## scripts/audit-jump-animation.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * Drives the REAL jump — the real state machine, the real ballistic arc, the real pose curves
 * (src/components/Three/jumpPose.ts) — over scripted input, and fails on the things the jump
 * rework exists to make impossible:
 *
 *   DEAD     a jump in which the limbs never move. The original bug: the arc played and the
 *            body did not, so every joint's total travel across the hop was zero.
 *   SNAP     any animated channel moving more than SNAP_LIMIT radians in one 60 Hz frame, or
 *            the root moving more than ROOT_SNAP_LIMIT world units. This is 「手腳突然跳到另一
 *            個姿勢」 measured rather than asserted, and it covers every phase JOIN as well as
 *            the two ends of the jump.
 *   DESYNC   the pose disagreeing with the physics: an 上升 pose while vy < 0, a 下降 pose while
 *            vy > 0, an airborne pose while the feet are down, or a 落地 that starts before the
 *            arc reaches the ground.
 *   STRANDED a jump that ends with the pose still applied (weight > 0 at 'grounded'), which is
 *            what leaves a limb parked mid-air after the animation is over.
 *   SUNK     the soles going through the ground during the crouch or the landing absorb — the
 *            root origin IS the contact point, so a dip that is not paid for by a bent knee is
 *            a foot underground.
 *   HANG     a jump that never comes back to 'grounded'; the failure mode the old flag had when
 *            it was set in a branch that could not clear it.
 *
 * Everything below the scripts is imported from the shipping module; nothing here restates a
 * curve, so what this measures is what ships.
 *
 *   npm run audit:jump
 */
import {
  createJumpState,
  stepJump,
  jumpFrame,
  isJumpAirborne,
  JUMP_APEX,
  JUMP_AIRTIME,
  JUMP_CROUCH_DURATION,
  type JumpPhase,
  type JumpState,
} from '../src/components/Three/jumpPose';
import type { RigJointName } from '../src/constants/interactionPostures';
import { LEGACY_SKELETON, CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE } from '../src/constants/characterRig';

const DT = 1 / 60;
const LEG_LENGTH = (LEGACY_SKELETON.hip.y - LEGACY_SKELETON.soleY) * CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE;

/**
 * Radians per frame — the absolute ceiling on how fast anything is allowed to move.
 *
 * 0.30 rad/frame is 18 rad/s, which is faster than any limb in this game has any business
 * being; the take-off arm swing, the fastest thing in the jump, peaks around 0.23.
 *
 * Note what this alone does NOT catch, and why the discontinuity check below exists as well:
 * fast is not the same as snapped. A swing spread smoothly over eight frames reads as a swing;
 * the same total travel taken in ONE frame is the 「手腳突然跳到另一個姿勢」 the brief is about,
 * and no single speed limit can tell those apart.
 */
const SNAP_LIMIT = 0.30;
/**
 * A frame may not move a channel more than this many times as far as the frames either side of
 * it. That is what a discontinuity IS — a spike in the first difference — and it is measured
 * rather than assumed, so it catches a bad phase join at any speed, including a slow one.
 */
const DISCONTINUITY_RATIO = 4;
/** Below this, a "spike" is float noise rather than a pop. */
const DISCONTINUITY_FLOOR = 0.02;
/** World units per frame. The arc itself covers ~0.28 at take-off, so this is the arc plus half. */
const ROOT_SNAP_LIMIT = 0.42;
/** How much total joint travel counts as "there is an animation here at all". */
const ALIVE_LIMIT = 0.5;

const JOINTS: RigJointName[] = ['head', 'torso', 'leftArm', 'rightArm', 'leftLeg', 'rightLeg'];

interface Sample {
  t: number;
  phase: JumpPhase;
  vy: number;
  ballistic: boolean;
  airborne: boolean;
  weight: number;
  rootOffset: number;
  /** The pose as the BODY sees it: the joint angle scaled by the weight it is applied at. */
  applied: Record<string, number>;
}

/** One frame of input, as the controller would have measured it. */
interface Step {
  requested?: boolean;
  canJump?: boolean;
  /** How far above its support the drawn body is. */
  gap?: number;
  /** How fast the support is falling away, units/s. */
  drop?: number;
}

/**
 * Runs a script and records what the body actually did.
 *
 * The support gap defaults to the arc's own height, which is what the controller measures on a
 * flat island: the rendered root is the support height plus the arc, so the gap IS the offset.
 */
function run(script: (frame: number, state: JumpState) => Step, frames: number): Sample[] {
  const state = createJumpState();
  const out: Sample[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
    const step = script(i, state);
    const gap = step.gap ?? Math.max(0, state.offsetY);
    stepJump(state, DT, {
      requested: step.requested ?? false,
      canJump: step.canJump ?? true,
      supportGap: gap,
      supportDrop: step.drop ?? 0,
    });
    const anim = jumpFrame(state, LEG_LENGTH);
    const applied: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const joint of JOINTS) {
      const pose = anim.pose[joint];
      applied[`${joint}.x`] = (pose?.x ?? 0) * anim.weight;
      applied[`${joint}.z`] = (pose?.z ?? 0) * anim.weight;
    }
    out.push({
      t: (i + 1) * DT,
      phase: state.phase,
      vy: state.vy,
      ballistic: state.ballistic,
      airborne: isJumpAirborne(state),
      weight: anim.weight,
      rootOffset: anim.rootOffset,
      applied,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Checks
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const failures: string[] = [];
const notes: string[] = [];

function fail(scenario: string, message: string) {
  failures.push(`${scenario}: ${message}`);
}

/** Total travel of every joint channel across the run — zero means nothing animated. */
function liveliness(samples: Sample[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
    for (const key of Object.keys(samples[i].applied)) {
      total += Math.abs(samples[i].applied[key] - samples[i - 1].applied[key]);
    }
  }
  return total;
}

function checkSnap(scenario: string, samples: Sample[]) {
  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) {
    for (const key of Object.keys(samples[i].applied)) {
      const d = Math.abs(samples[i].applied[key] - samples[i - 1].applied[key]);
      if (d > SNAP_LIMIT) {
        fail(scenario, `SNAP ${key} moved ${d.toFixed(3)} rad in one frame at t=${samples[i].t.toFixed(3)} (${samples[i - 1].phase}->${samples[i].phase})`);
        return;
      }
    }
    const dRoot = Math.abs(samples[i].rootOffset - samples[i - 1].rootOffset);
    if (dRoot > ROOT_SNAP_LIMIT) {
      fail(scenario, `SNAP root moved ${dRoot.toFixed(3)} units in one frame at t=${samples[i].t.toFixed(3)} (${samples[i - 1].phase}->${samples[i].phase})`);
      return;
    }
  }

  // The discontinuity half: one frame moving far more than its neighbours, which is what a
  // mismatched phase join looks like whatever the speed.
  const channels = [...Object.keys(samples[0].applied), 'root'];
  const valueOf = (s: Sample, key: string) => (key === 'root' ? s.rootOffset : s.applied[key]);
  for (const key of channels) {
    for (let i = 2; i < samples.length - 1; i++) {
      const d = Math.abs(valueOf(samples[i], key) - valueOf(samples[i - 1], key));
      const before = Math.abs(valueOf(samples[i - 1], key) - valueOf(samples[i - 2], key));
      const after = Math.abs(valueOf(samples[i + 1], key) - valueOf(samples[i], key));
      const neighbours = Math.max(before, after);
      if (d > DISCONTINUITY_FLOOR && d > DISCONTINUITY_RATIO * neighbours + DISCONTINUITY_FLOOR) {
        fail(scenario, `SNAP ${key} jumped ${d.toFixed(3)} against neighbours of ${neighbours.toFixed(3)} at t=${samples[i].t.toFixed(3)} (${samples[i - 1].phase}->${samples[i].phase})`);
        return;
      }
    }
  }
}

function checkSync(scenario: string, samples: Sample[]) {
  for (const s of samples) {
    if (!s.ballistic) continue;
    if (s.phase === 'rise' && s.vy <= 0) fail(scenario, `DESYNC 上升 pose with vy=${s.vy.toFixed(2)} at t=${s.t.toFixed(3)}`);
    if (s.phase === 'fall' && s.vy > 0) fail(scenario, `DESYNC 下降 pose with vy=${s.vy.toFixed(2)} at t=${s.t.toFixed(3)}`);
    if (s.airborne && s.rootOffset <= 0 && s.phase !== 'takeoff') {
      fail(scenario, `DESYNC airborne at ground level (offset ${s.rootOffset.toFixed(3)}) at t=${s.t.toFixed(3)}`);
    }
    if (!s.airborne && s.rootOffset > 0.01) {
      fail(scenario, `DESYNC grounded pose while ${s.rootOffset.toFixed(3)} above the ground at t=${s.t.toFixed(3)}`);
    }
  }
}

function checkStranded(scenario: string, samples: Sample[]) {
  for (const s of samples) {
    if (s.phase === 'grounded' && s.weight > 0.0001) {
      fail(scenario, `STRANDED pose still applied at weight ${s.weight.toFixed(3)} after the jump ended`);
      return;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * The soles, during the phases the character's own weight is on them.
 *
 * Foot height above the support = the dip (negative rootOffset) plus what the bent leg gives
 * back, L(1 - cos θ). Anything below zero is a foot in the terrain.
 */
function checkFeet(scenario: string, samples: Sample[]) {
  for (const s of samples) {
    if (s.phase !== 'crouch' && s.phase !== 'land') continue;
    const legAngle = s.applied['leftLeg.x'];
    const knee = LEG_LENGTH * (1 - Math.cos(legAngle));
    const sole = s.rootOffset + knee;
    if (sole < -0.005) {
      fail(scenario, `SUNK sole ${sole.toFixed(4)} below the surface during ${s.phase} at t=${s.t.toFixed(3)}`);
      return;
    }
  }
}

function checkAlive(scenario: string, samples: Sample[]) {
  const life = liveliness(samples);
  if (life < ALIVE_LIMIT) fail(scenario, `DEAD total joint travel ${life.toFixed(3)} rad - the model is being moved, not animated`);
  else notes.push(`${scenario}: ${life.toFixed(2)} rad of joint travel`);
}

function checkTerminates(scenario: string, samples: Sample[]) {
  if (samples[samples.length - 1].phase !== 'grounded') {
    fail(scenario, `HANG ended in phase '${samples[samples.length - 1].phase}'`);
  }
}

function phases(samples: Sample[]): JumpPhase[] {
  const seq: JumpPhase[] = [];
  for (const s of samples) if (seq[seq.length - 1] !== s.phase) seq.push(s.phase);
  return seq;
}

function audit(scenario: string, samples: Sample[], opts: { terminates?: boolean } = {}) {
  checkAlive(scenario, samples);
  checkSnap(scenario, samples);
  checkSync(scenario, samples);
  checkStranded(scenario, samples);
  checkFeet(scenario, samples);
  // Skipped only where the script itself is still asking for jumps on the last frame.
  if (opts.terminates !== false) checkTerminates(scenario, samples);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Scenarios — sections 九.1 to 九.6 of the brief
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 1/2/3. Jumping from a standstill, while walking and while running are the same jump: the
// controller's horizontal speed is not an input to it. What varies is the pose the jump blends
// AGAINST, which is applyBodyPose's business and is covered by the weight envelope reaching 0
// at both ends (STRANDED).
const plain = run((i) => ({ requested: i === 0 }), 90);
audit('standing jump', plain);

{
  const seq = phases(plain);
  const want: JumpPhase[] = ['crouch', 'takeoff', 'rise', 'fall', 'land', 'grounded'];
  if (seq.join(' -> ') !== want.join(' -> ')) {
    fail('standing jump', `phase sequence was ${seq.join(' -> ')}, expected ${want.join(' -> ')}`);
  }
  const apex = Math.max(...plain.map(s => s.rootOffset));
  if (Math.abs(apex - JUMP_APEX) > 0.05) fail('standing jump', `apex ${apex.toFixed(3)} != JUMP_APEX ${JUMP_APEX}`);
  const airborne = plain.filter(s => s.airborne).length * DT;
  if (Math.abs(airborne - JUMP_AIRTIME) > 0.05) fail('standing jump', `airtime ${airborne.toFixed(3)} != JUMP_AIRTIME ${JUMP_AIRTIME}`);
  const liftoff = plain.findIndex(s => s.airborne) * DT;
  if (liftoff > JUMP_CROUCH_DURATION + 2 * DT) fail('standing jump', `${liftoff.toFixed(3)}s of input latency before take-off`);
  notes.push(`standing jump: ${liftoff.toFixed(3)}s to take-off, ${airborne.toFixed(3)}s airborne, apex ${apex.toFixed(2)}`);
}

// 4. 連續跳躍 — space held down. Every hop must be a whole jump, not a stutter.
const held = run(() => ({ requested: true }), 240);
audit('held jump', held, { terminates: false });
{
  const hops = held.filter((s, i) => s.phase === 'takeoff' && held[i - 1]?.phase !== 'takeoff').length;
  if (hops < 3) fail('held jump', `only ${hops} hops in 4 seconds of holding the key`);
  else notes.push(`held jump: ${hops} hops in 4s`);
}

// A jump pressed a beat before touchdown must still be honoured (the buffer), and pressing it
// twice in mid-air must not produce two.
const buffered = run((i) => ({ requested: i === 0 || i === 30 || i === 31 }), 120);
audit('buffered jump', buffered);
{
  const hops = buffered.filter((s, i) => s.phase === 'takeoff' && buffered[i - 1]?.phase !== 'takeoff').length;
  if (hops !== 2) fail('buffered jump', `expected exactly 2 hops from a buffered press, got ${hops}`);
}

// 5. 從高處落下 — the ground vanishes in a single frame (a ledge), the body is left above it
// for half a second, and then the terrain catches up underneath.
const cliff = run((i) => ({ drop: i === 10 ? 90 : 0, gap: i > 10 && i < 45 ? 1.4 : 0 }), 120);
audit('walking off a ledge', cliff);
{
  const seq = phases(cliff);
  if (!seq.includes('fall') || !seq.includes('land')) {
    fail('walking off a ledge', `never fell or never landed: ${seq.join(' -> ')}`);
  }
  const arc = Math.max(...cliff.map(s => Math.abs(s.rootOffset)));
  // A free fall is the TERRAIN's, not the jump's: the machine may pose the body but must not
  // add an arc of its own on top of a drop the controller is already easing through.
  if (arc > 0.1) fail('walking off a ledge', `the fall pose displaced the root by ${arc.toFixed(3)} units of its own`);
}

// The bug this audit was extended for: walking DOWN A SLOPE opens the same gap a ledge does
// (0.79 measured in game, against a 0.45 threshold), and must not be read as a fall.
const slope = run(() => ({ gap: 0.79, drop: 1.2 }), 180);
if (slope.some(s => s.phase !== 'grounded')) {
  fail('walking downhill', `a slope walk was read as a fall (${slope.find(s => s.phase !== 'grounded')!.phase})`);
}
if (slope.some(s => s.weight > 0)) fail('walking downhill', 'the fall pose was applied while walking downhill');

// 6. Jumping when the rules forbid it (sitting, mid-somersault, swimming): nothing happens, and
// nothing is left half-applied.
const denied = run(() => ({ requested: true, canJump: false }), 60);
if (denied.some(s => s.phase !== 'grounded')) fail('jump denied', 'a jump started while it was forbidden');
if (denied.some(s => s.weight > 0)) fail('jump denied', 'the pose was applied while no jump was allowed');

// Losing permission MID-AIR (walking into water) must not freeze the body in flight.
const interrupted = run((i) => ({ requested: i === 0, canJump: i < 20 }), 120);
audit('permission lost mid-air', interrupted);

// A frame hitch: the controller clamps delta to 0.1s, and the machine must survive one.
{
  const state = createJumpState();
  const seen: JumpPhase[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    stepJump(state, i === 3 ? 0.1 : DT, { requested: i === 0, canJump: true, supportGap: Math.max(0, state.offsetY), supportDrop: 0 });
    if (seen[seen.length - 1] !== state.phase) seen.push(state.phase);
    const anim = jumpFrame(state, LEG_LENGTH);
    if (!Number.isFinite(anim.rootOffset) || !Number.isFinite(anim.weight)) {
      fail('frame hitch', 'produced a non-finite frame');
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!seen.includes('land')) fail('frame hitch', `never landed: ${seen.join(' -> ')}`);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

console.log('--- jump animation audit ---');
for (const note of notes) console.log('  ' + note);
// For comparison, and it needs no probe to measure: the jump this replaced was one phase
// (`sin(progress * PI) * 1.9` over a fixed 0.4 s) driving the ROOT's position and scale, and
// there was no line anywhere in the file that wrote a joint while it ran. Its joint travel is
// 0.00 rad by construction, which is the reported bug stated as a number.
console.log('  legacy jump: 1 phase, 0.00 rad of joint travel (the reported bug)');

if (failures.length > 0) {
  console.error(`\n${failures.length} failure(s):`);
  for (const f of failures) console.error('  ✗ ' + f);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('\n✓ jump animation OK');

```

## scripts/audit-object-animations.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * DOES EVERY INTERACTIVE OBJECT ACTUALLY REACT, AND DOES EVERY DECLARED PART EXIST?
 *
 * The guard on the Object Interaction Animation System, and it exists because that system has
 * exactly one failure mode worth automating against: **a part name that does not match anything**.
 *
 * `constants/objectAnimations.ts` says 「the wardrobe's `doorLeft` swings 76 degrees」 and
 * `Three/FurnitureItem.tsx` says `ref={anim.ref('doorLeft')}`. Those two strings are the join, and
 * nothing type-checks them against each other — a typo on either side produces no error, no
 * warning and no crash. It produces a wardrobe whose doors do not open, which looks exactly like
 * the bug this whole system was built to fix. So the join is checked here, in both directions.
 *
 * Four parts:
 *
 *   1  every interactive item either has an object reaction or is a listed exception
 *   2  every part a row declares is `ref`'d by the model that row belongs to
 *   3  every part a model `ref`s is declared by its row
 *   4  the numbers are within sane bounds, and the behaviour matches the interaction's family
 *
 * Run: npm run audit:object-animations
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { ALL_ITEMS } from '../src/constants/items';
import {
  OBJECT_ANIMATIONS,
  ObjectAnimationSpec,
  ObjectPartSpec,
} from '../src/constants/objectAnimations';
import {
  getPrimaryInteraction,
  interactionOccupies,
  interactionPosture,
} from '../src/constants/furnitureInteractions';
import { getPosture } from '../src/constants/interactionPostures';
import { SUSPENDED_MOTIONS } from '../src/constants/outdoorAnimation';
import { resolveLaunchHeading } from '../src/lib/objectAnimation';

const FURNITURE_ITEM = path.join(process.cwd(), 'src/components/Three/FurnitureItem.tsx');

let checks = 0;
let failures = 0;

function ok(label: string, detail = ''): void {
  checks++;
  console.log(`  ok    ${label}${detail ? `   ${detail}` : ''}`);
}
function fail(label: string, detail: string): void {
  checks++;
  failures++;
  console.log(`  FAIL  ${label}\n        ${detail}`);
}
function check(condition: boolean, label: string, detail: string): void {
  if (condition) ok(label);
  else fail(label, detail);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- reading the model file as text */

const source = fs.readFileSync(FURNITURE_ITEM, 'utf8');

/**
 * model id -> component name, read out of the `FURNITURE_MODELS` table.
 *
 * Parsed from the source rather than imported, because what this audit needs is the TEXT of each
 * component (to see which `anim.ref` names it uses), and a module import gives a function whose
 * body is not reliably introspectable after a bundler has been near it.
 */
function readModelTable(): Map<string, string> {
  const table = new Map<string, string>();
  const start = source.indexOf('const FURNITURE_MODELS');
  if (start < 0) throw new Error('FURNITURE_MODELS table not found in FurnitureItem.tsx');
  const end = source.indexOf('\n};', start);
  const body = source.slice(start, end);
  for (const m of body.matchAll(/'([a-z0-9-]+)':\s*(\w+),/g)) table.set(m[1], m[2]);
  return table;
}

/** The source text of one top-level `function Name(...) { … }`, to its closing brace at column 0. */
function componentSource(name: string): string | null {
  const start = source.indexOf(`function ${name}(`);
  if (start < 0) return null;
  const end = source.indexOf('\n}', start);
  return end < 0 ? source.slice(start) : source.slice(start, end + 2);
}

/** Every `anim.ref('x')` name inside one component. */
function refNames(body: string): Set<string> {
  const names = new Set<string>();
  for (const m of body.matchAll(/anim\.ref\('([^']+)'/g)) names.add(m[1]);
  return names;
}

const MODEL_TABLE = readModelTable();

/* ------------------------------------------------------- part 1: coverage */

/**
 * Interactive pieces that deliberately have NO object-side reaction, and why.
 *
 * Being on this list is a decision. Being on neither this list nor the table is an oversight, and
 * that is the whole point of separating them: 「we thought about the telescope」 and 「we forgot
 * the telescope」 look identical in a codebase and completely different here.
 */
const NO_REACTION_BY_DESIGN: Record<string, string> = {
  hammock: 'sways under its rider — SUSPENDED_MOTIONS.hammock, a richer mechanism than a part',
  swing: 'sways under its rider — SUSPENDED_MOTIONS.swing',
  'hanging-chair': 'sways under its rider — SUSPENDED_MOTIONS.hangingChair',
  'rocking-chair': 'rocks under its rider — SUSPENDED_MOTIONS.rockingChair',
  // 營火、望遠鏡、鳥屋、許願井 used to be listed here, each 「from its own rig」. They are rows in
  // OBJECT_ANIMATIONS now, so this audit checks their parts like everyone else's — and a fifth
  // piece that grows its own trigger loop has to be argued onto this list rather than slip past.
};

console.log('\n=== part 1: every interactive piece reacts, or says why not ===\n');

const interactiveItems = ALL_ITEMS.filter((i) => (i.interactions?.length ?? 0) > 0);
const missing: string[] = [];
let reacting = 0;
let byOtherMeans = 0;

for (const item of interactiveItems) {
  const model = item.model;
  if (!model) {
    missing.push(`${item.name} (${item.id}) has an interaction but no model`);
    continue;
  }
  if (OBJECT_ANIMATIONS[model as keyof typeof OBJECT_ANIMATIONS]) { reacting++; continue; }
  if (NO_REACTION_BY_DESIGN[model]) { byOtherMeans++; continue; }
  missing.push(`${item.name} (${item.id}, model '${model}')`);
}

check(
  missing.length === 0,
  `all ${interactiveItems.length} interactive items have an object reaction`,
  `no reaction and no stated exception for:\n        ${missing.join('\n        ')}`,
);
console.log(`        ${reacting} driven by OBJECT_ANIMATIONS, ${byOtherMeans} by a stated exception (see NO_REACTION_BY_DESIGN)`);

// The exception list must not rot: a model listed there has to still exist and still be
// interactive, or the list is a record of something that used to be true.
const interactiveModels = new Set<string>();
for (const i of interactiveItems) if (i.model) interactiveModels.add(i.model);
const staleExceptions = Object.keys(NO_REACTION_BY_DESIGN).filter((m) => !interactiveModels.has(m));
check(
  staleExceptions.length === 0,
  'no stale entries in the deliberate-exception list',
  `these models are listed as exceptions but are not interactive: ${staleExceptions.join(', ')}`,
);

/* ------------------------------------------------------- part 2 & 3: the name join */

console.log('\n=== part 2: every declared part is wired to a group in its model ===\n');

const entries = Object.entries(OBJECT_ANIMATIONS) as [string, ObjectAnimationSpec][];
const componentFor = new Map<string, string>();

for (const [modelId] of entries) {
  const component = MODEL_TABLE.get(modelId);
  if (!component) {
    fail(`${modelId} · model id resolves to a component`, 'not present in FURNITURE_MODELS');
    continue;
  }
  componentFor.set(modelId, component);
}

for (const [modelId, spec] of entries) {
  const component = componentFor.get(modelId);
  if (!component) continue;
  const body = componentSource(component);
  if (!body) {
    fail(`${modelId} · ${component} source found`, 'component not found in FurnitureItem.tsx');
    continue;
  }

  const wired = refNames(body);
  const parts = Object.keys(spec.parts ?? {});
  /*
   * A LAUNCH GROUP is a declared part too — it just answers a different question.
   *
   * `parts` says how far a thing moves; `launch.part` says which way it faces before it starts.
   * Both are the same untyped string join between a table and a JSX call site, which is the join
   * this whole audit exists for: a typo in either produces a frisbee that flies perfectly, in
   * the one direction the model was drawn in, which is exactly the bug the launch system was
   * added to fix and is indistinguishable from it.
   */
  const declared = spec.launch ? [...parts, spec.launch.part] : parts;

  const unwired = declared.filter((p) => !wired.has(p));
  if (unwired.length > 0) {
    fail(
      `${modelId} · declared parts are wired`,
      `${component} never calls anim.ref for: ${unwired.join(', ')} — these do nothing`,
    );
  }

  const undeclared = [...wired].filter((p) => !declared.includes(p));
  if (undeclared.length > 0) {
    fail(
      `${modelId} · wired parts are declared`,
      `${component} refs ${undeclared.join(', ')}, which OBJECT_ANIMATIONS does not drive`,
    );
  }

  // The launch group carries ONLY the heading. A group that both yaws and slides turns the part
  // on the spot and leaves it travelling along the old heading — see ObjectLaunchSpec.part.
  if (spec.launch && parts.includes(spec.launch.part)) {
    fail(
      `${modelId} · the launch group only aims`,
      `\`${spec.launch.part}\` is also a row in \`parts\` — a node's position is expressed in its `
      + 'PARENT\'s frame, so yawing the group that slides moves it along the old heading',
    );
  }

  if (unwired.length === 0 && undeclared.length === 0) {
    ok(`${modelId} · ${declared.length} part(s) joined`, declared.join(', ') || '(effects only)');
  }

  // A model that calls the hook must anchor it, or it registers an entry the cull can never see
  // and silently never animates — the quietest possible way for all of this to do nothing.
  const anchored = body.includes('anim.root') || /useObjectAnimation\([^)]*,\s*\w+Ref\)/.test(body);
  check(
    anchored,
    `${modelId} · ${component} anchors its animation`,
    'calls useObjectAnimation but never attaches anim.root nor passes an anchor ref',
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- part 4: the numbers */

console.log('\n=== part 3: the rows are within sane bounds ===\n');

/** Nothing in a low-poly cottage game should swing further than this. */
const MAX_HINGE = Math.PI * 1.2;
/** A slide is a drawer or a throw, not a teleport. */
const MAX_SLIDE = 4;

function auditPart(modelId: string, name: string, part: ObjectPartSpec): void {
  const where = `${modelId}.${name}`;
  if (part.motion === 'hinge' && Math.abs(part.travel) > MAX_HINGE && part.signal !== 'spin') {
    fail(`${where} · hinge travel is a sane angle`, `${part.travel.toFixed(2)} rad exceeds ${MAX_HINGE.toFixed(2)}`);
    return;
  }
  if (part.motion === 'slide' && Math.abs(part.travel) > MAX_SLIDE) {
    fail(`${where} · slide travel is a sane distance`, `${part.travel} model units exceeds ${MAX_SLIDE}`);
    return;
  }
  if (part.motion === 'scale' && part.travel <= -1) {
    fail(`${where} · scale never inverts`, `travel ${part.travel} would flip or flatten the part`);
    return;
  }
  if ((part.signal === 'spin' || part.signal === 'wobble') && !(part.period! > 0)) {
    fail(`${where} · ${part.signal} states a period`, 'period is required and must be positive');
    return;
  }
  if (part.range) {
    const [from, to] = part.range;
    if (!(from >= 0 && to <= 1 && from < to)) {
      fail(`${where} · range is an ordered slice of 0..1`, `got [${from}, ${to}]`);
      return;
    }
  }
  if (part.signal === 'pulse' && part.over != null && !(part.over > 0)) {
    fail(`${where} · pulse window is positive`, `over = ${part.over}`);
    return;
  }
  ok(`${where} · ${part.motion}/${part.signal ?? 'open'}`, `travel ${part.travel}`);
}

for (const [modelId, spec] of entries) {
  for (const [name, part] of Object.entries(spec.parts ?? {})) auditPart(modelId, name, part);

  if (spec.cue != null && !(spec.cue >= 0 && spec.cue <= 1)) {
    fail(`${modelId} · cue is a fraction of the posture`, `cue = ${spec.cue}, expected 0..1`);
  }
  for (const [field, value] of [
    ['openTime', spec.openTime], ['closeTime', spec.closeTime], ['hold', spec.hold],
  ] as const) {
    if (value != null && !(value > 0)) fail(`${modelId} · ${field} is positive`, `${field} = ${value}`);
  }
  if ((spec.behaviour === 'momentary' || spec.behaviour === 'run') && spec.hold == null) {
    fail(`${modelId} · a self-closing piece states its hold`, `behaviour '${spec.behaviour}' with no hold`);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- part 5: behaviour vs interaction */

console.log('\n=== part 4: the behaviour matches what the interaction actually does ===\n');

for (const [modelId, spec] of entries) {
  const item = ALL_ITEMS.find((i) => i.model === modelId && (i.interactions?.length ?? 0) > 0);
  if (!item) {
    // 'fountain' before its interaction existed was exactly this case, and it is worth catching:
    // a reaction on a piece nobody can interact with can never play.
    fail(`${modelId} · has an interactive item`, 'a row here but no item with an interaction');
    continue;
  }
  const interaction = getPrimaryInteraction(item.id)!;
  const occupies = interactionOccupies(interaction);

  if (spec.behaviour === 'occupied') {
    check(
      occupies,
      `${modelId} · 'occupied' belongs to an occupying interaction`,
      `${item.name}'s ${interaction.kind} hands the player back, so no occupancy event ever fires`,
    );
  } else {
    check(
      !occupies,
      `${modelId} · press behaviour belongs to an acting interaction`,
      `${item.name}'s ${interaction.kind} holds the player, so no 'furniture-interact' ever fires`,
    );
    // The cue is resolved against the posture's own duration; an acting posture always has one.
    const posture = getPosture(interactionPosture(interaction));
    check(
      (posture.duration ?? 0) > 0,
      `${modelId} · its posture states a duration for the cue`,
      `posture '${interactionPosture(interaction)}' has no duration, so cue ${spec.cue} resolves to 0 s`,
    );
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- part 6: sway rows are reachable */

console.log('\n=== part 5: every suspended motion is referenced by an item ===\n');

for (const id of Object.keys(SUSPENDED_MOTIONS)) {
  const users = ALL_ITEMS.filter((i) => i.interactions?.some((x) => x.sway === id));
  check(
    users.length > 0,
    `SUSPENDED_MOTIONS.${id} is used`,
    'declared but no item references it via interactions[].sway',
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- part 6: a throw follows the thrower */

/*
 * THE DYNAMIC-DIRECTION CHECK, and the reason it can be a unit test rather than a play session.
 *
 * The bug it guards is 「不論從哪一邊互動，物品都往同一個方向飛」, and the shape of that bug is a
 * CONSTANT: a heading that does not move when the player does. So the test is exactly that —
 * walk a synthetic player round the piece, resolve the real heading each time with the real
 * function, and require it to follow. A hard-coded `Vector3`, a fixed local axis or a forgotten
 * `launch` row all fail it the same way, by producing the same number twice.
 *
 * `spread` is deliberately excluded (jitter 0): the fan is a separate, wanted randomness, and
 * folding it in here would make a direction test flaky for the one reason that is not a defect.
 */
console.log('\n=== part 6: a launched piece follows the player who launched it ===\n');

/** Eight approach bearings, so the four the brief names (left/right/front/back) plus the corners. */
const BEARINGS = [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315];

for (const [modelId, spec] of entries) {
  const launch = spec.launch;
  if (!launch) continue;

  // The piece at the origin; the player one unit out on each bearing, facing it — which is where
  // the interaction system actually puts them (an acting posture resolves a stand spot on the
  // side the player approached from, squared up to the piece).
  const headings = BEARINGS.map((deg) => {
    const bearing = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const px = Math.sin(bearing);
    const pz = Math.cos(bearing);
    return resolveLaunchHeading(launch, {
      playerX: px,
      playerZ: pz,
      // Facing back at the piece from wherever they stand.
      playerYaw: Math.atan2(-px, -pz),
      objectX: 0,
      objectZ: 0,
    });
  });

  const unique = new Set(headings.map((h) => h.toFixed(4)));
  check(
    unique.size === BEARINGS.length,
    `${modelId} · every approach gives its own heading`,
    `${BEARINGS.length} approaches produced only ${unique.size} distinct headings — the direction `
    + 'is not reading the player',
  );

  // ...and it is the RIGHT own heading: a piece launched by someone standing due south of it
  // goes north. Checked as the angle between the resolved heading and the player→piece line,
  // which is 0 for any `fromFacing` when the player is squared up — that is the whole point of
  // the two sources agreeing for a piece you walk up to.
  let worst = 0;
  BEARINGS.forEach((deg, i) => {
    const bearing = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    // Player at bearing B faces the piece, so the throw should go along B + 180.
    const want = Math.atan2(-Math.sin(bearing), -Math.cos(bearing));
    let delta = headings[i] - want;
    while (delta > Math.PI) delta -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (delta < -Math.PI) delta += Math.PI * 2;
    worst = Math.max(worst, Math.abs(delta));
  });
  check(
    worst < 1e-6,
    `${modelId} · it goes away from the thrower`,
    `worst approach is ${((worst * 180) / Math.PI).toFixed(2)} deg off the line away from the player`,
  );

  // The two sources have to be genuinely wired, not just one of them. A player standing beside
  // the piece and looking elsewhere separates them, and a `fromFacing` strictly between 0 and 1
  // must land strictly between the two answers.
  if (launch.fromFacing > 0 && launch.fromFacing < 1) {
    const aside = { playerX: -1, playerZ: 0, objectX: 0, objectZ: 0 };
    const looking = Math.PI / 2 + 1.0; // facing the piece's +X side, a radian off the line to it
    const blended = resolveLaunchHeading(launch, { ...aside, playerYaw: looking });
    const pureAway = Math.PI / 2;
    check(
      Math.abs(blended - pureAway) > 1e-3 && Math.abs(blended - looking) > 1e-3,
      `${modelId} · the blend uses both facing and approach`,
      `fromFacing ${launch.fromFacing} still resolved to one of the two ends (${blended.toFixed(4)})`,
    );
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------- verdict */

console.log('');
if (failures > 0) {
  console.log(`FAIL — ${failures} of ${checks} checks failed.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log(
  `PASS — ${checks} checks. Every interactive piece reacts, and every part it declares is wired.`,
);

```

## scripts/audit-outdoor-quality.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * OUTDOOR ASSET QUALITY STANDARD —— 室外資產的品質下限，做成一個會失敗的檢查。
 *
 * ## 這個稽核在擋什麼
 *
 * 回報的原話是「屋內家具很精緻，但走到屋外就像另一個品質較低的遊戲」。把每一件室外物品量過
 * 之後，問題不是「室外整體比較差」，而是室外那一櫃**分層**了：最近做的東西（白色柵欄、十件
 * 寵物窩、許願井）早就在室內的水準上，而目錄裡最早的那五件（木製平台、噴泉、椰子樹、吊床、
 * 火把）從來沒被回頭修過 —— 它們是 3 個 mesh、2 種顏色。一櫃裡有兩種品質，比整櫃都樸素更難看。
 *
 * 所以這裡量的不是「好不好看」（沒辦法量），而是三件可以量、而且**低於它就一定不好看**的事：
 *
 *  1. **結構層數**（mesh 數量）。一個只有兩三個 primitive 的物件，不可能同時有主體、撐住它的
 *     東西、以及任何裝飾細節 —— 那就是「看起來像基礎 Geometry」的定義。下限依物件大小分級，
 *     因為一支火把本來就不需要跟一座噴泉一樣多零件。
 *  2. **色彩層次**（相異材質顏色數）。單色的木頭在 low poly 裡會糊成一坨，因為沒有貼圖去分隔
 *     相鄰的面。至少三階：受光面／主體／深色結構件。
 *  3. **Draw call 預算**（mesh 數量上限）。島上可能同時站著幾十件擺設，每個 mesh 是一個
 *     draw call。細節是拿來花的，花完就要停 —— 這一條跟第 1 條是同一個數字的兩端。
 *
 * ## 分級是量出來的，不是填的
 *
 * 大／中／小從模型自己的水平尺寸算出來（見 SIZE_CLASSES），沒有商品可以宣告自己是小東西來躲掉
 * 下限。跟 lib/furniturePlacement.ts 對碰撞體積的處理同一個原則：尺寸從畫出來的東西量，不從
 * 表格裡讀。
 *
 * ## 室內是對照組，不是受檢對象
 *
 * 室內家具的數字一起印出來，因為這個標準的目標本來就是「跟室內一致」；哪天室內整體再往上走，
 * 這裡的比值會先在報告裡看得出來，然後才需要調門檻。
 *
 * Run: npm run audit:outdoor
 */

import * as THREE from 'three';
import React from 'react';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { ALL_ITEMS } from '../src/constants/items';
import { DISPLAY_CATEGORIES } from '../src/utils/categoryUtils';
import { FurnitureModel } from '../src/components/Three/FurnitureItem';
import { HouseModel, getHouseVisualHeight } from '../src/components/Three/HouseModel';
import { HOUSE_STYLES } from '../src/constants/houseStyles';
import {
  LANDSCAPE_TIERS, LandscapeTier, PLAYER_WORLD_HEIGHT, landscapeTierOf,
} from '../src/constants/outdoorScale';
import {
  GEO_BOUNDS, ISLAND_SCALE, INTERIOR_SCALE, brokenComponents, renderComponent,
} from './lib/measureFurnitureModel';

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ walking a model */

type Sample = {
  meshes: number;
  colours: Set<string>;
  geometries: Set<string>;
  /** How deep the group nesting goes — a proxy for "is this assembled, or is it a pile". */
  depth: number;
  box: THREE.Box3;
};


function toVec3(v: unknown, fallback: number): THREE.Vector3 {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return new THREE.Vector3(v, v, v);
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return new THREE.Vector3(v[0] ?? fallback, v[1] ?? fallback, v[2] ?? fallback);
  return new THREE.Vector3(fallback, fallback, fallback);
}

function localMatrix(props: any): THREE.Matrix4 {
  const rot = toVec3(props.rotation, 0);
  return new THREE.Matrix4().compose(
    toVec3(props.position, 0),
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(rot.x, rot.y, rot.z)),
    toVec3(props.scale, 1),
  );
}

/** The first descendant element whose tag matches — used to read a mesh's own material. */
function findChild(children: any, match: (tag: string) => boolean): any {
  if (children == null || typeof children !== 'object') return undefined;
  if (Array.isArray(children)) {
    for (const c of children) { const hit = findChild(c, match); if (hit) return hit; }
    return undefined;
  }
  if (!React.isValidElement(children)) return undefined;
  const t: any = (children as any).type;
  if (typeof t === 'string' && match(t)) return children;
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * A mesh that DRAWS something rather than IS something —— 火焰粒子、鏡頭反光、互動時才飛出來的
 * 羽毛與火星。
 *
 * 它們不算結構，理由跟 lib/collisionShape.ts 不把它們算進碰撞體是同一個：一團火不是一個零件。
 * 而且它們的尺寸是每一幀在 useFrame 裡設的（`mesh.scale.setScalar(...)`），JSX 裡宣告的是半徑 1
 * 的球 —— 照著宣告去量，一支火把會量成 4.7 個世界單位寬。
 *
 * 兩個判準：`visible={false}`（平常不在畫面上，互動時才出現），或材質關掉了 depthWrite／改了
 * blending（那是「畫上去的光」而不是「擋得住的東西」的標記，出貨用的 measureFootprint 認的也是
 * 這兩個欄位）。
 */
function isEffectMesh(props: any): boolean {
  if (props.visible === false) return true;
  const material = findChild(props.children, (t) => t.endsWith('Material'));
  const mp = material?.props ?? {};
  return mp.depthWrite === false || mp.blending != null;
}

function walk(node: any, parent: THREE.Matrix4, out: Sample, depth: number, effect = false): void {
  if (node == null || typeof node !== 'object') return;
  if (Array.isArray(node)) { node.forEach((n) => walk(n, parent, out, depth, effect)); return; }
  if (!React.isValidElement(node)) return;

  const type: any = (node as any).type;
  const props: any = (node as any).props ?? {};

  if (type === React.Fragment) { walk(props.children, parent, out, depth, effect); return; }
  // Through the shared harness, so an animated model (鞦韆/營火/望遠鏡/鳥屋/許願井) is measured
  // in its rest pose rather than skipped — see renderComponent's doc for why that matters.
  if (typeof type === 'function') {
    walk(renderComponent(type, props), parent, out, depth, effect);
    return;
  }
  if (typeof type !== 'string') return;

  const here = new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(parent, localMatrix(props));
  const here_effect = effect || (type === 'mesh' && isEffectMesh(props)) || props.visible === false;

  if (type === 'mesh' && !here_effect) out.meshes++;
  if ((type === 'group' || type === 'mesh') && !here_effect) out.depth = Math.max(out.depth, depth + 1);

  // A colour may be a literal or a shared palette constant; either way it arrives as a string.
  if (type.endsWith('Material') && typeof props.color === 'string' && !here_effect) {
    out.colours.add(props.color.toLowerCase());
  }

  const bounds = GEO_BOUNDS[type];
  if (bounds && !here_effect) {
    out.geometries.add(type.replace('Geometry', ''));
    const [w, h, d] = bounds(props.args ?? []);
    const v = new THREE.Vector3();
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      v.set(i & 1 ? w / 2 : -w / 2, i & 2 ? h / 2 : -h / 2, i & 4 ? d / 2 : -d / 2).applyMatrix4(here);
      out.box.expandByPoint(v);
    }
  }

  walk(props.children, here, out, depth + 1, here_effect);
}

function sample(item: any, scale: number): Sample | null {
  const out: Sample = { meshes: 0, colours: new Set(), geometries: new Set(), depth: 0, box: new THREE.Box3() };
  walk(React.createElement(FurnitureModel, { name: item.name, item, scale }), new THREE.Matrix4(), out, 0);
  return out.meshes === 0 ? null : out;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the standard */

/**
 * The three size classes and what each owes the player, keyed off the model's own largest
 * horizontal extent (world units, at the scale it is drawn in the world it lives in).
 *
 * The split follows the brief: 大型物件重視 Silhouette + Structure；中型物件增加 Secondary
 * Details；小型物件優先確保 Readability + Distinctive Shape，而且不要塞太多細節造成畫面雜亂 ——
 * which is why the ceiling matters as much as the floor. A 30-mesh 火把 would be as wrong as a
 * 3-mesh one, in the other direction.
 */
const SIZE_CLASSES = [
  { name: 'Large ', minSpan: 2.0, minMeshes: 12, maxMeshes: 34, minColours: 4 },
  { name: 'Medium', minSpan: 0.8, minMeshes: 8, maxMeshes: 26, minColours: 3 },
  { name: 'Small ', minSpan: 0, minMeshes: 4, maxMeshes: 16, minColours: 2 },
] as const;

const classOf = (span: number) => SIZE_CLASSES.find((c) => span >= c.minSpan)!;

/**
 * Pieces exempt from the mesh FLOOR, with the reason. Nothing is ever exempt from the ceiling.
 *
 * Keep this at zero entries if you can. An exemption is a promise that the piece reads well at
 * three primitives, and that promise was wrong for all five of the original outdoor items — each
 * "obviously" did not need more parts until someone stood next to one.
 */
const FLOOR_EXEMPT: Record<string, string> = {};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ run */

const byCat = new Map(DISPLAY_CATEGORIES.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
const scopeOf = (catId: string) => {
  const c = byCat.get(catId) as any;
  return c ? (c.placementScope ?? c.mainSection) : '??';
};

type Row = {
  item: any; zone: 'OUT' | 'IN'; span: number; height: number; cls: typeof SIZE_CLASSES[number];
  meshes: number; colours: number; geometries: number; depth: number;
};

const rows: Row[] = [];
const unmeasured: string[] = [];

for (const item of ALL_ITEMS) {
  const scope = scopeOf(item.shopCategory);
  if (scope !== 'OUTDOOR' && scope !== 'INDOOR') continue;
  // Applied shelves (地板/牆面/房屋外觀) are not furniture models on this path — the Home's own
  // exterior is checked by its own geometry, not here.
  const cat = byCat.get(item.shopCategory) as any;
  if (!cat || cat.kind !== 'placeable') continue;

  const zone = scope === 'OUTDOOR' ? 'OUT' : 'IN';
  const scale = zone === 'OUT' ? ISLAND_SCALE : INTERIOR_SCALE;
  const s = sample(item, scale);
  if (!s) { unmeasured.push(item.name); continue; }

  const size = s.box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const span = Math.max(size.x, size.z);
  rows.push({
    item, zone, span, height: size.y, cls: classOf(span),
    meshes: s.meshes, colours: s.colours.size, geometries: s.geometries.size, depth: s.depth,
  });
}

let problems = 0;
const fail = (what: string, detail?: string) => {
  problems++;
  console.error(`  FAIL  ${what}`);
  if (detail) console.error(`        ${detail}`);
};
const ok = (what: string, detail?: string) => {
  console.log(`  ok    ${what}`);
  if (detail) console.log(`        ${detail}`);
};

const out = rows.filter((r) => r.zone === 'OUT');
const ind = rows.filter((r) => r.zone === 'IN');

console.log(`\n=== 室外 —— ${out.length} 件可擺放物，逐件對標準 ===\n`);
console.log('  class   item                span  meshes  colours  geom  depth');
for (const r of [...out].sort((a, b) => b.span - a.span)) {
  const flags: string[] = [];
  if (r.meshes < r.cls.minMeshes && !FLOOR_EXEMPT[r.item.id]) flags.push(`結構不足 ${r.meshes} < ${r.cls.minMeshes}`);
  if (r.meshes > r.cls.maxMeshes) flags.push(`超出預算 ${r.meshes} > ${r.cls.maxMeshes}`);
  if (r.colours < r.cls.minColours) flags.push(`色彩單一 ${r.colours} < ${r.cls.minColours}`);
  const line =
    `  ${r.cls.name}  ${r.item.name.padEnd(18)}  ${r.span.toFixed(2).padStart(4)}  ` +
    `${String(r.meshes).padStart(6)}  ${String(r.colours).padStart(7)}  ` +
    `${String(r.geometries).padStart(4)}  ${String(r.depth).padStart(5)}`;
  if (flags.length) { console.error(line + '   <<< ' + flags.join(' / ')); problems++; }
  else console.log(line);
}

console.log(`\n=== 室內對照組 —— ${ind.length} 件 ===`);
const stat = (list: Row[], key: 'meshes' | 'colours') => {
  const v = list.map((r) => r[key]).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return {
    mean: (v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length).toFixed(1),
    median: v[Math.floor(v.length / 2)],
    min: v[0], max: v[v.length - 1],
  };
};
for (const [label, list] of [['室內', ind], ['室外', out]] as const) {
  const m = stat(list, 'meshes');
  const c = stat(list, 'colours');
  console.log(
    `  ${label}  mesh  mean ${String(m.mean).padStart(5)}  median ${String(m.median).padStart(3)}  ` +
    `min ${String(m.min).padStart(3)}  max ${String(m.max).padStart(3)}   |   ` +
    `colours  mean ${String(c.mean).padStart(4)}  median ${String(c.median).padStart(2)}  min ${String(c.min).padStart(2)}`
  );
}

console.log('');
/*
  效能：把「細節」換算成玩家實際會付的代價。

  每個 mesh 是一個 draw call，而島上的草地半徑只有 5.7 —— 塞得下的擺設大約二三十件。所以這裡
  報的是「一座擺滿的島」的量級，而不是抽象的多邊形數：那才是掉不掉幀的那個數字。

  這一段不會失敗。真正的閘門是 SIZE_CLASSES 的 maxMeshes；這裡是讓「加了多少細節」看得見，
  以免下一輪改版是憑感覺加的。
*/
console.log('');
console.log('=== 效能：一座擺滿的島要畫幾次 ===');
const outTotal = out.reduce((a, r) => a + r.meshes, 0);
const TYPICAL_ISLAND = 24; // 擺滿一座島大概的件數
const avgOut = outTotal / out.length;
const decorCalls = Math.round(avgOut * TYPICAL_ISLAND);
const houseMeshes = HOUSE_STYLES.map((style) => {
  const s: Sample = { meshes: 0, colours: new Set(), geometries: new Set(), depth: 0, box: new THREE.Box3() };
  walk(React.createElement(HouseModel, { style }), new THREE.Matrix4(), s, 0);
  return s.meshes;
});
console.log(`  室外 ${out.length} 種各放一件              ${String(outTotal).padStart(5)} draw calls`);
console.log(`  典型一座島（${TYPICAL_ISLAND} 件擺設）           ${String(decorCalls).padStart(5)} draw calls`);
console.log(`  再加上房屋（${Math.min(...houseMeshes)}–${Math.max(...houseMeshes)}，只有一棟）   ` +
  `${String(decorCalls + Math.min(...houseMeshes)).padStart(5)}–${decorCalls + Math.max(...houseMeshes)} draw calls`);

/*
  景觀層次 —— 「植物擺到島上幾乎看不見」的那一半。

  上面那張表量的是「一件東西有幾個零件」，它完全看不見 SIZE：一叢 8 個 mesh 的草，畫成 0.3 個
  世界單位高還是 0.6 個，在結構標準眼裡一模一樣。改版前整個樹木貨架上只有椰子樹比玩家高，
  而草叢是 0.31 —— 玩家膝蓋的四分之一 —— 兩者都完美通過了結構檢查。

  所以尺寸要有自己的閘門，而且是兩道：

   1. **每一件都待在它宣告的級距裡**（constants/outdoorScale.ts 的 LANDSCAPE_TIERS）。
   2. **結構階梯不准交錯**：最矮的一棵大型喬木必須比最高的一棵中小型樹高，以此類推到地被。
      這一條才是「維持景觀層次」那句話的操作型定義 —— 它比的是每一件量出來的高度，不是
      表格裡宣告的帶子，所以任何人把倍率調過頭都會在這裡失敗，而不是等到有人截圖回報。

  花卉與特殊景觀刻意不在階梯上：它們在高度上跟灌木、地被重疊，是靠形狀辨識的類別。
*/
console.log('');
console.log('=== 景觀層次 —— 植栽尺寸 ===');
{
  const measured = (r: Row) =>
    LANDSCAPE_TIERS[landscapeTierOf(r.item.id)!].measure === 'span' ? r.span : r.height;

  const planted = out
    .filter((r) => landscapeTierOf(r.item.id) !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => measured(b) - measured(a));

  console.log(`  玩家身高 ${PLAYER_WORLD_HEIGHT.toFixed(2)} 世界單位；下面的「倍」是相對於它`);
  console.log('  tier        item                量測      倍   允許範圍');
  for (const r of planted) {
    const tier = landscapeTierOf(r.item.id)!;
    const t = LANDSCAPE_TIERS[tier];
    const v = measured(r);
    const ratio = v / PLAYER_WORLD_HEIGHT;
    const inBand = ratio >= t.min && ratio <= t.max;
    const line =
      `  ${t.name.padEnd(6)}  ${r.item.name.padEnd(18)}  ` +
      `${t.measure === 'span' ? '寬' : '高'}${v.toFixed(2).padStart(5)}  ` +
      `${ratio.toFixed(2).padStart(4)}   ${t.min.toFixed(2)}–${t.max.toFixed(2)}`;
    if (!inBand) { fail(`${r.item.name} 超出「${t.name}」的尺寸帶`, `量到 ${ratio.toFixed(2)} 倍玩家身高，允許 ${t.min}–${t.max}`); }
    else console.log(line);
  }

  // 結構階梯：由高到矮，每一級的最矮者都要高過下一級的最高者。
  const LADDER: LandscapeTier[] = ['canopy', 'understory', 'shrub', 'groundcover'];
  const heightsOf = (tier: LandscapeTier) =>
    out.filter((r) => landscapeTierOf(r.item.id) === tier).map((r) => r.height);
  console.log('');
  for (let i = 0; i < LADDER.length - 1; i++) {
    const hi = heightsOf(LADDER[i]);
    const lo = heightsOf(LADDER[i + 1]);
    if (!hi.length || !lo.length) continue;
    const shortestHi = Math.min(...hi);
    const tallestLo = Math.max(...lo);
    const label = `${LANDSCAPE_TIERS[LADDER[i]].name} 整級都高過 ${LANDSCAPE_TIERS[LADDER[i + 1]].name}`;
    const detail = `最矮的 ${shortestHi.toFixed(2)} vs 最高的 ${tallestLo.toFixed(2)}`;
    if (shortestHi > tallestLo) ok(label, detail); else fail(label, detail);
  }
}

console.log('');
console.log('=== 兩邊的差距 ===');
const meanOf = (list: Row[], key: 'meshes' | 'colours') => list.reduce((a, r) => a + r[key], 0) / list.length;
const meshGap = meanOf(out, 'meshes') / meanOf(ind, 'meshes');
const colourGap = meanOf(out, 'colours') / meanOf(ind, 'colours');
// 室外允許略低於室內（室外多的是小裝飾，室內多的是大件家具），但不該是另一個等級。
if (meshGap < 0.8) fail('室外的平均結構層數明顯低於室內', `${meshGap.toFixed(2)}x —— 下限 0.80x`);
else ok('室外的平均結構層數跟室內同一個等級', `${meshGap.toFixed(2)}x of indoor`);
if (colourGap < 0.8) fail('室外的平均色彩層次明顯低於室內', `${colourGap.toFixed(2)}x —— 下限 0.80x`);
else ok('室外的平均色彩層次跟室內同一個等級', `${colourGap.toFixed(2)}x of indoor`);

// 「不要讓某些物品突然非常精緻，但其他物品仍然只是基礎方塊」—— 室外自己內部也不能分層。
const outMeshes = out.map((r) => r.meshes).sort((a, b) => a - b);
const outMedian = outMeshes[Math.floor(outMeshes.length / 2)];
const leanest = out.reduce((a, b) => (a.meshes <= b.meshes ? a : b));
if (outMeshes[0] < outMedian * 0.35) {
  fail('室外自己內部就分成兩種品質', `最少的 ${leanest.item.name} 只有 ${outMeshes[0]}，中位數是 ${outMedian}`);
} else {
  ok('室外沒有一件遠遠落在其他人後面', `最少 ${outMeshes[0]}（${leanest.item.name}），中位數 ${outMedian}`);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 房屋 */

/*
  房屋是另一個級距。島上永遠只有一棟，而它是玩家最常看的東西，所以它的預算跟一件擺設不是同一
  個數量級 —— 但也因此，它是唯一一個「同一個模型換七次顏色」會被玩家一眼看穿的東西。

  所以這裡查兩件事，第二件才是重點：

   1. 每一棟都要有足夠的結構（下限 BUILDING_MIN_MESHES）與色彩層次。
   2. **沒有兩棟房子可以共用同一組（屋頂, 外牆）**。這一條是把「不要只是同一個房屋模型 + 換不同
      顏色」寫成程式判斷得了的形式：配色不算差異，屋頂形狀與外牆做法才算。每一組（屋頂, 外牆）
      配對只能用一次，所以新增一款外觀時，至少要有一邊是這個貨架上還沒出現過的做法。
*/
const BUILDING_MIN_MESHES = 40;
const BUILDING_MIN_COLOURS = 6;

console.log('');
console.log(`=== 房屋外觀 —— ${HOUSE_STYLES.length} 棟，逐棟對標準 ===`);
console.log('');
console.log('  style       roof      wall     height  meshes  colours  features');
const pairSeen = new Map<string, string>();
for (const style of HOUSE_STYLES) {
  const houseSample: Sample = { meshes: 0, colours: new Set(), geometries: new Set(), depth: 0, box: new THREE.Box3() };
  walk(React.createElement(HouseModel, { style }), new THREE.Matrix4(), houseSample, 0);
  const featureCount = Object.values(style.features ?? {}).filter(Boolean).length;
  const flags: string[] = [];
  if (houseSample.meshes < BUILDING_MIN_MESHES) flags.push(`結構不足 ${houseSample.meshes} < ${BUILDING_MIN_MESHES}`);
  if (houseSample.colours.size < BUILDING_MIN_COLOURS) flags.push(`色彩單一 ${houseSample.colours.size} < ${BUILDING_MIN_COLOURS}`);

  const pair = `${style.roof}/${style.wall}`;
  const clash = pairSeen.get(pair);
  if (clash) flags.push(`跟 ${clash} 是同一種建築，只有配色不同（${pair}）`);
  else pairSeen.set(pair, style.name);

  const line =
    `  ${style.name.padEnd(8)}  ${style.roof.padEnd(8)}  ${style.wall.padEnd(7)}  ` +
    `${getHouseVisualHeight(style).toFixed(2).padStart(6)}  ${String(houseSample.meshes).padStart(6)}  ` +
    `${String(houseSample.colours.size).padStart(7)}  ${String(featureCount).padStart(8)}`;
  if (flags.length) { console.error(line + '   <<< ' + flags.join(' / ')); problems++; }
  else console.log(line);
}

/*
  「不要只修改 Preview」的另一半：不要只修改模型。

  房屋的商店圖示（components/QVersionIcon.tsx 的 HouseStyleIcon）跟 3D 模型讀的是同一份資料，
  但它是各自畫的 —— 圖示裡每一種屋頂形狀、每一種外牆做法都是一個分支。所以新增一種屋頂而忘了
  加圖示分支，結果不是壞掉，是**悄悄掉進 default 分支**：木屋 的圖示會畫成一般的斜屋頂，玩家看
  著斜屋頂的圖買回一棟穀倉頂的原木屋。這一輪就發生過，兩種新屋頂各一次。

  這裡讀圖示檔的原始碼確認每一種 kind 都有它自己的分支。刻意讀文字而不是型別：TypeScript 管得了
  資料表，管不了「這個 switch 有沒有寫這一個 case」。
*/
const iconSrc = readFileSync(new URL('../src/components/QVersionIcon.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const ROOF_ICON_DEFAULT = 'gable';   // 圖示 switch 的 default 分支就是它
const WALL_ICON_BARE = 'plain';      // 素牆本來就沒有額外筆畫
const roofKinds = [...new Set(HOUSE_STYLES.map((s) => s.roof))];
const wallKinds = [...new Set(HOUSE_STYLES.map((s) => s.wall))];
const missingRoof = roofKinds.filter((k) => k !== ROOF_ICON_DEFAULT && !iconSrc.includes(`case '${k}':`));
const missingWall = wallKinds.filter((k) => k !== WALL_ICON_BARE && !iconSrc.includes(`style.wall === '${k}'`));
if (missingRoof.length) fail('有屋頂形狀在商店圖示裡沒有自己的分支，會靜靜地畫成一般斜屋頂', missingRoof.join('、'));
else ok('每一種屋頂形狀在商店圖示裡都畫得出來', `${roofKinds.length} 種`);
if (missingWall.length) fail('有外牆做法在商店圖示裡沒有自己的分支', missingWall.join('、'));
else ok('每一種外牆做法在商店圖示裡都畫得出來', `${wallKinds.length} 種`);

const heights = HOUSE_STYLES.map(getHouseVisualHeight);
const spread = Math.max(...heights) - Math.min(...heights);
if (spread < 0.8) fail('每一棟房子的高度幾乎一樣，遠看是同一個輪廓', `最高與最低只差 ${spread.toFixed(2)}`);
else ok('每一棟房子的輪廓高度都拉得開', `最高與最低差 ${spread.toFixed(2)} 個世界單位`);

if (unmeasured.length) {
  console.log(`\n  無法量測（元件用了 hook，需要 renderer）：${unmeasured.join('、')}`);
}
if (brokenComponents.size) {
  console.log(`  components skipped: ${[...brokenComponents].join(', ')}`);
}

console.log('');
if (problems) {
  console.error(`FAIL — ${problems} 件事不符合 Outdoor Asset Quality Standard（見 docs/outdoor-assets.md）`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('PASS — 室外每一件都達到它那個級距的結構、色彩與預算標準。');

```
