              live INSIDE this Canvas — projecting a world point into screen space needs this
              scene's own camera, and the island's tracker cannot see it (a second Canvas is a
              second WebGL context). The HTML half is the same component either way; see
              UI/InteractionPrompt.tsx. */}
          <InteractionPromptTracker scope="interior" />
          {/* Puts the house's walls, floors, doorways and furniture in reach of
              __auditZFighting() - see ZFightAuditBridge. Dev-only; renders nothing. */}
          <ZFightAuditBridge label="interior" />
          <FirstFrameSignal onReady={() => setInteriorDrawn(true)} />
        </Canvas>
      </div>

      {/* 玄關 — what the player looks at while the 3D layer is still compiling.
          Everything about it is chosen so that a slow entry reads as a door opening rather than as
          the game hanging:
          * it is CREAM, not the root's navy-dark. The dark slab under a fully-drawn HUD is what
            the 「變黑色」 report was describing, and no amount of shaving milliseconds off the
            compile would have made a black screen look intentional.
          * it covers the viewport and nothing else. The header, the exit button and the minimap
            stay live underneath it, so 離開房屋 works even if this entry is the slow one.
          * it leaves on the first PRESENTED frame, not on a timer. A fixed delay is a guess that
            is wrong on both ends - too short on a cold machine, an added wait on a warm one.
          * pointer-events-none: it is a picture, not a modal. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {!interiorDrawn && (
          <motion.div
            key="interior-veil"
            initial={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.28, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            className="absolute inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none bg-island-cream-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3"
          >
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-island-teal/12 border border-island-teal/25 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Home className="w-7 h-7 text-island-teal" strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 font-black text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">
              開門中
            </p>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Floating Panels for this view (build toolbar, expansion controls,
          placement controls, expansion picker, furniture shop-as-modal,
          furniture drawer) - portaled to #floating-panel-root (see
          FloatingPanelPortal's doc comment) so they escape this view's own
          z-game-view stacking context and can actually beat the persistent
          HUD (z-hud-*) via z-floating-panel/z-modal, instead of this whole
          view needing to be raised - see index.css's z-floating-panel tier
          docs for why that used to break MiniMap. */}
      {/* Only while the player is actually in the house. This subtree is PORTALED out to
          #floating-panel-root, so it is not covered by the hidden wrapper the parent puts
          around this view — without the guard, a drawer left open on the way out would hang
          over the island. The deactivate effect above already closes them; this is the
          structural half of the same rule, so a panel added later cannot forget it. */}
      {active && (
      <FloatingPanelPortal>
      {/* 小天使 tutorial NPC. Portaled with the rest of this view's floating
          chrome so it can sit above the docks it is pointing at; `key` remounts
          it per topic so the step counter restarts when the script changes. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {angelTopic && (
          <AngelGuide
            key={`${angelTopic}-${angelRun}`}
            steps={ANGEL_GUIDES[angelTopic]}
            onClose={dismissAngel}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Build Mode Toolbar.
          Peer destinations, so they read as cards on one plank rather than
          solid teal buttons: at full-teal every tool shouted equally and the
          row was a wall of colour with no way to tell them apart except the
          icon. Cream-2 tiles with a teal icon carry the same weight, and the
          freed-up teal now only marks the hovered/pressed one. The one-line
          hint under each label says what the tool actually does. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isBuildMode && !tempPlacement && !isExpandingRoom && (
          <DockPanel
            initial={{ y: 50, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ y: 50, opacity: 0 }}
            className="flex items-stretch gap-1.5 sm:gap-3 p-2 sm:p-3 w-[95%] sm:w-auto"
          >
            {BUILD_TOOLS.map((tool) => (
              <button
                key={tool.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (tool.id === 'furniture') setShowFurniturePanel(true);
                  else setShowExpansionPanel(true);
                }}
                className="group flex-1 sm:w-52 lg:w-56 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3.5 rounded-[1.5rem] border border-island-line bg-island-sand px-2 py-2.5 sm:px-4 sm:py-3 text-center sm:text-left shadow-[inset_0_1px_3px_rgba(38,70,83,0.07)] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-island-teal hover:bg-island-cream hover:shadow-[0_14px_28px_-10px_rgba(42,157,143,0.5)] active:scale-[0.98]"
              >
                {/* Solid teal, not a tint: on a sand card a tinted tile is
                    invisible, and the tile is what gives each slot its colour
                    weight. */}
                <IconTile
                  size={44}
                  solid
                  className="shadow-[0_4px_10px_rgba(42,157,143,0.35)] group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
                >
                  {tool.icon}
                </IconTile>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block text-[11px] sm:text-[15px] font-black text-island-navy whitespace-nowrap transition-colors group-hover:text-island-teal-dark">
                    {tool.label}
                  </span>
                  <span className="hidden sm:block text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft truncate">
                    {tool.hint}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <ChevronRight
                  size={16}
                  strokeWidth={3}
                  className="hidden sm:block flex-shrink-0 text-island-navy-soft/45 transition-all duration-300 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:text-island-teal"
                />
              </button>
            ))}
          </DockPanel>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Room Expansion HUD Controls Overlay.
          Same three-part anatomy as the placement dock below (subject →
          live verdict → actions), so the two flows feel like one build mode
          with two subjects rather than two unrelated screens. The previous
          version was a glass card (`bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl` + a white
          inset ring + a teal gradient pill) at its own radius and bottom
          offset — all three are things DESIGN_SYSTEM.md rules out; it now sits
          on the shared DockPanel with flat token colours. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isExpandingRoom && (
          <DockPanel
            initial={{ y: 80, opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ y: 80, opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 25, stiffness: 300 }}
            className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-3 md:gap-5 p-3 sm:p-4 w-[95%] max-w-3xl"
          >
            <DockStatus
              badge="房間擴建中"
              badgeIcon={<Maximize2 size={11} strokeWidth={3} />}
              title={
                <>
                  正在建置 <span className="text-island-teal-dark">{expandingRoomType ? ROOM_DEFS[expandingRoomType].name : ''}</span>
                </>
              }
              meta={
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft">
                  <MapPin size={10} strokeWidth={3} className="text-island-navy-soft/60" />
                  <span className="font-mono">x {expansionGridPos ? expansionGridPos.x : 0} · z {expansionGridPos ? expansionGridPos.z : 0}</span>
                </span>
              }
              className="flex-1 md:pr-5 md:border-r md:border-island-line"
            />

            {/* Live verdict. Both states share one shape/size so the dock does
                not resize as the player drags across legal and illegal cells —
                only the colour and the copy change.
                The "how do I do this" copy that used to sit in this dock now
                belongs to the 小天使 (ANGEL_GUIDES.expansion); this keeps only
                live status (room, coordinates, validity) and the actions. */}
            {isExpansionValid ? (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[1.25rem] border border-island-teal/25 bg-island-teal/10 px-4 py-3 text-center md:min-w-[190px] md:max-w-[220px]">
                <span className="flex h-5 w-5 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-island-teal text-white">
                  <Check size={12} strokeWidth={4} />
                </span>
                <span className="text-[13px] font-black text-island-teal-dark">點落位置合法</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="rounded-[1.25rem] border border-island-coral/25 bg-island-coral/10 px-4 py-3 text-center leading-snug md:min-w-[190px] md:max-w-[220px]">
                <span className="block text-[10px] font-black tracking-[0.14em] text-island-coral/70">無法建造</span>
                <span className="block text-[13px] font-black text-island-coral">{expansionInvalidReason}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={handleCancelExpansion}
                className="h-12 px-4 sm:px-5 text-sm"
              >
                取消
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                onClick={handleConfirmExpansion}
                disabled={!isExpansionValid}
                className="h-12 flex-1 px-5 sm:px-7 text-sm whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <Check size={18} strokeWidth={3} />
                <span>確認擴建</span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </DockPanel>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Placement controls — the shared dock (UI/PlacementDock.tsx), the same one the island
          uses. It used to be a hand-built block here and a differently-built bar at the TOP of
          the screen out there, so the identical three verbs lived at opposite edges depending on
          which build mode you were in. The anatomy is unchanged: subject → live verdict →
          actions, with danger keeping coral to itself and 取消 on the far side of 確認.

          This is the dock the 小天使 points at while she narrates ANGEL_GUIDES.furniture, so the
          verdict text carries the explaining and the how-to stays with her. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isBuildMode && tempPlacement && (() => {
          const selectedItem = getItemById(tempPlacement.itemId);
          // Does this piece go on the ceiling? Asked of the ITEM, not of where it happens to be
          // right now, because the dock has to be able to say 「點天花板」 in the one state where
          // `placementMount` is null — the state where the player is aiming somewhere illegal and
          // most needs telling what the legal thing is.
          const isCeilingPiece = canMountOn(tempPlacement.itemId, 'ceiling');
          const blockNote: PlacementNote | null = placementBlock
            ? {
              tone: 'blocked',
              detail: placementBlock === 'overlap' ? (
                <>
                  這裡已經有
                  <span className="mx-0.5">{getItemById(placementConflict?.itemId ?? '')?.name || '別的家具'}</span>
                  ，換個位置放
                </>
              ) : placementBlock === 'noWall' ? '這件作品要掛在牆上，靠近牆面就會自動貼齊'
                : placementBlock === 'noCeiling' ? '這盞燈要裝在天花板上，把游標移回房間裡面'
                  : placementBlock === 'noSurface' ? '把它放到桌子、櫃子或層架上'
                    : isCeilingPiece ? '這個位置裝不下，換一塊空一點的天花板'
                      : '這個位置放不下，換個大一點的地方',
            }
            // The one positive chip is the exception the rest of the dock's silence earns: a piece
            // that has found a wall, a ceiling or a tabletop is a piece that just snapped
            // somewhere, and saying so is what tells the player the snap was deliberate rather
            // than a jump. It matters most for the ceiling, where the piece ends up several metres
            // from the cursor that put it there.
            : placementMount === 'wall' || placementMount === 'surface' || placementMount === 'ceiling'
              ? {
                tone: 'ok',
                detail: placementMount === 'wall' ? '已貼齊牆面・對準想掛的高度'
                  : placementMount === 'ceiling' ? '已裝上天花板・點其他位置可以移動'
                    : '已放在檯面上',
              }
              // 「點擊天花板以安裝燈具」. The one instruction this dock gives, and it is here rather
              // than with the 小天使 because it answers a question the player has for exactly as
              // long as the lamp is in their hand: a ceiling fixture is the only thing in the game
              // that does not go where the cursor is, so 「aim at the ceiling」 has to be said
              // somewhere. `hint` is the quiet tone — one line in the dock the player is already
              // looking at, nothing over the room itself.
              : isCeilingPiece
                ? { tone: 'hint', detail: '點擊天花板以安裝燈具，或點地板上想吊掛的位置' }
                : null;

          return (
            <PlacementDock
              icon={<QVersionIcon itemId={tempPlacement.itemId} size={40} />}
              badge="擺放中"
              badgeIcon={<Hammer size={11} strokeWidth={3} />}
              title={selectedItem?.name || tempPlacement.itemId}
              note={blockNote}
              // Hidden for wall pieces: their facing comes from the wall, so there is nothing
              // here for the player to choose. See `canRotatePiece`.
              onRotate={canRotatePiece ? handleRotate : undefined}
              onRetrieve={handleDeletePlacement}
              retrieveTitle="收回這件家具"
              onConfirm={handleConfirmPlacement}
              confirmDisabled={isPlacementBlocked}
              confirmTitle={placementBlock === 'overlap' ? '這個位置和其他家具重疊了'
                : placementBlock === 'noWall' ? '這件作品需要一面牆'
                  : placementBlock === 'noCeiling' ? '這盞燈需要一片天花板'
                    : placementBlock === 'noSurface' ? '這件作品需要一個檯面'
                      : placementBlock === 'noFit' ? '這個位置放不下' : undefined}
              onCancel={clearPlacement}
            />
          );
        })()}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Expansion Panel */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showExpansionPanel && (
          <ModalOverlay zIndexClassName="z-modal">
            <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-4xl" className="max-h-[85vh] md:max-h-[80vh]">
              {/* Header */}
              <PanelHeader
                icon={<Home size={24} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
                title="擴建房屋內部空間"
                subtitle="為你的小窩打造專屬特色的功能房間"
                onClose={() => {
                  console.log("[UI_Click] Closed expansion panel");
                  setShowExpansionPanel(false);
                }}
              />

              {profile && (
                <div className="px-6 py-3 md:px-8 md:py-3.5 border-b border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 flex-shrink-0">
                  <CurrencyChip amount={getBalance(profile, 'coins')} />
                  <button
                    // Reports, and no longer claims success it did not check.
                    //
                    // This logged "success!" unconditionally after an `addGold` that swallowed its
                    // own errors, so a refused write printed a success line and changed nothing on
                    // screen. The `profile?.userId` guard was worse: a save missing that field made
                    // the button do LITERALLY nothing — no call, no log, no message — which is the
                    // most exact form of 「點不進去」 there is. The guard is gone because addGold
                    // already refuses without a user, and because `userId` missing is a condition
                    // the player needs told (firestore.rules' isValidUser demands it, so every
                    // write in the game is being refused), not one to silently branch around.
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (!(await addGold(10000))) showIslandAlert(describeRecentFailure());
                    }}
                    className="px-3 py-1 bg-white hover:bg-island-line/40 text-island-navy-soft font-black text-[10px] rounded-full border border-island-line active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ＋ 測試補給 10,000 金幣
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Scrollable grid area */}
              <div
                ref={setExpansionScrollRef}
                className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-6 md:p-8 no-scrollbar relative bg-island-cream-2/40"
                style={{ overflowY: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none' }}
              >
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pb-4">
                  {(Object.entries(ROOM_DEFS)).map(([key, def]) => {
                    const hasUnlocked = unlockedRooms.some(r => r === key || r.startsWith(`ext_${key}_`));
                    const existingCount = unlockedRooms.filter(r => r === key || r.startsWith(`ext_${key}_`)).length;
                    const isAffordable = profile && getBalance(profile, 'coins') >= def.price;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={key}
                        className={`p-7 md:p-8 rounded-[2rem] border transition-all duration-500 relative overflow-hidden group flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[380px] bg-white hover:-translate-y-2 ${
                          hasUnlocked
                            ? 'border-island-teal/40 shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(42,157,143,0.12)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(42,157,143,0.2)]'
                            : 'border-island-line hover:border-island-teal-light/50 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(38,70,83,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_16px_32px_rgba(38,70,83,0.08)]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Decorative background glow */}
                        {hasUnlocked && (
                          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-48 h-48 bg-island-teal/5 rounded-full blur-3xl -mr-20 -mt-20 pointer-events-none transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 opacity-60"></div>
                        )}
                        
                        <div className="relative z-10">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                            <div className="p-3 bg-island-cream rounded-2xl border border-island-line/50 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300">
                              {renderRoomIcon(key as RoomKey, hasUnlocked)}
                            </div>

                            {existingCount > 0 ? (
                              <span className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-island-teal/10 border border-island-teal/25 text-island-teal-dark font-black text-[11px] rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <Sparkles size={12} className="text-island-teal" strokeWidth={2.5} />
                                <span>已建造 {existingCount} 間</span>
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              /* Tailwind greys are off-palette for chrome — the
                                 "not yet built" state is cream-2 + line + soft
                                 navy ink, same as every other inert chip. */
                              <span className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line text-island-navy-soft/60 font-black text-[11px] rounded-full">
                                尚未解鎖
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          <h4 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-island-navy mb-2 mt-6 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-3">
                            <span>{def.name}</span>
                            {def.buff && (
                              <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-island-teal-dark bg-island-teal/10 border border-island-teal/25 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Sparkles size={12} className="text-island-teal" />
                                {def.buff}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </h4>
                          <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 text-sm font-bold leading-relaxed mb-6 tracking-wide">{def.description}</p>

                          {/* Dynamic Room Decoration Info Panel */}
                          {(() => {
                            const config = ROOM_TYPE_CONFIGS[key as RoomKey];
                            const STYLE_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
                              'wall-white': '經典象牙白壁紙',
                              'wall-green': '北歐森活粉綠油漆',
                              'wall-blue': '地中海美式天藍壁面',
                              'wall-red': '朋克工業炭火紅牆',
                              'wall-pink': '溫馨櫻花淡粉牆',
                              'wall-yellow': '陽光鄉村暖黃壁貼',
                              'wall-purple': '薰衣草優雅極簡紫壁',
                              'default': '溫馨原木標準白牆',
                              'floor-oak': '高級天然橡木地板',
                              'floor-white-tile': '精細防滑白瓷磚',
                              'floor-industrial-concrete': '工業磨砂混凝土',
                              'floor-vintage-pattern': '法式復古藝術花磚',
                              'floor-luxury-marble': '奢華皇家大理石地板'
                            };

                            if (!config) return null;
                            return (
                              <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line flex flex-col gap-3 text-xs text-island-navy/85">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-island-navy/60 text-[11px] tracking-widest uppercase">
                                  <Paintbrush size={12} strokeWidth={3} />
                                  <span>室內主題配置 <span className="opacity-60 font-medium">(自動裝潢)</span></span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 font-bold text-island-navy/80">
                                  <div className="bg-island-cream px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-island-line text-[11px] flex flex-col gap-1">
                                    <span className="text-island-navy/50 text-[10px]">壁飾</span>
                                    <span className="text-island-teal-dark font-black truncate">{STYLE_NAMES[config.wallMaterial] || config.wallMaterial}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="bg-island-cream px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-island-line text-[11px] flex flex-col gap-1">
                                    <span className="text-island-navy/50 text-[10px]">地板</span>
                                    <span className="text-island-teal-dark font-black truncate">{STYLE_NAMES[config.floorMaterial] || config.floorMaterial}</span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1 pt-3 border-t border-island-line/40">
                                  <div className="font-black text-island-navy/60 text-[11px]">預裝配家具 ({config.defaultFurnitureList.length} 件)：</div>
                                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-1 max-h-[60px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
                                    {config.defaultFurnitureList.map((fid, idx) => {
                                      const item = ALL_ITEMS.find(x => x.id === fid);
                                      return (
                                        <span key={idx} className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-island-cream border border-island-line text-island-navy rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold hover:border-island-teal/40 transition-colors">
                                          {item?.name || fid}
                                        </span>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            );
                          })()}
                        </div>

                        <Button
                          variant={isAffordable ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
                          onClick={() => {
                            console.log(`[UI_Click] Clicked room option button: key="${key}", name="${def.name}", price=${def.price}, isAffordable=${isAffordable}`);
                            startExpandingRoom(key as RoomKey);
                          }}
                          className="w-full py-4 px-4 mt-auto text-sm rounded-2xl"
                        >
                          <Coins className={isAffordable ? 'text-island-gold' : 'text-island-navy-soft/50'} size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                          <span>立即建造 ({def.price} 金幣) {!isAffordable && ' (測試免用金幣)'}</span>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </ModalShell>
          </ModalOverlay>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Furniture drawer — the one place a piece is chosen, owned or not, and now literally the
          same component the island browses through (UI/PlacementCatalog.tsx). The house has no
          家具商店 button of its own: this lists the whole 室內 catalog, with what the player owns
          on top and everything else below on the same row, so "buy it" happens on the item they
          were already looking at instead of in a second storefront with its own idea of what a
          sofa is.

          While a piece is being positioned the drawer stays mounted in its compact pose — pulled
          to the top right with its backdrop dropped — so clicks reach the floor underneath and the
          player can place one piece after another without re-opening the list. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showFurniturePanel && (
          <CatalogDrawer
            icon={<Sofa size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
            // 「挑選物件」，跟島上那個抽屜同名 —— 同一個元件、同一個動作，副標才是差別。
            // 見 UI/BuildModeOverlay.tsx 的同一處。
            title="挑選物件"
            subtitle="家具、燈具、藝術品、地板與牆面"
            categories={INDOOR_CATEGORIES}
            activeCategory={selectedSubCategory}
            onCategoryChange={setSelectedSubCategory}
            ownedCountByCategory={ownedCountByCategory}
            subGroupItems={drawerCategoryItems}
            activeSubGroup={drawerSubGroup}
            onSubGroupChange={setDrawerSubGroup}
            emptyIcon={<Sofa size={32} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
            compact={!!tempPlacement}
            onClose={() => setShowFurniturePanel(false)}
            banner={
              /* Styles apply to ONE room, so the panel has to say which one before the player
                 commits — otherwise 套用 is a guess about an invisible target. */
              drawerItems.owned.some(entry => entry.isStyle) && paintTargetRoom ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[1.25rem] border border-island-teal/25 bg-island-teal/8 px-4 py-3">
                  <Paintbrush size={16} className="flex-shrink-0 text-island-teal-dark" strokeWidth={3} />
                  <p className="text-xs font-black text-island-navy-soft/80">
                    套用至
                    <span className="mx-1 text-island-teal-dark">{paintTargetRoom.name}</span>
                    — 走到其他房間即可分別佈置
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : null
            }
          >
            {drawerItems.owned.length > 0 && (
              <section className="space-y-3">
                <DrawerSectionDivider {...OWNED_DIVIDER} count={drawerItems.owned.length} owned />
                {drawerItems.owned.map(entry => (
                  <InteriorItemRow
                    key={entry.item.id}
                    entry={entry}
                    owned
                    appliedStyle={paintTargetRoom ? profile?.interiorData?.roomStyles?.[paintTargetRoom.id] : undefined}
                    onPlace={() => handleCreateNewPlacement(entry.item.id, entry.isStyle)}
                    onBuy={() => setPurchaseTarget(entry.item)}
                  />
                ))}
              </section>
            )}
            {drawerItems.unowned.length > 0 && (
              <section className="space-y-3 pt-1">
                <DrawerSectionDivider {...UNOWNED_DIVIDER} count={drawerItems.unowned.length} />
                {drawerItems.unowned.map(entry => (
                  <InteriorItemRow
                    key={entry.item.id}
                    entry={entry}
                    owned={false}
                    onPlace={() => handleCreateNewPlacement(entry.item.id, entry.isStyle)}
                    onBuy={() => setPurchaseTarget(entry.item)}
                  />
                ))}
              </section>
            )}
          </CatalogDrawer>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Buying from the drawer opens the same dialog the shop opens. */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {purchaseTarget && (
          <PurchaseDialog item={purchaseTarget} onClose={() => setPurchaseTarget(null)} />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
      </FloatingPanelPortal>
      )}

      {/* Main Action Buttons (Non-Build mode) */}
      {!isBuildMode && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-6 sm:bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 flex items-center gap-4">
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleToggleBuildMode}
            className="px-6 py-3 sm:px-12 sm:py-6 gap-2 sm:gap-4 text-lg sm:text-2xl hover:-translate-y-1 sm:hover:-translate-y-2 whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <Hammer className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-8 sm:h-8" strokeWidth={2.5} />
            <span>佈置我的家</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Guide re-summon. The instructions themselves no longer live in a card
          parked down here — they're spoken by the 小天使 NPC up in the sky (see
          ANGEL_GUIDES / AngelGuide.tsx), which auto-plays once per topic. This
          button is how a player who skipped it gets the angel back, and it
          re-plays whichever script matches what they're doing right now. */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-20 sm:bottom-10 right-4 sm:right-10 z-50 text-right space-y-4 pointer-events-none">
        {isBuildMode && !angelTopic && (
          <button
            onClick={() => replayAngel(isExpandingRoom ? 'expansion' : 'furniture')}
            className="pointer-events-auto ml-auto cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-transform sm:hover:-translate-y-1"
            title="請小天使再說一次"
          >
            <PortholeFrame size={48} className="text-island-navy">
              <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </PortholeFrame>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**

import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../types';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Check, X, Star, Home, Waves, Map,
  Shell, Flower2, Droplets,
  Palmtree, Flame, Store, Layout, Grid, Sofa, Armchair,
  Tablet, Scroll, Book, Box, RotateCw, Anchor, PawPrint, Sailboat,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ALL_ITEMS, getItemById } from '../constants/items';
import { DEFAULT_RARITY, rarityStyleVars } from '../constants/rarity';
import { getItemRarity } from '../utils/debugOverrides';
import { useMemo, useState, Suspense } from 'react';
import { MAIN_SECTIONS, getCategoriesFor, getDisplayCategory, getItemCategoryLabel, resolveCategoryId } from '../utils/categoryUtils';
import { ShopView } from './ShopView';
import { QVersionIcon } from './QVersionIcon';
import { EmptyState, IconTile, PortholeFrame, Button } from './UI/DesignKit';
import { CategoryIcon } from './UI/CategoryIcon';
import { CategoryNote, SubCategoryTabs } from './UI/CategoryTabs';
import {
  BackpackTabBar, OwnedKindList, ownedItemsOfKind, type BackpackTabId,
} from './UI/BackpackTabs';
import { UtilityCardBag } from './UI/UtilityCard';
import { PetCareBag } from './UI/PetCarePanel';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { tuneRenderer } from '../lib/rendererTuning';
import { OrbitControls, Stage, PerspectiveCamera } from '@react-three/drei';
import { Avatar, AVATAR_BASE_SCALE } from './Three/Avatar';
import { CosmeticEffectField } from './Three/effects';
import { CompanionPet } from './Three/Pets';
import { StudioBackdrop, StudioFloor } from './Three/StudioFloor';
import { getPetSpec, getPetSpecies } from '../constants/pets';
import { resolveSpecialCosmetics } from '../constants/cosmeticEffects';
import { ownsItem } from '../utils/inventory';
import { SoundEffect, playSound } from '../lib/soundUtils';
import * as THREE from 'three';

const PERSON_CATEGORY_IDS = getCategoriesFor('PERSON').map(c => c.id);

/** The 寵物 rack — this screen's own, which is why it isn't in 人物外觀's row. */
const PET_RACK_ID = 'Pets';
const PET_RACK = getDisplayCategory(PET_RACK_ID);

/** The 寵物飾品 rack. Its items live in the shop's 寵物 section but are a separate equip slot. */
const PET_GEAR_ID = 'PetGear';
const PET_GEAR_RACK = getDisplayCategory(PET_GEAR_ID);

/** Racks shown here: 人物外觀's wearables, then the companion and what it wears. */
const RACKS = [...getCategoriesFor('PERSON'), PET_RACK, PET_GEAR_RACK].filter(
  (rack): rack is NonNullable<typeof rack> => !!rack,
);

/**
 * Whether an item IS a companion animal — not merely something filed under 寵物.
 *
 * Asked of the item ID rather than of its shop category, and that is the load-bearing part: the
 * 寵物 section also sells 寵物飾品, and a category test would class a collar as a pet. It would
 * then share the companion's single-select slot, so putting a bow on the dog would put the DOG
 * away. `getPetSpecies` answers the question that actually matters — is this an animal — from the
 * `pet-<species>-<breed>` id pattern that names one.
 */
const isPetAnimal = (itemId: string) => !!getPetSpecies(itemId);

export function DressingRoomView() {
  const { profile, setCurrentView, setActivePlacementItem, updateProfile } = useApp();
  // The remembered category is shared with the shop, so it can point at a housing category this
  // screen doesn't show — and at one that no longer exists at all after a catalog change.
  // Narrow it to a wearable category before using it.
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<string>(() => {
    const remembered = resolveCategoryId(localStorage.getItem('last_selected_category'), 'Hats');
    return PERSON_CATEGORY_IDS.includes(remembered) ? remembered : 'Hats';
  });
  const [showShop, setShowShop] = useState(false);

  /**
   * 背包的四個分頁。預設是 `wearable` —— 那就是以前的更衣室，所以路牌按一下看到的畫面沒有變。
   * 見 UI/BackpackTabs.tsx 為什麼分頁是 CategoryKind 的四個值而不是新分類。
   */
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<BackpackTabId>('wearable');

  /**
   * 每一頁有幾件，畫在標籤上。
   *
   * 「穿戴」那一格算的是**擁有的可穿戴物件**（包含寵物與寵物飾品，它們也是 wearable），跟底下衣
   * 架顯示的那一格不一樣 —— 標籤講的是整個分頁，不是目前開著的那個衣架。
   */
  const tabCounts = useMemo(
    () => ({
      wearable: ownedItemsOfKind(profile, 'wearable').length,
      placeable: ownedItemsOfKind(profile, 'placeable').length,
      consumable: ownedItemsOfKind(profile, 'consumable').length,
      applied: ownedItemsOfKind(profile, 'applied').length,
    }),
    [profile],
  );

  /** 島上有沒有帶著夥伴 —— 決定「消耗」頁要不要畫寵物照護那一段。 */
  const hasCompanionOut = (profile?.equippedItems ?? []).some((id) => !!getPetSpec(id));

  const getIcon = (item: any) => {
    return <QVersionIcon itemId={item.itemId} size={110} />;
  };

  const ownedItems = ALL_ITEMS
    // Through the Inventory System rather than reading `profile.inventory` directly, so this rack
    // and the shop can never disagree about what is owned — including under the ?unown= test
    // override (utils/debugOverrides.ts).
    .filter(item => ownsItem(profile, item.id))
    // The 寵物 rack holds every companion ANIMAL, not just items filed under the rack's own id:
    // this screen keeps pets in one slot while the shop splits them across 狗/貓/鳥 chips, so
    // matching on "is an animal" is what stops a 柴犬 bought there from vanishing here — and what
    // keeps 寵物飾品, which is sold in the same section, on its own rack instead.
    .filter(item =>
      activeCategory === PET_RACK_ID
        ? isPetAnimal(item.id)
        : item.shopCategory === activeCategory
    )
    .map(item => ({
      itemId: item.id,
      name: item.name,
      category: item.shopCategory,
    }));

  const activeRack = getDisplayCategory(activeCategory);
  const activeCategoryLabel = activeRack?.label ?? '裝扮';

  const isPetRack = activeCategory === PET_RACK_ID;

  /**
   * 這個衣架上的東西，普通商店賣不賣。
   *
   * 空衣架上那顆按鈕的文案是動態組出來的（`前往商店選購${分類名}`），所以它會照著任何一格說出
   * 那句話 —— 包括**特殊飾品**，而那一格的貨在限時小攤。按下去的結果是 ShopView 的
   * `resolveInitialTaxonomy` 丟掉這個 pin（見那裡：非 main-shop 的分類不是有效的 pin），退回
   * `initialSection: 'PERSON'`，也就是**帽子**。玩家按了一顆寫著「前往商店選購特殊飾品」的按鈕，
   * 到了一個沒有特殊飾品、也沒有任何說明的帽子貨架。
   *
   * 修法不是在這裡寫一個 `if (activeCategory === 'SpecialFx')`，那會是第二個記得這件事的地方，
   * 而且下一個限時限定的貨架不會繼承它。分類自己已經宣告了 `channel`（utils/categoryUtils.ts），
   * 所以問的是那一格：不是普通商店的貨，就不要給一顆通往普通商店的按鈕，改講它到底在哪裡賣
   * （`emptyNote`，那個欄位本來就是為了這件事存在的）。
   */
  const soldOutsideMainShop = (activeRack?.channel ?? 'main-shop') !== 'main-shop';

  /**
   * The pet on show beside the character. Equipping is single-select per slot (see
   * handleToggleEquip), so there is at most one — switching 未使用 on for a second dog takes the
   * first one off, which is why this can read the first match rather than reconcile a list.
   */
  const equippedPetId = profile?.equippedItems?.find(id => getPetSpec(id));

  /**
   * The pet's 特殊飾品, so the preview shows the bow on the dog the same way the island will.
   *
   * This is why the pet stands INSIDE the CosmeticEffectField below rather than beside it: the
   * ornaments animate and emit here exactly as they do in play, which is the whole point of a
   * preview — 寵物飾品 used to be the one thing on this screen you had to leave to see.
   */
  const petCosmetics = useMemo(
    () => resolveSpecialCosmetics(profile?.equippedItems ?? [], 'pet'),
    [profile?.equippedItems],
  );

  /**
   * Coming back from the shop lands on whichever category the player ended up
   * browsing there — the shop writes every chip switch to the shared
   * `last_selected_category`. Without this you leave from an empty 鞋子 rack, buy
   * a hat, and return to that same empty rack. Browsing 室內/室外 in the shop
   * leaves this screen alone, since neither is something you can wear.
   */
  const handleShopClose = () => {
    setShowShop(false);
    const browsed = resolveCategoryId(localStorage.getItem('last_selected_category'), activeCategory);
    if (PERSON_CATEGORY_IDS.includes(browsed)) setActiveCategory(browsed);
    // Every 狗/貓/鳥 chip in the shop comes back to the one 寵物 rack, since that is where the
    // thing you just bought is waiting — otherwise you buy a cat and return to the hat shelf.
    // 飾品 is its own rack on this screen, so it comes back to itself.
    else if (browsed === PET_GEAR_ID) setActiveCategory(PET_GEAR_ID);
    else if (getDisplayCategory(browsed)?.mainSection === 'PET') setActiveCategory(PET_RACK_ID);
  };

  /**
   * Wearing is single-select *within a category*: picking a hairstyle takes off
   * whichever hairstyle was already on, rather than stacking a second one.
   *
   * That exclusivity is what the renderer has always assumed. resolveHairSpec
   * (constants/hair.ts) renders the FIRST hair id it finds in equippedItems, so
   * the old arrayUnion toggle — which appended the new style and left the old
   * one in place — changed nothing at all on the avatar: the previously worn
   * style kept winning the lookup. Rebuilding the list here instead of sending
   * an arrayUnion/arrayRemove sentinel is also what lets the write go through
   * updateProfile, which updates local state before it waits on the network.
   *
   * A save left holding several hair ids by the old toggle heals itself the
   * first time its owner picks a hairstyle, since the filter drops every id in
   * the category before the chosen one goes back on.
   */
  const handleToggleEquip = (itemId: string) => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const equipped = profile.equippedItems ?? [];
    const isEquipped = equipped.includes(itemId);
    const category = ALL_ITEMS.find(item => item.id === itemId)?.shopCategory;
    // 寵物 is ONE slot even though the shop splits it across 狗/貓/鳥: the rack shows a single
    // companion and only one can stand beside the character, so bringing out a 柴犬 puts the
    // 臘腸 — or a future cat — away, exactly as a second hat takes off the first.
    //
    // Keyed on "is an ANIMAL" rather than on the 寵物 section, because that section also sells
    // 寵物飾品: on a section test, clipping a bow onto the dog would count as bringing out a
    // different pet and would put the dog itself away.
    const isAnimal = isPetAnimal(itemId);
    const sameSlot = new Set(
      ALL_ITEMS
        .filter(item => (isAnimal ? isPetAnimal(item.id) : item.shopCategory === category))
        .map(item => item.id)
    );

    // Clicking what you're wearing takes it off; clicking anything else swaps it in.
    const nextEquipped = equipped.filter(id => !sameSlot.has(id));
    if (!isEquipped) nextEquipped.push(itemId);

    playSound(SoundEffect.SUCCESS);
    void updateProfile({ equippedItems: nextEquipped });
  };

  return (
    // z-40: local sub-scale — this view is always mounted inside App.tsx's
    // z-game-view wrapper, so it only needs to out-rank its own siblings.
    // See DESIGN_SYSTEM.md's z-index "local sub-scale exception".
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-island-cream-2 overflow-hidden flex">
      {/* Background World Tint */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-island-cream-2 pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Main Container: Split Layout (Vertical on mobile, horizontal on desktop) */}
      <div className="relative flex flex-col-reverse md:flex-row w-full h-full">
        {/* Left Side: Inventory Panel */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ x: -100, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ x: -100, opacity: 0 }}
          className="relative w-full md:max-w-xl h-[55%] md:h-full bg-white border-t md:border-r md:border-t-0 border-island-line px-4 md:px-8 pt-16 md:pt-20 pb-6 md:pb-10 flex flex-col z-50 overflow-hidden shadow-[5px_0_30px_rgba(38,70,83,0.04)]"
        >
          {/* Back to Home Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setCurrentView(View.HOME)}
            className="absolute top-4 left-4 md:top-6 md:left-8 flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 md:px-4 md:py-2 bg-white hover:bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl text-island-navy-soft border border-island-line transition-all active:scale-95 z-50 group"
          >
            <Home size={18} strokeWidth={3} className="group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest whitespace-nowrap">返回遊戲主區</span>
          </button>

          {/* Subtle elegant pattern */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03] pointer-events-none" style={{ backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(rgba(38,70,83,1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(38,70,83,1) 1px, transparent 1px)', backgroundSize: '40px 40px' }} />

          <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 md:gap-6 mb-4 md:mb-10 relative">
            <div className="flex items-center">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-5">
                <PortholeFrame size={60} className="shadow-[0_4px_10px_rgba(42,157,143,0.3)]">
                  <div className="w-full h-full bg-island-teal flex items-center justify-center text-white">
                    <Box className="w-6 h-6 md:w-7 md:h-7" strokeWidth={2.5} />
                  </div>
                </PortholeFrame>
                <div>
                  {/* 「背包」，一個名字。
                      ─────────────
                      這個畫面以前自稱「裝備收藏庫」，而路牌上寫的是「更衣室」，商店裡還有一張
                      「我的裝備收納庫」的 banner 通往一個叫「我的收藏裝備」的 modal —— 四個名字，
                      其中兩個指著同一份 profile.inventory。玩家分不出哪個是哪個，因為它們本來就
                      沒有差別。 */}
                  <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-4xl font-black tracking-tight text-island-navy leading-none">背包</h2>
                  <p className="text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft uppercase tracking-[0.3em] mt-1.5 md:mt-2">Your Island Backpack</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 四個分頁 —— 穿戴 / 擺放 / 消耗 / 已套用，也就是 CategoryKind 的四個值。
                它們不是新分類：那一格早就是全遊戲判斷「這東西怎麼用」的依據，只是以前只有程式
                看得到。見 UI/BackpackTabs.tsx。 */}
            <BackpackTabBar active={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} counts={tabCounts} />

            <div className={`space-y-2.5 w-full ${activeTab === 'wearable' ? '' : 'hidden'}`}>
              {/* Tier 1: this screen only ever manages character items, so the
                  main-section tier is a static label rather than a fake toggle */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-island-teal-dark">
                <CategoryIcon iconName={MAIN_SECTIONS[0].iconName} size={14} active />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">{MAIN_SECTIONS[0].label}</span>
              </div>
              {/* Tier 2: sub-category chips */}
              <SubCategoryTabs
                categories={RACKS}
                active={activeCategory}
                onChange={(id) => {
                  setActiveCategory(id);
                  // `last_selected_category` means "where I was in the shop", and the shop has
                  // no 寵物 chip to restore — writing it would reopen the storefront on a
                  // category its row never renders.
                  if (!getDisplayCategory(id)?.standalone) {
                    localStorage.setItem('last_selected_category', id);
                  }
                }}
                className="md:!justify-start"
              />
              {/* Same shelf note as the shop's, so 配件 and 特殊飾品 say the same thing about
                  themselves in both places a player meets them. */}
              <CategoryNote categoryId={activeCategory} className="mx-0" />
            </div>
          </header>

          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2 custom-scrollbar">
            {/* 擺放 / 已套用 —— 唯讀清單，依貨架分組。沒有動作按鈕是刻意的：東西要放下去得站在
                放得下去的地方，而這裡不是。見 UI/BackpackTabs.tsx。 */}
            {(activeTab === 'placeable' || activeTab === 'applied') && (
              <div className="pb-20">
                <OwnedKindList profile={profile} kind={activeTab} onGoShop={() => setShowShop(true)} />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 消耗 —— 功能卡與寵物用品終於有了一個不在商店標題列裡的家。
                這兩個背包以前**只能從商店（與限時小攤）的 header 進去**，也就是說一袋買回來的
                飼料，唯一能拿出來餵的地方是另一家店的畫面。 */}
            {activeTab === 'consumable' && (
              <div className="space-y-6 pb-20">
                <section className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-[0.14em] text-island-navy-soft">
                      功能卡
                    </span>
                    <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-island-line" />
                  </div>
                  <UtilityCardBag />
                </section>

                {/* 只有帶著夥伴才畫 —— 對一個沒有寵物的玩家，這一段是一組沒有對象的餵食按鈕。
                    PetCareBag 自己也擋著，這裡的區塊標題跟著一起收起來。 */}
                {hasCompanionOut && (
                  <section className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-[0.14em] text-island-navy-soft">
                        我的寵物
                      </span>
                      <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-island-line" />
                    </div>
                    <PetCareBag />
                  </section>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className={`space-y-3 pb-20 ${activeTab === 'wearable' ? '' : 'hidden'}`}>
              <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
                {ownedItems.length === 0 ? (
                  <motion.div
                    key="empty"
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -12 }}
                    className="max-w-md mx-auto"
                  >
                    <EmptyState
                      bordered
                      icon={
                        soldOutsideMainShop
                          ? <Sailboat size={32} className="text-island-teal" />
                          : isPetRack
                            ? <PawPrint size={32} className="text-island-teal" />
                            : <Store size={32} className="text-island-teal" />
                      }
                      title={isPetRack ? '還沒有夥伴陪著你' : `還沒有任何${activeCategoryLabel}`}
                      description={
                        // A shelf another storefront owns says where its goods actually come from
                        // (the category's own `emptyNote` — see utils/categoryUtils.ts), because
                        // the 前往商店 line below would be a promise this screen cannot keep.
                        soldOutsideMainShop
                          ? activeRack?.emptyNote ?? `${activeCategoryLabel}不在普通商店販售。`
                          : isPetRack
                            ? '這一格放你帶在身邊的夥伴，商店的寵物區已經有狗狗在等人帶回家了。'
                            : `商店裡還有更多${activeCategoryLabel}，買下就能直接在這裡換上。`
                      }
                      action={
                        // The pet rack gets the same 前往商店 button as every other rack now that
                        // 商店 has a 寵物 section to send the player to — it used to be the one
                        // rack with nowhere to go.
                        //
                        // A limited-shop shelf gets NO button, and that is the fix rather than an
                        // omission: the only honest destination is a merchant who has to be walked
                        // to and who is not always on the island (constants/merchantVisit.ts), so
                        // there is nothing here that could open it. The description above says
                        // where to look; a button that opened the wrong shop said less than nothing.
                        soldOutsideMainShop ? undefined : (
                          <Button
                            variant="primary"
                            onClick={() => setShowShop(true)}
                            className="px-5 py-3 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider"
                          >
                            <Store size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                            {`前往商店選購${activeCategoryLabel}`}
                          </Button>
                        )
                      }
                    />
                  </motion.div>
                ) : (
                  ownedItems.map((item, idx) => {
                    const isEquipped = profile?.equippedItems?.includes(item.itemId);
                    // Every wearable in this drawer carries a tier now (constants/rarity.ts), so
                    // the whole wardrobe reads as one ladder rather than as a graded pet shelf
                    // among plain clothes. Thumbnail form only (`.rarity-chip`), and 使用中 still
                    // out-ranks it for the same reason the furniture drawer's 套用中 does: a STATE
                    // beats a GRADE. That is why `graded` is still a condition — it is about the
                    // equipped state, not about whether the item has a tier.
                    const definition = getItemById(item.itemId);
                    const rarity = definition ? getItemRarity(definition) : DEFAULT_RARITY;
                    const graded = !isEquipped;
                    return (
                      <motion.div
                        layout
                        key={item.itemId}
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                        transition={{ delay: idx * 0.05 }}
                        onClick={() => handleToggleEquip(item.itemId)}
                        className={`group p-4 rounded-2xl dock-notch border transition-all flex items-center gap-5 cursor-pointer relative ${
                          isEquipped
                            ? 'bg-white border-island-teal shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(42,157,143,0.1)]'
                            : graded
                              ? 'rarity-chip bg-white/60 hover:bg-island-cream-2'
                              : 'bg-white/60 border-island-line hover:border-island-teal-light hover:bg-island-cream-2'
                        }`}
                        style={graded ? rarityStyleVars(rarity) : undefined}
                      >
                        <IconTile size={64} active={isEquipped} className="text-island-navy shadow-inner">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110 filter drop-shadow-[0_4px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)]">
                            <QVersionIcon itemId={item.itemId} size={64} />
                          </div>
                        </IconTile>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <h4 className={`font-black text-lg truncate ${isEquipped ? 'text-island-teal-dark' : 'text-island-navy'}`}>
                            {item.name}
                          </h4>
                          <p className={`text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5 truncate ${isEquipped ? 'text-island-teal' : 'text-island-navy-soft'}`}>
                            {getItemCategoryLabel(item.itemId)}
                          </p>
                        </div>

                        <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-[9px] font-black uppercase transition-all ${
                          isEquipped ? 'bg-island-teal/12 text-island-teal-dark border border-island-teal/25' : 'bg-white text-island-navy-soft border border-island-line group-hover:bg-island-teal group-hover:text-white'
                        }`}>
                          {isEquipped ? '使用中' : '未使用'}
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Right Side: 3D Preview Studio */}
        <div className="flex-1 h-[45%] md:h-full relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-white w-full">
          {/* Studio Backdrop */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
             <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-island-cream-2" />
             {/* Glow */}
             <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-island-teal/6 via-transparent to-island-teal/6" />
             {/* Soft Grid */}
             <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03] pointer-events-none" style={{ backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(rgba(38,70,83,1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(38,70,83,1) 1px, transparent 1px)', backgroundSize: '100px 100px' }} />
          </div>

          <div className="w-full h-full relative z-10">
            <Canvas shadows={{ type: THREE.PCFShadowMap }} dpr={[1, 2]} onCreated={({ gl }) => tuneRenderer(gl)}>
              <PerspectiveCamera makeDefault position={[0, 0.4, 3.2]} fov={35} />
              <ambientLight intensity={0.6} />

              {/* Studio Key Lights */}
              <pointLight position={[2, 2, 2]} intensity={70} color="#ffffff" />
              <pointLight position={[-2, 2, 2]} intensity={70} color="#ffffff" />
              <pointLight position={[0, 3, 5]} intensity={30} color="#ffffff" />

              {/* Backlight / Rim LIGHT */}
              <spotLight
                position={[0, 6, -4]}
                angle={0.4}
                penumbra={1}
                intensity={400}
                color="#ffffff"
                castShadow
              />

              {/* The graded wall the whole stage stands in — see StudioBackdrop. It is what
                  stops a white bubble, a pale star or an ice halo from being previewed against
                  a white field and disappearing into it. Outside the stage group and outside
                  Suspense: it is the room, it never loads anything, and it must be there on the
                  first frame rather than after the avatar resolves. */}
              <StudioBackdrop />

              <Suspense fallback={null}>
                {/* Special cosmetic effects, so an ornament previews the way it will actually
                    look. Mounted OUTSIDE the stage group on purpose: the pooled particles it
                    renders are world-space, and inside they would be carried 0.85 units down
                    with the stage while their spawn points stayed where the avatar is. */}
                <CosmeticEffectField>
                {/* Stage / Floor */}
                <group position={[0, -0.85, 0]}>
                  {/* The tiled stage, rings included — see Three/StudioFloor.tsx */}
                  <StudioFloor />

                  <group scale={0.5} position={[0, 0, 0]}>
                     <Avatar isInterior={false} />
                     {/* The equipped pet stands on the same stage floor as the character, as a
                         sibling of the avatar rather than a child of it: the avatar's own group
                         carries walk/idle/squash transforms that a companion has no business
                         inheriting. Being a sibling means re-applying AVATAR_BASE_SCALE by hand,
                         which is what puts the dog's height (measured in the avatar's local units
                         against its knee) back in proportion. */}
                     {equippedPetId && (
                       <group scale={AVATAR_BASE_SCALE}>
                         <CompanionPet itemId={equippedPetId} cosmetics={petCosmetics} />
                       </group>
                     )}
                  </group>
                </group>
                </CosmeticEffectField>
              </Suspense>

              <OrbitControls
                enablePan={false}
                enableZoom={false}
                minPolarAngle={Math.PI / 3}
                maxPolarAngle={Math.PI / 1.6}
                // Explicitly off — drei defaults this to TRUE, and this turntable was the one
                // <OrbitControls> in the app still left on that default (the game camera turns it
                // off at CameraController.tsx's enableDamping={false} for the same reason). With
                // damping on, three's dampingFactor 0.05 only closes 5% of the pending rotation
                // per frame: the character visibly trails the cursor during the drag and keeps
                // gliding after you let go. Off, it turns exactly with the pointer and stops dead.
                enableDamping={false}
                // A drag the full height of the canvas = one full turn (OrbitControls rotates
                // `2*PI*rotateSpeed / clientHeight` radians per pixel). The old 0.5 meant a
                // full-height drag only got you halfway round, which read as more sluggishness on
                // top of the damping lag.
                rotateSpeed={1}
                makeDefault
              />
            </Canvas>
          </div>

          {/* Vanity Controls Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute inset-8 border border-island-line/40 pointer-events-none rounded-[4rem] z-20" />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-20">
             {/* Studio Bulbs along the sides */}
             <div className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 left-10 flex flex-col gap-12">
               {[1,2,3,4,5].map(i => (
                 <div key={i} className="relative text-left">
                   <div className="absolute inset-0 blur-[8px] bg-island-teal-light/60 opacity-90" />
                   <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-white rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(42,157,143,0.5)] border border-island-teal-light z-10 animate-pulse" />
                 </div>
               ))}
             </div>
             <div className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 right-10 flex flex-col gap-12">
               {[1,2,3,4,5].map(i => (
                 <div key={i} className="relative text-left">
                   <div className="absolute inset-0 blur-[8px] bg-island-teal-light/60 opacity-90" />
                   <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-white rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(42,157,143,0.5)] border border-island-teal-light z-10 animate-pulse" />
                 </div>
               ))}
             </div>
          </div>



        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {showShop && (
          // Opened from an empty rack, so it lands on the exact category the
          // player was standing on (帽子 → 商店的帽子) rather than wherever the
          // shared `last_selected_category` happened to leave the shop.
          // initialSection is the floor under that. 寵物 needs its own: the rack's
          // id is standalone, so the shop ignores it as a pin and would drop the
          // player back at 帽子 instead of the 寵物 shelf they asked for.
          <ShopView
            isOverlay
            initialSection={isPetRack || activeCategory === PET_GEAR_ID ? 'PET' : 'PERSON'}
            initialCategory={activeCategory}
            onClose={handleShopClose}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
