```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, Suspense } from 'react';
import { Camera, Mic, Flame, Play, X, Check, Trophy, Heart, Hand, Music, RefreshCw, Smile, Coins } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../types';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import { MovementTracker } from './MovementTracker';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { tuneRenderer } from '../lib/rendererTuning';
import { StickFigure } from './Three/StickFigure';
import { Environment } from '@react-three/drei';
import { HDRI_CITY } from '../constants/environmentMaps';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../lib/soundUtils';
import { vibrateGoalCompleted } from '../lib/vibration';
import { makeWorkoutCompletion, reportWorkoutCompletion } from '../lib/workoutCompletion';
import { payoutForWorkout, type WorkoutPayout } from '../constants/workoutRewards';
import { PortholeFrame, StatTile } from './UI/DesignKit';
import { FragmentGainCard, FragmentShard } from './UI/FragmentProgress';
import { fragmentsForWorkout, rollWorkoutFragmentItem } from '../constants/fragments';
import { ownsItem } from '../utils/inventory';

type WorkoutType = 'jumping-jacks' | 'squats';

export function FitnessView() {
  const { setCurrentView, profile, setIsWorkoutActive, grantFragments } = useApp();
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(false);
  const [isFinished, setIsFinished] = useState(false);
  const [workoutType, setWorkoutType] = useState<WorkoutType>('jumping-jacks');
  /**
   * 商品碎片 this session paid, or null when it paid none (no reps, or the write was refused).
   *
   * Held as a snapshot of what the GRANT reported rather than re-rolled at render time, for the
   * obvious reason: the settlement screen re-renders whenever the emote buttons are pressed, and a
   * reward that changed item every time somebody made the character dance would not be a reward.
   */
  const [fragmentReward, setFragmentReward] = useState<
    { itemId: string; amount: number; overflow: number; tickets: number } | null
  >(null);

  const [reps, setReps] = useState(0);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [calories, setCalories] = useState(0);
  /**
   * What the finished session was worth, for the results screen ONLY.
   *
   * Asked of the rules module (`payoutForWorkout`, constants/workoutRewards.ts) rather than worked
   * out here — this screen displays the figure, it does not decide it, and the reward service pays
   * it from the same function on the same completion. That distinction is the whole point: the two
   * cannot disagree, because there is only one formula.
   *
   * It used to be `Math.floor(reps * 0.8)` inline in the tile below, which was the payout rule
   * copied into a view. That copy silently went WRONG the moment the rule grew a per-minute
   * component: the screen would have shown a player less than they were actually paid, with no
   * error anywhere.
   */
  const [payout, setPayout] = useState<WorkoutPayout | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsWorkoutActive(isActive && !isFinished);
    return () => setIsWorkoutActive(false);
  }, [isActive, isFinished, setIsWorkoutActive]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive && !isFinished) {
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setSeconds(s => s + 1);
      }, 1000);
    } else {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    }
    return () => { if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current); };
  }, [isActive, isFinished]);

  const handleRep = () => {
    setReps(r => r + 1);
    setCalories(c => c + 0.8);
    playSound(SoundEffect.TICK, 0.2); // Subtle tick for each rep
  };

  const startWorkout = (type: WorkoutType) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setWorkoutType(type);
    setReps(0);
    setSeconds(0);
    setCalories(0);
    setFragmentReward(null);
    setPayout(null);
    setIsActive(true);
    setIsFinished(false);
  };

  const finishWorkout = async () => {
    setIsFinished(true);
    setIsActive(false);
    playSound(SoundEffect.SUCCESS);
    vibrateGoalCompleted();

    // Trigger the celebrate emote in the 3D background immediately!
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('trigger-avatar-emote', { detail: { emote: 'CELEBRATE' } }));
    
    if (profile) {
      confetti({
        particleCount: 150,
        spread: 80,
        origin: { y: 0.6 }
      });

      const finished = makeWorkoutCompletion({
        userId: profile.userId,
        workoutType: workoutType === 'jumping-jacks' ? '開合跳' : '深蹲',
        durationSeconds: seconds,
        repCount: reps,
        source: 'prototype',
      });
      // Display only, from the same completion the service is about to be paid on.
      setPayout(payoutForWorkout(finished));
      reportWorkoutCompletion(finished);

      try {
        // 商品碎片 — the everyday source (constants/fragments.ts).
        const fragmentAmount = fragmentsForWorkout(reps);
        const drop = fragmentAmount > 0
          ? rollWorkoutFragmentItem(profile, id => ownsItem(profile, id))
          : null;
        if (drop) {
          const report = await grantFragments([{ itemId: drop.id, amount: fragmentAmount }]);
          const settled = report.results[0];
          if (settled) {
            setFragmentReward({
              itemId: drop.id,
              amount: settled.kept,
              overflow: settled.overflow,
              tickets: report.tickets,
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to grant fragments', e);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleHomeReturn = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setCurrentView(View.HOME);
  };

  const formatTime = (totalSeconds: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
    const secs = totalSeconds % 60;
    return `${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  if (isFinished) {
    return (
      // z-40: local sub-scale — FitnessView's 3 top-level states (picker/
      // active/finished) are mutually exclusive early-returns of the same
      // z-game-view-scoped view, so they can safely share one tier. See
      // DESIGN_SYSTEM.md's z-index "local sub-scale exception".
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-6 z-40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 30 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="max-w-md w-full bg-white p-10 rounded-[2rem] shadow-[0_32px_64px_rgba(38,70,83,0.25)] text-center border border-island-line"
        >
          <PortholeFrame size={96} className="mx-auto mb-6">
            <div className="w-full h-full bg-island-gold/15 text-island-gold flex items-center justify-center">
              <Trophy size={48} />
            </div>
          </PortholeFrame>
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-island-navy mb-2 tracking-tight">運動挑戰成功！</h2>
          <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 font-bold mb-8 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs">Achievement Unlocked</p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-6">
            <StatTile accent="teal" icon={<Flame size={16} />} label="總次數" value={reps} />
            <StatTile accent="gold" icon={<Coins size={16} />} label="獲得金幣" value={`+${payout?.coins ?? 0}`} />
          </div>

          {/* 商品碎片, directly under the gold. This is the screen the reward was designed for: the
              player has just finished the work, and what they are shown is not a number but the
              THING they are closer to owning. */}
          {fragmentReward && (
            <div className="mb-6 text-left">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft/70 uppercase font-black mb-2">
                <FragmentShard size={12} />
                本次獲得商品碎片
              </span>
              <FragmentGainCard
                itemId={fragmentReward.itemId}
                amount={fragmentReward.amount}
                overflow={fragmentReward.overflow}
              />
              {/* Only when the overflow actually MINTED something. 「多出來的碎片已轉為抽獎券」 with
                  a 0 beside it would be the interface congratulating the player on nothing. */}
              {fragmentReward.tickets > 0 && (
                <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70">
                  多出來的碎片已轉換成 {fragmentReward.tickets} 張抽獎券。
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Celebratory 3D avatar emote menu */}
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-[2rem] border border-island-line">
            <span className="block text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft/70 uppercase font-black mb-2.5">
              🎉 點擊讓 3D 角色做出慶祝動作！
            </span>
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-2">
              {[
                { id: 'CELEBRATE', name: '狂歡', icon: Trophy, color: 'hover:bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal border-island-teal/25' },
                { id: 'FLIP', name: '空翻', icon: RefreshCw, color: 'hover:bg-island-navy/8 text-island-navy border-island-navy/20' },
                { id: 'DANCE', name: '熱舞', icon: Music, color: 'hover:bg-island-coral/10 text-island-coral border-island-coral/25' },
                { id: 'WAVE', name: '揮手', icon: Hand, color: 'hover:bg-island-gold/12 text-island-gold border-island-gold/30' },
              ].map((em) => {
                const IconComp = em.icon;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={em.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('trigger-avatar-emote', { detail: { emote: em.id } }));
                    }}
                    className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 w-14 h-14 bg-white border rounded-2xl transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-[0_2px_6px_rgba(38,70,83,0.12)] cursor-pointer ${em.color}`}
                    title={em.name}
                  >
                    <IconComp size={18} />
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold">{em.name}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleHomeReturn}
            className="w-full bg-island-navy text-white py-6 rounded-[2rem] font-black text-2xl hover:bg-island-teal-dark transition-all shadow-[0_20px_44px_rgba(38,70,83,0.35)] active:scale-95 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
          >
            返回我的海島
          </button>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isActive) {
    return (
      // z-40: same local sub-scale as the finished/picker states above —
      // mutually exclusive, so reusing the tier is safe.
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black flex flex-col md:flex-row overflow-hidden">
        {/* Reference Area - 1/3 height on mobile, 2/5 width on desktop */}
        <div className="w-full md:w-2/5 h-[35vh] md:h-full relative bg-island-navy border-r border-white/5 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-island-teal-dark/25 to-transparent pointer-events-none z-10" />
          <Suspense fallback={null}>
            <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 1.0, 3.8], fov: 35 }} onCreated={({ gl }) => tuneRenderer(gl)}>
              <ambientLight intensity={1.5} />
              <pointLight position={[10, 10, 10]} intensity={2} />
              <StickFigure type={workoutType === 'jumping-jacks' ? 'jumping-jacks' : 'squats'} />
              <gridHelper args={[10, 10, 0x444444, 0x222222]} position={[0, -0.4, 0]} />
              <Environment files={HDRI_CITY} />
            </Canvas>
          </Suspense>
          
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-between p-8 pointer-events-none z-20">
            <div className="bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl px-6 py-4 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 self-start">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-3 h-3 bg-island-coral rounded-full animate-ping" />
                <span className="text-white font-black text-lg tracking-tight">示範動作：{workoutType === 'jumping-jacks' ? '開合跳' : '深蹲'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-island-teal text-white px-8 py-5 rounded-[2.5rem] font-black text-2xl shadow-2xl self-center mb-8 border-4 border-white/20 animate-bounce">
              跟著小人動起來！
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tracker Area */}
        <div className="flex-1 relative bg-black">
          <MovementTracker 
            isActive={isActive} 
            exerciseType={workoutType} 
            onRepDetected={handleRep} 
          />

          {/* Overlay UI */}
          <div className="absolute top-8 right-8 flex gap-4 z-50">
            <div className="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl px-8 py-5 rounded-[2.5rem] border border-white/10 shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
              <span className="text-island-teal-light text-[10px] uppercase font-black tracking-widest leading-none mb-1">Time</span>
              <span className="text-white text-4xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none">{formatTime(seconds)}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={finishWorkout}
              className="w-16 h-16 bg-island-coral hover:bg-island-coral/85 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-[0_12px_28px_rgba(232,131,106,0.4)] transition-all active:scale-95 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
            >
              <X size={32} strokeWidth={4} />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="absolute bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex flex-col gap-6 items-center z-50 w-full max-w-xl px-6">
            {/* Elegant, smoothly animated progress bar */}
            <div className="w-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl p-6 rounded-[2rem] border border-white/10 shadow-[0_16px_36px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] flex flex-col gap-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="text-white/60 text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase">
                  {reps >= 10 ? '🎉 目標完成！' : `💪 距離目標還差 ${10 - reps} 下`}
                </span>
                <span className="text-island-teal-light text-sm font-black font-mono">
                  {reps} / 10 Reps
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full h-3.5 bg-white/10 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative border border-white/5">
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ width: 0 }}
                  animate={{ width: `${Math.min((reps / 10) * 100, 100)}%` }}
                  transition={{
                    type: "spring",
                    stiffness: 80,
                    damping: 15,
                    mass: 0.8
                  }}
                  className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-island-teal-light to-island-teal-dark rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(42,157,143,0.5)]"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="w-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl p-8 rounded-[3rem] border border-white/10 shadow-[0_24px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] flex items-center justify-around">
              <div className="text-center">
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-white/40 uppercase font-black mb-1">次數</span>
                <span className="text-6xl font-black text-white font-mono tracking-tighter">{reps}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-px h-16 bg-white/10" />
              <div className="text-center">
                <span className="block text-[10px] text-white/40 uppercase font-black mb-1">卡路里</span>
                <span className="text-6xl font-black text-island-teal-light font-mono tracking-tighter">{calories.toFixed(1)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-y-auto z-40 bg-gradient-to-br from-island-teal/6 to-island-cream-2 page-shell-y page-shell-x flex flex-col items-center">
      <button
        onClick={handleHomeReturn}
        className="fixed corner-safe-tr w-14 h-14 bg-white border border-island-line hover:bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-navy transition-all z-50 shadow-[0_10px_24px_rgba(38,70,83,0.15)] active:scale-95 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
      >
        <X size={28} strokeWidth={3} />
      </button>

      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        // Shadow is `.notch-shadow-lg` on this wrapper rather than a
        // `shadow-[...]` on the clipped card — a clip-path clips the element's
        // own box-shadow away entirely (see index.css). This also drops the
        // raw-black shadow the old value used, which DESIGN_SYSTEM.md rules
        // out for chrome in favour of the navy-tinted family.
        className="max-w-3xl w-full flex notch-shadow-lg"
      >
        <div className="w-full bg-white border border-island-line dock-notch p-12 rounded-[4rem] text-island-navy">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-10">
          <header className="flex justify-between items-end">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <div className="h-2 w-12 bg-island-teal rounded-full" />
                <span className="text-island-teal-dark font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">Daily Challenge</span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-5xl font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight leading-none">健美海島生活</h2>
              <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 font-bold text-lg mt-3 uppercase tracking-wide">Choose Your Power Session</p>
            </div>
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal rounded-[2rem] flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_16px_32px_rgba(42,157,143,0.15)] rotate-6 transform transition-transform hover:rotate-0 cursor-default">
              <Camera size={36} strokeWidth={2.5} />

            <div className="flex items-center gap-6">

                <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 font-bold text-sm">請將相機對準全身以進行動作計數</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-island-teal/10 content-[''] px-6 py-2 rounded-full border border-island-teal/25">
```

## src/components/InteractionPrompt.tsx

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { LogIn } from 'lucide-react';
import { View } from '../types';
import { db, doc, updateDoc } from '../lib/firebase';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../lib/soundUtils';

export function InteractionPrompt() {
  const { nearbyBuilding, setCurrentView, profile } = useApp();

  const handleEnter = async () => {
    if (!nearbyBuilding || !profile) return;
    
    try {
      playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
      triggerHaptic('double');
      const userRef = doc(db, 'users', profile.userId);
      await updateDoc(userRef, { activeBuildingId: nearbyBuilding.id });
      setCurrentView(View.BUILDING_INTERIOR);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {nearbyBuilding && (
        <motion.div 
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          className="fixed bottom-32 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[60]"
        >
          <button 
            onClick={handleEnter}
            className="bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-2 border-amber-100 px-8 py-5 rounded-[2.5rem] shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-4 hover:-translate-y-1 active:scale-95 transition-all group"
          >
            <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-amber-500 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg group-hover:rotate-12 transition-transform shadow-amber-500/20">
              <LogIn size={28} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase font-[1000] text-amber-500 tracking-widest leading-none mb-1">發現目標建築</p>
              <h3 className="text-gray-900 font-black text-2xl tracking-tight leading-none">進入 {nearbyBuilding.name}</h3>
            </div>
          </button>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

## src/components/LimitedShopView.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { Check, Coins, Gem, History, Layers, Tent, Timer, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../types';
import { getBalance, type CurrencyId } from '../constants/currency';
import { rarityStyleVars } from '../constants/rarity';
import { LIMITED_SHOP_CONFIG, getPurchasedCount } from '../constants/limitedShop';
import {
  currentRotation,
  describeTimeLeft,
  msUntilRotationEnds,
  remainingAllowance,
  resolveOffer,
  type LimitedOffer,
  type LimitedRotation,
  type OfferPrice,
  type ResolvedOffer,
} from '../constants/limitedShopRotation';
import { LIMITED_PURCHASE_MESSAGES, type LimitedPurchaseResult } from '../context/useLimitedShop';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../lib/soundUtils';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { useDirectWheelScroll } from '../hooks/useScrollIsolation';
import { QVersionIcon } from './QVersionIcon';
import { RarityAura } from './UI/RarityAura';
import {
  Button,
  CurrencyChip,
  EmptyState,
  ModalOverlay,
  ModalShell,
  PanelHeader,
} from './UI/DesignKit';
import {
  UtilityCardArt,
  UtilityCardBagButton,
  UtilityCardBagModal,
  UtilityCardMeta,
  UtilityCardTile,
  useNow,
} from './UI/UtilityCard';

/**
 * 限時小攤 —— 一家獨立的店。
 *
 * 普通商店賣常駐商品，這裡賣本檔限定的東西，兩邊的商品池互斥（constants/distribution.ts），
 * 玩家不需要「先進商店，再去找限時分類」。
 *
 * ## 進得來，是因為有人把門打開了
 *
 * 這一頁**不判斷商人在不在**，一行都沒有。它以前是路牌上一格按鈕直接開的；現在唯一開得了它
 * 的是 UI/MerchantSession.tsx —— 玩家走到島邊那位旅行商人面前按下動作鍵，那個元件確認過造訪
 * 狀態（constants/merchantVisit.ts）之後才切 view。商人收攤時也是它蓋上「他已經離開了」那一
 * 層，並把玩家送回島上。
 *
 * 這一頁因此**完全沒有為了改成世界入口而改動**：它照樣只畫 `currentRotation(now)`。那是刻意
 * 的分工 —— 一個會自己判斷「商人還在嗎」的商店畫面，就是第二個關於商人在不在的答案，而兩個
 * 答案遲早會在某個邊界上不一致。
 *
 * ## 這一頁要讓玩家搞懂的三件事
 *
 *  1. **這不是普通商店。** 靠的是它自己的入口、攤位的木牌語彙與「本檔」的說法，而不是一片紅色
 *     倒數。這裡刻意不做成課金商城：倒數只講到「天/小時」，沒有秒數在跳，沒有「最後機會」，
 *     沒有搶購動畫。它要像島上一個期間限定的小攤子，不是一個要你現在就掏錢的櫃檯。
 *  2. **卡牌是整包賣的。** 每一張卡牌卡片上都直接寫「× N 張」與整包價格，而且沒有數量選擇器
 *     （§16/§17）—— 商品本身就是一包，按鈕上寫的是「購買此組合」。
 *  3. **沒買到不是永久失去。** 「返場」標籤是這家店最有用的一句話。
 *
 * ## 這裡不決定任何事
 *
 * 賣什麼、一包幾張、多少錢、還能買幾次，全部來自 constants/limitedShopRotation.ts 的
 * `currentRotation(now)`，那是期數的純函數。這一頁只是把它畫出來 —— 所以重新整理、重開遊戲、
 * 換一台裝置都會看到同一組商品與同一個價格（§23）。
 */

const headerBtnClass =
  'h-10 px-3.5 gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-island-line hover:border-island-teal hover:text-island-teal text-island-navy-soft flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-90 flex-shrink-0';

/** 價格用哪一種貨幣籌碼。金幣金色、碎片藍綠 —— 見 DesignKit 的 CurrencyChip。 */
const chipKind = (currency: CurrencyId) => (currency === 'coins' ? 'coins' : 'fragments');

export function LimitedShopView({ onClose }: { onClose?: () => void }) {
  const { profile, setCurrentView } = useApp();
  // 一秒一跳：倒數是這一頁「限時」這個說法的全部憑據，而在玩家眼前換檔的貨架，也必須在畫面上
  // 真的換掉 —— `currentRotation` 是這個數字的純函數，所以新的一檔會自己畫出來。
  const now = useNow(1000);
  const rotation: LimitedRotation = currentRotation(now);
  const scrollRef = useDirectWheelScroll();

  const [pending, setPending] = useState<{ resolved: ResolvedOffer; price: OfferPrice } | null>(null);
  const [showBag, setShowBag] = useState(false);

  const exit = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    if (onClose) onClose();
    else setCurrentView(View.HOME);
  };

  // 只有在上面沒有疊東西的時候：對話框與卡牌背包打開時各自接管 Esc，兩個 window 層級的監聽會在
  // 同一次按鍵一起關掉。
  useEscapeToClose(exit, !pending && !showBag);
  useEscapeToClose(() => setPending(null), !!pending);
  useEscapeToClose(() => setShowBag(false), showBag);

  /** 這一檔的商品，依設定裡的貨架區分組，順序照設定寫的。 */
  const sections = useMemo(
    () =>
      LIMITED_SHOP_CONFIG.slots
        .map((slot) => ({
          slot,
          offers: rotation.offers.filter((offer) => offer.slotId === slot.id),
        }))
        .filter((section) => section.offers.length > 0),
    [rotation],
  );

  const timeLeft = msUntilRotationEnds(rotation, now);

  return (
    <>
      <div
        ref={scrollRef}
        className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-island-cream-2 overflow-y-auto page-shell-x page-shell-y"
      >
        <div className="w-full max-w-[1000px] mx-auto bg-island-cream rounded-[2rem] shadow-[0_15px_40px_rgba(38,70,83,0.12)] border border-island-line overflow-hidden mb-10">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-stretch flex-shrink-0">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={<Tent size={22} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              title="限時小攤"
              subtitle="旅行商人的期間限定攤位，本檔換一批"
              className="flex-1 min-w-0 !border-b-0 md:!border-b"
            />
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end flex-wrap gap-2.5 bg-island-cream-2 border-b border-island-line px-6 py-3 md:pr-8 md:pl-2 md:py-0 flex-shrink-0">
              <CurrencyChip amount={getBalance(profile, 'coins')} />
              <CurrencyChip amount={getBalance(profile, 'fragments')} currency="fragments" />
              {/* 卡牌背包，就在這裡：這是全遊戲買得到卡牌的地方，一張只能回商店才看得到的卡是
                  一張玩家會忘記自己有的卡。 */}
              <UtilityCardBagButton onClick={() => setShowBag(true)} />
              <button onClick={exit} className={headerBtnClass} aria-label="離開限時小攤">
                <X size={16} strokeWidth={3} />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest whitespace-nowrap">
                  離開
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-6 md:p-8 space-y-7">
            {/* 「這不是常駐商品」這件事，講一次，講得平靜。 */}
            <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-line bg-white px-6 py-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-4">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-island-teal text-white flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                <Timer size={22} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight">
                  本檔剩餘 {describeTimeLeft(timeLeft)}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 mt-0.5">
                  換檔後攤位上的東西會全部換一批，卡牌組合包的張數與價格也會重新配置。沒買到也沒
                  關係——過一陣子它們可能會再回來。
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {sections.map(({ slot, offers }) => (
              <section key={slot.id} className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <h3 className="text-base font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight">{slot.label}</h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60">
                    本檔 {offers.length} 項
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 leading-relaxed">
                  {slot.note}
                </p>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 pt-1">
                  {offers.map((offer) => (
                    <LimitedOfferCard
                      key={offer.id}
                      offer={offer}
                      rotationId={rotation.id}
                      onBuy={(resolved, price) => {
                        triggerHaptic('medium');
                        setPending({ resolved, price });
                      }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>
            ))}

            {sections.length === 0 && (
              <EmptyState
                icon={<Tent size={32} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
                title="本檔攤位還沒擺出來"
                description="換檔後再回來看看吧！"
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {pending && (
          <LimitedPurchaseDialog
            resolved={pending.resolved}
            price={pending.price}
            rotationId={rotation.id}
            onClose={() => setPending(null)}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* z-[80]：這一頁本地層級的最上層，蓋過貨架與對話框那一層。 */}
      <UtilityCardBagModal open={showBag} onClose={() => setShowBag(false)} zIndexClassName="z-[80]" />
    </>
  );
}
/**
 * 攤位上的一項商品。
 *
 * 兩種畫法，一套規則。標籤、價格列、限購讀數與購買流程對組合包與飾品完全一樣，所以它們寫在這裡
 * 一次；不一樣的是**它被畫成什麼**：功能卡走 `UtilityCardTile`（圓形卡面、票根壓線 —— 功能卡不是
 * 商品，不能被畫成商品，見 DESIGN_SYSTEM.md），目錄商品走商店那張 `.store-card`。
 *
 * 這就是 §20 說的那條線：可以共用基礎卡片，但 Offer 資料、購買規則與刷新規則各自獨立 —— 而它們
 * 獨立的地方在 constants/，不在這裡。
 */
function LimitedOfferCard({
  offer,
  rotationId,
  onBuy,
}: {
  offer: LimitedOffer;
  rotationId: string;
  onBuy: (resolved: ResolvedOffer, price: OfferPrice) => void;
}) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const resolved = resolveOffer(offer);
  if (!resolved) return null;

  const bought = getPurchasedCount(profile?.limitedShop, rotationId, offer.id);
  const remaining = remainingAllowance(profile?.limitedShop, rotationId, offer);
  const soldOut = remaining <= 0;
  const isBundle = offer.kind === 'card-bundle';

  const badges = (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
      {/* 一包幾張,排在第一個。§16 要的就是這個:玩家不能以為 450 碎片只買到一張。 */}
      {isBundle && (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-teal text-white text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1">
          <Layers size={10} strokeWidth={3} />× {resolved.quantity} 張
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-gold/12 text-island-navy text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg border border-island-gold/35 flex items-center gap-1">
        <Tent size={10} strokeWidth={3} />
        本檔限定
      </span>
      {/* 返場 —— 這家店最有用的一句話:錯過不是永久的。 */}
      {offer.returning && (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-teal/12 text-island-teal-dark text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg border border-island-teal/25 flex items-center gap-1">
          <History size={10} strokeWidth={3} />
          返場
        </span>
      )}
      {offer.purchaseLimit !== null && (
        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-cream-2 text-island-navy-soft text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg border border-island-line">
          本檔限購 {bought}/{offer.purchaseLimit}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  /* 組合包再用整句話講一次張數。上面的 chip 是給掃過去的眼睛看的,這一段是給真的在讀的人看的
     —— 「本檔組合」四個字也順便說明了為什麼下一檔的張數會不一樣。 */
  const bundleNote = isBundle ? (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-3 py-2">
      <p className="text-xs font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight">
        本檔組合：{resolved.name} × {resolved.quantity} 張
      </p>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 mt-0.5">
        整包販售，購買後一次獲得 {resolved.quantity} 張
      </p>
    </div>
  ) : null;

  const priceRows = (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {offer.prices.map((price) => (
        <PriceRow
          key={price.id}
          price={price}
          quantity={resolved.quantity}
          disabled={soldOut}
          onClick={() => onBuy(resolved, price)}
        />
      ))}
      {soldOut && (
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 text-center">
          本檔已售罄，換檔後再來
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // 功能卡：用共用的卡片元件畫,不是用商品卡(DESIGN_SYSTEM.md:功能卡不是商品)。抽獎券不走這
  // 一條 —— 它在目錄裡是一件真的商品,有自己的 Q 版圖,畫成商品卡才是對的;它跟飾品的差別只在
  // 交付到哪裡,而那件事在 constants/,不在這裡。
  if (resolved.card) {
    return (
      <UtilityCardTile
        card={resolved.card}
        badges={badges}
        aside={bundleNote}
        action={priceRows}
      />
    );
  }

  const item = resolved.item;
  if (!item) return null;

  return (
    <div
      // 稀有度的類名也掛在卡片上,不是只掛在光暈上 —— 整張卡現在就是稀有度本身(見 index.css
      // 的 `.rarity-card`:染色的紙、框內的內襯線、史詩以上的壓紋與沿框走的高光)。
      className={`store-card rarity-card rarity-${resolved.rarity} p-4 rounded-[1.75rem] border flex flex-col cursor-default`}
      style={rarityStyleVars(resolved.rarity)}
    >
      <div className="w-full aspect-[4/3] bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl mb-3 flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden border rarity-well">
        <RarityAura rarity={resolved.rarity} />
        <div className="text-island-navy flex items-center justify-center scale-[0.96] relative">
          <QVersionIcon itemId={item.id} size={110} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <h4 className="text-base font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight leading-tight mb-1.5 truncate">
        {resolved.name}
      </h4>
      {badges}
      {/* 抽獎券這種「是商品、但整包賣」的商品在這裡也要把張數講清楚。飾品沒有 bundleNote,所以
          這一行對它們不會畫任何東西。 */}
      {bundleNote && <div className="mb-2">{bundleNote}</div>}
      <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 text-xs font-bold leading-relaxed mb-3 line-clamp-3">
        {resolved.description}
      </p>

      <div className="mt-auto border-t border-dashed border-island-line pt-3">{priceRows}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 一種付法,做成一顆按鈕。
 *
 * 沒有 `[-] 1 [+]`(§17):商品本身就是一個固定的組合,數量不是玩家的選擇,所以畫面上不該有一個
 * 讓人以為可以選的控制項。按鈕上寫的是「購買此組合」而不是「購買」。
 *
 * 組合包底下多一行「平均每張 ○○」。它不是折扣廣告 —— 它是玩家判斷「這一檔的組合划不划算」唯一
 * 需要的數字,而且正因為價格**不是**單價 × 張數(constants/limitedShop.ts 的 BundlePricing),
 * 這個數字每一檔都不一樣,才值得寫出來。
 */
function PriceRow({
  price,
  quantity,
  disabled,
  onClick,
}: {
  price: OfferPrice;
  quantity: number;
  disabled: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const balance = getBalance(profile, price.currency);
  const cannotAfford = balance < price.amount;
  const isBundle = quantity > 1;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Button
        variant={price.currency === 'coins' ? 'secondary' : 'primary'}
        disabled={disabled || cannotAfford}
        onClick={onClick}
        className="w-full py-2.5 text-sm"
        title={cannotAfford ? '餘額不足' : undefined}
      >
        {price.currency === 'coins' ? (
          <Coins size={15} className="text-island-gold" strokeWidth={2.75} />
        ) : (
          <Gem size={15} strokeWidth={2.75} />
        )}
        <span>{price.amount.toLocaleString()}</span>
        <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-80">{isBundle ? '購買此組合' : '購買'}</span>
      </Button>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60 text-center">
        {isBundle ? `平均每張 ${Math.round(price.amount / quantity).toLocaleString()}` : price.note}
        {isBundle && price.note ? ` · ${price.note}` : ''}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 限時小攤的購買確認。
 *
 * 是 `PurchaseDialog` 的兄弟而不是它裡面的一個分支:那個對話框是繞著一件 `ItemDefinition`、一個
 * 金幣價格、商品碎片路線與稀有度揭示長出來的,而這四件事沒有一件描述得了「一包三張、用碎片買、
 * 本檔限購一次」。兩者共用的是真正重要的那件事 —— **寫入**,一家店一個函數,永遠不是逐張分支。
 */
function LimitedPurchaseDialog({
  resolved,
  price,
  rotationId,
  onClose,
}: {
  resolved: ResolvedOffer;
  price: OfferPrice;
  rotationId: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { profile, buyLimitedOffer } = useApp();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const balance = getBalance(profile, price.currency);
  const after = balance - price.amount;
  const bought = getPurchasedCount(profile?.limitedShop, rotationId, resolved.offer.id);
  const isBundle = resolved.offer.kind === 'card-bundle';

  const confirm = async () => {
    if (busy || done) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    const result: LimitedPurchaseResult = await buyLimitedOffer(resolved.offer.id, price.id);
    setBusy(false);
    if (result === 'ok') {
      setDone(true);
      playSound(SoundEffect.REWARD, 0.4);
      triggerHaptic('medium');
      window.setTimeout(onClose, 900);
      return;
    }
    setError(LIMITED_PURCHASE_MESSAGES[result]);
  };

  return (
    // z-[80]：這一頁本地層級的最上層 —— 見上面的卡牌背包。
    <ModalOverlay zIndexClassName="z-[80]" onClick={onClose}>
      <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-md">
        <PanelHeader
          icon={<Tent size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
          title={isBundle ? '確認購買組合包' : '確認購買'}
          subtitle="限時小攤 · 本檔限定"
          onClose={onClose}
        />

        <div className="p-6 space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div
              className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-island-cream-2 border rarity-well flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0"
              style={rarityStyleVars(resolved.rarity)}
            >
              <RarityAura rarity={resolved.rarity} />
              <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
                {resolved.card ? (
                  <UtilityCardArt card={resolved.card} size={48} />
                ) : resolved.item ? (
                  <div className="scale-[0.5]">
                    <QVersionIcon itemId={resolved.item.id} size={110} />
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight truncate">
                {resolved.name}
                {isBundle && (
                  <span className="text-island-teal-dark"> × {resolved.quantity}</span>
                )}
              </h3>
              {resolved.card ? (
                <UtilityCardMeta card={resolved.card} className="mt-1.5" />
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 mt-1 line-clamp-2">
                  {resolved.description}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 p-4 space-y-2">
            {/* 組合包最上面先講「會拿到幾張」,再講錢。玩家最容易誤會的就是這一格。 */}
            {isBundle && (
              <Row
                label="購買後獲得"
                value={
                  <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-teal-dark">
                    {resolved.name} × {resolved.quantity} 張
                  </span>
                }
              />
            )}
            <Row
              label={isBundle ? '整包價格' : '價格'}
              value={<CurrencyChip amount={price.amount} currency={chipKind(price.currency)} />}
            />
            <Row label="目前持有" value={<CurrencyChip amount={balance} currency={chipKind(price.currency)} />} />
            <Row
              label="購買後"
              value={<CurrencyChip amount={Math.max(0, after)} currency={chipKind(price.currency)} />}
            />
            {resolved.offer.purchaseLimit !== null && (
              <Row
                label="本檔限購"
                value={
                  <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy">
                    {bought}/{resolved.offer.purchaseLimit}
                  </span>
                }
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {error && (
            <p className="text-xs font-black text-island-coral bg-island-coral/10 border border-island-coral/25 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-2.5">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 py-3">
              <X size={16} strokeWidth={2.75} />
              <span>取消</span>
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              disabled={busy || after < 0}
              onClick={confirm}
              className="flex-1 py-3"
            >
              <Check size={16} strokeWidth={2.75} />
              <span>{done ? '已購買' : busy ? '購買中…' : '確認購買'}</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ModalShell>
    </ModalOverlay>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70">{label}</span>
      {value}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/MovementTracker.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Webcam from 'react-webcam';
import { PoseLandmarker, FilesetResolver, Landmark, DrawingUtils } from '@mediapipe/tasks-vision';
import { Button } from './UI/DesignKit';

interface MovementTrackerProps {
  onRepDetected: () => void;
  exerciseType: 'jumping-jacks' | 'squats';
  isActive: boolean;
}

export function MovementTracker({ onRepDetected, exerciseType, isActive }: MovementTrackerProps) {
  const webcamRef = useRef<Webcam>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const poseLandmarkerRef = useRef<PoseLandmarker | null>(null);
  const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const lastStateRef = useRef<'up' | 'down' | 'open' | 'closed'>('closed');
  
  // Exercise Detection Logic
  const detectExercise = (landmarks: Landmark[]) => {
    if (!landmarks || landmarks.length < 33) return;

    // MediaPipe Indices:
    // Left Shoulder: 11, Right Shoulder: 12
    // Left Hip: 23, Right Hip: 24
    // Left Knee: 25, Right Knee: 26
    // Left Wrist: 15, Right Wrist: 16

    if (exerciseType === 'squats') {
      const hipY = (landmarks[23].y + landmarks[24].y) / 2;
      const kneeY = (landmarks[25].y + landmarks[26].y) / 2;
      
      // If hip is close to or below knee, it's a squat "down"
      const currentPos = (kneeY - hipY < 0.15) ? 'down' : 'up';
      
      if (lastStateRef.current === 'up' && currentPos === 'down') {
        lastStateRef.current = 'down';
      } else if (lastStateRef.current === 'down' && currentPos === 'up') {
        lastStateRef.current = 'up';
        onRepDetected();
      }
    } else if (exerciseType === 'jumping-jacks') {
      const leftWristY = landmarks[15].y;
      const rightWristY = landmarks[16].y;
      const eyeY = landmarks[0].y;
      
      // If wrists are above head
      const currentPos = (leftWristY < eyeY && rightWristY < eyeY) ? 'open' : 'closed';
      
      if (lastStateRef.current === 'closed' && currentPos === 'open') {
        lastStateRef.current = 'open';
        onRepDetected();
      } else if (lastStateRef.current === 'open' && currentPos === 'closed') {
        lastStateRef.current = 'closed';
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let animationFrameId: number;

    const setupPoseLandmarker = async () => {
      try {
        const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(
          "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@latest/wasm"
        );
        
        poseLandmarkerRef.current = await PoseLandmarker.createFromOptions(vision, {
          baseOptions: {
            modelAssetPath: "https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task",
            delegate: "GPU"
          },
          runningMode: "VIDEO",
          numPoses: 1
        });
        
        setIsLoaded(true);
        predictWebcam();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to setup MediaPipe PoseLandmarker:", err);
        // If MediaPipe resolver or task fails to load (offline or blocked), fallback gracefully too
        setIsLoaded(true);
      }
    };

    const predictWebcam = async () => {
      if (cameraError) return;
      if (
        poseLandmarkerRef.current &&
        webcamRef.current &&
        webcamRef.current.video?.readyState === 4 &&
        isActive
      ) {
        const video = webcamRef.current.video;
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;
        
        if (canvas) {
          canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
          canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          
          if (ctx) {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            const drawingUtils = new DrawingUtils(ctx);
            const startTimeMs = performance.now();
            const results = poseLandmarkerRef.current.detectForVideo(video, startTimeMs);

            if (results.landmarks && results.landmarks.length > 0) {
              const landmarks = results.landmarks[0];
              detectExercise(landmarks);
              
              // Draw landmarks
              drawingUtils.drawConnectors(landmarks, PoseLandmarker.POSE_CONNECTIONS, {
                color: "#10b981",
                lineWidth: 4
              });
              drawingUtils.drawLandmarks(landmarks, {
                color: "#ffffff",
                lineWidth: 2,
                radius: 4
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
      animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(predictWebcam);
    };

    if (isActive) {
      setupPoseLandmarker();
    }

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
      poseLandmarkerRef.current?.close();
    };
  }, [isActive, exerciseType, cameraError]);

  if (!isActive) return null;

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-full bg-black flex items-center justify-center">
      {!cameraError ? (
        <>
          <Webcam
            ref={webcamRef}
            audio={false}
            className="h-full w-full object-cover mirror"
            videoConstraints={{
              facingMode: "user",
              width: 1280,
              height: 720
            }}
            mirrored={true}
            onUserMediaError={() => {
              setCameraError(true);
              setIsLoaded(true);
            }}
          />
          <canvas
            ref={canvasRef}
            className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover mirror pointer-events-none"
            style={{ transform: 'scaleX(-1)' }}
          />
          {!isLoaded && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-island-teal border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
              <p className="text-white font-bold tracking-widest text-sm uppercase">正在初始化 AI 視覺系統...</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center max-w-lg mx-auto bg-island-navy/90 border border-white/10 rounded-[3rem] shadow-[0_20px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] backdrop-blur-xl">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-island-teal/10 border-2 border-island-teal/30 text-island-teal-light rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
            <svg className="w-10 h-10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M15.75 6a3.75 3.75 0 11-7.5 0 3.75 3.75 0 017.5 0zM4.501 20.118a7.5 7.5 0 0114.998 0A17.933 17.933 0 0112 21.75c-2.676 0-5.216-.584-7.499-1.632z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-white font-black text-2xl mb-2">自主訓練計數模式</h3>
          <p className="text-white/60 text-sm mb-8 leading-relaxed">
            系統未偵測到相機或權限被拒絕。不用擔心！您可以一邊自主運動，一邊點擊下方按鈕手動累計次數，依然能獲得完整的金幣與經驗值獎勵。
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={() => {
              onRepDetected();
            }}
            className="w-full py-5 px-8 text-xl animate-pulse"
          >
            我完成了一次動作！(點擊計數)
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/QVersionIcon.tsx

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Shirt, Shell, Palmtree,
  Anchor, Flower2, Waves, Droplets
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getHouseStyleByItemId, HouseStyleDefinition } from '../constants/houseStyles';
import { getHairSpec } from '../constants/hair';
import { getHatPalette } from '../constants/hats';
import { PANTS_PALETTES, DENIM_RIVET, DENIM_TURNUP } from '../constants/pants';
import { isSpecialCosmeticIcon, SpecialCosmeticIcon } from './SpecialCosmeticIcon';
import { ArtworkIcon, isArtworkIcon } from './ArtworkIcon';
import { PET_SPECS, PetSpec } from '../constants/pets';
import { HIPPO, RABBIT } from '../constants/npcs';
// 抽獎券的圖示認的是目錄裡的 grantsTickets 欄位，不是一個寫死的 id —— 見下面 RaffleTicketIcon。
import { getItemById } from '../constants/items';

/**
 * Flat-art shading derived from one product colour.
 *
 * Shared by the hair and hat thumbnails so neither authors a highlight by hand: an
 * item declares the colour it actually is in 3D, and its readable tints follow. A
 * near-white product has to shade DOWN (a lighter highlight on #e2e8f0 is invisible)
 * and a dark one UP, which is why this keys off luminance rather than being a fixed
 * pair of tints - 黑長直 and 毛帽's white pompom would otherwise need opposite rules.
 */
function shadeFrom(color: string) {
  const rgb = [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(color.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  const luminance = (0.299 * rgb[0] + 0.587 * rgb[1] + 0.114 * rgb[2]) / 255;
  const mix = (amount: number) => {
    const target = luminance > 0.6 ? 0 : 255;
    return `#${rgb.map(c => Math.round(c + (target - c) * amount).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
  };
  return {
    mix,
    /** Top stop of the body gradient. */
    top: mix(0.28),
    /** Primary highlight - gloss, straw lights, knit sheen. */
    shine: mix(0.55),
    /** Secondary lines - stitching, strands. */
    shineSoft: mix(0.3),
    /** Shadowed face, for giving a flat shape thickness. */
    deep: luminance > 0.6 ? mix(0.22) : `#${rgb.map(c => Math.round(c * 0.62).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`,
  };
}

interface QVersionIconProps {
  itemId?: string;
  categoryId?: string;
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Shop/inventory icon for a House Style, built from the same palette and roof silhouette the 3D
 * HouseModel uses. Data-driven on purpose: this file is otherwise a ~100-case exact-id switch,
 * so a new style would silently render the grey fallback box without it.
 */
function HouseStyleIcon({
  style, size, className, strokeColor, strokeWidth,
}: {
  style: HouseStyleDefinition;
  size: number;
  className: string;
  strokeColor: string;
  strokeWidth: string;
}) {
  const c = style.palette;
  const f = style.features ?? {};

  // Roof silhouette per RoofKind, matching HouseModel's shapes.
  const roof = (() => {
    switch (style.roof) {
      case 'thatch':
        return (
          <>
            <path d="M8 34L32 14L56 34H8Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M14 24L32 8L50 24H14Z" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M30 8L32 3L34 8H30Z" fill={c.roof} />
          </>
        );
      case 'slab':
        return (
          <>
            <rect x="6" y="26" width="52" height="7" rx="1.5" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
            <rect x="12" y="19" width="40" height="8" rx="1.5" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
          </>
        );
      case 'hip':
        return (
          <>
            <rect x="5" y="30" width="54" height="4" rx="1.5" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
            <path d="M10 30L32 13L54 30H10Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'gambrel':
        // Barn profile: a steep lower pitch breaking into a shallow upper one. The knuckle is the
        // whole point of the shape, so it is drawn as a visible corner rather than smoothed.
        return (
          <>
            <path d="M6 32L15 21L32 13L49 21L58 32H6Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M15 21L49 21" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="1.6" />
            <line x1="32" y1="13" x2="32" y2="32" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="2" />
          </>
        );
      case 'cottage':
        // A hip, plus the little cross-gable that projects over the door — the one feature that
        // separates 花園小屋 from 海景小屋 at a glance, in the icon as much as in the world.
        return (
          <>
            <rect x="5" y="30" width="54" height="4" rx="1.5" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
            <path d="M10 30L32 14L54 30H10Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M23 33L32 20L41 33H23Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M23 33L32 20L41 33" fill="none" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'pavilion':
        // TWO tiers with daylight between them. The gap is the whole recognition — a single
        // pyramid here would be the `hip` icon in another colour, which is exactly the confusion
        // the model avoids by building this roof in two pieces.
        return (
          <>
            <rect x="2" y="29" width="60" height="4" rx="1.5" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
            <path d="M5 29L32 16L59 29H5Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            {/* the ventilation gap, and the posts holding the cap clear of the skirt */}
            <line x1="14" y1="16" x2="14" y2="12" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.6" />
            <line x1="50" y1="16" x2="50" y2="12" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.6" />
            <rect x="11" y="10" width="42" height="3" rx="1" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.2" />
            <path d="M13 10L32 1L51 10H13Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'dormer':
        // A steeper pitch than `gable`, with the dormer pushed out of its front slope.
        return (
          <>
            <path d="M8 32L32 7L56 32H8Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <line x1="32" y1="7" x2="32" y2="32" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="2" />
            <path d="M20 32L27 21L34 32H20Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <rect x="24" y="26" width="6" height="6" rx="1" fill={c.glass} stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          </>
        );
      case 'flat':
        // No pitch at all — a cantilevered band, a parapet, and the terrace railing. The railing
        // is the part that says "you can stand up there", which is what separates it from `slab`.
        return (
          <>
            <rect x="3" y="27" width="58" height="6" rx="1.5" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
            <rect x="10" y="22" width="44" height="5" rx="1" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.2" />
            <line x1="12" y1="22" x2="12" y2="14" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <line x1="32" y1="22" x2="32" y2="14" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <line x1="52" y1="22" x2="52" y2="14" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <line x1="11" y1="14.5" x2="53" y2="14.5" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'saltbox':
        // Lopsided on purpose: short steep slope on the right, long shallow one sweeping left and
        // ending BELOW the other eave. Every other roof in this switch is symmetric about x = 32.
        return (
          <>
            <path d="M2 36L40 12L60 30H2Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M40 12L60 30" fill="none" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="2" />
            <line x1="14" y1="29" x2="26" y2="21" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'gablefront':
        // The gable TRIANGLE facing you, over a narrow front — a ridge line straight down the
        // middle would be wrong here, because the ridge runs away from the viewer.
        return (
          <>
            <rect x="6" y="30" width="52" height="4" rx="1.5" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.5" />
            <path d="M9 30L32 6L55 30H9Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M15 27L32 10L49 27" fill="none" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <circle cx="32" cy="21" r="2.6" fill={c.roofAccent} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          </>
        );
      default: // 'gable'
        return (
          <>
            <path d="M7 32L32 12L57 32H7Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <line x1="32" y1="12" x2="32" y2="32" stroke={c.roofAccent} strokeWidth="2.5" />
          </>
        );
    }
  })();

  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 64 64" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className={className}>
      {/* Foundation plinth */}
      <rect x="10" y="46" width="44" height="4" rx="1" fill={c.plinth} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
      {/* Wall body */}
      <path d="M12 46V31H52V46H12Z" fill={c.wall} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinejoin="round" />

      {/* Wall treatment */}
      {style.wall === 'timber' && (
        <>
          <line x1="14.5" y1="31" x2="14.5" y2="46" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.5" />
          <line x1="49.5" y1="31" x2="49.5" y2="46" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.5" />
        </>
      )}
      {style.wall === 'masonry' && (
        <>
          <rect x="11" y="35" width="4" height="6" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <rect x="49" y="35" width="4" height="6" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <line x1="12" y1="38" x2="52" y2="38" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.5" />
          <line x1="12" y1="43" x2="52" y2="43" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.5" />
        </>
      )}
      {style.wall === 'plank' && (
        <>
          <line x1="12" y1="36" x2="52" y2="36" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.5" />
          <line x1="12" y1="41" x2="52" y2="41" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.5" />
        </>
      )}
      {/* Vertical poles with two lashing bands. Round caps, because what says "bamboo" rather than
          "fence" is the cylinder — the same read the model buys with 6-sided cylinders. */}
      {style.wall === 'bamboo' && (
        <>
          {[14.5, 19, 23.5, 28, 36, 40.5, 45, 49.5].map((x) => (
            <line key={x} x1={x} y1="31" x2={x} y2="46" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
          ))}
          <line x1="12" y1="35" x2="52" y2="35" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="2" />
          <line x1="12" y1="44" x2="52" y2="44" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="2" />
        </>
      )}
      {/* Board-and-batten: the seams run UP, which is the one thing that has to survive being
          shrunk to 64px — it is the whole difference from `plank`. */}
      {style.wall === 'batten' && (
        <>
          {[16, 21, 26, 38, 43, 48].map((x) => (
            <line key={x} x1={x} y1="32" x2={x} y2="45" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.8" />
          ))}
          <rect x="11" y="44" width="42" height="2.5" fill={c.frame} />
        </>
      )}
      {/* Two reveal joints and one accent bay. Nothing else — a modern rendered wall is
          recognised by how LITTLE is drawn on it. */}
      {style.wall === 'panel' && (
        <>
          <line x1="24" y1="31" x2="24" y2="46" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <line x1="44" y1="31" x2="44" y2="46" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <rect x="12" y="31" width="6" height="15" fill={c.trim} />
          <rect x="12" y="44.5" width="40" height="1.6" fill={c.frame} />
        </>
      )}
      {/* Staggered shake courses. The offset between rows is the read; a grid would be tile. */}
      {style.wall === 'shingle' && (
        <>
          {[33.5, 37.5, 41.5, 45].map((y, row) => (
            <g key={y}>
              {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
                <rect
                  key={i}
                  x={12 + i * 6.7 + (row % 2) * 3.35}
                  y={y - 3.4}
                  width="6"
                  height="3.6"
                  rx="1.2"
                  fill={row % 2 === 0 ? c.trim : c.plinth}
                  stroke={strokeColor}
                  strokeWidth="0.7"
                />
              ))}
            </g>
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {/* Round-capped courses that run PAST the wall on both sides — the notched corner that
          alternate log courses make, which is how the model reads a log cabin too. */}
      {style.wall === 'log' && (
        <>
          {[33.5, 37.5, 41.5, 45].map((y, i) => (
            <line
              key={y}
              x1={i % 2 === 0 ? 10 : 12}
              y1={y}
              x2={i % 2 === 0 ? 54 : 52}
              y2={y}
              stroke={i % 2 === 0 ? c.trim : c.plinth}
              strokeWidth="3.4"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
          ))}
        </>
      )}

      {roof}
      {f.chimney && <rect x="41" y="8" width="6" height="11" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.2" />}

      {/* Side window */}
      <rect x="16" y="35" width="8" height="8" rx="1" fill={c.glass} stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.5" />
      <line x1="20" y1="35" x2="20" y2="43" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1" />
      <line x1="16" y1="39" x2="24" y2="39" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1" />
      {f.windowFlowerBox && (
        <>
          <rect x="15" y="43" width="10" height="3" rx="1" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <circle cx="20" cy="42.5" r="1.6" fill="#F87171" />
        </>
      )}

      {/* Door */}
      <path d="M27 46V37C27 35.5 29 34.5 32 34.5C35 34.5 37 35.5 37 37V46H27Z" fill={c.door} stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
      <circle cx="34.8" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#D4A017" />

      {f.doorPlanter && (
        <>
          <path d="M42 42h5v4h-5z" fill="#E7DCCA" stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <circle cx="44.5" cy="40" r="3" fill="#4D7C0F" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.firewood && (
        <>
          <circle cx="42.5" cy="44.5" r="1.8" fill={c.frame} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <circle cx="46.5" cy="44.5" r="1.8" fill={c.frame} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.fence && (
        <>
          <line x1="4" y1="47" x2="4" y2="53" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          <line x1="10" y1="47" x2="10" y2="53" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          <line x1="54" y1="47" x2="54" y2="53" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          <line x1="60" y1="47" x2="60" y2="53" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.stilts && (
        <>
          <rect x="15" y="50" width="4" height="6" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <rect x="45" y="50" width="4" height="6" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.shutters && (
        <>
          <rect x="13" y="35" width="2.6" height="8" rx="0.8" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <rect x="24.4" y="35" width="2.6" height="8" rx="0.8" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.porch && (
        <>
          <rect x="24" y="33" width="16" height="2.6" rx="1" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <line x1="25.2" y1="35.6" x2="25.2" y2="46" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" />
          <line x1="38.8" y1="35.6" x2="38.8" y2="46" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="2" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.lantern && (
        <>
          <line x1="40" y1="36" x2="43" y2="36" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <rect x="41.6" y="36" width="3.4" height="4" rx="0.8" fill={c.glass} stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.2" />
        </>
      )}
      {f.barrel && (
        <>
          <rect x="6" y="39" width="5.5" height="7" rx="1.4" fill={c.frame} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <line x1="6" y1="42.5" x2="11.5" y2="42.5" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.2" />
        </>
      )}
      {/* 小型陽台 — deck line, handrail and balusters, over the door where the model puts it. */}
      {f.balcony && (
        <>
          <rect x="25" y="32.5" width="14" height="2" rx="0.8" fill={c.trim} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" />
          <line x1="25" y1="29" x2="39" y2="29" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" />
          {[26.5, 30, 33.5, 37].map((x) => (
            <line key={x} x1={x} y1="29" x2={x} y2="32.5" stroke={c.trim} strokeWidth="1.1" />
          ))}
        </>
      )}
      {/* 小型遮雨棚 over the side window. */}
      {f.awning && (
        <path d="M14 34.5h12l1.5 -3h-15Z" fill={c.roof} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      )}
      {/* Floats on a line — the one place a house icon carries colours that are not its palette,
          because a float that matched the wall would not be a float. */}
      {f.floats && (
        <>
          <path d="M40 34 q5 3 10 0" fill="none" stroke={c.frame} strokeWidth="1.1" />
          <circle cx="42" cy="37" r="2.2" fill="#E8734A" stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="0.9" />
          <circle cx="46" cy="38.4" r="2.2" fill="#4A90A4" stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="0.9" />
          <circle cx="50" cy="37" r="2.2" fill="#E8C34A" stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="0.9" />
        </>
      )}
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   TROUSERS (下裝 / `pants-*`)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Drawn front-on and flat, the way a pair is laid out on a table.

   TWO THINGS THIS FIXES, and they are related.

   1. The legs were two SEPARATE boxes with a gap down the middle and a bar
      balanced on top — a garment sliced in half. Trousers are one piece of
      cloth: the legs part at the crotch and are joined everywhere above it.
      So the silhouette here is a SINGLE closed path, and the split between the
      legs is a notch cut up into it, not a space between two shapes. Because
      the path is generated rather than hand-typed five times, the legs cannot
      come apart again — there is one outline and it has no gap in it.

   2. All five cuts shared that one shape and differed only by fill colour and
      a 2px width change, so 直筒 / 錐形 / 寬褲 / 窄管 / 工裝 were the same
      picture in five colours. What actually distinguishes these cuts is the
      SILHOUETTE — "tapered" literally means wide at the hip and narrow at the
      ankle — so that is what {@link TrouserShape} parameterises: half-widths
      measured at the waist, hip, knee and hem. Colour and trim (pockets,
      pleats, cuffs, drape folds) then sit on top of a shape that already reads,
      the same rule the shoe icons below follow. */

/** Y stations every cut shares, so a row of trousers in the shop grid lines up. */
const TROUSER_WAIST_Y = 14;
const TROUSER_HIP_Y = 25;
const TROUSER_CROTCH_Y = 31;
// The knee sits partway down the leg rather than at a fixed offset from the crotch, so lengthening
// the leg below stretches the thigh and the shin together instead of leaving a stumpy thigh over a
// long shin.
const TROUSER_KNEE_Y = 42.6;
// Long enough that the leg, not the waistband, is what the eye reads first. The hem is as low as
// the 64-box allows: below it there is only the ground shadow, whose own Y is derived from this
// one so the two move together.
const TROUSER_HEM_Y = 60;

/** Half-widths of the garment, measured out from the centre line at each station. */
interface TrouserShape {
  waistHalf: number;
  hipHalf: number;
  /** Outer/inner edge of one leg at the knee. Their difference is the leg's width there. */
  kneeOuter: number;
  kneeInner: number;
  hemOuter: number;
  hemInner: number;
}

/**
 * A run between two points that leaves BOTH of them vertically — the shape of a seam falling
 * under its own weight. Every segment of the outline is one, which is what keeps the silhouette
 * reading as cloth instead of as a polygon.
 */
function seam(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): string {
  const t = (y2 - y1) * 0.45;
  return `C${x1} ${y1 + t} ${x2} ${y2 - t} ${x2} ${y2}`;
}

/**
 * The whole garment as one closed path: down the left side, down the left leg's outer edge,
 * across its hem, back UP the inseam to the crotch, then mirrored down the right. The crotch is
 * the single point where the two inseams meet — above it the trousers are one body.
 */
function trouserOutline(s: TrouserShape): string {
  const L = (v: number) => 32 - v;
  const R = (v: number) => 32 + v;
  return [
    `M${L(s.waistHalf)} ${TROUSER_WAIST_Y}`,
    seam(L(s.waistHalf), TROUSER_WAIST_Y, L(s.hipHalf), TROUSER_HIP_Y),
    seam(L(s.hipHalf), TROUSER_HIP_Y, L(s.kneeOuter), TROUSER_KNEE_Y),
    seam(L(s.kneeOuter), TROUSER_KNEE_Y, L(s.hemOuter), TROUSER_HEM_Y),
    `L${L(s.hemInner)} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y}`,
    seam(L(s.hemInner), TROUSER_HEM_Y, L(s.kneeInner), TROUSER_KNEE_Y),
    seam(L(s.kneeInner), TROUSER_KNEE_Y, 32, TROUSER_CROTCH_Y),
    seam(32, TROUSER_CROTCH_Y, R(s.kneeInner), TROUSER_KNEE_Y),
    seam(R(s.kneeInner), TROUSER_KNEE_Y, R(s.hemInner), TROUSER_HEM_Y),
    `L${R(s.hemOuter)} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y}`,
    seam(R(s.hemOuter), TROUSER_HEM_Y, R(s.kneeOuter), TROUSER_KNEE_Y),
    seam(R(s.kneeOuter), TROUSER_KNEE_Y, R(s.hipHalf), TROUSER_HIP_Y),
    seam(R(s.hipHalf), TROUSER_HIP_Y, R(s.waistHalf), TROUSER_WAIST_Y),
    'Z',
  ].join('');
}

interface TrouserCut {
  shape: TrouserShape;
  /** Main cloth, its shaded side, the waistband, and the topstitching/trim colour. */
  body: string;
  shade: string;
  band: string;
  stitch: string;
}

/**
 * One entry per `pants-*` id. The numbers ARE the description in constants/items.ts:
 * 直筒 keeps one width top to bottom, 錐形 is roomy at the hip and closes to the ankle,
 * 寬褲 opens out below the knee, 窄管 hugs all the way down, 工裝 is straight-ish but bulkier
 * than the classic cut because of what it is carrying.
 *
 * 牛仔 is the odd one out: its shape is near enough to 直筒's that the numbers alone would put two
 * blue trousers side by side in the 下裝 grid. What separates it is the CLOTH — raw indigo instead
 * of a washed mid-blue, orange thread instead of tan, copper rivets, and a turn-up at the hem — so
 * its detail branch carries more of the work than the others' do.
 *
 * COLOUR IS NO LONGER AUTHORED HERE. It comes from constants/pants.ts, for the same reason the
 * hats read theirs from constants/hats.ts, and the trousers needed it more: the 3D garment had
 * its own copy of this palette and five of the six cuts disagreed with the drawing below. A
 * player could buy the near-white 寬褲 in this grid and walk away in a dark slate pair. Only the
 * SHAPE is still authored at both ends, because these numbers are an SVG box describing both
 * legs at once and the 3D lathes one leg out of radii in metres - see the note in pants.ts.
 */
const TROUSER_CUTS: Record<string, TrouserCut> = {
  straight: {
    shape: { waistHalf: 12.5, hipHalf: 14, kneeOuter: 13, kneeInner: 3.2, hemOuter: 12.5, hemInner: 3 },
    ...PANTS_PALETTES.straight,
  },
  tapered: {
    shape: { waistHalf: 12.5, hipHalf: 16, kneeOuter: 14, kneeInner: 3.2, hemOuter: 10, hemInner: 3.4 },
    ...PANTS_PALETTES.tapered,
  },
  wide: {
    shape: { waistHalf: 12, hipHalf: 15, kneeOuter: 17.5, kneeInner: 3, hemOuter: 21, hemInner: 2.6 },
    ...PANTS_PALETTES.wide,
  },
  skinny: {
    shape: { waistHalf: 11.5, hipHalf: 12.8, kneeOuter: 9.5, kneeInner: 3, hemOuter: 7.6, hemInner: 3 },
    ...PANTS_PALETTES.skinny,
  },
  cargo: {
    shape: { waistHalf: 13, hipHalf: 15.5, kneeOuter: 14.5, kneeInner: 3.2, hemOuter: 13.5, hemInner: 3.2 },
    ...PANTS_PALETTES.cargo,
  },
  denim: {
    // Heavier than 直筒 everywhere and cut dead straight from the knee down, the way a rigid
    // 14oz leg hangs off the hip instead of following the thigh.
    shape: { waistHalf: 12.8, hipHalf: 15, kneeOuter: 13.6, kneeInner: 3.2, hemOuter: 13.6, hemInner: 3 },
    ...PANTS_PALETTES.denim,
  },
};

function TrouserIcon({
  cut: cutId, size, className, strokeColor, strokeWidth,
}: {
  cut: string;
  size: number;
  className: string;
  strokeColor: string;
  strokeWidth: string;
}) {
  const cut = TROUSER_CUTS[cutId] ?? TROUSER_CUTS.straight;
  const { shape: s, body, shade, band, stitch } = cut;

  // Centre line of one leg at the knee and at the hem. Detail is placed off these rather than
  // off typed-in coordinates, so a cut's pockets and cuffs follow its own leg instead of
  // drifting off the narrow ones and outside the wide one.
  const legMidKnee = (s.kneeOuter + s.kneeInner) / 2;
  const legMidHem = (s.hemOuter + s.hemInner) / 2;
  const hemBandY = TROUSER_HEM_Y - 3.6;

  const detail = (() => {
    switch (cutId) {
      case 'tapered':
        return (
          <>
            {/* Pleats falling from the waistband — the roomy front that makes the cut */}
            <path d={`M${32 - 5.5} 19.5C${32 - 6} 24 ${32 - 5.4} 27.5 ${32 - 4.6} 30`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d={`M${32 + 5.5} 19.5C${32 + 6} 24 ${32 + 5.4} 27.5 ${32 + 4.6} 30`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" />
            {/* Slanted side pockets */}
            <path d={`M${32 - s.hipHalf + 1.6} 19.4L${32 - s.hipHalf + 6.4} 25.6`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d={`M${32 + s.hipHalf - 1.6} 19.4L${32 + s.hipHalf - 6.4} 25.6`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            {/* Turn-ups. A cuff is the giveaway detail of a carrot/tapered trouser. */}
            <path d={`M${32 - s.hemOuter + 0.5} ${hemBandY}H${32 - s.hemInner - 0.5}`} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d={`M${32 + s.hemOuter - 0.5} ${hemBandY}H${32 + s.hemInner + 0.5}`} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d={`M${32 - legMidHem} ${hemBandY + 1.4}v2.4M${32 + legMidHem} ${hemBandY + 1.4}v2.4`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'wide':
        return (
          <>
            {/* Drape folds instead of pockets: what you notice about a wide leg is the cloth
                moving, so the panel is left clean and the folds carry it. */}
            <path d={`M${32 - 9} 22C${32 - 11} 32 ${32 - 13} 42 ${32 - 14.5} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 1}`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.75" />
            <path d={`M${32 - 5} 26C${32 - 6} 35 ${32 - 6.6} 44 ${32 - 7} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 1}`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.55" />
            <path d={`M${32 + 9} 22C${32 + 11} 32 ${32 + 13} 42 ${32 + 14.5} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 1}`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.75" />
            <path d={`M${32 + 5} 26C${32 + 6} 35 ${32 + 6.6} 44 ${32 + 7} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 1}`} stroke={shade} strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.55" />
            {/* Drawstring waist rather than a belt — this is a soft, pull-on trouser */}
            <path d="M29 18.6C29 21.4 28.2 23 26.8 24.6" stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d="M35 18.6C35 21.4 35.8 23 37.2 24.6" stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <circle cx="32" cy="18.2" r="2" fill={stitch} stroke={strokeColor} strokeWidth="1.6" />
          </>
        );
      case 'skinny':
        return (
          <>
            {/* A sheen down each leg. On near-black cloth the highlight is the only thing that
                shows how closely the leg is following the body. */}
            <path d={`M${32 - legMidKnee - 1.4} 27C${32 - legMidKnee - 1.6} 36 ${32 - legMidHem - 1.2} 45 ${32 - legMidHem - 1} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 2}`} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.14" />
            <path d={`M${32 + legMidKnee + 1.4} 27C${32 + legMidKnee + 1.6} 36 ${32 + legMidHem + 1.2} 45 ${32 + legMidHem + 1} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 2}`} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.14" />
            {/* Back pockets at the seat */}
            <path d={`M${32 - 9.5} 21.5h6.4v4.2h-6.4zM${32 + 3.1} 21.5h6.4v4.2h-6.4z`} stroke={stitch} strokeWidth="1.3" fill="none" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            {/* Ankle zips — the detail that says the hem is too narrow to get a foot through */}
            <path d={`M${32 - legMidHem} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 5.6}v4.6M${32 + legMidHem} ${TROUSER_HEM_Y - 5.6}v4.6`} stroke={stitch} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </>
        );
      case 'denim':
        return (
          <>
            {/* Whiskering: the pale creases worn in at the hip by sitting down. On indigo this is
                the first thing that says "denim" rather than "blue trousers". */}
            {[-1, 1].map((sideSign) => (
              <g key={sideSign} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeLinecap="round" fill="none">
                <path d={`M${32 + sideSign * 2.6} 25.4C${32 + sideSign * 6} 25 ${32 + sideSign * 8.6} 25.6 ${32 + sideSign * 10.6} 26.8`} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.28" />
                <path d={`M${32 + sideSign * 2.8} 28.8C${32 + sideSign * 6} 28.6 ${32 + sideSign * 8.4} 29.2 ${32 + sideSign * 10} 30.4`} strokeWidth="1.3" opacity="0.2" />
              </g>
            ))}
            {/* Faded knees, where the leg bends the cloth open every day. Soft and wide — a hard
                edge here reads as a patch sewn on rather than as wear. */}
            <path d={`M${32 - legMidKnee} ${TROUSER_KNEE_Y - 2.2}q0 2.6 0 4.4`} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="8" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.06" />
            <path d={`M${32 + legMidKnee} ${TROUSER_KNEE_Y - 2.2}q0 2.6 0 4.4`} stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="8" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.06" />

            {/* Five-pocket front in orange thread, with a rivet at each corner — the bar-tack
                hardware the whole garment was patented around. The opening is kept short and
                steep: swept any further across the hip it stops reading as a pocket and starts
                reading as a brace strap. */}
            {[-1, 1].map((sideSign) => {
              const openTop = 32 + sideSign * (s.waistHalf - 1.6);
              const openEnd = 32 + sideSign * (s.waistHalf - 6.4);
              return (
                <g key={sideSign}>
```
