```tsx
  const allShapes = collectHouseShapes(rooms, margin);

  // Check if (x, z) is already inside any square or doorway
  for (const shape of allShapes) {
    if (x >= shape.xmin && x <= shape.xmax && z >= shape.zmin && z <= shape.zmax) {
      return { x, z };
    }
  }

  // If not inside, find the closest point among all shapes
  let minD2 = Infinity;
  let closestX = x;
  let closestZ = z;

  allShapes.forEach((shape) => {
    const clampX = Math.max(shape.xmin, Math.min(shape.xmax, x));
    const clampZ = Math.max(shape.zmin, Math.min(shape.zmax, z));
    const dx = x - clampX;
    const dz = z - clampZ;
    const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    if (d2 < minD2) {
      minD2 = d2;
      closestX = clampX;
      closestZ = clampZ;
    }
  });

  return { x: closestX, z: closestZ };
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls } from '@react-three/drei';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View, CameraMode } from '../../types';
import { parseUnlockedRooms, ROOM_GRID_SIZE, ROOM_HALF_SIZE } from '../../constants/rooms';
import { FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM } from '../../constants/cameraZoom';

interface CameraRigProps {
  minDistance?: number;
  maxDistance?: number;
  minPolarAngle?: number;
  maxPolarAngle?: number;
  isBuildMode?: boolean;
}

const SECOND_PERSON_POS_ISLAND = new THREE.Vector3(15, 8, 15);
const SECOND_PERSON_POS_INTERIOR = new THREE.Vector3(8, 4, 8);

export function CameraRig({ 
  minDistance = 4.5, 
  maxDistance = 18,
  minPolarAngle = Math.PI / 10,
  maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2.1,
  isBuildMode = false
}: CameraRigProps) {
  const { camera, scene, gl } = useThree();
  const controlsRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const { joystickData, orbitJoystickData, uiScale, setUiScale, currentView, cameraMode, profile } = useApp();
  const raycaster = useRef(new THREE.Raycaster());
  const prevBuildMode = React.useRef(isBuildMode);
  const idealCamPosRef = React.useRef<THREE.Vector3 | null>(null);
  const wasFirstPersonRef = React.useRef(false);
  const lastTargetRef = React.useRef<THREE.Vector3 | null>(null);
  
  const keysRef = React.useRef({ w: false, a: false, s: false, d: false });

  const lastActiveRoomIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  const transitionProgressRef = React.useRef<number>(1.0); // 1.0 means transition complete
  const transitionStartCamPos = React.useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3());
  const transitionStartTarget = React.useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3());

  const ensurePolyfills = (controls: any) => {
    if (!controls) return;
    if (!controls.setPolarAngle) {
      controls.setPolarAngle = (angle: number) => {
        const target = controls.target;
        const offset = camera.position.clone().sub(target);
        const spherical = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(offset);
        spherical.phi = angle;
        offset.setFromSpherical(spherical);
        camera.position.copy(target).add(offset);
      };
    }
    if (!controls.setAzimuthalAngle) {
      controls.setAzimuthalAngle = (angle: number) => {
        const target = controls.target;
        const offset = camera.position.clone().sub(target);
        const spherical = new THREE.Spherical().setFromVector3(offset);
        spherical.theta = angle;
        offset.setFromSpherical(spherical);
        camera.position.copy(target).add(offset);
      };
    }
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      if (currentView !== View.HOME && currentView !== View.BUILDING_INTERIOR) {
        return;
      }
      
      // Let scrollable containers handle wheel events naturally
      let target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      while (target && target !== document.body) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(target);
        if (
          target.scrollHeight > target.clientHeight ||
          target.scrollWidth > target.clientWidth ||
          style.overflowY === 'auto' ||
          style.overflowY === 'scroll' ||
          style.overflowX === 'auto' ||
          style.overflowX === 'scroll' ||
          target.classList.contains('overflow-y-auto') ||
          target.classList.contains('overflow-x-auto') ||
          target.classList.contains('custom-scrollbar') ||
          target.classList.contains('no-scrollbar') ||
          target.classList.contains('custom-scrollbar-brown')
        ) {
          return;
        }
        target = target.parentElement;
      }

      e.preventDefault();
      const zoomDir = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1;
      const step = 0.05;
      setUiScale((prev: number) => {
        const next = prev + zoomDir * step;
        return Math.max(0.5, Math.min(next, 2.0));
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('wheel', handleWheel);
    };
  }, [currentView, setUiScale]);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const key = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if (key === 'w' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') keysRef.current.w = true;
      if (key === 's' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') keysRef.current.s = true;
      if (key === 'a' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keysRef.current.a = true;
      if (key === 'd' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') keysRef.current.d = true;
    };
    const handleKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const key = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if (key === 'w' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') keysRef.current.w = false;
      if (key === 's' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') keysRef.current.s = false;
      if (key === 'a' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keysRef.current.a = false;
      if (key === 'd' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') keysRef.current.d = false;
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
    };
  }, []);
  
  React.useEffect(() => {
    ensurePolyfills(controlsRef.current);
    idealCamPosRef.current = null;
    if (controlsRef.current) {
      const isInterior = currentView === View.BUILDING_INTERIOR;
      
      if (isInterior) {
        if (isBuildMode && !prevBuildMode.current) {
          console.log("[CameraRig] Transitioning to build/edit mode. Seeding high diagonal bird's-eye angle.");
          const playerPos = (window as any).playerPos as THREE.Vector3 | undefined;
          const targetPoint = playerPos ? playerPos.clone() : new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0);
          
          controlsRef.current.target.copy(targetPoint);
          // Set diagonal elevated angle (X offset: ~1 unit, Y height: ~11 units, Z offset: ~13 units)
          const highOffset = new THREE.Vector3(1, 11, 13);
          camera.position.copy(targetPoint).add(highOffset);
          
          controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(Math.PI / 4.5); // High diagonal look-down angle (~40 degrees)
          controlsRef.current.minDistance = 1.0;
          controlsRef.current.maxDistance = 50.0;
          controlsRef.current.update();
        } else if (!isBuildMode) {
          console.log("[CameraRig] Centering camera inside BUILDING_INTERIOR dynamically to prevent blocked perspective.");
          const playerPos = (window as any).playerPos as THREE.Vector3 | undefined;
          if (playerPos) {
            const targetPoint = new THREE.Vector3(playerPos.x, playerPos.y + 1.8, playerPos.z);
            controlsRef.current.target.copy(targetPoint);
            
            const cameraOffset = new THREE.Vector3(0, 3.5, 3.5);
            camera.position.copy(targetPoint).add(cameraOffset);
          }
          
          controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(Math.PI / 3); // 60-degree angle
          controlsRef.current.minDistance = 0.5;
          controlsRef.current.maxDistance = 5.5;
          controlsRef.current.update();
        }
      }
    }
    prevBuildMode.current = isBuildMode;
  }, [currentView, cameraMode, camera, isBuildMode]);
  
  useFrame((state, delta) => {
    ensurePolyfills(controlsRef.current);
    const playerPos = (window as any).playerPos as THREE.Vector3 | undefined;
    if (playerPos && controlsRef.current) {
      const isInterior = currentView === View.BUILDING_INTERIOR;
      const isDressing = currentView === View.DRESSING_ROOM;
      let currentFocusY = 1.8;
      const baseHeadHeight = isInterior ? (0.68 * 1.35) : (0.68 * 2.25);
      if (!isBuildMode && uiScale > 1.5) {
        const t = (uiScale - 1.5) / 0.5;
        currentFocusY = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(1.8, baseHeadHeight, t);
      }
      const targetPoint = new THREE.Vector3(playerPos.x, playerPos.y + currentFocusY, playerPos.z);

      // Shift camera and OrbitControls target by the targetPoint translation delta
      // to keep relative camera offset 100% stable during player translation,
      // especially in first person where the offset is tiny and prone to wild rotation.
      if (lastTargetRef.current && !isBuildMode && !isDressing) {
        const deltaTranslation = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(targetPoint, lastTargetRef.current);
        camera.position.add(deltaTranslation);
        controlsRef.current.target.add(deltaTranslation);
      }
      lastTargetRef.current = targetPoint.clone();

      const roomsList = parseUnlockedRooms(profile?.interiorData?.unlockedRooms);
      
      // Determine the active room and handle smooth room transitions
      let activeRoom = roomsList[0];
      if (isInterior) {
        const refPos = isBuildMode ? controlsRef.current.target.clone() : targetPoint.clone();
        const detectedActive = getActiveRoom(refPos.x, refPos.z, roomsList);
        if (detectedActive) {
          activeRoom = detectedActive;
        }

        // Detect if active room changed to trigger seamless 0.2-0.4s glide transition
        if (lastActiveRoomIdRef.current === null) {
          lastActiveRoomIdRef.current = activeRoom.id;
        } else if (lastActiveRoomIdRef.current !== activeRoom.id) {
          lastActiveRoomIdRef.current = activeRoom.id;
          transitionProgressRef.current = 0.0;
          transitionStartCamPos.current.copy(camera.position);
          transitionStartTarget.current.copy(controlsRef.current.target);
        }

        // Progress transition factor smoothly
        const transitionDuration = 0.35; // 0.35 seconds
        if (transitionProgressRef.current < 1.0) {
          transitionProgressRef.current = Math.min(1.0, transitionProgressRef.current + delta / transitionDuration);
        }
      }
      
      if (!isBuildMode && cameraMode !== CameraMode.SECOND_PERSON && uiScale < FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM) {
        if (idealCamPosRef.current) {
          camera.position.copy(idealCamPosRef.current);
        }
      }
      
      if (isDressing) {
        // 更衣室視角：極近距離，專注於角色
        const targetDist = 2.5;
        const targetPointAdjusted = new THREE.Vector3(playerPos.x, playerPos.y + 1.2, playerPos.z);
        
        controlsRef.current.minDistance = 2.5;
        controlsRef.current.maxDistance = 2.5;
        controlsRef.current.target.lerp(targetPointAdjusted, 0.45);
        
        // 允許環繞旋轉預覽角色
        if (orbitJoystickData && (Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.y) > 0.01)) {
          const orbitSpeed = 4.0;
          const currentAzimuth = controlsRef.current.getAzimuthalAngle();
          controlsRef.current.setAzimuthalAngle(currentAzimuth - orbitJoystickData.x * orbitSpeed * delta);
        }
        
        controlsRef.current.update();
      } else if (isInterior && isBuildMode) {
        // 編輯模式：改由使用者自由控制、旋轉、平移、縮放視角。這裡不執行強行跟隨玩家或限制 min/max 距離
        const front = new THREE.Vector3();
        camera.getWorldDirection(front);
        
        const right = new THREE.Vector3();
        right.crossVectors(front, camera.up).normalize();
        
        front.y = 0;
        front.normalize();
        right.y = 0;
        right.normalize();
        
        const moveDir = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0);
        if (keysRef.current.w) moveDir.add(front);
        if (keysRef.current.s) moveDir.sub(front);
        if (keysRef.current.a) moveDir.sub(right);
        if (keysRef.current.d) moveDir.add(right);
        
        if (joystickData && (Math.abs(joystickData.x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(joystickData.y) > 0.01)) {
          const joyRightVec = right.clone().multiplyScalar(joystickData.x);
          const joyFrontVec = front.clone().multiplyScalar(joystickData.y);
          moveDir.add(joyRightVec).add(joyFrontVec);
        }
        
        if (moveDir.lengthSq() > 0) {
          moveDir.normalize();
          // Navigation speed is optimized and halved for precise build mode movement
          const speed = 2.5; 
          const translation = moveDir.multiplyScalar(speed * delta);
          
          controlsRef.current.target.add(translation);
          camera.position.add(translation);
        }
        
        // 編輯模式下的視野縮放連動
        const buildTargetFov = 55.0 / uiScale;
        if (camera instanceof THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
          camera.fov = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.fov, buildTargetFov, 0.1);
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        }
        
        // Control horizontal orbit rotation in decoration mode using the orbit joystick (on mobile, locked horizontally):
        if (orbitJoystickData && (Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.y) > 0.01)) {
          const orbitSpeed = 2.0; // Halved for steady rotation
          const currentAzimuth = controlsRef.current.getAzimuthalAngle();
          controlsRef.current.setAzimuthalAngle(currentAzimuth - orbitJoystickData.x * orbitSpeed * delta);
          
          // Fixed vertical polar angle to ensure stable horizontal-only view
          controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(Math.PI / 4.5);
        }
        
        // Keep target strictly inside the house boundaries to restrict view area (margin = 0.4)
        const tgtClamped = clampPointToHouse(controlsRef.current.target.x, controlsRef.current.target.z, roomsList, 0.4);
        controlsRef.current.target.x = tgtClamped.x;
        controlsRef.current.target.z = tgtClamped.z;
        controlsRef.current.target.y = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(3.0, controlsRef.current.target.y));

        // Keep camera strictly inside the active room boundaries (margin = 0.5)
        const camClamped = clampPointToHouse(camera.position.x, camera.position.z, [activeRoom], 0.5);
        const targetCamPos = new THREE.Vector3(camClamped.x, Math.max(0.4, Math.min(4.45, camera.position.y)), camClamped.z);

        // Apply transition interpolation if active in build mode!
        if (transitionProgressRef.current < 1.0 && transitionStartCamPos.current.lengthSq() > 0) {
          const clampedStartCamPos = transitionStartCamPos.current.clone();
          const clampedStartCamXZ = clampPointToHouse(clampedStartCamPos.x, clampedStartCamPos.z, [activeRoom], 0.5);
          clampedStartCamPos.x = clampedStartCamXZ.x;
          clampedStartCamPos.z = clampedStartCamXZ.z;
          clampedStartCamPos.y = Math.max(0.40, Math.min(4.45, clampedStartCamPos.y));

          const progress = transitionProgressRef.current;
          const easeProgress = progress < 0.5 ? 4 * progress * progress * progress : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 3) / 2;

          const lerpedCamPos = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(clampedStartCamPos, targetCamPos, easeProgress);
          camera.position.copy(lerpedCamPos);
        } else {
          camera.position.copy(targetCamPos);
        }

        controlsRef.current.update();
      } else if (cameraMode === CameraMode.SECOND_PERSON) {
        // 第一人稱視角 (射擊遊戲風格)：極近距離 (角色眼睛位置)
        const targetDist = 0.01;
        const targetPointAdjusted = new THREE.Vector3(playerPos.x, playerPos.y + 1.65, playerPos.z);
        
        controlsRef.current.minDistance = 0.01;
        controlsRef.current.maxDistance = 0.01;
        controlsRef.current.target.lerp(targetPointAdjusted, 0.45);

        // 第一人稱下的視野縮放連動
        const fpTargetFov = 60.0 / uiScale;
        if (camera instanceof THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
          camera.fov = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.fov, fpTargetFov, 0.1);
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        }

        // 允許室內旋轉（只在手動使用搖桿或滑鼠拖曳時旋轉方向，移動時不自動強行跟隨旋轉）
        const hasJoystickInput = orbitJoystickData && (Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.y) > 0.01);
        if (hasJoystickInput) {
          const orbitSpeed = 2.4; 
          const currentAzimuth = controlsRef.current.getAzimuthalAngle();
          controlsRef.current.setAzimuthalAngle(currentAzimuth - orbitJoystickData.x * orbitSpeed * delta);
          
          const polarSpeed = 1.8; 
          const currentPolar = controlsRef.current.getPolarAngle();
          const nextPolar = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            currentPolar + orbitJoystickData.y * polarSpeed * delta,
            Math.PI / 6, 
            Math.PI / 1.2
          );
          controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(nextPolar);
        }
      } else {
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // UNIFIED PLAY SYSTEM (Indoors & Outdoors)
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        
        // Map uiScale to camera distance to zoom the view seamlessly 
        const t = uiScale > 1.5 ? (uiScale - 1.5) / 0.5 : 0;
        const targetDist = uiScale > 1.5
          ? THREE.MathUtils.lerp(7.0 / 1.5, 0.001, t)
          : 7.0 / uiScale;

        if (uiScale >= FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM) {
          // First-person play mode
          if (!wasFirstPersonRef.current) {
            const charRot = (window as any).playerRotation !== undefined ? (window as any).playerRotation : 0;
            // OrbitControls azimuth angle is rotated Math.PI from camera view, so to face same forward:
            controlsRef.current.setAzimuthalAngle(charRot + Math.PI);
            // Look straight ahead horizontally
            controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(Math.PI / 2);
            wasFirstPersonRef.current = true;
          }

          // Lock OrbitControls target to targetPoint (exact head center)
          controlsRef.current.target.copy(targetPoint);
          controlsRef.current.minDistance = 0.001;
          controlsRef.current.maxDistance = 0.001;

          if (orbitJoystickData && (Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.y) > 0.01)) {
            const orbitSpeed = 4.0;
            const currentAzimuth = controlsRef.current.getAzimuthalAngle();
            controlsRef.current.setAzimuthalAngle(currentAzimuth - orbitJoystickData.x * orbitSpeed * delta);

            const polarSpeed = 2.8;
            const currentPolar = controlsRef.current.getPolarAngle();
            const nextPolar = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
              currentPolar + orbitJoystickData.y * polarSpeed * delta,
              0.05,
              Math.PI - 0.05
            );
            controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(nextPolar);
          }
          controlsRef.current.update();
        } else {
          // Normal Orbit with optional indoor collision/clamping
          wasFirstPersonRef.current = false;

          // Maintain the OrbitControls update using targetDist as the ideal distance boundaries
          controlsRef.current.minDistance = targetDist;
          controlsRef.current.maxDistance = targetDist;
          controlsRef.current.update();

          // Capture the newly updated ideal camera position (driven by user's mouse/drag actions on the ideal sphere)
          const idealCamPos = camera.position.clone();
          idealCamPosRef.current = idealCamPos;
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(idealCamPos, targetPoint);
          if (dir.lengthSq() < 0.00001) {
            dir.set(0, 0.866, 0.5);
          }
          dir.normalize();

          let maxSafeDist = targetDist;
          let shiftedTargetPoint = targetPoint.clone();

          if (isInterior) {
            const minCeilHt = 4.45;
            const maxFloorHt = 0.40;
            const desiredCamPos = idealCamPos.clone();
            
            desiredCamPos.y = Math.max(maxFloorHt, Math.min(minCeilHt, desiredCamPos.y));
            const margin = 0.55;
            const clampedXZ = clampPointToHouse(desiredCamPos.x, desiredCamPos.z, [activeRoom], margin);
            desiredCamPos.x = clampedXZ.x;
            desiredCamPos.z = clampedXZ.z;

            maxSafeDist = desiredCamPos.distanceTo(targetPoint);

            let raySafeDist = targetDist;
            const segments: Array<{ x1: number; z1: number; x2: number; z2: number; isDoorway?: boolean }> = [];

            // We only generate wall segments for the activeRoom to ensure complete containment and absolute zero outer wall clipping!
            const activeRoomsList = [activeRoom];
            activeRoomsList.forEach((r) => {
              const gx = Math.round(r.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE);
              const gz = Math.round(r.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE);

              const hasRoomAt = (nx: number, nz: number) => {
                return activeRoomsList.some((other) => Math.round(other.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === nx && Math.round(other.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === nz);
              };

              const hasN = hasRoomAt(gx, gz + 1);
              const hasS = hasRoomAt(gx, gz - 1);
              const hasE = hasRoomAt(gx + 1, gz);
              const hasW = hasRoomAt(gx - 1, gz);

              if (!hasN) {
                segments.push({ x1: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z1: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE, x2: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z2: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE });
              }
              if (!hasS) {
                segments.push({ x1: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z1: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, x2: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z2: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE });
              }
              if (!hasE) {
                segments.push({ x1: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z1: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, x2: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z2: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE });
              }
              if (!hasW) {
                segments.push({ x1: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z1: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, x2: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z2: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE });
              }
            });

            const S = { x: targetPoint.x, z: targetPoint.z };
            const D = { x: dir.x, z: dir.z };
            const cameraRadius = 0.55;

            segments.forEach((seg) => {
              const A = { x: seg.x1, z: seg.z1 };
              const B = { x: seg.x2, z: seg.z2 };

              const dx = B.x - A.x;
              const dz = B.z - A.z;
              const det = dx * D.z - dz * D.x;

              if (Math.abs(det) > 0.0001) {
                const det_t = (A.x - S.x) * (-dz) - (-dx) * (A.z - S.z);
                const det_u = D.x * (A.z - S.z) - (A.x - S.x) * D.z;
                const t = det_t / det;
                const u = det_u / det;

                if (t >= 0 && u >= 0 && u <= 1) {
                  raySafeDist = Math.min(raySafeDist, Math.max(0.1, t - cameraRadius));
                }
              }
            });

            maxSafeDist = Math.min(maxSafeDist, raySafeDist);

            if (dir.y > 0.0001) {
              const ceilDist = (minCeilHt - targetPoint.y) / dir.y;
              maxSafeDist = Math.min(maxSafeDist, ceilDist);
            } else if (dir.y < -0.0001) {
              const floorDist = (maxFloorHt - targetPoint.y) / dir.y;
              maxSafeDist = Math.min(maxSafeDist, floorDist);
            }

            // Only push shifted target point back if we are in normal third person (not deep zooming first person)
            if (uiScale <= 1.5 && maxSafeDist < 0.8) {
              const shiftAmt = 0.8 - maxSafeDist;
              shiftedTargetPoint.sub(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(shiftAmt));
              maxSafeDist = 0.8;
            }
          }

          // H. 視野縮放 (FOV) 連動 (Unified)
          const baseFov = 35.0 / uiScale;
          const targetFov = uiScale > 1.5
            ? THREE.MathUtils.lerp(baseFov, 65.0, (uiScale - 1.5) / 0.5)
            : baseFov;
          if (camera instanceof THREE.PerspectiveCamera) {
            camera.fov = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.fov, targetFov, 0.1); 
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          }

          // I. 更新實際相機渲染位置 (避障立即反應，解除避障平滑回復)
          const currentDist = camera.position.distanceTo(targetPoint);
          let finalDist = maxSafeDist;
          if (maxSafeDist > currentDist) {
            // Slide back outward smoothly and quickly
            finalDist = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(currentDist, maxSafeDist, 0.45);
          } else {
            // Collision inward detection: INSTANT SNAP to prevent clipping through any geometry!
            finalDist = maxSafeDist;
          }

          // Compute final physical camera position and copy to camera
          const finalCamPos = shiftedTargetPoint.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(finalDist));
          
          if (isInterior) {
            const minCeilHt = 4.45;
            const maxFloorHt = 0.40;
            // Hard physical caps clamp to ensure zero ceiling/floor penetration under any rounding/precision circumstance
            finalCamPos.y = Math.max(maxFloorHt, Math.min(minCeilHt, finalCamPos.y));
            const clampedFinal = clampPointToHouse(finalCamPos.x, finalCamPos.z, [activeRoom], 0.5);
            finalCamPos.x = clampedFinal.x;
            finalCamPos.z = clampedFinal.z;
          }
          
          // NOW, apply transition interpolation if active!
          if (isInterior && transitionProgressRef.current < 1.0 && transitionStartCamPos.current.lengthSq() > 0) {
            // Clamp the starting transition camera position to the NEW active room to prevent wall-crossing artifacts!
            const clampedStartCamPos = transitionStartCamPos.current.clone();
            const clampedStartCamXZ = clampPointToHouse(clampedStartCamPos.x, clampedStartCamPos.z, [activeRoom], 0.5);
            clampedStartCamPos.x = clampedStartCamXZ.x;
            clampedStartCamPos.z = clampedStartCamXZ.z;
            clampedStartCamPos.y = Math.max(0.40, Math.min(clampedStartCamPos.y, 4.45));

            // Lerp both target and position smoothly over the 0.2-0.4 second window!
            const progress = transitionProgressRef.current;
            // Use easeInOutCubic for beautiful smooth deceleration
            const easeProgress = progress < 0.5 ? 4 * progress * progress * progress : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 3) / 2;

            const lerpedCamPos = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(clampedStartCamPos, finalCamPos, easeProgress);
            const lerpedTarget = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(transitionStartTarget.current, shiftedTargetPoint, easeProgress);

            camera.position.copy(lerpedCamPos);
            controlsRef.current.target.copy(lerpedTarget);
          } else {
            // Normal steady state
            camera.position.copy(finalCamPos);
            controlsRef.current.target.lerp(shiftedTargetPoint, 0.45);
          }

          // Limit controls min/max so orbit controller behaves correctly during this render loop
          controlsRef.current.minDistance = Math.max(0.001, finalDist - 0.01);
          controlsRef.current.maxDistance = finalDist + 0.01;

          // J. 允許使用搖桿旋轉視角 (包含完整的 Azimuth 繞行與 Polar 高低俯仰繞行！)
          if (orbitJoystickData && (Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.x) > 0.01 || Math.abs(orbitJoystickData.y) > 0.01)) {
            const orbitSpeed = 4.0;
            const currentAzimuth = controlsRef.current.getAzimuthalAngle();
            controlsRef.current.setAzimuthalAngle(currentAzimuth - orbitJoystickData.x * orbitSpeed * delta);

            const polarSpeed = 2.8;
            const currentPolar = controlsRef.current.getPolarAngle();
            const nextPolar = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
              currentPolar + orbitJoystickData.y * polarSpeed * delta,
              isInterior ? Math.PI / 12 : Math.PI / 10,       // polar bounds
              isInterior ? Math.PI / 2.05 : Math.PI / 2.1
            );
            controlsRef.current.setPolarAngle(nextPolar);
          }
        }
        
        if (controlsRef.current) {
          controlsRef.current.enabled = !(window as any).isDraggingPlacement;
        }
        controlsRef.current.update();
      }

      const euler = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(camera.quaternion, 'YXZ');
      (window as any).cameraYaw = euler.y;
    }
  });

  const isInteriorView = currentView === View.BUILDING_INTERIOR;

  return (
    <OrbitControls 
      ref={controlsRef}
      enablePan={isBuildMode}
      enableZoom={currentView !== View.BUILDING_INTERIOR || isBuildMode}
      panSpeed={isInteriorView ? (isBuildMode ? 0.0375 : 0.075) : 0.125}
      rotateSpeed={isInteriorView ? (isBuildMode ? 0.1 : 0.2) : 0.6}
      zoomSpeed={isInteriorView ? (isBuildMode ? 0.0375 : 0.075) : 0.15}
      minPolarAngle={isBuildMode ? Math.PI / 4.5 : (uiScale >= FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM ? 0.05 : minPolarAngle)}
      maxPolarAngle={isBuildMode ? Math.PI / 4.5 : (uiScale >= FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM ? Math.PI - 0.05 : maxPolarAngle)}
      minDistance={isBuildMode ? 1.0 : minDistance}
      maxDistance={isBuildMode ? 50.0 : maxDistance}
      makeDefault
    />
  );
}

function clampPointToHouse(
  x: number,
  z: number,
  rooms: Array<{ cx: number; cz: number }>,
  margin = 0.5
): { x: number; z: number } {
  // 1. Define room squares
  const roomSquares = rooms.map((r) => ({
    xmin: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE + margin,
    xmax: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE - margin,
    zmin: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE + margin,
    zmax: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE - margin,
  }));

  // 2. Define doorway rectangles
  const doorways: Array<{ xmin: number; xmax: number; zmin: number; zmax: number }> = [];
  rooms.forEach((r) => {
    const gx = Math.round(r.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE);
    const gz = Math.round(r.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE);

    // Check north
    const hasN = rooms.some(
      (other) =>
        Math.round(other.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gx &&
        Math.round(other.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gz + 1
    );
    if (hasN) {
      doorways.push({
        xmin: r.cx - 1.5 + margin,
        xmax: r.cx + 1.5 - margin,
        zmin: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE - margin,
        zmax: r.cz + ROOM_HALF_SIZE + margin,
      });
    }

    // Check east
    const hasE = rooms.some(
      (other) =>
        Math.round(other.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gx + 1 &&
        Math.round(other.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gz
    );
    if (hasE) {
      doorways.push({
        xmin: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE - margin,
        xmax: r.cx + ROOM_HALF_SIZE + margin,
        zmin: r.cz - 1.5 + margin,
        zmax: r.cz + 1.5 - margin,
      });
    }

    // Check south
    const hasS = rooms.some(
      (other) =>
        Math.round(other.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gx &&
        Math.round(other.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gz - 1
    );
    if (hasS) {
      doorways.push({
        xmin: r.cx - 1.5 + margin,
        xmax: r.cx + 1.5 - margin,
        zmin: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE - margin,
        zmax: r.cz - ROOM_HALF_SIZE + margin,
      });
    }

    // Check west
    const hasW = rooms.some(
      (other) =>
        Math.round(other.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gx - 1 &&
        Math.round(other.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE) === gz
    );
    if (hasW) {
      doorways.push({
        xmin: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE - margin,
        xmax: r.cx - ROOM_HALF_SIZE + margin,
        zmin: r.cz - 1.5 + margin,
        zmax: r.cz + 1.5 - margin,
      });
    }
  });

  // Check if (x, z) is already inside any square or doorway
  for (const sq of roomSquares) {
    if (x >= sq.xmin && x <= sq.xmax && z >= sq.zmin && z <= sq.zmax) {
      return { x, z };
    }
  }
  for (const dw of doorways) {
    if (x >= dw.xmin && x <= dw.xmax && z >= dw.zmin && z <= dw.zmax) {
      return { x, z };
    }
  }

  // If not inside, find the closest point among all shapes
  let minD2 = Infinity;
  let closestX = x;
  let closestZ = z;

  const allShapes = [...roomSquares, ...doorways];
  allShapes.forEach((shape) => {
    const clampX = Math.max(shape.xmin, Math.min(shape.xmax, x));
    const clampZ = Math.max(shape.zmin, Math.min(shape.zmax, z));
    const dx = x - clampX;
    const dz = z - clampZ;
    const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    if (d2 < minD2) {
      minD2 = d2;
      closestX = clampX;
      closestZ = clampZ;
    }
  });

  return { x: closestX, z: closestZ };
}

function getActiveRoom(
  x: number,
  z: number,
  rooms: any[]
): any {
  if (!rooms || rooms.length === 0) return null;
  let minD2 = Infinity;
  let active = rooms[0];
  rooms.forEach((r) => {
    const dx = x - r.cx;
    const dz = z - r.cz;
    const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    if (d2 < minD2) {
      minD2 = d2;
      active = r;
    }
  });
  return active;
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { AttachmentPoint } from '../../constants/characterRig';
import { Attachment } from './character/Attachment';
import { candleFlicker, interiorLights } from '../../lib/interiorLights';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { getGlowTexture } from './glowTexture';

/**
 * 關了燈之後，角色手上那根蠟燭。
 *
 * ## 它掛在哪裡
 *
 * 掛在右手臂關節底下的 `hand` 插槽 —— 那個插槽本來就是為了這件事開的（見 characterRig.ts：
 * 「a held item (a tool, a fishing rod, a lantern)」），這是第一個用到它的東西。掛在關節下面
 * 的意思是它跟著手臂擺動，走路的時候蠟燭會跟著晃，那是免費拿到的。
 *
 * 由 Three/Avatar.tsx 用 R3F 的 createPortal 送進手臂的 group，而不是由角色模型自己畫。這是
 * 刻意的分層：模型只擁有幾何，不知道任何狀態（見 character/types.ts 的那條規則），而「家裡的燈
 * 關了沒有」正是一個純粹的執行期狀態。三個模型（legacy / v2 / authored）因此都不用改，而且
 * 每一個都自動拿得到蠟燭 —— 它們共通的只有那個被綁定的手臂關節。
 *
 * ## 為什麼形和光是分開的
 *
 * 這裡只有火焰的「樣子」。真正照亮房間的那盞 pointLight 在場景那一層（BuildingInteriorView
 * 的 CandleGlow），透過 playerBus.candlePos 跟著這裡的火焰跑。理由寫在 playerBus 那個欄位上：
 * 第一人稱時整個身體是隱藏的，掛在身上的燈會跟著消失。
 *
 * ## 為什麼火焰要反轉父層的旋轉
 *
 * 拿蠟燭的手是抬起來的（見 Avatar 的 CANDLE_ARM_PITCH），手臂轉了將近 50 度。蠟燭如果乖乖
 * 跟著手轉，它就是斜的 —— 而一根斜的蠟燭，火焰還直直往上，兩件事只能對一件。所以這裡每幀把
 * 自己的世界旋轉設回單位四元數：蠟燭永遠是直的，位置仍然完全跟著手走。蠟燭是旋轉對稱的，所以
 * 「朝向世界 +Z」跟「朝向任何方向」沒有差別，不需要保留身體的偏航。
 */

/**
 * 暖機要畫幾幀。三幀是為了 frameloop='demand'：玩家還在門口的時候室內畫布只在場景有變化時才
 * 畫，所以「幀」來得很稀疏，多給兩幀讓它一定跨得過那次暖機的繪製。
 */
const WARM_FRAMES = 3;

/** 火焰在蠟燭本體頂端多高（角色區域單位，世界值為 ×2.25）。 */
const FLAME_Y = 0.205;

const WAX_COLOR = '#fbf3df';
const HOLDER_COLOR = '#c9a227';

const CANDLE_WORLD = new THREE.Vector3();
const PARENT_QUAT = new THREE.Quaternion();

export function CandleInHand({ hand }: { hand: AttachmentPoint }) {
  const { camera } = useThree();
  /** 反轉父層旋轉的那一層。位置由手決定，姿態由這裡奪回來。 */
  const uprightRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  /** 整根蠟燭，燈亮著的時候縮到看不見。 */
  const bodyRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const flameRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const haloRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const waxRef = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
  /** 還要再「畫給編譯器看」幾幀。見下面 useFrame 裡的 warming。 */
  const warmFramesRef = useRef(0);

  // 卸載時把 bus 上的位置清掉，否則場景那盞燭光會永遠停在角色最後站的地方 —— 一盞掛在
  // 空氣中、關不掉的燈。這跟 registerDoor 一定要有 unregisterDoor 是同一件事。
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      playerBus.candlePos = undefined;
    };
  }, []);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const t = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    // 「蠟燭該有多實在」＝「房間有多暗」。跟著 level 走而不是跟著 on 走，所以拿出蠟燭跟房間暗
    // 下來是同一個動作的兩半，而不是一個瞬間出現的道具配上一段淡出。
    const lit = 1 - interiorLights.level;

    // 開頭幾幀把整根蠟燭縮到看不見、但照樣畫出來一次，為的是它的 shader。
    //
    // 一個從來沒被畫過的材質，它的 shader 是在第一次要畫它的那一幀才編的。蠟燭平常是藏起來的，
    // 所以那一幀就是玩家第一次按下 Q 的那一幀 —— 火焰、燭身、光暈一次全部進來，畫面就在按下去
    // 的當下卡住。這幾幀把那筆帳挪到玩家還站在門口、房間正在暖機的時候（見 BuildingInteriorView
    // 的 frameloop='demand' 那一段），也就是「開門中」那張紙蓋著的時間裡。
    //
    // 縮到 1e-3 而不是 visible=false：要的就是它真的被送進去畫一次。這個大小在螢幕上不到一個
    // 像素，而且此時房間是亮的，蠟燭本來就該是看不見的。
    const warming = warmFramesRef.current < WARM_FRAMES;
    if (warming) warmFramesRef.current += 1;

    const body = bodyRef.current;
    const out = lit > 0.015;
    if (body) {
      body.visible = out || warming;
      body.scale.setScalar(out ? lit : 0.001);
    }

    if (!body || !out) {
      playerBus.candlePos = undefined;
      return;
    }

    // 姿態：把手臂（以及身體）的旋轉整個反掉，蠟燭因此永遠是直的。
    const upright = uprightRef.current;
    if (upright && upright.parent) {
      upright.parent.getWorldQuaternion(PARENT_QUAT);
      upright.quaternion.copy(PARENT_QUAT).invert();
    }

    const f = candleFlicker(t);

    const flame = flameRef.current;
    if (flame) {
      // 上下比左右抖得兇：燭火會抽長再縮回去，但腰身不太動。等比縮放的火看起來像在呼吸的球。
      flame.scale.set(0.94 + (f - 0.94) * 0.5, f, 0.94 + (f - 0.94) * 0.5);
      // 一點點的擺，跟閃爍不同步（頻率不成比例），所以火不會「照著節拍」歪。
      flame.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 3.1) * 0.07 + Math.sin(t * 7.7) * 0.02;
    }

    const halo = haloRef.current;
    if (halo) {
      // 面向鏡頭。父層的世界旋轉在上面已經被設成單位了，所以直接抄鏡頭的四元數就是對的。
      halo.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
      halo.scale.setScalar(0.85 + (f - 0.94) * 1.6);
      (halo.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = 0.42 * f;
    }

    // 蠟身自己也被火照到。少了這個，一根白蠟燭在暗房間裡是一根灰色的棒子。
    if (waxRef.current) waxRef.current.emissiveIntensity = 0.55 * f;

    // 火焰在世界的哪裡 —— 場景那盞燭光每幀來拿。就地改寫同一個向量，不配置新的。
    if (flame) {
      flame.getWorldPosition(CANDLE_WORLD);
      playerBus.candlePos = CANDLE_WORLD;
    }
  });

  return (
    <Attachment point={hand}>
      <group ref={uprightRef}>
        <group ref={bodyRef}>
          {/* 銅燭台。一個淺盤加一圈唇邊 —— 光禿禿一根蠟燭浮在拳頭裡不像被拿著，像被插著。 */}
          <mesh position={[0, -0.105, 0]}>
            <cylinderGeometry args={[0.075, 0.085, 0.018, 16]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={HOLDER_COLOR} roughness={0.32} metalness={0.85} />
          </mesh>
          <mesh position={[0, -0.093, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
            <torusGeometry args={[0.072, 0.011, 8, 20]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={HOLDER_COLOR} roughness={0.28} metalness={0.9} />
          </mesh>

          {/* 蠟身。從燭台穿過拳頭往上，所以手是「握著」它而不是托著它。 */}
          <mesh position={[0, 0.02, 0]} castShadow>
            <cylinderGeometry args={[0.032, 0.035, 0.25, 14]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial
              ref={waxRef}
              color={WAX_COLOR}
              roughness={0.62}
              emissive="#ff9a3c"
              emissiveIntensity={0.55}
            />
          </mesh>
          {/* 燭頂那一圈融掉的蠟。它比蠟身亮，因為蠟是半透的，而火就在它正上方。 */}
          <mesh position={[0, 0.148, 0]}>
            <sphereGeometry args={[0.033, 12, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#fff0c9" roughness={0.35} emissive="#ffb347" emissiveIntensity={1.1} />
          </mesh>
          {/* 燭芯 */}
          <mesh position={[0, 0.172, 0]}>
            <cylinderGeometry args={[0.005, 0.006, 0.03, 6]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#3a2a18" roughness={0.9} />
          </mesh>

          {/* 火焰。三層由內而外：白心、琥珀、橘外緣。三層都是加法混合的水滴，疊起來的中心會過曝
              成白色 —— 那正是一團火在眼睛裡的樣子，而單一顆發光的球永遠只是一顆球。
              `toneMapped={false}` 讓火不被色調映射拉回來：房間暗下來時曝光是壓低的（見
              InteriorLighting 的 DARK_EXPOSURE），火如果一起被壓，關燈就只是整個畫面變灰。 */}
          <group ref={flameRef} position={[0, FLAME_Y, 0]}>
            <mesh scale={[0.78, 1.75, 0.78]}>
              <sphereGeometry args={[0.036, 12, 12]} />
              <meshBasicMaterial
                color="#ff7a1a"
                transparent
                opacity={0.34}
                depthWrite={false}
                blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
                toneMapped={false}
              />
            </mesh>
            <mesh scale={[0.72, 1.55, 0.72]} position={[0, -0.004, 0]}>
              <sphereGeometry args={[0.026, 12, 12]} />
              <meshBasicMaterial
                color="#ffc24d"
                transparent
                opacity={0.7}
                depthWrite={false}
                blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
                toneMapped={false}
              />
            </mesh>
            <mesh scale={[0.62, 1.35, 0.62]} position={[0, -0.008, 0]}>
              <sphereGeometry args={[0.016, 10, 10]} />
              <meshBasicMaterial color="#fffbe8" transparent opacity={0.95} depthWrite={false} toneMapped={false} />
            </mesh>
          </group>

          {/* 火焰外圍那圈化不開的暈。一張徑向漸層貼圖，永遠面向鏡頭 —— 火有邊緣，光沒有。 */}
          <mesh ref={haloRef} position={[0, FLAME_Y + 0.01, 0]}>
            <planeGeometry args={[0.62, 0.62]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial
              map={getGlowTexture()}
              color="#ffb15a"
              transparent
              opacity={0.42}
              depthWrite={false}
              blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
              toneMapped={false}
            />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      </group>
    </Attachment>
  );
}
```

## src/components/Three/Clouds.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { WeatherType } from '../../types';
import { useLightningFlicker } from '../../hooks/useLightningFlicker';

/**
 * The sky's cloud layer, drawn as one InstancedMesh.
 *
 * It used to be 25 <Cloud> components x 8 <mesh> puffs = 200 separate transparent spheres, each
 * with its own 16x16 SphereGeometry (480 triangles) and its own MeshLambertMaterial. That is
 * 200 draw calls and 96,000 triangles - by itself half the scene's triangle budget - and because
 * every one of them was `transparent`, the renderer also depth-sorted all 200 every frame and
 * blended them over each other with no depth write, i.e. maximum overdraw across the whole sky.
 * Each cloud's own useFrame then walked its 8 meshes to lerp material colour/opacity, so the
 * shared look was being written 200 times per frame into 200 separate materials.
 *
 * Every puff has always shown the same weather-driven colour and opacity, so there is exactly one
 * material here, one geometry, and one draw call. The per-puff transform work stays on the CPU
 * (200 matrix composes is nothing next to 200 draw calls) so the drift/bob/scale behaviour is
 * unchanged.
 */

// Puff layout within a single cloud, in cloud-local units. Unchanged from the per-mesh version.
const PUFFS: Array<{ offset: [number, number, number]; scale: number }> = [
  { offset: [0, 0, 0], scale: 1.5 },
  { offset: [0.8, -0.2, 0.2], scale: 1.2 },
  { offset: [-0.8, -0.1, -0.2], scale: 1.1 },
  { offset: [0.3, 0.5, -0.1], scale: 1.1 },
  { offset: [1.4, -0.3, 0], scale: 0.8 },
  { offset: [-1.4, -0.2, 0.1], scale: 0.75 },
  { offset: [-0.4, 0.3, 0.4], scale: 0.95 },
  { offset: [0.5, -0.1, -0.6], scale: 0.95 },
];

const CLOUD_COUNT = 25;
const PUFF_COUNT = CLOUD_COUNT * PUFFS.length;

// 16x16 was 480 triangles per puff for a soft white blob seen from 30+ units below, blurred
// further by its own transparency. 10x8 holds the same silhouette at a fifth of the cost.
const SPHERE_SEGMENTS = 10;
const SPHERE_RINGS = 8;

interface CloudTargets {
  color: THREE.Color;
  opacity: number;
  speedMult: number;
  scaleMult: number;
}

function getWeatherTargets(weather: WeatherType): CloudTargets {
  switch (weather) {
    case WeatherType.RAINY:
      return { color: new THREE.Color('#788896'), opacity: 0.9, speedMult: 1.6, scaleMult: 1.25 };
    case WeatherType.STORM:
      return { color: new THREE.Color('#334155'), opacity: 0.95, speedMult: 2.8, scaleMult: 1.45 };
    case WeatherType.SNOW:
      return { color: new THREE.Color('#E2E8F0'), opacity: 0.95, speedMult: 0.65, scaleMult: 1.15 };
    case WeatherType.TWILIGHT:
      return {
        color: new THREE.Color('#FDA4AF').lerp(new THREE.Color('#FED7AA'), 0.5),
        opacity: 0.92,
        speedMult: 0.4,
        scaleMult: 1.0,
      };
    case WeatherType.MIDNIGHT:
      // Deliberately the only semi-transparent entry: at night the clouds are
      // dark silhouettes that the star field has to show through, not the solid
      // white blobs every daytime state wants.
      return { color: new THREE.Color('#2C3A52'), opacity: 0.55, speedMult: 0.35, scaleMult: 1.05 };
    case WeatherType.SUNNY:
    default:
      return { color: new THREE.Color('#FFFFFF'), opacity: 0.95, speedMult: 1.0, scaleMult: 1.0 };
  }
}

// Scratch objects reused every frame. The per-cloud version allocated a THREE.Color per cloud per
// frame during a lightning flash (25 of them) plus one unconditionally.
const LIGHTNING_TINT = new THREE.Color('#E2E8F0');
const displayColor = new THREE.Color();
const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();

export function Clouds() {
  const { weather } = useApp();
  const meshRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);

  const clouds = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from({ length: CLOUD_COUNT }).map(() => ({
        origin: [
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200,
          30 + Math.random() * 15,
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200,
        ] as [number, number, number],
        // Live X position, drifted every frame. Kept off `origin` so the bob below can keep
        // referencing the cloud's authored height/phase.
        x: 0,
        scale: 3 + Math.random() * 6,
        currentScale: 3,
        speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.3,
      })),
    []
  );

  const geometry = useMemo(
    () => new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, SPHERE_SEGMENTS, SPHERE_RINGS),
    []
  );
  const material = useMemo(
    () => new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#ffffff', transparent: true, opacity: 0.95 }),
    []
  );

  const targets = useMemo(() => getWeatherTargets(weather), [weather]);
  const updateLightning = useLightningFlicker();

  useEffect(() => {
    clouds.forEach((c) => {
      c.x = c.origin[0];
      c.currentScale = c.scale;
    });
  }, [clouds]);

  useEffect(() => () => { geometry.dispose(); material.dispose(); }, [geometry, material]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const mesh = meshRef.current;
    if (!mesh) return;

    const elapsed = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    const bobAmount = weather === WeatherType.STORM ? 1.4 : 1.0;

    let i = 0;
    for (const cloud of clouds) {
      cloud.x += cloud.speed * targets.speedMult * 0.01;
      if (cloud.x > 150) cloud.x = -150;

      const y = cloud.origin[1] + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.5 + cloud.origin[0]) * 0.5 * bobAmount;
      cloud.currentScale = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(cloud.currentScale, cloud.scale * targets.scaleMult, 0.04);
      const s = cloud.currentScale;

      for (const puff of PUFFS) {
        dummy.position.set(
          cloud.x + puff.offset[0] * s,
          y + puff.offset[1] * s,
          cloud.origin[2] + puff.offset[2] * s
        );
        dummy.scale.setScalar(puff.scale * s);
        dummy.updateMatrix();
        mesh.setMatrixAt(i++, dummy.matrix);
      }
    }
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;

    // Storm lightning flash, synced with SkyDome and the scene lights.
    const flash = updateLightning(elapsed, weather === WeatherType.STORM, 0.95, 0.2);
    displayColor.copy(targets.color);
    if (flash > 0) displayColor.lerp(LIGHTNING_TINT, flash * 0.9);

    material.color.lerp(displayColor, 0.04);
    material.opacity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(material.opacity, targets.opacity, 0.04);
  });

  return (
    <instancedMesh
      ref={meshRef}
      args={[geometry, material, PUFF_COUNT]}
      // The layer spans 200 world units and every puff moves every frame, so a per-instance
      // bounding sphere would have to be recomputed constantly to cull something that is on
      // screen most of the time anyway.
      frustumCulled={false}
    />
  );
}
```

## src/components/Three/Fireflies.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { WeatherType } from '../../types';
import { ISLAND_SURFACE_Y } from '../../constants/terrain';

/**
 * The lights drifting over the island after dark.
 *
 * ## What this used to be, and why none of it survived
 *
 * A `<pointsMaterial>` cloud of 40 identical lime dots, updated by a CPU loop,
 * mounted unconditionally. Four things were wrong with it:
 *
 *   1. **It never turned off.** Fireflies glowed through high noon. Nothing in
 *      a bright blue sky reads as a firefly - additively blended lime specks
 *      over a lit island read as dirt on the lens. They now ramp in with the
 *      darkness, exactly the way NightSky.tsx's moon and stars do, and they are
 *      brightest at 深夜 with a weaker showing at 黃昏 (see {@link nightTarget}).
 *   2. **The swarm drifted, at a speed that depended on the monitor.** The loop
 *      did `position += sin(t)` every frame with no delta term, so each frame's
 *      sample was *accumulated* rather than *evaluated*: a 144Hz display moved
 *      every firefly ~2.4x as far per second as a 60Hz one, and because the
 *      integral of the wander never returned exactly to zero the whole cloud
 *      walked outward until the radius clamp started dragging it back in. The
 *      wander is now a pure function of `uTime` added to a fixed anchor, so it
 *      cannot accumulate and cannot drift - and the clamps that existed to
 *      contain the drift are gone with it.
 *   3. **They did not blink.** A firefly's whole character is the flash. A
 *      `pointsMaterial` has one shared `opacity`, so the best it could express
 *      was every firefly in the sky pulsing in unison - which is why the old
 *      one simply held a constant 0.8. Blinking needs per-particle phase, which
 *      needs a shader; same reasoning as StarField's twinkle in NightSky.tsx.
 *   4. **They were squares.** An untextured point sprite is a flat quad, so at
 *      the size these are drawn the swarm was visibly made of tiny rectangles.
 *
 * ## Cost
 *
 * Everything - the wander, the blink, the size pulse - is a function of `uTime`
 * and per-particle attributes, so it all lives in the vertex shader. There is
 * no particle array to step and no buffer re-upload per frame; the only CPU
 * work is three uniform writes, and the draw is skipped outright in daylight.
 * This is the same structure as the bubble columns in OceanDecorations.tsx.
 */

/** How fast the night ramp reaches its target. Matched to NightSky/SkyDome. */
const NIGHT_LERP = 0.03;

/**
 * How lit the swarm gets in each sky.
 *
 * 黃昏 gets a real but partial showing because that is when fireflies actually
 * come out, and because the ramp doubles as the cross-fade when the player
 * switches 黃昏 -> 深夜: the swarm thickens instead of appearing from nothing.
 */
function nightTarget(weather: WeatherType): number {
  switch (weather) {
    case WeatherType.MIDNIGHT:
      return 1;
    case WeatherType.TWILIGHT:
      return 0.45;
    default:
      return 0;
  }
}

/** Below this the swarm is invisible anyway, so stop drawing it entirely. */
const VISIBLE_EPSILON = 0.004;

/** Anchor footprint, in territoryLevel-1 units. The grass plateau ends at r 5.7. */
const RING_INNER = 1.2;
const RING_OUTER = 7.4;

const HEIGHT_MIN = ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + 0.35;
const HEIGHT_SPAN = 4.3;

function createFireflyMaterial() {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uNight: { value: 0 },
      uPixelRatio: { value: 1 },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      attribute float aSize;
      attribute float aSpeed;
      attribute float aTint;
      attribute vec3 aPhase;
      uniform float uTime;
      uniform float uNight;
      uniform float uPixelRatio;
      varying float vAlpha;
      varying float vTint;

      void main() {
        // Two out-of-step octaves per axis. One sine alone traces a clean
        // ellipse, which reads as a dot on a wire the moment you follow it;
        // beating a slower one against it gives a path that never quite
        // repeats. Vertical amplitude is deliberately the smallest of the
        // three - fireflies hold their height and wander sideways.
        vec3 pos = position;
        pos.x += sin(uTime * aSpeed + aPhase.x) * 0.85
               + sin(uTime * aSpeed * 0.41 + aPhase.z) * 0.45;
        pos.y += sin(uTime * aSpeed * 0.63 + aPhase.y) * 0.32
               + sin(uTime * aSpeed * 0.23 + aPhase.x) * 0.18;
        pos.z += cos(uTime * aSpeed * 0.87 + aPhase.z) * 0.85
               + cos(uTime * aSpeed * 0.33 + aPhase.y) * 0.45;

        // The blink: fast attack, slow decay, long dark gap. A symmetric sine
        // here reads as a breathing lamp rather than a firefly, and the phase
        // offset is what keeps the swarm from flashing as one organism.
        float cycle = fract(uTime * (0.26 + aSpeed * 0.20) + aPhase.x * 0.159);
        float flash = smoothstep(0.0, 0.06, cycle) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.09, 0.60, cycle));
        // Never reaches zero. A sprite that fully vanishes pops when it returns,
        // so an ember holds each firefly's place between flashes.
        float glow = 0.16 + flash * 0.84;

        vAlpha = uNight * glow;
        vTint = aTint;

        vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
        // A brighter firefly reads as a bigger one. Growing the sprite with the
        // flash fakes the bloom that a post-processing pass would give, at no
        // cost - there is no post chain in this scene to hang one on.
        gl_PointSize = aSize * uPixelRatio * (0.72 + glow * 0.55) * 300.0 / -mv.z;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying float vAlpha;
      varying float vTint;

      void main() {
        float d = length(gl_PointCoord - vec2(0.5));
        if (d > 0.5) discard;

        // A hot near-white core inside a wide coloured halo. The squared
        // falloff on the halo is what sells it as light rather than as a
        // flat disc - a linear ramp gives a sticker, not a glow.
        float halo = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.5, d);
        float core = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, d);

        // Warm amber through yellow-green, varied per firefly. The old single
        // #bef264 was an acid lime that sat on top of the night sky instead of
        // in it; real ones are warmer and no two are quite the same.
        vec3 col = mix(vec3(1.00, 0.87, 0.42), vec3(0.76, 1.00, 0.47), vTint);
        col = mix(col, vec3(1.0), core * 0.7);

        float a = (halo * halo * 0.75 + core * 0.55) * vAlpha;
        if (a <= 0.002) discard;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(col, a);
      }
    `,
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
  });
}

export function Fireflies({ count = 20 }: { count?: number }) {
  const { weather, profile } = useApp();
  const pointsRef = useRef<THREE.Points>(null);
  const nightRef = useRef(0);

  const material = useMemo(createFireflyMaterial, []);

  // The swarm covers the island rather than a fixed patch of it, so a levelled-up
  // territory does not end up with its fireflies huddled in the middle. Scaling
  // the group rather than the anchors keeps the geometry static; `gl_PointSize`
  // is computed from `aSize` directly, so the dots stay the same size on screen
  // and only their footprint grows.
  const islandScale = 1 + ((profile?.territoryLevel || 1) - 1) * 0.4;

  const geometry = useMemo(() => {
    const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
    const phases = new Float32Array(count * 3);
    const sizes = new Float32Array(count);
    const speeds = new Float32Array(count);
    const tints = new Float32Array(count);

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      // sqrt of a lerp between the squared radii is an even spread across the
      // ring. The old version drew a square and clamped it to a circle, which
      // both piled fireflies up along the clamp and left the corners empty.
      const radius = Math.sqrt(
        THREE.MathUtils.lerp(RING_INNER * RING_INNER, RING_OUTER * RING_OUTER, Math.random()),
      );

      positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      // Biased low: most of the swarm hangs just over the grass where it reads
      // against the island, with a thinning few drifting up into the dark.
      positions[i * 3 + 1] = HEIGHT_MIN + Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.8) * HEIGHT_SPAN;
      positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(angle) * radius;

      phases[i * 3] = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      phases[i * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      phases[i * 3 + 2] = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

      // Mostly small with a few standouts, rather than 40 identical dots.
      //
      // These are much larger than the 0.15 the old `pointsMaterial` used, and
      // deliberately so: with `300.0 / -mv.z` attenuation and this camera's
      // ~30-unit orbit, 0.15 works out to a *two pixel* speck. That is why the
      // old swarm read as dust on the screen - there were not enough pixels in
      // a firefly to show a shape, let alone a glow. This range lands at
      // roughly 6-13px at normal orbit, which is enough for the halo to exist.
      sizes[i] = 0.55 + Math.pow(Math.random(), 2) * 0.75;
      speeds[i] = 0.22 + Math.random() * 0.30;
      tints[i] = Math.random();
    }

    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('aPhase', new THREE.BufferAttribute(phases, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('aSize', new THREE.BufferAttribute(sizes, 1));
    geo.setAttribute('aSpeed', new THREE.BufferAttribute(speeds, 1));
    geo.setAttribute('aTint', new THREE.BufferAttribute(tints, 1));
    return geo;
  }, [count]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const night = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(nightRef.current, nightTarget(weather), NIGHT_LERP);
    nightRef.current = night;

    material.uniforms.uTime.value = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    material.uniforms.uNight.value = night;
    material.uniforms.uPixelRatio.value = state.gl.getPixelRatio();

    if (pointsRef.current) {
      pointsRef.current.visible = night > VISIBLE_EPSILON;
    }
  });

  return (
    <group scale={[islandScale, 1, islandScale]}>
      {/* Culling is off because the wander is applied in the vertex shader, so
          the bounding sphere three derives from the anchor attribute does not
          contain where the fireflies actually are. At this count the test is
          worth less than the pop it would cause at the edge of frame. */}
      <points ref={pointsRef} geometry={geometry} frustumCulled={false} visible={false}>
        <primitive object={material} attach="material" />
      </points>
    </group>
  );
}
```

## src/components/Three/Fish.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { mergeGeometries } from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { WeatherType } from '../../types';
import {
  MAX_SUBMERGED_TOP_Y,
  WATER_SURFACE_Y,
  seabedY,
} from '../../constants/world';

// Small fish schooling in the shallows around the island. They live *below*
// WATER_SURFACE_Y and are drawn as ordinary opaque meshes, so the translucent
// water planes above them blend over them and tint them automatically - that
// wash is what sells "underwater" without any extra shader work here.
//
// Everything is drawn with two InstancedMeshes (bodies + tail fins) sharing a
// per-fish transform, so a whole shoal costs two draw calls. The tail is a
// separate instance rather than merged geometry purely so it can wag relative
// to the body.

// Tropical palette - deliberately saturated, since roughly half of each fish's
// color is washed out by the water above it before it reaches the camera.
const FISH_COLORS = ['#fb923c', '#fcd34d', '#f472b6', '#67e8f9', '#e2e8f0', '#f87171'];

// --- Proportions. The geometry builders further down are the authority on the
// shape itself; these are the numbers the swimming maths also has to know. ---

// Nose-to-peduncle length of the body mesh. The caudal fin mounts at the back
// of it and adds roughly another third on top, so a fish reads a little longer
// than this number alone suggests.
const BODY_LENGTH = 0.4;

// Where the caudal fin pivots - just inside the back of the body, so the joint
// stays buried instead of opening a seam when the tail swings.
const TAIL_JOINT_Z = -BODY_LENGTH / 2 + 0.01;

// Highest point of the silhouette above the body's centre line: the dorsal fin
// tip, not the back itself.
const FISH_HALF_HEIGHT = 0.17;

// Per-fish scale spread, and the vertical scatter/bob each fish rides on top of
// its school's shared depth.
const MIN_FISH_SIZE = 0.8;
const MAX_FISH_SIZE = 1.2;
const DEPTH_JITTER = 0.18;
const BOB_AMPLITUDE = 0.09;

// The shallowest a school may sit before the tallest fish riding the top of its
// jitter would break through the wave trough. Deriving it rather than
// hand-tuning each depth is what stops the shoal from surfacing the next time
// the fish are resized - which is exactly what enlarging them did to the
// hand-tuned depths this replaced. The ceiling itself now lives in
// constants/world.ts, shared with the reef, which is fitted under the same line.
const MAX_SCHOOL_DEPTH =
  MAX_SUBMERGED_TOP_Y - DEPTH_JITTER - BOB_AMPLITUDE - FISH_HALF_HEIGHT * MAX_FISH_SIZE;

// Fish orbit the island in loose bands. Each school shares a radius/depth/
// direction so they read as a group moving together, and individual fish only
// jitter around that shared path. Depths are expressed as a distance *below
// the water surface* rather than as absolute world Y, so the shoal follows the
// sea if the waterline ever moves - a fish is only a fish while it's under it.
const SCHOOLS = [
  { radiusOffset: 2.0, speed: 0.10, depth: Math.min(WATER_SURFACE_Y - 0.7, MAX_SCHOOL_DEPTH) },
  { radiusOffset: 4.6, speed: -0.075, depth: Math.min(WATER_SURFACE_Y - 1.05, MAX_SCHOOL_DEPTH) },
  { radiusOffset: 7.2, speed: 0.055, depth: Math.min(WATER_SURFACE_Y - 0.88, MAX_SCHOOL_DEPTH) },
  { radiusOffset: 9.6, speed: -0.045, depth: Math.min(WATER_SURFACE_Y - 1.25, MAX_SCHOOL_DEPTH) },
];

// Coast radius at territory level 1 - mirrors Ocean.tsx's uCoastRadius and
// Island.tsx's sand edge, and is scaled by islandScale below so the shoals
// stay just off the beach as the island grows instead of ending up inland.
const COAST_RADIUS = 6.8;

// A fish is seen through *two* translucent layers - the ocean surface and the
// painted reflection smear beneath it (see Ocean.tsx) - which between them eat
// well over half of its shaded color. A plain lit material comes out muddy
// under that, so each fish is given a little self-lit glow on top of its
// normal shading to keep its color readable through the water. `totalEmissiveRadiance *= vColor` is the patch
// that makes that glow follow the per-instance color: three multiplies the
// instance color into the diffuse term only, leaving emissive a single shared
// color, which would flatten every fish toward the same washed white.
function createFishMaterial() {
  const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.05,
    emissive: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
    emissiveIntensity: 0.35,
    flatShading: true,
    // Required for the per-instance color to reach the fragment shader at all.
    // three (0.184) defines USE_INSTANCING_COLOR only in the *vertex* prefix, so
    // color_pars_fragment - which gates `varying vec4 vColor` on USE_COLOR /
    // USE_COLOR_ALPHA - never declares it for an instanced-color-only material.
    // Without this the patch below referenced an undeclared identifier, the
    // program failed to link, and the entire shoal silently vanished; even had
    // it linked, color_fragment gates `diffuseColor *= vColor` the same way, so
    // the per-fish colors would have been dropped too. Setting vertexColors
    // defines USE_COLOR in both prefixes, which fixes both halves at once. See
    // createFishGeometry for the white color attribute this requires.
    vertexColors: true,
  });
  material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace(
      '#include <emissivemap_fragment>',
      // .rgb, not the bare varying: vColor is a vec4 here and
      // totalEmissiveRadiance is a vec3, which is itself a compile error.
      '#include <emissivemap_fragment>\n\ttotalEmissiveRadiance *= vColor.rgb;'
    );
  };
  return material;
}

// vertexColors makes three declare `attribute vec3 color` and multiply it into
// vColor before the instance color is applied. A geometry without that
// attribute leaves it unbound, and WebGL feeds unbound attributes (0,0,0) - so
// every fish would come out black. Flat white makes the per-vertex term a
// no-op and lets instanceColor alone decide the fish's color.
function withWhiteVertexColors(geometry: THREE.BufferGeometry) {
  const white = new Float32Array(geometry.attributes.position.count * 3).fill(1);
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(white, 3));
  return geometry;
}

function createBody() {
  // Fusiform profile revolved around the axis: pointed snout, widest a little
  // forward of centre, tapering to a thin caudal peduncle. This used to be a
  // single 6-sided cone, which reads as a spike from every angle - the taper on
  // both ends is what actually makes the silhouette say "fish" at this size.
  const half = BODY_LENGTH / 2;
  const profile = [
    new THREE.Vector2(0.0, -half - 0.004), // cap, so the peduncle isn't an open ring
    new THREE.Vector2(0.012, -half),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.03, -half * 0.68),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.052, -half * 0.32),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.07, -half * 0.02),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.075, half * 0.2), // widest point
    new THREE.Vector2(0.064, half * 0.5),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.04, half * 0.78),
    new THREE.Vector2(0.0, half), // snout
  ];
  const body = new THREE.LatheGeometry(profile, 12);
  // Lathe revolves around +Y; point the nose at +Z, the direction the instance
  // transform below treats as "forward".
  body.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
  // Fish are compressed side-to-side and deep top-to-bottom. Applied to the
  // body alone - the fins below are already modelled at final proportions.
  body.scale(0.72, 1.15, 1);
  return body;
}

// All three fins are 3-sided cones squashed into blades. Cheaper than extruded
// shapes, and the facets match the body's own under flatShading rather than
// introducing a second, smoother visual language.
function createDorsalFin() {
  const fin = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.085, 3);
  fin.translate(0, 0.0425, 0); // base to the origin, so the height below is absolute
  fin.scale(0.16, 1, 1.7); // thin across the body, stretched fore-aft
  fin.translate(0, 0.082, -0.01); // sunk slightly into the back, no gap at the root
  return fin;
}

function createPectoralFin(side: number) {
  const fin = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.032, 0.075, 3);
  fin.translate(0, 0.0375, 0);
  fin.scale(0.22, 1, 1.25); // flattened into a paddle *before* it is swung outward
  fin.rotateZ(side * -(Math.PI / 2 + 0.25)); // out to the flank, angled slightly down
  fin.rotateY(side * 0.35); // sweep the tip aft, as if held against the current
  fin.translate(side * 0.04, -0.01, 0.045);
  return fin;
}

function createFishGeometry() {
  // Body and fins merge into one buffer so the whole shoal still costs a single
  // draw call - the fins never move relative to the body, so there is nothing
  // to gain from keeping them separate.
  return withWhiteVertexColors(
    mergeGeometries([createBody(), createDorsalFin(), createPectoralFin(1), createPectoralFin(-1)])
  );
}

function createTailGeometry() {
  // Forked caudal fin - two blades splayed off a shared joint at the origin, so
  // the wag rotation in useFrame pivots where the fin actually meets the body.
  const lobe = (dir: number) => {
    const l = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.145, 3);
    l.translate(0, 0.0725, 0);
    l.scale(0.2, 1, 0.55);
    // Local +Y becomes -Z here, so the blade points aft; the extra dir term
    // splays one lobe up and the other down into the fork.
    l.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2 + dir * 0.5);
    return l;
  };
  return withWhiteVertexColors(mergeGeometries([lobe(1), lobe(-1)]));
}

export function Fish({ count = 28 }: { count?: number }) {
  const { profile, weather } = useApp();
  const territoryLevel = profile?.territoryLevel || 1;
  const islandScale = 1 + (territoryLevel - 1) * 0.4;

  const bodyRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const tailRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  // Lerped, not snapped, so a weather change eases the shoal down/up instead
  // of teleporting it - matches how Ocean/SkyDome ease their own transitions.
  const depthOffset = useRef(0);

  const bodyGeometry = useMemo(() => createFishGeometry(), []);
  const tailGeometry = useMemo(() => createTailGeometry(), []);
  // One material for both meshes - the tail is the same fish, just a
  // separately-transformed piece of it.
  const material = useMemo(() => createFishMaterial(), []);

  const fishes = useMemo(() => {
    // Deterministic-enough per-fish jitter, generated once. Each entry is a
    // fixed offset from its school's shared path.
    return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
      const school = SCHOOLS[i % SCHOOLS.length];
      return {
        school,
        angle0: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        // Fish in the same school clump together in a short arc rather than
        // spreading evenly around the whole ring.
        dAngle: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
        dRadius: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.8,
        dDepth: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * DEPTH_JITTER,
        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        size: MIN_FISH_SIZE + Math.random() * (MAX_FISH_SIZE - MIN_FISH_SIZE),
        color: new THREE.Color(FISH_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * FISH_COLORS.length)]),
      };
    });
  }, [count]);

  // Scratch objects reused every frame - allocating matrices per fish per
  // frame would churn the GC hard at 60fps.
  const scratch = useMemo(
    () => ({
      position: new THREE.Vector3(),
      quaternion: new THREE.Quaternion(),
      scale: new THREE.Vector3(),
      bodyMatrix: new THREE.Matrix4(),
      tailMatrix: new THREE.Matrix4(),
      tailLocal: new THREE.Matrix4(),
      tailWag: new THREE.Matrix4(),
      yAxis: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
    }),
    []
  );

  useFrame((state, delta) => {
    const body = bodyRef.current;
    const tail = tailRef.current;
    if (!body || !tail) return;

    const t = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    const coastRadius = COAST_RADIUS * islandScale;
    // The submerged foot of the sand slope reaches ~1.04x the coast radius and
    // grows with islandScale, while the school offsets below are fixed - so at
    // high territory levels the innermost school would eventually be swallowed
    // by the beach. This floor keeps every fish just clear of it at any size.
    const minRadius = coastRadius * 1.09;

    // In rough weather the shoal drops away from the churned-up surface; in
    // calm weather it drifts back up into the bright shallows.
    const targetDepth =
      weather === WeatherType.STORM ? -0.55 : weather === WeatherType.RAINY ? -0.25 : 0;
    depthOffset.current = THREE.MathUtils.damp(depthOffset.current, targetDepth, 1.2, delta);

    for (let i = 0; i < fishes.length; i++) {
      const f = fishes[i];

      const angle = f.angle0 + f.dAngle + t * f.school.speed + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + f.phase) * 0.05;
      const radius = Math.max(
        minRadius,
        coastRadius + f.school.radiusOffset + f.dRadius + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + f.phase) * 0.4
      );
      // There is a real sea floor under the shoal now (see OceanDecorations), so
      // a school's depth is no longer the whole story: the innermost band swims
      // over water barely a metre deep, and in rough weather `depthOffset` used
      // to push it straight down through the sand. Clamping against the same
      // profile the reef is built from keeps every fish above the floor at any
      // radius and in any weather - and has the pleasant side effect of making
      // the inshore school hug the bottom as the shallows squeeze it.
      const floorY = seabedY(radius, islandScale) + FISH_HALF_HEIGHT * f.size + 0.05;
      const y = Math.max(
        floorY,
        f.school.depth +
          f.dDepth +
          depthOffset.current +
          Math.sin(t * 1.1 + f.phase) * BOB_AMPLITUDE
      );

      scratch.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * radius, y, Math.sin(angle) * radius);

      // Face along the direction of travel: the tangent to the orbit, flipped
      // for schools swimming the other way round the island. atan2(x, z)
      // (not the usual z, x) because the model's nose points +Z.
      const dir = Math.sign(f.school.speed);
      const heading =
        Math.atan2(-Math.sin(angle) * dir, Math.cos(angle) * dir) +
        Math.sin(t * 2.2 + f.phase) * 0.12; // gentle weave off the perfect circle

      scratch.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(scratch.yAxis, heading);
      scratch.scale.setScalar(f.size);
      scratch.bodyMatrix.compose(scratch.position, scratch.quaternion, scratch.scale);
      body.setMatrixAt(i, scratch.bodyMatrix);

      // Tail rides at the back of the body and wags about that joint. Built
      // as body * offset * wag so it inherits the body's own uniform scale.
      scratch.tailWag.makeRotationY(Math.sin(t * 6 + f.phase) * 0.45);
      scratch.tailLocal.makeTranslation(0, 0, TAIL_JOINT_Z).multiply(scratch.tailWag);
      scratch.tailMatrix.multiplyMatrices(scratch.bodyMatrix, scratch.tailLocal);
      tail.setMatrixAt(i, scratch.tailMatrix);
    }

    body.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    tail.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  // Colors are per-instance and never change, so they're written once after
  // mount rather than every frame alongside the matrices.
  useEffect(() => {
    for (const mesh of [bodyRef.current, tailRef.current]) {
      if (!mesh) continue;
      for (let i = 0; i < fishes.length; i++) mesh.setColorAt(i, fishes[i].color);
      if (mesh.instanceColor) mesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }, [fishes]);

  return (
    <group>
      {/* frustumCulled is off on both: an InstancedMesh derives its bounding
          sphere from the geometry sitting at the origin, so with every fish
          transformed out to the coastline the whole shoal would pop out of
          existence whenever the origin left the view. */}
      <instancedMesh ref={bodyRef} args={[bodyGeometry, material, count]} frustumCulled={false} />

      {/* Fully opaque, like the body: a transparent fin would be sorted into
          the same pass as the ocean planes and could end up drawn over the
          water instead of beneath it. */}
      <instancedMesh ref={tailRef} args={[tailGeometry, material, count]} frustumCulled={false} />
    </group>
  );
}
```
