```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { playerBus, clampFrameDelta } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { usePlayerHome, getHomeDoorPosition } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import { getHouseVisualHeight } from './HouseModel';
import { SIGHTLINE_OCCLUDER_LAYER } from '../../constants/layers';
import { findTidyTarget } from '../../lib/islandOvergrowth';
import { nearestLightSwitch } from '../../lib/interiorLights';
import { getIslandSurfaceY } from '../../constants/terrain';

// Matches PettingMiniGame.tsx's own pet-dog trigger radius - kept in sync manually since the
// dog's proximity isn't tracked in AppContext like nearbyBuilding/nearbyInteractable are.
const DOG_TRIGGER_DIST = 2.5;

// Fixed "above the bounding box" anchor heights per target type, added on top of each object's
// own base world position. These are hand-tuned approximations of each model's actual height
// (small dog) rather than a real THREE.Box3 computed from the mesh - good enough for a floating
// nameplate and far simpler than plumbing mesh refs for every target type through to this
// component.
//
// Two exceptions, both because a hardcoded height that lands INSIDE the object puts the anchor
// where the occlusion raycast hits the object's own surface, and the prompt then silently never
// appears:
//   the Home        - derived from its House Style footprint (see homeAnchorHeight below);
//   any furniture   - already measured off the model by lib/furnitureInteraction.ts and published
//                     on the bus as a complete world point, so this file adds nothing to it. That
//                     replaced a flat 1.3 that was written for a hammock and would have sat two
//                     thirds of the way up a wardrobe.
const DOG_ANCHOR_HEIGHT = 0.75;

// 離線環境變化 (Three/IslandOvergrowth.tsx). Two heights, because one press clears two very
// different things: a patch of weeds at the players feet, and the vines hanging off the eaves.
// The wall height is measured to just under the roofline and the anchor itself sits OUTSIDE the
// wall (see findTidyTarget), so the occlusion cast below does not hit the house it is pointing at.
const TIDY_ANCHOR_HEIGHT = 0.8;
const TIDY_WALL_ANCHOR_HEIGHT = 2.5;

/** Floats the badge clear of the roofline of whatever style the Home currently wears. */
const HOME_ANCHOR_CLEARANCE = 0.6;

// Occlusion raycast is capped just short of the target's own distance so the target's own
// surface (the thing the ray is aimed at) never registers as "something in the way".
const OCCLUSION_SLACK = 0.4;
// Small margin so a target that's just past the edge of the frustum doesn't pop out the instant
// its projected point crosses the exact viewport boundary.
const OFFSCREEN_MARGIN = 60;

type Candidate = { key: string; distance: number; anchor: THREE.Vector3 };

// Scratch objects. This runs every frame, and the three candidate anchors plus the two vectors
// the occlusion cast needs used to be freshly allocated each time - ~6 THREE.Vector3 per frame
// thrown straight at the GC. The candidate list is fixed (building / interactable / dog), so each
// one owns a reusable anchor instead.
const ANCHOR_SCRATCH: Record<string, THREE.Vector3> = {
  building: new THREE.Vector3(),
  interactable: new THREE.Vector3(),
  dog: new THREE.Vector3(),
  tidy: new THREE.Vector3(),
  merchant: new THREE.Vector3(),
  lightswitch: new THREE.Vector3(),
  npc: new THREE.Vector3(),
  speech: new THREE.Vector3(),
};

/** 居民泡泡的螢幕座標，發佈到 playerBus.npcSpeechPrompt 的那一個物件 —— 就地改寫，不是每幀一個。 */
const SPEECH_SCREEN = { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
const toTarget = new THREE.Vector3();
const ndc = new THREE.Vector3();

/**
 * 一次投影的結果。模組層級重複使用，呼叫端當場讀完就算 —— 這個檔案每幀跑兩次投影（E 那格和
 * Q 那格），沒有理由每幀丟兩個物件給 GC。
 */
const PROJECTION = { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };

// Walks up from a raycast hit to see if it landed on the player's own avatar (tagged in
// Avatar.tsx) - such hits don't count as occlusion, see isOccluded below for why.
function isPlayerAvatarHit(object: THREE.Object3D): boolean {
  let node: THREE.Object3D | null = object;
  while (node) {
    if (node.userData?.isPlayerAvatar) return true;
    node = node.parent;
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * 一個世界點 → 螢幕座標 + 它現在看不看得見，寫進 {@link PROJECTION}。
 *
 * 抽出來是因為現在有兩個徽章要用同一套規則：排名第一的那個互動（E），和牆上的電燈開關（Q）。
 * 「看得見」在這裡永遠是同一件事 —— 在視錐裡、沒有被牆擋住 —— 而那正是不該有兩份的東西：
 * 兩份就會有一天只有一邊被修好。
 *
 * Occlusion: 從鏡頭往目標打一條射線，任何落在目標之前（扣掉 OCCLUSION_SLACK）的命中都算被擋。
 * 打到玩家自己身上的不算 —— 第三人稱時角色幾乎永遠在鏡頭和目標之間，那不是牆。
 */
function projectToScreen(
  anchor: THREE.Vector3,
  camera: THREE.Camera,
  scene: THREE.Scene,
  raycaster: THREE.Raycaster,
  width: number,
  height: number,
): typeof PROJECTION {
  toTarget.copy(anchor).sub(camera.position);
  const fullDist = toTarget.length();
  let occluded = false;
  if (fullDist > 0.05) {
    raycaster.set(camera.position, toTarget.normalize());
    raycaster.near = 0.05;
    raycaster.far = Math.max(0.1, fullDist - OCCLUSION_SLACK);
    occluded = raycaster.intersectObjects(scene.children, true).some((hit) => !isPlayerAvatarHit(hit.object));
  }

  ndc.copy(anchor).project(camera);
  const inFrustum = ndc.z < 1;
  PROJECTION.x = (ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * width;
  PROJECTION.y = (-ndc.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * height;
  PROJECTION.visible =
    inFrustum && !occluded &&
    PROJECTION.x > -OFFSCREEN_MARGIN && PROJECTION.x < width + OFFSCREEN_MARGIN &&
    PROJECTION.y > -OFFSCREEN_MARGIN && PROJECTION.y < height + OFFSCREEN_MARGIN;
  return PROJECTION;
}

/**
 * Lives inside the exterior <Canvas> (see Scene.tsx) so it can project the single nearest
 * interactable's world position into screen space every frame, with real camera-frustum and
 * line-of-sight (occlusion) checks - neither of which the HTML overlay (InteractionPrompt.tsx)
 * can do on its own, since it never sees the THREE.Camera or scene graph.
 *
 * Writes its result into playerBus (see playerBus.ts) rather than React state/context so this
 * never triggers a React re-render on this fast a cadence; InteractionPrompt.tsx polls
 * playerBus.interactionPrompt itself via requestAnimationFrame and applies it as a direct
 * transform, the same "mutate outside React" pattern already used for playerPos/dogPos etc.
 *
 * Renders nothing - this is a logic-only Canvas child, like CameraController.
 */
export function InteractionPromptTracker({ scope = 'island' }: {
  /**
   * Which world this tracker is projecting for.
   *
   * `'island'` ranks everything outdoors: the Home's door, the furniture in reach, the pet, a
   * patch of overgrowth. `'interior'` runs inside the house's own Canvas (a second WebGL context
   * with its own camera and scene) and has exactly one kind of candidate — the furniture the
   * player is standing next to. None of the others exist indoors: there is no door to enter from
   * the inside, the pet stays out on the island, and nothing grows on the floorboards.
   */
  scope?: 'island' | 'interior';
} = {}) {
  const { camera, scene, size } = useThree();
  const { currentView, nearbyBuilding, profile, isWorkoutActive } = useApp();
  // The one structure the player can enter. Avatar.tsx resolves the same Home for its own
  // proximity check; there is no list to search any more.
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);
  // Only tests objects that opted into SIGHTLINE_OCCLUDER_LAYER - see constants/layers.ts. Without
  // this mask the cast brute-forced every triangle in the world, ocean planes included.
  const raycaster = useMemo(() => {
    const r = new THREE.Raycaster();
    r.layers.set(SIGHTLINE_OCCLUDER_LAYER);
    return r;
  }, []);
  // Persists across frames so the on-screen position can ease toward its target instead of
  // snapping every frame (smoothing), while still snapping instantly the moment the *nearest*
  // target actually changes (switching from e.g. the dog to a building shouldn't visibly slide
  // the badge across the screen from one to the other).
  const smoothedRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; key: string | null }>({ x: 0, y: 0, key: null });
  /** 開關那格自己的平滑狀態。`live` 是「上一幀有沒有在畫」，用來決定要不要瞬移過去。 */
  const switchSmoothedRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; live: boolean }>({ x: 0, y: 0, live: false });

  useFrame((_state, rawDelta) => {
    const delta = clampFrameDelta(rawDelta);
    const playerPos = playerBus.playerPos;

    // One tracker instance per Canvas, each gated to the view its Canvas belongs to — the island
    // one must go quiet the moment the player steps indoors, or it would keep projecting the
    // island's candidates through the interior's camera.
    const activeView = scope === 'interior' ? View.BUILDING_INTERIOR : View.HOME;
    const otherView = scope === 'interior' ? View.HOME : View.BUILDING_INTERIOR;
    if (currentView !== activeView || isWorkoutActive || !playerPos) {
      // The idle tracker must NOT clear the prompt while the other one is filling it in. Both
      // Canvases stay mounted (the island keeps rendering behind the interior), so both of these
      // run every frame against one shared field — and whichever happened to run second would
      // win. Clearing only when nobody is writing removes the race instead of relying on the
      // order the two render loops happen to be in.
      const otherTrackerLive = !isWorkoutActive && currentView === otherView;
      if (!otherTrackerLive) playerBus.interactionPrompt = null;
      if (scope === 'island') playerBus.tidyTarget = null;
      // 泡泡同理：只收自己這個場景的那一句，另一個場景的居民可能正在說話。
      if (playerBus.npcSpeech?.scope === scope) playerBus.npcSpeechPrompt = null;
      // 開關那格只有室內這個 tracker 會寫，所以它也只由室內這個 tracker 收拾 —— 島上那個碰都
      // 不碰，兩邊就沒有互相蓋來蓋去的問題（那正是上面那行要處理的事）。
      if (scope === 'interior') {
        playerBus.lightSwitchPrompt = null;
        switchSmoothedRef.current.live = false;
      }
      smoothedRef.current.key = null;
      return;
    }

    // --- Q：牆上的電燈開關 ------------------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // 自己一格，不跟下面那些排名次。它按的是 Q 而不是 E，所以「兩個徽章搶同一個位置就是一次
    // 玩家看不見的擲硬幣」那個理由在這裡不成立：站在沙發旁邊的牆邊，E 坐下和 Q 關燈是兩件互
    // 不衝突的事，兩個都該出現。這也是它以前被排進名次時真正的毛病 —— 房裡只要有一件家具離
    // 你更近，開關的徽章就永遠不會出現，而玩家會以為那面牆上根本沒有開關。
    //
    // 佈置模式排除：那個模式下鏡頭是自由的、角色是不動的，而且它一律當作燈是亮的（見
    // Three/InteriorLighting.tsx），一個按了不會有任何事發生的提示比沒有提示更糟。
    //
    // 掛點是 lib/interiorLights.ts 登記時就算好的世界點，已經沿著面板的法線推離牆面 —— 開關
    // 貼在牆上，錨點如果留在牆面上，遮蔽射線第一個打到的就是它自己所在的那面牆。
    if (scope === 'interior') {
      const sw = playerBus.isBuildMode ? null : nearestLightSwitch(playerPos.x, playerPos.z);
      if (!sw) {
        playerBus.lightSwitchPrompt = null;
        switchSmoothedRef.current.live = false;
      } else {
        const p = projectToScreen(
          ANCHOR_SCRATCH.lightswitch.set(sw.promptX, sw.y, sw.promptZ),
          camera, scene, raycaster, size.width, size.height,
        );
        const s = switchSmoothedRef.current;
        if (!s.live) {
          // 第一幀就位，不要從上一個開關的位置滑過來 —— 走進隔壁房間時那會是一條橫越畫面的線。
          s.x = p.x;
          s.y = p.y;
          s.live = true;
        } else {
          const t = 1 - Math.pow(0.001, delta || 1 / 60);
          s.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(s.x, p.x, t);
          s.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(s.y, p.y, t);
        }
        playerBus.lightSwitchPrompt = { x: s.x, y: s.y, visible: p.visible };
      }
    }

    // --- 居民說的話：泡泡的位置 ---------------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // 不參加下面的排名 —— 泡泡不是一個「按了會做什麼」的東西，它跟提示同時存在（提示寫「繼續聊天」，
    // 泡泡裡是她剛說的那一句）。投影規則跟提示同一個函式，所以被牆擋住時兩個一起消失。
    const speech = playerBus.npcSpeech;
    if (speech && speech.scope === scope) {
      const p = projectToScreen(
        ANCHOR_SCRATCH.speech.copy(speech.anchor), camera, scene, raycaster, size.width, size.height,
      );
      SPEECH_SCREEN.x = p.x;
      SPEECH_SCREEN.y = p.y;
      SPEECH_SCREEN.visible = p.visible;
      playerBus.npcSpeechPrompt = SPEECH_SCREEN;
    } else if (!speech) {
      playerBus.npcSpeechPrompt = null;
    }

    const candidates: Candidate[] = [];

    // The furniture in reach. The one candidate BOTH scopes have, and the only one indoors —
    // its anchor is a finished world point (measured off the piece's own model, see
    // lib/furnitureInteraction.ts), so unlike every other candidate here it gets no height added.
    const interactablePos = playerBus.nearbyInteractablePos;
    if (interactablePos) {
      candidates.push({
        key: 'interactable',
        distance: playerPos.distanceTo(interactablePos),
        anchor: ANCHOR_SCRATCH.interactable.copy(interactablePos),
      });
    }

    // 居民 (constants/npcSocial.ts) — the gardener outdoors, the butler indoors, so this one is in
    // BOTH scopes. The target carries its own scope and is ignored by the other tracker: the two
    // Canvases share one coordinate space, and the interior keeps ticking while the player is
    // outside, so a butler in the living room would otherwise light a prompt on the island.
    const npc = playerBus.npcTarget;
    if (npc && npc.scope === scope) {
      const npcDist = Math.hypot(npc.anchor.x - playerPos.x, npc.anchor.z - playerPos.z);
      if (npcDist < npc.reach) {
        candidates.push({
          key: 'npc',
          distance: npcDist,
          anchor: ANCHOR_SCRATCH.npc.copy(npc.anchor),
        });
      }
    }

    // Everything else there is to point at exists only on the island.
    if (scope === 'island') {
      if (nearbyBuilding && home) {
        const doorPos = getHomeDoorPosition(home);
        candidates.push({
          key: 'building',
          distance: playerPos.distanceTo(doorPos),
          anchor: ANCHOR_SCRATCH.building.set(
            doorPos.x,
            doorPos.y + getHouseVisualHeight(home.style) + HOME_ANCHOR_CLEARANCE,
            doorPos.z
          ),
        });
      }

      const dogPos = playerBus.dogPos;
      if (dogPos) {
        const dogDist = playerPos.distanceTo(dogPos);
        if (dogDist < DOG_TRIGGER_DIST) {
          candidates.push({
            key: 'dog',
            // Ranked by the handicapped distance, triggered by the real one - an equipped companion
            // stands closer than anything the player ever walks up to. See playerBus.dogPromptBias.
            distance: dogDist + (playerBus.dogPromptBias ?? 0),
            anchor: ANCHOR_SCRATCH.dog.set(dogPos.x, dogPos.y + DOG_ANCHOR_HEIGHT, dogPos.z),
          });
        }
      }

      // 旅行商人. Joins the SAME ranking as the front door and the furniture rather than getting
      // a prompt of its own — the brief's §6 (「不要為旅行商人另外建立第二套 Interaction
      // Event」) and the rule this whole file already applies: the player has one action key, so
      // exactly one thing may offer itself at a time.
      //
      // Everything about the candidate comes off the bus, written by the component that is
      // actually sailing the boat (Three/MerchantVisitor.tsx) — including the trigger radius,
      // which is the dock's own (constants/merchantDocks.ts) rather than a number kept here.
      // That matters: a second merchant mooring somewhere tighter carries its own reach, and the
      // field being absent is ALSO how "he has not docked yet / he is casting off" arrives here,
      // so the prompt and the action key go quiet together instead of each deciding separately.
      const merchant = playerBus.merchantTarget;
      if (merchant) {
        const merchantDist = Math.hypot(
          merchant.anchor.x - playerPos.x,
          merchant.anchor.z - playerPos.z,
        );
        if (merchantDist < merchant.reach) {
          candidates.push({
            key: 'merchant',
            distance: merchantDist,
            anchor: ANCHOR_SCRATCH.merchant.copy(merchant.anchor),
          });
        }
      }

      // 整理 — the one interaction 離線回歸 adds. It joins the same ranking as everything else
      // rather than getting a prompt of its own: the player has one action key, and a second badge
      // competing for the same corner of the screen is how a cosy chore turns into clutter.
      //
      // Deliberately NOT handicapped like the companion is. Overgrowth is something the player walks
      // over to, so being the nearest thing genuinely means they are standing in it — and when they
      // are at their own front door with weeds around it, the door is closer to its own anchor than
      // the weeds are to theirs, so 進入我的家 still wins.
      const sprouts = profile?.islandState?.sprouts;
      const tidy =
        sprouts && sprouts.length > 0 ? findTidyTarget(sprouts, playerPos.x, playerPos.z, home) : null;
      playerBus.tidyTarget = tidy;
      if (tidy) {
        const islandScale = 1 + ((profile?.territoryLevel ?? 1) - 1) * 0.4;
        const groundY = getIslandSurfaceY(tidy.x, tidy.z, islandScale);
        candidates.push({
          key: 'tidy',
          distance: Math.hypot(tidy.x - playerPos.x, tidy.z - playerPos.z),
          anchor: ANCHOR_SCRATCH.tidy.set(
            tidy.x,
            groundY + (tidy.wall ? TIDY_WALL_ANCHOR_HEIGHT : TIDY_ANCHOR_HEIGHT),
            tidy.z,
          ),
        });
      }
    }

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      playerBus.interactionPrompt = null;
      smoothedRef.current.key = null;
      return;
    }

    // Only the single nearest candidate is ever shown - see the module doc comment.
    candidates.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
    const target = candidates[0];

    // 視錐 + 遮蔽 + 螢幕座標，跟上面那格開關走同一個函式（見 projectToScreen）。
    const { x: px, y: py, visible } = projectToScreen(
      target.anchor, camera, scene, raycaster, size.width, size.height,
    );

    if (smoothedRef.current.key !== target.key) {
      // Switched to a different nearest target this frame - snap instead of easing from the
      // previous target's old screen position.
      smoothedRef.current.x = px;
      smoothedRef.current.y = py;
      smoothedRef.current.key = target.key;
    } else {
      // Frame-rate independent exponential smoothing (same shape as elsewhere in this codebase,
      // e.g. Avatar.tsx's smoothedZoomOpacityRef) so the badge eases toward the object's current
      // projected position instead of jittering with it frame to frame.
      const t = 1 - Math.pow(0.001, delta || 1 / 60);
      smoothedRef.current.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(smoothedRef.current.x, px, t);
      smoothedRef.current.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(smoothedRef.current.y, py, t);
    }

    playerBus.interactionPrompt = {
      key: target.key,
      x: smoothedRef.current.x,
      y: smoothedRef.current.y,
      visible,
    };
  });

  return null;
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { advanceInteriorLights, candleFlicker, interiorLights } from '../../lib/interiorLights';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';

/**
 * 家裡的光，開著和關著兩種樣子。
 *
 * 這個檔案存在的理由，就是 lib/interiorLights.ts 開頭那一段：房間的亮度不是房間自己的。室內
 * 只有一盞平行光、一盞環境光、一張 environment map 和一盞跟著玩家的補光，四個都是整棟共用的，
 * 每間房自己的吸頂燈在總量裡只佔一小份。所以「關燈」不是關掉幾盞燈，是把整棟的光一起換成另外
 * 一組值 —— 而換過去的那組值不能只是「一樣的光但比較暗」，否則畫面只會變灰。
 *
 * 暗下來的那一組是這樣選的：
 *
 *   顏色要換邊。   亮著的家是暖的（#fffef4 / #fffde6，鎢絲燈）。關了燈之後房間唯一的光源是
 *                  窗外，而那是月光，是冷的。暖光調暗只是變成暗暗的暖光，看起來像黃昏或像
 *                  故障；換成冷的藍才會讀成「晚上」。
 *   環境貼圖要幾乎歸零。 HDRI 是這裡最大的一份亮度，而且是整棟均勻的一份 —— 它不歸零，房間
 *                  就會是一個各處一樣亮的灰盒子，蠟燭照不出任何對比。
 *   曝光要壓一點。 只壓一點（{@link DARK_EXPOSURE}）。這是讓黑真的變黑的那一步，但壓過頭
 *                  燭光也會跟著沉下去 —— 火焰本身用 `toneMapped={false}` 躲開這件事。
 *
 * 佈置模式一律當作燈是亮的：在暗房間裡搬家具是搬不了的。它動的是亮度不是開關狀態，所以退出
 * 佈置模式之後燈還是玩家離開時的樣子。
 */

// --- 亮著的家 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const LIT_AMBIENT = 0.7;
const LIT_AMBIENT_COLOR = new THREE.Color('#fffef4');
const LIT_SUN = 1.5;
const LIT_SUN_COLOR = new THREE.Color('#fffde6');
const LIT_FOLLOW = 2.2;
const LIT_ENV = 1;
const LIT_EXPOSURE = 1;

// --- 關了燈的家 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/**
 * 不是 0。全黑的房間不是氣氛，是一個看不見自己在哪裡的房間 —— 玩家會走不出去，也找不回牆上
 * 那個開關。這一點點藍是「窗外的月光」，剛好夠讓牆和地板保有輪廓，而所有的細節都留給燭光。
 */
const DARK_AMBIENT = 0.13;
const DARK_AMBIENT_COLOR = new THREE.Color('#6b86c4');
const DARK_SUN = 0.16;
const DARK_SUN_COLOR = new THREE.Color('#a8c6ff');
const DARK_FOLLOW = 0;
const DARK_ENV = 0.05;
const DARK_EXPOSURE = 0.86;

/** 每幀重用，不在迴圈裡配置 THREE.Color —— 跟 Torch.tsx 的火焰色一樣的理由。 */
const AMBIENT_SCRATCH = new THREE.Color();
const SUN_SCRATCH = new THREE.Color();
const CANDLE_SCRATCH = new THREE.Vector3();

/**
 * 整棟的環境光與太陽光，外加曝光和 environment map 的強度。
 *
 * 也是全場唯一推進 {@link advanceInteriorLights} 的地方 —— 亮度的緩動一幀只能走一步，走兩步
 * 就等於速率快了一倍。其他所有讀 `interiorLights.level` 的人都只讀不寫。
 */
export function InteriorAmbience({ isBuildMode }: { isBuildMode: boolean }) {
  const { gl, scene } = useThree();
  const ambientRef = useRef<THREE.AmbientLight>(null);
  const sunRef = useRef<THREE.DirectionalLight>(null);

  useFrame((_state, delta) => {
    const level = advanceInteriorLights(delta, isBuildMode);

    if (ambientRef.current) {
      ambientRef.current.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DARK_AMBIENT, LIT_AMBIENT, level);
      ambientRef.current.color.copy(AMBIENT_SCRATCH.copy(DARK_AMBIENT_COLOR).lerp(LIT_AMBIENT_COLOR, level));
    }
    if (sunRef.current) {
      sunRef.current.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DARK_SUN, LIT_SUN, level);
      sunRef.current.color.copy(SUN_SCRATCH.copy(DARK_SUN_COLOR).lerp(LIT_SUN_COLOR, level));
    }
    scene.environmentIntensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DARK_ENV, LIT_ENV, level);
    gl.toneMappingExposure = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DARK_EXPOSURE, LIT_EXPOSURE, level);
  });

  return (
    <>
      <ambientLight ref={ambientRef} intensity={LIT_AMBIENT} color={LIT_AMBIENT_COLOR} />
      {/* The one shadow-casting light indoors.
          Its shadow camera used to be left at three.js's default, which is a
          10x10 orthographic box at the origin — while the house spans +/-18
          (ROOM_GRID_SIZE 12 + ROOM_HALF_SIZE 6). Shadows therefore existed over
          roughly 8% of the floor area, with a hard invisible boundary running
          through the starter room: the player's own shadow blinked on as they
          walked into the box and off as they left it, and furniture sitting on
          the edge was half shadowed. That is the "sometimes there's a shadow on
          the sofa when I walk up to it" report.

          Bounds now cover the whole house with room for one ring of expansion,
          and the map is doubled to keep ~46 texels per world unit over that
          larger area. `normalBias` is what removes the blotchy self-shadowing
          (shadow acne) on flat-ish surfaces — offsetting along the surface
          normal rather than in depth, so it doesn't detach contact shadows the
          way a large plain `bias` would.

          關了燈之後它不會被關掉，只是變暗變藍：月光也有影子，而一個沒有任何方向性的暗房間會
          變成一張平的剪影。 */}
      <directionalLight
        ref={sunRef}
        position={[5, 12, 4]}
        intensity={LIT_SUN}
        color={LIT_SUN_COLOR}
        castShadow
        shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
        shadow-camera-left={-22}
        shadow-camera-right={22}
        shadow-camera-top={22}
        shadow-camera-bottom={-22}
        shadow-camera-near={0.5}
        shadow-camera-far={60}
        shadow-normalBias={0.035}
        shadow-bias={-0.0008}
      />
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 一間房的吸頂燈。
 *
 * 燈關了它就真的滅掉（強度 0），而不是變暗 —— 它是房間裡唯一一盞「燈具」，其他三個都是為了讓
 * 房間看得見而存在的假光。這也是為什麼它值得自己跑一個 useFrame：房間是動態增建的，一間新蓋
 * 的房間要自己知道現在是不是關著燈。
 */
export function CeilingLight() {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null);
  useFrame(() => {
    if (ref.current) ref.current.intensity = interiorLights.level;
  });
  return <pointLight ref={ref} position={[0, 4.2, 0]} intensity={1} distance={15} decay={1.2} color="#ffdca8" />;
}

/**
 * Dynamic Player-Following Fill Light to ensure character is always brilliantly illuminated in
 * corners — 燈關了之後整個讓位給燭光，因為它正是「不管你在哪裡都看得清楚」的那盞光，而那恰好
 * 是關燈要拿掉的東西。
 */
export function PlayerFollowLight() {
  const lightRef = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null);

  useFrame(() => {
    const playerPos = playerBus.playerPos;
    if (playerPos && lightRef.current) {
      if (lightRef.current.position.x === 0 && lightRef.current.position.z === 0) {
        lightRef.current.position.x = playerPos.x;
        lightRef.current.position.y = playerPos.y + 3.5;
        lightRef.current.position.z = playerPos.z;
      } else {
        lightRef.current.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(lightRef.current.position.x, playerPos.x, 0.15);
        lightRef.current.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(lightRef.current.position.y, playerPos.y + 3.5, 0.15);
        lightRef.current.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(lightRef.current.position.z, playerPos.z, 0.15);
      }
      // 強度歸零，而不是 `visible = false`。見 CandleGlow 上面那一段：把一盞燈藏起來會改變場景
      // 的燈數，而燈數是每個材質 shader 的編譯參數之一，所以「關燈」會變成「重編整個房間」。
      lightRef.current.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(DARK_FOLLOW, LIT_FOLLOW, interiorLights.level);
    }
  });

  return <pointLight ref={lightRef} intensity={LIT_FOLLOW} distance={12} decay={1.3} color="#fffbf0" />;
}

/**
 * 燭光 —— 關了燈之後房間裡唯一真正的光源。
 *
 * 兩盞而不是一盞，而且不是「同一盞開兩次」：
 *
 *   核心   很近、掉得很快（decay 2、distance 3.4）。它只照亮拿著蠟燭的那雙手和那張臉，是
 *          讓角色自己看起來是「被火照著」而不是「站在一片橘色裡」的那一盞。
 *   房間   遠、掉得慢（decay 1.5、distance 10）。它是牆和家具身上那一圈會走動的暖色。
 *
 * 一盞燈沒辦法同時做到這兩件事：把 distance 拉到照得到牆，臉上就沒有近距離該有的爆亮；把
 * decay 調到臉上好看，房間就整個黑掉。
 *
 * 位置每幀跟著手上火焰的世界座標（playerBus.candlePos）。拿不到就退回玩家頭附近 —— 佈置模式、
 * 或是 Avatar 還沒掛上來的那幾幀，房間仍然要有光。
 *
 * 不投影：一盞會投影的點光源等於每幀從六個方向重畫整個場景，而 Torch.tsx 已經替這個決定寫過
 * 一次理由了。房間的形狀由那盞變藍的平行光維持。
 *
 * ## 這兩盞燈永遠不會被藏起來，只會被關到 0
 *
 * 這是「按下開關之後要頓一下」的那個原因，而且它一點都不明顯。three.js 把場景裡「有幾盞點光源、
 * 幾盞平行光」編進每一個材質的 shader 編譯參數裡（WebGLPrograms 的 cache key）。所以 `visible`
 * 從 false 翻成 true 不是省下一盞燈那麼簡單 —— 它換掉了整個場景的燈數，於是每一個正在畫的材質
 * 都得用新的參數重編一次程式。實測第一次關燈要編 17 支 shader（把 linkProgram 掛起來數的），
 * 而那 17 支就是玩家按下 Q 之後畫面卡住的那一下。
 *
 * 改成強度歸零之後，燈數從頭到尾不變，一支都不用重編（實測 0）。代價是三盞強度為 0 的點光源
 * 仍然會被逐像素算一次 —— 那是每幀幾乎量不到的成本，換掉一次看得見的頓挫。
 *
 * 同一條規則也套用在 PlayerFollowLight 上，它以前也在藏自己，以及每一件會發光的家具
 * （Three/FixtureLight.tsx）—— 那裡是這條規則最要緊的地方：燈具是玩家每間房放最多的東西，
 * 一間佈置過的房間一次要藏掉六盞點光源，於是整個房間跟著重編。
 */
export function CandleGlow() {
  const coreRef = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null);
  const roomRef = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const dark = 1 - interiorLights.level;
    const core = coreRef.current;
    const room = roomRef.current;
    if (!core || !room) return;

    if (dark <= 0.01) {
      core.intensity = 0;
      room.intensity = 0;
      return;
    }

    const at = playerBus.candlePos
      ?? (playerBus.playerPos ? CANDLE_SCRATCH.copy(playerBus.playerPos).setY(playerBus.playerPos.y + 1.3) : null);
    if (at) {
      core.position.copy(at);
      room.position.copy(at);
    }

    // 同一個 candleFlicker，跟火焰的形狀共用 —— 兩邊各自算一次自己的隨機，光和火就會不同步，
    // 那看起來會像兩個東西。同一個 Canvas 所以是同一個時鐘。
    const f = candleFlicker(state.clock.getElapsedTime());
    core.intensity = 2.4 * f * dark;
    room.intensity = 5.4 * f * dark;
  });

  return (
    <>
      <pointLight ref={coreRef} intensity={0} distance={3.4} decay={2} color="#ffe3b0" />
      <pointLight ref={roomRef} intensity={0} distance={10} decay={1.5} color="#ffb367" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## src/components/Three/InteriorNpcs.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { INTERIOR_NPCS } from '../../constants/npcs';
import {
  ROOM_INNER_HALF_SIZE,
  INTERIOR_FLOOR_Y,
  buildWalkableRects,
  getRoomNeighbours,
  toShellRooms,
  type ShellRoom,
  type WalkRect,
} from '../../constants/interiorShell';
import { ROOM_GRID_SIZE, ROOM_HALF_SIZE, parseUnlockedRooms } from '../../constants/rooms';
import { resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture } from '../../lib/furniturePlacement';
import type { PlacedItem } from '../../types';
import { NpcTerritory, NpcWalker, NpcWaypoint } from './NpcWalker';
import { HippoFacilityFx, HippoFx, createHippoBrain } from './HippoButler';

/**
 * 家裡的 NPC —— 拿著放大鏡在房間之間巡視、每 10 步就近玩一件設施的河馬管家。
 *
 * 跟 IslandNpcs.tsx 對稱：那邊回答「島上哪裡可以走」，這邊回答「屋裡哪裡可以走」。作息在
 * Three/HippoButler.tsx。
 *
 * 他能站的地方就是 `buildWalkableRects` 算出來的那組矩形，跟玩家能站的地方是同一組規則、只是換
 * 一個身體半徑。穿門是「路線」而不是「尋路」：房間是凸的矩形、門在牆的正中央，所以「房間裡任一
 * 點 → 門口 → 門的另一側 → 隔壁房間裡任一點」這條折線的每一段都完整落在一個凸區域裡。
 */

/** 管家的身體半徑。比玩家的 0.35 大一點：他矮但寬。 */
const NPC_RADIUS = 0.4;

/** 挑房間裡的點時，往內縮的比例。 */
const ROOM_INSET = 0.72;

/** 到站之後有多少機率走去隔壁房間。 */
const DOOR_CHANCE = 0.45;

/** 同一間房裡的新目的地至少要離現在多遠。 */
const MIN_TRIP = 2.5;

const PICK_ATTEMPTS = 12;

const SIDES = [
  { key: 'hasN', dx: 0, dz: 1 },
  { key: 'hasS', dx: 0, dz: -1 },
  { key: 'hasE', dx: 1, dz: 0 },
  { key: 'hasW', dx: -1, dz: 0 },
] as const;

function clamp(v: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return v < min ? min : v > max ? max : v;
}

function inRect(rect: WalkRect, x: number, z: number): boolean {
  return x >= rect.minX && x <= rect.maxX && z >= rect.minZ && z <= rect.maxZ;
}

export const InteriorNpcs = React.memo(function InteriorNpcs({ isBuildMode }: { isBuildMode: boolean }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const interior = profile?.interiorData;
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera);

  const territory = useMemo(() => {
    const rooms: ShellRoom[] = toShellRooms(
      parseUnlockedRooms(Array.from(new Set(['living', ...(interior?.unlockedRooms || [])]))),
    );
    const items = interior?.placements || [];
    const rects = buildWalkableRects(rooms, NPC_RADIUS);
    const inner = ROOM_INNER_HALF_SIZE - NPC_RADIUS;

    const isFree = (x: number, z: number): boolean => {
      const pushed = resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture(x, z, NPC_RADIUS + 0.15, items);
      return pushed.x === x && pushed.z === z;
    };

    /** 站得住：在牆內，而且沒有被家具占著。 */
    const canStand = (x: number, z: number): boolean =>
      rects.some((r) => inRect(r, x, z)) && isFree(x, z);

    const roomAt = (x: number, z: number): ShellRoom | null => {
      let best: ShellRoom | null = null;
      let bestDist = Infinity;
      for (const r of rooms) {
        const d = Math.max(Math.abs(x - r.cx), Math.abs(z - r.cz));
        if (d < bestDist) {
          bestDist = d;
          best = r;
        }
      }
      return best;
    };

    const spotIn = (room: ShellRoom, awayFromX?: number, awayFromZ?: number): NpcWaypoint => {
      for (let i = 0; i < PICK_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
        const x = room.cx + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * inner * ROOM_INSET;
        const z = room.cz + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * inner * ROOM_INSET;
        if (awayFromX !== undefined && awayFromZ !== undefined
          && Math.hypot(x - awayFromX, z - awayFromZ) < MIN_TRIP) continue;
        if (!isFree(x, z)) continue;
        return { x, z };
      }
      return { x: room.cx, z: room.cz };
    };

    /** 從 here 穿過 side 那扇門到隔壁房間的兩個門口點（近側那一點等門開）。 */
    const doorway = (here: ShellRoom, side: { dx: number; dz: number }): NpcWaypoint[] => {
      const gate = { x: here.cx + side.dx * ROOM_HALF_SIZE, z: here.cz + side.dz * ROOM_HALF_SIZE };
      return [
        { x: here.cx + side.dx * inner, z: here.cz + side.dz * inner, gate },
        { x: here.cx + side.dx * (ROOM_GRID_SIZE - inner), z: here.cz + side.dz * (ROOM_GRID_SIZE - inner) },
      ];
    };

    const gridOf = (r: ShellRoom) => ({
      gx: Math.round(r.cx / ROOM_GRID_SIZE),
      gz: Math.round(r.cz / ROOM_GRID_SIZE),
    });

    const terr: NpcTerritory = {
      pickRoute(from): NpcWaypoint[] {
        if (rooms.length === 0) return [];
        const here = roomAt(from.x, from.z);
        if (!here) return [];
        const neighbours = getRoomNeighbours(here, rooms);
        const open = SIDES.filter(s => neighbours[s.key]);
        if (open.length > 0 && Math.random() < DOOR_CHANCE) {
          const side = open[Math.floor(Math.random() * open.length)];
          const hg = gridOf(here);
          const next = rooms.find((r) => {
            const g = gridOf(r);
            return g.gx === hg.gx + side.dx && g.gz === hg.gz + side.dz;
          });
          if (next) return [...doorway(here, side), spotIn(next)];
        }
        return [spotIn(here, from.x, from.z)];
      },
      routeTo(from, to) {
        const here = roomAt(from.x, from.z);
        const there = roomAt(to.x, to.z);
        if (!here || !there) return null;
        if (here === there) return [{ x: to.x, z: to.z }];
        // 只走到隔壁：兩間房格子相鄰、而且中間那面牆上真的有門。
        const hg = gridOf(here);
        const tg = gridOf(there);
        const side = SIDES.find((s) => tg.gx === hg.gx + s.dx && tg.gz === hg.gz + s.dz);
        if (!side || !getRoomNeighbours(here, rooms)[side.key]) return null;
        return [...doorway(here, side), { x: to.x, z: to.z }];
      },
      contain(p) {
        const pushed = resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture(p.x, p.z, NPC_RADIUS, items);
        p.x = pushed.x;
        p.z = pushed.z;
        if (rects.length === 0) return;
        if (rects.some(r => inRect(r, p.x, p.z))) return;
        let bestX = p.x;
        let bestZ = p.z;
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        for (const r of rects) {
          const x = clamp(p.x, r.minX, r.maxX);
          const z = clamp(p.z, r.minZ, r.maxZ);
          const d = (x - p.x) * (x - p.x) + (z - p.z) * (z - p.z);
          if (d < bestDist) {
            bestDist = d;
            bestX = x;
            bestZ = z;
          }
        }
        p.x = bestX;
        p.z = bestZ;
      },
      groundY() {
        return INTERIOR_FLOOR_Y;
      },
    };
    return { terr, canStand, items };
  }, [interior]);

  // 腦子只建一次，它看到的家具與地板永遠是最新的那一份。
  const latest = useRef(territory);
  latest.current = territory;
  const cameraRef = useRef(camera);
  cameraRef.current = camera;
  const fx = useMemo(() => new HippoFx(), []);
  const brain = useMemo(() => createHippoBrain({
    fx,
    getPlacements: (): PlacedItem[] => latest.current.items,
    canStand: (x, z) => latest.current.canStand(x, z),
    camera: () => cameraRef.current,
  }), [fx]);

  // 佈置模式下收起來：他的身體會擋住擺放射線，而且卸載會讓腦子放掉手上的設施與聲音。
  if (isBuildMode) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {INTERIOR_NPCS.map((npc) => (
        <NpcWalker
          key={npc.id}
          npcId={npc.id}
          name={npc.name}
          scope="interior"
          kind={npc.kind}
          height={npc.height}
          spawnX={npc.x}
          spawnZ={npc.z}
          spawnRotation={npc.rotation}
          territory={territory.terr}
          opensDoors
          brain={npc.kind === 'hippoButler' ? brain : undefined}
        />
      ))}
      <HippoFacilityFx fx={fx} />
    </>
  );
});
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useMemo, memo } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { getResolvedRockPositions, getRockScale } from '../../utils/placementRules';
import { usePlayerHome } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import { useCameraBlocker } from '../../constants/layers';
import { GroundCover } from './GroundCover';
import { getTerrainMaterial, setTerrainIslandScale } from './groundMaterial';
import {
  ISLAND_SURFACE_Y,
  ISLAND_TERRAIN,
  MOUND_BASE_SINK,
  MOUND_COLOR,
  PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR,
  PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR,
} from '../../constants/terrain';

export function Island() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const territoryLevel = profile?.territoryLevel || 1;
  const islandScale = 1 + (territoryLevel - 1) * 0.4; // Increased growth to 40% per level
  const solidTerrainRef = useCameraBlocker<THREE.Group>();

  /**
   * The terrain materials read the shared ground field in LOCAL island units, so they need the
   * XZ scale this group applies. Set during render rather than in an effect because the very
   * first frame after a territory upgrade is drawn before effects flush, and a frame of the
   * island shaded at the previous scale is a visible jump in the lawn's pattern.
   */
  setTerrainIslandScale(islandScale);

  return (
    <>
    <group scale={[islandScale, 1, islandScale]}>
      {/* Main Island Body.

          The plateau, the skirt and the underside are three meshes that meet
          edge-to-edge and never overlap, rather than a solid cylinder with a
          second, slightly-taller cylinder stacked on it. That stack used to put
          two opaque discs 0.02 apart across the whole r=4.5 centre of the
          island, which is far finer than the depth buffer can resolve at this
          camera distance - the plateau flickered between two greens as the
          camera moved. The lighter green the upper disc contributed is now a
          vertex-coloured band on the plateau itself (PlateauSurface), the same
          way SandEdge has always handled its dry -> wet transition. */}
      <PlateauSurface />

      {/* Body skirt - open-ended, so it contributes no cap of its own to
          conflict with the plateau it shares a rim with.

          Takes the 'shore' grading: grain, and nothing else. A vertical face has no slope to
          express, and pulling its colour around with the lushness field would recolour the
          island's own cliff by how much grass happens to be growing on top of it. */}
      <mesh
        position={[0, (ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseY) / 2, 0]}
        receiveShadow
        material={getTerrainMaterial('shore', PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR)}
      >
        <cylinderGeometry
          args={[
            ISLAND_TERRAIN.plateauRadius,
            ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseRadius,
            ISLAND_SURFACE_Y - ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseY,
            32,
            1,
            true,
          ]}
        />
      </mesh>

      {/* Underside. Only ever seen through the water from a low angle, but the
          skirt above is open-ended so something has to close it. */}
      <mesh position={[0, ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseY, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <circleGeometry args={[ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseRadius, 32]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR} />
      </mesh>

      {/* Raised terrain - a structure, so it blocks both the camera and interaction prompts (see
          constants/layers.ts), and the only part of the island that opts into either. The flat
          plateau, the skirt, the underside,
          the sand and the grass are all deliberately left out: the camera is clamped above ground
          level and every prompt anchor floats above its target, so a flat surface can never come
          between the two - it would only cost triangle tests. Grass exclusion also fixes a real
          glitch, where a blade clipping the sightline counted as "blocked" and blinked the prompt
          out with nothing actually in front of it. */}
      <group ref={solidTerrainRef}>
        {/* Raised mounds. Each clears the plateau by well over
            MIN_SURFACE_SEPARATION, so these are genuine elevation changes rather
            than duplicate surfaces, and their buried bottom caps are hidden by
            the plateau instead of fighting it. */}
        {ISLAND_TERRAIN.mounds.map((m, i) => {
          // Sunk into the plateau so the skirt reads as emerging from the ground
          // rather than as a disc resting on it. The depth is shared with the
          // walk height (MOUND_BASE_SINK) because it sets the slope's steepness,
          // and a walker has to be able to stand on the slope that is drawn.
          const bottomY = ISLAND_SURFACE_Y - MOUND_BASE_SINK;
          return (
            <mesh
              key={i}
              position={[m.cx, (m.topY + bottomY) / 2, m.cz]}
              receiveShadow
              material={getTerrainMaterial('mound', MOUND_COLOR)}
            >
              {/* 32 sides rather than 12. The walk height treats the mound as a
                  circle, and a 12-gon's flat top pulls in 8.5cm from that circle
                  at each facet's midpoint - which is 8.5cm of ground missing from
                  under the feet of anyone walking near the rim. At 32 the two
                  disagree by ~1cm, below the sole depth the rig already has. */}
              <cylinderGeometry args={[m.radiusTop, m.radiusBottom, m.topY - bottomY, 32]} />
            </mesh>
          );
        })}

        {/* Rocky Outcrops */}
        <RockyTerrain islandScale={islandScale} />
      </group>

      {/* Sand Edge - dry sand grades into wet sand, then fades toward the
          waterline so the beach doesn't cut hard into the ocean mesh */}
      <SandEdge />
    </group>

    {/* 地被層 —— the lawn (Three/GroundCover.tsx).

        A SIBLING of the island group rather than a child, and that placement is the whole
        reason it is not still inside: everything above is drawn inside
        `scale={[islandScale, 1, islandScale]}`, which is right for a disc and wrong for
        anything STANDING on it. A blade in that group is stretched 2.6x horizontally and not
        at all vertically on a level-5 island. Out here it works in world units and stays the
        same shape however far the territory grows. */}
    <GroundCover islandScale={islandScale} />
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The single flat surface the island is walked on, drawn once.
 *
 * A ring with `innerRadius` 0 is a disc built from concentric rows of vertices,
 * unlike a cylinder cap (a fan from one centre vertex) or a circle, so it can
 * carry the radial colour band that replaced the old stacked terrain layer.
 * The band is a smoothstep across exactly the radii that layer occupied - its
 * flat top at 4.5 and the base of its skirt at 4.8 - so the plateau reads the
 * same from above as it did while being two meshes.
 */
function PlateauSurface() {
  const geometry = useMemo(() => {
    const { plateauRadius, innerTintRadius, innerTintFadeRadius } = ISLAND_TERRAIN;
    // 32 concentric rows: enough for the tint to grade smoothly rather than
    // stepping between rows, and still a trivial vertex count for a static mesh.
    const geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0, plateauRadius, 32, 32);
    const posAttr = geo.attributes.position;
    const colors = new Float32Array(posAttr.count * 3);

    const inner = new THREE.Color(PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR);
    const outer = new THREE.Color(PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR);
    const c = new THREE.Color();

    for (let i = 0; i < posAttr.count; i++) {
      // RingGeometry is authored in the XY plane; the mesh rotates it flat.
      const r = Math.hypot(posAttr.getX(i), posAttr.getY(i));
      const t = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(r, innerTintRadius, innerTintFadeRadius);
      c.copy(inner).lerp(outer, t);
      colors[i * 3] = c.r;
      colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g;
      colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
    }

    geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    return geo;
  }, []);

  return (
    <mesh
      position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0]}
      rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}
      geometry={geometry}
      receiveShadow
      // White base, because this mesh's colour arrives as the vertex attribute above; the
      // material multiplies it and then grades it against the shared ground field. See
      // groundMaterial.ts for why the two greens stay here rather than moving into the shader.
      material={getTerrainMaterial('plateau', '#ffffff', true)}
    />
  );
}

function SandEdge() {
  const geometry = useMemo(() => {
    // Extra height segments so the vertex-color gradient below has enough
    // rows to approximate a smooth (non-linear) dry -> wet -> submerged curve.
    const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(5.93, 7.07, 0.8, 32, 24);
    const posAttr = geo.attributes.position;
    const colors = new Float32Array(posAttr.count * 3);

    const dry = new THREE.Color('#fef08a');
    const wet = new THREE.Color('#b8823a');
    const submerged = wet.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color('#2dd4bf'), 0.45);
    const c = new THREE.Color();

    for (let i = 0; i < posAttr.count; i++) {
      const y = posAttr.getY(i);
      // Local y=+0.4 is the dry inland top; local y=-0.25 sits at the
      // waterline (world y=-0.5); local y=-0.4 is the fully submerged bottom.
      // The bands are spread across most of the visible slope (not just a
      // sliver right at the shoreline) so the gradient reads clearly under
      // the scene's lighting/tone-mapping, per the coastline transition request.
      const dryToWet = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, -0.05, 0.3);
      c.copy(dry).lerp(wet, dryToWet);
      const wetToSubmerged = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, -0.35, -0.1);
      c.lerp(submerged, wetToSubmerged);
      colors[i * 3] = c.r;
      colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g;
      colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
    }

    geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    return geo;
  }, []);

  return (
    <mesh
      position={[0, -0.25, 0]}
      geometry={geometry}
      material={getTerrainMaterial('shore', '#ffffff', true)}
    />
  );
}

function RockyTerrain({ islandScale }: { islandScale: number }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();

  // Rocks are pushed clear of the player's Home so they never poke through its walls.
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);

  const rocks = useMemo(() => {
    // Get resolved positions. The getResolvedRockPositions function handles auto-pushing
    const resolvedPositions = getResolvedRockPositions(islandScale, home);

    return resolvedPositions.map((resolvedPos, i) => ({
      // Note: resolvedPos is already scaled by islandScale inside getResolvedRockPositions.
      // Since it is inside the scale={[islandScale, 1, islandScale]} root group,
      // we need to divide by islandScale to counteract the double-scaling!
      position: [resolvedPos[0] / islandScale, resolvedPos[1], resolvedPos[2] / islandScale] as [number, number, number],
      // Shared with the walk height, which has to know how big the rock it is putting the
      // player on top of actually is - see getRockScale.
      scale: getRockScale(i),
      rotation: [i * 0.5, i * 0.8, i * 1.2] as [number, number, number]
    }));
  }, [islandScale, home]);

  return (
    <group>
      {rocks.map((rock, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} position={rock.position} scale={rock.scale} rotation={rock.rotation} castShadow receiveShadow>
          <dodecahedronGeometry args={[1, 0]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#64748b" roughness={0.9} />
        </mesh>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}


/*
 * DELETED: `Grass` / `GrassMemo` — 520 identical 4 cm boxes on a uniform `sqrt(random()) * 5.1`
 * scatter, one colour, one size, half of every blade buried below the plateau.
 *
 * It is now Three/GroundCover.tsx, drawn from constants/groundCover.ts and scattered against the
 * shared field in lib/groundField.ts. Three things moved rather than being added on top of it:
 * the vertex-shader wind (kept, but as a height-weighted BEND so the roots cannot lift out of
 * the ground, and driven by the island's one wind clock rather than a private `elapsedTime`),
 * the single InstancedMesh (kept, now one per layer), and the density (no longer uniform — it is
 * whatever the ground material is already shading as lush).
 */
```

## src/components/Three/IslandDecorations.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { TREASURE_REWARD_FRAGMENTS, TREASURE_REWARD_XP } from '../../context/useEconomyActions';
import { WeatherType } from '../../types';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { findNearestValidPlacement, findRandomValidPlacement, HomeObstacle } from '../../utils/placementRules';
import { getWeatherSwayFactors } from '../../utils/weatherSway';
import { tintableInstances } from './instanceColor';
import { usePlayerHome } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import {
  DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS,
  getIslandDecalY,
  getIslandSurfaceY,
  ISLAND_SURFACE_Y,
  PATHWAY_BASE_POINTS,
} from '../../constants/terrain';

// Shared scratch objects for the instanced decoration groups below. Each of them writes a few
// dozen instance matrices per frame, and allocating an Object3D/Vector3 per instance per frame
// would put more garbage on the heap than the transforms themselves cost to compute.
const DUMMY = new THREE.Object3D();
const OFFSET = new THREE.Vector3();
const FLORA_COLOR = new THREE.Color();

// Slab facings are rolled once at module load. They used to call Math.random() inline in the JSX,
// so every re-render of the zone gave each slab a new rotation - a visible twitch plus a matrix
// recompute for no reason.
const GARDEN_SLABS = ([[-1.2, 0, -1], [-0.4, 0, -0.6], [0.4, 0, -0.2], [1.2, 0, 0.2]] as const).map(
  (pos) => ({ pos, spin: Math.random() })
);

function GardenZone({
  position,
  scale = 1,
  islandScale,
}: { position: [number, number, number], scale?: number, islandScale: number }) {
  const { weather } = useApp();
  // The whole zone sits on whatever the terrain is under its centre, not on a
  // constant. At territory level 2 this zone lands on the raised mound, where a
  // hard-coded plateau height sank the trees and flowers 0.1 into the hillside
  // and buried the stone path under it entirely.
  const yBase = getIslandSurfaceY(position[0], position[2], islandScale);
  const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  
  useFrame((state) => {
    if (groupRef.current) {
      const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
      // Gentle wind sway adjusted by weather
      const { speedMult, swayAmt } = getWeatherSwayFactors(weather);

      groupRef.current.children.forEach((child, i) => {
        if (child.name === 'sway') {
          child.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 1.5 * speedMult + i) * 0.05 * swayAmt;
          child.rotation.x = Math.cos(t * 1.2 * speedMult + i) * 0.03 * swayAmt;
        }
      });
    }
  });

  return (
    <group ref={groupRef} position={[position[0], yBase, position[2]]} scale={scale}>
      {/* Stone Path. Each slab takes its height from the terrain under that
          slab rather than from a shared local lift: the group sits at the
          plateau height, so a fixed local +0.01 left every slab 0.01 above the
          ground (z-fighting) and buried any slab that fell on a mound. The
          local Y here is the world decal height converted back into the
          group's scaled local frame. */}
      {GARDEN_SLABS.map((slab, i) => {
        const worldX = position[0] + slab.pos[0] * scale;
        const worldZ = position[2] + slab.pos[2] * scale;
        const localY = (getIslandDecalY(worldX, worldZ, islandScale) - yBase) / scale;
        return (
          <mesh key={i} position={[slab.pos[0], localY, slab.pos[2]]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, slab.spin]}>
            <circleGeometry args={[0.3, 8]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#94a3b8" {...DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS} />
          </mesh>
        );
      })}
      
      {/* Small Trees */}
      <group position={[-2, 0, -2]} name="sway">
        <mesh position={[0, 0.8, 0]} castShadow>
          <cylinderGeometry args={[0.1, 0.15, 1.6]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#78350f" />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, 2, 0]} castShadow>
          <sphereGeometry args={[0.8, 8, 8]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color={weather === WeatherType.SNOW ? "#14532d" : "#166534"} />
        </mesh>
        {weather === WeatherType.SNOW && (
          <mesh position={[0, 2.55, 0]}>
            <coneGeometry args={[0.9, 0.4, 8]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" roughness={0.9} />
          </mesh>
        )}
      </group>

      {/* Flowers */}
      {[[-1.5, 0, 1], [-2, 0, 0.5], [-1, 0, 2], [1.5, 0, -1.5], [2, 0, -1]].map((pos, i) => (
        <group key={i} position={[pos[0], 0.2, pos[2]]} name="sway">
          <mesh position={[0, 0, 0]}>
            <cylinderGeometry args={[0.02, 0.02, 0.4]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={weather === WeatherType.SNOW ? "#3f6a45" : "#22c55e"} />
          </mesh>
          <mesh position={[0, 0.25, 0]}>
            <sphereGeometry args={[0.15, 8, 8]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={i % 2 === 0 ? "#ec4899" : "#f59e0b"} />
          </mesh>
          {weather === WeatherType.SNOW && (
            <mesh position={[0, 0.36, 0]}>
              <sphereGeometry args={[0.09, 6, 6]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#ffffff" roughness={0.9} />
            </mesh>
          )}
        </group>
      ))}
      <pointLight position={[0, 1, 0]} intensity={1} distance={6} color="#bef264" />
    </group>
  );
}

function SmallStone({
  position, 
  scale = 1, 
  rotation = [0, 0, 0],
  home,
  islandScale
}: { 
  position: [number, number, number]; 
  scale?: number; 
  rotation?: [number, number, number];
  home: HomeObstacle | null;
  islandScale: number;
}) {
  const { profile, claimIslandTreasure, showIslandAlert } = useApp();
  const [isFound, setIsFound] = React.useState(false);

  const resolvedPosition = useMemo(() => {
    return findNearestValidPlacement(
      'NPC / 獨特物',
      position,
      home,
      islandScale
    );
  }, [position, home, islandScale]);

  /**
   * 島嶼秘寶 — pays 碎片 through the Economy Service, not 金幣 through a `updateDoc` right here.
   *
   * It used to do both wrong things at once: it imported Firestore inside a 3D prop and wrote
   * `balanceGold: increment(500)` on the spot. That is §16 (a currency moved from a component, with
   * no record of why) and §8 (500 金幣 from something that is not exercise) in six lines. The
   * amount and the currency now live in context/useEconomyActions.ts, where every other grant in
   * the game does, and the source is recorded as 島上互動.
   *
   * The stone hides itself BEFORE the write resolves, and stays hidden even if the write fails.
   * That is deliberate: an unrewarded second tap is a small loss, while a stone that reappears
   * after paying out is a repeatable currency faucet. It has always behaved this way.
   */
  const handleInteract = async () => {
    if (!profile || isFound) return;
    setIsFound(true);
    const paid = await claimIslandTreasure();
    showIslandAlert(
      paid
        ? `發現島嶼秘寶！獲得 ${TREASURE_REWARD_FRAGMENTS} 碎片 & ${TREASURE_REWARD_XP} 經驗值`
        : '發現島嶼秘寶，但獎勵沒有存檔成功',
    );
  };

  return (
    <mesh 
      position={[resolvedPosition[0], 0.3 + (0.3 * scale), resolvedPosition[2]]} 
      scale={isFound ? [0, 0, 0] : [scale, scale, scale]} 
      rotation={rotation}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        handleInteract();
      }}
      onPointerEnter={() => (document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer')}
      onPointerLeave={() => (document.body.style.cursor = 'auto')}
    >
      <dodecahedronGeometry args={[0.3]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#94a3b8" roughness={0.8} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

const FLOWER_COLORS = ["#ef4444", "#f59e0b", "#ec4899", "#8b5cf6", "#3b82f6"];

/**
 * Per-weather surface response, previously recomputed inline for every flower on every render.
 */
function getFloraSurface(weather: WeatherType) {
  switch (weather) {
    case WeatherType.SUNNY: return { roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.1, emissiveIntensity: 0.35 };
    case WeatherType.RAINY:
    case WeatherType.STORM: return { roughness: 0.15, metalness: 0.4, emissiveIntensity: 0.1 };
    case WeatherType.TWILIGHT: return { roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.1, emissiveIntensity: 0.8 };
    case WeatherType.SNOW: return { roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0.1, emissiveIntensity: 0.1 };
    // Highest emissive of any state: with the directional light down to moonlight
    // strength, the emissive term is most of what keeps the flowers visible.
    case WeatherType.MIDNIGHT: return { roughness: 0.75, metalness: 0.1, emissiveIntensity: 1.15 };
    default: return { roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0.1, emissiveIntensity: 0.2 };
  }
}

/**
 * Lets a material's per-instance colour drive its emissive term as well as its diffuse one.
 * three multiplies `instanceColor` into diffuse only, so without this every flower's glow would
 * collapse to one shared colour. Same patch Fish.tsx uses for its shoal.
 */
function applyInstanceEmissive(material: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial) {
  material.vertexColors = true;
  material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace(
      '#include <emissivemap_fragment>',
      '#include <emissivemap_fragment>\n\ttotalEmissiveRadiance *= vColor.rgb;'
    );
  };
}

/**
 * Wildflowers, as three InstancedMeshes (stems / buds / snow caps).
 *
 * This was one <group> of two or three <mesh>es per flower - ~96 meshes at territory level 1,
 * growing with the island - and every one of them declared its own geometry and its own
 * MeshStandardMaterial inline, so nothing was shared even though there are only two shapes and
 * five colours in the whole field. Profiling counted the scene at 943 unique materials, and this
 * was the second largest contributor after the lawn.
 *
 * The sway still runs on the CPU (unlike Grass, which has hundreds of blades): a few dozen matrix
 * composes per frame is genuinely cheap, and it keeps the per-flower phase/scale behaviour exactly
 * as it was without a third shader patch to maintain.
 */
function ScatteredFlora({
  count = 30,
  home,
  islandScale
}: {
  count?: number;
  home: HomeObstacle | null;
  islandScale: number;
}) {
  const { weather } = useApp();
  const stemRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const budRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const capRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const isSnow = weather === WeatherType.SNOW;

  const seeds = useMemo(() => {
    return Array.from({ length: count }).map(() => {
      const resolved = findRandomValidPlacement(
        'Flower',
        home,
        islandScale,
        [],
        0.35
      );
      return {
        position: resolved,
        color: FLOWER_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * FLOWER_COLORS.length)],
        scale: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4,
        rotationOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI,
        swaySpeed: 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2
      };
    });
  }, [count, home, islandScale]);

  const { stemGeo, budGeo, capGeo, stemMat, budMat, capMat } = useMemo(() => ({
    stemGeo: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.02, 0.02, 0.3),
    budGeo: tintableInstances(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.12, 8, 8)),
    capGeo: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 6, 6),
    stemMat: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(),
    budMat: (() => {
      const m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ emissive: new THREE.Color('#ffffff') });
      applyInstanceEmissive(m);
      return m;
    })(),
    capMat: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#ffffff', roughness: 0.9 }),
  }), []);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    [stemGeo, budGeo, capGeo].forEach((g) => g.dispose());
    [stemMat, budMat, capMat].forEach((m) => m.dispose());
  }, [stemGeo, budGeo, capGeo, stemMat, budMat, capMat]);

  // Per-flower bud colour. Set once per seed set rather than per frame.
  useEffect(() => {
    const bud = budRef.current;
    if (!bud) return;
    seeds.forEach((s, i) => bud.setColorAt(i, FLORA_COLOR.set(s.color)));
    if (bud.instanceColor) bud.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
  }, [seeds]);

  // Weather-driven surface response, shared by every flower.
  useEffect(() => {
    const surface = getFloraSurface(weather);
    stemMat.color.set(isSnow ? '#3f6a45' : '#22c55e');
    stemMat.roughness = surface.roughness;
    stemMat.metalness = surface.metalness;
    budMat.roughness = surface.roughness;
    budMat.metalness = surface.metalness;
    budMat.emissiveIntensity = surface.emissiveIntensity;
  }, [weather, isSnow, stemMat, budMat]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const stem = stemRef.current;
    const bud = budRef.current;
    if (!stem || !bud) return;

    const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
    const { speedMult, swayAmt: angleMult } = getWeatherSwayFactors(weather);
    const cap = capRef.current;

    seeds.forEach((s, i) => {
      DUMMY.rotation.set(
        Math.cos(t * (s.swaySpeed * 0.8) * speedMult + s.rotationOffset) * 0.05 * angleMult,
        0,
        Math.sin(t * s.swaySpeed * speedMult + s.rotationOffset) * 0.1 * angleMult
      );
      DUMMY.scale.setScalar(s.scale);

      // Stem/bud/cap sat at local +0.1 / +0.25 / +0.34 inside the swaying flower's own frame, so
      // each offset has to ride the lean - hence rotating it rather than just adding it to Y.
      const place = (mesh: THREE.InstancedMesh, localY: number) => {
        OFFSET.set(0, localY * s.scale, 0).applyEuler(DUMMY.rotation);
        DUMMY.position.set(
          s.position[0] + OFFSET.x,
          s.position[1] + OFFSET.y,
          s.position[2] + OFFSET.z
        );
        DUMMY.updateMatrix();
        mesh.setMatrixAt(i, DUMMY.matrix);
      };

      place(stem, 0.1);
      place(bud, 0.25);
      if (cap) place(cap, 0.34);
    });

    stem.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    bud.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (cap) cap.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  return (
    <group>
      <instancedMesh ref={stemRef} args={[stemGeo, stemMat, seeds.length]} frustumCulled={false} />
      <instancedMesh ref={budRef} args={[budGeo, budMat, seeds.length]} frustumCulled={false} />
      {isSnow && (
        <instancedMesh ref={capRef} args={[capGeo, capMat, seeds.length]} frustumCulled={false} />
      )}
    </group>
  );
}

/** Rocks share one shape and (per weather) one surface, so they draw as a single InstancedMesh. */
function IslandRocks({
  count = 15,
  home,
  islandScale
}: {
  count?: number;
  home: HomeObstacle | null;
  islandScale: number;
}) {
  const { weather } = useApp();
  const rockRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const capRef = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const isWet = weather === WeatherType.RAINY || weather === WeatherType.STORM;
  const isSnow = weather === WeatherType.SNOW;

  const rocks = useMemo(() => {
    const coords: [number, number, number][] = [];
    return Array.from({ length: count }).map(() => {
      const resolved = findRandomValidPlacement(
        'IslandRock',
        home,
        islandScale,
        coords,
        0.35
      );
      coords.push(resolved);
      return {
        position: resolved,
        scale: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        rotation: [ Math.random() * Math.PI, Math.random() * Math.PI, Math.random() * Math.PI ] as [number, number, number],
        hasWindEffect: Math.random() > 0.6,
        swayOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI,
        swayFreq: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
        // The wind rocks used to accumulate `rotation.y += 0.005` straight onto their Object3D;
        // an instanced rock has no Object3D of its own, so the spin lives here instead.
        spin: 0,
      };
    });
  }, [count, home, islandScale]);

  const { rockGeo, capGeo, rockMat, capMat } = useMemo(() => ({
    rockGeo: new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(0.3),
    capGeo: new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.22, 8, 8),
    rockMat: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(),
    capMat: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#ffffff', roughness: 0.9 }),
  }), []);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    [rockGeo, capGeo].forEach((g) => g.dispose());
    [rockMat, capMat].forEach((m) => m.dispose());
  }, [rockGeo, capGeo, rockMat, capMat]);

  useEffect(() => {
    rockMat.color.set(isWet ? '#334155' : '#64748b');
    rockMat.roughness = isWet ? 0.2 : 0.9;
    rockMat.metalness = isWet ? 0.5 : 0.0;
  }, [isWet, rockMat]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const rock = rockRef.current;
    if (!rock) return;
    const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
    const cap = capRef.current;

    rocks.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (r.hasWindEffect) r.spin += 0.005;
      const y = r.hasWindEffect
        ? 0.35 + Math.sin(t * r.swayFreq + r.swayOffset) * 0.05
        : r.position[1];

      DUMMY.position.set(r.position[0], y, r.position[2]);
      DUMMY.rotation.set(r.rotation[0], r.rotation[1] + r.spin, r.rotation[2]);
      DUMMY.scale.setScalar(r.scale);
      DUMMY.updateMatrix();
      rock.setMatrixAt(i, DUMMY.matrix);

      if (cap) {
        // Snow cap sat at local +0.22 with no rotation of its own, squashed flat.
        DUMMY.position.set(r.position[0], y + 0.22 * r.scale, r.position[2]);
        DUMMY.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
        DUMMY.scale.set(r.scale, r.scale * 0.4, r.scale);
        DUMMY.updateMatrix();
        cap.setMatrixAt(i, DUMMY.matrix);
      }
    });

    rock.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (cap) cap.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  });

  return (
    <group>
      <instancedMesh ref={rockRef} args={[rockGeo, rockMat, rocks.length]} castShadow frustumCulled={false} />
      {isSnow && (
        <instancedMesh ref={capRef} args={[capGeo, capMat, rocks.length]} frustumCulled={false} />
      )}
    </group>
  );
}

function Pathways({
  home,
  islandScale
}: {
  home: HomeObstacle | null;
  islandScale: number;
}) {
  const geometry = useMemo(() => new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.5, 8), []);
  const material = useMemo(
    () => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#a8a29e', opacity: 0.6, transparent: true, ...DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS }),
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => () => { geometry.dispose(); material.dispose(); }, [geometry, material]);

  const points = useMemo(() => {
    return PATHWAY_BASE_POINTS.map((p) => {
      const originalPos: [number, number, number] = [
        p[0] * islandScale,
        ISLAND_SURFACE_Y,
        p[2] * islandScale
      ];
      // Stepping stones still get nudged out of the Home's footprint, but nothing else
      // constrains them - they are meant to lead right up to the door.
      const resolved = findNearestValidPlacement(
        'PathwayCircle',
        originalPos,
        home,
        islandScale
      );
      // Height comes from the terrain, not from a constant: these stones used to
      // be pinned at a hard-coded y=0.31, which put them 0.01 above the plateau
      // near the shore (z-fighting the whole way along the path) and *below* the
      // raised mound further inland, where four of the ten simply vanished.
      return {
        position: [
          resolved[0],
          getIslandDecalY(resolved[0], resolved[2], islandScale),
          resolved[2],
        ] as [number, number, number],
        // Drawn once per stone, not re-rolled on every render. Calling Math.random() inline in
        // the JSX gave each stone a new facing every time this component re-rendered, which both
        // made the path visibly twitch and forced a matrix recompute for all ten.
        spin: Math.random() * Math.PI,
      };
    });
  }, [home, islandScale]);

  return (
    <group>
      {points.map((p, i) => (
        <mesh
          key={i}
          position={p.position}
          rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, p.spin]}
          geometry={geometry}
          material={material}
        />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

export function IslandDecorations() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const territoryLevel = profile?.territoryLevel || 1;
  const islandScale = 1 + (territoryLevel - 1) * 0.4;

  // Natural decorations route around the player's Home so nothing spawns inside its walls or
  // blocks the doorway. The Home itself is drawn by PlayerHomeView, not here.
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);

  return (
    <group>
      <ScatteredFlora count={40 * (1 + territoryLevel * 0.2)} home={home} islandScale={islandScale} />
      <IslandRocks count={20 * (1 + territoryLevel * 0.1)} home={home} islandScale={islandScale} />
      <Pathways home={home} islandScale={islandScale} />

      <SmallStone position={[4.5, 0.1, -4.5]} scale={1.2} home={home} islandScale={islandScale} />
      <SmallStone position={[-5, 0.1, 4.2]} scale={0.8} home={home} islandScale={islandScale} />
      <SmallStone position={[3, 0.1, 5.5]} scale={1} home={home} islandScale={islandScale} />

      {/* Unlockable Zones — anchor positions are chosen to stay within the flat Grass Terrain
          radius (5.7 * islandScale) even at the moment each zone first unlocks, so they never
          spill onto the sloped sand or open water. */}
      {territoryLevel >= 2 && (
        <GardenZone position={[-3.2, 0, -3.2]} islandScale={islandScale} />
      )}

      {territoryLevel >= 4 && (
        <GardenZone position={[4, 0, -8]} scale={0.8} islandScale={islandScale} />
      )}
    </group>
  );
}
```

## src/components/Three/IslandNpcs.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { ISLAND_NPCS } from '../../constants/npcs';
import { SHORELINE_RADIUS } from '../../constants/terrain';
import { getSurfaceAt } from '../../lib/placementSurfaces';
import { footprintDistanceToPoint, getFootprint, resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture } from '../../lib/furniturePlacement';
import { usePlayerHome } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import { resolveHomeCollision } from './characterMovement';
import { NpcTerritory, NpcWalker, NpcWaypoint } from './NpcWalker';
import { DigFx, RabbitDigFx, createRabbitBrain } from './RabbitGardener';

/**
 * 島上的 NPC —— 拿著鏟子在島上到處走、每 5 步挖一次土的餅乾兔園丁。
 *
 * 這個檔案回答的是「島上哪裡可以走」與「哪裡可以挖」。走路本身在 Three/NpcWalker.tsx，
 * 作息與挖土在 Three/RabbitGardener.tsx，長相在 Three/Npcs.tsx。
 *
 * 可以走、可以挖的地方，跟玩家自己走得到的地方是同一組規則、同一批函式：`getSurfaceAt` 決定腳下
 * 是陸地、水還是木製平台，`resolveHomeCollision` 是房子的殼，`resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture` 與
 * 家具的量測輪廓是島上擺出來的東西。
 */

/** 她的身體半徑，用來跟房子與家具保持距離。 */
const NPC_RADIUS = 0.3;

/** 她會走到離島心多遠（水線往內縮一圈）。 */
const ROAM_FRACTION = 0.82;

/** 新目的地至少要離現在多遠。 */
const MIN_TRIP = 2.2;

/** 挑點是用亂數試出來的，試這麼多次還挑不到就這一輪不走。 */
const PICK_ATTEMPTS = 14;

/** 土坑的半徑再加一點土堆 —— 這一圈裡每一點都要是能挖的地。 */
const DIG_CLEARANCE = 0.3;
/** 土坑範圍內地面高低差上限。太斜的坡挖出來的坑會一半浮在空中。 */
const DIG_MAX_SLOPE = 0.12;

export const IslandNpcs = React.memo(function IslandNpcs() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);
  const islandScale = 1 + ((profile?.territoryLevel || 1) - 1) * 0.4;
  const placements = profile?.islandPlacements;

  const territory = useMemo(() => {
    const items = placements || [];
    const roam = SHORELINE_RADIUS * islandScale * ROAM_FRACTION;
    const probe = new THREE.Vector3();

    /** 這一點站得住嗎：是陸地、不在房子裡、也不在家具裡。 */
    const isFree = (x: number, z: number): boolean => {
      if (!getSurfaceAt(x, z, items, islandScale).isSolid) return false;
      probe.set(x, 0, z);
      if (home) resolveHomeCollision(probe, home, NPC_RADIUS + 0.2);
      if (probe.x !== x || probe.z !== z) return false;
      const pushed = resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture(x, z, NPC_RADIUS + 0.2, items);
      return pushed.x === x && pushed.z === z;
    };

    /**
     * 這一點能不能挖。
     *
     * 比「站得住」嚴格：木製平台站得住但不能挖（supportId 不是 null），野餐墊這種貼地、走得過去
     * 的東西也不能挖（它沒有走路碰撞，所以另外量它的整個輪廓）。土坑那一圈的每一個取樣點都要
     * 通過，而且地面不能太斜。
     */
    const canDig = (x: number, z: number): boolean => {
      const samples: [number, number][] = [
        [x, z], [x + DIG_CLEARANCE, z], [x - DIG_CLEARANCE, z], [x, z + DIG_CLEARANCE], [x, z - DIG_CLEARANCE],
      ];
      let minY = Infinity;
      let maxY = -Infinity;
      for (const [sx, sz] of samples) {
        const hit = getSurfaceAt(sx, sz, items, islandScale);
        if (!hit.isSolid || hit.supportId !== null) return false;
        minY = Math.min(minY, hit.y);
        maxY = Math.max(maxY, hit.y);
        probe.set(sx, 0, sz);
        if (home) resolveHomeCollision(probe, home, 0.15);
        if (probe.x !== sx || probe.z !== sz) return false;
      }
      if (maxY - minY > DIG_MAX_SLOPE) return false;
      // 岸邊那一圈留給浪。
      if (Math.hypot(x, z) > SHORELINE_RADIUS * islandScale * 0.86) return false;
      for (const item of items) {
        const fp = getFootprint(item.itemId);
        if (!fp) {
          if (Math.hypot(item.position[0] - x, item.position[2] - z) < 0.9) return false;
          continue;
        }
        const d = footprintDistanceToPoint(fp, item.position[0], item.position[2], item.rotation || 0, x, z);
        if (d < DIG_CLEARANCE) return false;
      }
      return true;
    };

    const terr: NpcTerritory = {
      pickRoute(from): NpcWaypoint[] {
        for (let i = 0; i < PICK_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
          const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          // sqrt 是為了讓點在圓面上均勻分布。
          const radius = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * roam;
          const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
          const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
          if (Math.hypot(x - from.x, z - from.z) < MIN_TRIP) continue;
          if (!isFree(x, z)) continue;
          return [{ x, z }];
        }
        return [];
      },
      routeTo(_from, to) {
        // 島是一片開闊地，直線走過去；途中被家具推開由 contain 處理，走不通由卡住偵測處理。
        return isFree(to.x, to.z) ? [{ x: to.x, z: to.z }] : null;
      },
      contain(p) {
        if (home) resolveHomeCollision(p, home, NPC_RADIUS);
        const pushed = resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture(p.x, p.z, NPC_RADIUS, items);
        p.x = pushed.x;
        p.z = pushed.z;
        if (!getSurfaceAt(p.x, p.z, items, islandScale).isSolid) {
          const shore = SHORELINE_RADIUS * islandScale * 0.94;
          const dist = Math.hypot(p.x, p.z);
          if (dist > shore && dist > 1e-6) {
            p.x *= shore / dist;
            p.z *= shore / dist;
          }
        }
      },
      groundY(x, z) {
        return getSurfaceAt(x, z, items, islandScale).y;
      },
    };
    return { terr, isFree, canDig };
  }, [placements, islandScale, home]);

  // 腦子只建一次；它問的「能不能挖」永遠是最新的那一份（家具搬動、領土升級之後）。
  const latest = useRef(territory);
  latest.current = territory;
  const fx = useMemo(() => new DigFx(), []);
  const brain = useMemo(() => createRabbitBrain({
    fx,
    canDig: (x, z) => latest.current.canDig(x, z),
    canStand: (x, z) => latest.current.isFree(x, z),
  }), [fx]);

  return (
    <>
      {ISLAND_NPCS.map((npc) => (
        <NpcWalker
          key={npc.id}
          npcId={npc.id}
          name={npc.name}
          scope="island"
          kind={npc.kind}
          height={npc.height}
          spawnX={npc.x * islandScale}
          spawnZ={npc.z * islandScale}
          spawnRotation={npc.rotation}
          territory={territory.terr}
          brain={npc.kind === 'cookieRabbit' ? brain : undefined}
        />
      ))}
      <RabbitDigFx fx={fx} />
    </>
  );
});
```
