 */

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { clampFrameDelta, playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { publishWorldSolids } from '../../lib/worldSolids';
import { MERCHANTS, getMerchantDockFor, type MerchantSpec } from '../../constants/merchants';
import { merchantVisitAt } from '../../constants/merchantVisit';
import { dockReach, resolveDock } from '../../constants/merchantDocks';
import { MERCHANT_SENSES } from '../../constants/merchantAnimation';
import { MerchantAnimator, type MerchantSenses } from '../../lib/merchantAnimation';
import type { CurrencyId } from '../../constants/currency';
import { NpcGait, NpcModel } from './Npcs';
import type { SolidBox } from '../../lib/furniturePlacement';
import {
  BOAT_COLLIDERS,
  BOAT_DECK_Y,
  BOAT_PROMPT_HEIGHT,
  MERCHANT_FACING,
  MERCHANT_STAND,
  MerchantBoat,
} from './MerchantBoat';

/**
 * 島邊那位旅行商人 —— 船、人，以及他怎麼來、怎麼走。
 *
 * ## 兩個時鐘，不要弄混
 *
 * 「他在不在島上」是 constants/merchantVisit.ts 從商店檔期算出來的，單位是天；「那艘船這
 * 一秒漂到哪裡」是這個檔案的狀態機，單位是秒。前者是**權威**，後者只是把權威演出來：
 *
 * \`\`\`
 *   造訪相位（天）      offshore ──► arriving ──► docked ──► leaving ──► offshore
 *   visit.open true                  ▲ 進場動畫          ▲ 離港動畫
 *   visit.open false ────────────────┘                  └────────────
 * \`\`\`
 *
 * 沒有 `setTimeout`，也沒有任何一行 `destroy`。每一次轉換都是「這一幀的相位」與「這一幀
 * 的動畫進度」比對出來的結果，所以分頁被切走三十秒、或整條 Canvas 被 `frameloop='never'`
 * 停掉（玩家進了屋子或商店），回來時它只是重新問一次時鐘然後接著演——不會有一個燒在
 * timer 裡的未來事件在沒人看的時候把船刪掉。
 *
 * ## 進場動畫是給這位玩家看的，不是世界事件
 *
 * 商人可能已經停在那裡三天了，但玩家這次進遊戲時，船仍然會從外海滑進來一次。這是 §8 明
 * 講可以接受的做法（「在玩家不容易注意的位置生成 + 平滑移動至停靠點」），而且是**刻意**
 * 的：突然出現在視野裡的船是最糟的一種；讓它從可游泳範圍以外滑進來，玩家只會看到「有東
 * 西來了」。這一段動畫不影響任何資料——店開不開得了看的是相位，不是船在哪。
 *
 * ## 這裡沒有 AI
 *
 * 航線是兩個點之間的內插，兩個點都從停靠點推出來（constants/merchantDocks.ts）。沒有尋
 * 路、沒有避障、沒有轉向控制器——海上沒有東西要閃。
 */

/** 進場滑行的秒數。29 個世界單位左右，所以大約 1.8/s：比玩家走路慢三倍，是「船在滑」。 */
const SAIL_IN_SECONDS = 16;
/** 離港滑行的秒數。比進場略久一點——離開該有一點依依不捨。 */
const SAIL_OUT_SECONDS = 19;

/** 造訪相位多久重新問一次時鐘。每幀問是浪費：這個答案以天為單位在變。 */
const SCHEDULE_POLL_MS = 500;

/** 浮沉。刻意**不**去對 Ocean.tsx 的浪高——見 {@link bobAt}。 */
const BOB_HEIGHT = 0.055;
const BOB_ROLL = 0.028;

/**
 * 他一直微微低著的那一點頭。
 *
 * 他站在甲板上（+0.3），玩家站在沙灘上，所以「平視前方」實際上是看過玩家的頭頂。這是**姿勢**
 * 不是動畫，所以它是一個常數，不歸動畫控制器管。
 */
const HEAD_TILT = 0.05;

type Stage = 'offshore' | 'arriving' | 'docked' | 'leaving';

const easeOut = (t: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
const easeIn = (t: number) => t * t * t;
const clamp01 = (v: number) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v);

/**
 * 船的浮沉。
 *
 * 兩個不同週期的正弦，**不是** Ocean.tsx 那個浪高函數。那個函數住在 GLSL 裡
 * （`WAVE_NOISE_GLSL`），要讓船精確地跟著浪走，就得在 JS 裡再寫一份一模一樣的四項正弦
 * 和——而兩份手抄的同一條式子只會在某次調浪的時候悄悄分家，然後船就會浮在浪面下方。
 *
 * 換來的代價是「船的起伏跟它腳下那道浪不是同一道」，而那件事在這個相機距離下看不出來。
 * 這是一個明知道的取捨，不是疏漏。
 */
function bobAt(t: number): { y: number; roll: number; pitch: number } {
  return {
    y: Math.sin(t * 0.9) * BOB_HEIGHT + Math.sin(t * 1.53 + 1.1) * BOB_HEIGHT * 0.45,
    roll: Math.sin(t * 0.72 + 0.4) * BOB_ROLL,
    pitch: Math.sin(t * 1.15 + 2.2) * BOB_ROLL * 0.7,
  };
}

/** 最短路徑的角度內插，跟 NpcWalker 用的是同一個——免得轉過 ±π 時繞遠路。 */
function lerpAngle(from: number, to: number, t: number): number {
  const delta = Math.atan2(Math.sin(to - from), Math.cos(to - from));
  return from + delta * t;
}

/**
 * 一位商人在世界裡的身體。
 *
 * 一個 spec 一個實例，所以「同時有兩位商人來」不需要這個檔案改任何一行——
 * {@link MerchantVisitors} 多掛一個就是了。
 */
function MerchantVisitorEntity({ spec, islandScale }: { spec: MerchantSpec; islandScale: number }) {
  const dock = getMerchantDockFor(spec);

  /**
   * 這一趟航線的兩個端點。
   *
   * 跟著 islandScale 重算，所以升領土之後船會停到新的水線外，而不是留在原本那個現在已經
   * 是沙灘的位置上。這正是停靠點寫成「水線往外幾單位」而不是寫成座標的全部理由。
   */
  const route = useMemo(
    () => (dock ? resolveDock(dock, islandScale) : null),
    [dock, islandScale],
  );

  /**
   * 玩家要多近才談得到。
   *
   * 從停靠點推出來（constants/merchantDocks.ts 的 `dockReach`），不是這裡的一個數字，也不是
   * dock 上的一格資料：它是「船停多遠」加「玩家站得進來多少」。船挪動時它自己跟著挪，所以這
   * 個元件裡不可能出現一組跟停靠點對不上的互動距離。不隨 islandScale 縮放 —— 跟船、玩家、
   * 寵物一樣，領土升級長大的是島，不是外面的世界。
   */
  const reach = dock ? dockReach(dock) : 0;

  const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  /** 甲板上那個人自己的 group。動畫只轉得到它的 `rotation.y`，碰不到船，也碰不到 root 的位置。 */
  const standRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const gaitRef = useRef<NpcGait>({ intensity: 0, phase: 0, lookYaw: 0, lookPitch: 0, pose: null });

  /**
   * 他的動作。
   *
   * 一位商人一台控制器，種子取自他的 id，所以「兩位商人同時在島上」不會連呼吸與張望都同步 ——
   * 那比完全靜止更假。控制器本身不認識 React 也不認識 three.js（見 lib/merchantAnimation.ts）。
   */
  const animator = useMemo(() => {
    let seed = 0x9e3779b9;
    for (let i = 0; i < spec.id.length; i++) seed = (Math.imul(seed ^ spec.id.charCodeAt(i), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0);
    return new MerchantAnimator(seed);
  }, [spec.id]);

  /**
   * 上一次看到的成交序號。
   *
   * 初值是**現在**的序號而不是 0：玩家可能在這位商人抵達之前就買過東西（上一檔、上一位），
   * 而那筆交易不該讓剛靠岸的這一位對著空氣道謝。
   */
  const lastPurchase = useRef(playerBus.merchantPurchase?.count ?? 0);

  /** 餵給控制器的那一組感官。每幀就地改寫同一顆，理由跟碰撞盒與錨點一樣：這是每秒六十次的資料。 */
  const senses = useRef<MerchantSenses>({
    delta: 0,
    distance: null,
    bearing: 0,
    available: false,
    awareness: 0,
    interaction: 0,
  });

  /**
   * 唯一的 React state：這個實體現在有沒有掛在場景裡。
   *
   * 只在「開始進場」與「離港完成」時各翻一次面，所以這棵樹一整檔期只重建兩次。其餘所有
   * 的動——位置、朝向、浮沉、轉頭——都是 useFrame 直接寫 transform，一幀都不經過 React。
   * 這是 Three/Npcs.tsx 與 IslandPet 用的同一套分工。
   */
  const [present, setPresent] = useState(false);

  const stage = useRef<Stage>('offshore');
  const progress = useRef(0);
  /** 上一次問時鐘的結果，加上下一次該問的時間。 */
  const schedule = useRef<{ open: boolean; polledAt: number }>({ open: false, polledAt: 0 });
  /** 提示的錨點。每幀重寫同一顆，不是每幀 new 一顆——見 playerBus 上其他欄位的同一句話。 */
  const anchor = useRef(new THREE.Vector3());
  /**
   * 這艘船這一幀的碰撞盒，世界座標。
   *
   * 配置一次、每幀就地改寫，跟錨點同一個理由：這是每秒六十次的資料，每幀 new 一組物件等於
   * 把八個物件直接丟給 GC。長度固定（`BOAT_COLLIDERS` 是常數），所以連 push 都不需要。
   */
  const solids = useRef<SolidBox[]>(
    BOAT_COLLIDERS.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, cx: 0, cz: 0, halfW: c.halfW, halfD: c.halfD, rotation: 0 })),
  );

  // 卸下這個實體時把它的碰撞盒一起收走。useFrame 停了就不會再有人撤銷它們，而一組留在登記
  // 表裡、再也不會更新的盒子，就是一面停在最後一幀位置上的隱形牆。
  useEffect(() => () => { publishWorldSolids(spec.id, null); }, [spec.id]);

  useFrame((state, rawDelta) => {
    const group = groupRef.current;
    if (!route || !dock) return;

    const delta = clampFrameDelta(rawDelta);
    const nowMs = Date.now();

    // --- 相位：以天為單位的那個時鐘 -----------------------------------------
    if (nowMs - schedule.current.polledAt >= SCHEDULE_POLL_MS) {
      schedule.current = { open: merchantVisitAt(nowMs, spec).open, polledAt: nowMs };
    }
    const open = schedule.current.open;

    // --- 狀態機：以秒為單位的那個時鐘 ---------------------------------------
    switch (stage.current) {
      case 'offshore':
        if (open) {
          stage.current = 'arriving';
          progress.current = 0;
          if (!present) setPresent(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'arriving':
        if (!open) {
          // 一檔在船還沒靠岸時就結束了。從**現在的位置**掉頭，而不是先瞬移到岸邊再開走。
          stage.current = 'leaving';
          progress.current = 1 - progress.current;
          break;
        }
        progress.current += delta / SAIL_IN_SECONDS;
        if (progress.current >= 1) {
          progress.current = 1;
          stage.current = 'docked';
        }
        break;
      case 'docked':
        if (!open) {
          stage.current = 'leaving';
          progress.current = 0;
        }
        break;
      case 'leaving':
        if (open) {
          // 下一檔在船還沒開遠時就開始了（例如玩家掛著遊戲跨過換檔）。同樣是掉頭，
          // 不是重新生成一艘。
          stage.current = 'arriving';
          progress.current = 1 - progress.current;
          break;
        }
        progress.current += delta / SAIL_OUT_SECONDS;
        if (progress.current >= 1) {
          progress.current = 1;
          stage.current = 'offshore';
          // 「離開視野之後才消失」——不是 destroy，是這個實體不再被畫出來。下一檔它會從
          // 同一條航線重新滑進來。
          if (present) setPresent(false);
        }
        break;
    }

    if (!present || !group) {
      // 不在場的商人談不到。這一行同時關掉提示與動作鍵——見 playerBus.merchantTarget。
      if (playerBus.merchantTarget?.merchantId === spec.id) playerBus.merchantTarget = null;
      // 也不擋路。船開走了碰撞盒必須跟著走，否則海上會留下一塊看不見卻游不過去的水。
      publishWorldSolids(spec.id, null);
      return;
    }

    // --- 位置與朝向 ---------------------------------------------------------
    const { moored, approach } = route;
    // 0 = 在外海，1 = 停好。進場是 easeOut（滑進來然後慢慢停住），離港是 easeIn（慢慢
    // 起步然後開走）——兩者都是「船靠港/離港」該有的加速度曲線。
    const along =
      stage.current === 'arriving' ? easeOut(clamp01(progress.current))
        : stage.current === 'leaving' ? 1 - easeIn(clamp01(progress.current))
        : 1;

    const x = approach.x + (moored.x - approach.x) * along;
    const z = approach.z + (moored.z - approach.z) * along;

    // 船身在航行時朝著島（= approach.yaw），最後四分之一才轉成側靠的停泊姿態。分開處理
    // 而不是整段內插，是因為一條「一路都在慢慢轉」的船看起來像失去舵效。
    const swing = clamp01((along - 0.75) / 0.25);
    const yaw = lerpAngle(approach.yaw, moored.yaw, swing);

    const bob = bobAt(state.clock.getElapsedTime());
    group.position.set(x, moored.y + bob.y, z);
    group.rotation.set(bob.pitch, yaw, bob.roll);

    // 商人站在甲板上、船身的 local 座標裡，所以他的世界位置要照船的朝向轉一次。轉法跟
    // lib/furnitureInteraction.ts 的 resolveInteractionSpot 完全一致（x' = x·cos + z·sin,
    // z' = -x·sin + z·cos），因為那是這個專案裡「local 掛到 world」唯一的一種寫法。
    //
    // 感知距離與提示錨點都從**這一個**位置量，不是從船心：兩者量的必須是同一個人，否則會出
    // 現「提示亮了但他沒發現你」那種只差半公尺的不一致。
    const cos = Math.cos(yaw);
    const sin = Math.sin(yaw);
    const standX = x + MERCHANT_STAND.x * cos + MERCHANT_STAND.z * sin;
    const standZ = z - MERCHANT_STAND.x * sin + MERCHANT_STAND.z * cos;

    // --- 碰撞：跟畫面用同一個 transform ---------------------------------------
    //
    // 就在寫完 `group.position` / `group.rotation` 的下一行，而且用的是**同樣那兩個變數**
    // （`x`, `z`, `yaw`），不是回頭去讀 group 的矩陣，也不是另外算一次航線。這就是「Visual
    // 與 Collider 全程同步」的實作：它們不是兩個要對齊的東西，是同一個 transform 的兩個
    // 用途，所以進場、離港、換檔、升領土時都不可能有一個動了另一個沒動。
    //
    // 刻意**不**把浮沉的 pitch / roll 帶進碰撞盒：那是 ±0.03 弧度的搖晃，帶進來只會讓玩
    // 家貼著船身時被每幀推一下。碰撞用的是船的平面位置與艏向，那才是「船佔住了哪塊水面」。
    //
    // 動畫也一樣碰不到它：控制器只寫得到姿勢（lib/npcPose.ts），而姿勢裡根本沒有位移這種
    // 通道。他揮手、轉身、呼吸的時候，下面這幾格一個字都不會變。
    {
      const out = solids.current;
      for (let i = 0; i < BOAT_COLLIDERS.length; i++) {
        const c = BOAT_COLLIDERS[i];
        const s = out[i];
        // local → world，跟這個專案其他每一個 local 掛 world 的地方同一條式子
        // （lib/furnitureInteraction.ts 的 resolveInteractionSpot）。
        s.cx = x + c.cx * cos + c.cz * sin;
        s.cz = z - c.cx * sin + c.cz * cos;
        s.rotation = yaw;
      }
      publishWorldSolids(spec.id, out);
    }

    // --- 他現在在做什麼 ------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // 這一段只做兩件事：**量**（玩家離他多遠、在他的哪一邊），然後把量到的交給控制器。要播
    // 哪一個狀態、能不能再打一次招呼、揮到一半被購買反應接手怎麼辦，全部在
    // lib/merchantAnimation.ts 裡，而且完全不認識 three.js —— 所以那些規則驗得動（見
    // scripts/test-merchant-visit.ts），而這裡永遠只有「量完、寫進去」。
    const playerPos = playerBus.playerPos;
    const merchantYaw = yaw + MERCHANT_FACING;
    const sense = senses.current;
    sense.distance = null;
    sense.bearing = 0;
    if (playerPos) {
      const dx = playerPos.x - standX;
      const dz = playerPos.z - standZ;
      sense.distance = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      const toPlayer = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
      // 相對於他**預設**的朝向。控制器自己會把已經轉過去的角度扣掉，所以這裡不能把
      // pose.bodyYaw 算進來——那會變成一個追著自己跑的迴圈。
      sense.bearing = Math.atan2(Math.sin(toPlayer - merchantYaw), Math.cos(toPlayer - merchantYaw));
    }

    // 一筆**成交**的買賣（§11）。比對序號而不是把它消費掉，所以停在商店畫面上的那幾分鐘
    // （這條 Canvas 根本沒在跑）不會漏掉，回到島上的第一幀才播。
    const purchase = playerBus.merchantPurchase;
    if (purchase && purchase.count !== lastPurchase.current) {
      lastPurchase.current = purchase.count;
      // 他只對**自己開的那家店**的成交有反應。商人與店是兩張表，所以第二位商人賣別的東西時
      // 這一行不必改。
      if (purchase.shop === spec.shop) {
        animator.notifyPurchase({
          currency: purchase.currency as CurrencyId,
          amount: purchase.amount,
        });
      }
    }

    sense.delta = delta;
    // 船還在進場或正在離開時，他不打招呼也不應對——那時候他還沒「在島上」。
    sense.available = stage.current === 'docked';
    // 感知半徑是從**互動半徑**推出來的（constants/merchantAnimation.ts），所以調停靠點時，
    // 「先被看到、再談得到」這個順序不會走鐘。
    sense.awareness = reach * MERCHANT_SENSES.awarenessFromReach;
    sense.interaction = reach;
    const pose = animator.update(sense);

    const gait = gaitRef.current;
    // 模型讀的是這一個物件，而控制器每幀就地改寫同一顆姿勢——所以這一行是指標賦值，不是複製。
    gait.pose = pose;
    gait.lookYaw = pose.headYaw;
    gait.lookPitch = HEAD_TILT + pose.headPitch;
    // 站著顧攤，不是在走路。四肢的擺動幅度歸零，關節照樣在（見 OtterTraderModel 的檔頭）。
    gait.intensity = 0;

    // 轉向（§9/§15）。只寫 `rotation.y`：他的位置、船的位置、碰撞盒全部沒有被碰過，所以
    // 「轉向」不可能把他轉出那一格碰撞盒，也不可能讓他離開甲板。
    if (standRef.current) standRef.current.rotation.y = MERCHANT_FACING + pose.bodyYaw;

    // --- 談不談得到 ---------------------------------------------------------
    if (stage.current !== 'docked') {
      if (playerBus.merchantTarget?.merchantId === spec.id) playerBus.merchantTarget = null;
      return;
    }

    // 錨點就掛在上面量出來的那個位置上——提示指著的、感知距離量的，是同一個人。
    anchor.current.set(standX, moored.y + bob.y + BOAT_PROMPT_HEIGHT, standZ);
    playerBus.merchantTarget = {
      merchantId: spec.id,
      anchor: anchor.current,
      reach,
      label: spec.prompt,
    };
  });

  if (!dock) return null;

  return (
    <group ref={groupRef} visible={present}>
      {present && (
        <>
          <MerchantBoat />
          {/* 站在甲板上的他。`scale` 是 NpcSpec.height 的同一個角色：模型是單位高度，
              「這一位多高」是資料，不是幾何。 */}
          <group
            ref={standRef}
            position={[MERCHANT_STAND.x, BOAT_DECK_Y, MERCHANT_STAND.z]}
            rotation={[0, MERCHANT_FACING, 0]}
            scale={spec.height}
          >
            <NpcModel kind={spec.model} gait={gaitRef} />
          </group>
        </>
      )}
    </group>
  );
}

/**
 * 島邊所有的訪客。
 *
 * 掛在 Scene.tsx 的世界 group 裡。它讀 context 的唯一理由是領土等級（島有多大決定船停在
 * 哪），所以它是一個很小的訂閱者——真正的每幀工作全部在上面那個實體的 useFrame 裡。
 *
 * 商人的名單是資料（constants/merchants.ts）。要加第二位商人不必改這個檔案。
 */
export const MerchantVisitors = React.memo(function MerchantVisitors() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  // 跟島上其他元件同一條式子（Island.tsx、Avatar.tsx、IslandNpcs.tsx…）。
  const islandScale = 1 + ((profile?.territoryLevel || 1) - 1) * 0.4;

  return (
    <>
      {MERCHANTS.map((spec) => (
        <MerchantVisitorEntity key={spec.id} spec={spec} islandScale={islandScale} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
});

## src/components/Three/NightSky.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { WeatherType } from '../../types';

/**
 * 深夜's sky furniture: the moon, a twinkling star field, and a shooting star
 * every so often.
 *
 * Mounted unconditionally and ramped in/out by weather rather than mounted only
 * while MIDNIGHT is selected. SkyDome cross-lerps its gradient over roughly a
 * second, so a hard mount would pop a full moon into a sky that is still orange
 * — every piece here reads the same `night` ramp instead, and the whole night
 * sky arrives and leaves with the darkness.
 *
 * Radii are chosen to sit in their own shell: drei's <Stars> in Scene.tsx
 * already occupies 100-150, the moon sits at ~250, these stars at 300-430, and
 * SkyDome's dome is at 500. Nothing here writes depth, so the ordering only has
 * to be roughly right, not exact.
 */

/** How fast the night ramp reaches 1 (per frame lerp, matched to SkyDome's 0.03). */
const NIGHT_LERP = 0.03;

const MOON_POSITION: [number, number, number] = [-140, 150, -145];
const MOON_RADIUS = 11;
/** Halo plane sizes, as multiples of the disc's diameter. */
const MOON_GLOW_SCALE = 1.95;
const MOON_HALO_SCALE = 3.2;

/** Mean synodic month — one new moon to the next. */
const SYNODIC_MONTH_DAYS = 29.530588853;
/** 2000-01-06 18:14 UTC: the new moon nearest J2000, the usual epoch for this series. */
const NEW_MOON_EPOCH_MS = Date.UTC(2000, 0, 6, 18, 14);
/**
 * How close to a new moon the phase is allowed to get, in radians of phase angle.
 *
 * A true new moon is invisible, and two nights a month where the sky's one landmark has silently
 * gone missing reads as a bug rather than as astronomy. Clamping the angle away from zero leaves a
 * thin crescent at the darkest point of the cycle — the moon still goes through 陰晴圓缺, it just
 * never drops out of the scene entirely. Only ~2 nights a month are touched at all.
 */
const MIN_PHASE_ANGLE = 0.42;

/**
 * Where tonight sits in the 陰晴圓缺 cycle: 0 new, 0.25 waxing half, 0.5 full, 0.75 waning half.
 *
 * Driven by the real calendar rather than by playtime. Two reasons. A cycle keyed to the session
 * clock would visibly morph the disc while someone watched it, which no moon does; and a cycle
 * keyed to the real date means the moon overhead tonight is the moon that is actually overhead
 * tonight — a detail nobody is told about, that rewards anyone who notices. The phase drifts by
 * 0.14% an hour, so within one sitting it is fixed for all practical purposes.
 */
export function moonPhaseFraction(nowMs: number = Date.now()): number {
  const cycles = (nowMs - NEW_MOON_EPOCH_MS) / (SYNODIC_MONTH_DAYS * 86_400_000);
  return cycles - Math.floor(cycles);
}

/** The phase as a sunlight angle the shader can light a sphere with, clamped per MIN_PHASE_ANGLE. */
function moonPhaseAngle(fraction: number): number {
  return THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
    fraction * Math.PI * 2,
    MIN_PHASE_ANGLE,
    Math.PI * 2 - MIN_PHASE_ANGLE,
  );
}

const STAR_COUNT = 420;
const STAR_SHELL_MIN = 300;
const STAR_SHELL_MAX = 430;

const METEOR_COUNT = 2;
/** Length of the visible streak, in world units. */
const METEOR_LENGTH = 42;
const METEOR_HALF_WIDTH = 0.9;
/** How far a meteor flies before it has fully burnt out. */
const METEOR_TRAVEL = 175;
const METEOR_DURATION = 1.15;
/** Idle seconds between one meteor's burnout and its next appearance. */
const METEOR_GAP_MIN = 5;
const METEOR_GAP_MAX = 19;
const METEOR_SHELL = 240;

/**
 * Per-star twinkle needs per-star phase, which a shared PointsMaterial.opacity
 * cannot express — one opacity would pulse the entire sky in unison. Hence a
 * small shader: `aPhase` scatters both the rate and the offset so no two stars
 * breathe together.
 *
 * `gl_PointSize` is in framebuffer pixels, so it is multiplied by the pixel
 * ratio to keep a star the same apparent size on a HiDPI display.
 */
function createStarMaterial() {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uNight: { value: 0 },
      uPixelRatio: { value: 1 },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      attribute float aSize;
      attribute float aPhase;
      uniform float uTime;
      uniform float uNight;
      uniform float uPixelRatio;
      varying float vAlpha;
      void main() {
        vec4 mvPosition = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
        float twinkle = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(uTime * (0.5 + aPhase * 0.4) + aPhase * 6.283);
        vAlpha = uNight * twinkle;
        gl_PointSize = aSize * uPixelRatio * (0.75 + 0.25 * twinkle);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying float vAlpha;
      void main() {
        // Soft round dot; a bare square point reads as dust, not as a star.
        float r = length(gl_PointCoord - vec2(0.5));
        float a = smoothstep(0.5, 0.08, r) * vAlpha;
        if (a <= 0.002) discard;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(1.0, 0.97, 0.90), a);
      }
    `,
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
  });
}

function StarField({ nightRef }: { nightRef: React.MutableRefObject<number> }) {
  const material = useMemo(createStarMaterial, []);

  const [positions, sizes, phases] = useMemo(() => {
    const pos = new Float32Array(STAR_COUNT * 3);
    const size = new Float32Array(STAR_COUNT);
    const phase = new Float32Array(STAR_COUNT);

    for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
      // Upper hemisphere only — a star below the horizon would be drawn through
      // the ocean plane. 0.06 keeps them off the waterline itself.
      const azimuth = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const elevation = 0.06 + Math.random() * (Math.PI / 2 - 0.06);
      const radius = STAR_SHELL_MIN + Math.random() * (STAR_SHELL_MAX - STAR_SHELL_MIN);

      pos[i * 3] = Math.cos(elevation) * Math.cos(azimuth) * radius;
      pos[i * 3 + 1] = Math.sin(elevation) * radius;
      pos[i * 3 + 2] = Math.cos(elevation) * Math.sin(azimuth) * radius;

      // Mostly faint pinpricks with a scattering of bright ones, rather than a
      // uniform field of identical dots.
      const roll = Math.random();
      size[i] = roll > 0.92 ? 3.4 + Math.random() * 1.2
              : roll > 0.65 ? 2.2 + Math.random() * 0.8
              : 1.4 + Math.random() * 0.6;

      phase[i] = Math.random();
    }
    return [pos, size, phase];
  }, []);

  useFrame((state) => {
    material.uniforms.uTime.value = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    material.uniforms.uNight.value = nightRef.current;
    material.uniforms.uPixelRatio.value = state.gl.getPixelRatio();
  });

  return (
    <points frustumCulled={false}>
      <bufferGeometry>
        <bufferAttribute attach="attributes-position" args={[positions, 3]} />
        <bufferAttribute attach="attributes-aSize" args={[sizes, 1]} />
        <bufferAttribute attach="attributes-aPhase" args={[phases, 1]} />
      </bufferGeometry>
      <primitive object={material} attach="material" />
    </points>
  );
}

/**
 * The moon's face: a billboarded disc shaded as though it were a sphere, so that it can carry a
 * phase.
 *
 * Drawn on a flat quad rather than on real geometry under a real light. Lighting a sphere would
 * mean giving the moon a light that must not touch anything else in the scene, and would still
 * swing the terminator the wrong way every time the camera orbited. Here the sphere is
 * reconstructed per fragment — `z` below is the height of the unit hemisphere above the disc — and
 * lit by a direction taken purely from the phase, so the terminator stays put on screen from every
 * angle the camera can reach.
 *
 * The face is what stops it reading as the plain white cutout it used to be:
 *
 *   · Warm, not white. Sunlight off grey rock, seen through our own atmosphere, lands as pale
 *     straw. A neutral `#f4f7ff` disc was the one thing in the night sky with no colour temperature
 *     at all, which is exactly why it read as a sticker pasted over the sky.
 *   · Limb darkening. A sphere is brightest where it faces you and falls off toward its rim; flat
 *     fill is what made the old disc a circle rather than a ball.
 *   · Maria. A few soft dark patches at fixed spots — the naked-eye pattern, not noise. Without
 *     them the terminator has nothing to sweep across and the phase is just a shape.
 *   · Earthshine. The unlit part is dimmed, never cut away. A crescent whose dark side vanished
 *     would be a disembodied sliver instead of a sphere with a shadow across it.
 */
function createMoonFaceMaterial() {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uNight: { value: 0 },
      /** (sin, cos) of the phase angle — the sunlight direction, in the disc's own frame. */
      uSunDir: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0, -1) },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform float uNight;
      uniform vec2 uSunDir;
      varying vec2 vUv;

      // Sunlit rock: a warm centre falling off to a deeper straw at the rim.
      const vec3 CORE  = vec3(1.000, 0.957, 0.812);
      const vec3 LIMB  = vec3(0.925, 0.796, 0.522);
      // The night side. Cool and very dark, so it reads as shadow lying on a sphere rather than as
      // a hole punched in the sky, while still sitting above SkyDome's #060d24 zenith.
      const vec3 SHADE = vec3(0.086, 0.106, 0.180);

      /**
       * One soft dark patch of mare, in unit-disc coordinates.
       *
       * Elliptical and quadratic rather than a round hard-edged spot. Circles with a crisp rim
       * read as bubbles in cheese, not as basalt plains; stretched blobs that fall off gently and
       * overlap each other merge into the irregular outlines the naked eye actually sees.
       */
      float mare(vec2 p, vec2 centre, vec2 radii, float strength) {
        float d = min(1.0, length((p - centre) / radii));
        float falloff = 1.0 - d * d;
        return strength * falloff * falloff;
      }

      void main() {
        vec2 p = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
        float r2 = dot(p, p);
        if (r2 > 1.0) discard;

        // Height of the unit hemisphere over this point: the sphere the flat quad stands in for.
        float z = sqrt(max(0.0, 1.0 - r2));

        // Lambert against the phase direction. At angle 0 the light is directly behind the moon
        // (new), at PI directly behind us (full), at PI/2 off to one side (a half moon) — the
        // whole of 陰晴圓缺, in one dot product.
        float lambert = p.x * uSunDir.x - z * uSunDir.y;
        // A hair of softness on the terminator: sharp enough to read as a shadow edge, wide enough
        // not to stair-step across the pixels of a disc this small.
        float lit = smoothstep(-0.035, 0.045, lambert);

        // The naked-eye pattern, laid out as overlapping lobes so no single blob shows its own
        // outline. Roughly the northern maria up the left, Tranquillitatis across the middle, and
        // a smaller scatter toward the south-east.
        float maria = mare(p, vec2(-0.34,  0.26), vec2(0.42, 0.31), 1.00)
                    + mare(p, vec2(-0.12,  0.44), vec2(0.30, 0.25), 0.75)
                    + mare(p, vec2( 0.14,  0.34), vec2(0.26, 0.22), 0.55)
                    + mare(p, vec2( 0.34, -0.04), vec2(0.34, 0.29), 0.85)
                    + mare(p, vec2( 0.10, -0.16), vec2(0.26, 0.20), 0.50)
                    + mare(p, vec2(-0.30, -0.30), vec2(0.30, 0.24), 0.60)
                    + mare(p, vec2( 0.26, -0.48), vec2(0.18, 0.15), 0.35);
        float surface = 1.0 - min(maria, 1.0) * 0.16;

        // Limb darkening, biased so the warm falloff occupies the outer third rather than only the
        // last few pixels of rim — at the size this disc actually appears in the sky, a falloff
        // that narrow is one pixel wide and the moon goes back to reading as a flat sticker.
        vec3 sunlit = mix(LIMB, CORE, smoothstep(0.0, 0.8, z)) * surface;
        vec3 colour = mix(SHADE * surface, sunlit, lit);

        // Feathered rim, so the disc has an edge rather than a staircase.
        float alpha = uNight * smoothstep(1.0, 0.955, sqrt(r2));
        if (alpha <= 0.002) discard;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(colour, alpha);
      }
    `,
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
  });
}

/**
 * One additive halo ring around the moon.
 *
 * A billboarded plane with a radial falloff, deliberately not the glow spheres this replaces. A
 * sphere's near face sits between the camera and the disc, so its haze was laid *over* the moon's
 * surface — washing the face out into a bright blob, which is the other half of why the old moon
 * read as a white ring. A plane parked behind the disc can only ever bloom around it.
 */
function createMoonHaloMaterial(colour: string, falloff: number) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uOpacity: { value: 0 },
      uColour: { value: new THREE.Color(colour) },
      uFalloff: { value: falloff },
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform float uOpacity;
      uniform vec3 uColour;
      uniform float uFalloff;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        float r = length(vUv * 2.0 - 1.0);
        float a = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - r), uFalloff) * uOpacity;
        if (a <= 0.002) discard;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(uColour, a);
      }
    `,
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
  });
}

interface MoonProps {
  nightRef: React.MutableRefObject<number>;
  /** Where in the cycle to draw it — 0 new, 0.5 full. Chosen by the caller; see NightSky below. */
  phase: number;
}

export function Moon({ nightRef, phase }: MoonProps) {
  const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const glowRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const haloRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);

  // Settled once per phase: it cannot meaningfully change inside a session (see
  // moonPhaseFraction), so there is nothing here for a frame to recompute.
  const { faceMaterial, glowMaterial, haloMaterial, illuminated } = useMemo(() => {
    const angle = moonPhaseAngle(phase);
    const face = createMoonFaceMaterial();
    face.uniforms.uSunDir.value.set(Math.sin(angle), Math.cos(angle));
    return {
      faceMaterial: face,
      glowMaterial: createMoonHaloMaterial('#ffe3a6', 2.1),
      haloMaterial: createMoonHaloMaterial('#ffc978', 3.0),
      /** How much of the disc is lit — 0 at new, 1 at full. */
      illuminated: (1 - Math.cos(angle)) / 2,
    };
  }, [phase]);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const night = nightRef.current;
    const elapsed = state.clock.getElapsedTime();

    // Billboard. Every layer is a flat quad, so the whole group turns to face the camera as one —
    // and since it takes the camera's roll with it, the terminator stays upright on screen.
    groupRef.current?.quaternion.copy(state.camera.quaternion);

    faceMaterial.uniforms.uNight.value = night;

    // A thin crescent throws far less light about than a full moon, so the halo is scaled by how
    // much of the disc is lit rather than blooming the same either way. The floor keeps a crescent
    // from losing its halo altogether, which would leave it looking pasted on again.
    const bloom = 0.3 + 0.7 * illuminated;
    if (glowRef.current) {
      glowMaterial.uniforms.uOpacity.value = night * 0.4 * bloom;
      // Same slow breathing the sun has, so the two read as one sky system.
      glowRef.current.scale.setScalar(1.0 + Math.sin(elapsed * 0.8) * 0.025);
    }
    if (haloRef.current) {
      haloMaterial.uniforms.uOpacity.value = night * 0.17 * bloom;
      haloRef.current.scale.setScalar(1.0 + Math.cos(elapsed * 0.6) * 0.03);
    }
  });

  return (
    <group ref={groupRef} position={MOON_POSITION}>
      {/* Back to front: both halos bloom behind the face, which is then drawn over them. */}
      <mesh ref={haloRef} renderOrder={0} position={[0, 0, -0.6]}>
        <planeGeometry args={[MOON_RADIUS * 2 * MOON_HALO_SCALE, MOON_RADIUS * 2 * MOON_HALO_SCALE]} />
        <primitive object={haloMaterial} attach="material" />
      </mesh>
      <mesh ref={glowRef} renderOrder={1} position={[0, 0, -0.3]}>
        <planeGeometry args={[MOON_RADIUS * 2 * MOON_GLOW_SCALE, MOON_RADIUS * 2 * MOON_GLOW_SCALE]} />
        <primitive object={glowMaterial} attach="material" />
      </mesh>
      <mesh renderOrder={2}>
        <planeGeometry args={[MOON_RADIUS * 2, MOON_RADIUS * 2]} />
        <primitive object={faceMaterial} attach="material" />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

/** One meteor's flight, or the pause before its next one. */
interface MeteorState {
  /** Seconds into the current flight, or -1 while waiting for `nextAt`. */
  t: number;
  /** Clock time the next flight begins. */
  nextAt: number;
  start: THREE.Vector3;
  direction: THREE.Vector3;
}

const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
/** Cone geometry's axis, aligned to the meteor's *backwards* direction below. */
const CONE_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
const scratchRadial = new THREE.Vector3();
const scratchTangent = new THREE.Vector3();
const scratchQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
const scratchBack = new THREE.Vector3();

function armMeteor(state: MeteorState, now: number) {
  const azimuth = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const elevation = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.5; // radians above the horizon
  state.start.set(
    Math.cos(elevation) * Math.cos(azimuth) * METEOR_SHELL,
    Math.sin(elevation) * METEOR_SHELL,
    Math.cos(elevation) * Math.sin(azimuth) * METEOR_SHELL,
  );

  // Fly mostly sideways-and-down across the sky. A purely radial direction
  // would head straight at (or away from) the island and foreshorten into a
  // stationary dot from most camera angles.
  scratchRadial.copy(state.start).normalize();
  scratchTangent.set(-scratchRadial.z, 0, scratchRadial.x).normalize();
  const sideways = (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.5);

  state.direction
    .copy(scratchTangent).multiplyScalar(sideways)
    .addScaledVector(UP, -(0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4))
    .addScaledVector(scratchRadial, -0.15) // drift slightly inward, toward the island
    .normalize();

  state.t = 0;
  state.nextAt = now + METEOR_DURATION + METEOR_GAP_MIN + Math.random() * (METEOR_GAP_MAX - METEOR_GAP_MIN);
}

function Meteor({ nightRef, initialDelay }: { nightRef: React.MutableRefObject<number>; initialDelay: number }) {
  const groupRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const streakRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const headRef = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);

  const state = useRef<MeteorState>({
    t: -1,
    nextAt: initialDelay,
    start: new THREE.Vector3(),
    direction: new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0),
  });

  useFrame((frame, delta) => {
    const group = groupRef.current;
    if (!group) return;

    const night = nightRef.current;
    const now = frame.clock.getElapsedTime();
    const s = state.current;

    // Below the ramp threshold the sky is not night enough for a meteor to read
    // as anything but a stray white line, so hold every flight until it is.
    if (night < 0.35) {
      s.t = -1;
      s.nextAt = Math.max(s.nextAt, now + 1.5);
      group.visible = false;
      return;
    }

    if (s.t < 0) {
      group.visible = false;
      if (now >= s.nextAt) armMeteor(s, now);
      return;
    }

    s.t += delta;
    const progress = s.t / METEOR_DURATION;
    if (progress >= 1) {
      s.t = -1;
      group.visible = false;
      return;
    }

    group.visible = true;
    group.position.copy(s.start).addScaledVector(s.direction, progress * METEOR_TRAVEL);

    // Point the cone's +Y axis backwards along the flight, so its wide base is
    // the leading head and its apex tapers off into the tail.
    scratchBack.copy(s.direction).negate();
    scratchQuat.setFromUnitVectors(CONE_AXIS, scratchBack);
    group.quaternion.copy(scratchQuat);

    // Bright on entry, gone by burnout; ^0.7 keeps it near full brightness for
    // most of the flight instead of only at the midpoint.
    const alpha = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * progress), 0.7) * night;
    if (streakRef.current) {
      (streakRef.current.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = alpha * 0.75;
    }
    if (headRef.current) {
      (headRef.current.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = alpha;
    }
  });

  return (
    <group ref={groupRef} visible={false}>
      {/* Offset by half its length so the group's origin is the head, which is
          the point that follows the flight path. */}
      <mesh ref={streakRef} position={[0, METEOR_LENGTH / 2, 0]}>
        <coneGeometry args={[METEOR_HALF_WIDTH, METEOR_LENGTH, 6, 1, true]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial
          color="#ffffff"
          transparent
          opacity={0}
          depthWrite={false}
          blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
          side={THREE.DoubleSide}
        />
      </mesh>
      <mesh ref={headRef}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[METEOR_HALF_WIDTH * 1.5, 12, 12]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial
          color="#e8f0ff"
          transparent
          opacity={0}
          depthWrite={false}
          blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending}
        />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

export function NightSky() {
  const { weather } = useApp();

  // Shared 0..1 darkness ramp. A ref rather than state so the moon, the stars
  // and both meteors read the same value without re-rendering any of them.
  const nightRef = useRef(0);

  // Read at mount, not per frame. Tonight's phase is tonight's phase — re-deriving it every frame
  // would rebuild the moon's materials 60 times a second for an answer that moves 0.14% an hour.
  const phase = useMemo(() => moonPhaseFraction(), []);

  useFrame(() => {
    nightRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
      nightRef.current,
      weather === WeatherType.MIDNIGHT ? 1 : 0,
      NIGHT_LERP,
    );
  });

  return (
    <group>
      <Moon nightRef={nightRef} phase={phase} />
      <StarField nightRef={nightRef} />
      {/* Two, staggered: usually one crosses alone, but occasionally a pair
          overlaps, which is what makes it feel unscripted. */}
      {Array.from({ length: METEOR_COUNT }).map((_, i) => (
        <Meteor key={i} nightRef={nightRef} initialDelay={3 + i * 7} />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
}

/**

import React, { memo, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { NpcKind, NPC_WALK } from '../../constants/npcs';
import { getNpcSocial } from '../../constants/npcSocial';
import { clampFrameDelta, playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { doorOpennessAt, registerDoorAgent } from '../../lib/interiorDoors';
import { NpcSocialAnimator } from '../../lib/npcSocial';
import { angleDelta, seedFromId } from '../../lib/npcPose';
import { playNpcVoice } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { NpcGait, NpcModel } from './Npcs';

/**
 * 一位會自己在場景裡走來走去的 NPC。
 *
 * 兩位居民（島上的兔子園丁、家裡的河馬管家）共用這一份走路實作，差別分成兩層：
 *
 *   territory   「哪裡可以去、腳下多高」—— 島嶼和房子各自才知道的事（IslandNpcs / InteriorNpcs）。
 *   brain       「現在在做什麼」—— 每位自己的有限狀態機（RabbitGardener / HippoButler）。
 *
 * 這個檔案只負責「身體」：沿著路線走、被牆和家具推開、撞到就掉頭、腳步相位跟著真正走出去的
 * 距離推進，並且在每一次**腳掌落地**時舉一次 {@link NpcBody.stepEvent}。腦子讀那個事件來數步，
 * 所以「走幾步才挖土」是由腳決定的，不是由時鐘決定的 —— 原地轉身、被沙發頂住、站著等門，
 * 腳沒有往前落下，就不會有步數。
 *
 * WORLD SPACE —— 這裡每一個座標都是所在場景的世界座標（島嶼是已經乘過 islandScale 的，
 * 室內是房間座標）。模型本身是單位高度，由 `height` 縮放，跟 constants/npcs.ts 的
 * NpcSpec.height 是同一個數字。
 */

/** 一個路徑點。用最樸素的 XZ，因為高度永遠是問 groundY 得來的，不是被指定的。 */
export interface NpcWaypoint {
  x: number;
  z: number;
  /**
   * 這一站是一道門檻：走到了以後，要等 (gate.x, gate.z) 那扇門真的開了才准往下一個點走。
   *
   * 存的是門的世界座標而不是一個 boolean，因為「等哪一扇」本來就是路線的一部分 —— 挑路線
   * 的那一邊知道自己要穿哪個門口，走路的這一邊不知道、也不該知道。門開了沒有是問
   * lib/interiorDoors.ts，那裡沒登記過的門口一律當作開著（見 doorOpennessAt）。
   */
  gate?: { x: number; z: number };
}

/**
 * 一位 NPC 能活動的範圍，由掛他的那個場景提供。
 */
export interface NpcTerritory {
  /**
   * 從 `from` 出發，挑下一段閒逛路線。
   *
   * 回傳的是「一串路徑點」而不是單一目的地，因為室內需要它：房間之間隔著牆，只有門口
   * 那一段能過去。回空陣列代表「現在挑不出來」，呼叫端會歇一下再問一次 —— 不是錯誤。
   */
  pickRoute: (from: THREE.Vector3) => NpcWaypoint[];
  /**
   * 從 `from` 走到指定的 `to` 要經過哪些點，走不到就是 null。
   *
   * 腦子有明確目的地時用（園丁要換一塊能挖的地、管家要走到設施前面）。島上是一條直線；室內
   * 同一間是直線、隔壁間要穿門，再遠就算走不到 —— 「走到哪就玩什麼」本來就不該跨三個房間。
   */
  routeTo: (from: THREE.Vector3, to: { x: number; z: number }) => NpcWaypoint[] | null;
  /**
   * 把位置推回站得住的地方（牆、家具、水線），就地修改。
   *
   * 每幀都會呼叫，而且是「推開」而不是「擋住」：一位撞上沙發就停住的管家會卡在那裡直到
   * 玩家離開，被推開的那位則會蹭著沙發邊繼續走。
   */
  contain: (pos: THREE.Vector3) => void;
  /** 這一點的腳下地面高度。 */
  groundY: (x: number, z: number) => number;
}

/**
 * 腦子直接把身體擺在某個位置（坐上沙發、坐進搖椅）。
 *
 * 擺著的時候這裡不走路、不做碰撞、不被玩家推 —— 坐在沙發上的管家本來就在沙發的碰撞盒裡面，
 * 讓 contain 每幀把他推出來，他就永遠坐不下去。y 是絕對高度，不再問地面。
 */
export interface NpcOverride {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
  yaw: number;
  /** 整隻繞自己的左右軸前後傾（坐在搖椅上跟著搖）。正 = 往前。 */
  pitch?: number;
}

/** 腦子看得到、也寫得了的身體。每幀同一個物件，不會被換掉。 */
export interface NpcBody {
  readonly kind: NpcKind;
  readonly height: number;
  readonly pos: THREE.Vector3;
  yaw: number;
  /** 模型讀的那一份步態。腦子寫 `pose` 與 `rig`，走路的部分由這裡寫。 */
  readonly gait: NpcGait;
  /** 還沒走完的路徑點，[0] 是下一個。 */
  route: NpcWaypoint[];
  /** 路線走完時要不要自己挑下一段閒逛路線（站一下再走）。 */
  wander: boolean;
  /** 見 {@link NpcOverride}。null = 正常走路。 */
  override: NpcOverride | null;
  /** 腦子想讓頭看的方向（相對身體），以及它要蓋過走路張望的比例。 */
  look: { yaw: number; pitch: number; weight: number };
  /** 速度倍率。走向設施的最後一小段放慢，看起來才是「走過去」而不是「衝過去」。 */
  speedScale: number;
  readonly territory: NpcTerritory;

  // ---- 這一幀發生了什麼（由這裡寫、腦子讀） ----
  /** 這一幀有沒有真的往前走出去。 */
  walking: boolean;
  /** 這一幀有一隻腳完成了一次落地 —— 計步的唯一來源。 */
  stepEvent: boolean;
  /** 這一幀走完了整條路線。 */
  arrived: boolean;
  /** 這一幀路線被放棄了（撞牆、卡住）。 */
  abandoned: boolean;
}

/** 一位 NPC 的有限狀態機。每幀在身體移動之後被呼叫一次。 */
export interface NpcBrain {
  update(body: NpcBody, delta: number, t: number): void;
  /** 卸載時清掉鎖、聲音、事件與暫存物件。 */
  dispose(body: NpcBody): void;
}

/** 最短路徑的角度內插，免得轉過 ±π 時繞遠路。 */
function turnToward(current: number, target: number, alpha: number): number {
  const delta = Math.atan2(Math.sin(target - current), Math.cos(target - current));
  return current + delta * alpha;
}

/** 與幀率無關的緩動：這一幀要補掉剩餘差距的幾成。 */
function easeAlpha(rate: number, delta: number): number {
  return 1 - Math.exp(-rate * delta);
}

/**
 * 原地慢慢轉向 `target`，回傳還差多少弧度。
 *
 * 轉身有角速度上限（{@link TURN_IN_PLACE}），不是指數逼近：指數逼近在角度差大的時候第一幀轉得
 * 最快，180° 的迴轉會像被甩過去。上限之下再用緩動收尾，停下來那一下才不會喀一聲。
 */
export function faceToward(body: NpcBody, target: number, delta: number): number {
  const diff = Math.atan2(Math.sin(target - body.yaw), Math.cos(target - body.yaw));
  const eased = diff * easeAlpha(NPC_WALK.turnRate, delta);
  const capped = Math.sign(eased) * Math.min(Math.abs(eased), TURN_IN_PLACE * delta);
  body.yaw += capped;
  return Math.abs(diff - capped);
}

/** 原地轉身的最大角速度，弧度每秒。180° 大約 1.3 秒 —— 這兩位是慢慢轉過去的。 */
const TURN_IN_PLACE = 2.6;

/**
 * 張望的幅度。
 *
 * 走路時只有一點點（0.22 弧度，約 13°）—— 一邊走一邊大幅度轉頭會看起來像在找廁所；站定
 * 之後才放大到 0.78（約 45°），配上一點低頭，那才是「停下來看東西」。
 */
const LOOK = {
  walkYaw: 0.22,
  pauseYaw: 0.78,
  walkPitch: 0.02,
  pausePitch: 0.13,
  /** 掃視的角速度。刻意慢：這兩位在觀察，不是在警戒。 */
  speed: 0.72,
  /** 走 / 停之間切換的緩動速率。 */
  blend: 1.8,
  /** 看著玩家時頭的仰角。 */
  facePitch: -0.05,
} as const;

/**
 * 不會走進玩家身體裡的最短距離。
 *
 * 這兩位不會閃避玩家 —— 這裡做的只是最後那一下：真的疊在一起時把他推開。走不到目的地的話，
 * 卡住偵測會讓他換一個地方去。
 */
const PLAYER_CLEARANCE = 0.75;

/** 跟寵物保持的距離。寵物比玩家小，但一樣不該跟居民長在一起。 */
const PET_CLEARANCE = 0.55;

/**
 * 撞到邊緣的判準：這一步真正走進目標方向的比例。
 *
 * 走不通的時候，contain 每幀都會把她推回來 —— 位置幾乎沒變，但她一直在「走」。所以問的是
 * 「這一步到底走進去了幾成」：擦著牆滑過去還留著大半個步伐，正面頂在岸線或牆上則幾乎是零。
 */
const BOUNCE_PROGRESS = 0.45;

/** 連續走不動多久才算「這條路走不通」。 */
const BOUNCE_SECONDS = 0.15;

/** 站著的時候被推多遠才算「這個位置本身待不住」，每幀的公尺數。 */
const SHOVE_EPSILON = 0.001;

/** 掉頭前站住的時間。 */
const BOUNCE_PAUSE = 0.4;

/** 掉頭之後，多久之內不再往剛剛被擋下來的那個方向走。 */
const BOUNCE_MEMORY = 5;

/** 「跟剛剛被擋下來的是同一個方向」的判準：夾角 60 度以內。 */
const BOUNCE_CONE = Math.cos(Math.PI / 3);

/** 為了避開被擋下的方向，最多重挑幾次路線。 */
const REROUTE_ATTEMPTS = 4;

/** 這條路線的第一步，是不是又朝著剛剛被擋下來的方向去。 */
function headsIntoBlocked(
  route: NpcWaypoint[], from: THREE.Vector3, blocked: THREE.Vector2,
): boolean {
  const dx = route[0].x - from.x;
  const dz = route[0].z - from.z;
  const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (d < 1e-4) return false;
  return (dx / d) * blocked.x + (dz / d) * blocked.y > BOUNCE_CONE;
}

/**
 * 門要開到幾成才准跨過去。0.8 的時候兩片門扇之間已經有 2.4 的淨寬，管家過得去。
 */
const DOOR_PASSABLE = 0.8;

export const NpcWalker = memo(function NpcWalker({
  npcId, name, scope, kind, height, spawnX, spawnZ, spawnRotation, territory, opensDoors = false, brain,
}: {
  npcId: string;
  name: string;
  scope: 'island' | 'interior';
  kind: NpcKind;
  /** 世界單位的身高。模型是單位高度，這是它的縮放。 */
  height: number;
  /** 出生點。只有第一幀會讀 —— 之後他在哪是他自己走出來的。 */
  spawnX: number;
  spawnZ: number;
  spawnRotation: number;
  territory: NpcTerritory;
  /**
   * 這一位會不會讓自動門為他開。預設關著：島上那位的座標跟室內的房間網格是同一個數字空間，
   * 由呼叫端說「我這位住在屋裡」，比在這裡猜他在哪個場景可靠。
   */
  opensDoors?: boolean;
  /** 這一位的狀態機。沒有就是單純閒逛（預覽頁用）。 */
  brain?: NpcBrain;
}) {
  const group = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const squashGroup = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const gait = useRef<NpcGait>({ intensity: 0, phase: 0, lookYaw: 0, lookPitch: 0, pose: null, rig: null });

  // 出生點就先填進去，不等第一幀 —— 這個物件會被登記給門看，而 (0,0,0) 正好是客廳的正中央。
  const body = useRef<NpcBody>(null as unknown as NpcBody);
  if (body.current === null) {
    body.current = {
      kind,
      height,
      pos: new THREE.Vector3(spawnX, 0, spawnZ),
      yaw: spawnRotation,
      gait: gait.current,
      route: [],
      wander: true,
      override: null,
      look: { yaw: 0, pitch: 0, weight: 0 },
      speedScale: 1,
      territory,
      walking: false,
      stepEvent: false,
      arrived: false,
      abandoned: false,
    };
  }
  const spawned = useRef(false);
  /** 站著看的剩餘秒數（只在 wander 時用）。 */
  const pause = useRef(0.8);
  /** 目前的張望幅度（0 = 走路時的小幅度，1 = 站定時的大幅度）。 */
  const looking = useRef(0);
  /** 上一幀離目前路徑點的距離，和「距離沒有變近」持續了多久 —— 卡住偵測用。 */
  const lastDist = useRef(Infinity);
  const stuckFor = useRef(0);
  /** 這一幀開始移動之前的位置。 */
  const stepFrom = useRef(new THREE.Vector3());
  /** 「這一步幾乎沒走進去」已經連續多久。 */
  const blockedFor = useRef(0);
  const blockedDir = useRef(new THREE.Vector2());
  const blockedUntil = useRef(0);

  const social = useMemo(() => {
    const profile = getNpcSocial(kind);
    return profile ? { profile, animator: new NpcSocialAnimator(profile, seedFromId(npcId)) } : null;
  }, [kind, npcId]);

  const headAnchor = useRef(new THREE.Vector3());
  const target = useRef<NonNullable<typeof playerBus.npcTarget>>({
    npcId, scope, anchor: headAnchor.current, reach: 0, label: '', talking: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!social) return;
    const onInteract = (e: Event) => {
      if ((e as CustomEvent<{ npcId?: string }>).detail?.npcId === npcId) social.animator.requestTalk();
    };
    window.addEventListener('npc-interact', onInteract);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('npc-interact', onInteract);
  }, [social, npcId]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (playerBus.npcTarget?.npcId === npcId) playerBus.npcTarget = null;
    if (playerBus.npcSpeech?.npcId === npcId) {
      playerBus.npcSpeech = null;
      playerBus.npcSpeechPrompt = null;
    }
  }, [npcId]);

  /** territory 每次重繪都是新物件，走路的迴圈讀的是 body 上那一份。 */
  useEffect(() => {
    (body.current as { territory: NpcTerritory }).territory = territory;
  }, [territory]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!opensDoors) return;
    return registerDoorAgent(body.current.pos);
  }, [opensDoors]);

  // 腦子的清理：鎖、聲音、正在坐的家具，全部在它自己的 dispose 裡。
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!brain) return;
    const b = body.current;
    return () => brain.dispose(b);
  }, [brain]);

  useFrame(({ clock }, rawDelta) => {
    const g = group.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const b = body.current;
    const pos = b.pos;

    const delta = clampFrameDelta(rawDelta);
    const t = clock.getElapsedTime();
    const terr = b.territory;

    if (!spawned.current) {
      pos.set(spawnX, terr.groundY(spawnX, spawnZ), spawnZ);
      b.yaw = spawnRotation;
      spawned.current = true;
    }

    b.walking = false;
    b.stepEvent = false;
    b.arrived = false;
    b.abandoned = false;

    const player = playerBus.playerPos;
    const inScene = scope === 'interior' ? !!playerBus.isInsideHouse : !playerBus.isInsideHouse;
    const available = !!player && inScene && !playerBus.isBuildMode;
    let frame: ReturnType<NpcSocialAnimator['update']> | null = null;
    let toPlayer = b.yaw;
    if (social && b.override === null) {
      let distance: number | null = null;
      let bearing = 0;
      if (available && player) {
        const dx = player.x - pos.x;
        const dz = player.z - pos.z;
        distance = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        toPlayer = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
        bearing = angleDelta(b.yaw, toPlayer);
      }
      frame = social.animator.update({
        delta,
        distance,
        bearing,
        available,
        paused: b.route.length === 0,
      });
    }
    const hold = frame?.hold ?? false;
    const pace = frame?.pace ?? 1;

    let travelled = 0;
    let walking = false;
    stepFrom.current.copy(pos);
    let stepX = 0;
    let stepZ = 0;
    let waitingAtGate = false;
    const seated = b.override !== null;

    if (!seated) {
      if (b.route.length === 0) {
        if (b.wander) {
          pause.current -= delta;
          if (pause.current <= 0) {
            const avoid = t < blockedUntil.current ? blockedDir.current : null;
            let picked: NpcWaypoint[] = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < REROUTE_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
              picked = terr.pickRoute(pos);
              if (picked.length === 0) break;
              if (!avoid || !headsIntoBlocked(picked, pos, avoid)) break;
            }
            b.route = picked;
            pause.current = b.route.length > 0 ? 0 : 0.5;
            lastDist.current = Infinity;
            stuckFor.current = 0;
            blockedFor.current = 0;
          }
        }
      } else if (hold) {
        lastDist.current = Infinity;
        stuckFor.current = 0;
      } else {
        const target = b.route[0];
        const dx = target.x - pos.x;
        const dz = target.z - pos.z;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);

        if (dist <= NPC_WALK.arrive) {
          // 門檻：走到了，但門還沒開就在這裡等（見 NpcWaypoint.gate）。
          if (target.gate && doorOpennessAt(target.gate.x, target.gate.z) < DOOR_PASSABLE) {
            waitingAtGate = true;
            lastDist.current = Infinity;
            stuckFor.current = 0;
          } else {
            b.route.shift();
            if (b.route.length === 0) {
              b.arrived = true;
              pause.current = NPC_WALK.pauseMin + Math.random() * (NPC_WALK.pauseMax - NPC_WALK.pauseMin);
            }
            lastDist.current = Infinity;
            stuckFor.current = 0;
          }
        } else {
          walking = true;
          travelled = Math.min(dist, NPC_WALK.speed * b.speedScale * pace * delta);
          stepX = dx / dist;
          stepZ = dz / dist;
          pos.x += stepX * travelled;
          pos.z += stepZ * travelled;
          b.yaw = turnToward(b.yaw, Math.atan2(dx, dz), easeAlpha(NPC_WALK.turnRate, delta));

          stuckFor.current = dist < lastDist.current - 0.01 ? 0 : stuckFor.current + delta;
          lastDist.current = dist;
          if (stuckFor.current > NPC_WALK.stuckSeconds) {
            b.route.length = 0;
            b.abandoned = true;
            pause.current = 0.6;
            stuckFor.current = 0;
          }
        }
      }

      // 牆、家具、水線，然後才問地面高度。
      terr.contain(pos);

      // 玩家與寵物：先讓場景決定他能站哪，再處理「那個位置上剛好站著誰」。
      const pushFrom = (other: THREE.Vector3 | undefined, clearance: number) => {
        if (!other) return;
        const ox = pos.x - other.x;
        const oz = pos.z - other.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(ox, oz);
        if (d >= clearance) return;
        const nx = d > 1e-4 ? ox / d : Math.sin(b.yaw);
        const nz = d > 1e-4 ? oz / d : Math.cos(b.yaw);
        pos.x = other.x + nx * clearance;
        pos.z = other.z + nz * clearance;
      };
      pushFrom(playerBus.playerPos, PLAYER_CLEARANCE);
      pushFrom(playerBus.dogPos, PET_CLEARANCE);

      // 撞到邊緣就掉頭（見 BOUNCE_PROGRESS）。
      const gained = walking
        ? (pos.x - stepFrom.current.x) * stepX + (pos.z - stepFrom.current.z) * stepZ
        : 0;
      const blocked = walking
        ? gained < travelled * BOUNCE_PROGRESS
        : Math.hypot(pos.x - stepFrom.current.x, pos.z - stepFrom.current.z) > SHOVE_EPSILON;
      blockedFor.current = blocked && !waitingAtGate && !hold ? blockedFor.current + delta : 0;
      if (blockedFor.current >= BOUNCE_SECONDS) {
        const hadRoute = b.route.length > 0;
        b.route.length = 0;
        blockedFor.current = 0;
        stuckFor.current = 0;
        lastDist.current = Infinity;
        if (hadRoute) b.abandoned = true;
        if (walking) {
          pause.current = BOUNCE_PAUSE;
          blockedDir.current.set(stepX, stepZ);
          blockedUntil.current = t + BOUNCE_MEMORY;
        } else {
          pause.current = 0;
          blockedUntil.current = 0;
        }
      }

      /*
       * 步伐相位，與腳步事件。
       *
       * 相位被「這一步真正往前走出去的距離」推進 —— 不是被時間、也不是被「打算走多遠」推進。
       * 被沙發頂住時 gained 是零，腿就不會在原地空踩，也就不會有步數；擦著牆滑過去時只推進滑
       * 出去的那一段。半個週期是一步（左腳落地、右腳落地），一步的長度是 height × stride。
       *
       * 相位跨過 0 或 π 的那一幀，就是一隻腳落地的那一幀 —— {@link NpcBody.stepEvent}。一幀最多
       * 走 speed × 0.1 = 0.115，一步至少 0.5，所以一幀不可能跨過兩次落地，切回分頁時也不會一次
       * 補好幾步。
       */
      const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(travelled, gained));
      if (progress > 0) {
        const before = gait.current.phase;
        const after = before + (progress / (height * NPC_WALK.stride)) * Math.PI;
        if (Math.floor(after / Math.PI) !== Math.floor(before / Math.PI)) b.stepEvent = true;
        gait.current.phase = after % (Math.PI * 2);
      }
      b.walking = walking && progress > travelled * BOUNCE_PROGRESS;
    }

    if (social && frame && !walking && frame.face > 0.01 && available) {
      b.yaw = turnToward(
        b.yaw, toPlayer, easeAlpha(social.profile.faceTurnRate * frame.face, delta),
      );
    }

    gait.current.intensity = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
      gait.current.intensity, walking && !seated ? 1 : 0, easeAlpha(7, delta),
    );

    // ---- 腦子 ----
    brain?.update(b, delta, t);

    // ---- 張望 ----
    looking.current = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(looking.current, walking ? 0 : 1, easeAlpha(LOOK.blend, delta));
    const sweep = Math.sin(t * LOOK.speed);
    const sweepYaw = sweep * THREE.MathUtils.lerp(LOOK.walkYaw, LOOK.pauseYaw, looking.current);
    const sweepPitch = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(LOOK.walkPitch, LOOK.pausePitch, looking.current);
    let socialYaw = sweepYaw;
    let socialPitch = sweepPitch;

    if (frame) {
      const engaged = frame.engaged;
      gait.current.pose = frame.pose;
      socialYaw = sweepYaw * (1 - engaged) + frame.pose.headYaw;
      socialPitch = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(sweepPitch, LOOK.facePitch, engaged) + frame.pose.headPitch;
    } else {
      gait.current.pose = null;
    }

    const w = b.look.weight;
    gait.current.lookYaw = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(socialYaw, b.look.yaw, w);
    gait.current.lookPitch = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(socialPitch, b.look.pitch, w);

    // ---- 擺上去 ----
    let hop = 0;
    // YXZ：先轉朝向、再在自己的左右軸上前後傾，搖椅的搖動才是沿著他自己面對的方向。
    g.rotation.order = 'YXZ';
    g.rotation.x = b.override?.pitch ?? 0;
    if (b.override) {
      pos.set(b.override.x, b.override.y, b.override.z);
      b.yaw = b.override.yaw;
      g.rotation.z = 0;
    } else {
      const surfaceY = terr.groundY(pos.x, pos.z);
      pos.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(pos.y, surfaceY, easeAlpha(14, delta));
      // 身體的上下起伏與左右重心，跟腿用同一個相位。
      hop = Math.abs(Math.sin(gait.current.phase)) * height * 0.02 * gait.current.intensity;
      g.rotation.z = Math.sin(gait.current.phase) * 0.035 * gait.current.intensity;
    }
    g.position.set(pos.x, pos.y + hop, pos.z);
    g.rotation.y = b.yaw;

    // squash & stretch 套在根上：模型原點就是腳底，所以縮放不會讓腳離開地面。
    const sg = squashGroup.current;
    if (sg) {
      const s = gait.current.rig?.squash ?? 0;
      sg.scale.set(1 - s * 0.5, 1 + s, 1 - s * 0.5);
    }

    // --- 發佈：提示、泡泡、聲音 -------------------------------------------------------------
    if (social && frame) {
      const profile = social.profile;
      headAnchor.current.set(pos.x, pos.y + height * (1 + profile.headClearance), pos.z);

      if (available && frame.inTalkReach) {
        const tgt = target.current;
        tgt.reach = profile.talkReach;
        tgt.talking = frame.talking;
        tgt.label = frame.talking ? profile.promptContinue : profile.prompt;
        playerBus.npcTarget = tgt;
      } else if (playerBus.npcTarget?.npcId === npcId) {
        playerBus.npcTarget = null;
      }

      if (frame.lineStarted >= 0) {
        playerBus.npcSpeech = {
          npcId,
          scope,
          name,
          text: profile.lines[frame.lineStarted],
          anchor: headAnchor.current,
          startedAt: performance.now(),
          seconds: profile.lineSeconds + profile.talkIdleTimeout,
        };
        playNpcVoice(profile.voice, frame.lineStarted);
      }
      if (frame.talkEnded && playerBus.npcSpeech?.npcId === npcId) {
        playerBus.npcSpeech = null;
      }
    }
  });

  return (
    <group ref={group} scale={height}>
      <group ref={squashGroup}>
        <NpcModel kind={kind} gait={gait} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
});

```
