## src/components/Three/PlacementGhost.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { getItemById } from '../../constants/items';
import { DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS, SURFACE_DECAL_LIFT } from '../../constants/terrain';
import { FurnitureModel } from './FurnitureItem';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { usePlayerHome, getPlayerHome } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import { getHouseStyle, STARTER_HOUSE_ITEM_ID } from '../../constants/houseStyles';
import {
  Footprint, footprintOutline, getFootprint, getFootprintVersion, makeObb, measureFootprint,
  obbContainsPoint, subscribeFootprints,
} from '../../lib/furniturePlacement';
import { PLAYER_PHYSICAL_RADIUS } from '../../utils/placementRules';
import {
  HOME_INSTANCE_ID,
  PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MESSAGE,
  PlacementVerdict,
  evaluateIslandPlacement,
} from '../../lib/placementSurfaces';
import { HouseModel } from './HouseModel';
import { PlacedItem, View } from '../../types';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { describeRecentFailure } from '../../lib/saveStatus';
import { useSightlineOccluder } from '../../constants/layers';
import {
  PointerRayLike,
  canSelect,
  consumeCancelKeyGuard,
  endSession,
  isClickGuarded,
  isManipulating,
  rayHitHorizontal,
  selectSubject,
} from '../../lib/placementSession';
import { usePlacementDrag } from './usePlacementDrag';
import { playPlacementError } from '../../lib/soundUtils';

// The buzz itself moved to lib/soundUtils.ts (playPlacementError). It used to be spelled out
// here over a `new AudioContext()` of its own, which meant it both leaked contexts - the browser
// caps a page at about six, after which every later one throws and takes ALL of the game's audio
// with it - and answered to nothing, including 全部靜音.

/**
 * Asks the Placement System whether `itemId` may stand at `(x, z)`, and how high it would sit.
 *
 * A thin adapter, deliberately: every rule this used to implement itself — a circle around the
 * Home sized by a hand-typed `footprintRadius`, a second circle around the candidate, a flat
 * `y = 0.35` for everything regardless of what was underneath — now lives in
 * lib/placementSurfaces.ts, next to the rule the player's own feet are resolved with. The ghost's
 * job is to show the verdict, not to have an opinion of its own.
 */
function evaluateAt(
  itemId: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  rotation: number,
  profile: any,
  islandScale: number,
  excludeInstanceId: string | null,
): PlacementVerdict {
  return evaluateIslandPlacement({
    itemId,
    x,
    z,
    rotation,
    placements: profile?.islandPlacements || [],
    home: getPlayerHome(profile),
    islandScale,
    excludeInstanceId,
  });
}

/**
 * How far outside a newly-seeded object the player has to be standing — see {@link swallowsPlayer}.
 *
 * PLAYER_PHYSICAL_RADIUS (0.35) is what the character collides with the world at, and clearing the
 * box by exactly that is not enough: it puts the character's shoulder against the wall, which for a
 * building reads as standing in the doorway rather than beside the house. Half a metre on top is
 * about a stride, which is the distance at which the object is plainly a separate thing.
 */
const SEED_PLAYER_CLEARANCE = PLAYER_PHYSICAL_RADIUS + 0.5;

/**
 * Would an object seeded here be placed ON TOP of the player?
 *
 * The placement rules proper have no opinion about this and should not: they answer "may this
 * object exist at these coordinates", and a player standing in the way is not a permanent property
 * of the ground. But a spot the SOLVER picks is different from a spot the player drags to — nobody
 * chose it, so it must not be a spot that puts the character inside the object.
 *
 * That is what happened to every new player. The spiral below starts at the island's centre, the
 * character also spawns at the island's centre, and the first thing the game does is hand them a
 * house — so the Starter House's opening position was, reliably, exactly where they were standing.
 * From third person that is a doll's house with someone sealed inside it; from first person (the
 * camera anyone who had zoomed all the way in still had) it is worse, because the walls are drawn
 * one-sided and you are inside them: the player's first sight of their island is the inside of a
 * building they can see straight out through. AppContext's first-home camera reset is the other
 * half of this fix; it puts the camera outside their head, and this puts the house outside them.
 *
 * Tested against the object's own measured box, so it is exact for a 火把 and for a house alike.
 * An unmeasured item (no footprint yet) is let through — the seed is re-evaluated once the model
 * mounts and measures itself, and refusing every spot for a box we do not have would leave the
 * ghost nowhere to go.
 */
function swallowsPlayer(itemId: string, x: number, z: number, rotation: number): boolean {
  const player = playerBus.playerPos;
  const fp = getFootprint(itemId);
  if (!player || !fp) return false;
  // Grown by the clearance on both axes rather than distance-tested from the box, which is what
  // makes this exact on a long thin object: a deck's corner and a deck's long side both end up the
  // same stride away, where a radius test would have let the player stand against the middle of it.
  const grown: Footprint = {
    ...fp,
    halfW: fp.halfW + SEED_PLAYER_CLEARANCE,
    halfD: fp.halfD + SEED_PLAYER_CLEARANCE,
  };
  return obbContainsPoint(makeObb(grown, x, z, rotation), player.x, player.z);
}

/**
 * Where a newly armed copy starts: a spiral out from the island's centre for the first spot the
 * rules accept AND that is not on top of the player. Unchanged in shape — it just asks the one
 * shared rule now, so a spot the solver picks can never be a spot the live drag check would
 * immediately mark red.
 */
function findOpeningPlacement(
  itemId: string,
  profile: any,
  islandScale: number
): [number, number, number] {
  const spacing = 0.3;
  const maxRadius = 4.5 * islandScale;

  for (let r = 0; r <= maxRadius; r += spacing) {
    const steps = Math.max(8, Math.floor(2 * Math.PI * r / spacing));
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const angle = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
      const testX = Math.cos(angle) * r;
      const testZ = Math.sin(angle) * r;

      if (swallowsPlayer(itemId, testX, testZ, 0)) continue;
      const verdict = evaluateAt(itemId, testX, testZ, 0, profile, islandScale, null);
      if (verdict.ok) return [testX, verdict.y, testZ];
    }
  }

  // Backup search with randomized coordinates if space is extremely constrained
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const radius = (1.0 + Math.random() * 3.0) * islandScale;
    const testX = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
    const testZ = Math.sin(angle) * radius;

    if (swallowsPlayer(itemId, testX, testZ, 0)) continue;
    const verdict = evaluateAt(itemId, testX, testZ, 0, profile, islandScale, null);
    if (verdict.ok) return [testX, verdict.y, testZ];
  }

  // Last resort, and deliberately NOT filtered by the player: an island with no legal spot left
  // has to put the ghost somewhere for the player to drag off, and refusing here would return
  // nothing at all. Every path above has already preferred a spot clear of them.
  const fallback = evaluateAt(itemId, 0, 0, 0, profile, islandScale, null);
  return [0, fallback.y, 0];
}

/** How thick the on-ground footprint ring is drawn. */
const OUTLINE_THICKNESS = 0.06;

/**
 * The ground the object will actually occupy, drawn flat on the surface under it.
 *
 * This replaced a fixed `ringGeometry(1.2, 1.3)` — the same circle for a 火把 and for a 木製平台
 * five units across. A ring that size is a promise the placement rules never made: it read as the
 * object's clearance, so a spot that looked comfortably empty inside the ring could still be
 * refused, and one that looked tight was fine. Reading the measured footprint means what the
 * player is shown is the shape the check is run against, to the centimetre.
 *
 * And it is now genuinely that SHAPE, not a rectangle around it: the collider is the model's own
 * convex outline (lib/collisionShape.ts), so a 噴泉 draws a ring and a plank draws a sliver. This
 * is the whole rule made visible — a player who can see the outline hug the model can see why a
 * spot was refused, which is what a box could never show them because the box was not the reason.
 */
function FootprintOutline({ footprint, blocked }: { footprint: Footprint | null; blocked: boolean }) {
  const geometry = useMemo(() => {
    if (!footprint) return null;
    // Local frame: this mesh is a child of the ghost's own rotated group, so the outline is drawn
    // un-rotated and carried round by the parent — the same transform the collider goes through.
    const ring = footprintOutline(footprint, 0, 0, 0);
    if (ring.length < 3) return null;

    // An inner copy pulled toward the outline's centre, so the two rings bound a band. Radial
    // rather than a true polygon offset: at 6cm on shapes this size the difference is invisible,
    // and a true offset needs mitre handling that a decal does not earn.
    let cx = 0;
    let cz = 0;
    for (const [x, z] of ring) { cx += x; cz += z; }
    cx /= ring.length;
    cz /= ring.length;

    const positions: number[] = [];
    const push = (x: number, z: number) => { positions.push(x, 0, z); };
    for (let i = 0; i < ring.length; i++) {
      const j = (i + 1) % ring.length;
      const pull = ([x, z]: [number, number]): [number, number] => {
        const dx = x - cx;
        const dz = z - cz;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        const k = d > OUTLINE_THICKNESS ? (d - OUTLINE_THICKNESS) / d : 0;
        return [cx + dx * k, cz + dz * k];
      };
      const [ax, az] = ring[i];
      const [bx, bz] = ring[j];
      const [aix, aiz] = pull(ring[i]);
      const [bix, biz] = pull(ring[j]);
      push(ax, az); push(bx, bz); push(bix, biz);
      push(ax, az); push(bix, biz); push(aix, aiz);
    }

    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    return geo;
  }, [footprint]);

  useEffect(() => () => geometry?.dispose(), [geometry]);

  if (!geometry) return null;

  return (
    <mesh name="indicator-ring" position={[0, SURFACE_DECAL_LIFT, 0]} geometry={geometry}>
      <meshBasicMaterial
        color={blocked ? '#dc2626' : '#0ea5e9'}
        transparent
        opacity={0.75}
        side={THREE.DoubleSide}
        {...DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS}
      />
    </mesh>
  );
}

/**
 * The one object the player is currently siting on the island — a newly bought copy, a placed
 * object they clicked to move, or the Home itself.
 *
 * All three are the same session (see context/useIslandEditor.ts): drag to move, R to rotate,
 * double-click or the panel's 確認 to commit. Which write happens on commit is the draft's own
 * business, so nothing here branches on "is this a house or a decoration" beyond picking the
 * mesh to draw.
 */
export function PlacementGhost() {
  const {
    islandDraft, profile, showIslandAlert,
    setDraftTransform, setDraftBlock, commitDraft, cancelDraft, rotateDraft,
  } = useApp();
  const ghostRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);

  const item = islandDraft?.itemId ? getItemById(islandDraft.itemId) : null;
  // Establishing the Home runs through this same ghost so siting your house feels identical to
  // siting anything else - only the commit step differs (placeHome vs placeIslandItem).
  const isHouse = islandDraft?.kind === 'home' || islandDraft?.itemId === STARTER_HOUSE_ITEM_ID;

  const modelRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);

  const posRef = useRef<[number, number, number]>([0, 0.35, 0]);
  const [initialPos, setInitialPos] = useState<[number, number, number]>([0, 0.35, 0]);
  const [blockReason, setBlockReason] = useState<PlacementVerdict['reason']>(null);
  const blockReasonRef = useRef<PlacementVerdict['reason']>(null);
  const isBlocked = blockReason !== null;

  const territoryLevel = profile?.territoryLevel || 1;
  const islandScale = 1 + (territoryLevel - 1) * 0.4;
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);

  const hasDraft = !!islandDraft;
  const rot = islandDraft?.rotation ?? 0;
  // Mirrored so the drag's release handler — installed once, on the window — reads the rotation as
  // it is at that moment rather than as it was when the listener was created.
  const rotRef = useRef(rot);
  rotRef.current = rot;
  const collisionItemId = islandDraft?.kind === 'home' ? STARTER_HOUSE_ITEM_ID : islandDraft?.itemId ?? null;
  // Moving the Home excludes the Home, moving a placement excludes that placement. Same slot,
  // because the Home goes through the shared obstacle list as an ordinary box now.
  const excludeInstanceId = islandDraft?.kind === 'home'
    ? HOME_INSTANCE_ID
    : islandDraft?.instanceId ?? null;

  // Every already-placed item measures its own footprint on mount (IslandPlacements below), so by
  // the time a SECOND copy of that item type is dragged, its collision box is already cached. The
  // very first copy of a type the player has never placed before has no such earlier instance to
  // have measured it - so the drag ghost measures its own model too. Subscribed rather than read
  // once because that measurement lands one render after this component mounts (lib/
  // furniturePlacement.ts's `measureFootprint`/`subscribeFootprints`), and the overlap check below
  // needs to re-run the moment it does - see the rot/footprintVersion effect further down.
  const footprintVersion = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeFootprints, getFootprintVersion);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (collisionItemId && collisionItemId !== STARTER_HOUSE_ITEM_ID && modelRef.current) {
      measureFootprint(collisionItemId, modelRef.current);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [collisionItemId]);

  // A draft is re-seeded only when the *subject* changes — dragging and rotating must never
  // snap it back to a solver-chosen spot.
  const draftKey = islandDraft
    ? `${islandDraft.kind}:${islandDraft.itemId ?? 'home'}:${islandDraft.instanceId ?? ''}`
    : null;

  const evaluateHere = (x: number, z: number): PlacementVerdict =>
    collisionItemId
      ? evaluateAt(collisionItemId, x, z, rot, profile, islandScale, excludeInstanceId)
      // Nothing identifiable to place (should not happen — a draft always names its subject), so
      // the spot is whatever was asked for and the verdict is "fine".
      : { ok: true, reason: null, x, z, y: 0.35, supportId: null };

  const applyVerdict = (verdict: PlacementVerdict) => {
    if (verdict.reason === blockReasonRef.current) return;
    blockReasonRef.current = verdict.reason;
    setBlockReason(verdict.reason);
    setDraftBlock(verdict.reason ? PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MESSAGE[verdict.reason] : null);
  };

  /**
   * Moves the ghost to `(x, z)` and drops it onto whatever surface is there.
   *
   * The height is resolved every time rather than pinned at 0.35, which is what makes an object
   * dragged over a deck climb onto the boards instead of sliding through them — and what makes an
   * object dragged back off it settle onto the grass.
   */
  const updateGhostPosition = (x: number, z: number) => {
    const verdict = evaluateHere(x, z);
    // The rule's corrected spot, not the raw one it was asked about: it quantises, and it slides
    // the object back onto a deck or a tabletop it is hanging off. Drawing the ghost at the
    // requested point instead would put the picture and the verdict in different places.
    posRef.current = [verdict.x, verdict.y, verdict.z];
    if (ghostRef.current) {
      ghostRef.current.position.set(verdict.x, verdict.y, verdict.z);
    }
    applyVerdict(verdict);
  };

  /**
   * The island's Placement Raycast: pointer ray in, a spot on the island out.
   *
   * The whole of what the ghost's own `onPointerMove` and the invisible ring's used to do between
   * them, in one place and off one plane. The plane is the height the object is CURRENTLY sitting
   * at, so an object that has climbed onto a deck keeps the grabbed point under the cursor instead
   * of lagging behind it by the deck's height times the camera's slant — and, because there is now
   * exactly one such plane rather than the ghost's and the ring's fixed 0.34, crossing the model's
   * own outline no longer makes the object jump between two answers.
   *
   * Split out from the drag so the ground's own 「點一下決定落點」 click reads the SAME plane and
   * the same clamp. Aiming with a click and aiming with a drag disagreeing about where the pointer
   * is in the world is exactly the class of bug this file has already been through once.
   */
  const aimPoint = (ray: PointerRayLike): [number, number] | null => {
    const hit = rayHitHorizontal(ray, posRef.current[1]);
    if (!hit) return null;
    // The island's outer edge, which grows with the territory level.
    const maxDist = 9.0 * islandScale;
    return [
      Math.max(-maxDist, Math.min(maxDist, hit.x)),
      Math.max(-maxDist, Math.min(maxDist, hit.z)),
    ];
  };

  /** Every sample of a drag: aim, then slide the ghost there. */
  const aimGhost = (ray: PointerRayLike) => {
    const point = aimPoint(ray);
    if (point) updateGhostPosition(point[0], point[1]);
  };

  /**
   * THE ACTIVE OBJECT, as the shared session knows it (lib/placementSession.ts).
   *
   * A placed object is its own instance; a copy that has not been placed yet has none, so it is
   * keyed by what it is. Either way it is one stable string for the life of the session, which is
   * what the selection lock compares against.
   */
  const activeId = !islandDraft
    ? null
    : islandDraft.kind === 'home'
      ? HOME_INSTANCE_ID
      : islandDraft.instanceId ?? `create:${islandDraft.itemId ?? 'unknown'}`;

  /**
   * Puts the ghost back at `[x, z]` and re-runs the verdict there.
   *
   * The same three writes {@link updateGhostPosition} makes, plus the write back to the editor —
   * used by the two paths that JUMP the object rather than sliding it: 取消 (back to where the
   * press found it) and a click on open ground.
   */
  const settleGhostAt = (x: number, z: number) => {
    updateGhostPosition(x, z);
    setDraftTransform(posRef.current, rotRef.current);
  };

  const drag = usePlacementDrag({
    activeId,
    getOrigin: () => posRef.current,
    onMove: aimGhost,
    // The settled spot goes back to the editor on release, so the panel's 確認 commits what is on
    // screen rather than the last position React happened to have re-rendered.
    onEnd: () => setDraftTransform(posRef.current, rotRef.current),
    // 取消移動: Esc or the right button mid-drag. `origin` is where the object stood when the
    // press landed, so this is a real undo of the drag rather than leaving it wherever the
    // player happened to let go — and the session stays open, so the piece is still held.
    onCancel: (origin) => settleGhostAt(origin[0], origin[2]),
  });

  // Seed the ghost: a new copy starts at the nearest free ground, an object being moved starts
  // exactly where it already stands (so cancelling leaves it untouched).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!islandDraft || !draftKey) return;

    const seed: [number, number] =
      islandDraft.kind === 'create' && islandDraft.itemId
        ? (([sx, , sz]) => [sx, sz] as [number, number])(findOpeningPlacement(islandDraft.itemId, profile, islandScale))
        : [islandDraft.position[0], islandDraft.position[2]];

    const verdict = evaluateHere(seed[0], seed[1]);
    const start: [number, number, number] = [verdict.x, verdict.y, verdict.z];

    posRef.current = start;
    setInitialPos(start);
    if (ghostRef.current) {
      ghostRef.current.position.set(...start);
    }
    blockReasonRef.current = verdict.reason;
    setBlockReason(verdict.reason);
    setDraftBlock(verdict.reason ? PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MESSAGE[verdict.reason] : null);
    setDraftTransform(start, islandDraft.rotation);
    playerBus.isDraggingPlacement = false;
    // Deliberately keyed on the subject only — see draftKey above.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [draftKey, islandScale]);

  // Re-run the overlap test, without moving the ghost, whenever either input the OBB test above
  // depends on changes out from under the last check: `rot` because the ghost's own R-key rotate
  // (unlike a drag) never touches x/z, and the old circle-radius test never depended on rotation
  // in the first place so nothing needed to re-check it; `footprintVersion` because the very first
  // copy of an item type placed this session has no measured footprint on the frame it seeds (see
  // the layout effect above), so that seed's overlap check under-reports and needs a second pass
  // once the measurement lands.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!islandDraft) return;
    const verdict = evaluateHere(posRef.current[0], posRef.current[2]);
    // Rotating can push a piece off the edge of the deck it is standing on, so the corrected spot
    // matters here too — the clamp is what slides it back on instead of refusing the turn.
    posRef.current = [verdict.x, verdict.y, verdict.z];
    ghostRef.current?.position.set(verdict.x, verdict.y, verdict.z);
    applyVerdict(verdict);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [rot, footprintVersion]);

  /**
   * The session lock, opened and closed with the draft.
   *
   * `selectSubject` marks the draft's subject as the Active Object; `endSession` releases it on
   * confirm, on cancel and on leaving build mode. Everything that could steal the selection —
   * every placed model's own click handler — asks the session rather than asking this component,
   * which is what lets the rule be the same one the interior uses.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeId) {
      endSession();
      return;
    }
    selectSubject(activeId);
    return () => endSession();
  }, [activeId]);

  // Keyboard shortcuts. R turns the object 45° and ESC drops the session — the same two verbs
  // the editor panel offers as buttons, so mouse and keyboard stay interchangeable.
  //
  // ESC has two meanings and they are separated by whether a drag is running, not by anything
  // here: usePlacementDrag takes the key in the CAPTURE phase while the object is being dragged
  // (取消這次搬動 — the piece goes back where the press found it) and stops it, so this bubble
  // listener only ever sees the at-rest case (放下這個東西 — the whole session ends).
  //
  // Keyed on whether a draft exists, not on the draft itself: the draft object is replaced on
  // every rotate and every drag release, and re-binding a window listener that often is pure
  // churn. The handlers it calls are stable.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasDraft) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (target && (target.isContentEditable || ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(target.tagName))) return;

      if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') {
        rotateDraft();
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        // A drag already spent this one putting the object back — see `guardCancelKey`.
        if (consumeCancelKeyGuard()) return;
        cancelDraft();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [hasDraft, rotateDraft, cancelDraft]);

  // Traverse children, enforce semi-transparency and apply deep warning red tint if overlapping
  useFrame(() => {
    if (ghostRef.current) {
      ghostRef.current.traverse((child) => {
        if (child instanceof THREE.Mesh) {
          if (child.name === 'indicator-ring') return;
          const materials = Array.isArray(child.material) ? child.material : [child.material];
          materials.forEach((mat) => {
            if (mat) {
              mat.transparent = true;
              mat.opacity = 0.55;
              if (isBlocked) {
                if (mat.color) {
                  if (!mat.userData.originalColor) {
                    mat.userData.originalColor = mat.color.clone();
                  }
                  mat.color.set('#dc2626'); // Deep warning red color
                }
              } else {
                if (mat.color && mat.userData.originalColor) {
                  mat.color.copy(mat.userData.originalColor);
                }
              }
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }
  });

  if (!islandDraft) return null;
  if (!isHouse && !item) return null;

  const handlePointerOver = (e: any) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.body.style.cursor = drag.isDraggingRef.current ? 'grabbing' : 'grab';
  };

  const handlePointerOut = (e: any) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!drag.isDraggingRef.current) {
      document.body.style.cursor = 'auto';
    }
  };

  const handleDoubleClick = async (e: any) => {
    e.stopPropagation();

    // Refuse, and say which of the rules said no rather than always blaming an overlap.
    const reason = blockReasonRef.current;
    if (reason) {
      playPlacementError();
      showIslandAlert(PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MESSAGE[reason]);
      return;
    }

    // Revert cursor to auto
    document.body.style.cursor = 'auto';
    playerBus.isDraggingPlacement = false;

    setDraftTransform(posRef.current, rot);
    const committed = await commitDraft();
    if (!committed) {
      // The draft is deliberately still armed here (see useIslandEditor's
      // commitDraft): the object is not placed, so the session it belongs to has
      // not ended, and dropping it would silently discard the spot the player
      // just chose. What must not happen is the failure passing unremarked —
      // that is what made a server-rejected save read as a dead click.
      playPlacementError();
      showIslandAlert(describeRecentFailure());
    }
  };

  const ghostStyle = islandDraft.kind === 'home' && home ? home.style : getHouseStyle('starter');
  // Re-read on every measurement so the outline appears the frame the first copy of a new item
  // type is measured, rather than one drag later. `footprintVersion` is what re-renders us.
  void footprintVersion;
  const ghostFootprint = collisionItemId ? getFootprint(collisionItemId) ?? null : null;

  return (
    <group>
      <group
        ref={ghostRef}
        position={initialPos}
        rotation={[0, rot, 0]}
        onPointerOver={handlePointerOver}
        onPointerOut={handlePointerOut}
        onPointerDown={drag.onPointerDown}
        onPointerUp={drag.onPointerUp}
        onDoubleClick={handleDoubleClick}
      >
        <group ref={modelRef}>
          {isHouse
            ? <HouseModel style={ghostStyle} />
            : <FurnitureModel name={item!.name} item={item} />}
        </group>

        {/* The object's actual placement bounds, drawn on the surface it would land on.
            A decal like any other: the shared lift keeps it out of the surface's shadow
            pass and the shared bias keeps it out of its depth range. */}
        <FootprintOutline footprint={ghostFootprint} blocked={isBlocked} />
      </group>

      {/* The ground, as a placement surface.
          It used to carry the drag as well, via an `onPointerMove` that intersected THIS mesh at
          its own fixed y = 0.34 — a second, disagreeing answer to "where is the pointer in the
          world" that the ghost's own handler switched to and from as the cursor crossed the
          model's outline, which is a visible jump every time. Aiming is the window-level pointer
          stream now (usePlacementDrag), off one plane, so this mesh no longer has an opinion about
          where the object is — only about the player having clicked the ground. */}
      <mesh
        rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}
        position={[0, 0.34, 0]}
        /*
          A click on open ground MOVES the object there. It does not commit it.

          This is the outdoor half of 「或點一下地板決定落點」 — the interior's floor, wall and
          ceiling have all worked exactly this way for as long as the mode has existed, and the two
          modes disagreeing about what a click on the ground means was the last inconsistency
          between them.

          What it replaced was a straight commit, which only ever made sense alongside the old
          follow-the-cursor aiming: the object was already under the pointer, so "click the ground"
          and "put it down here" were the same act. With the object staying put until it is
          dragged, that same click would have persisted the object at a spot the player was not
          even pointing at. 確認 on the dock is the commit now, for both modes, as it always was
          indoors.
        */
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          // Letting go of a drag is not a click. The release reaches this mesh whenever it lands
          // away from the model — which, at the end of a drag, it usually does — so without this
          // the piece would jump its own grab offset the instant the button came up. See
          // `isClickGuarded`.
          if (isClickGuarded()) return;
          const point = e.ray ? aimPoint(e.ray) : null;
          if (point) settleGhostAt(point[0], point[1]);
        }}
        onDoubleClick={handleDoubleClick}
      >
        <ringGeometry args={[0, Math.max(30, 20 * islandScale), 64]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0.0} depthWrite={false} color="#0ea5e9" />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

/**
 * One already-placed object. Its own component (rather than inline in
 * `IslandPlacements`'s `.map()`) purely so it can hold the `modelRef` +
 * `useLayoutEffect` that measures its collision footprint off the geometry
 * actually being drawn - the same reason BuildingInteriorView's furniture
 * piece is its own component. See lib/placementSurfaces.ts for why measuring
 * replaced a hand-typed radius.
 */
function IslandPlacementInstance({
  item, placement, isEditable, onSelect,
}: {
  item: ReturnType<typeof getItemById>;
  placement: PlacedItem;
  isEditable: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
}) {
  const modelRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (modelRef.current) measureFootprint(placement.itemId, modelRef.current);
  }, [placement.itemId]);

  return (
    <group
      position={placement.position}
      rotation={[0, placement.rotation, 0]}
      onClick={isEditable ? (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        // THE SELECTION RAYCAST, and the one question it now has to ask first. A click that lands
        // here while another object is being dragged is a HOVER — the pointer passed over this
        // model on its way somewhere — and the session says so. See lib/placementSession.ts.
        if (!canSelect(placement.instanceId)) return;
        onSelect();
      } : undefined}
      onPointerOver={isEditable ? (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        // Hover feedback is also refused mid-gesture: an object that cannot be selected must not
        // advertise that it can, or the player is invited to make the mistake the lock prevents.
        if (isManipulating()) return;
        document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      } : undefined}
      onPointerOut={isEditable ? () => {
        if (isManipulating()) return;
        document.body.style.cursor = 'auto';
      } : undefined}
    >
      <group ref={modelRef}>
        <FurnitureModel name={item!.name} item={item} instanceId={placement.instanceId} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
}

/**
 * Everything standing on the island.
 *
 * In build mode each object is clickable: tapping one starts a move session for it (the same
 * session a freshly bought copy uses), which is what replaced the old per-item 收回 button in
 * the build rail. The object being edited is hidden here while the ghost draws it, so the
 * player never sees the piece twice.
 */
export function IslandPlacements() {
  const { profile, currentView, islandDraft, selectIslandPlacement } = useApp();
  const placements = profile?.islandPlacements || [];
  /**
   * Which placed objects answer the pointer at all.
   *
   * This used to be `BUILD_MODE && !islandDraft` — the whole island went inert for the length of a
   * session. It kept a drag from stealing the selection, but only by making the player confirm or
   * cancel before they could touch anything else, and it was the reason picking a second object
   * meant two extra clicks.
   *
   * The lock is per-gesture now (lib/placementSession.ts), so the models can stay live. The one
   * remaining exclusion is a `create` draft: it holds a copy that has come out of the backpack and
   * has not been put down anywhere, so switching subjects would silently throw the player's armed
   * item away. Switching away from a `move` (or the Home) costs nothing and is allowed — which is
   * "明確點擊其他物品" from the brief, as an explicit action and never as an automatic one.
   */
  const isEditable = currentView === View.BUILD_MODE && islandDraft?.kind !== 'create';
  // Props, not structures (see constants/layers.ts). Everything the player places out here is
  // decoration - a fountain, a hammock, a torch, a birdhouse - so it can hide an interaction
  // prompt and joins that raycast, but the camera deliberately does NOT shorten its arm for any of
  // it. A camera that backs off for every piece of garden furniture is one that is permanently
  // pulled in on a well-decorated island.
  const occluderRef = useSightlineOccluder<THREE.Group>();

  return (
    <group ref={occluderRef}>
      {placements.map((p, index) => {
        const item = getItemById(p.itemId);
        if (!item) return null;
        if (islandDraft?.instanceId === p.instanceId) return null;

        return (
          <IslandPlacementInstance
            key={`${p.instanceId}-${index}`}
            item={item}
            placement={p}
            isEditable={isEditable}
            onSelect={() => selectIslandPlacement(p.instanceId)}
          />
        );
      })}
    </group>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { usePlayerHome } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import { HouseModel } from './HouseModel';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { useSightlineOccluder } from '../../constants/layers';

/**
 * Renders the player's single Home on the island, if it has been placed.
 *
 * Deliberately separate from IslandPlacements (which draws ordinary Buildings from
 * `islandPlacements`): the Home is not an entry in that list, so there is no code path that
 * could ever draw two of them. Swapping the style re-renders this same node in place - the
 * position and rotation come from `profile.home`, untouched by a style change.
 *
 * In build mode it is selectable by clicking, like any other object — but selecting it opens 我的家
 * (UI/HomePanel.tsx) rather than picking it up. That is the difference between this and a fountain
 * and it is deliberate: a house has three verbs (外觀 / 移動 / 轉向) where a fountain has one, so a
 * click here is a question, not a command. Clicking used to start a move outright, which meant
 * "let me look at my house" made the house vanish behind its own ghost.
 *
 * It still hides itself while actually being MOVED, because the ghost is drawing it then.
 */
export function PlayerHomeView() {
  const { profile, currentView, islandDraft, selectHome } = useApp();
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);
  // A sightline occluder only — the Home genuinely hides an interaction badge, and it is NOT a
  // raycast camera blocker.
  //
  // It was one, and that is the whole reason it is worth a paragraph here. Making it a blocker did
  // fix a real bug (the arm is much longer than the ~4-unit house, so walking up to a wall put the
  // camera inside the shell, where the exterior canvas' 0.5 near plane clips the wall away and you
  // see straight through the building) — but it fixed it with the wrong question. A raycast blocker
  // shortens the arm the moment anything crosses the SIGHTLINE, and a small building on open ground
  // crosses it constantly without ever containing the camera: rounding the corner of the house
  // swept the roof edge through the arm and dollied the camera in and out, so the character swelled
  // and shrank as you walked past, and the frame a house was first placed on did it once, hard.
  //
  // The containment condition — "the camera may not stand inside the shell" — is now stated
  // directly and analytically, against the same solid box the player is stopped by, in
  // CameraController (solveBoxContainmentLimit). It keeps the anti-x-ray guarantee this tag was
  // added for and drops the graze that came with it.
  const occluderRef = useSightlineOccluder<THREE.Group>();

  if (!home) return null;
  if (islandDraft?.kind === 'home') return null;

  const isEditable = currentView === View.BUILD_MODE && !islandDraft;

  return (
    <group
      ref={occluderRef}
      position={home.position}
      rotation={[0, home.rotation, 0]}
      onClick={isEditable ? (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        selectHome();
      } : undefined}
      onPointerOver={isEditable ? (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      } : undefined}
      onPointerOut={isEditable ? () => {
        document.body.style.cursor = 'auto';
      } : undefined}
    >
      <HouseModel style={home.style} />
    </group>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { NpcBody, NpcBrain } from './NpcWalker';
import { faceToward } from './NpcWalker';
import { NpcPose, neutralNpcPose, resetNpcPose } from '../../lib/npcPose';
import {
  ArmSpec,
  NpcRig,
  Spring,
  aimArm,
  lerp,
  neutralNpcRig,
  npcDebug,
  prefersReducedMotion,
  smooth01,
  span,
  toUpperBody,
} from '../../lib/npcRig';
import { clampFrameDelta, playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { playSoilPatter, playSpadeDig } from '../../lib/soundUtils';

/**
 * 餅乾兔園丁的作息：走 5 步、挖一次土、把地填回去、再走 5 步。
 *
 * \`\`\`
 *   WALKING ──第 5 次腳步落地──▶ STOP_AND_FACE ──站穩、轉向土地──▶ DIGGING（5 秒）
 *      ▲                                                             │
 *      └──────────── 步數歸零、重新握好鏟子 ◀── GROUND_RESTORE（0.8 秒回填）
 * \`\`\`
 *
 * 步數只在 WALKING 裡、只在 NpcWalker 舉起 `stepEvent`（一隻腳真的往前落地）的那一幀加一。
 * 第 5 次落地的那一幀就停止計步、清掉路線 —— 第 4 次落地什麼都不會發生。
 *
 * 這個檔案同時是「土坑與飛土」的那一半（{@link DigFx} / {@link RabbitDigFx}）：一個土坑、18 顆
 * 土塊、8 團灰塵、18 片落影，全部是開場就建好的 InstancedMesh，挖土只是在改矩陣，沒有任何
 * 一次挖土會 new 出 geometry 或 material。
 */

/* ================================================================== timing */

/** 每走幾步挖一次。 */
export const RABBIT_STEPS_PER_DIG = 5;
/** 挖掘本身多長，秒（含開頭的調整鏟子與結尾的擦汗）。 */
const DIG_SECONDS = 5.0;
/** 開頭停下、調整鏟子的時間。 */
const ADJUST_END = 0.5;
/** 有節奏的鏟土從哪裡到哪裡，以及鏟幾下。 */
const STROKES_START = 0.5;
const STROKES_END = 4.4;
const STROKES = 4;
const STROKE_LEN = (STROKES_END - STROKES_START) / STROKES;
/** 回填動畫多長。 */
const RESTORE_SECONDS = 0.8;
/** 回填之後站直、重新單手提好鏟子。 */
const REGRIP_SECONDS = 0.35;
/** 每一鏟之後土坑長到多大（完整土坑的比例）。 */
const HOLE_STAGES = [0.38, 0.62, 0.84, 1.0];

/* ================================================================== rig measurements */

const HIP_Y = 0.29;
/**
 * 兩隻手臂的量測。hand 是內層 group 那個 ∓0.09 的外撇轉過之後，手套球心相對於肩關節的位置：
 * 上臂 group 在肩下 0.105，手在 group 下 0.118（見 Npcs.tsx 的 CookieRabbitModel）。
 */
const ARM_RIGHT: ArmSpec = { pivot: [-0.125, 0.5, 0.005], hand: [0.0106, -0.2225, 0], baseLift: 0, side: 'right' };
const ARM_LEFT: ArmSpec = { pivot: [0.125, 0.5, 0.005], hand: [-0.0106, -0.2225, 0], baseLift: 0, side: 'left' };

/** 鏟尖在鏟子自己座標裡的位置（鏟面那顆轉 45° 方塊的下角）。 */
const TIP_LOCAL_Y = -0.308;
/**
 * 單手提著時，鏟子原點在模型座標裡的位置與朝向 —— 手臂 group (-0.125, 0.395, 0.005) 轉 +0.09，
 * 再加上 Spade 自己的 (-0.035, 0, 0.045)。兩手接過鏟子時從這裡出發，放回去時回到這裡，所以
 * 換手的那一幀鏟子一公分都不會跳。
 */
const CARRY_POS = new THREE.Vector3(-0.125 - 0.035 * Math.cos(0.09), 0.395 - 0.035 * Math.sin(0.09), 0.005 + 0.045);
const CARRY_QUAT = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0.09));

/**
 * 手握在鏟柄上的哪一段。offset 是「手心相對於柄軸」的位移（在鏟子座標裡，往身體那側一點），
 * 從單手提著的姿勢量出來；lo/hi 是手可以滑動的柄段，prefer 是這隻手喜歡的位置。
 */
const GRIP_RIGHT = { ox: 0.035, oz: -0.045, lo: -0.13, hi: 0.13, prefer: 0.1, carryPrefer: -0.118 };
const GRIP_LEFT = { ox: 0.03, oz: -0.04, lo: -0.12, hi: 0.06, prefer: -0.02, carryPrefer: -0.02 };

/**
 * 動作是用「右手握的那一點」擺的，不是用鏟尖擺的。
 *
 * 第一版用鏟尖當關鍵點，結果手搆不到柄：她的手臂只有 0.22 長、鏟子有 0.44 長，鏟尖釘在地上
 * 時柄的中段常常落在膝蓋的高度，左手只能垂在身邊。改成先決定「手在身前哪裡」（每個關鍵姿勢
 * 都放在離肩膀約一個手臂長的地方），鏟尖從柄的角度推出來 —— 手永遠握得到。
 */
const GRIP_Y = 0.06;

/** 擦汗時左手要去的額頭側邊（上半身座標，頭球之外）。 */
const BROW = new THREE.Vector3(0.13, 0.66, 0.17);

/** 挖土點（鏟尖落地的位置）在模型座標裡，相對於腳底。 */
const DIG_TIP = { x: -0.02, z: 0.32 };

/* ================================================================== the dig keys */

interface DigKey {
  /** 柄上 GRIP_Y 那一點（右手握的地方）在模型座標裡的位置。 */
  gx: number; gy: number; gz: number;
  /** 鏟柄往身體那側倒多少。 */
  tilt: number;
  /** 鏟子繞自己的柄轉多少（拋土時鏟面翻向側面）。 */
  spin: number;
  lean: number; rise: number; twist: number; squash: number;
}

const k = (gx: number, gy: number, gz: number, tilt: number, spin: number,
  lean: number, rise: number, twist: number, squash: number): DigKey =>
  ({ gx, gy, gz, tilt, spin, lean, rise, twist, squash });

// 每一個手的位置都放在「那個姿勢的肩膀往前下方約一個手臂長」；註解裡是推出來的鏟尖。

/** 準備姿勢：身體微蹲，鏟尖貼著地面（尖 y≈0.01, z≈0.29）。 */
const READY = k(-0.02, 0.34, 0.13, 0.45, 0, 0.12, -0.006, 0, 0);
/** 抬起：雙手舉到胸前、身體往後蓄力、拉長（尖離地 0.1）。 */
const LIFT = k(-0.03, 0.47, 0.17, 0.05, 0.1, -0.08, 0.01, 0.06, 0.035);
/** 鏟尖碰到地面的那一瞬間：往前壓、壓扁（尖 y≈-0.02, z≈0.32）。 */
const CONTACT = k(-0.02, 0.31, 0.16, 0.46, 0, 0.27, -0.022, 0, -0.055);
/** 撞擊停頓：插進去一點點。 */
const IMPACT = k(-0.02, 0.295, 0.165, 0.47, 0, 0.29, -0.028, 0, -0.065);
/** 撬：鏟尖不動，壓低身體、把柄往身體這邊扳。 */
const PRY = k(-0.02, 0.27, 0.106, 0.62, 0, 0.36, -0.04, 0, -0.04);
/** 鏟起：土在鏟面上。 */
const SCOOP = k(-0.04, 0.34, 0.15, 0.5, 0.3, 0.22, -0.02, -0.15, -0.01);
/** 往身體右後方拋：上半身右轉、鏟面翻向側面。 */
// 手的 z 不能小於 0.16：上半身右轉之後，左手要橫過胸前去握柄，再貼近就穿進衣服裡了。
const FLING = k(-0.08, 0.41, 0.17, 0.1, 0.9, 0.02, 0.012, -0.42, 0.03);
/** 最後：鏟子拄在坑邊、身體站直一點。 */
const PLANT = k(-0.03, 0.33, 0.12, 0.3, 0, 0.04, 0, 0.1, 0);

type Ease = (t: number) => number;
const easeInCubic: Ease = (t) => t * t * t;
const easeOutCubic: Ease = (t) => 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t) * (1 - t);

/** 一鏟的時間軸：[開始比例, 從哪個 key, 到哪個 key, 緩動]。 */
const STROKE: readonly (readonly [number, number, DigKey, DigKey, Ease])[] = [
  [0.0, 0.28, READY, LIFT, smooth01],
  // 落下是加速的 —— 鏟子的重量在這一段。
  [0.28, 0.42, LIFT, CONTACT, easeInCubic],
  [0.42, 0.5, CONTACT, IMPACT, easeOutCubic],
  [0.5, 0.7, IMPACT, PRY, smooth01],
  [0.7, 0.76, PRY, SCOOP, smooth01],
  [0.76, 0.84, SCOOP, FLING, easeOutCubic],
  [0.84, 1.0, FLING, READY, smooth01],
];
/** 撞擊與拋土在一鏟裡的哪一刻。 */
const IMPACT_AT = 0.42;
const FLING_AT = 0.78;

function mixKey(a: DigKey, b: DigKey, t: number, out: DigKey): DigKey {
  out.gx = lerp(a.gx, b.gx, t); out.gy = lerp(a.gy, b.gy, t); out.gz = lerp(a.gz, b.gz, t);
  out.tilt = lerp(a.tilt, b.tilt, t); out.spin = lerp(a.spin, b.spin, t);
  out.lean = lerp(a.lean, b.lean, t); out.rise = lerp(a.rise, b.rise, t);
  out.twist = lerp(a.twist, b.twist, t); out.squash = lerp(a.squash, b.squash, t);
  return out;
}

/** 挖掘時間 `t`（0..DIG_SECONDS+RESTORE）時的姿勢。 */
function evalDig(t: number, out: DigKey): DigKey {
  if (t < STROKES_START) return mixKey(READY, READY, 0, out);
  if (t < STROKES_END) {
    const u = ((t - STROKES_START) % STROKE_LEN) / STROKE_LEN;
    for (const [u0, u1, a, b, ease] of STROKE) {
      if (u <= u1) return mixKey(a, b, ease(span(u, u0, u1)), out);
    }
    return mixKey(READY, READY, 0, out);
  }
  if (t < DIG_SECONDS) return mixKey(READY, PLANT, smooth01(span(t, STROKES_END, STROKES_END + 0.18)), out);
  // 回填：拿鏟背輕拍兩下土。
  const r = span(t, DIG_SECONDS, DIG_SECONDS + RESTORE_SECONDS);
  mixKey(PLANT, READY, smooth01(span(t, DIG_SECONDS, DIG_SECONDS + 0.15)), out);
  const tap = Math.abs(Math.sin(r * Math.PI * 2));
  out.gy = 0.32 + tap * 0.06;
  out.tilt = 0.36;
  out.lean = 0.12 + (1 - tap) * 0.06;
  out.squash = -(1 - tap) * 0.02;
  return out;
}

/* ================================================================== the effects */

const HOLE_RADIUS = 0.21;
const CLOD_COUNT = 18;
const DUST_COUNT = 8;
const MOUND_COUNT = 9;
const GRAVITY = 7.2;

interface Clod {
  alive: boolean;
  p: THREE.Vector3;
  v: THREE.Vector3;
  size: number;
  /** 落地後經過的秒數，-1 = 還在空中。 */
  landed: number;
  bounced: boolean;
  rot: THREE.Euler;
  spin: THREE.Vector3;
}

interface Dust {
  alive: boolean;
  p: THREE.Vector3;
  age: number;
  life: number;
  size: number;
}

/**
 * 土坑與飛土的狀態 —— 純資料，沒有 React。
 *
 * 腦子呼叫 begin / setStage / setFill / throwClods / puff / end，{@link RabbitDigFx} 每幀呼叫
 * step 並把結果寫進矩陣。分成兩半，是因為「什麼時候噴土」是動作的事，「土怎麼落」是物理的
 * 事，而後者要在腦子沒在挖的時候也繼續跑完（最後一鏟的土還在空中時就開始回填）。
 */
export class DigFx {
  groundY: (x: number, z: number) => number = () => 0;
  readonly hole = {
    visible: false,
    center: new THREE.Vector3(),
    quat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    grow: 0,
    growTarget: 0,
    fill: 0,
    /** 每一次挖都重擲的土堆角度與大小，免得每個土坑長得一模一樣。 */
    mounds: Array.from({ length: MOUND_COUNT }, () => ({ angle: 0, size: 1, lift: 0 })),
  };
  readonly clods: Clod[] = Array.from({ length: CLOD_COUNT }, () => ({
    alive: false, p: new THREE.Vector3(), v: new THREE.Vector3(), size: 0, landed: -1, bounced: false,
    rot: new THREE.Euler(), spin: new THREE.Vector3(),
  }));
  readonly dust: Dust[] = Array.from({ length: DUST_COUNT }, () => ({
    alive: false, p: new THREE.Vector3(), age: 0, life: 1, size: 0,
  }));
  /** 土塊落地時要不要出一次聲（每一拋只出一次）。 */
  private patterArmed = false;
  onPatter: ((x: number, z: number) => void) | null = null;
  /** 有沒有任何東西需要畫。沒有的話 RabbitDigFx 連矩陣都不寫。 */
  dirty = true;

  begin(center: THREE.Vector3): void {
    const h = this.hole;
    const e = 0.22;
    const gx0 = this.groundY(center.x - e, center.z);
    const gx1 = this.groundY(center.x + e, center.z);
    const gz0 = this.groundY(center.x, center.z - e);
    const gz1 = this.groundY(center.x, center.z + e);
    const normal = new THREE.Vector3((gx0 - gx1) / (2 * e), 1, (gz0 - gz1) / (2 * e)).normalize();
    h.quat.setFromUnitVectors(UP, normal);
    h.center.set(center.x, this.groundY(center.x, center.z), center.z);
    h.visible = true;
    h.grow = 0;
    h.growTarget = 0;
    h.fill = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < MOUND_COUNT; i++) {
      const m = h.mounds[i];
      m.angle = (i / MOUND_COUNT) * Math.PI * 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
      m.size = 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.5;
      m.lift = Math.random();
    }
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  setStage(target: number): void {
    this.hole.growTarget = target;
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  setFill(f: number): void {
    this.hole.fill = f;
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  /** 挖完了：土坑、土堆、土塊、灰塵全部歸零。回到「從來沒挖過」的狀態。 */
  end(): void {
    this.hole.visible = false;
    this.hole.grow = 0;
    this.hole.growTarget = 0;
    this.hole.fill = 0;
    for (const c of this.clods) c.alive = false;
    for (const d of this.dust) d.alive = false;
    this.patterArmed = false;
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  throwClods(from: THREE.Vector3, dirX: number, dirZ: number, count: number, strength: number): void {
    let spawned = 0;
    for (const c of this.clods) {
      if (spawned >= count) break;
      if (c.alive) continue;
      spawned++;
      c.alive = true;
      c.landed = -1;
      c.bounced = false;
      // 大小不同：兩三顆大塊、其餘細碎。
      c.size = spawned <= 2 ? 0.045 + Math.random() * 0.02 : 0.018 + Math.random() * 0.02;
      c.p.set(
        from.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
        from.y + Math.random() * 0.04,
        from.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
      );
      const spread = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9;
      const cos = Math.cos(spread);
      const sin = Math.sin(spread);
      const dx = dirX * cos - dirZ * sin;
      const dz = dirX * sin + dirZ * cos;
      const speed = (1.0 + Math.random() * 0.9) * strength;
      c.v.set(dx * speed, (2.0 + Math.random() * 1.1) * strength, dz * speed);
      c.rot.set(Math.random() * 6, Math.random() * 6, Math.random() * 6);
      c.spin.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 12, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12);
    }
    this.patterArmed = spawned > 0;
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  puff(at: THREE.Vector3, count: number): void {
    let spawned = 0;
    for (const d of this.dust) {
      if (spawned >= count) break;
      if (d.alive) continue;
      spawned++;
      d.alive = true;
      d.age = 0;
      d.life = 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.35;
      d.size = 0.06 + Math.random() * 0.05;
      d.p.set(at.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25, at.y + 0.03, at.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25);
    }
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  step(dt: number): void {
    const h = this.hole;
    if (h.visible) h.grow += (h.growTarget - h.grow) * (1 - Math.exp(-10 * dt));
    let any = h.visible;
    for (const c of this.clods) {
      if (!c.alive) continue;
      any = true;
      if (c.landed < 0) {
        c.v.y -= GRAVITY * dt;
        c.p.addScaledVector(c.v, dt);
        c.rot.x += c.spin.x * dt;
        c.rot.y += c.spin.y * dt;
        c.rot.z += c.spin.z * dt;
        const ground = this.groundY(c.p.x, c.p.z) + c.size * 0.5;
        if (c.p.y <= ground && c.v.y < 0) {
          c.p.y = ground;
          if (!c.bounced && c.v.y < -1.3) {
            // 一次很小的彈跳，然後就停住 —— 土塊不是橡皮球。
            c.bounced = true;
            c.v.set(c.v.x * 0.35, -c.v.y * 0.22, c.v.z * 0.35);
            c.spin.multiplyScalar(0.3);
          } else {
            c.landed = 0;
          }
          if (this.patterArmed) {
            this.patterArmed = false;
            this.onPatter?.(c.p.x, c.p.z);
          }
        }
      } else {
        c.landed += dt;
        // 落地後很快散掉：0.35 秒縮到沒有。
        if (c.landed > 0.35) c.alive = false;
      }
    }
    for (const d of this.dust) {
      if (!d.alive) continue;
      any = true;
      d.age += dt;
      d.p.y += dt * 0.18;
      if (d.age >= d.life) d.alive = false;
    }
    if (any) this.dirty = true;
  }
}

const UP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ textures (module cache) */

let soilTexture: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
let blobTexture: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;

/**
 * 土坑的面：中心深、往外漸亮、邊緣淡出成透明。不是一個黑色圓形 —— 顏色是濕土的暖棕，而且
 * 往上偏一點的暗環讓它讀起來有深度（光從上方來，坑的上緣內壁在陰影裡）。
 */
function getSoilTexture(): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  if (soilTexture) return soilTexture;
  const S = 128;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = S;
  c.height = S;
  const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
  const grad = g.createRadialGradient(S / 2, S * 0.46, 2, S / 2, S / 2, S / 2);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(58,38,24,1)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(84,58,36,1)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(118,86,56,0.95)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.9, 'rgba(140,106,72,0.5)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(140,106,72,0)');
  g.fillStyle = grad;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
  // 幾顆碎土點，讓它是土不是一塊漸層。
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * S * 0.36;
    g.fillStyle = `rgba(${40 + Math.random() * 50},${28 + Math.random() * 30},${18 + Math.random() * 20},0.55)`;
    g.beginPath();
    g.arc(S / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, S / 2 + Math.sin(a) * r, 1 + Math.random() * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
  }
  soilTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  soilTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return soilTexture;
}

/** 土塊落在地上的柔和圓影。 */
function getBlobTexture(): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  if (blobTexture) return blobTexture;
  const S = 64;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = S;
  c.height = S;
  const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
  const grad = g.createRadialGradient(S / 2, S / 2, 0, S / 2, S / 2, S / 2);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.fillStyle = grad;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
  blobTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  return blobTexture;
}

const ZERO = new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0, 0, 0);
const M = new THREE.Matrix4();
const MQ = new THREE.Quaternion();
const MP = new THREE.Vector3();
const MS = new THREE.Vector3();
const FLAT = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0));

/**
 * 把 {@link DigFx} 畫出來。一個土坑 group（兩片土面 + 9 顆土堆）、土塊、灰塵、落影，全部開場就
 * 掛著：InstancedMesh 在沒東西時所有 instance 是零縮放，所以 shader 在第一幀就編譯好了，第一次
 * 挖土不會卡一下（見 memory：隱藏物件池第一次顯示才編譯）。
 */
export function RabbitDigFx({ fx, manual = false }: {
  fx: DigFx;
  /** 預覽頁用：由外面自己呼叫 fx.step，這裡只負責畫。 */
  manual?: boolean;
}) {
  const holeGroup = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const soilMat = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
  const depthMat = useRef<THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
  const soilMesh = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const depthMesh = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null);
  const mounds = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const clods = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const dust = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const shadows = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);

  const geometries = useMemo(() => ({
    disc: new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 28).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2),
    mound: new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1),
    clod: new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0),
    dust: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 8, 6),
    blob: new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 14),
  }), []);

  useFrame((_, raw) => {
    if (!manual) fx.step(clampFrameDelta(raw));
    if (!fx.dirty) return;
    fx.dirty = false;

    const h = fx.hole;
    const hg = holeGroup.current;
    if (hg) {
      hg.visible = h.visible;
      hg.position.copy(h.center);
      hg.quaternion.copy(h.quat);
      const open = h.grow * (1 - h.fill);
      const r = HOLE_RADIUS * Math.max(0.001, open);
      soilMesh.current?.scale.set(r * 1.25, 1, r * 1.25);
      depthMesh.current?.scale.set(r * 0.62, 1, r * 0.62);
      if (soilMat.current) soilMat.current.opacity = 1 - h.fill * h.fill;
      if (depthMat.current) depthMat.current.opacity = (1 - h.fill) * 0.85;
      const mm = mounds.current;
      if (mm) {
        for (let i = 0; i < MOUND_COUNT; i++) {
          const m = h.mounds[i];
          // 土堆跟著土坑長；回填時被推回坑裡 —— 往中心滑、一起縮小、沉進地面，不會攤成一圈碎片。
          const sink = smooth01(h.fill);
          const s = 0.075 * m.size * h.grow * (1 - sink);
          const ringR = HOLE_RADIUS * Math.max(0.3, h.grow) * (1.05 + m.lift * 0.12) * (1 - sink * 0.75);
          MP.set(Math.cos(m.angle) * ringR, s * 0.15 - sink * 0.02, Math.sin(m.angle) * ringR);
          MQ.setFromAxisAngle(UP, m.angle);
          MS.set(s * 1.3, s * 0.55, s);
          M.compose(MP, MQ, MS);
          mm.setMatrixAt(i, s < 1e-4 ? ZERO : M);
        }
        mm.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    }

    const cm = clods.current;
    const sm = shadows.current;
    if (cm && sm) {
      for (let i = 0; i < CLOD_COUNT; i++) {
        const c = fx.clods[i];
        if (!c.alive) {
          cm.setMatrixAt(i, ZERO);
          sm.setMatrixAt(i, ZERO);
          continue;
        }
        const fade = c.landed < 0 ? 1 : 1 - c.landed / 0.35;
        const s = c.size * Math.max(0, fade);
        MQ.setFromEuler(c.rot);
        MS.set(s, s * 0.8, s);
        M.compose(c.p, MQ, MS);
        cm.setMatrixAt(i, M);
        const gy = fx.groundY(c.p.x, c.p.z);
        const height = Math.max(0, c.p.y - gy);
        const ss = c.size * 1.5 * Math.max(0, fade) / (1 + height * 2.5);
        MP.set(c.p.x, gy + 0.012, c.p.z);
        MS.set(ss, ss, ss);
        M.compose(MP, FLAT, MS);
        sm.setMatrixAt(i, M);
      }
      cm.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      sm.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    const dm = dust.current;
    if (dm) {
      for (let i = 0; i < DUST_COUNT; i++) {
        const d = fx.dust[i];
        if (!d.alive) {
          dm.setMatrixAt(i, ZERO);
          continue;
        }
        const u = d.age / d.life;
        // 灰塵先鼓起來、再縮掉：沒有逐顆透明度，所以淡出是用大小做的。
        const s = d.size * Math.sin(Math.min(1, u) * Math.PI) * (0.6 + u * 0.8);
        MS.set(s, s * 0.7, s);
        M.compose(d.p, MQ.identity(), MS);
        dm.setMatrixAt(i, M);
      }
      dm.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  });

  return (
    <>
      <group ref={holeGroup} visible={false}>
        {/* 土坑的面。polygonOffset 讓它貼著地面而不跟地面搶深度，也就不必抬高到浮起來。 */}
        <mesh ref={soilMesh} geometry={geometries.disc} position={[0, 0.012, 0]} receiveShadow renderOrder={1}>
          <meshStandardMaterial
            ref={soilMat}
            map={getSoilTexture()}
            transparent
            depthWrite={false}
            polygonOffset
            polygonOffsetFactor={-4}
            polygonOffsetUnits={-4}
            roughness={1}
            metalness={0}
          />
        </mesh>
        {/* 坑底較深的那一圈。 */}
        <mesh ref={depthMesh} geometry={geometries.disc} position={[0, 0.014, 0]} renderOrder={2}>
          <meshStandardMaterial
            ref={depthMat}
            map={getSoilTexture()}
            color="#6d5a4a"
            transparent
            depthWrite={false}
            polygonOffset
            polygonOffsetFactor={-5}
            polygonOffsetUnits={-5}
            roughness={1}
            metalness={0}
          />
        </mesh>
        {/* 坑邊圓潤的土堆。 */}
        <instancedMesh ref={mounds} args={[geometries.mound, undefined, MOUND_COUNT]} castShadow receiveShadow frustumCulled={false}>
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7a5638" roughness={1} metalness={0} flatShading />
        </instancedMesh>
      </group>
      <instancedMesh ref={clods} args={[geometries.clod, undefined, CLOD_COUNT]} castShadow frustumCulled={false}>
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#6b4a2e" roughness={1} metalness={0} flatShading />
      </instancedMesh>
      <instancedMesh ref={shadows} args={[geometries.blob, undefined, CLOD_COUNT]} frustumCulled={false} renderOrder={1}>
        <meshBasicMaterial map={getBlobTexture()} transparent depthWrite={false} color="#000000" />
      </instancedMesh>
      <instancedMesh ref={dust} args={[geometries.dust, undefined, DUST_COUNT]} frustumCulled={false}>
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#cdb08a" transparent opacity={0.38} depthWrite={false} />
      </instancedMesh>
    </>
  );
}

/* ================================================================== the brain */

export type RabbitState = 'WALKING' | 'STOP_AND_FACE' | 'DIGGING' | 'GROUND_RESTORE';

export interface RabbitDebug {
  state: RabbitState;
  steps: number;
  digs: number;
  /** 最近的腳步事件：第幾步、當時的狀態。 */
  stepLog: { n: number; state: RabbitState; at: number }[];
  /** 每次挖掘開始時，當輪累積的步數。 */
  digStartSteps: number[];
  digStartedAt: number;
  restoreEndedAt: number;
  holeVisible: boolean;
  /** 她現在站在哪（同一個物件，唯讀）。 */
  pos?: THREE.Vector3;
}

export interface RabbitBrainOptions {
  fx: DigFx;
  /** 這一點能不能挖：乾燥的島嶼地面、不在家具/房子/平台/水上。 */
  canDig: (x: number, z: number) => boolean;
  /** 這一點站不站得住。 */
  canStand: (x: number, z: number) => boolean;
}

const V1 = new THREE.Vector3();
const V2 = new THREE.Vector3();
const Q1 = new THREE.Quaternion();
const Q2 = new THREE.Quaternion();
const E1 = new THREE.Euler();
const Y_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

/** 模型座標的一點 → 世界座標（腳底在 body.pos、朝 body.yaw、乘上身高）。 */
function modelToWorld(body: NpcBody, x: number, y: number, z: number, out: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {
  const h = body.height;
  const c = Math.cos(body.yaw);
  const s = Math.sin(body.yaw);
  return out.set(body.pos.x + (x * c + z * s) * h, body.pos.y + y * h, body.pos.z + (-x * s + z * c) * h);
}

/** 站在 (x, z)、朝 yaw 時，鏟尖會落在哪。 */
function tipAt(x: number, z: number, yaw: number, height: number): { x: number; z: number } {
  const c = Math.cos(yaw);
  const s = Math.sin(yaw);
  return {
    x: x + (DIG_TIP.x * c + DIG_TIP.z * s) * height,
    z: z + (-DIG_TIP.x * s + DIG_TIP.z * c) * height,
  };
}

function attenuation(x: number, z: number): number {
  if (playerBus.isInsideHouse) return 0;
  const p = playerBus.playerPos;
  if (!p) return 0;
  const d = Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.z - z);
  return 1 / (1 + (d / 4) * (d / 4));
}

export function createRabbitBrain(opts: RabbitBrainOptions): NpcBrain & { debug: RabbitDebug } {
  const { fx } = opts;
  const pose: NpcPose = neutralNpcPose();
  const rig: NpcRig = neutralNpcRig();
  const key: DigKey = { ...READY };
  const earSpring = new Spring();
  const spreadSpring = new Spring();

  let state: RabbitState = 'WALKING';
  let steps = 0;
  let clock = 0;
  let seekTimer = 0;
  /** 挖掘時間軸（DIGGING 與 GROUND_RESTORE 共用一條）。 */
  let digT = 0;
  let impacts = 0;
  let flings = 0;
  let site = { x: 0, z: 0, yaw: 0 };
  let seeking = false;
  let lastLean = 0;
  let lastRise = 0;
  let weight = 0;

  const debug: RabbitDebug = {
    state, steps, digs: 0, stepLog: [], digStartSteps: [], digStartedAt: 0, restoreEndedAt: 0, holeVisible: false,
  };
  npcDebug.rabbit = debug;

  const setState = (next: RabbitState) => {
    state = next;
    debug.state = next;
  };

  const patter = (x: number, z: number) => {
    const a = attenuation(x, z);
    if (a > 0.02) playSoilPatter(0.07 * a);
  };

  /** 這個站位 + 朝向挖不挖得下去。 */
  const siteOk = (x: number, z: number, yaw: number, height: number): boolean => {
    if (!opts.canStand(x, z)) return false;
    const tip = tipAt(x, z, yaw, height);
    if (!opts.canDig(tip.x, tip.z)) return false;
    // 不在玩家腳下、也不在寵物身上。
    const p = playerBus.playerPos;
    if (p && Math.hypot(p.x - tip.x, p.z - tip.z) < 1.0) return false;
    if (p && Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.z - z) < 0.8) return false;
    const pet = playerBus.dogPos;
    if (pet && Math.hypot(pet.x - tip.x, pet.z - tip.z) < 0.7) return false;
    return true;
  };

  /** 從近到遠找一塊可以挖的地。先試原地換個方向，再往外一圈一圈找。 */
  const findSite = (body: NpcBody): { x: number; z: number; yaw: number } | null => {
    const { pos, yaw, height } = body;
    for (const turn of [0, 0.6, -0.6, 1.2, -1.2, Math.PI]) {
      if (siteOk(pos.x, pos.z, yaw + turn, height)) return { x: pos.x, z: pos.z, yaw: yaw + turn };
    }
    for (const r of [0.7, 1.3, 2.0, 2.8]) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const a = yaw + (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;
        const x = pos.x + Math.sin(a) * r;
        const z = pos.z + Math.cos(a) * r;
        if (siteOk(x, z, a, height)) return { x, z, yaw: a };
      }
    }
    return null;
  };

  const beginStop = (body: NpcBody) => {
    body.route = [];
    body.wander = false;
    const found = findSite(body);
    setState('STOP_AND_FACE');
    seekTimer = 0;
    if (!found) {
      // 附近真的沒有地可以挖（例如整片都是平台）：回去走路，下一次腳步落地再找一次。步數
      // 維持在 5，不會多算。
      seeking = false;
      setState('WALKING');
      body.wander = true;
      return;
    }
    site = found;
    const here = Math.hypot(found.x - body.pos.x, found.z - body.pos.z) < 0.05;
    seeking = !here;
    if (seeking) {
      const route = body.territory.routeTo(body.pos, found);
      if (!route) {
        seeking = false;
        setState('WALKING');
        body.wander = true;
        return;
      }
      body.route = route;
      body.speedScale = 0.8;
    }
  };

  const startDigging = (body: NpcBody) => {
    setState('DIGGING');
    digT = 0;
    impacts = 0;
    flings = 0;
    debug.digs++;
    debug.digStartSteps.push(steps);
    if (debug.digStartSteps.length > 12) debug.digStartSteps.shift();
    debug.digStartedAt = performance.now();
    // 釘在原地：挖土時腳不能滑，被玩家擠也不動。
    body.override = { x: body.pos.x, y: body.pos.y, z: body.pos.z, yaw: body.yaw };
    const tip = tipAt(body.pos.x, body.pos.z, body.yaw, body.height);
    V1.set(tip.x, 0, tip.z);
    fx.begin(V1);
    earSpring.reset();
    spreadSpring.reset();
  };

  const finish = (body: NpcBody) => {
    fx.end();
    body.override = null;
    body.gait.pose = null;
    body.gait.rig = null;
    body.look.weight = 0;
    body.wander = true;
    body.speedScale = 1;
    // 步數歸零，相位也歸零：下一步從一個完整的步子開始數，不會把挖土前停在半空的那半步算進去。
    steps = 0;
    debug.steps = 0;
    body.gait.phase = 0;
    weight = 0;
    debug.restoreEndedAt = performance.now();
    setState('WALKING');
  };

  /** 把挖掘姿勢寫進 pose / rig。w 是挖掘姿勢的權重（0 = 單手提著鏟子走路）。 */
  const writePose = (body: NpcBody, dt: number, w: number) => {
    const reduced = prefersReducedMotion();
    evalDig(digT, key);

    const lean = key.lean * w;
    const rise = key.rise * w;
    const twist = key.twist * w * (reduced ? 0.6 : 1);

    // 鏟子：從單手提著的位置，混到動作要它在的位置。
    E1.set(-key.tilt, key.twist * 0.8, 0, 'YXZ');
    Q1.setFromEuler(E1);
    Q2.setFromAxisAngle(Y_AXIS, key.spin);
    Q1.multiply(Q2);
    V1.set(0, GRIP_Y, 0).applyQuaternion(Q1);
    V2.set(key.gx - V1.x, key.gy - V1.y, key.gz - V1.z);
    rig.propPos.copy(CARRY_POS).lerp(V2, w);
    rig.propQuat.copy(CARRY_QUAT).slerp(Q1, w);
    rig.propFree = w > 0.001;

    resetNpcPose(pose);
    pose.lean = lean;
    pose.rise = rise;
    pose.twist = twist;

    // 兩隻手追著鏟柄：在柄上找一點，離肩膀剛好一個手臂長。
    const grip = (spec: ArmSpec, g: typeof GRIP_RIGHT, into: { lift: number; out: number }) => {
      let best = Infinity;
      // 單手提著時手在柄的中段，兩手握著挖土時右手滑到柄頂附近。
      const prefer = lerp(g.carryPrefer, g.prefer, w);
      let bestY = prefer;
      const len = Math.hypot(spec.hand[0], spec.hand[1], spec.hand[2]);
      for (let i = 0; i <= 14; i++) {
        const y = g.lo + ((g.hi - g.lo) * i) / 14;
        V1.set(g.ox, y, g.oz).applyQuaternion(rig.propQuat).add(rig.propPos);
        toUpperBody(V1, HIP_Y, lean, twist, rise, V2);
        const d = Math.hypot(V2.x - spec.pivot[0], V2.y - spec.pivot[1], V2.z - spec.pivot[2]);
        const cost = Math.abs(d - len) * 10 + Math.abs(y - prefer) * 0.3;
        if (cost < best) {
          best = cost;
          bestY = y;
        }
      }
      V1.set(g.ox, bestY, g.oz).applyQuaternion(rig.propQuat).add(rig.propPos);
      toUpperBody(V1, HIP_Y, lean, twist, rise, V2);
      aimArm(spec, V2, into);
    };
    grip(ARM_RIGHT, GRIP_RIGHT, pose.right);
    grip(ARM_LEFT, GRIP_LEFT, pose.left);
    // 左手在單手提著時是空著的，所以它握上去的比例跟著權重走。
    const leftOn = smooth01(w * 1.4);
    pose.left.lift *= leftOn;
    pose.left.out *= leftOn;

    // 擦汗：最後那半秒，左手離開鏟柄去抹一下額頭。
    const wipe = span(digT, 4.45, 4.6) * (1 - span(digT, 4.82, 4.97));
    if (wipe > 0) {
      const brow = { lift: 0, out: 0 };
      V1.copy(BROW);
      V1.x += Math.sin((digT - 4.45) * 18) * 0.02;
      aimArm(ARM_LEFT, V1, brow);
      const ws = smooth01(wipe);
      pose.left.lift = lerp(pose.left.lift, brow.lift, ws);
      pose.left.out = lerp(pose.left.out, brow.out, ws);
    }

    // 弓步：左腳在前、右腳在後。調整鏟子的那半秒裡站開，挖的時候不再動。
    rig.legLeft = -0.16 * w;
    rig.legRight = 0.1 * w;
    rig.squash = key.squash * w * (reduced ? 0.4 : 1);

    // 耳朵：上半身前後甩、上下沉的速度，晚半拍傳到耳朵上。
    if (dt > 0) {
      const leanVel = (lean - lastLean) / dt;
      const riseVel = (rise - lastRise) / dt;
      const drive = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(leanVel * 0.22 - riseVel * 3.0, -0.7, 0.7);
      const amp = reduced ? 0.35 : 1;
      rig.earPitch = earSpring.step(drive + lean * 0.35, dt, 2.1, 0.32) * amp;
      rig.earSpread = (0.04 * w + Math.abs(spreadSpring.step(drive * 0.5, dt, 1.6, 0.4)) * 0.4) * amp;
    }
    lastLean = lean;
    lastRise = rise;

    // 最後看一眼土坑。
    const peek = span(digT, 4.65, 4.85) * (1 - span(digT, 5.0, 5.3));
    body.look.yaw = 0.1;
    body.look.pitch = 0.34;
    body.look.weight = smooth01(Math.max(peek, 0.55 * w * span(digT, 0.1, 0.5)));

    body.gait.pose = pose;
    body.gait.rig = rig;
  };

  return {
    debug,
    update(body, dt) {
      clock += dt;
      fx.groundY = body.territory.groundY;
      // 在 update 裡掛而不是在建立時：StrictMode 會先 dispose 再重新掛載同一顆腦子。
      if (!fx.onPatter) fx.onPatter = patter;
      debug.pos = body.pos;
      npcDebug.rabbit = debug;
      const reduced = prefersReducedMotion();

      switch (state) {
        case 'WALKING': {
          if (body.stepEvent) {
            if (steps < RABBIT_STEPS_PER_DIG) {
              steps++;
              debug.steps = steps;
              debug.stepLog.push({ n: steps, state, at: clock });
              if (debug.stepLog.length > 20) debug.stepLog.shift();
            }
            // 第 5 次落地：立刻停止計步、進入挖掘流程。（找不到地的時候，之後每一次落地重找。）
            if (steps >= RABBIT_STEPS_PER_DIG) beginStop(body);
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'STOP_AND_FACE': {
          if (seeking) {
            seekTimer += dt;
            if (body.arrived) {
              seeking = false;
              body.speedScale = 1;
            } else if (body.abandoned || seekTimer > 8 || body.route.length === 0) {
              // 被擋住了：原地重找一次。
              seeking = false;
              body.speedScale = 1;
              beginStop(body);
            }
            break;
          }
          const left = faceToward(body, site.yaw, dt);
          if (left < 0.04 && body.gait.intensity < 0.15) {
            if (siteOk(body.pos.x, body.pos.z, body.yaw, body.height)) startDigging(body);
            else beginStop(body);
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'DIGGING': {
          digT += dt;
          // 事件：撞擊與拋土，每一鏟各一次。
          if (digT >= STROKES_START && digT < STROKES_END) {
            const u = digT - STROKES_START;
            const stroke = Math.floor(u / STROKE_LEN);
            const local = (u % STROKE_LEN) / STROKE_LEN;
            if (stroke >= impacts && local >= IMPACT_AT) {
              impacts = stroke + 1;
              fx.setStage(HOLE_STAGES[Math.min(stroke, HOLE_STAGES.length - 1)]);
              fx.puff(fx.hole.center, reduced ? 1 : 2);
              const a = attenuation(fx.hole.center.x, fx.hole.center.z);
              if (a > 0.02) playSpadeDig(0.11 * a);
            }
            if (stroke >= flings && local >= FLING_AT) {
              flings = stroke + 1;
              // 鏟面的世界座標，往她自己的右後方拋。
              V1.set(0, -0.25, 0).applyQuaternion(rig.propQuat).add(rig.propPos);
              modelToWorld(body, V1.x, V1.y, V1.z, V2);
              const c = Math.cos(body.yaw);
              const s = Math.sin(body.yaw);
              const mx = -0.55;
              const mz = -0.83;
              fx.throwClods(V2, mx * c + mz * s, -mx * s + mz * c, reduced ? 3 : 6, reduced ? 0.6 : 1);
              fx.puff(V2, 1);
            }
          }
          writePose(body, dt, smooth01(digT / ADJUST_END));
          debug.holeVisible = fx.hole.visible;
          if (digT >= DIG_SECONDS) setState('GROUND_RESTORE');
          break;
        }
        case 'GROUND_RESTORE': {
          digT += dt;
          const fill = smooth01(span(digT, DIG_SECONDS, DIG_SECONDS + RESTORE_SECONDS));
          fx.setFill(fill);
          const regrip = span(digT, DIG_SECONDS + RESTORE_SECONDS, DIG_SECONDS + RESTORE_SECONDS + REGRIP_SECONDS);
          if (fill >= 1 && fx.hole.visible) fx.end();
          weight = 1 - smooth01(regrip);
          writePose(body, dt, weight);
          debug.holeVisible = fx.hole.visible;
          if (regrip >= 1) finish(body);
          break;
        }
      }
    },
    dispose(body) {
      fx.end();
      fx.onPatter = null;
      body.override = null;
      body.gait.pose = null;
      body.gait.rig = null;
      if (npcDebug.rabbit === debug) delete npcDebug.rabbit;
    },
  };
}
```
