```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX,
  PointerRayLike,
  beginMove,
  clearClickGuard,
  dragThresholdFor,
  endGesture,
  guardCancelKey,
  guardNextClick,
  rayHitHorizontal,
  setAlignModifier,
  translateRayXZ,
} from '../../lib/placementSession';
import {
  POINTER_BUTTON,
  capturePointerForDrag,
  isDragStartButton,
  subscribePointerRelease,
} from '../../lib/inputManager';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';

/**
 * THE DRAG: one gesture — press, pull, release — shared by both placement modes.
 *
 * ## The gesture, in full
 *
 *     pointerdown on the subject   → ARMED. Nothing moves. The camera is pinned (see below).
 *     pointer travels < threshold  → still armed. Release here and it was a CLICK.
 *     pointer travels >= threshold → DRAGGING. `beginMove` locks the selection, and from this
 *                                    sample on the object follows the pointer.
 *     pointerup                    → the spot is settled; `onEnd` hands it back to the caller.
 *     Esc / right button           → CANCELLED; `onCancel` puts the object back where the press
 *                                    found it.
 *
 * ## The three bugs this exists to remove
 *
 * ### 1. Outdoors the object followed the bare cursor
 *
 * 【建造模式】ran with a `followWhenIdle` flag that sampled `pointermove` with **no button held**,
 * so the held object teleported to wherever the mouse happened to end up — reach for a HUD
 * button, glance at another corner of the island, and the fountain came too. There was no way to
 * look at a spot without committing to it, and no confirmation beat anywhere in the gesture.
 * Worse on a phone, where "no button held" is not even a state a finger can be in: dragging the
 * camera in build mode fired the same handler and dragged the OBJECT with it.
 *
 * That flag is gone. A move is a press-and-pull now, exactly as it always was indoors, which is
 * the whole of 「選取 → 按住拖曳 → 放開確認」.
 *
 * ### 2. `pointerdown` was itself the start of the move
 *
 * Even indoors, the first pixel of pointer travel after a press moved the piece. A player who
 * meant to *select* something — or who simply has an unsteady hand on a trackpad, or a finger on
 * glass — nudged it instead, and the only evidence was a piece that no longer sat where it had.
 * So a press now ARMS the gesture and a short press-and-release stays a click; only travel past
 * `DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX` promotes it to a drag. The rule itself lives in lib/placementSession.ts
 * beside the rest of "who owns the gesture", so it is one number for both modes and is covered by
 * `npm run test:placement`.
 *
 * ### 3. The drag was only sampled while the pointer was ON the model
 *
 * Both modes drove the drag from an R3F `onPointerMove` **on the ghost object itself**. R3F
 * delivers that handler by raycasting the scene: it fires when, and only when, the ray still meets
 * that object's own geometry. So the gesture worked like this —
 *
 *     pointer on the vase      -> sample -> vase moves under the cursor
 *     pointer slips off it     -> NO EVENT AT ALL -> vase frozen, however far the mouse travels
 *     pointer crosses it again -> one sample -> vase snaps the whole accumulated distance
 *
 * — which is precisely the reported "no reaction, then a big jump", and it is worst on exactly the
 * things players most want to nudge: a lamp, a book, a small plant, anything whose silhouette is a
 * few dozen pixels.
 *
 * The fix is to stop asking the scene. A drag is a gesture on the *pointer*, not on any geometry:
 * once the gesture is armed, this hook reads `pointermove` off the **window**, rebuilds the ray
 * from the camera and the cursor's own screen coordinates, and never consults a hit test again.
 *
 * ### And the grab offset
 *
 * Neither mode had one, so the object's ORIGIN went to the cursor. Take hold of a table by its
 * corner and the table lurches a metre before the mouse has moved at all. See
 * {@link translateRayXZ} — the offset is applied to the ray, which makes it correct on the floor,
 * on a tabletop and on a wall without a per-mount case. It is measured at the press, which is also
 * what makes the threshold invisible: when the drag finally starts, the object is exactly where
 * the pointer's own travel says it should be, with no catch-up jump.
 *
 * ## What this hook does NOT do
 *
 * It has no opinion about where the object may go. It produces a corrected ray and hands it to the
 * caller's resolver — lib/interiorPlacement.ts indoors, lib/placementSurfaces.ts outdoors — so the
 * Placement Raycast and the Collision Check stay exactly where they were, and this stays the one
 * owner of the *gesture*. That split is what lets 室內 and 室外 share the interaction while each
 * keeps its own Surface Detection and Collision Rule.
 */
export interface PlacementDragOptions {
  /**
   * The Active Object's id while a session is open, or null when there is nothing to drag.
   * Passed straight to the session lock, so a drag and the selection lock can never disagree.
   */
  activeId: string | null;
  /**
   * The object's current world position. Read once, at pointerdown, to work out where within the
   * object the player took hold of it — and to remember where to put it back if they cancel.
   */
  getOrigin: () => [number, number, number];
  /** Every pointer sample of the drag, as a ray already corrected for the grab offset. */
  onMove: (ray: PointerRayLike) => void;
  /**
   * The press has become a real drag (the threshold was crossed). Fires once per gesture, before
   * the first {@link onMove}, so the caller can snapshot whatever {@link onCancel} has to restore.
   */
  onDragStart?: () => void;
  /** The gesture ended normally — released, or taken away by the browser. Idempotent. */
  onEnd?: () => void;
  /**
   * The player abandoned the move: Esc, or the right button. The argument is the object's
   * position as it was when the press started, so the caller can put it back rather than leaving
   * it stranded halfway.
   */
  onCancel?: (origin: [number, number, number]) => void;
  /**
   * How far from the object's origin a grab may be honoured.
   *
   * A guard against a degenerate ray, and NOT a statement about how big furniture is — that
   * distinction cost a debugging round, so it is worth writing down. The grab is the gap between
   * the object's origin and where the pointer's ray meets the horizontal plane the object stands
   * on. For a TALL model those are far apart and legitimately so: click the roof of a house from a
   * low camera and the ray carries on past it for several metres before it reaches the ground.
   * A bound sized to "the largest piece of furniture" therefore rejects the honest grab on exactly
   * the objects that need it most — and rejecting it means falling back to zero, which is the
   * origin-snaps-to-the-cursor lurch this whole mechanism exists to remove.
   *
   * So the bound is only large enough to catch a ray running almost parallel to the ground, which
   * resolves a point hundreds of units away. The island is ~9 units across at territory level 1.
   */
  maxGrab?: number;
}

const DEFAULT_MAX_GRAB = 60;

export interface PlacementDragHandlers {
  /** Spread onto the draggable ghost. The only R3F pointer handler the drag still needs. */
  onPointerDown: (e: any) => void;
  /** Ends the gesture when R3F can still route the release here. The window path is the guarantee. */
  onPointerUp: (e: any) => void;
  /** True between the threshold being crossed and release — for cursor styling only. */
  isDraggingRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
}

export function usePlacementDrag({
  activeId,
  getOrigin,
  onMove,
  onDragStart,
  onEnd,
  onCancel,
  maxGrab = DEFAULT_MAX_GRAB,
}: PlacementDragOptions): PlacementDragHandlers {
  const { camera, gl } = useThree();

  // Callbacks read through refs so the window listeners below are installed exactly once, rather
  // than being torn down and rebuilt on every render of a component that re-renders per drag
  // sample. A listener that is replaced mid-gesture is a listener that can miss events.
  const onMoveRef = useRef(onMove);
  onMoveRef.current = onMove;
  const onDragStartRef = useRef(onDragStart);
  onDragStartRef.current = onDragStart;
  const onEndRef = useRef(onEnd);
  onEndRef.current = onEnd;
  const onCancelRef = useRef(onCancel);
  onCancelRef.current = onCancel;
  const getOriginRef = useRef(getOrigin);
  getOriginRef.current = getOrigin;
  const activeIdRef = useRef(activeId);
  activeIdRef.current = activeId;

  /** A press is being held on the subject, but it has not travelled far enough to be a drag yet. */
  const armedRef = useRef(false);
  /** The threshold was crossed: the object is following the pointer. */
  const draggingRef = useRef(false);
  /** Screen position of the press, and the distance from it that promotes the press to a drag. */
  const downRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; threshold: number }>({
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    threshold: DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX,
  });
  /** Where the object stood when the press landed — what a cancel restores. */
  const startOriginRef = useRef<[number, number, number]>([0, 0, 0]);
  const grabRef = useRef<[number, number]>([0, 0]);

  // One raycaster and one vector for the whole lifetime of the drag. Pointer events arrive at the
  // mouse's report rate (125–1000 Hz on modern hardware); allocating per sample is how a drag ends
  // up fighting the garbage collector for the frame budget it needs to look smooth.
  const raycaster = useMemo(() => new THREE.Raycaster(), []);
  const ndc = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector2(), []);

  /**
   * Tears the gesture down, whether it ever became a drag or not.
   *
   * `dragged` says which of the two just ended, and it is the only thing the two paths differ on:
   * a press that never crossed the threshold IS a click and must leave the click guard alone, or
   * tapping a piece to look at it would stop selecting anything.
   */
  const settle = useCallback((dragged: boolean) => {
    armedRef.current = false;
    draggingRef.current = false;
    playerBus.isDraggingPlacement = false;
    if (dragged) {
      // A release that ended a real drag belongs to the drag, not to whatever model happens to be
      // under it — see `guardNextClick`.
      guardNextClick();
    }
    endGesture();
    if (document.body.style.cursor === 'grabbing') document.body.style.cursor = 'auto';
  }, []);

  const finish = useCallback(() => {
    if (!armedRef.current && !draggingRef.current) return;
    const dragged = draggingRef.current;
    settle(dragged);
    if (dragged) onEndRef.current?.();
  }, [settle]);

  /**
   * 取消移動 — put it back where the press found it.
   *
   * Only meaningful once the object has actually moved, so an armed-but-not-yet-dragging press is
   * left alone: Escape there is the player asking to drop the whole session, which is the outer
   * handler's job (see PlacementGhost / BuildingInteriorView). The click guard IS set, because the
   * pointerup still to come is the tail of an abandoned drag and must not select or place
   * anything.
   */
  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (!draggingRef.current) return;
    const origin = startOriginRef.current;
    settle(true);
    onCancelRef.current?.(origin);
  }, [settle]);

  /**
   * The drag's only input, taken from the window rather than from the scene.
   *
   * Registered unconditionally and gated on the refs instead of being added and removed around the
   * gesture: the add would have to happen inside the pointerdown handler, and a listener attached
   * during event dispatch can miss the moves that follow in the same task.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!draggingRef.current) {
        if (!armedRef.current) return;
        // THE DRAG THRESHOLD. Measured in screen space from the press, not in world units: what
        // the player is deciding is "did I mean to move this", and that is a question about their
        // hand, not about how far away the camera happens to be.
        const { x, y, threshold } = downRef.current;
        if (Math.hypot(e.clientX - x, e.clientY - y) < threshold) return;

        armedRef.current = false;
        draggingRef.current = true;
        // Only NOW does the session enter its locked phase — a press that is still deciding must
        // not stop the player selecting something else.
        const id = activeIdRef.current;
        if (id) beginMove(id);
        document.body.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        onDragStartRef.current?.();
      }

      // Shift is read off the move itself, so the modifier applies the moment it is pressed
      // without needing a separate global key listener to keep in sync.
      setAlignModifier(e.shiftKey);

      const rect = gl.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return;
      ndc.set(
        ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
        -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
      );
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      const [gx, gz] = grabRef.current;
      onMoveRef.current(translateRayXZ(raycaster.ray, gx, gz));
    };

    /**
     * Any fresh press retires the previous gesture's claim on its release — see `guardNextClick`.
     * Capture phase, on the window, so it lands before R3F routes the press to anything and cannot
     * be hidden by a `stopPropagation` in the scene.
     *
     * The right button doubles as 取消: it is the one button that is never a placement gesture
     * (it is the camera's look-rotation), the browser menu it would otherwise open is already
     * suppressed globally (lib/inputManager.ts), and it is the cancel every desktop editor has.
     */
    const handleDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (draggingRef.current && e.button === POINTER_BUTTON.RIGHT) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cancel();
        return;
      }
      clearClickGuard();
    };

    /**
     * Escape, taken in the CAPTURE phase so it reaches this before the mode-level Escape handlers.
     *
     * Both placement modes bind Escape on the window to drop the whole session, in the bubble
     * phase. Capture on `window` runs first, and `stopPropagation` there keeps a real keypress
     * from ever descending — so mid-drag Escape means 「取消這次搬動」 and Escape at rest still
     * means 「放下這個東西」.
     *
     * `guardCancelKey` is the belt to that braces, and it is not decoration: `stopPropagation`
     * does nothing about a second listener on the SAME node, so an event dispatched at the window
     * still reaches the mode's handler. See the note on the guard for what that cost.
     */
    const handleKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (!draggingRef.current || e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      guardCancelKey();
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      cancel();
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handleMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', handleDown, { capture: true });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey, { capture: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handleMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handleDown, { capture: true });
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey, { capture: true });
    };
  }, [camera, cancel, gl, ndc, raycaster]);

  // Every way the browser can take a gesture away, in one place — see lib/inputManager.ts. Without
  // it a swallowed `pointerup` leaves the object following a mouse with no button held.
  useEffect(() => subscribePointerRelease(finish), [finish]);

  // Leaving the session (confirm, cancel, mode exit) while the button is still down.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeId) return;
    finish();
  }, [activeId, finish]);

  // Nothing may outlive this hook.
  //
  // Both of these are module-global by necessity — `isDraggingPlacement` gates OrbitControls from
  // outside React, and the click guard has to be readable by handlers that never see this hook —
  // which makes "set on the way in, cleared on the way out" the whole safety story. The failure
  // mode if it is not cleared is severe and silent in different ways for each: a latched
  // `isDraggingPlacement` pins the camera so the view can never be rotated again, and a latched
  // click guard makes `canSelect` refuse forever, so NOTHING in the scene can be selected. Both
  // read to a player as "the game locked up", with a reload as the only way out.
  useEffect(() => () => {
    playerBus.isDraggingPlacement = false;
    clearClickGuard();
  }, []);

  const onPointerDown = useCallback((e: any) => {
    // The right button is the camera's look-rotation. A drag started on it could never be closed
    // by the player, because the browser withholds the matching pointerup while its context menu
    // is up. See lib/inputManager.ts.
    if (!isDragStartButton(e)) return;
    const id = activeIdRef.current;
    if (!id) return;

    e.stopPropagation?.();
    clearClickGuard();

    // WHERE THE PLAYER TOOK HOLD. Measured against the horizontal plane through the object's own
    // origin, which is the plane the object slides on, so the point under the cursor at the start
    // of the drag is still under it at the end.
    const origin = getOriginRef.current();
    startOriginRef.current = [origin[0], origin[1], origin[2]];
    const hit = e.ray ? rayHitHorizontal(e.ray, origin[1]) : null;
    if (hit) {
      const gx = origin[0] - hit.x;
      const gz = origin[2] - hit.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(gx, gz);
      grabRef.current = d > maxGrab ? [0, 0] : [gx, gz];
    } else {
      grabRef.current = [0, 0];
    }

    downRef.current = {
      x: e.clientX ?? 0,
      y: e.clientY ?? 0,
      threshold: dragThresholdFor(e.pointerType),
    };

    setAlignModifier(!!e.shiftKey);
    armedRef.current = true;
    draggingRef.current = false;
    /*
      Pinned from the FIRST pixel, not from the threshold.

      The camera reads this flag once per frame and consumes whatever pointer travel it has
      accumulated (CameraController). If the press did not pin it here, the few pixels before the
      threshold would rotate the view underneath the object the player is about to pull — the
      object would then be dragged relative to a camera that had already moved. Clearing it on a
      release that never became a drag costs nothing: by definition the pointer barely moved, so
      there is no rotation to have missed.
    */
    playerBus.isDraggingPlacement = true;
    capturePointerForDrag(gl.domElement, e.pointerId);
  }, [gl, maxGrab]);

  const onPointerUp = useCallback((e: any) => {
    e.stopPropagation?.();
    finish();
  }, [finish]);

  return { onPointerDown, onPointerUp, isDraggingRef: draggingRef };
}
```

## src/components/Three/wallMaterial.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import * as THREE from 'three';

import { NOISE_GLSL } from './proceduralNoise';

/**
 * Procedural materials for the interior wall styles.
 *
 * The same story as floorMaterial.ts, one surface later. Every wall in the
 * house was a single flat colour on a 12 x 5 box, which is the largest thing on
 * screen at the interior camera's distance and the only surface left in the
 * room with no material at all: the floor has planks and grout, the doors have
 * real stile-and-rail joinery, the ceiling has beams, and the wall behind all
 * of it was one unbroken fill. The item names had been promising otherwise the
 * whole time - 象牙白"壁紙", 粉綠"油漆", 暖黃"壁貼", 炭火紅"牆" - while all seven
 * were the identical flat paint with a different hex code.
 *
 * TWO THINGS ARE HAPPENING IN THIS SHADER, and they are worth keeping apart:
 *
 *   1. SHADING every style gets, whatever its pattern. Contact darkening where
 *      the wall meets the floor and the ceiling, and at the room's vertical
 *      corners. This is the part that stops a wall reading as cardboard: a flat
 *      fill with no corner darkening has nothing anywhere to say which way the
 *      surface turned, so the two walls of a corner merge into one shape.
 *
 *   2. The PATTERN, per style - plaster mottle, shiplap grooves, brick, weave.
 *
 * Both are drawn from WORLD position, not from mesh UVs, for the reason spelled
 * out in floorMaterial.ts: a room's walls are separate boxes, and a wall shared
 * by two adjoining rooms is two meshes, so UV-space patterns would restart at
 * every mesh and put a visible break at each doorway. Keying off world position
 * makes brick courses and panel joints run straight through a doorway into the
 * next room - which is what makes the house read as one built shell rather than
 * as rooms wallpapered one at a time.
 *
 * WHICH WORLD AXIS RUNS ALONG THE WALL is decided per fragment from the world
 * normal rather than passed in, because these materials are shared and cached
 * per style (a house has up to four walls per room and eight rooms; that has to
 * be one material and one compiled program). A wall facing +/-Z runs along X,
 * and one facing +/-X runs along Z.
 *
 * All arithmetic - no texture files, matching the rest of the project's art.
 */

/** Wall height, and the top of the AO ramp. Matches the 5-unit wall boxes. */
const WALL_TOP = 5.0;

/**
 * Contact shading, applied to every style on top of whatever its pattern drew.
 *
 * `U` is the along-wall world coordinate and `V` is world height.
 *
 * The corner term needs to know where a wall ENDS, and it gets that from the
 * room lattice rather than from mesh-local coordinates: rooms sit on a
 * ROOM_GRID_SIZE grid, so a wall's two ends are always at odd multiples of the
 * half grid. Doing it this way means the flanking panels of a doorway get the
 * same corner darkening as a solid wall, in the same place, without either
 * needing to know its own width.
 */
const AO_GLSL = `
  // 0 at the room corner, growing towards the middle of the wall.
  float wCornerDist(float U) {
    float t = fract((U + 6.0) / 12.0) * 12.0 - 6.0;
    return 6.0 - abs(t);
  }
  float wContactAO(float U, float V) {
    // Floor. Starts above the baseboard, which already has its own dark mass.
    float floorAO = mix(0.62, 1.0, smoothstep(0.28, 1.45, V));
    // Ceiling. Shallower than the floor's - light comes from above, so the
    // gloom collects at the bottom, not the top.
    float ceilAO = 1.0 - 0.30 * smoothstep(4.15, ${WALL_TOP.toFixed(2)}, V);
    // Vertical corners.
    float cornerAO = mix(0.74, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, 1.15, wCornerDist(U)));
    return floorAO * ceilAO * cornerAO;
  }
`;

/**
 * Per-style body. Each sets `vec3 col` and `float gloss` (0 = matte, 1 = satin
 * sheen) from `vec2 P`, where P.x runs ALONG the wall and P.y is height above
 * the floor, both in world units.
 */
const PATTERNS: Record<string, string> = {
  // 經典象牙白壁紙 - tone-on-tone satin stripe. The stripe is barely a shade
  // apart from the ground; what actually reads is the gloss difference between
  // the satin band and the matte one, which is why the paper looks like paper
  // from an angle and like plain cream head-on.
  'wall-white': `
    const float SW = 0.44;
    float band = mod(floor(P.x / SW), 2.0);
    vec3 base = vec3(0.976, 0.949, 0.878);
    col = mix(base, base * 1.028, band);
    // Paper tooth.
    col *= 0.985 + 0.030 * fNoise(P * 26.0);
    // Hairline where two drops of paper butt together. Measured to the nearest stripe
    // BOUNDARY - fract(x) - 0.5 would have put it down the middle of each stripe instead,
    // which is the one place a seam cannot be.
    float seam = min(fract(P.x / SW), 1.0 - fract(P.x / SW)) * SW;
    col *= 1.0 - 0.030 * fLine(seam, 0.004, 0.006);
    gloss = 0.16 + 0.16 * band;
  `,

  // 北歐森活粉綠油漆 - limewash. Broad cloudy variation plus a much finer
  // vertical brush direction, because a flat-rolled matte paint and a limewash
  // differ almost entirely in whether you can see the hand that applied it.
  'wall-green': `
    vec3 deep = vec3(0.529, 0.584, 0.463);
    vec3 pale = vec3(0.706, 0.745, 0.624);
    float cloud = fFbm(P * 0.55);
    float brush = fFbm(P * vec2(1.6, 5.5) + 13.0);
    col = mix(deep, pale, smoothstep(0.30, 0.80, cloud * 0.72 + brush * 0.38));
    col *= 0.970 + 0.050 * fNoise(P * 18.0);
    gloss = 0.05;
  `,

  // 地中海美式天藍壁面 - horizontal shiplap. The groove is the whole style: a
  // board wall with no shadow line in the joint is just a striped paint job.
  'wall-blue': `
    const float BH = 0.44;
    float row = floor(P.y / BH);
    float f = fract(P.y / BH);
    float tone = fHash(vec2(row, 3.1));
    col = mix(vec3(0.478, 0.784, 0.925), vec3(0.647, 0.882, 0.976), 0.30 + 0.55 * tone);
    // Long grain running along the board, not across it.
    col *= 0.980 + 0.040 * fNoise(vec2(P.x * 3.0, P.y * 42.0));
    // Shadow in the groove, and the lit bevel on the board above it.
    float groove = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.10, f);
    float bevel = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.10, 0.24, f);
    col *= (1.0 - 0.34 * groove) * (1.0 + 0.09 * bevel);
    gloss = 0.36 - 0.28 * groove;
  `,

  // 朋克工業炭火紅牆 - fired brick in running bond.
  'wall-red': `
    const float BW = 0.52, BH = 0.215;
    float row = floor(P.y / BH);
    float off = mod(row, 2.0) * 0.5 * BW;
    float bx = (P.x + off) / BW;
    vec2 cell = vec2(fract(bx), fract(P.y / BH));
    float bid = fHash(vec2(floor(bx), row));
    vec3 brick = mix(vec3(0.427, 0.157, 0.129), vec3(0.706, 0.298, 0.216), 0.22 + 0.72 * bid);
    // Firing blotches.
    brick *= 0.88 + 0.24 * fFbm(P * 9.0);
    vec2 e = min(cell, 1.0 - cell) * vec2(BW, BH);
    float joint = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.022, 0.034, min(e.x, e.y));
    col = mix(brick, vec3(0.784, 0.757, 0.706) * (0.94 + 0.10 * fNoise(P * 20.0)), joint);
    gloss = 0.12 * (1.0 - joint);
  `,

  // 溫馨櫻花淡粉牆 - small floral wallpaper, five petals on a staggered grid.
  'wall-pink': `
    const float CS = 0.58;
    vec2 g = P / CS;
    g.x += mod(floor(g.y), 2.0) * 0.5;
    vec2 c = fract(g) - 0.5;
    float r = length(c);
    float petal = 0.155 + 0.085 * cos(5.0 * atan(c.y, c.x));
    float flower = 1.0 - smoothstep(petal - 0.025, petal + 0.025, r);
    float centre = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.032, 0.055, r);
    col = mix(vec3(0.984, 0.906, 0.925), vec3(0.937, 0.706, 0.784), flower);
    col = mix(col, vec3(0.988, 0.855, 0.612), centre);
    col *= 0.985 + 0.030 * fNoise(P * 24.0);
    gloss = 0.18 + 0.14 * flower;
  `,

  // 陽光鄉村暖黃壁貼 - linen. Deliberately coarse: a weave fine enough to be
  // realistic is finer than a pixel at this camera distance and turns into a
  // shimmering moire the moment the player walks, so the thread count is set by
  // what stays still on screen rather than by what a real fabric has.
  'wall-yellow': `
    const float TH = 34.0;
    // Saturated harder than the tone the swatch suggests. The weave, the slubs and the contact
    // shading each take a few percent off, and together they walked a 暖陽黃 all the way to
    // beige on screen - the base has to start further out to arrive where the name promises.
    vec3 base = vec3(0.996, 0.871, 0.416);
    float warp = sin(P.x * TH) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    float weft = sin(P.y * TH) * 0.5 + 0.5;
    col = base * (0.935 + 0.115 * (0.5 + 0.5 * (warp - weft)));
    // Slubs - the thick-and-thin of a natural fibre.
    col *= 0.960 + 0.070 * fFbm(P * 3.2);
    gloss = 0.11;
  `,

  // 薰衣草優雅極簡紫壁 - damask. Ground and motif are nearly the same colour
  // and differ mostly in sheen, which is how a real tone-on-tone damask works.
  'wall-purple': `
    const float DS = 1.15;
    vec2 c = abs(fract(P / DS) - 0.5);
    float d = c.x + c.y;
    float ring = fLine(d - 0.30, 0.040, 0.028);
    float leaf = fLine(d - 0.14, 0.028, 0.022);
    float bud = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.050, 0.080, length(c));
    float motif = clamp(ring + leaf * 0.8 + bud, 0.0, 1.0);
    vec3 base = vec3(0.914, 0.859, 0.965);
    col = mix(base, base * 0.912, motif);
    col *= 0.990 + 0.020 * fNoise(P * 22.0);
    gloss = 0.14 + 0.20 * motif;
  `,

  // 胡桃木護牆板 - vertical walnut panelling. Each board is a slightly
  // different tone and the grain is stretched hard along it, so the boards read
  // as cut from different parts of the log rather than printed.
  'wall-wood-panel': `
    const float PW = 0.64;
    float board = floor(P.x / PW);
    float f = fract(P.x / PW);
    float tone = fHash(vec2(board, 2.7));
    col = mix(vec3(0.259, 0.161, 0.110), vec3(0.451, 0.310, 0.208), 0.28 + 0.58 * tone);
    col *= 0.900 + 0.200 * fNoise(vec2(P.x * 34.0, P.y * 1.6) + board * 11.0);
    // Cathedral figure, a few broad arcs per board.
    col *= 0.94 + 0.12 * fLine(fract(P.y * 0.19 + tone) - 0.5, 0.06, 0.10);
    // V groove between boards.
    float groove = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.038, min(f, 1.0 - f) * PW);
    col *= 1.0 - 0.52 * groove;
    gloss = 0.44 - 0.34 * groove;
  `,

  // 白刷磚牆 - the same bond as 炭火紅, limewashed. The paint sits thicker in
  // the joints than on the brick faces, which is the tell that a white brick
  // wall is a painted brick wall and not white bricks.
  'wall-brick-white': `
    const float BW = 0.52, BH = 0.215;
    float row = floor(P.y / BH);
    float off = mod(row, 2.0) * 0.5 * BW;
    float bx = (P.x + off) / BW;
    vec2 cell = vec2(fract(bx), fract(P.y / BH));
    float bid = fHash(vec2(floor(bx), row));
    vec3 brick = mix(vec3(0.847, 0.831, 0.804), vec3(0.965, 0.957, 0.937), 0.25 + 0.70 * bid);
    // Thin spots where the roller skipped and the clay shows through warm.
    brick = mix(brick, vec3(0.804, 0.706, 0.643), 0.30 * smoothstep(0.62, 0.90, fFbm(P * 2.4)));
    vec2 e = min(cell, 1.0 - cell) * vec2(BW, BH);
    float joint = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.022, 0.034, min(e.x, e.y));
    col = mix(brick, vec3(0.976, 0.973, 0.961), joint);
    gloss = 0.10 + 0.06 * (1.0 - joint);
  `,

  // 清水模灰牆 - board-formed concrete. Formwork panel joints plus the tie
  // holes left by the bolts that held the forms together; without the ties it
  // is just grey noise with a grid on it.
  'wall-concrete': `
    const float PW = 1.80, PH = 1.20;
    vec2 cell = vec2(fract(P.x / PW), fract(P.y / PH));
    vec3 base = vec3(0.706, 0.706, 0.694);
    col = base * (0.90 + 0.18 * fFbm(P * 1.4));
    col *= 0.970 + 0.050 * fNoise(P * 12.0);
    vec2 e = min(cell, 1.0 - cell) * vec2(PW, PH);
    float joint = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.012, 0.026, min(e.x, e.y));
    col = mix(col, base * 0.70, joint);
    // Four recessed ties per panel.
    vec2 h = abs((cell - 0.5) * vec2(PW, PH)) - vec2(PW * 0.30, PH * 0.30);
    float tie = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.030, 0.046, length(h));
    col = mix(col, base * 0.52, tie);
    gloss = 0.16 - 0.10 * max(joint, tie);
  `,

  // 學院藍白條紋 - broad two-tone stripe with a gold pinstripe on the seam.
  'wall-stripe-navy': `
    const float SW = 0.52;
    float band = mod(floor(P.x / SW), 2.0);
    vec3 navy = vec3(0.145, 0.243, 0.416);
    vec3 cream = vec3(0.961, 0.949, 0.910);
    col = mix(cream, navy, band);
    col *= 0.980 + 0.035 * fNoise(P * 22.0);
    // Pinstripe, on the boundary between every pair - so distance to the nearest stripe EDGE,
    // not to its centre, which is where fract(x) - 0.5 lands.
    float seam = min(fract(P.x / SW), 1.0 - fract(P.x / SW)) * SW;
    col = mix(col, vec3(0.831, 0.686, 0.376), 0.85 * fLine(seam, 0.007, 0.005));
    gloss = mix(0.24, 0.13, band);
  `,

  // 摩洛哥赤陶 - tadelakt. The burnished patches are the point: polished clay
  // plaster is glossy exactly where the trowel worked it and matte elsewhere,
  // so this style says most of what it says through roughness, not colour.
  'wall-terracotta': `
    vec3 deep = vec3(0.612, 0.333, 0.227);
    vec3 pale = vec3(0.855, 0.588, 0.443);
    float cloud = fFbm(P * 0.80 + 4.0);
    float trowel = fFbm(P * vec2(3.0, 1.2) + 21.0);
    col = mix(deep, pale, smoothstep(0.28, 0.82, cloud * 0.70 + trowel * 0.42));
    col *= 0.960 + 0.070 * fNoise(P * 15.0);
    gloss = 0.26 + 0.42 * smoothstep(0.38, 0.78, trowel);
  `,

  // 薄荷方磚 - small glazed square tile. The glaze pools slightly towards each
  // tile's edge, so the tiles catch the ceiling light as individual pillows
  // rather than as one glossy sheet with a grid drawn on it.
  'wall-mint-tile': `
    const float TS = 0.34;
    vec2 cell = fract(P / TS);
    float tid = fHash(floor(P / TS));
    vec3 tile = mix(vec3(0.518, 0.812, 0.741), vec3(0.729, 0.925, 0.878), 0.28 + 0.62 * tid);
    vec2 e = min(cell, 1.0 - cell) * TS;
    float edge = min(e.x, e.y);
    float grout = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.011, 0.019, edge);
    col = mix(tile, vec3(0.898, 0.902, 0.886), grout);
    col *= 1.0 + 0.07 * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.020, 0.065, edge)) * (1.0 - grout);
    gloss = mix(0.94, 0.12, grout);
  `,
};

/** Base PBR settings per style, before the pattern's own gloss modulation. */
const BASE_PROPS: Record<string, { roughness: number; metalness: number }> = {
  'wall-white': { roughness: 0.62, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-green': { roughness: 0.88, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-blue': { roughness: 0.56, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-red': { roughness: 0.86, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-pink': { roughness: 0.64, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-yellow': { roughness: 0.80, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-purple': { roughness: 0.66, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-wood-panel': { roughness: 0.50, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-brick-white': { roughness: 0.84, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-concrete': { roughness: 0.78, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-stripe-navy': { roughness: 0.60, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-terracotta': { roughness: 0.70, metalness: 0.0 },
  'wall-mint-tile': { roughness: 0.30, metalness: 0.0 },
};

const DEFAULT_PROPS = { roughness: 0.70, metalness: 0.0 };

/**
 * Builds the material for one wall style.
 *
 * Call through {@link getWallMaterial} rather than directly - these are shared
 * and cached, because there is one of these per style, not one per wall.
 *
 * A style with no pattern entry still gets the contact shading: `default` is a
 * plain painted wall, and a plain painted wall with corner darkening is exactly
 * what it should look like.
 */
function createWallMaterial(wallId: string, fallbackColor: string): THREE.MeshStandardMaterial {
  const pattern = PATTERNS[wallId];
  const props = BASE_PROPS[wallId] ?? DEFAULT_PROPS;

  const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: pattern ? '#ffffff' : fallbackColor,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
    ...props,
  });

  material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
    shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
      .replace('void main() {', 'varying vec3 vWallW;\nvarying vec3 vWallN;\nvoid main() {')
      .replace(
        '#include <beginnormal_vertex>',
        '#include <beginnormal_vertex>\n\tvWallN = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * objectNormal);'
      )
      .replace(
        '#include <begin_vertex>',
        '#include <begin_vertex>\n\tvWallW = (modelMatrix * vec4(transformed, 1.0)).xyz;'
      );

    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
      .replace(
        'void main() {',
        `varying vec3 vWallW;
         varying vec3 vWallN;
         ${NOISE_GLSL}
         ${AO_GLSL}
         void main() {
           // Declared out here so the roughness patch further down can read the
           // sheen the pattern decided on. Without that, a grout line or a
           // plank groove is only a colour change and still mirrors the ceiling
           // light exactly like the face beside it, which is what gives a
           // pattern away as painted on.
           float wallGloss = 0.5;`
      )
      .replace(
        '#include <color_fragment>',
        `#include <color_fragment>
         {
           // A wall facing +/-Z runs along X; one facing +/-X runs along Z.
           float U = abs(vWallN.z) >= abs(vWallN.x) ? vWallW.x : vWallW.z;
           vec2 P = vec2(U, vWallW.y);
           vec3 col = diffuseColor.rgb;
           float gloss = 0.5;
           ${pattern ?? ''}
           diffuseColor.rgb = col * wContactAO(U, vWallW.y);
           wallGloss = clamp(gloss, 0.0, 1.0);
         }`
      )
      .replace(
        '#include <roughnessmap_fragment>',
        `#include <roughnessmap_fragment>
         roughnessFactor = clamp(mix(0.96, 0.10, wallGloss), 0.06, 1.0);`
      );
  };

  // three keys its shader cache on onBeforeCompile's SOURCE TEXT, which is
  // identical for every style built by this one factory - without a distinct
  // key, all styles would be handed whichever program compiled first.
  material.customProgramCacheKey = () => `wall|${wallId}`;

  return material;
}

const cache = new Map<string, THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>();

/**
 * The shared material for a wall style. Cached per style: a house can have
 * eight rooms painted the same colour, and they should be one material and one
 * compiled program, not twenty-odd.
 */
export function getWallMaterial(wallId: string, fallbackColor: string): THREE.MeshStandardMaterial {
  const key = `${wallId}|${fallbackColor}`;
  let material = cache.get(key);
  if (!material) {
    material = createWallMaterial(wallId, fallbackColor);
    cache.set(key, material);
  }
  return material;
}

/** True when this style draws a procedural pattern (rather than a flat colour). */
export function hasWallPattern(wallId: string): boolean {
  return wallId in PATTERNS;
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license

 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { getBalance } from '../../constants/currency';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import {
  User,
  LogOut,
  Settings,
  Key,
  ShieldAlert,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Calendar,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronRight,
  TrendingUp,
  Coins,
  X
, Gem } from 'lucide-react';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { AvatarIcon } from './AvatarIcon';
import { PortholeFrame, ModalOverlay, PanelHeader, IconTile } from './DesignKit';
import { FloatingPanelPortal } from './FloatingPanelPortal';
import { ProviderButton } from './ProviderButton';
import type { SettingsCategoryId } from './settings/settingsCategories';
import { requestSettingsCategory } from './settings/settingsNavigation';
import { useAuth } from '../../auth/useAuth';
import { providerLabel } from '../../auth/errors';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { useIsTouchDevice } from '../../hooks/useIsTouchDevice';
import { profileLevel, xpIntoLevel } from '../../utils/level';

interface AccountPanelProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function AccountPanel({ onClose }: AccountPanelProps) {
  const {
    user,
    profile,
    setCurrentView,
  } = useApp();

  // Account binding is driven entirely by the auth layer: which providers are
  // still bindable comes from the registry, not from a hardcoded Google button.
  const { linkableProviders, linkProvider, signOut, pendingProviderId, error, clearError } =
    useAuth();

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [showManageStats, setShowManageStats] = useState(false);
  // Now a viewport-centred sheet at every size (see the container below), so
  // it no longer needs to know where TopBar is — this used to anchor to
  // TopBar's desktop card via `top-[128px] left-[104px]`, which broke once
  // TopBar moved into the shared HUD rail. `isMobile` (pointer-type) is kept
  // only to pick the panel *width* (full-bleed sheet on touch vs. fixed
  // desktop width).
  const isMobile = useIsTouchDevice();

  // Esc key closure
  useEscapeToClose(onClose);

  if (!profile) return null;

  const isGuest = !!user?.isGuest;
  // True only when the session never reached Firebase at all — the save is on
  // this device and nowhere else. Distinct from an ordinary anonymous guest,
  // whose progress *is* in the cloud and already syncs.
  const isLocalOnly = !!user?.isLocalOnly;
  const userEmail = user?.email || 'guest-session@island.local';
  const providerNames = (user?.linkedProviders ?? []).map(providerLabel).join('、');

  // Copy local user ID
  const handleCopyId = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(profile.userId);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  /**
   * 開設定，而且**停在被承諾的那一頁**。
   *
   * 底下兩張快捷卡以前都呼叫同一個不帶參數的版本，所以「編輯個人資料 · 更變暱稱 & 挑選您的專屬
   * 頭像」會把玩家送到 設定 · 一般 —— 一個既沒有暱稱也沒有頭像的分頁。兩個看起來不同的入口通往
   * 同一個地方，而且是錯的那一個。現在每張卡自己說它要去哪（見 settings/settingsNavigation.ts）。
   */
  const handleNavigateToSettings = (category: SettingsCategoryId) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    requestSettingsCategory(category);
    setCurrentView(View.SETTINGS);
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSignOut = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    onClose();
    void signOut();
  };

  const handleLink = (providerId: Parameters<typeof linkProvider>[0]) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    void linkProvider(providerId);
  };

  // 等級 and the bar both derive from cumulative XP (utils/level.ts); `profile.level` is stored
  // once and never incremented, so reading it here showed LV.1 for a player with thousands of XP.
  const level = profileLevel(profile);
  const xpPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, xpIntoLevel(profile.currentXp)));

  return (
    // Portaled to #floating-panel-root, because this panel is rendered by
    // TopBar — i.e. from *inside* HudFrame, which is one stacking context on
    // the z-hud-frame tier (z-index 20). A `z-modal` written inside that
    // context only ranks against HudFrame's other children; it cannot beat an
    // App-level sibling of the frame itself. InteractionPrompt (z-hud-toolbar,
    // 24) is exactly that, so the world-tracked "摸摸小狗" badge painted straight
    // over this dialog. Portaling moves the panel out to App's root stacking
    // context, where its z-modal (1000) means what it says. Same reasoning,
    // and same fix, as BuildingInteriorView's floating dialogs — see
    // FloatingPanelPortal.tsx.
    <FloatingPanelPortal>
      {/* Background overlay for click outside dismissal — shared ModalOverlay
          scrim, same as every other blocking dialog in the app. */}
      <ModalOverlay
        className="!p-0 backdrop-blur-[2px] cursor-default"
        onClick={() => {
          playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
          onClose();
        }}
      />

      {/* Account panel container — viewport-centred at every size. */}
      <div
        className={`fixed z-modal pointer-events-auto top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ${
          isMobile ? 'w-[92vw] max-w-sm' : 'w-[400px] xl:w-[440px]'
        }`}
      >
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 15 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 10 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 24, stiffness: 280 }}
          // `.notch-shadow-lg` (a filter on this element, wrapping the clipped
          // card below) instead of a `shadow-[...]` on the `dock-notch` element
          // — a clip-path clips the element's own box-shadow away. index.css.
          className="notch-shadow-lg max-h-[85vh] flex"
        >
        <div
          className="bg-white border border-island-line dock-notch rounded-[2rem] flex flex-col overflow-hidden w-full min-h-0 text-island-navy font-sans"
        >
          <PanelHeader
            icon={<Sparkles size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
            title="帳號資訊安全"
            onClose={() => {
              playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
              onClose();
            }}
            className="!px-6 !py-4"
          />

          <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 min-h-0 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-island-line scrollbar-track-transparent">
          {/* User profile capsule */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 pt-5 pb-6 text-center">
            {/* Avatar — ticket photo in a porthole frame */}
            <div className="relative group">
              <PortholeFrame size={92} className="shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(42,157,143,0.2)]">
                <AvatarIcon id={profile.avatar} size={80} />
              </PortholeFrame>
              <div className="absolute -bottom-1.5 -right-1 bg-island-teal border-2 border-white text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black z-10 font-mono shadow">
                LV.{level}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Display Name */}
            <h3 className="mt-4 font-black text-xl tracking-tight text-island-navy mb-1">
              {profile.displayName}
            </h3>

            {/* Account identifier */}
            <p className="text-island-navy-soft text-xs font-mono break-all max-w-[280px]">
              {isGuest ? '訪客存檔' : userEmail}
            </p>

            {/* Sync badge. Three states, not two: an anonymous guest with a real
                Firebase account already syncs, and conflating that with a
                device-only session is what let players believe their progress
                was safe when it was sitting in one browser's localStorage. */}
            <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black tracking-wide uppercase mt-3 ${
              isLocalOnly
                ? 'bg-island-coral/10 text-island-coral border border-island-coral/30'
                : isGuest
                  ? 'bg-island-sand text-island-navy-soft border border-island-line'
                  : 'bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal-dark border border-island-teal/30'
            }`}>
              <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                isLocalOnly ? 'bg-island-coral' : isGuest ? 'bg-island-navy-soft' : 'bg-island-teal'
              } animate-pulse`} />
              {isLocalOnly ? '僅存於此裝置' : isGuest ? '訪客雲端存檔' : `${providerNames || '雲端'} 同步中`}
            </span>

            {isLocalOnly && (
              <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-island-coral/90 bg-island-coral/8 border border-island-coral/20 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2.5 max-w-[300px]">
                你的島嶼目前只儲存在這台裝置上，換裝置或清除瀏覽器資料就會消失。綁定帳號即可備份並跨裝置同步。
              </p>
            )}

            {/* Manage My Account Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                setShowManageStats(!showManageStats);
              }}
              className="mt-5 w-full max-w-[240px] border border-island-line hover:bg-island-cream-2 active:scale-95 transition-all py-3.5 px-4 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-island-navy tracking-wide flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              {showManageStats ? '隱藏詳細狀態' : '管理您的帳號資訊'}
              <ChevronRight size={14} className={`transition-transform duration-300 ${showManageStats ? 'rotate-90' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Manage Stats Drawer Area */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {showManageStats && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                className="overflow-hidden bg-island-cream-2 border-t border-b border-island-line"
              >
                <div className="p-5 space-y-4 text-left">
                  {/* Copy User ID */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft font-black uppercase tracking-wider">用戶獨立代碼 (UID)</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-island-line">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-island-navy truncate max-w-[200px]">{profile.userId}</span>
                      <button
                        onClick={handleCopyId}
                        className="text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-navy transition-colors p-3 -m-2"
                        title="複製 UID"
                      >
                        {copied ? <Check size={14} className="text-island-teal" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Island Stats.

                      Three tiles rather than two: this is the 帳號中心, the one screen that is
                      supposed to be a complete statement of what the account holds, and a wallet
                      that lists one of its two currencies is not one. The 「健身取得」/「非健身取得」
                      captions are the whole point — they say WHY the two numbers are different
                      resources, which a colour alone cannot (§22).

                      「非健身取得」 rather than 「簽到取得」 since 2026-09-17: the 每日登入 round
                      stopped paying this currency (it pays 金幣 and 商品碎片 now, see
                      constants/dailyLogin.ts) and naming a source that no longer exists is worse
                      than naming none. What is left — 輪盤, 摸摸寵物, 島嶼秘寶 — has no one
                      name, and the rule they share is exactly the one worth saying. */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <Coins className="text-island-gold" size={16} />
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft font-black tracking-widest uppercase">持有金幣・健身取得</div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-island-navy">{getBalance(profile, 'coins').toLocaleString()}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      <Gem className="text-island-teal-dark" size={16} />
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft font-black tracking-widest uppercase">持有碎片・非健身取得</div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-island-navy">{getBalance(profile, 'fragments').toLocaleString()}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line flex items-center gap-2.5 col-span-2">
                      <TrendingUp className="text-island-teal" size={16} />
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft font-black tracking-widest uppercase">當前經驗</div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-island-navy">{profile.currentXp} XP</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Level Progress */}
                  <div className="space-y-1 bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft uppercase tracking-widest">
                      <span>等級進度</span>
                      <span>{xpIntoLevel(profile.currentXp)} / 100 XP</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-full bg-island-teal rounded-full"
                        style={{ width: `${xpPercent}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {/* Account binding — 「將 Guest 存檔綁定至正式帳號」.
              Rendered from `linkableProviders`, so this list grows on its own
              as providers are promoted to `ready` in the registry. For a
              Firebase anonymous guest the account is upgraded in place (same
              uid, nothing copied); for a device-only session the save is
              claimed into the new account by src/save/guestClaim.ts. */}
          {linkableProviders.length > 0 && (
            <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-island-line bg-island-cream-2/60 flex flex-col gap-2.5">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft font-black uppercase tracking-wider block">
                  {isGuest ? '綁定帳號以保存進度' : '綁定其他登入方式'}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft/80 leading-relaxed">
                  {isGuest
                    ? '綁定後即可在其他裝置登入並繼續你的島嶼。'
                    : '多綁一種登入方式，換裝置時更方便。'}
                </span>
              </div>

              {error && (
                <div
                  role="alert"
                  className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-island-coral/30 bg-island-coral/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-island-coral leading-relaxed"
                >
                  <ShieldAlert size={13} className="mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="flex-1">{error.message}</span>
                  <button onClick={clearError} className="opacity-60 hover:opacity-100" aria-label="關閉提示">
                    <X size={12} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {linkableProviders.map((descriptor) => (
                  <ProviderButton
                    key={descriptor.id}
                    descriptor={descriptor}
                    busy={pendingProviderId === descriptor.id}
                    disabled={pendingProviderId !== null && pendingProviderId !== descriptor.id}
                    onSelect={() => handleLink(descriptor.id)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick Actions List */}
          <div className="px-3 py-2 border-t border-island-line flex flex-col gap-0.5">
            {/* Editor profile link */}
            <button
              onClick={() => handleNavigateToSettings('account')}
              className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl hover:bg-island-cream-2 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-between text-left group"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <IconTile size={36} active accent="teal">
                  <User size={16} />
                </IconTile>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold block text-island-navy">編輯個人資料</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">更變暱稱 & 挑選您的專屬頭像</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-island-navy-soft/50 group-hover:text-island-navy group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" />
            </button>

            {/* Sync configuration settings */}
            <button
              onClick={() => handleNavigateToSettings('general')}
              className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl hover:bg-island-cream-2 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-between text-left group"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <IconTile size={36} className="text-island-navy-soft">
                  <Settings size={16} />
                </IconTile>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold block text-island-navy">偏好系統設定</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">調整背景音樂與 AI 語音輔助</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-island-navy-soft/50 group-hover:text-island-navy group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" />
            </button>

            {/* 每日補給與連續登入's re-grant button used to sit here, styled exactly like the two
                real account actions above it — which is precisely why it moved: a test hook that
                pays out gold and XP with no daily cap should not be one row away from 「偏好系統
                設定」. It is now in the 管理員測試 console (UI/admin/, 新手與登入流程). */}
          </div>

          {/* Three developer panels — 管理員數值調整, 離線回歸測試, 健身獎勵測試 — used to be
              stacked here, below the sign-out button's own divider, which turned 帳號中心 into the
              longest scroll in the game the moment 管理員測試模式 was switched on. All three moved
              into the 管理員測試 console (UI/admin/) unchanged; only their address did. */}

          {/* Sign Out Area */}
          <div className="p-5 border-t border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 flex flex-col items-center">
            <button
              onClick={handleSignOut}
              className="w-full py-4 px-5 rounded-full bg-island-coral/12 hover:bg-island-coral/20 border border-island-coral/25 text-island-coral active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold"
            >
              <LogOut size={14} />
              安全登出帳號
            </button>
          </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </FloatingPanelPortal>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/AdminIslandControls.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Check, Play, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { describeRecentFailure } from '../../lib/saveStatus';
import { describeOfflineStage } from '../../context/useIslandLife';
import {
  COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN,
  COLOUR_STAGES,
  OVERGROWTH_MAX,
  PET_MOODS,
  colourDrainForHours,
  colourStageForDrain,
  hoursForColourDrain,
  resolveIslandAmbience,
  resolveOfflineReturn,
} from '../../constants/islandReturn';

/**
 * 離線回歸測試 — 管理員測試模式 only (constants/adminFeatures.ts).
 *
 * 離線回歸's whole behaviour is keyed to a timestamp that is normally days old, which makes it the
 * hardest feature in the game to look at: without this, checking what a fortnight away produces
 * means either waiting a fortnight or editing Firestore by hand.
 *
 * ## Why these buttons wind the clock back instead of painting the result
 *
 * Each one rewinds `islandState.lastSeenAt` and then runs {@link resolveIslandArrival} — the same
 * function the login path runs, on the same profile, with the same siting rules. What the tester
 * sees is therefore what a player who was genuinely away that long would see. A shortcut that
 * fabricated the outcome would be a second implementation of the feature, and it would keep
 * passing while the real one was broken.
 *
 * Everything here is reversible, and none of it can cost the account anything: the writes touch
 * `islandState` alone, and 重置 puts it back to a clean island and a lively pet.
 */

/**
 * The absences worth having a button for, shortest first.
 *
 * Fractional days are allowed and 12 小時 uses one: it is the exact QUIET_HOURS threshold, which
 * makes it the single most useful button here — it is the one that has to produce NOTHING, and a
 * regression that starts growing weeds overnight is otherwise invisible until a player reports it.
 *
 * 60 天 is the other end: the growth curve reaches OVERGROWTH_MAX at 18.4 days, so this is well
 * past it: 「模擬最大離線狀態」. Whatever it shows is the worst the island can ever look, and if that
 * reads as a ruin rather than as a garden that needs an afternoon's work, the tuning is wrong.
 */
const OFFLINE_PRESETS: readonly { days: number; label: string }[] = [
  { days: 0.5, label: '12 小時' },
  { days: 1, label: '1 天' },
  { days: 3, label: '3 天' },
  { days: 7, label: '7 天' },
  { days: 14, label: '14 天' },
  { days: 30, label: '30 天' },
  { days: 60, label: '最大' },
];

const chipClass =
  'px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-[10px] font-black leading-none transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer';

/** The absence 「完全黑白」 corresponds to, from the production curve's own inverse. */
const MONO_HOURS = hoursForColourDrain(1);

export function AdminIslandControls() {
  const {
    profile, simulateOfflineDays, resetIslandEnvironment, showIslandAlert,
    islandRecovery, previewIslandColour,
  } = useApp();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!profile) return null;

  const state = profile.islandState;
  const sprouts = state?.sprouts ?? [];
  // Read live rather than from `lastReturnHours`: that field records the last absence the game
  // GREETED, and a tester needs to see how long the island has been alone right now.
  const current = resolveOfflineReturn(state?.lastSeenAt);
  const mood = PET_MOODS[state?.pet?.mood ?? 'lively'] ?? PET_MOODS.lively;
  // The same call Three/Scene.tsx grades the light with and Three/IslandOvergrowth.tsx grows the
  // vines from. Reading it here rather than re-deriving anything is the point of the readout: what
  // this panel shows is literally the number the screen is being drawn from.
  const ambience = resolveIslandAmbience(sprouts);
  // 離線褪色 — the OTHER half of the environment state, and the clock-driven one. It sits next to
  // the ambience readout precisely because the two are different measurements: wildness is what
  // the island is holding, the drain is how long it has been alone. Read off the preview when one
  // is up rather than off the live absence, so the panel always describes what is on screen.
  const previewHours = islandRecovery?.hours ?? current.hours;
  const drain = colourDrainForHours(previewHours);
  const pct = (value: number) => `${Math.round(value * 100)}%`;

  const run = async (key: string, action: () => Promise<boolean>) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setBusy(key);
    const ok = await action();
    setBusy(null);
    if (!ok) {
      showIslandAlert(describeRecentFailure());
      return;
    }
    setApplied(key);
    window.setTimeout(() => setApplied((k) => (k === key ? null : k)), 1400);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft">
        <span>
          目前離線：
          <span className="font-mono text-island-navy">
            {current.isFirstSighting ? '尚未記錄' : `${current.hours} 小時`}
          </span>
        </span>
        <span>
          離線階段：<span className="text-island-navy">{describeOfflineStage(current.hours)}</span>
        </span>
        <span>
          環境物件：
          <span className="font-mono text-island-navy">
            {sprouts.length} / {OVERGROWTH_MAX}
          </span>
        </span>
        <span>
          荒廢程度：
          <span className="font-mono text-island-navy">{pct(ambience.wildness)}</span>
          <span className="text-island-navy"> · {ambience.grade.label}</span>
        </span>
        <span>
          藤蔓生長：<span className="font-mono text-island-navy">{pct(ambience.vineGrowth)}</span>
        </span>
        <span>
          畫面色調：
          <span className="font-mono text-island-navy">
            {pct(ambience.saturation)} / {pct(ambience.brightness)}
          </span>
        </span>
        <span>
          寵物狀態：<span className="text-island-navy">{mood.label}</span>
        </span>
        <span>
          離線褪色：
          <span className="font-mono text-island-navy">{pct(drain)}</span>
          <span className="text-island-navy"> · {colourStageForDrain(drain).label}</span>
          {islandRecovery && !islandRecovery.play && (
            <span className="text-island-coral"> · 停住</span>
          )}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1.5 border-t border-dashed border-island-line">
        {OFFLINE_PRESETS.map(({ days, label }) => {
          const key = `d${days}`;
          return (
            <button
              key={key}
              disabled={busy !== null}
              onClick={() => void run(key, () => simulateOfflineDays(days))}
              className={`${chipClass} bg-island-teal/10 hover:bg-island-teal/20 border-island-teal/30 text-island-navy disabled:opacity-50`}
              title={`管理員：把上次上線時間倒退 ${days} 天，並照正式流程重新計算一次回歸`}
            >
              {applied === key ? <Check size={11} /> : label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
        <button
          disabled={busy !== null}
          onClick={() => void run('reset', resetIslandEnvironment)}
          className={`${chipClass} bg-white hover:bg-island-coral/10 border-island-line text-island-navy-soft flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50`}
          title="管理員：清空目前的環境變化，並把寵物狀態調回活潑"
        >
          {applied === 'reset' ? <Check size={11} /> : <RotateCcw size={10} />}
          重置
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 離線褪色測試. A second row rather than more chips in the first, because these do a
          different KIND of thing: the buttons above rewind the save and re-run a real arrival,
          while these touch nothing at all — the colour drain is a pure function of hours and is
          never persisted, so a preview is just a number handed to the veil. Pressing 重置 or
          reloading ends any of them. */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1.5 border-t border-dashed border-island-line">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft/70">畫面飽和</span>
        {COLOUR_STAGES.map((stage) => {
          const key = `c${stage.id}`;
          // Back through the production curve's own inverse, so a preview is a real absence
          // rendered by the real formula rather than a level invented for the panel.
          const hours = stage.previewDrain <= 0 ? null : hoursForColourDrain(stage.previewDrain);
          return (
            <button
              key={key}
              onClick={() => {
                playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                previewIslandColour(hours, false);
              }}
              className={`${chipClass} bg-island-teal/10 hover:bg-island-teal/20 border-island-teal/30 text-island-navy`}
              title={
                hours === null
                  ? '管理員：結束預覽，畫面回到正常彩色'
                  : `管理員：把畫面停在「${stage.label}」（約 ${Math.round(hours / 24)} 天未登入的飽和度）`
              }
            >
              {stage.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
            // Replays from whatever is on screen, so 「先停在接近灰階、再看它恢復」 is two presses
            // and describes one absence. Falls back to the deepest drain when the current one is
            // below the threshold, because a button whose honest answer is 「這次沒有東西要恢復」
            // is one a tester reads as broken.
            previewIslandColour(drain >= COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN ? previewHours : MONO_HOURS, true);
          }}
          className={`${chipClass} bg-island-teal/20 hover:bg-island-teal/30 border-island-teal/40 text-island-navy flex items-center gap-1`}
          title="管理員：從目前的褪色程度播放一次恢復演示（不會鎖住操作）"
        >
          <Play size={9} />
          播放恢復
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
            previewIslandColour(null);
          }}
          className={`${chipClass} bg-white hover:bg-island-coral/10 border-island-line text-island-navy-soft`}
          title="管理員：直接跳到恢復完成的狀態（恢復演示自己跑完也會到這裡）"
        >
          恢復完成
        </button>
      </div>

      <span className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft/80 leading-tight">
        走的是正式的回歸流程（同一個計算、同一套生成規則），不是另外畫一份結果。畫面色調由目前島上的環境物件決定，所以整理雜草時光線也會跟著回來。離線褪色則由離線時數決定，只在畫面上、不寫進存檔，重新登入後會自己恢復；恢復演示期間可以照常走動、開 UI、進商店。環境變化可以在島上直接整理掉，不影響金幣、家具或任何進度。
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useAdminMode } from '../../hooks/useAdminMode';

/**
 * Central render gate for Admin/QA-only UI — see constants/adminFeatures.ts
 * for the registry of what belongs behind it.
 *
 * Wrap a feature in this ONCE at its mount point:
 *
 *   <AdminOnly><DebugPanel /></AdminOnly>
 *
 * instead of adding a local `if (settings?.adminTestMode)` at each call site.
 * When a feature is promoted from "candidate" to "active" in the registry,
 * this is the only wrapper it needs.
 */
export function AdminOnly({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const isAdminMode = useAdminMode();
  if (!isAdminMode) return null;
  return <>{children}</>;
}
```

```tsx
/**
```
