```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { useOnboardingActive } from '../../lib/onboardingQueue';
import { View } from '../../types';
import {
  COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN,
  colourDrainForHours,
  resolveIslandColour,
  type IslandColourState,
} from '../../constants/islandReturn';

/**
 * 離線褪色 — the one element that takes colour out of the island, and puts it back.
 *
 * A single transparent sheet laid over the island's <Canvas>, desaturating whatever is behind it.
 * All of the *thinking* lives in constants/islandReturn.ts ({@link resolveIslandColour}); this
 * file is the sheet, the clock that decides when the recovery may begin, and nothing else.
 *
 * ## Why a backdrop filter and not a post-processing pass
 *
 * The island renders straight to the canvas — there is no EffectComposer, and Three/Scene.tsx
 * argues at length why adding one to tint the light was the wrong trade. That argument does not
 * carry over here, because this effect has to reach places light cannot: the sky dome, the
 * fireflies, the ocean's own tint and every emissive surface are unlit, so desaturating the three
 * lights leaves them in full colour. 「完全黑白」 that leaves a blue sky is not black and white.
 *
 * A composited CSS filter buys the whole frame for less than a WebGL pass would. There is no
 * render target, no second draw of the scene, no extra dependency and no shader — the browser
 * desaturates the layer it has already composited, on the GPU, in the step it was going to
 * perform anyway. And it is *removable*: the element is unmounted the instant the recovery ends
 * and never mounted at all for the absences that do not earn it (see the guard below), so the
 * ordinary session pays exactly nothing. A composer, once added, costs its pass on every frame
 * of every session forever.
 *
 * ## Why it cannot affect anything but the picture (brief §5 / §11)
 *
 * It is `pointer-events: none`, it holds no state the game reads, and it lives outside the R3F
 * tree entirely — there is no path from here to a raycast, a collider, the camera or an input
 * handler. It is also mounted INSIDE Three/Scene.tsx's `z-background` wrapper, below every HUD
 * tier, so the UI, the shop and every modal stay in full colour and full contrast on top of a
 * black-and-white world. That is deliberate: a greyed-out button reads as disabled.
 *
 * ## Ordering against everything else that owns the screen (brief §13)
 *
 * The recovery is a few seconds long and worth watching, so it does not start until the island is
 * actually watchable — the player is on the island (not in the shop, the house or the dressing
 * room) and no onboarding surface is up. In practice that means it begins the moment the returning
 * player closes 「歡迎回到島上」, which is the best seat in the house; without the gate it would run
 * its whole course behind that very panel and be missed. Once running it never pauses, because a
 * recovery that stalls when you open a menu is one the player can strand.
 */

/**
 * How far the cleared circle reaches at full bloom, as a percentage of the gradient's radius.
 *
 * Past 100 on purpose: a `circle` gradient's percentages are measured to the farthest corner, so
 * 100 is exactly enough and 108 is exactly enough plus a margin against rounding. The margin is
 * what guarantees the last frame is a true no-op rather than a hairline of desaturation left in
 * the corners at the moment the element is removed.
 */
const VEIL_SPREAD = 108;

/** The soft edge of the bloom at its narrowest — the first speck of colour, in gradient percent. */
const VEIL_FEATHER_MIN = 5;

/** How much wider that soft edge grows as the bloom opens out. */
const VEIL_FEATHER_SPAN = 26;

/**
 * Where the colour comes back from: slightly below the middle of the screen.
 *
 * The camera orbits the island at a fixed pitch, so the island itself always sits a little under
 * centre while the sky takes the top of the frame. Blooming from the geometric middle would start
 * the recovery in the sky, which reads as a light turning on; starting it here reads as the colour
 * coming back out of the island — which is the sentence the whole feature is trying to say.
 */
const VEIL_ORIGIN = '50% 56%';

/**
 * 恢復演示 — one mounted recovery, from the arrival state to full colour.
 *
 * Keyed on the recovery's token by its parent, so an admin pressing a second preset gets a clean
 * instance rather than a half-finished animation being re-aimed.
 */
function ColourVeilLayer({ hours, play }: { hours: number; play: boolean }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  /** When the recovery actually began. Latched, so losing `play` mid-flight cannot restart it. */
  const startedRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;

    /**
     * Writes a resolved state to the element.
     *
     * Both values are quantised and compared against the last write, so a frame that has not
     * moved the effect by a visible amount touches no style at all. That matters more than it
     * looks: a `backdrop-filter` change is free (the compositor re-runs it every frame regardless)
     * but a new `mask-image` string makes the browser re-rasterise a full-screen gradient, and
     * doing that sixty times a second for six seconds is the one part of this that could be felt.
     * At these step sizes the mask is redrawn a few dozen times across the whole animation, and
     * the gradient's own soft edge hides every step.
     */
    let lastSaturation = -1;
    let lastClear = -2;
    const paint = (colour: IslandColourState) => {
      const saturation = Math.round(colour.saturation * 200) / 200;
      if (saturation !== lastSaturation) {
        lastSaturation = saturation;
        const filter = `saturate(${saturation})`;
        // Through setProperty for the vendor-prefixed form, which is what Safari still reads and
        // what CSSStyleDeclaration has no typed member for.
        el.style.setProperty('backdrop-filter', filter);
        el.style.setProperty('-webkit-backdrop-filter', filter);
      }

      // -1 is 「no mask at all」, which is a different thing from 「a mask with a zero-width hole」
      // and has to survive the comparison as its own value — otherwise the first frame of the
      // bloom quantises to 0, matches the held state, and the mask is never applied.
      const clear = colour.bloom <= 0 ? -1 : Math.round(colour.bloom * VEIL_SPREAD * 4) / 4;
      if (clear !== lastClear) {
        lastClear = clear;
        const mask =
          clear < 0
            ? 'none'
            : `radial-gradient(circle at ${VEIL_ORIGIN}, transparent ${clear}%, #000 ${
                clear + VEIL_FEATHER_MIN + colour.bloom * VEIL_FEATHER_SPAN
              }%)`;
        el.style.setProperty('mask-image', mask);
        el.style.setProperty('-webkit-mask-image', mask);
      }
    };

    // Where the effect is right now, written in a layout effect so it is on the element before the
    // browser paints the frame this component appeared on. A returning player must never see one
    // frame of full colour before the world drains — that reads as a bug, not as an absence.
    //
    // It has to be the CURRENT state and not the arrival state, because this effect also re-runs
    // mid-recovery whenever `play` changes — which it does every time the player steps into the
    // shop or the house and back out. Painting the arrival state there would slam the frame back
    // to fully drained for exactly one frame, on the frame they return to the island.
    paint(
      resolveIslandColour(
        hours,
        startedRef.current === null ? null : (performance.now() - startedRef.current) / 1000,
      ),
    );

    // Held: either the admin is inspecting a level, or the island is not watchable yet. No
    // animation frame is requested at all, so holding costs one composited layer and no CPU.
    if (!play && startedRef.current === null) return;

    if (startedRef.current === null) startedRef.current = performance.now();
    const startedAt = startedRef.current;

    let raf = 0;
    const tick = () => {
      const colour = resolveIslandColour(hours, (performance.now() - startedAt) / 1000);
      paint(colour);
      // Both terms land on neutral together (see resolveIslandColour), so unmounting here changes
      // nothing on screen — the effect is already a no-op by the time the element goes.
      if (colour.done) {
        setDone(true);
        return;
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [hours, play]);

  if (done) return null;

  return <div ref={ref} aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none" />;
}

/**
 * Decides whether there is a recovery to draw, and when it is allowed to begin.
 *
 * Mounted by Three/Scene.tsx inside the island's own wrapper. Renders nothing — not a hidden
 * element, nothing — for every session that has not just come back from a long absence, which is
 * almost all of them.
 */
export function IslandColourVeil() {
  const { islandRecovery, currentView } = useApp();
  const onboarding = useOnboardingActive();

  // The same 「is the island on screen」 test <Scene> uses to park its frameloop, for the same
  // reason: everything else is a full-screen view with the island behind it.
  const covered = currentView !== View.HOME && currentView !== View.BUILD_MODE;

  if (!islandRecovery) return null;
  // The one guard for the whole feature. An absence too short to be worth showing produces no
  // element, no animation frame and no compositing pass — see COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN.
  if (colourDrainForHours(islandRecovery.hours) < COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN) return null;

  return (
    <ColourVeilLayer
      key={islandRecovery.token}
      hours={islandRecovery.hours}
      play={islandRecovery.play && !covered && !onboarding}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { Compass, Hammer, Home, Move } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { getItemById } from '../../constants/items';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { describeRecentFailure } from '../../lib/saveStatus';
import { QVersionIcon } from '../QVersionIcon';
import { PlacementDock } from './PlacementDock';
import { FloatingPanelPortal } from './FloatingPanelPortal';
import { facingLabel } from './HomePanel';

/**
 * The island editing dock — the single piece of chrome for whatever is being sited outdoors.
 *
 * One dock for all three subjects (a newly bought object, a placed object clicked in the world,
 * the Home itself), because they are one session: drag to move, R or 旋轉 to turn, 確認 to keep,
 * 取消 to drop it. See context/useIslandEditor.ts.
 *
 * ## Why it moved to the bottom
 *
 * It used to be a bar pinned to the TOP of the screen, while the house's placement controls sat
 * bottom-centre. Same session, same verbs, opposite edges — so a player who had furnished a room
 * arrived out here and had to find 確認 again. Both are now the shared `PlacementDock`
 * (UI/PlacementDock.tsx), bottom-centre, in the same order, with the same live verdict.
 *
 * The top anchor existed to stay clear of the NavBar and the old build rail, and both reasons are
 * gone: the build rail's tools hide themselves while a draft is running (BuildModeOverlay), and
 * App.tsx retires the NavBar for the same reason — while you are holding something, the bottom of
 * the screen belongs to putting it down, not to leaving.
 *
 * ## Why 更換房屋外觀 is no longer here
 *
 * This dock used to carry an 外觀 key and own the style picker, which made repainting a house
 * something you could only do from INSIDE a move — the player had to pick the building up to
 * change its colour. It was also two kinds of confirm in one panel: `applyHouseStyle` writes
 * straight through while the transform is still a draft, so 取消 undid the move and kept the
 * paint. Appearance now lives with the rest of house management (UI/HomePanel.tsx), and this dock
 * is back to one job — 「你正拿著一個東西，把它放下」 — for all three subjects alike.
 */
export function IslandEditorOverlay() {
  const {
    currentView, islandDraft, isDraftBlocked, draftBlockMessage, showIslandAlert,
    rotateDraft, cancelDraft, commitDraft, retrieveDraftTarget,
  } = useApp();

  /**
   * Every button here that persists something reports when it didn't.
   *
   * These used to be `void commitDraft()` / `void retrieveDraftTarget()` — the boolean each of
   * them returns was thrown away, so a write the server refused left the dock exactly as it was
   * and said nothing. The 3D ghost's double-click path already alerted on a failed commit; this
   * dock offers the same verbs and has to answer for them the same way, or the player's read is
   * "the 確認 button is broken".
   */
  const persist = (run: () => Promise<boolean>) => {
    void run().then((ok) => {
      if (!ok) showIslandAlert(describeRecentFailure());
    });
  };

  const isIslandView = currentView === View.HOME || currentView === View.BUILD_MODE;
  if (!islandDraft || !isIslandView) return null;

  const item = islandDraft.itemId ? getItemById(islandDraft.itemId) : null;
  const isHome = islandDraft.kind === 'home';
  const isMove = islandDraft.kind === 'move';

  const act = (action: () => void) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    triggerHaptic('light');
    action();
  };

  return (
    <FloatingPanelPortal>
      <PlacementDock
        icon={isHome ? <Home size={24} strokeWidth={2.5} /> : <QVersionIcon itemId={islandDraft.itemId || ''} size={40} />}
        badge={isHome ? '移動與轉向' : isMove ? '移動中' : '擺放中'}
        badgeIcon={isMove || isHome ? <Move size={11} strokeWidth={3} /> : <Hammer size={11} strokeWidth={3} />}
        title={isHome ? '我的家' : item?.name || '擺設'}
        // Which way the door ends up pointing, live, for the one subject where that is a fact the
        // player came here to change. It is the same reading 我的家 shows on its dial, so 旋轉
        // stops being a button you press to find out what it does. Ordinary objects get no such
        // chip: a fountain has no front.
        // The compass glyph carries the noun, measured rather than guessed: DockStatus wraps its
        // badge row inside a ~160px column, and 移動與轉向 already spends 96px of it, so anything
        // longer than the bearing itself drops onto a second line and pushes 我的家 down. 我的家's
        // own dial spells out 大門朝向 in full; here the tooltip does.
        meta={isHome ? (
          <span
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft"
            title="大門朝向"
          >
            <Compass size={11} strokeWidth={3} />
            {facingLabel(islandDraft.rotation)}
          </span>
        ) : undefined}
        // The blocked verdict is the only thing this dock volunteers, and it has to: it is the
        // explanation for 確認 having gone dead, and the island has four different ways to say no
        // (see PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MESSAGE). How to drag and rotate is the 小天使's line, not a
        // permanent caption.
        note={isDraftBlocked ? { tone: 'blocked', label: '無法放置', detail: draftBlockMessage } : null}
        onRotate={() => act(rotateDraft)}
        onRetrieve={isMove ? () => act(() => persist(retrieveDraftTarget)) : undefined}
        retrieveTitle="收回這個擺設，庫存會加回一件"
        onConfirm={() => act(() => persist(commitDraft))}
        confirmDisabled={isDraftBlocked}
        confirmTitle={draftBlockMessage ?? undefined}
        onCancel={() => act(cancelDraft)}
      />
    </FloatingPanelPortal>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/IslandReturnPanel.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { CalendarDays, Leaf, PawPrint, Sprout, Sunrise } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { ONBOARDING_MODAL_CLASS, useOnboardingSlot } from '../../lib/onboardingQueue';
import { COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN, colourDrainForHours } from '../../constants/islandReturn';
import { Button, ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader, StatTile } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * 回歸事件 — what a player is told when they come back after a few days away.
 *
 * The view half of 離線回歸; every word and every threshold it draws comes from
 * constants/islandReturn.ts, and the event itself is resolved once at arrival
 * (context/useIslandLife.ts). This component decides nothing.
 *
 * ## What it is careful not to be
 *
 * It is a welcome, not a report card. It never counts the days the player missed, never uses the
 * word 「懲罰」 or its polite cousins, and never opens with what went wrong — because nothing did.
 * The only numbers on it are how long the island was on its own and what grew in that time, both
 * of which are things to look at rather than things to fix. The one call to action is 「去看看」,
 * which closes the panel and gives them their island back.
 *
 * It also only appears at all past the 「數天」 threshold (`OfflineStageDef.greets`). A player who
 * was away overnight is not returning from anywhere, and being greeted for it would turn a quiet
 * world into one that notices when you leave.
 */
export function IslandReturnPanel() {
  const { islandReturn, dismissIslandReturn } = useApp();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  // Opened by the arrival, not by a render: `islandReturn` is set once, at profile load, and stays
  // set until it is dismissed. Mirroring it into local state is what lets the exit animation play
  // — clearing the context value straight away would unmount the panel mid-fade.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!islandReturn) return;
    setIsOpen(true);
    playSound(SoundEffect.REWARD, 0.25);
  }, [islandReturn]);

  const handleClose = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setIsOpen(false);
    dismissIslandReturn();
  };

  const onScreen = useOnboardingSlot('islandReturn', isOpen && !!islandReturn);
  useEscapeToClose(handleClose, onScreen);

  if (!islandReturn) return null;

  // Days, and never a smaller unit. An absence measured in hours invites the player to read it as
  // a clock they are being held to; 「大約 5 天」 reads as weather.
  const away = islandReturn.days >= 1 ? `約 ${islandReturn.days} 天` : '不到一天';

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {onScreen && (
        <ModalOverlay className={ONBOARDING_MODAL_CLASS} onClick={handleClose}>
          <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-md" className="max-h-[90vh]">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={<Sprout size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              title="歡迎回到島上"
              subtitle="這段時間，島嶼自己生活了一陣子"
              onClose={handleClose}
            />

            <div className="p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-island-navy leading-relaxed">
                  {islandReturn.line}
                </p>

                <StatTile
                  icon={<CalendarDays size={18} />}
                  label="離開了"
                  value={away}
                  accent="teal"
                />

                {/* The growth list is a wrapping row of chips rather than a second StatTile: a
                    StatTile's value is one truncating line, and 「落葉 x5・雜草 x3・藤蔓 x2」 is
                    exactly the kind of string that would lose its tail there. */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-line p-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Leaf size={14} className="text-island-teal shrink-0" />
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft/70 uppercase tracking-widest">
                      島上的變化
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {islandReturn.summary ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {islandReturn.summary.split('・').map((entry) => (
                        <span
                          key={entry}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-island-sand border border-island-line text-[11px] font-black text-island-navy"
                        >
                          {entry}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft">一切如常</span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {islandReturn.petLine && (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-island-sand border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3">
                    <PawPrint size={16} className="text-island-teal shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy leading-relaxed">
                      {islandReturn.petLine}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* 離線褪色 — one line, and only when there is actually something to explain.
                    The recovery starts the moment this panel closes (see UI/IslandColourVeil), so
                    this is the sentence that tells the player what they are about to watch. It is
                    gated on the same threshold the veil is, read from the same function, so the
                    copy cannot promise a recovery the screen is not going to play. */}
                {colourDrainForHours(islandReturn.hours) >= COLOUR_MIN_DRAIN && (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-island-sand border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3">
                    <Sunrise size={16} className="text-island-teal shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy leading-relaxed">
                      島上的顏色淡了一些 —— 你回來了，它正在慢慢恢復。
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* The whole of the "what do I do about it" copy. Two sentences, and both of them
                    say that it is optional — the island is not waiting on a chore list. */}
                <p className="text-[11px] text-island-navy-soft leading-relaxed">
                  走到長出東西的地方，按下互動鍵就能整理。想放著也沒關係，什麼都不會消失。
                </p>

                <Button onClick={handleClose} className="w-full py-4 text-lg">
                  去看看
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </ModalShell>
        </ModalOverlay>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/IslandTidy.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Sprout } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { Toast } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * 整理 — the one thing the player does about 離線環境變化.
 *
 * Mounted beside PettingMiniGame in the bottom-centre HUD region and built the same way: the
 * floating badge (UI/InteractionPrompt.tsx) and the E key (Three/Avatar.tsx) both just dispatch
 * `island-tidy`, and the feature that owns the write owns the whole of what happens next. The two
 * triggers therefore cannot drift apart, and neither of them has to know that tidying is a save.
 *
 * ## Why there is no reward
 *
 * Deliberate, and the single most important line in this file. Paying for tidying would turn a
 * pleasant thing to do into a thing the player is behind on — and would make being away from the
 * island a way to farm it, which is the exact inversion of a system whose whole premise is that
 * nothing is lost by leaving. The payoff for coming back is that the island is yours to put right.
 *
 * ## Why the failure case says something
 *
 * `tidyIslandAt` returns how many pieces went, and a refused write returns zero after rolling the
 * optimistic removal back — so a player on a broken connection watches the weeds reappear. Saying
 * so, quietly, is the difference between a save problem and a button that does not work: the same
 * reasoning as the 管理員數值調整 buttons (components/UI/AdminValueControls.tsx).
 */
export function IslandTidy() {
  const { currentView, tidyIslandAt } = useApp();
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ text: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);
  /** Guards a double-fire — a tap on the badge and the E key can land in the same tick. */
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const announce = useCallback((text: string, ok: boolean) => {
    setToast({ text, ok });
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2600);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onTidy = async () => {
      if (busyRef.current) return;
      const target = playerBus.tidyTarget;
      if (!target) return;
      busyRef.current = true;
      try {
        const removed = await tidyIslandAt(target.x, target.z);
        if (removed > 0) {
          playSound(SoundEffect.SUCCESS, 0.3);
          triggerHaptic('light');
          announce(`整理好了 ×${removed}`, true);
        } else {
          announce('這次沒有存檔成功，等一下再試試', false);
        }
      } finally {
        busyRef.current = false;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('island-tidy', onTidy);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('island-tidy', onTidy);
  }, [tidyIslandAt, announce]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
    },
    [],
  );

  if (currentView !== View.HOME) return null;

  return (
    <div className="relative z-hud-topbar pointer-events-none flex flex-col items-center">
      <Toast visible={!!toast} accent={toast?.ok ? 'teal' : 'coral'} position="inline">
        <Sprout size={16} />
        <span>{toast?.text}</span>
      </Toast>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { Check, Coins, Lock, PackageOpen, ShoppingBag, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { getBalance } from '../../constants/currency';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { ItemDefinition } from '../../constants/items';
import { getAvailableStock, getOwnedCount, isStackableItem } from '../../utils/inventory';
import { getXpRemaining, getXpRequirement, isXpLocked } from '../../utils/unlock';
import { canUnlockWithFragments, getRaffleTickets } from '../../constants/fragments';
import { getItemById } from '../../constants/items';
import { FragmentShard, RaffleTicket } from './FragmentProgress';
import { Button } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * The two pieces of shop vocabulary every catalog surface shares.
 *
 * The shop grid, the outdoor build rail and the indoor furniture drawer all lay their cards out
 * differently — a big product tile, a compact rail tile, a wide list row — but a player must be
 * able to read "how many do I have left" and "what does another cost" the same way in all three.
 * Those two answers live here, so a new surface gets them right by using them rather than by
 * re-deriving counts and re-writing the copy.
 */

/**
 * Live stock readout. Placeable items show what is left to put down (stock is `owned − placed`,
 * see utils/inventory.ts); applied items (floors, walls, house appearances) just say 已解鎖,
 * because owning one is the whole story. Not-yet-owned items render nothing — the buy button
 * beside them already says so.
 */
export function StockBadge({ itemId, className = '' }: { itemId: string; className?: string }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();

  // 抽獎券 reports the BALANCE it pays into, not an inventory count — buying one adds to
  // `raffleTickets` and puts nothing in the backpack (constants/items.ts's `grantsTickets`), so
  // `getOwnedCount` is 0 for it forever and the badge below would never appear. 「我手上有幾張」
  // is the only question this card can be asked, and this is the one place every catalog surface
  // asks it.
  const tickets = getItemById(itemId)?.grantsTickets;
  if (tickets) {
    const held = getRaffleTickets(profile);
    return (
      <span
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-island-gold/35 bg-island-gold/12 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy ${className}`}
        title="目前持有的抽獎券。買下後直接加進這個數字，不會放進背包"
      >
        <RaffleTicket size={11} />
        持有 {held.toLocaleString()} 張
      </span>
    );
  }

  const owned = getOwnedCount(profile, itemId);
  if (owned === 0) return null;

  if (!isStackableItem(itemId)) {
    return (
      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-island-teal/20 bg-island-teal/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-island-teal-dark ${className}`}>
        <Check size={11} strokeWidth={3} />
        已解鎖
      </span>
    );
  }

  const available = getAvailableStock(profile, itemId);
  const isEmpty = available === 0;

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black ${
        isEmpty
          ? 'border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 text-island-navy-soft/70'
          : 'border-island-teal/20 bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal-dark'
      } ${className}`}
      title={isEmpty ? '已全部擺放，再購買一個才能繼續擺放' : undefined}
    >
      <PackageOpen size={11} strokeWidth={2.75} />
      庫存 {available}
      <span className="opacity-60">/ 已擁有 {owned}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Buy action. Reads 購買 the first time and 再購買 afterwards for anything that stacks, which is
 * what lets a player who wants a second fountain say so from wherever they noticed they wanted
 * it. Own-once items disable themselves once owned instead of offering a purchase that would be
 * refused.
 *
 * An 經驗值-unlocked item (utils/unlock.ts) takes the same button rather than a separate one: it
 * states the requirement while it is locked and turns into 免費解鎖 once the player reaches it, so
 * every card on the shelf still answers "what do I do with this" in the same place.
 *
 * 碎片解鎖 (constants/fragments.ts) is the same story a third time. Once a stack is full the button
 * says so INSTEAD of quoting a gold price, and — this is the part that matters — it stops being
 * disabled by 金幣不足: a player who collected 200 fragments has earned the item outright, and a
 * greyed-out button would be the shop refusing something it is not charging for. The gold route is
 * still offered inside the dialog for anyone who would rather keep the fragments.
 */
export function BuyButton({
  item,
  onClick,
  className = '',
}: {
  item: ItemDefinition;
  onClick: () => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const owned = getOwnedCount(profile, item.id) > 0;
  const stackable = isStackableItem(item.id);
  const cannotAfford = getBalance(profile, 'coins') < item.price;
  const alreadyOwnedOnce = owned && !stackable;
  const xpRequired = getXpRequirement(item);
  const locked = isXpLocked(profile, item);
  const fragmentReady = canUnlockWithFragments(profile, item.id, owned);

  return (
    <Button
      variant={alreadyOwnedOnce || locked ? 'ghost' : 'primary'}
      disabled={alreadyOwnedOnce || locked || (cannotAfford && !fragmentReady)}
      onClick={onClick}
      title={
        locked
          ? `還差 ${getXpRemaining(profile, item)} 經驗值才能解鎖`
          : fragmentReady
            ? '碎片已集滿，可免費解鎖'
            : cannotAfford
              ? '金幣不足'
              : undefined
      }
      className={`gap-1.5 ${className}`}
    >
      {alreadyOwnedOnce ? (
        <>
          <Check size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
          <span>已擁有</span>
        </>
      ) : locked ? (
        <>
          <Lock size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
          <span>需 {xpRequired} 經驗值</span>
        </>
      ) : xpRequired > 0 ? (
        <>
          <Sparkles size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} />
          <span>免費解鎖</span>
        </>
      ) : fragmentReady ? (
        <>
          <FragmentShard size={14} />
          <span>碎片解鎖</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ShoppingBag size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} />
          <span>{owned ? '再購買' : '購買'}</span>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 opacity-90">
            <Coins size={12} className="text-island-gold" />
            {item.price}
          </span>
        </>
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

```

## src/components/UI/LightSwitchPrompt.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { LampCeiling, Lightbulb } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { useIsTouchDevice } from '../../hooks/useIsTouchDevice';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { interiorLights, subscribeInteriorLights } from '../../lib/interiorLights';
import { triggerHaptic } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { HintBubble } from './DesignKit';
import { PROMPT_SAFE_MARGIN } from '../../constants/hudLayout';

/**
 * 站在牆上電燈開關前面時，浮在它上面的「Q 關燈」方框。
 *
 * ## 為什麼是自己一個元件，而不是 InteractionPrompt 的又一個分支
 *
 * 它一開始就是那樣寫的，而那是錯的。那個徽章是「E 這一格」：它從一堆候選人裡挑最近的一個，因為
 * 玩家只有一個動作鍵，同時給兩個東西就是一次他看不見的擲硬幣。開關按的是 Q，所以它根本不在那場
 * 競爭裡 —— 而排進去的代價是：房裡只要有任何一件家具離你更近，開關的徽章就永遠不會出現，玩家
 * 會合理地以為那面牆上沒有開關。兩個徽章、兩個鍵、互不遮蔽，才是這件事真正的形狀。
 *
 * 位置的來源同樣是 Canvas 裡的 InteractionPromptTracker（只有它看得到鏡頭和場景，才問得出
 * 「有沒有被牆擋住」），透過 playerBus.lightSwitchPrompt 傳過來，這裡每幀輪詢並直接寫
 * transform —— 跟 InteractionPrompt 是同一套做法，位置不經過 React state。
 *
 * ## 字為什麼是「關燈」而不是「電燈開關」
 *
 * 徽章寫的是接下來會發生什麼，不是這是什麼。這跟家具的徽章寫「坐下」而不是「使用 沙發」是同一
 * 條規則。燈的狀態用訂閱而不是輪詢：它一次按鍵才變一次，是低頻率的事件，而位置才是每幀的事。
 */
export function LightSwitchPrompt() {
  const isTouch = useIsTouchDevice();
  const { currentView, isWorkoutActive } = useApp();
  const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [lightsOn, setLightsOn] = useState(interiorLights.on);

  // 燈的狀態：按一下才動一次，所以用訂閱。初始值再讀一次，是因為玩家可能是關著燈離開房子、
  // 再走回來的 —— 那盞燈的狀態活過離開（見 lib/interiorLights.ts），而這個元件沒有。
  useEffect(() => {
    setLightsOn(interiorLights.on);
    return subscribeInteriorLights(setLightsOn);
  }, []);

  // 位置每幀直接寫 transform，只有「看不看得見」進 React state —— 那是唯一需要重繪的東西。
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf: number;
    const tick = () => {
      const p = playerBus.lightSwitchPrompt;
      if (wrapperRef.current && p) {
        const x = Math.min(Math.max(p.x, PROMPT_SAFE_MARGIN.left), window.innerWidth - PROMPT_SAFE_MARGIN.right);
        const y = Math.min(Math.max(p.y, PROMPT_SAFE_MARGIN.top), window.innerHeight - PROMPT_SAFE_MARGIN.bottom);
        wrapperRef.current.style.transform = `translate3d(${x}px, ${y}px, 0)`;
      }
      setVisible(!!p && p.visible);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, []);

  // 開關只存在於室內，所以這個徽章也是。島上那個 tracker 從來不寫這一格（見
  // Three/InteractionPromptTracker.tsx），這裡的檢查是第二道，讓它在任何情況下都不會跑到屋外。
  if (currentView !== View.BUILDING_INTERIOR || isWorkoutActive) return null;

  const label = lightsOn ? '關燈' : '開燈';
  const Icon = lightsOn ? LampCeiling : Lightbulb;
  const onActivate = () => {
    triggerHaptic('light');
    // 派事件而不是走 triggerExternalAction：那條路上有一個「附近沒有家具就什麼都不做」的守門
    // （見 Three/Avatar.tsx），而開關不是家具。聲音由 Avatar 那邊發，所以點徽章跟按 Q 聽起來
    // 完全一樣。
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lightswitch-toggle'));
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={wrapperRef}
      className="fixed top-0 left-0 z-hud-toolbar pointer-events-none will-change-transform"
    >
      <div className="-translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-full flex flex-col items-center">
        <AnimatePresence>
          {visible && (
            <motion.button
              key="lightswitch-prompt"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.85 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.85 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: 'easeOut' }}
              whileHover={{ y: -2 }}
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.94 }}
              onClick={onActivate}
              className="pointer-events-auto flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer group"
            >
              <HintBubble
                nub="arrow"
                className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2.5 group-hover:shadow-[0_8px_26px_rgba(38,70,83,0.24)] transition-shadow"
              >
                {isTouch ? (
                  <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-island-teal flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_2px_6px_rgba(38,70,83,0.2)] flex-shrink-0">
                    <Icon size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} className="text-white" />
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center font-mono border border-island-line shadow-[0_2px_6px_rgba(38,70,83,0.12)] text-sm text-island-navy flex-shrink-0">
                    Q
                  </span>
                )}
                <span className="text-island-navy text-sm whitespace-nowrap">{label}</span>
              </HintBubble>
            </motion.button>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/LoadingScreen.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { Home, Sprout } from 'lucide-react';

interface LoadingScreenProps {
  onComplete?: () => void;
  isFirebaseReady?: boolean; // Maintain fallback backward compatibility with App.tsx
  
  // Suggested specifications from the user
  progress?: number;
  message?: string;
  isVisible?: boolean;
}

export function LoadingScreen({
  onComplete,
  isFirebaseReady = false,
  progress,
  message,
  isVisible = true
}: LoadingScreenProps) {
  /**
   * Stage-based genuine loading milestones.
   *
   * Every one of these must be something the BROWSER settles on its own. There used to be a
   * fourth, `assets`, which waited on `new Image()` pointed at a 1920px Unsplash photo — and the
   * photo had already stopped being rendered when this screen's background became a CSS gradient,
   * so the only thing it still did was hold the bar. An image load has no timeout: if the host is
   * slow neither `onload` nor `onerror` ever fires, the bar sticks at its 95% cap (see the cap in
   * the progress loop below), and the game never appears at all — measured at 9s on a network that
   * merely refuses the request, and unbounded on one that black-holes it.
   *
   * Nothing here may depend on a third party again. `document.fonts.ready` is safe because it is
   * the browser reporting on itself; `firebase` is gated by App.tsx, which is the auth layer this
   * screen is genuinely waiting for.
   */
  const [stageProgresses, setStageProgresses] = useState({
    dom: 50,      // Pre-initialized to 50% for standard initial boot
    fonts: 0,     // Web Fonts status via document.fonts.ready
    firebase: 0,  // Firebase Authentication & profile metadata synchronization
    warmup: 0     // Game loop/WebGL compiler warmup phase
  });

  // Animated progress state to ensure at least 3.5s elapsed duration
  const [animatedProgress, setAnimatedProgress] = useState(0);
  const [startTime] = useState(() => Date.now());

  // 1. Hook into actual resource events
  useEffect(() => {
    // Milestone A: DOM fully interactive
    const handleDOMLoaded = () => {
      setStageProgresses(prev => ({ ...prev, dom: 100 }));
    };
    if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') {
      handleDOMLoaded();
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', handleDOMLoaded);
    }

    // Milestone B: Web Fonts resources loaded via browser Native APIs
    if (document.fonts) {
      document.fonts.ready.then(() => {
        setStageProgresses(prev => ({ ...prev, fonts: 100 }));
      }).catch((err) => {
        console.warn('Font loading API check completed with error, resolving fallback.', err);
        setStageProgresses(prev => ({ ...prev, fonts: 100 }));
      });
    } else {
      // Browser doesn't support fonts.ready, resolve instantly
      setStageProgresses(prev => ({ ...prev, fonts: 100 }));
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', handleDOMLoaded);
    };
  }, []);

  // Milestone D: Sync Firebase profile updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFirebaseReady) {
      setStageProgresses(prev => ({ ...prev, firebase: 100 }));
    }
  }, [isFirebaseReady]);

  // Milestone E: Micro post-processing shader warming delay once all criteria are met
  useEffect(() => {
    const { dom, fonts, firebase } = stageProgresses;
    const coreEnginesReady = dom === 100 && fonts === 100 && firebase === 100;

    if (coreEnginesReady && stageProgresses.warmup === 0) {
      const warmupTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        setStageProgresses(prev => ({ ...prev, warmup: 100 }));
      }, 450);
      return () => clearTimeout(warmupTimeout);
    }
  }, [stageProgresses]);

  // Smooth progress bar calculation to guarantee exactly or at least 3.5 seconds run duration
  useEffect(() => {
    let animationFrameId: number;
    
    const updateProgress = () => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
      const duration = 3500; // 3.5 seconds minimum run duration
      
      // Continuous linear/exponential curve for progress
      const timePercent = Math.min((elapsed / duration) * 100, 100);
      
      // Determine if resources are truly complete
      const resourcesReady = isFirebaseReady && stageProgresses.warmup === 100;
      
      let targetVisual = timePercent;
      
      // If resources are slow, cap visual progress at 95% until they are ready
      if (!resourcesReady && targetVisual > 95) {
        targetVisual = 95;
      }
      
      setAnimatedProgress(prev => {
        // Guarantee progress only moves forwards
        return Math.max(prev, Math.round(targetVisual));
      });
      
      if (elapsed < duration || !resourcesReady || animatedProgress < 100) {
        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(updateProgress);
      }
    };
    
    animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(updateProgress);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
  }, [startTime, isFirebaseReady, stageProgresses, animatedProgress]);

  // Fallback to computed progress if custom progress prop is provided, otherwise use smooth animated progress
  const activeProgress = progress !== undefined ? progress : animatedProgress;

  // Fire completion callback only when we hit 100%
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeProgress >= 100 && isFirebaseReady && onComplete) {
      const completionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        onComplete();
      }, 500); // Sleek hold-on-complete for visual feedback and organic fading transition
      return () => clearTimeout(completionTimeout);
    }
  }, [activeProgress, isFirebaseReady, onComplete]);

  if (!isVisible) return null;

  // Sparkles Configuration for absolute floating starry aura
  const sparkles = [
    { id: 1, left: '12%', top: '20%', size: 14, delay: 0 },
    { id: 2, left: '22%', top: '55%', size: 10, delay: 1.5 },
    { id: 3, left: '78%', top: '15%', size: 12, delay: 0.5 },
    { id: 4, left: '88%', top: '65%', size: 16, delay: 2.2 },
    { id: 5, left: '46%', top: '25%', size: 8, delay: 1 },
    { id: 6, left: '56%', top: '10%', size: 12, delay: 2.8 },
    { id: 7, left: '30%', top: '35%', size: 10, delay: 0.2 },
    { id: 8, left: '70%', top: '45%', size: 14, delay: 1.8 },
    { id: 9, left: '8%', top: '68%', size: 8, delay: 3 },
    { id: 10, left: '92%', top: '28%', size: 10, delay: 0.8 },
    { id: 11, left: '40%', top: '15%', size: 14, delay: 2.4 },
    { id: 12, left: '82%', top: '80%', size: 8, delay: 1.2 }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-loading w-screen h-screen bg-island-cream-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-between select-none touch-none pointer-events-auto overflow-hidden">

      {/* 1. Flat island-teal sky fading to sand — replaces the old off-theme
          wooden-cabin photo background. The photo's `Image()` preload used to
          outlive it as the "assets" milestone; that is gone too, because a
          third-party download must never be what decides whether the game is
          allowed to appear (see the milestone list above). */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 z-0"
        style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-island-teal) 0%, var(--color-island-teal-light) 45%, var(--color-island-cream-2) 100%)' }}
      />

      {/* 2. Distant shoreline silhouette, echoes AuthScreen for continuity */}
      <svg className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full h-[22%] text-island-navy/15 pointer-events-none z-0" viewBox="0 0 400 60" preserveAspectRatio="none">
        <path d="M0,40 Q50,10 100,35 T200,30 T300,42 T400,25 L400,60 L0,60 Z" fill="currentColor" />
      </svg>

      {/* 3. Floating Glow & Sparkle Particles — teal/white instead of amber */}
      {sparkles.map((s) => (
        <motion.div
          key={s.id}
          className="absolute pointer-events-none z-10 text-white"
          style={{ left: s.left, top: s.top }}
          animate={{
            y: [0, -32, 0],
            opacity: [0, 0.9, 0],
            scale: [0.7, 1.3, 0.7]
          }}
          transition={{
            duration: 4.5,
            repeat: Infinity,
            delay: s.delay,
            ease: "easeInOut"
          }}
        >
          <svg style={{ width: s.size, height: s.size }} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
            <path d="M12,2 L15,9 L22,12 L15,15 L12,22 L9,15 L2,12 L9,9 Z" />
          </svg>
        </motion.div>
      ))}

      {/* Main Content Layout Container */}
      <div className="relative z-20 w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-10 select-none">

        {/* Subtle decorative header bar — both badges share one pill treatment so they read as a matched pair */}
        <div className="w-full flex justify-between items-center max-w-2xl opacity-90 flex-shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 bg-white/80 hover:bg-white cursor-default px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-island-line shadow-sm">
            <Home size={14} className="text-island-teal-dark" strokeWidth={2.5} />
            <span className="text-island-navy font-sans text-[11px] tracking-wider uppercase font-black">Fitness Island v1.2</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 bg-white/80 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-island-line shadow-sm">
            <span className="relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
              <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-island-teal-light opacity-75 animate-ping" />
              <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-island-teal border border-island-teal-dark" />
            </span>
            <span className="text-island-navy font-sans text-[11px] font-bold">海島伺服器連線中</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Mascot + loading panel form one centered group instead of being pinned to opposite
            screen edges, so the middle of the screen doesn't read as empty dead space */}
        <div className="flex-1 w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 md:gap-8">

        {/* 4. Q-Version Chibi Boat Mascot (小舟精靈) in the Central Stage */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
          {/* Glowing Aura Ring */}
          <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-36 h-36">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/40 rounded-full blur-2xl animate-pulse" />
            <div className="absolute inset-4 bg-island-teal-light/30 rounded-full blur-xl animate-ping" style={{ animationDuration: '3s' }} />

            {/* Bobbing Mascot Wrap */}
            <motion.div
              animate={{ y: [-8, 8, -8], rotate: [-3, 3, -3] }}
              transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 2.5, ease: "easeInOut" }}
              className="relative z-20 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="w-28 h-28 filter drop-shadow-[0_6px_10px_rgba(38,70,83,0.2)]">
                {/* Sail */}
                <path d="M50,14 L50,52 L26,50 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#264653" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                <path d="M50,14 L50,15" stroke="#264653" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />

                {/* Mast */}
                <path d="M50,14 L50,58" stroke="#264653" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />

                {/* Hull */}
                <path d="M22,58 C22,54 78,54 78,58 L70,78 C63,82 37,82 30,78 Z" fill="#2A9D8F" stroke="#1F7A70" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                <path d="M28,64 L72,64" stroke="#1F7A70" strokeWidth="1.4" opacity="0.6" />

                {/* Cute Arch Blushes */}
                <circle cx="38" cy="68" r="3.5" fill="#E8836A" opacity="0.7" />
                <circle cx="62" cy="68" r="3.5" fill="#E8836A" opacity="0.7" />

                {/* Angled arc happy eyes, not a flat squint */}
                <path d="M35,62 Q38,58 42,61" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2.2" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />
                <path d="M58,61 Q62,58 65,62" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2.2" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />

                {/* Sweet smile curve */}
                <path d="M46,71 Q50,74 54,71" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />

                {/* Wake ripple beneath hull */}
                <path d="M18,86 Q30,82 42,86 T66,86 T90,86" stroke="#5FBDAF" strokeWidth="2.5" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.6" />
              </svg>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 5. Bottom Loading Panel — flat white ticket card, dock-notch corner
            for consistency with the rest of the "Dock & Signpost" HUD. */}
        {/* Shadow is `.notch-shadow-lg` on the wrapper: a clip-path clips the
            element's own box-shadow away, so a `shadow-[...]` alongside
            `dock-notch` never renders (see index.css). */}
        <div className="w-full max-w-xl flex notch-shadow-lg">
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center space-y-5 bg-white dock-notch border-2 border-island-line p-6 md:p-8 rounded-[2.25rem]">

          {/* Header text container */}
          <div className="text-center space-y-1">
            {/* Loading Tagline (Loading 小標) - Hard Requirement */}
            <span className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-[0.2em] text-island-teal-dark uppercase bg-island-teal/10 border border-island-teal/25 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full inline-block shadow-sm animate-pulse">
              海島碼頭整理中
            </span>

            {/* Loading Main Title (Loading 主標題) - Hard Requirement */}
            <h2 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-black text-island-navy pt-1 tracking-wide">
              {activeProgress < 100 ? '正在校準羅盤與潮汐...' : '登島完成，歡迎回到海島！'}
            </h2>
          </div>

          {/* 6. Loading progress track — already on the island-teal system,
              kept untouched. */}
          <div className="relative w-full h-4.5 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-full border border-island-line shadow-[inset_0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] overflow-visible">

            {/* Progress Fill */}
            <motion.div
              className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-island-teal-light to-island-teal-dark rounded-full flex items-center justify-end shadow-[inset_0_1.5px_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.4)]"
              style={{ width: `${activeProgress}%` }}
              layout
              transition={{ ease: "easeOut", duration: 0.1 }}
            >
              {/* Internal diagonal stripes shimmer effect */}
              <div className="h-full w-full relative overflow-hidden rounded-full opacity-35">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/25 to-transparent animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite]" style={{ backgroundSize: '200% 100%' }} />
              </div>
            </motion.div>

            {/* 7. Cute sprouting rider — kept as the lucide Sprout icon so it
                still matches the hand-drawn icon language used elsewhere. */}
            <motion.div
              className="absolute top-1/2 -mt-4.5 w-9 h-9 bg-white/70 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transform -translate-x-1/2 z-20 pointer-events-none drop-shadow-sm border border-island-teal-light/40"
              style={{ left: `${activeProgress}%` }}
              animate={{ rotate: [0, 8, -8, 0], scale: [1, 1.1, 0.95, 1] }}
              transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 1.8, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            >
              <Sprout size={16} className="text-island-teal-dark" strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </motion.div>
          </div>

          {/* 8. Bottom Checkpoint Milestone Texts & Progress Indicator */}
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center w-full px-1 text-island-navy text-[11px] font-sans font-black">
            <span className="bg-island-teal/8 border border-island-teal/25 text-island-teal-dark px-3 py-1 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
              載入進度：{activeProgress}%
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
                <span className="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 bg-island-teal-light animate-ping" />
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-island-teal" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-island-navy font-bold">
                {activeProgress < 20 ? '正在喚醒海風與浪花...' :
                 activeProgress < 40 ? '正在打掃碼頭木棧板...' :
                 activeProgress < 65 ? '正在繫緊船帆與纜繩...' :
                 activeProgress < 85 ? '正在引導 Firebase 安全登入...' :
                 activeProgress < 100 ? '正在調整鏡頭俯仰角度氣氛...' :
                 '載入成功，進入畫面。'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
        </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/LoginBonusPopup.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * ⚠️ 這個檔案目前**沒有被掛載**。全樹沒有任何一處 import 它。
 *
 * 每日登入獎勵現在是七天的板子（UI/DailyLoginPanel.tsx），它接手了同一條 `subscribeLoginBonus`
 * 通道，也接手了 onboarding 佇列裡的 `loginBonus` 名額。這一版是它之前的單一數字彈窗。
 *
 * 保留而不刪除的理由跟 UI/WeatherWidget.tsx 一樣，需要這段標註的理由也一樣。特別注意：它會訂閱
 * `subscribeLoginBonus` **並且消費掉通知**，所以把它掛回去會跟 DailyLoginPanel 搶同一則登入
 * 獎勵，變成兩個彈窗其中一個永遠不開。
 */
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { Calendar, Coins, Zap, Trophy } from 'lucide-react';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { vibrateGoalCompleted } from '../../lib/vibration';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { publishLoginBonus, subscribeLoginBonus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { ONBOARDING_MODAL_CLASS, useOnboardingSlot } from '../../lib/onboardingQueue';
import { ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader, Button, StatTile } from './DesignKit';

export function LoginBonusPopup() {
  const [bonusData, setBonusData] = useState<{ streak: number, gold: number, xp: number, isManual?: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);

  // Subscribed, not polled. This was a `setInterval(…, 500)` over
  // `playerBus.showLoginBonus`, which meant the reward could be granted up to
  // half a second before this popup knew about it — and in that gap
  // HomeSetupGuide took the first-run slot and opened, only to be displaced when
  // this caught up. See publishLoginBonus for the full note.
  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeLoginBonus((data) => {
      if (!data) return;
      setBonusData(data);
      setIsVisible(true);
      if (!data.isManual) {
        playSound(SoundEffect.REWARD);
        vibrateGoalCompleted();
      }
      // Consume it, so it doesn't show again this session.
      publishLoginBonus(null);
    });
  }, []);

  const handleClose = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setIsVisible(false);
  };

  // First in the first-run queue (lib/onboardingQueue.ts). It used to simply
  // render, which put its scrim under HomeSetupGuide's identical one — same
  // z-modal tier, later in the DOM wins — so 太棒了！ was covered by a
  // transparent layer belonging to another dialog and could not be clicked.
  const onScreen = useOnboardingSlot('loginBonus', isVisible && !!bonusData);

  // Escape follows what is actually on screen, not merely what is queued.
  useEscapeToClose(handleClose, onScreen);

  if (!bonusData) return null;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {onScreen && (
        <ModalOverlay className={ONBOARDING_MODAL_CLASS} onClick={handleClose}>
          <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-md" className="max-h-[90vh] md:max-h-[85vh]">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={<Trophy size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              title={bonusData.isManual ? '登入獎勵狀態' : '每日登入獎勵'}
              subtitle={bonusData.isManual ? '目前獎勵等級' : '歡迎回來！又是充滿活力的一天！'}
              onClose={handleClose}
            />

            {/* Scrollable Content */}
            <div className="p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                <StatTile
                  icon={<Calendar size={18} />}
                  label="連續登入天數"
                  value={<>{bonusData.streak} <span className="text-base">天</span></>}
                  accent="teal"
                />

                {/* Rewards Grid */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <StatTile
                    icon={<Coins size={18} />}
                    label={bonusData.isManual ? '下次獎勵' : '金幣'}
                    value={`+${bonusData.gold}`}
                    accent="gold"
                  />
                  <StatTile
                    icon={<Zap size={18} />}
                    label={bonusData.isManual ? '下次獎勵' : '經驗值'}
                    value={`+${bonusData.xp}`}
                    accent="teal"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Motivation message */}
                <p className="text-center text-island-navy-soft/70 font-bold italic text-xs">
                  連續登入天數越多，獲得的獎勵就越高！
                </p>

                <Button onClick={handleClose} className="w-full py-4 text-lg">
                  太棒了！
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </ModalShell>
        </ModalOverlay>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```
