## src/components/UI/PetFeeding.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Utensils, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { getItemById } from '../../constants/items';
import { FEED_PET_MESSAGES } from '../../context/usePetCare';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { startEating } from '../../lib/petActivity';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { HintBubble, Toast } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * 餵食 — the island half of the feeding flow, and the one place a feed actually happens.
 *
 * Mounted beside UI/IslandTidy.tsx in the bottom-centre HUD region and built exactly the same way,
 * because it is the same shape of thing: the floating badge (UI/InteractionPrompt.tsx) and the E key
 * (Three/Avatar.tsx) both just dispatch `pet-feed`, and the feature that owns the write owns the
 * whole of what happens next. The two triggers therefore cannot drift apart, and neither of them has
 * to know that feeding is a save.
 *
 * ## What is on screen, and what deliberately is not
 *
 * While a food is armed: one small line saying so, with a way out of it. That is all. There is no
 * hunger meter, no bowl icon over the animal, and no badge on the nav — the pet's condition is
 * legible from how it is behaving, and the numbers live behind a button in 我的寵物
 * (UI/PetCarePanel.tsx). See the brief's §14: the goal is a companion you notice, not a survival HUD.
 *
 * The line disappears the moment the feed lands, so the ordinary state of the screen — the one a
 * player is in almost all of the time — carries nothing from this feature at all.
 *
 * ## Why the failure case says something
 *
 * `feedPet` reports why it refused, and every reason is a sentence in FEED_PET_MESSAGES
 * (context/usePetCare.ts). A player whose save was rejected has to be told the food is still theirs,
 * or a bag that appears not to have been spent reads as a bag that was lost — the same reasoning
 * UI/IslandTidy.tsx gives for saying so when a tidy fails to persist.
 */
export function PetFeeding() {
  const { currentView, pendingPetFood, cancelPetFeeding, feedPet } = useApp();
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ text: string; ok: boolean } | null>(null);
  /** Guards a double-fire — a tap on the badge and the E key can land in the same tick. */
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const hideTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const announce = useCallback((text: string, ok: boolean) => {
    setToast({ text, ok });
    if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
    hideTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2800);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onFeed = async (event: Event) => {
      if (busyRef.current) return;
      /**
       * Two ways in, one handler.
       *
       * The interaction panel (UI/PetInteractionPanel.tsx) names both the food and the animal,
       * because the player picked a food while standing in front of a particular pet. The E key and
       * the floating badge name neither: they are the 「先選好飼料再走過去」 fast path, so the food is
       * whatever was armed and the animal is whichever one the prompt is pointing at
       * (`playerBus.petTargetId`). Both end up in the same call.
       */
      const detail = (event as CustomEvent<{ itemId?: string; petItemId?: string }>).detail;
      const itemId = detail?.itemId ?? pendingPetFood;
      const petItemId = detail?.petItemId ?? playerBus.petTargetId;
      if (!itemId) return;
      busyRef.current = true;
      try {
        const result = await feedPet(itemId, petItemId);
        if (result.ok) {
          // 進食 — started only now, on a save that was actually accepted (§20). An animation kicked
          // off at the click would have a pet happily eating a meal that failed to persist, which is
          // the same lie as spending the bag optimistically.
          //
          // It is an ACTIVITY now rather than a timestamp (lib/petActivity.ts): the owner bends to put
          // a bowl down, the animal walks over to it, eats until it is empty, and the bowl fades —
          // all drawn by Three/IslandPet.tsx. The avatar hears `pet-care-gesture` and crouches.
          startEating(result.petItemId);
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pet-care-gesture', {
            detail: { kind: 'feed', petItemId: result.petItemId },
          }));
          // What it ACTUALLY moved, not what the item promised: a nearly full bowl takes only the
          // room it has (see applyPetCareEffects), and a toast that reported the promise would be
          // telling the player something the animal did not experience.
          const gained = Math.round(result.delta.nutrition * 100);
          // The animal by name, because with more than one companion 「牠」 does not say which one
          // just ate. Falls back to 牠 for anything the catalog cannot name.
          const who = getItemById(result.petItemId)?.name ?? '牠';
          playSound(SoundEffect.SUCCESS, 0.3);
          triggerHaptic('light');
          announce(gained > 0 ? `${who}吃得很開心（營養 +${gained}%）` : `${who}開心地吃完了`, true);
        } else {
          announce(FEED_PET_MESSAGES[result.reason], false);
        }
      } finally {
        busyRef.current = false;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('pet-feed', onFeed);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('pet-feed', onFeed);
  }, [pendingPetFood, feedPet, announce]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (hideTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(hideTimer.current);
    },
    [],
  );

  if (currentView !== View.HOME) return null;

  const food = pendingPetFood ? getItemById(pendingPetFood) : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="relative z-hud-topbar pointer-events-none flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
      <AnimatePresence>
        {food && (
          <motion.div
            key="armed"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          >
            <HintBubble variant="solid" className="rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Utensils size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} className="flex-shrink-0" />
              <span className="text-xs font-black whitespace-nowrap">
                走到寵物旁邊，餵牠吃{food.name}
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                  cancelPetFeeding();
                }}
                className="pointer-events-auto w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-white/15 hover:bg-white/25 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors active:scale-90 flex-shrink-0"
                title="取消餵食"
              >
                <X size={13} strokeWidth={3} />
              </button>
            </HintBubble>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <Toast visible={!!toast} accent={toast?.ok ? 'teal' : 'coral'} position="inline">
        <Utensils size={16} />
        <span>{toast?.text}</span>
      </Toast>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/PetInteractionPanel.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { ChevronLeft, Hand, Home, PawPrint, ShoppingBag, Utensils, Volleyball } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { getItemById } from '../../constants/items';
import { getPetFoodsFor } from '../../constants/consumables';
import { PET_HABITAT_KINDS } from '../../constants/petHabitats';
import { getPetSpecies, PET_SPECIES_TABLE } from '../../constants/pets';
import { equippedPetId, readPetCondition } from '../../context/usePetCare';
import { resolveRestingSpot } from '../../lib/petRestingSpots';
import { usePlayerHome } from '../../hooks/usePlayerHome';
import { getAvailableStock } from '../../utils/inventory';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { QVersionIcon } from '../QVersionIcon';
import { Button, EmptyState, ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader } from './DesignKit';
import { CareMeter } from './PetCarePanel';

/**
 * 寵物互動面板 — what opens when the player walks up to their companion and presses the prompt.
 *
 * This is the brief's §14–§19 in one component, and it exists because the old feeding flow was
 * inside-out. Feeding used to start in a menu: open 我的寵物, pick a food, ARM it, walk to the
 * animal, press E. Five steps, three of them before you were anywhere near the pet, and the food
 * had to be chosen before you could see how hungry it was.
 *
 * The flow now starts where the player is already looking:
 *
 *   走近寵物 → [E] 與寵物互動 → 這個面板 → 餵食 → 選一種食物 → 完成
 *
 * ## What it deliberately is not
 *
 * It is NOT opened by proximity. §16 is explicit, and it is right: a panel that appears because you
 * walked past your dog is a panel that appears while you are trying to walk past your dog. Being
 * near the animal produces one small floating badge (UI/InteractionPrompt.tsx); this only opens
 * because the player asked it to.
 *
 * It is also not a second 我的寵物 (UI/PetCarePanel.tsx). That one is the shop-side screen — the
 * place to browse everything you could feed, including what you do not own — and it is where
 * arming a food for later still lives. This is the in-world one: the animal is in front of you, so
 * everything here acts on it immediately and everything you cannot do right now is absent.
 *
 * ## Which animal
 *
 * The one the prompt was pointing at, read off the bus (`playerBus.petTargetId`) at the moment the
 * panel opens and held for as long as it is open. Not re-read per render, and NOT resolved from the
 * profile: with more than one companion out, 「the pet」 is not a thing the profile can answer — the
 * only component that knows which animal the player walked up to is the one drawing it. That is
 * §21, and it is one field rather than a targeting system.
 */
export function PetInteractionPanel() {
  const { profile, currentView, setCurrentView } = useApp();
  const home = usePlayerHome(profile);

  /** The animal this panel is about, or null when it is closed. Opening captures it once. */
  const [petItemId, setPetItemId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  /** `home` — name, state, what you can do. `feed` — the food list. Never both at once. */
  const [view, setView] = useState<'home' | 'feed'>('home');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  /**
   * The clock the meters are read at. Sampled on open and whenever the save changes, never ticked —
   * 營養 moves by half a percent an hour, so a running timer would be a re-render a second to redraw
   * the same two bars. Same rule UI/PetCarePanel.tsx follows.
   */
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());

  const close = useCallback(() => {
    setPetItemId(null);
    setView('home');
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onInteract = () => {
      // The prompt's target first; the equipped companion as a fallback for any caller that opened
      // this without one in reach (there is none today, and a panel that opened empty would be a
      // dead end if one appeared).
      const target = playerBus.petTargetId ?? equippedPetId(profile);
      if (!target) return;
      playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
      setPetItemId(target);
      setView('home');
      setNow(Date.now());
    };
    window.addEventListener('pet-interact', onInteract);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('pet-interact', onInteract);
  }, [profile]);

  // A feed, an unequip or a purchase all land here as a new profile; re-reading the clock is what
  // makes the meters show the result of what just happened.
  useEffect(() => setNow(Date.now()), [profile?.islandState?.pet, profile?.inventory]);

  // Leaving the island closes it. A panel about an animal standing on the grass has nothing to say
  // from inside the house or the shop.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentView !== View.HOME) close();
  }, [currentView, close]);

  // The pet being put away while its panel is open — the one way this can be left pointing at an
  // animal that is no longer there.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (petItemId && !(profile?.equippedItems ?? []).includes(petItemId)) close();
  }, [petItemId, profile?.equippedItems, close]);

  const pet = petItemId ? getItemById(petItemId) : undefined;
  const species = getPetSpecies(petItemId);
  const speciesDef = species ? PET_SPECIES_TABLE[species] : undefined;
  const condition = readPetCondition(profile, petItemId, now);

  const restSpot = useMemo(
    () =>
      resolveRestingSpot({
        placements: profile?.islandPlacements ?? [],
        home,
        islandScale: 1 + ((profile?.territoryLevel ?? 1) - 1) * 0.4,
        petItemId,
      }),
    [profile?.islandPlacements, profile?.territoryLevel, home, petItemId],
  );

  /**
   * What this animal can be given, right now — §17's whole requirement, as one filter.
   *
   * Two narrowings, in this order and for different reasons. `getPetFoodsFor(species)` is
   * COMPATIBILITY: a dog is never shown birdseed, whether or not the player owns any, because
   * offering it and then refusing it is worse than never offering it. The stock filter is
   * POSSESSION: a food the player has run out of is not a choice, it is a disappointment — and the
   * empty state below is a better answer to 「我沒有食物」 than a list of greyed-out rows.
   *
   * (我的寵物 makes the opposite call and shows what you do not own, greyed, with where to get it.
   * That is a shop-side screen whose job includes teaching what exists; this one is a player
   * standing next to a hungry animal.)
   */
  const foods = useMemo(() => {
    if (!species) return [];
    return getPetFoodsFor(species).filter((food) => getAvailableStock(profile, food.id) > 0);
  }, [species, profile]);

  const handleFeed = useCallback(
    async (foodId: string) => {
      if (!petItemId || busy) return;
      setBusy(true);
      try {
        // Dispatched rather than written here, exactly as the E key and the floating badge do it:
        // the write, the sound, the 進食 animation and the toast all belong to the component that
        // owns feeding (UI/PetFeeding.tsx). A panel that called `feedPet` itself would be a second
        // place that has to remember to start the animation and say what happened.
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('pet-feed', { detail: { itemId: foodId, petItemId } }),
        );
        triggerHaptic('light');
        close();
      } finally {
        setBusy(false);
      }
    },
    [petItemId, busy, close],
  );

  const handlePet = useCallback(() => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    triggerHaptic('light');
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('start-pet-dog'));
    close();
  }, [close]);

  /**
   * 陪牠玩. Dispatched rather than started here, for the reason feeding is: the animal on the island
   * (Three/IslandPet.tsx) is the only thing that knows its species — and so whether it fetches,
   * pounces or swoops — and which way its owner is facing when the toy leaves the hand.
   */
  const handlePlay = useCallback(() => {
    if (!petItemId) return;
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    triggerHaptic('light');
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pet-play', { detail: { petItemId } }));
    close();
  }, [petItemId, close]);

  const goToShop = useCallback(() => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    // The same steer 更衣室 uses to send a player to the right rack (DressingRoomView): the shop
    // restores `last_selected_category` on open, so writing it is how one screen deep-links
    // another without the storefront growing a prop for every caller.
    localStorage.setItem('last_selected_category', 'PetSupplies');
    close();
    setCurrentView(View.SHOP);
  }, [close, setCurrentView]);

  const open = !!petItemId && !!pet && currentView === View.HOME;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <ModalOverlay onClick={close}>
          <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-md" className="max-h-[80vh]">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={
                view === 'feed' ? (
                  <Utensils size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                ) : (
                  <PawPrint size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                )
              }
              title={view === 'feed' ? `餵${pet!.name}` : pet!.name}
              subtitle={
                view === 'feed'
                  ? `只顯示${speciesDef?.label ?? ''}吃得到的食物`
                  : `${speciesDef?.label ?? '寵物'}・${condition.band.label}`
              }
              onClose={close}
            />

            <div className="p-5 md:p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
              {view === 'home' ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                      <QVersionIcon itemId={petItemId!} size={52} />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/80 leading-relaxed min-w-0">
                      {condition.band.note}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <CareMeter label="營養" value={condition.nutrition} />
                    <CareMeter label="活動力" value={condition.activity} />
                  </div>

                  {/* 休息處 — said here because this is where the player is standing when they
                      wonder about it, and because it is the one piece of this animal's state that a
                      purchase changes rather than food. A default spot says so plainly, so 「牠該有
                      個自己的窩」 is discoverable from the screen that made you ask. */}
                  <div className="rounded-2xl border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-4 py-3 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                    <Home size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} className="text-island-teal-dark flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-xs font-black text-island-navy">休息處：{restSpot.label}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 leading-relaxed mt-0.5">
                        {restSpot.kind
                          ? PET_HABITAT_KINDS[restSpot.kind].note
                          : `還沒有專屬的休息處，商店的「寵物窩」有適合${speciesDef?.label ?? '牠'}的款式。`}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Three actions, laid out as a grid so they share the width evenly at every size
                      and wrap to one column on a narrow phone. No absolute positioning anywhere in
                      this panel — see §22. */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                    <Button
                      variant="primary"
                      className="px-4 py-3 text-sm"
                      onClick={() => {
                        playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                        setView('feed');
                      }}
                    >
                      <Utensils size={16} strokeWidth={2.75} />
                      餵食
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="secondary" className="px-4 py-3 text-sm" onClick={handlePet}>
                      <Hand size={16} strokeWidth={2.75} />
                      摸摸{speciesDef?.companionNoun ?? '牠'}
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="secondary" className="px-4 py-3 text-sm" onClick={handlePlay}>
                      <Volleyball size={16} strokeWidth={2.75} />
                      陪牠玩
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {foods.length === 0 ? (
                    // §18 — never an empty feeding list. What the player is missing is said in
                    // their own terms, and the way out is offered without being taken for them:
                    // this opens the right shelf, it does not buy anything.
                    <EmptyState
                      icon={<Utensils size={28} strokeWidth={2} />}
                      title={`目前沒有適合${speciesDef?.label ?? '這隻寵物'}的食物`}
                      description={`${pet!.name}吃得到的飼料與零食都在商店的「寵物用品」裡，買了會放進背包，走回來就能餵牠。`}
                      action={
                        <Button variant="primary" className="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm" onClick={goToShop}>
                          <ShoppingBag size={15} strokeWidth={2.75} />
                          前往商店
                        </Button>
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    foods.map((food) => {
                      const stock = getAvailableStock(profile, food.id);
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={food.id}
                          className="rounded-2xl border border-island-line bg-white p-3 flex items-center gap-3"
                        >
                          <QVersionIcon itemId={food.id} size={44} />
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <p className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">
                              {food.name}
                              <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-black text-island-navy-soft/60 font-mono">
                                ×{stock}
                              </span>
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-teal-dark">
                              {food.consumable?.effectSummary}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <Button
                            variant="primary"
                            className="px-4 py-2.5 text-sm flex-shrink-0"
                            disabled={busy}
                            onClick={() => void handleFeed(food.id)}
                          >
                            {food.consumable?.verb ?? '餵食'}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })
                  )}

                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-xs"
                    onClick={() => {
                      playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                      setView('home');
                    }}
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
                    返回
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </ModalShell>
        </ModalOverlay>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/PetSpeciesFilter.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { Dog, Cat, Bird, PawPrint } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ItemDefinition } from '../../constants/items';
import { PET_SPECIES_TABLE, type PetSpecies } from '../../constants/pets';
import { speciesServedBy } from '../../lib/petCompatibility';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';

/** `all` is a real choice, not the absence of one — see the file doc. */
export type PetSpeciesFilterValue = PetSpecies | 'all';

const SPECIES_GLYPH: Record<PetSpecies, typeof Dog> = { dog: Dog, cat: Cat, bird: Bird };

/**
 * 寵物用品的物種篩選 — the chip row above the 寵物用品 and 寵物窩 shelves.
 *
 * The brief's §5 is the whole reason it exists: a player who owns a bird should not have to work
 * out which of ten homes on a shelf a bird can use. It opens on THEIR animal's species (see
 * {@link defaultSpeciesFilter}), so the shelf a bird owner walks into is a shelf of bird homes.
 *
 * ## Why it is a filter and not a hard narrowing
 *
 * §5 also says the wrong option should not be shown at all, and in the two places where the player
 * is ACTING on a specific animal — the in-world feeding list (UI/PetInteractionPanel.tsx) and the
 * resting-spot resolver (lib/petRestingSpots.ts) — it is exactly that: incompatible things do not
 * exist. A shop is the one surface where that would be wrong, because the shop is also where the
 * player buys their SECOND pet. A cat owner saving up for a bird has to be able to see that birds
 * have homes, and a shelf that hid them would be a dead end reached by following the game's own
 * advice. So 全部 stays one tap away and nothing is ever unreachable.
 *
 * ## Nothing here knows what a dog is
 *
 * The chips are built from {@link speciesServedBy} over the items on the shelf, so a species with
 * nothing on this shelf gets no chip (a filter that can only empty the screen is not offered), and
 * a future 寵物玩具 shelf grows this row for free the moment its rows declare a species. The row
 * hides itself entirely below two species — one chip plus 全部 is not a choice.
 */
export function PetSpeciesFilter({
  items,
  value,
  onChange,
  className = '',
}: {
  /** The shelf's items, unfiltered. What the chips are derived from. */
  items: readonly ItemDefinition[];
  value: PetSpeciesFilterValue;
  onChange: (value: PetSpeciesFilterValue) => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const species = speciesServedBy(items);
  if (species.length < 2) return null;

  const options: { id: PetSpeciesFilterValue; label: string; Glyph: typeof Dog }[] = [
    { id: 'all', label: '全部', Glyph: PawPrint },
    ...species.map((id) => ({
      id: id as PetSpeciesFilterValue,
      label: PET_SPECIES_TABLE[id].label,
      Glyph: SPECIES_GLYPH[id],
    })),
  ];

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 select-none ${className}`}
      role="group"
      aria-label="依寵物種類篩選"
    >
      {options.map(({ id, label, Glyph }) => {
        const active = value === id;
        return (
          <button
            key={id}
            onClick={() => {
              playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
              onChange(id);
            }}
            aria-pressed={active}
            className={`h-9 px-3.5 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all active:scale-95 flex-shrink-0 ${
              active
                ? 'bg-island-teal border-island-teal text-white shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(42,157,143,0.25)]'
                : 'bg-white border-island-line text-island-navy-soft hover:border-island-teal hover:text-island-teal'
            }`}
          >
            <Glyph size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap">{label}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Which chip a pet shelf opens on: the player's own companion's species, when the shelf has
 * anything for it.
 *
 * This is the half of §5 that is actually about being kind — the filter existing is not much use if
 * the player has to find and press it. The fallback to 全部 covers a player with no pet out and a
 * shelf that happens to serve nobody they own, both of which want the whole shelf.
 */
export function defaultSpeciesFilter(
  items: readonly ItemDefinition[],
  species: PetSpecies | undefined,
): PetSpeciesFilterValue {
  if (!species) return 'all';
  return speciesServedBy(items).includes(species) ? species : 'all';
}
```

## src/components/UI/PettingMiniGame.tsx

```tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { Heart, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { playerBus } from '../../lib/playerBus';
import {
  finishPetActivity,
  patPet,
  playPetReaction,
  startPetting,
} from '../../lib/petActivity';
import { Toast } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * 摸摸 — the mini-game, and now also the start, middle and end of the animal actually being petted.
 *
 * It used to drive the pet through one boolean on the bus: `dogIsHappy = true` when the bar filled,
 * and a `setTimeout` three seconds later to set it back. That boolean had no word for 「being petted
 * right now」, so the animal kept wandering off while the player was clicking; it did not say WHICH
 * animal, so three companions would all have spun at once; and the timer ran on regardless of whether
 * the player was still on the island to see it.
 *
 * The pet's side is lib/petActivity.ts now. Starting the game starts a `petting` activity for the
 * animal the prompt was pointing at — it stays put, turns to its owner and leans in — every click is
 * a `pat` it visibly reacts to, and filling the bar ends the activity with a `happy` reaction. Closing
 * the game, leaving the island or unmounting ends it too. Nothing here waits on a timer to put the
 * animal back: an activity nobody finishes expires on its own clock (`petActivityExpired`).
 *
 * The avatar hears the same beats as a `pet-care-gesture` event and crouches to the animal — see
 * Three/Avatar.tsx.
 */
export function PettingMiniGame() {
  const { petDog, currentView } = useApp();
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [showReward, setShowReward] = useState(false);
  const [rewardResult, setRewardResult] = useState<{ rewarded: boolean; remaining: number } | null>(null);
  /** The animal this round is about, captured when it starts — see PetInteractionPanel for why. */
  const petRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const toastTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const stopPetting = useCallback(() => {
    if (petRef.current) finishPetActivity(petRef.current);
    petRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  const handlePet = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) {
      setIsPlaying(true);
      setProgress(0);
      const pet = playerBus.petTargetId ?? null;
      if (pet && startPetting(pet)) {
        petRef.current = pet;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pet-care-gesture', { detail: { kind: 'petting', petItemId: pet } }));
      }
      return;
    }

    if (petRef.current) {
      patPet(petRef.current);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pet-care-gesture', { detail: { kind: 'pat', petItemId: petRef.current } }));
    }

    setProgress(prev => {
      const next = prev + 10;
      if (next >= 100) {
        // Win!
        setIsPlaying(false);

        // The animal's delight is its own reaction now (a couple of hops, tail going, a happy
        // noise in its own species' voice — Three/IslandPet.tsx), whether or not gold is left today.
        const pet = petRef.current;
        stopPetting();
        if (pet) playPetReaction(pet, 'happy');

        petDog().then(result => {
          setRewardResult(result);
          setShowReward(true);
          if (result.rewarded) {
            playSound(SoundEffect.SUCCESS);
          }

          if (toastTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(toastTimer.current);
          // Only the toast is on a timer. The pet's side ended the moment the bar filled.
          toastTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setShowReward(false), 3000);
        });

        return 0;
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [isPlaying, petDog, stopPetting]);

  // Decay progress over time
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPlaying) {
      const decay = setInterval(() => {
        setProgress(p => Math.max(0, p - 2));
      }, 100);
      return () => clearInterval(decay);
    }
  }, [isPlaying]);

  // InteractionPrompt.tsx (desktop AND mobile/tablet, both now unified there) dispatches this
  // instead of this component rendering its own idle "摸摸小狗" button — same start-the-game
  // entry point, just triggered from the floating prompt anchored above the dog instead of a
  // dedicated fixed-position button.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onStartPetDog = () => handlePet();
    window.addEventListener('start-pet-dog', onStartPetDog);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('start-pet-dog', onStartPetDog);
  }, [handlePet]);

  // Leaving the island mid-round is the round ending: the animal must not be left 「being petted」
  // by nobody. The same on unmount.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentView !== 'home' && isPlaying) {
      setIsPlaying(false);
      stopPetting();
    }
  }, [currentView, isPlaying, stopPetting]);
  useEffect(() => () => {
    stopPetting();
    if (toastTimer.current) window.clearTimeout(toastTimer.current);
  }, [stopPetting]);

  if (currentView !== 'home') return null;

  return (
    // Placed (bottom, centred, above the NavBar) by the `bottom-center` HUD
    // region (HudFrame.tsx) — no longer `fixed bottom-32 left-[88px]` (that
    // left offset was hand-tuned to clear the SideButtons column). The grid
    // keeps it centred on the viewport and clear of the left rail at any
    // width; `relative` keeps the z-hud-topbar tier for local stacking.
    <div className="relative z-hud-topbar pointer-events-none flex flex-col items-center">
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isPlaying && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 bg-island-cream p-6 rounded-[2rem] shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(38,70,83,0.22)] border border-island-line relative pointer-events-auto"
          >
            {/* Exit/Close Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                setIsPlaying(false);
                stopPetting();
              }}
              className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-10 h-10 bg-island-coral/12 hover:bg-island-coral/20 text-island-coral flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer pointer-events-auto active:scale-95 z-50"
              title="結束互動"
            >
              <X size={18} strokeWidth={3} />
            </button>

            <div className="text-island-coral flex gap-1 pt-2">
              {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
                <motion.div
                  key={i}
                  animate={{ scale: [1, 1.2, 1] }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.6, repeat: Infinity, delay: i * 0.2 }}
                >
                  <Heart fill="currentColor" />
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="w-52 sm:w-64 h-6 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-island-line">
              <motion.div
                className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-island-coral to-island-coral/80"
                animate={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
              />
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handlePet}
              className="pointer-events-auto bg-island-coral hover:bg-island-coral/90 text-white px-8 sm:px-12 py-4 sm:py-5 rounded-[2rem] font-black shadow-[0_15px_40px_rgba(232,131,106,0.35)] active:scale-95 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all uppercase tracking-widest text-2xl sm:text-3xl whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              PET IT!
            </button>
            <p className="text-island-coral font-bold animate-pulse">連點摸摸它！</p>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <Toast
        visible={showReward && !!rewardResult}
        accent={rewardResult?.rewarded ? 'gold' : 'coral'}
        position="inline"
      >
        {rewardResult?.rewarded ? (
          <>
            <span className="text-2xl">💰</span>
            <span>+20 Gold / +10 XP!</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          // 牠 rather than 狗狗: the animal being petted is whichever pet is equipped (see
          // Three/IslandPet.tsx), which is a cat or a bird as often as a dog.
          <span>今日獎勵已領完，牠還是好開心！</span>
        )}
        <Heart fill="white" size={16} />
      </Toast>
    </div>
  );
}

```

## src/components/UI/PlacementCatalog.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { ArrowLeft, Check, Coins, Hammer, PackageOpen, ShoppingBag } from 'lucide-react';
import { ItemDefinition } from '../../constants/items';
import { rarityStyleVars } from '../../constants/rarity';
import { getFurnitureSeries } from '../../constants/furnitureModels';
import { getItemRarity } from '../../utils/debugOverrides';
import { DisplayCategory } from '../../utils/categoryUtils';
import { ANGEL_AVOID } from '../../constants/angelAvoid';
import { QVersionIcon } from '../QVersionIcon';
import { CategoryIcon } from './CategoryIcon';
import { SubGroupFilter } from './CategoryTabs';
import { Button, EmptyState, IconTile, PanelHeader } from './DesignKit';
import { BuyButton, StockBadge } from './ItemStock';

/**
 * THE ONE CATALOG DRAWER — "choose a thing to put down", wherever the player is standing.
 *
 * ## Why it is shared
 *
 * Both build modes ask the player the same question and used to ask it in two different shapes.
 * The house had a right-hand drawer: a grid of category tiles carrying an 已擁有 N 款 count, then
 * a vertical list split 已擁有 / 尚未擁有 with a divider, each row showing the piece's name, its
 * description, its stock and one action. The island had a bottom rail: a flat chip row of
 * categories, then a horizontal strip of small square cards with arrow buttons over them, no
 * ownership split at all — a piece you own and a piece you have never bought looked the same
 * except for a 庫存不足 veil across the art, and the card's own tap did two different things
 * depending on which it was.
 *
 * The drawer was the better of the two on every count that matters here, and none of what made it
 * better is about being indoors: an ownership split is about a backpack, a description is about
 * an item, and a vertical list is about there being forty of them. So it moves out here and both
 * modes use it, and the taxonomy stays what it already was — the shop's own categories, filtered
 * by placement scope (utils/categoryUtils.ts), so 「我在哪裡看過這個」 keeps having one answer.
 *
 * ## What stayed different, and why
 *
 * The island's rail is not simply replaced by the drawer: outdoors the player is also placing
 * BUILDINGS, and the thing they most often want is not in any category — it is the object already
 * standing on their lawn. That is a different question ("which of my things do I want to move?")
 * and it gets its own tool, next to this one, rather than being bolted onto a list of things to
 * buy. See UI/BuildModeOverlay.tsx.
 */

/**
 * Heading that separates 已擁有 from 尚未擁有 inside a category.
 *
 * The split is the whole point of the list order — what you can place right now first, what you
 * could buy after it — so it gets a real divider (icon + label + count + rule) rather than a gap
 * the eye has to interpret.
 */
export function DrawerSectionDivider({
  icon,
  label,
  count,
  owned = false,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  count: number;
  owned?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <span
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-[0.14em] ${
          owned
            ? 'border-island-teal/25 bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal-dark'
            : 'border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 text-island-navy-soft'
        }`}
      >
        {icon}
        {label}
        <span className="opacity-70">{count}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-island-line" />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * One row in a catalog drawer.
 *
 * Deliberately ONE component for both halves of the list: an owned piece and a not-yet-owned
 * piece are the same object in the same category, and building two card designs for them is what
 * makes a catalog feel like two unrelated screens. Only the action area differs — 擺放 / 套用 for
 * something in the backpack, 購買 for something in the shop.
 */
export function PlacementItemRow({
  item,
  owned,
  available,
  applied = false,
  appliedLabel = '使用中',
  placeLabel = '擺放',
  placeIcon,
  tags,
  onPlace,
  onBuy,
}: {
  item: ItemDefinition;
  owned: boolean;
  /** Copies left to place. Ignored when the item is own-once (a style). */
  available: number;
  /** This row is the one currently in effect — a floor/wall style that is painted on right now. */
  applied?: boolean;
  appliedLabel?: string;
  placeLabel?: string;
  placeIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Extra chips before the stock badge, e.g. 地板 / 牆面 for a style. */
  tags?: React.ReactNode;
  onPlace: () => void;
  onBuy: () => void;
}) {
  const outOfStock = owned && !applied && available <= 0;
  // Thumbnail form only — border and halo, never the aura (see `.rarity-chip` in index.css).
  // 套用中 still wins: a STATE the player put the row into has to out-rank a grade the row was
  // born with, or the one row they just changed stops looking changed.
  const rarity = getItemRarity(item);
  const graded = !applied;

  return (
    <div
      className={`group flex w-full items-center gap-4 rounded-[1.5rem] border p-4 transition-all ${
        applied ? 'border-island-teal bg-island-teal/6'
          : graded ? 'rarity-chip bg-white'
            : 'border-island-line bg-white hover:border-island-teal-light'
      }`}
      style={graded ? rarityStyleVars(rarity) : undefined}
    >
      <IconTile size={64} className="flex-shrink-0 bg-white transition-transform group-hover:scale-105">
        <QVersionIcon itemId={item.id} size={56} />
      </IconTile>

      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          {tags}
          {/* The shelf this piece sits on inside a large category — 畫作 / 雕塑 / 陶藝 and so on
              inside 藝術品. A chip rather than a third row of category tabs: it gives a
              forty-item list internal shape without every screen having to learn a third tier.
              See `subGroup` in constants/items.ts. */}
          {item.subGroup && (
            <span className="rounded-md border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black text-island-navy-soft/80">
              {item.subGroup}
            </span>
          )}
          {/* The style series, tinted with its own accent. It matters MORE here than in the shop:
              this is the drawer the player opens while actually furnishing a room, which is the
              moment 「哪幾件是同一套」 is the question they are asking. */}
          {(() => {
            const series = getFurnitureSeries(item.styleSeries);
            if (!series) return null;
            return (
              <span
                className="rounded-md border px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black"
                style={{
                  color: series.accent,
                  borderColor: `${series.accent}55`,
                  backgroundColor: `${series.accent}1a`,
                }}
              >
                {series.label}
              </span>
            );
          })()}
          {applied && (
            <span className="rounded-md border border-island-teal/20 bg-island-teal/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black text-island-teal-dark">
              {appliedLabel}
            </span>
          )}
          {owned ? <StockBadge itemId={item.id} /> : (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft">
              <Coins size={11} className="text-island-gold" />
              {item.price}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-base font-black text-island-navy">{item.name}</p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-1 text-xs font-black text-island-navy-soft/70">{item.description}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-shrink-0 flex-col items-stretch gap-1.5">
        {owned && (
          <Button
            variant={applied ? 'ghost' : 'primary'}
            disabled={applied || outOfStock}
            onClick={onPlace}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px]"
            title={outOfStock ? '已全部擺放，再購買一件才能繼續擺放' : undefined}
          >
            {applied ? <Check size={13} strokeWidth={3} /> : placeIcon ?? <Hammer size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
            <span>{applied ? appliedLabel : placeLabel}</span>
          </Button>
        )}
        {/* A piece whose copies are all standing somewhere gets the same 再購買 affordance as a
            piece never bought — that is the whole reason stock is visible. */}
        {(!owned || outOfStock) && (
          <BuyButton item={item} onClick={onBuy} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px]" />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The right-hand drawer both build modes browse in: a grid of categories, then the items in one.
 *
 * `compact` is the pose it takes while something is actually being positioned — pulled to the top
 * right, half height, and with its backdrop dropped so clicks reach the world underneath. That is
 * what lets a player place one piece after another without re-opening the list, and it is why the
 * placement dock is bottom-centred: the two must never want the same pixels.
 */
export function CatalogDrawer({
  icon,
  title,
  subtitle,
  categories,
  activeCategory,
  onCategoryChange,
  ownedCountByCategory,
  subGroupItems,
  activeSubGroup = null,
  onSubGroupChange,
  banner,
  emptyIcon,
  emptyTitle = '此分類目前沒有商品',
  emptyNote,
  compact = false,
  onClose,
  children,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  /** Shown at the top level; a chosen category names itself. */
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  categories: DisplayCategory[];
  activeCategory: string | null;
  onCategoryChange: (id: string | null) => void;
  ownedCountByCategory: Record<string, number>;
  /**
   * 貨架內分組列的三個參數 —— 全部可選，一起給或一起不給。
   *
   * `subGroupItems` 是**這一架的全部商品**（不是已篩過的），因為分組列要列出的是這一架有哪幾組；
   * 篩選本身由呼叫端做，因為只有它知道自己那份 已擁有／尚未擁有 的清單要怎麼切。門檻與畫不畫在
   * SubGroupFilter 自己身上（UI/CategoryTabs.tsx）。
   *
   * 室內抽屜的 藝術品 有 40 件，是全遊戲最長的一份清單、又擠在一個 max-w-md 的抽屜裡 —— 這一列
   * 存在的理由主要就是它。
   */
  subGroupItems?: readonly { subGroup?: string }[];
  activeSubGroup?: string | null;
  onSubGroupChange?: (subGroup: string | null) => void;
  /** Optional strip above the list, e.g. which room a paint would be applied to. */
  banner?: React.ReactNode;
  emptyIcon: React.ReactNode;
  emptyTitle?: string;
  emptyNote?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** The rows for `activeCategory`. Empty renders the empty state. */
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const active = activeCategory ? categories.find(c => c.id === activeCategory) : null;
  const isEmpty = React.Children.count(children) === 0;

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
      onClick={onClose}
      onWheel={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      className={`absolute inset-0 z-floating-panel flex justify-end p-4 md:p-8 ${
        compact ? 'items-start pointer-events-none' : 'items-center bg-island-navy/45'
      }`}
    >
      <motion.div
        // The drawer is the tallest thing either build mode puts up, and the 小天使 narrates it
        // from the band to its left; marked so she measures it and steps aside rather than
        // landing on it. On the CARD, not on the full-bleed backdrop above — marking that would
        // tell her the whole screen is occupied. See constants/angelAvoid.ts.
        {...ANGEL_AVOID}
        initial={{ x: 100 }}
        animate={{ x: 0 }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onWheel={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={`pointer-events-auto flex w-full max-w-md flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-island-line bg-island-cream shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(38,70,83,0.3)] ${
          compact ? 'max-h-[55vh]' : 'h-full'
        }`}
      >
        <PanelHeader
          icon={
            active ? (
              <button
                onClick={() => onCategoryChange(null)}
                className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center"
                title="返回分類"
              >
                <ArrowLeft size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </button>
            ) : icon
          }
          title={active ? active.label : title}
          subtitle={active ? active.description : subtitle}
          onClose={onClose}
        />

        <div
          onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="no-scrollbar relative flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-island-cream-2/40 p-6"
          style={{ overflowY: 'auto', scrollbarWidth: 'none' }}
        >
          {!active ? (
            /* --- Layer 1: the shop's own categories for this world --- */
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {categories.map(category => (
                <button
                  key={category.id}
                  onClick={() => onCategoryChange(category.id)}
                  className="group relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 overflow-hidden rounded-[1.5rem] border border-island-line bg-white p-5 text-center shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(38,70,83,0.04)] transition-all duration-200 hover:border-island-teal-light hover:shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(38,70,83,0.08)] active:scale-95"
                >
                  <IconTile size={72} className="text-island-teal-dark transition-transform group-hover:scale-110">
                    {category.artKey
                      ? <QVersionIcon categoryId={category.artKey} size={50} />
                      : <CategoryIcon iconName={category.iconName} size={32} active />}
                  </IconTile>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-base font-black text-island-navy transition-colors group-hover:text-island-teal-dark">
                      {category.label}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 rounded-lg border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-island-navy-soft/70">
                      已擁有 {ownedCountByCategory[category.id] ?? 0} 款
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* --- Layer 2: 已擁有 on top, 尚未擁有 below, one row design for both --- */
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* 貨架內的分組列。給了 `onSubGroupChange` 才畫，而且元件自己還有件數/組數門檻 ——
                  所以只有真正長到需要它的貨架會長出來（室內的 藝術品 40 件、室外的 互動物件 21
                  件）。放在 banner 上面：先決定要看哪一種，再看那條「套用到哪個房間」的提示。 */}
              {onSubGroupChange && subGroupItems && (
                <SubGroupFilter
                  items={subGroupItems}
                  active={activeSubGroup}
                  onChange={onSubGroupChange}
                  className="md:!justify-start"
                />
              )}
              {banner}
              {isEmpty
                ? <EmptyState icon={emptyIcon} title={emptyTitle} description={active.emptyNote ?? emptyNote} />
                : children}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

/** The two section headings a catalog list is split by, so no caller re-picks the icons. */
export const OWNED_DIVIDER = { icon: <PackageOpen size={13} strokeWidth={3} />, label: '已擁有' };
export const UNOWNED_DIVIDER = { icon: <ShoppingBag size={13} strokeWidth={3} />, label: '尚未擁有' };
```

## src/components/UI/PlacementDock.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Check, Grid3x3, Move, RotateCw, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button, DockPanel, DockStatus, IconTile, KeyCap } from './DesignKit';
import { getPlacementSession, subscribePlacementSession } from '../../lib/placementSession';
import { useIsTouchDevice } from '../../hooks/useIsTouchDevice';

/**
 * THE ONE PLACEMENT DOCK — the chrome for "you are holding something; put it down".
 *
 * ## Why it is shared
 *
 * The house and the island were running the same three beats (pick a subject → adjust → commit or
 * cancel, see DESIGN_SYSTEM.md "Catalog, shop, inventory, placement, selection") through two
 * unrelated pieces of chrome: indoors a bottom-centre `DockPanel` with captioned action keys,
 * outdoors a top-centre floating bar with small inline buttons. Same verbs, opposite ends of the
 * screen, different button shapes, and a live verdict that read one way in one place and another
 * way in the other. A player who learned to decorate their living room had to learn the whole
 * thing again to put a fountain on their lawn — which is the learning cost this consolidation is
 * about, and it was pure cost: nothing about a fountain makes 確認 belong somewhere else.
 *
 * ## The anatomy, and what each part is allowed to say
 *
 *   **subject** — what is being positioned right now. Never instructions.
 *   **note**    — the LIVE verdict, and only when there is something live to say: why 確認 has
 *                 gone dead, or that the piece has just snapped to a wall or a tabletop. How to
 *                 use the editor belongs to the 小天使 (AngelGuide.tsx), not to a bar the player
 *                 reads once and then has to look past forever. The `hint` tone is the one
 *                 exception, for a session that has no verdict of its own to report.
 *   **actions** — 旋轉 (with its key cap), whatever the subject adds, 收回, 確認, 取消.
 *                 Danger keeps coral to itself and 取消 sits on the far side of 確認, so the two
 *                 destructive taps are never neighbours.
 *
 * Everything optional is optional because a subject genuinely does not have it: a wall-mounted
 * picture takes its facing from the wall, so it gets no 旋轉; a copy being placed for the first
 * time is not yet standing anywhere, so it gets no 收回.
 */

export type PlacementNoteTone = 'blocked' | 'ok' | 'hint';

export interface PlacementNote {
  tone: PlacementNoteTone;
  /** Small caps line above the message. Only used by `blocked`, where naming the refusal helps. */
  label?: React.ReactNode;
  detail: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Which step the drag is moving in, live.
 *
 * The grid used to be the only way to move a piece indoors — half a metre at a time, whether the
 * player wanted it or not — and it was invisible, so what the player saw was furniture that
 * refused to be nudged. It is a tool now rather than the mechanism: dragging is continuous, and
 * holding Shift snaps to a coarse grid for lining a row of things up. That is worth exactly one
 * chip: it says which of the two is happening right now, and which key changes it.
 *
 * Pointer devices only. There is no Shift on a touchscreen, so on a phone this would be a control
 * the player cannot reach describing a state they cannot leave.
 */
function PrecisionChip() {
  const session = useSyncExternalStore(subscribePlacementSession, getPlacementSession);
  const isTouch = useIsTouchDevice();
  if (isTouch) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="hidden flex-shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-[1.25rem] border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 px-3 py-2 text-island-navy-soft sm:flex"
      title="拖曳可自由微調；按住 Shift 對齊格線"
    >
      {session.align
        ? <Grid3x3 size={15} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0 text-island-teal-dark" />
        : <Move size={15} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0" />}
      <span className="text-[11px] font-black leading-none">
        {session.align ? '對齊格線' : '自由微調'}
      </span>
      <KeyCap size="sm">Shift</KeyCap>
    </div>
  );
}

const NOTE_STYLE: Record<PlacementNoteTone, string> = {
  blocked: 'border-island-coral/25 bg-island-coral/10 text-island-coral',
  ok: 'border-island-teal/25 bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal-dark',
  hint: 'border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 text-island-navy-soft',
};

export function PlacementDock({
  icon,
  badge,
  badgeIcon,
  title,
  meta,
  note,
  onRotate,
  rotateTitle = '旋轉 45°（鍵盤 R）',
  extraActions,
  onRetrieve,
  retrieveLabel = '收回',
  retrieveTitle,
  onConfirm,
  confirmLabel = '確認擺放',
  confirmDisabled = false,
  confirmTitle,
  onCancel,
  className = '',
  ...motionProps
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  badge: React.ReactNode;
  badgeIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  title: React.ReactNode;
  meta?: React.ReactNode;
  note?: PlacementNote | null;
  /** Omit to hide 旋轉 — for a subject whose facing is not the player's to choose. */
  onRotate?: () => void;
  rotateTitle?: string;
  /** Subject-specific extras, e.g. the Home's 更換外觀. Sits between 旋轉 and 收回. */
  extraActions?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Omit to hide 收回 — for a copy that is not standing anywhere yet. */
  onRetrieve?: () => void;
  retrieveLabel?: string;
  retrieveTitle?: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  confirmDisabled?: boolean;
  confirmTitle?: string;
  onCancel: () => void;
  className?: string;
} & Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof DockPanel>, 'children' | 'className' | 'title'>) {
  return (
    <DockPanel
      initial={{ y: 40, scale: 0.94, opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ y: 0, scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
      exit={{ y: 40, scale: 0.94, opacity: 0 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 300 }}
      // `w-max`, not `w-auto`. DockPanel is absolutely positioned at `left-1/2`, and an absolute
      // box's shrink-to-fit width is capped at the space from its left edge to the containing
      // block's right edge — half the viewport. On a laptop window that clamp lands right in the
      // middle of this dock and squeezes the verdict until it wraps one character per line.
      // max-content ignores the clamp; the max-width below is what keeps it on screen instead.
      className={`flex w-[95%] flex-col gap-3 p-3 sm:w-max sm:max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-4 sm:p-4 ${className}`}
      {...motionProps}
    >
      {/* `flex-shrink-0` and a min width, not just a max: without them the action row's confirm
          button wins the space and the subject block collapses until 擺放中 wraps one character
          per line. A dock names what it is holding or it is not a dock. */}
      <div className="flex flex-shrink-0 items-center gap-3 sm:min-w-[180px] sm:max-w-[240px] sm:border-r sm:border-island-line sm:pr-4">
        <IconTile size={52} active className="flex-shrink-0">
          {icon}
        </IconTile>
        <DockStatus badge={badge} badgeIcon={badgeIcon} title={title} meta={meta} className="flex-1" />

        {/* Phone-only dismiss. On sm+ it lives at the end of the action row, clear of 收回. */}
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="h-9 w-9 flex-shrink-0 p-0 sm:hidden"
          title="取消（Esc）"
        >
          <X size={18} strokeWidth={3} />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {note && (
        <div
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[1.25rem] border px-3 py-2 sm:min-w-[150px] sm:max-w-[240px] ${NOTE_STYLE[note.tone]}`}
        >
          {note.tone === 'blocked' && <AlertTriangle size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0" />}
          {note.tone === 'ok' && <Check size={16} strokeWidth={3} className="flex-shrink-0" />}
          <span className="min-w-0 text-[11px] font-bold leading-snug">
            {note.label && (
              <span className="block text-[10px] font-black tracking-[0.14em] opacity-70">{note.label}</span>
            )}
            <span className="block font-black">{note.detail}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      <PrecisionChip />

      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        {onRotate && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={onRotate}
            className="h-14 w-14 flex-col p-0 hover:-translate-y-1 sm:h-16 sm:w-16"
            title={rotateTitle}
          >
            <RotateCw size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] leading-none">
              旋轉
              <KeyCap size="sm">R</KeyCap>
            </span>
          </Button>
        )}

        {extraActions}

        {onRetrieve && (
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            onClick={onRetrieve}
            className="h-14 w-14 flex-col p-0 hover:-translate-y-1 sm:h-16 sm:w-16"
            title={retrieveTitle}
          >
            <Trash2 size={22} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            <span className="text-[10px] leading-none">{retrieveLabel}</span>
          </Button>
        )}

        <Button
          variant="primary"
          onClick={onConfirm}
          disabled={confirmDisabled}
          title={confirmTitle}
          className="h-14 flex-1 gap-2 px-5 text-sm hover:-translate-y-1 sm:h-16 sm:flex-initial sm:gap-3 sm:px-9 sm:text-base"
        >
          <Check size={22} strokeWidth={3} />
          <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{confirmLabel}</span>
        </Button>

        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="hidden h-16 w-16 p-0 sm:flex"
          title="取消（Esc）"
        >
          <X size={24} strokeWidth={3} />
        </Button>
      </div>
    </DockPanel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ProviderDescriptor } from '../../auth/providers/types';
import { Button } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * One sign-in / account-binding button, rendered entirely from a
 * {@link ProviderDescriptor}.
 *
 * This component knows nothing about Google, Apple or anyone else — that is the
 * point. The sign-in screen maps over the registry, so adding Discord later
 * changes `providers/registry.ts` and no JSX at all. The previous screen had
 * one hand-written `<Button>` per provider, complete with a hotlinked
 * `google.com/favicon.ico`, which is exactly the 「將登入邏輯散落於 UI Component」
 * pattern the brief rules out.
 */
export function ProviderButton({
  descriptor,
  onSelect,
  busy = false,
  disabled = false,
  hint,
}: {
  descriptor: ProviderDescriptor;
  onSelect: () => void;
  /** This provider's own sign-in is in flight. */
  busy?: boolean;
  /** Some other provider is in flight, or the app is otherwise blocked. */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Small trailing note, e.g. 「上次使用」. */
  hint?: string;
}) {
  const isPlanned = descriptor.status === 'planned';

  return (
    <Button
      variant={descriptor.emphasis === 'primary' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
      onClick={onSelect}
      disabled={disabled || busy || isPlanned}
      aria-label={descriptor.label}
      className={`w-full gap-3 px-6 py-4 text-base ${
        descriptor.emphasis === 'secondary' ? 'hover:border-island-teal' : ''
      }`}
    >
      {busy ? (
        <Loader2 size={20} className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />
      ) : (
        <svg
          viewBox={descriptor.mark.viewBox}
          width={20}
          height={20}
          aria-hidden
          className="flex-shrink-0"
        >
          {descriptor.mark.paths.map((path, index) => (
            <path key={index} d={path.d} fill={path.fill ?? 'currentColor'} />
          ))}
        </svg>
      )}
      <span className="flex-1 text-left">{descriptor.label}</span>
      {isPlanned && (
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest opacity-60">
          即將推出
        </span>
      )}
      {!isPlanned && hint && (
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest opacity-60">{hint}</span>
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}
```
