## src/components/UI/UtilityCard.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Clock, Coins, Sparkles, Ticket, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { rarityStyleVars } from '../../constants/rarity';
import {
  ALL_UTILITY_CARDS,
  describeDuration,
  getOwnedCards,
  remainingMs,
  type UtilityCardDefinition,
  type UtilityCardIconName,
} from '../../constants/utilityCards';
import { CARD_USE_MESSAGES, readLiveEffects } from '../../context/useUtilityCards';
// The app already has exactly one countdown format (`03:41:07`, zero-padded so it does not jitter
// in width). It lives beside the panel that needed it first; a second one here would be a second
// way to write the same duration on two screens the player sees minutes apart.
import { formatCountdown } from '../../constants/dailyLogin';
import { playSound, SoundEffect, triggerHaptic } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { RarityAura } from './RarityAura';
import { Button, EmptyState, ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * 功能卡 UI — the one place a card is drawn, wherever it appears.
 *
 * §14 of the brief: a player must be able to tell at a glance that this is NOT a hat, a sofa or a
 * 特殊飾品 — it is something you USE. Four things do that work, and none of them is a colour:
 *
 *  1. **A ticket, not a product card.** A round icon well instead of the catalog's 4:3 rectangle,
 *     and a perforated stub line across the card. Shop cards in this game are all the same
 *     rectangle; this one is a different object. (「change the construction, not the colour」 —
 *     DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.)
 *  2. **The effect is the headline.** 「金幣獲得 ×2」 sits where a price would, in its own pill.
 *     An item card answers 「這是什麼」; a card has to answer 「用了會怎樣」.
 *  3. **A 功能卡 label**, said in words, because the shape only works once the player has learned it.
 *  4. **A duration line**, because 「用了會怎樣」 is incomplete without 「持續多久」.
 *
 * The 稀有度 treatment is the shared one (`.rarity-card` / `RarityAura`), deliberately: a card is
 * graded on the same ladder as everything else, and giving it a private rarity look would be a
 * second grading system to keep in step. What differs is the object it is painted on.
 */

/** Card glyphs, resolved from the definition's `iconName`. All three are honoured — see the type. */
const CARD_ICONS: Record<UtilityCardIconName, typeof Coins> = {
  Coins,
  Sparkles,
  Zap,
};

/**
 * A ticking clock, for anything that counts down.
 *
 * One interval per consumer and no shared store: these are seconds-resolution readouts on panels
 * that are open for a minute at a time, and a global ticker driving every mounted component would
 * be a re-render budget nobody is watching. Returns `Date.now()`, so the caller does the maths in
 * the same units every pure function in this feature takes.
 */
export function useNow(intervalMs = 1000): number {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), intervalMs);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [intervalMs]);
  return now;
}

/** The card's own glyph, in a ring. Sized for a tile (72) or a dialog (48). */
export function UtilityCardArt({
  card,
  size = 72,
}: {
  card: UtilityCardDefinition;
  size?: number;
}) {
  const Icon = CARD_ICONS[card.iconName] ?? Sparkles;
  return (
    <span
      className="rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-island-teal/40 flex items-center justify-center text-island-teal-dark flex-shrink-0"
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <Icon size={Math.round(size * 0.42)} strokeWidth={2.5} />
    </span>
  );
}

/** 功能卡 / 效果 / 持續時間 — the three chips that say what kind of thing this is. */
export function UtilityCardMeta({ card, className = '' }: { card: UtilityCardDefinition; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-teal/12 text-island-teal-dark text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg border border-island-teal/25 flex items-center gap-1">
        <Ticket size={10} strokeWidth={3} />
        功能卡
      </span>
      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-cream-2 text-island-navy-soft text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg border border-island-line flex items-center gap-1">
        <Clock size={10} strokeWidth={3} />
        {describeDuration(card.duration)}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The card itself. Composed rather than configured: a caller passes whatever action belongs on it
 * (購買 in the 限時商店, 使用 in the bag), so one component serves both without a `mode` prop.
 */
export function UtilityCardTile({
  card,
  count,
  action,
  aside,
  badges,
  className = '',
}: {
  card: UtilityCardDefinition;
  /** How many the player holds, shown as a stub count. Omitted where it is not the point. */
  count?: number;
  /** The 購買/使用 control. */
  action?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Anything extra above the action — a price row, a status line. */
  aside?: React.ReactNode;
  /**
   * Context tags from whatever surface is showing the card — 限時, 返場, 本檔限購.
   *
   * They ride directly under the card's own chips rather than down in the stub, because on a
   * limited shelf 「這是限時的」 has to be readable in the same glance as the card's name. The tile
   * does not know what they mean; the shelf does.
   */
  badges?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      // The tier's class rides on the card itself, not only on the aura inside the well — the
      // whole rectangle is graded now (`.rarity-card` in index.css). Same treatment a product
      // card gets, for the same reason the aura is shared: a 稀有 card is lit exactly like a
      // 稀有 hat.
      className={`store-card rarity-card rarity-${card.rarity} p-4 rounded-[1.75rem] border flex flex-col cursor-default ${className}`}
      style={rarityStyleVars(card.rarity)}
    >
      {typeof count === 'number' && count > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-island-teal text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest z-20">
          ×{count}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* The round well — the shape that separates a card from a product tile. The aura is the
          shared 稀有度 treatment, so a 稀有 card is lit exactly like a 稀有 hat. */}
      <div className="w-full py-4 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl mb-3 flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden border rarity-well">
        <RarityAura rarity={card.rarity} />
        <div className="relative">
          <UtilityCardArt card={card} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <h4 className="text-base font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight leading-tight mb-1.5">{card.name}</h4>
      <UtilityCardMeta card={card} className="mb-2" />
      {badges}

      {/* The effect, where a price would be on a shop card. This is the line the whole tile exists
          to deliver. */}
      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-island-teal text-white text-xs font-black mb-2">
        <Sparkles size={12} strokeWidth={3} />
        {card.effectSummary}
      </div>

      <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 text-xs font-bold leading-relaxed mb-3 line-clamp-3">
        {card.description}
      </p>

      {/* The stub line. A dashed rule rather than a clip-path notch, on purpose: a clip would eat
          the card's own shadow and its rarity ring (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, 「A clipped element cannot
          carry its own shadow」). */}
      <div className="mt-auto border-t border-dashed border-island-line pt-3 space-y-2">
        {aside}
        {action}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 效果進行中 — the live readout.
 *
 * Renders nothing when nothing is running, so it can be dropped anywhere without a guard at the
 * call site. It is a STATUS and never a control: using a card is done in the bag, and a chip that
 * could be clicked would be a second use path.
 */
export function ActiveEffectChip({ className = '' }: { className?: string }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const now = useNow();
  const effects = readLiveEffects(profile, now);
  if (effects.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
      {effects.map((live) => {
        const left = remainingMs(live.effect, now);
        return (
          <span
            key={live.effect.activationId}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-island-teal/35 bg-island-teal/12 text-island-navy font-black text-xs"
            title={`${live.name}：${live.summary}`}
          >
            <Sparkles size={13} className="text-island-teal-dark" strokeWidth={2.5} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>{live.summary}</span>
            <span className="text-island-navy-soft/70 font-bold">
              {left !== null ? formatCountdown(left) : `剩 ${live.usesLeft ?? 0} 次`}
            </span>
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 我的功能卡 — the bag, and the only place a card is used.
 *
 * Deliberately NOT the shop's inventory drawer. That drawer lists things you own and wear or place;
 * these are things you spend, and the verb on every row is 使用. Cards the player does not hold are
 * still listed, greyed, with where to get one — a bag that hides what you do not have cannot teach
 * anybody that the feature exists.
 */
export function UtilityCardBag() {
  const { profile, useUtilityCard } = useApp();
  const now = useNow();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const owned = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Map(getOwnedCards(profile?.utilityCards).map((entry) => [entry.card.id, entry.count]));
    return ALL_UTILITY_CARDS.map((card) => ({ card, count: counts.get(card.id) ?? 0 }));
  }, [profile?.utilityCards]);

  const live = readLiveEffects(profile, now);

  const handleUse = async (card: UtilityCardDefinition) => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(card.id);
    setMessage(null);
    const result = await useUtilityCard(card.id);
    setBusy(null);
    if (result.ok) {
      setMessage(`${card.name} 已使用 — ${card.effectSummary}`);
      return;
    }
    setMessage(CARD_USE_MESSAGES[result.reason]);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {live.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-teal/30 bg-island-teal/8 p-4">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-island-teal-dark mb-2">
            效果進行中
          </p>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {live.map((effect) => {
              const left = remainingMs(effect.effect, now);
              return (
                <div key={effect.effect.activationId} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">
                    {effect.name} · {effect.summary}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-teal-dark flex-shrink-0">
                    {left !== null ? formatCountdown(left) : `剩 ${effect.usesLeft ?? 0} 次`}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {message && (
        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {owned.map(({ card, count }) => (
          <UtilityCardTile
            key={card.id}
            card={card}
            count={count}
            className={count === 0 ? 'opacity-60' : ''}
            aside={
              count === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70">
                  可在限時小攤購買組合包，或從輪盤抽到
                </p>
              ) : null
            }
            action={
              <Button
                variant={count > 0 ? 'primary' : 'ghost'}
                disabled={count === 0 || busy === card.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                  triggerHaptic('light');
                  void handleUse(card);
                }}
                className="w-full py-2.5 text-sm"
              >
                <Zap size={15} strokeWidth={2.75} />
                <span>{count > 0 ? '使用' : '尚未擁有'}</span>
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {owned.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyState icon={<Ticket size={32} strokeWidth={1.5} />} title="目前沒有任何功能卡" />
      )}

      {/* 模擬輪盤抽獎 / 重置功能卡 used to sit here. They moved to the 管理員測試 console
          (UI/admin/, 商店與經濟) — same real wheel table, same real grant path, but no longer
          behind this bag, which is itself behind the 限時小攤, which is itself behind the
          travelling merchant's schedule. That chain is right for the SHOP and was never meant to
          gate a QA button for the ~20-hour gap between rotations. */}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The bag in a dialog — the shared pop-out, so 「我的功能卡」 is the same panel wherever it is
 * opened from (the shop header, the limited shelf's header).
 *
 * A second copy of this modal in each caller is how the two would drift into having different
 * headers, different z tiers and, eventually, different behaviour.
 */
export function UtilityCardBagModal({
  open,
  onClose,
  zIndexClassName = 'z-modal',
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** Override only when the caller lives in its own local z sub-scale (e.g. ShopView). */
  zIndexClassName?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <ModalOverlay zIndexClassName={zIndexClassName} onClick={onClose}>
          <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-2xl" className="max-h-[85vh]">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={<Ticket size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              title="我的功能卡"
              subtitle="使用後會立刻生效"
              onClose={onClose}
            />
            <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
              <UtilityCardBag />
            </div>
          </ModalShell>
        </ModalOverlay>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

/** The 我的功能卡 button, so the shop and the limited shelf open the bag the same way. */
export function UtilityCardBagButton({
  onClick,
  className = '',
}: {
  onClick: () => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => {
        playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
        onClick();
      }}
      className={`h-10 px-3.5 gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-island-line hover:border-island-teal hover:text-island-teal text-island-navy-soft flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-90 flex-shrink-0 ${className}`}
    >
      <Ticket size={16} strokeWidth={2.75} />
      <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest whitespace-nowrap">我的功能卡</span>
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { WeatherType, View } from '../../types';
import { Sun, CloudRain, CloudLightning, Snowflake, Sunset, Moon } from 'lucide-react';
import { Toast } from './DesignKit';

const WEATHER_LABEL: Record<WeatherType, string> = {
  [WeatherType.SUNNY]: '晴空萬里',
  [WeatherType.RAINY]: '細雨綿綿',
  [WeatherType.STORM]: '狂風暴雨',
  [WeatherType.SNOW]: '瑞雪紛飛',
  [WeatherType.TWILIGHT]: '暮色餘暉',
  [WeatherType.MIDNIGHT]: '星月深夜',
};

const WEATHER_ICON: Record<WeatherType, React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; className?: string }>> = {
  [WeatherType.SUNNY]: Sun,
  [WeatherType.RAINY]: CloudRain,
  [WeatherType.STORM]: CloudLightning,
  [WeatherType.SNOW]: Snowflake,
  [WeatherType.TWILIGHT]: Sunset,
  [WeatherType.MIDNIGHT]: Moon,
};

/**
 * Passive, corner-only weather notice. Replaces the old center-screen popup
 * that fired on every weather change and briefly blocked the view — this
 * never requires dismissal, never overlaps the scene, and only ever shows
 * one line at a time: a rapid string of changes (auto-cycle, real-world
 * sync) just resets the same toast's timer instead of stacking new ones.
 */
export function WeatherToast() {
  const { weather, currentView } = useApp();
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const hasMounted = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasMounted.current) {
      hasMounted.current = true;
      return;
    }
    setVisible(true);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), 2600);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [weather]);

  if (currentView !== View.HOME) return null;

  const Icon = WEATHER_ICON[weather] || Sun;

  return (
    <Toast visible={visible} icon={<Icon size={15} className="text-island-teal shrink-0" />}>
      {/* 島嶼狀態, not 天氣: 深夜 is a time of day, and "天氣轉為星月深夜"
          does not parse. Matches the settings block's own title. */}
      島嶼狀態轉為 {WEATHER_LABEL[weather] || weather}
    </Toast>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * ⚠️ 這個檔案目前**沒有被掛載**。全樹沒有任何一處 import 它。
 *
 * 島嶼天氣本身是活的 —— 但玩家看到的是另外兩個東西：角落那張通知（UI/WeatherToast.tsx，換天氣
 * 時的一行字），以及 設定 · 一般 裡的「島嶼狀態」選擇器（UI/settings/GeneralCategory.tsx）。這
 * 個 widget 是更早的一版，把兩件事做在同一張常駐卡片上。
 *
 * 保留而不刪除，是因為這一輪的目標是整理資訊架構、不是砍功能。但它需要這段標註：一個沒有入口、
 * 卻跟現行 UI 長得很像的完整元件，是下一個人最容易誤以為自己正在改的東西。要復活它的話，先決定
 * 它跟 WeatherToast 之間誰是唯一的天氣入口 —— 兩個都掛上去，就是同一件事有兩個答案。
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { WeatherType, View } from '../../types';
import { Sun, CloudRain, CloudLightning, Snowflake, Sunset, Moon, RefreshCw, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';

const weatherOrder = [
  WeatherType.SUNNY,
  WeatherType.RAINY,
  WeatherType.STORM,
  WeatherType.SNOW,
  WeatherType.TWILIGHT
];

export function AnimatedWeatherIcon({ type, size = 16, className = '', isActive = true }: { type: WeatherType; size?: number; className?: string; isActive?: boolean }) {
  const iconMap = {
    [WeatherType.SUNNY]: Sun,
    [WeatherType.RAINY]: CloudRain,
    [WeatherType.STORM]: CloudLightning,
    [WeatherType.SNOW]: Snowflake,
    [WeatherType.TWILIGHT]: Sunset,
    [WeatherType.MIDNIGHT]: Moon,
  };
  
  const IconComponent = iconMap[type] || Sun;
  
  if (!isActive) {
    return <IconComponent size={size} className={className} />;
  }

  let animateProps = {};
  let transitionProps = {};
  
  switch (type) {
    case WeatherType.SUNNY:
      animateProps = {
        rotate: 360,
        scale: [1, 1.15, 1]
      };
      transitionProps = {
        rotate: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 8,
          ease: "linear"
        },
        scale: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 3,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        }
      };
      break;
      
    case WeatherType.RAINY:
      animateProps = {
        y: [0, -2, 1, 0],
        scale: [1, 1.05, 1]
      };
      transitionProps = {
        y: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 2,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        },
        scale: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 2,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        }
      };
      break;
      
    case WeatherType.STORM:
      animateProps = {
        scale: [1, 1.2, 0.95, 1.1, 1],
        rotate: [0, -8, 8, -4, 4, 0],
        opacity: [1, 0.8, 1, 0.85, 1]
      };
      transitionProps = {
        scale: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 2.2,
          ease: "easeInOut",
          repeatDelay: 1
        },
        rotate: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 1.8,
          ease: "easeInOut",
          repeatDelay: 1
        },
        opacity: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 0.6,
          ease: "linear"
        }
      };
      break;
      
    case WeatherType.SNOW:
      animateProps = {
        rotate: [0, 30, -30, 0],
        scale: [1, 1.1, 1]
      };
      transitionProps = {
        rotate: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 5,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        },
        scale: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 3,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        }
      };
      break;
      
    case WeatherType.TWILIGHT:
      animateProps = {
        y: [0, -2, 0],
        scale: [1, 1.12, 1],
        filter: [
          "drop-shadow(0px 0px 0px rgba(249,115,22,0))", 
          "drop-shadow(0px 3px 6px rgba(249,115,22,0.4))", 
          "drop-shadow(0px 0px 0px rgba(249,115,22,0))"
        ]
      };
      transitionProps = {
        y: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 3,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        },
        scale: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 3,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        },
        filter: {
          repeat: Infinity,
          duration: 3,
          ease: "easeInOut"
        }
      };
      break;
      
    default:
      animateProps = { scale: [1, 1.05, 1] };
      transitionProps = { repeat: Infinity, duration: 2 };
  }

  return (
    <motion.span
      animate={animateProps}
      // @ts-ignore
      transition={transitionProps}
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center ${className}`}
    >
      <IconComponent size={size} />
    </motion.span>
  );
}

export function WeatherWidget() {
  const { weather, setWeather, currentView } = useApp();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(60);
  const [isAuto, setIsAuto] = useState(true);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [isSyncActive, setIsSyncActive] = useState(false);
  const [syncLoading, setSyncLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncData, setSyncData] = useState<{
    city: string;
    temp: number;
    wmoDescription: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const handleWeatherSync = async (active: boolean) => {
    setIsSyncActive(active);
    if (!active) {
      setSyncData(null);
      return;
    }

    setIsAuto(false);
    setSyncLoading(true);

    try {
      let lat = 25.0330;
      let lon = 121.5654;
      let cityName = "台北市";

      try {
        const geoRes = await fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/');
        if (geoRes.ok) {
          const geoData = await geoRes.json();
          if (geoData.latitude && geoData.longitude) {
            lat = geoData.latitude;
            lon = geoData.longitude;
            cityName = geoData.city || geoData.region || "當前位置";
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("IP Geolocation fetch failed, using fallback/navigator:", e);
      }

      if (navigator.geolocation) {
        const getCoords = () => new Promise<GeolocationPosition>((resolve, reject) => {
          navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, { timeout: 4000 });
        });
        try {
          const pos = await getCoords();
          lat = pos.coords.latitude;
          lon = pos.coords.longitude;
          cityName = "當前位置";
        } catch (e) {
          console.log("Navigator Geolocation failed or timed out, keeping IP city:", cityName);
        }
      }

      const weatherRes = await fetch(`https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${lat}&longitude=${lon}&current=weather_code,is_day,temperature_2m`);
      if (!weatherRes.ok) throw new Error("Weather API failed");
      
      const weatherData = await weatherRes.json();
      const code = weatherData.current.weather_code;
      const isDay = weatherData.current.is_day;
      const temp = weatherData.current.temperature_2m;

      let mappedType = WeatherType.SUNNY;
      let wmoDesc = "晴朗暖陽";

      if (isDay === 0) {
        mappedType = WeatherType.TWILIGHT;
        wmoDesc = "夜幕暮色";
      } else {
        if ([0, 1].includes(code)) {
          mappedType = WeatherType.SUNNY;
          wmoDesc = "晴空萬里";
        } else if ([2, 3].includes(code)) {
          mappedType = WeatherType.TWILIGHT;
          wmoDesc = "多雲多霧";
        } else if ([45, 48].includes(code)) {
          mappedType = WeatherType.TWILIGHT;
          wmoDesc = "濃霧瀰漫";
        } else if ([51, 53, 55, 61, 63, 65, 80, 81, 82].includes(code)) {
          mappedType = WeatherType.RAINY;
          wmoDesc = "陰雨綿綿";
        } else if ([95, 96, 99].includes(code)) {
          mappedType = WeatherType.STORM;
          wmoDesc = "雷雨狂風";
        } else if ([56, 57, 66, 67, 71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86].includes(code)) {
          mappedType = WeatherType.SNOW;
          wmoDesc = "白雪皚皚";
        }
      }

      setWeather(mappedType);
      setSyncData({
        city: cityName,
        temp: Math.round(temp),
        wmoDescription: wmoDesc
      });

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Real-world weather sync error:", err);
    } finally {
      setSyncLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSyncActive) return;
    
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      handleWeatherSync(true);
    }, 5 * 60 * 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isSyncActive]);

  const weatherOptions = [
    { 
      type: WeatherType.SUNNY, 
      label: '晴空萬里', 
      icon: Sun, 
      color: 'text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-400/10 hover:border-amber-400/20', 
      activeBg: 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-900 shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.35)]' 
    },
    { 
      type: WeatherType.RAINY, 
      label: '細雨綿綿', 
      icon: CloudRain, 
      color: 'text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-400/10 hover:border-blue-400/20', 
      activeBg: 'bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.35)]' 
    },
    { 
      type: WeatherType.STORM, 
      label: '狂風暴雨', 
      icon: CloudLightning, 
      color: 'text-purple-400 hover:bg-purple-400/10 hover:border-purple-400/20', 
      activeBg: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 text-white shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(147,51,234,0.35)]' 
    },
    { 
      type: WeatherType.SNOW, 
      label: '瑞雪紛飛', 
      icon: Snowflake, 
      color: 'text-sky-300 hover:bg-sky-300/10 hover:border-sky-300/20', 
      activeBg: 'bg-sky-400 text-slate-900 shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(56,189,248,0.35)]' 
    },
    { 
      type: WeatherType.TWILIGHT, 
      label: '暮色餘暉', 
      icon: Sunset, 
      color: 'text-orange-400 hover:bg-orange-400/10 hover:border-orange-400/20', 
      activeBg: 'bg-orange-500 text-white shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.35)]' 
    },
  ];

  // 1-minute automatic cycle timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuto) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          return 0; // Trigger transition in the effect below
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isAuto]);

  // Handle automatic weather transition when timeLeft reaches 0
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAuto && timeLeft === 0) {
      const currentIndex = weatherOrder.indexOf(weather);
      const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % weatherOrder.length;
      setWeather(weatherOrder[nextIndex]);
      setTimeLeft(60);
    }
  }, [timeLeft, isAuto, weather, setWeather]);

  // Show beautiful announcement when weather changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const currentOption = weatherOptions.find(o => o.type === weather);
    if (currentOption) {
      setAnnouncement(currentOption.label);
      const audioToPlay = weather === WeatherType.STORM ? SoundEffect.CLICK : SoundEffect.CLICK;
      playSound(audioToPlay);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setAnnouncement(null);
      }, 4500);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [weather]);

  // Handle manual select
  const handleSelect = (type: WeatherType) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setWeather(type);
    setTimeLeft(60); // Reset timer to give a full minute immediately
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  // Only display in standard Home View
  if (currentView !== View.HOME) {
    return null;
  }

  const currentOption = weatherOptions.find(o => o.type === weather) || weatherOptions[0];

  return (
    <>
      {/* Dynamic Poetic Screen Announcement */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {announcement && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -45, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -25, scale: 0.9 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 100, damping: 15 }}
            className="fixed top-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[100] flex flex-col items-center gap-1 px-8 py-4 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_30px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] text-center max-w-[90vw] pointer-events-none"
          >
            <div className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-white/40 font-black font-mono">
              當前氣候轉變
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-black text-white tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
              <AnimatedWeatherIcon type={weather} size={18} className={currentOption.color.split(' ')[0]} isActive={true} />
              <span>{currentOption.label}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-white/70 max-w-sm tracking-wide font-medium leading-relaxed mt-1">
              {weather === WeatherType.SUNNY && "暖陽與微風拂面，空氣中漫漂著細緻的黃金花粉..."}
              {weather === WeatherType.RAINY && "煙雨濛濛落重湖，細水在灰藍色天宇輕灑..."}
              {weather === WeatherType.STORM && "狂風怒號、烏雲翻湧！電閃雷鳴驚現，暴雨橫掃整個島嶼！"}
              {weather === WeatherType.SNOW && "冷冽極光映照天際，冬雪隨浪漫正弦風動輕旋飄逸..."}
              {weather === WeatherType.TWILIGHT && "夕陽夕暮，漫天緋紅與紫霞交織，溫暖的餘燼粒子靜靜徐升..."}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      <div className="fixed top-2 right-2 md:top-4 md:right-4 z-[75] flex flex-col items-end gap-2 pointer-events-auto">
        {/* Primary Toggle Pill Button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
            setIsOpen(!isOpen);
          }}
          className={`relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-1.5 md:gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 md:px-4 md:py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-b backdrop-blur-2xl text-white font-bold rounded-2xl select-none transition-all active:scale-95 group hover:-translate-y-0.5 focus:outline-none border ${
            weather === WeatherType.SUNNY ? 'from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/85 to-amber-950/25 border-amber-500/20 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.15)] hover:border-amber-400/40' :
            weather === WeatherType.RAINY ? 'from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/85 to-blue-950/25 border-blue-500/20 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(59,130,246,0.15)] hover:border-blue-400/40' :
            weather === WeatherType.STORM ? 'from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/85 to-purple-950/25 border-purple-500/20 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(147,51,234,0.15)] hover:border-purple-400/40' :
            weather === WeatherType.SNOW ? 'from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/85 to-sky-950/25 border-sky-400/25 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(56,189,248,0.12)] hover:border-sky-300/40' :
            'from-slate-950/90 via-slate-900/85 to-orange-950/25 border-orange-500/20 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(249,115,22,0.15)] hover:border-orange-400/40'
          }`}
        >
          {/* Subtle top-light gradient glare on header */}
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 to-transparent" />

          {/* Premium Ambient Shimmer Sweep Reflection */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ left: '-100%' }}
            animate={{ left: '100%' }}
            transition={{
              repeat: Infinity,
              duration: 3,
              ease: "easeInOut",
              repeatDelay: 2
            }}
            className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-1/2 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/5 to-transparent skew-x-12 pointer-events-none"
          />

          {/* Decorative weather live indicator glow dot */}
          <div className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 flex h-2 w-2">
            <span className={`animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${
              weather === WeatherType.SUNNY ? 'bg-amber-400' :
              weather === WeatherType.RAINY ? 'bg-blue-400' :
              weather === WeatherType.STORM ? 'bg-purple-400' :
              weather === WeatherType.SNOW ? 'bg-sky-300' :
              'bg-orange-400'
            }`} />
            <span className={`relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${
              weather === WeatherType.SUNNY ? 'bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(251,191,36,0.8)]' :
              weather === WeatherType.RAINY ? 'bg-blue-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(59,130,246,0.8)]' :
              weather === WeatherType.STORM ? 'bg-purple-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(147,51,234,0.8)]' :
              weather === WeatherType.SNOW ? 'bg-sky-300 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(56,189,248,0.8)]' :
              'bg-orange-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(249,115,22,0.8)]'
            }`} />
          </div>

          <AnimatedWeatherIcon type={weather} size={15} className={currentOption.color.split(' ')[0]} isActive={true} />
          <span className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-white/95 hidden sm:inline ml-0.5">{currentOption.label}</span>
          
          {isAuto && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-white/50 ml-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-white/10 rounded-md hidden sm:inline-block border border-white/5">
              {timeLeft}s
            </span>
          )}

          {/* Hardened Premium weather-themed progress loader bar with light glow glow */}
          {isAuto && (
            <div 
              className={`absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-[2.5px] bg-gradient-to-r transition-all duration-1000 ease-linear rounded-b-2xl ${
                weather === WeatherType.SUNNY ? 'from-amber-500 via-amber-400 to-amber-300 shadow-[0_-1px_4px_rgba(251,191,36,0.6)]' :
                weather === WeatherType.RAINY ? 'from-blue-500 via-blue-400 to-blue-300 shadow-[0_-1px_4px_rgba(59,130,246,0.6)]' :
                weather === WeatherType.STORM ? 'from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-indigo-500 shadow-[0_-1px_4px_rgba(147,51,234,0.6)]' :
                weather === WeatherType.SNOW ? 'from-sky-500 via-sky-400 to-teal-400 shadow-[0_-1px_4px_rgba(56,189,248,0.6)]' :
                'from-orange-500 via-orange-400 to-yellow-500 shadow-[0_-1px_4px_rgba(249,115,22,0.6)]'
              }`} 
              style={{ width: `${(timeLeft / 60) * 100}%` }} 
            />
          )}
        </button>

        {/* Expanded Weather Drawer Selection */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {isOpen && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10, scale: 0.95 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
              className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] w-48 relative overflow-hidden"
            >
              {/* Drawer Top Glow Effect */}
              <div className="absolute top-0 inset-x-0 h-10 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/5 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

              <div className="relative text-[10px] text-white/50 font-black px-3 py-2 uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-center select-none flex items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 bg-white/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
                <span>選擇氣候環境</span>
                <span className="w-1 h-1 bg-white/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
                {/* Horizontal bottom line decoration */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-2 h-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/10 to-transparent" />
              </div>
              
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 mt-1">
                {weatherOptions.map((opt) => {
                  const isActive = weather === opt.type;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={opt.type}
                      onClick={() => handleSelect(opt.type)}
                      className={`relative flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-black transition-all group overflow-hidden ${
                        isActive 
                          ? `${opt.activeBg} font-extrabold scale-[1.02]` 
                          : `text-white/60 hover:text-white border border-transparent hover:bg-white/5 ${opt.color.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ')}`
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Interactive hover glow highlight inside buttons */}
                      {!isActive && (
                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/5 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-1000 ease-out" />
                      )}
                      
                      <AnimatedWeatherIcon type={opt.type} size={17} isActive={isActive} className={isActive ? "" : opt.color.split(' ')[0]} />
                      <span className="tracking-wide">{opt.label}</span>

                      {/* Small glowing trailing circle for selected climate */}
                      {isActive && (
                        <motion.div 
                          layoutId="activeIndicator"
                          className="absolute right-3.5 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.9)]"
                        />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Automatic Cycle Toggle Switch */}
              <div className="mt-1 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 px-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-white/50 font-black flex items-center gap-1 select-none">
                  <RefreshCw size={10} className={isAuto ? "animate-spin" : ""} style={{ animationDuration: '4s' }} />
                  自動變換 (1分)
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                    setIsAuto(!isAuto);
                    if (!isAuto) setTimeLeft(60);
                    // Turn off weather sync if auto is toggled on
                    if (!isAuto) setIsSyncActive(false);
                  }}
                  className={`relative w-8 h-4.5 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors duration-300 pointer-events-auto ${
                    isAuto ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-400 to-sky-400' : 'bg-white/20'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`bg-white w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full shadow-md transform transition-transform duration-300 ${
                      isAuto ? 'translate-x-3.5' : 'translate-x-0'
                    }`}
                  />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Real-world Weather Sync Toggle Switch */}
              <div className="mt-1 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 px-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-white/50 font-black flex items-center gap-1 select-none">
                    <Clock size={10} className={isSyncActive ? "animate-pulse text-amber-400" : ""} />
                    真實世界天氣同步
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                      const nextVal = !isSyncActive;
                      handleWeatherSync(nextVal);
                    }}
                    disabled={syncLoading}
                    className={`relative w-8 h-4.5 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors duration-300 pointer-events-auto ${
                      isSyncActive ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-orange-500' : 'bg-white/20'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div
                      className={`bg-white w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full shadow-md transform transition-transform duration-300 ${
                        isSyncActive ? 'translate-x-3.5' : 'translate-x-0'
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Loading / Synced Info Display */}
                {syncLoading && (
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-white/40 italic flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1 py-0.5">
                    <span className="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border border-white/30 border-t-white animate-spin" />
                    獲取當前氣象中...
                  </div>
                )}

                {!syncLoading && syncData && (
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300/90 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg flex flex-col gap-0.5 mt-0.5 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-white/80 font-black">📍 {syncData.city}</span>
                      <span className="font-extrabold">{syncData.temp}°C</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-white/40 text-[8px] tracking-wider uppercase font-black">
                      氣象狀態：<span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{syncData.wmoDescription}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/WorkoutRewardPopup.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import { Dumbbell, Gift, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { getItemById } from '../../constants/items';
import { getItemCategoryLabel } from '../../utils/categoryUtils';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { vibrateGoalCompleted } from '../../lib/vibration';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { ONBOARDING_MODAL_CLASS, useOnboardingSlot } from '../../lib/onboardingQueue';
import { QVersionIcon } from '../QVersionIcon';
import { Button, ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader } from './DesignKit';

/**
 * 健身獎勵通知 — 「恭喜完成第一次健身！」 and the item it came with.
 *
 * The view half of 健身獎勵, and it decides nothing. Every word on it comes from the rule's row in
 * constants/workoutRewards.ts, and the item is already in the player's inventory and on their save
 * by the time this component knows it exists (context/useWorkoutRewards.ts). That ordering is the
 * feature's §12/§16 and it is worth stating from this side too: **this popup cannot be the reason a
 * player has an item, and closing it cannot be the reason they lose one.** If it never renders — a
 * reload at the wrong moment, a tab closed on the way back — the reward is still theirs.
 *
 * ## Why it waits for the island
 *
 * The grant happens the instant the workout ends, which is while 運動 is still full-screen. Showing
 * it there would put a reward card on top of the workout's own 運動挑戰成功！ summary, and the brief
 * (§15) asks for it on the way back. So the popup queues on `View.HOME` — the notice sits in the
 * provider until the player is home, however long that takes, and the queue (lib/onboardingQueue.ts)
 * decides whether anything else has the screen first.
 *
 * ## The design
 *
 * A plain DesignKit modal — `ModalOverlay` + `ModalShell` + `PanelHeader` + one `Button` — because
 * that is what every other reward dialog in this game is (LoginBonusPopup, IslandReturnPanel), and
 * a newbie gift is not the moment to introduce a second visual language. Deliberately NOT the
 * 稀有度揭曉 / 每日領取 treatment: those are full-screen dark-stage reveals reserved for a 神話
 * purchase and the once-a-day round, and spending that vocabulary on a 120-金幣 hat would leave
 * nothing louder for the things that are meant to be loud. One confetti burst and the reward chime
 * is the whole of the celebration.
 */
export function WorkoutRewardPopup() {
  const { workoutReward, dismissWorkoutReward, currentView } = useApp();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

  // Opened by the notice arriving, not by a render — same as IslandReturnPanel: mirroring it into
  // local state is what lets the exit animation play, since clearing the context value straight
  // away would unmount the panel mid-fade.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!workoutReward) return;
    setIsOpen(true);
  }, [workoutReward]);

  /**
   * 回到主畫面才顯示 (§15).
   *
   * `queued` is the whole condition — there is no separate `ready`, because for this surface
   * wanting the screen and being able to draw are the same thing. A player who finishes a workout
   * and then goes straight to the shop simply gets the card when they come back out.
   */
  const onScreen = useOnboardingSlot('workoutReward', isOpen && !!workoutReward && currentView === View.HOME);

  const handleClose = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setIsOpen(false);
    dismissWorkoutReward();
  };

  useEscapeToClose(handleClose, onScreen);

  // The celebration fires when the card actually reaches the screen, not when the notice was
  // published — those can be minutes apart if the player wandered off first.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onScreen) return;
    playSound(SoundEffect.REWARD);
    vibrateGoalCompleted();

    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    // Its own canvas: the library's global one sits at z-index 100, far below `.z-modal` (1000), so
    // a global burst would fire behind this dialog. Same reason DailyClaimReveal creates one.
    const fire = confetti.create(canvas, { resize: true });
    fire({
      particleCount: 90,
      spread: 70,
      startVelocity: 38,
      origin: { x: 0.5, y: 0.45 },
      ticks: 110,
      // Chrome tokens rather than a party palette — teal, cream, sand, navy (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md).
      // 金幣 gold is deliberately absent: nothing here is currency.
      colors: ['#2A9D8F', '#5FBDAF', '#EFE9DC', '#264653'],
      disableForReducedMotion: true,
    });
    return () => {
      fire.reset();
    };
  }, [onScreen]);

  if (!workoutReward) return null;

  const item = getItemById(workoutReward.itemId);
  const { rule } = workoutReward;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {onScreen && (
        <ModalOverlay className={ONBOARDING_MODAL_CLASS} onClick={handleClose}>
          <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-md" className="max-h-[90vh] relative">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={<Dumbbell size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              title={`🎉 ${rule.title}`}
              subtitle="Newbie Reward"
              onClose={handleClose}
            />

            <div className="p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-island-navy leading-relaxed text-center">
                  {rule.message}
                </p>

                {/* The item well — the shop card's own treatment (cream field, thin line, the
                    hand-drawn icon at rest in the middle of it), so the thing the player has just
                    been given looks like the thing they will later find in their wardrobe. */}
                <div className="bg-island-cream-2 rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-line p-6 flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="text-island-navy flex items-center justify-center">
                    {item ? (
                      <QVersionIcon itemId={item.id} size={120} />
                    ) : (
                      // Only reachable if the granted item is later retired from the catalog. The
                      // reward still happened, so the card still says so rather than showing a hole.
                      <div className="w-[120px] h-[120px] flex items-center justify-center text-island-navy-soft/40">
                        <Gift size={56} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft/70 uppercase tracking-widest">
                      獲得
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-2xl font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight text-center">
                      {item?.name ?? '新手小禮物'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-white border border-island-line rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft">
                      {getItemCategoryLabel(workoutReward.itemId)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-island-sand border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3">
                  <Sparkles size={16} className="text-island-teal shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy leading-relaxed">
                    已經放進你的背包了，到更衣室就能換上。
                  </span>
                </div>

                <Button onClick={handleClose} className="w-full py-4 text-lg">
                  收下
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none"
            />
          </ModalShell>
        </ModalOverlay>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/YouTubeMusicHost.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { Play, Pause, SkipBack, SkipForward } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import {
  subscribeYtm, getYtmSnapshot, nextYtm, prevYtm, setYtmSlot, unmuteYtm,
} from '../../lib/youtubeMusic';
import { toggleBackgroundMusicPlayback } from '../../lib/backgroundMusic';

export function useYtm() {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeYtm, getYtmSnapshot, getYtmSnapshot);
}

/**
 * The YouTube player's on-screen window, rendered inside the Settings screen.
 *
 * IT IS A WINDOW, NOT THE PLAYER. The div below is an empty placeholder; the
 * real iframe is owned by lib/youtubeMusic.ts, parented to <body>, and merely
 * positioned over this rectangle for as long as this panel is mounted (see
 * setYtmSlot). Unmounting the panel parks the player off-screen and the music
 * keeps playing - which is the whole point, and the reason this component no
 * longer creates or destroys anything.
 *
 * The video surface is visible rather than hidden while Settings is open:
 * YouTube's Terms require the embedded player to be visible, and a
 * `display:none` host also makes the API refuse to begin playback at all.
 */
export function YouTubeMusicPanel() {
  const { settings } = useApp();
  const slotRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const ytm = useYtm();

  const bgmVolume = settings?.bgmVolume ?? 0.5;
  const isMuted = settings?.isMuted ?? false;

  // Claim the player for the duration of this panel, and hand it back on the way
  // out. No creation, no teardown, no `mountedRef` bookkeeping: this effect is
  // safe to run twice (React StrictMode does exactly that) because the second
  // run only re-states where the player should be.
  useEffect(() => {
    setYtmSlot(slotRef.current);
    return () => setYtmSlot(null);
  }, []);

  const isPlaying = ytm.status === 'playing';

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-island-line overflow-hidden">
      {/* The player lands here. Kept black so the rectangle reads as a video
          surface in the frame between the panel appearing and the placement
          loop's first frame. */}
      <div className="bg-black w-full aspect-video">
        <div ref={slotRef} className="w-full h-full" />
      </div>

      {/* The two settings that silently produce "no sound", called out where the
          user is looking when it happens rather than left to be discovered. */}
      {isMuted && (
        <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-t border-amber-200 px-4 py-2">
          背景音樂目前為靜音,YouTube 也會跟著暫停。請先解除上方的靜音。
        </div>
      )}
      {!isMuted && bgmVolume < 0.05 && (
        <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-t border-amber-200 px-4 py-2">
          背景音樂音量接近 0,YouTube 會沒有聲音。請調高上方的音量滑桿。
        </div>
      )}

      {/* The player muted itself (YouTube's autoplay fallback). We clear this
          automatically on every play path, but if one slips through, this makes
          the cause visible and one click away instead of a silent mystery. */}
      {!isMuted && ytm.playerMuted && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-t border-amber-200 px-4 py-2">
          <span>YouTube 播放器被瀏覽器設為靜音,所以畫面在動卻沒有聲音。</span>
          <button
            onClick={unmuteYtm}
            className="shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 text-white hover:bg-amber-700 transition-colors active:scale-95"
          >
            解除靜音
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Live read-back of what the player itself reports, so "no sound" can be
          diagnosed from the screen rather than guessed at. */}
      {ytm.hasQueue && (
        <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-island-navy-soft/70 border-t border-island-line px-4 py-1.5">
          狀態 {ytm.status} · 播放器音量 {ytm.playerVolume} · {ytm.playerMuted ? '靜音中' : '未靜音'}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy truncate">
            {ytm.title || (ytm.status === 'loading' ? '載入中…' : ytm.status === 'cued' ? '已就緒,點一下畫面即可播放' : '尚未選擇音樂')}
          </div>
          {ytm.author && (
            <div className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft truncate">{ytm.author}</div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={prevYtm}
            disabled={!ytm.isPlaylist}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-island-navy-soft hover:bg-island-line/40 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors"
            title="上一首"
          >
            <SkipBack size={14} />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={toggleBackgroundMusicPlayback}
            disabled={!ytm.hasQueue}
            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-red-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-30 transition-all active:scale-95"
            title={isPlaying ? '暫停' : '播放'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? <Pause size={16} /> : <Play size={16} />}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={nextYtm}
            disabled={!ytm.isPlaylist}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-island-navy-soft hover:bg-island-line/40 disabled:opacity-30 transition-colors"
            title="下一首"
          >
            <SkipForward size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/ZoomControl.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { ZoomIn, ZoomOut } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { useIsTouchDevice } from '../../hooks/useIsTouchDevice';
import { useViewportWidth } from '../../hooks/useViewportWidth';
import { PortholeFrame } from './DesignKit';
import { BUTTON_ZOOM_STEP } from '../../constants/cameraZoom';
// Station 4 of the 新手引導 (NewbieTour.tsx) — the dial is also the 人稱 switch:
// zooming all the way in crosses into first person (see CameraController).
import { TOUR_TARGET, tourTag } from '../../constants/tourTargets';

/**
 * Single source of truth for the camera-zoom UI. Previously this was
 * implemented twice — once in SideButtons for desktop, once in
 * MobileControls for touch — each gated by its own "is this mobile" check.
 * The two checks used different heuristics and could both evaluate false
 * at once (e.g. a narrow but mouse-driven desktop window), which made the
 * zoom control disappear entirely. One component, one visibility check.
 */
export function ZoomControl() {
  const { currentView, uiScale, setUiScale } = useApp();
  const isTouch = useIsTouchDevice();
  // Only consulted once we already know this is a desktop (mouse) session —
  // never used to decide mobile-vs-desktop on its own (see useViewportWidth's
  // own doc comment for why: width alone false-positives on touch tablets).
  const viewportWidth = useViewportWidth();
  const desktopDialSize = !isTouch && viewportWidth >= 1536 ? 112 : !isTouch && viewportWidth >= 1280 ? 100 : 90;

  const visible = currentView === View.HOME || currentView === View.BUILDING_INTERIOR;
  const dialSize = isTouch ? 64 : desktopDialSize;
  // 44px is the smallest comfortable touch target — the previous 36px
  // touch buttons (kept small to save vertical space) were the tightest,
  // smallest cluster in a mobile UX pass, so both size and gap go up here.
  // Desktop values also step up further at xl:/2xl: — safe with plain width
  // breakpoints here since this string is only ever applied when isTouch is
  // false, so a touch tablet never reads it regardless of its own width.
  const btnSizeClass = isTouch ? 'w-11 h-11' : 'w-14 h-14 xl:w-16 xl:h-16';
  const iconSize = isTouch ? 18 : 26;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {visible && (
        <motion.div
          key="zoom-panel"
          {...tourTag(TOUR_TARGET.camera)}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
          // Placed (right edge, above 幸運轉盤 in the rail's lower dock) by the
          // `mid-right` HUD region (HudFrame.tsx) — no longer `fixed right-8
          // top-1/2`, so it can't collide with the bottom NavBar on short
          // screens, nor with the wheel it now shares a column with. `relative`
          // keeps the z-hud-toolbar tier for local stacking within the frame.
          className={`relative z-hud-toolbar flex flex-col items-center pointer-events-auto ${isTouch ? 'gap-2.5' : 'gap-4'}`}
        >
          <button
            onClick={() => setUiScale((prev) => prev + BUTTON_ZOOM_STEP)}
            className={`${btnSizeClass} bg-island-cream hover:bg-island-teal/10 active:scale-90 text-island-navy rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all shadow-sm border border-island-line hover:border-island-teal cursor-pointer`}
            title="放大視角"
          >
            <ZoomIn size={iconSize} />
          </button>

          {/* Depth-gauge dial — a porthole reading uiScale like an instrument, not a plain label. */}
          <PortholeFrame size={dialSize} className="shadow-lg">
            <div
              className="absolute inset-[6px] rounded-full pointer-events-none"
              style={{
                background: 'repeating-conic-gradient(var(--color-island-line) 0deg 2deg, transparent 2deg 18deg)',
                WebkitMask: 'radial-gradient(circle, transparent 68%, black 70%, black 88%, transparent 90%)',
                mask: 'radial-gradient(circle, transparent 68%, black 70%, black 88%, transparent 90%)',
              }}
            />
            <span className={`relative font-black text-island-navy select-none font-mono tracking-widest ${isTouch ? 'text-[10px]' : 'text-sm xl:text-base'}`}>
              {Math.round(uiScale * 100)}%
            </span>
          </PortholeFrame>

          <button
            onClick={() => setUiScale((prev) => prev - BUTTON_ZOOM_STEP)}
            className={`${btnSizeClass} bg-island-cream hover:bg-island-teal/10 active:scale-90 text-island-navy rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all shadow-sm border border-island-line hover:border-island-teal cursor-pointer`}
            title="縮小視角"
          >
            <ZoomOut size={iconSize} />
          </button>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { setMerchantAlwaysDocked } from '../../../constants/merchantVisit';

/**
 * 管理員測試模式下，島邊那艘商船一直停在岸邊。
 *
 * ## 它為什麼是一個元件，而不是一行 `if`
 *
 * 「商人在不在」的權威是 constants/merchantVisit.ts，而那裡是純函式 —— 它被
 * Three/MerchantVisitor.tsx 在 `useFrame` 裡呼叫，那個位置讀不到 React context（也不該為了
 * 一個布林值把整艘船接上 provider）。所以覆寫是一格模組層級的開關，需要有人從 React 這一側
 * 把帳號設定推進去。
 *
 * 推的那個人就是這個元件，而它整個 render 什麼都不畫（回傳 `null`）：它的全部行為在
 * `useEffect` 的兩端。掛載 = 打開，卸載 = 關掉。
 *
 * ## 為什麼那樣就夠了
 *
 * 因為它掛在 `<AdminOnly>` 裡面（App.tsx），而 `<AdminOnly>` 在管理員測試模式關閉時回傳的是
 * `null` **而不是一個被隱藏的元素** —— 也就是說這個元件會真的被卸載，cleanup 會真的跑。
 * 「關掉開關」與「歸零覆寫」因此不是兩件要記得同步的事，是同一次卸載。
 *
 * 這是刻意不寫成 `useEffect(() => setMerchantAlwaysDocked(isAdmin), [isAdmin])` 的理由：那種
 * 寫法要求這個元件對正式玩家也一直掛著，而一格「正式玩家身上也在跑的管理員程式碼」正是
 * `<AdminOnly>` 存在要避免的東西。
 *
 * ## 它改的是行程，不是時鐘
 *
 * 船不走，但檔期照走：貨架仍然每 7 天換一批，商人仍然會換成「下一趟」。所以這個開關測得到
 * 換檔（那是這家店最容易出錯的一刻），只是不用等四天才能再跟商人講話。
 */
export function AdminMerchantDock() {
  useEffect(() => {
    setMerchantAlwaysDocked(true);
    return () => setMerchantAlwaysDocked(false);
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

## src/components/UI/admin/AdminTestConsole.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 【管理員測試】 — the single entrance to every test-only control in the game.
 *
 * ## What this replaced
 *
 * Switching 管理員測試模式 on used to change SEVEN screens at once. A quick-supply row appeared
 * inside the player's own profile card; a zoom dial appeared on the right edge of the island; the
 * shop grew a 清空裝備 button next to its wallet and a 重製 button inside the collection drawer;
 * 帳號中心 gained four stacked developer panels; the pet care sheet grew a row of state buttons;
 * the 功能卡 bag grew two more; and 設定 grew an extra switch. None of them announced themselves,
 * several of them sat inside chrome a player uses constantly, and the only way to find out what
 * existed was to flip the switch and go looking for what had changed.
 *
 * Now the switch adds exactly one thing to the screen: an edge tab. Everything else lives behind
 * it, in categories (adminTestSections.tsx).
 *
 * This file is the PANEL. The handle that opens it is AdminTestLauncher.tsx, which has the write-up
 * on where an edge tab can and cannot go on this screen.
 *
 * ## Why a side panel and not a modal
 *
 * 「測試時仍能看到遊戲」 is the requirement, so this deliberately has no scrim and no backdrop: a
 * modal overlay would dim the very thing the panel exists to let you watch, and swallow the clicks
 * that drive it. The island keeps rendering, keeps taking WASD, and keeps being clickable while the
 * panel is open. On a 1440px window the panel is 21rem — under a quarter of the width — and it is
 * pinned to the right edge, which is the side the game has the least on.
 *
 * On a phone it becomes a bottom sheet instead of a narrow column, because a 320px side panel on a
 * 390px screen is not a side panel, it is a full-screen modal with a sliver of game showing. See
 * `.admin-console-panel` in index.css for the four tiers.
 *
 * ## Information architecture: list first, category second
 *
 * The panel opens on a table of CONTENTS — six category cards, each naming what is inside it —
 * rather than on the controls themselves. That is the whole point: the complaint this replaced was
 * that turning the mode on produced a screen of unexplained buttons and no answer to
 * 「有哪些類型的測試功能」. Panel → 分類 → 功能, never all of it at once.
 *
 * ## Open / minimize / close
 *
 * Three states, not two, because a tester working through 家具 + NPC + 動畫 puts the panel away and
 * picks it up constantly:
 *
 *   closed     the handle alone. Reopening starts at the category list.
 *   minimized  the handle, naming the category still loaded; restoring returns to that screen.
 *   open       the panel.
 *
 * ## Isolation
 *
 * Both this and the launcher are mounted inside `<AdminOnly>` in App.tsx, which returns `null` —
 * not a hidden element — when 管理員測試模式 is off. Nothing here is mounted, no effect is
 * registered, no keyboard listener is attached and no context work happens for a normal player.
 * The 3D scene, the HUD and every game view are byte-for-byte what they were before this existed.
 */

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, FlaskConical, Minus, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../../context/AppContext';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../../lib/soundUtils';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { HAS_DEBUG_OVERRIDE } from '../../../utils/debugOverrides';
import { AdminStatePill } from './AdminTestKit';
import { ADMIN_SECTIONS } from './adminTestSections';
import { useAdminTest } from './AdminTestContext';

/**
 * The front page: what kinds of test functions exist.
 *
 * Cards rather than a flat button list, because the brief's complaint was precisely
 * 「Button Button Button 全部排列在一起」. Each card names the category, says in one line what it is
 * for, and lists the controls inside it — so the answer to 「有哪些類型的測試功能」 is legible
 * without opening anything.
 */
function AdminSectionList({ onPick }: { onPick: (id: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      {ADMIN_SECTIONS.map((section) => (
        <button
          key={section.id}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPick(section.id)}
          className="w-full text-left rounded-[1.5rem] border border-island-line bg-white/70 hover:bg-white hover:border-island-teal/45 transition-all active:scale-[0.99] p-3.5 group"
        >
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <span className="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-island-teal/12 border border-island-teal/30 text-island-teal-dark flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
              {section.icon}
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <h4 className="text-[13px] font-black text-island-navy leading-tight truncate">
                  {section.label}
                </h4>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-shrink-0 text-island-navy-soft/60 group-hover:text-island-teal-dark transition-colors">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-black tabular-nums">{section.entries.length}</span>
                  <ChevronRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.75} />
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/85 leading-snug mt-1">
                {section.tagline}
              </p>
              {/* The contents, spelled out. This is the line that makes the front page a table of
                  contents instead of a menu — a tester looking for 「重置功能卡」 finds the word
                  itself here rather than having to guess which category owns it. */}
              <p className="text-[9px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60 leading-snug mt-1.5">
                {section.entries.join('・')}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The always-visible strip under the header: what is switched on right now, across categories. */
function AdminStatusStrip() {
  const { settings } = useApp();
  const { showZoomDial } = useAdminTest();

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 border-b border-island-line bg-island-cream-2/70">
      <AdminStatePill tone="on">測試模式啟用中</AdminStatePill>
      <AdminStatePill tone={settings?.adminOwnAllItems ? 'on' : 'off'}>
        全部商品{settings?.adminOwnAllItems ? '已開' : '未開'}
      </AdminStatePill>
      <AdminStatePill tone={showZoomDial ? 'on' : 'off'}>
        轉盤{showZoomDial ? '顯示' : '隱藏'}
      </AdminStatePill>
      {/* Only when it is actually doing something — a permanent 「未使用」 chip for a URL parameter
          nobody typed would be noise on the one strip that has to stay scannable. The full
          read-out lives in 商店與經濟. */}
      {HAS_DEBUG_OVERRIDE && <AdminStatePill tone="warn">網址覆寫生效中</AdminStatePill>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AdminTestConsole() {
  const { mode, section, close, minimize, openSection } = useAdminTest();

  const active = useMemo(
    () => ADMIN_SECTIONS.find((s) => s.id === section) ?? null,
    [section],
  );

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    close();
  }, [close]);

  /**
   * Escape steps BACK one level before it closes, so a tester deep in a category is not thrown all
   * the way out by the key they were using to leave a dialog. It is only armed while the panel is
   * open — closed and minimized states leave Escape to whatever else on screen wants it.
   */
  const handleEscape = useCallback(() => {
    if (section) {
      openSection(null);
      return;
    }
    close();
  }, [section, openSection, close]);
  useEscapeToClose(handleEscape, mode === 'open');

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {mode === 'open' && (
        <motion.aside
          key="panel"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 24, y: 24 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 24, y: 24 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label="管理員測試面板"
          /* No scrim, deliberately. A modal backdrop would dim exactly the thing the panel exists
             to let you keep watching, and would swallow the clicks that drive the game — the whole
             point is that the island stays live and playable beside the panel. */
          className="admin-console-panel z-admin-console flex flex-col bg-island-cream border border-island-line shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(38,70,83,0.28)] overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto"
        >
          <header className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-3 border-b border-island-line bg-island-navy text-white flex-shrink-0">
            {active ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                  openSection(null);
                }}
                title="回到分類列表"
                aria-label="回到分類列表"
                className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-white/12 hover:bg-white/22 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors active:scale-90 flex-shrink-0"
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={15} strokeWidth={3} />
              </button>
            ) : (
              <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-white/12 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                <FlaskConical size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </span>
            )}

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h3 className="text-[13px] font-black leading-tight truncate">
                {active ? active.label : '管理員測試'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[9px] font-bold text-white/60 leading-tight truncate">
                {active ? active.tagline : `${ADMIN_SECTIONS.length} 個分類・僅在管理員測試模式下存在`}
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                minimize();
              }}
              title="收合成小按鈕（保留目前分類）"
              aria-label="收合管理員測試面板"
              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-white/12 hover:bg-white/22 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors active:scale-90 flex-shrink-0"
            >
              <Minus size={15} strokeWidth={3} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              title="關閉（下次從分類列表開始）"
              aria-label="關閉管理員測試面板"
              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-white/12 hover:bg-island-coral/70 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors active:scale-90 flex-shrink-0"
            >
              <X size={15} strokeWidth={3} />
            </button>
          </header>

          <AdminStatusStrip />

          {/* `[&>*]:flex-shrink-0` 是這一行唯一不明顯的地方，而它不是裝飾：這是一個 `flex flex-col`
              的捲動容器，而 flex item 預設 `flex-shrink: 1`。少了它，內容比容器高的時候瀏覽器不會
              讓容器捲動，而是把**每一個分區壓扁**到剛好塞進去 —— 每一張卡都被裁掉大約一半，而且因為
              分區自己是 `overflow-hidden`，被裁掉的那一半不會留下任何痕跡：看起來就像那些控制項沒有
              被寫出來。六個分類全都比面板高，所以這件事在每一個分類上都會發生。 */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5 [&>*]:flex-shrink-0">
            {active ? <active.Body /> : <AdminSectionList onPick={(id) => {
              playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
              openSection(id);
            }} />}
          </div>
        </motion.aside>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/admin/AdminTestContext.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * The 管理員測試 console's own session state — which is deliberately NOT part of the save.
 *
 * WHY A CONTEXT AT ALL. Two things outside the console need to agree with it:
 *
 *   1. App.tsx's `mid-right` HUD slot, which draws the 鏡頭遠近轉盤 only while the console says
 *      to (see {@link AdminTestState.showZoomDial}).
 *   2. NewbieTour's station 4, whose whole subject IS that dial — a spotlight cut over an empty
 *      corner is worse than a shorter tour, which is why the station already drops out for normal
 *      players and now follows the dial itself rather than the admin flag.
 *
 * WHY NOT `settings`. Every field on AppSettings is written to Firestore, and this project has
 * been bitten before by a new profile field that firestore.rules did not know about — the write
 * is not merely refused, the next profile READ collapses into a starter stub. None of this state
 * is worth that risk: 「面板現在是開的」 is not something a save should remember, and a tester who
 * reloads wants the game back, not the panel they left open. `adminTestMode` itself stays where it
 * is (SettingsView) because THAT is a preference; everything here is a window.
 *
 * The whole thing collapses to `closed` the moment 管理員測試模式 is switched off, so turning it
 * back on later always lands on the console's front page rather than mid-way into a category
 * somebody opened days ago.
 */

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useAdminMode } from '../../../hooks/useAdminMode';

/**
 * `minimized` is a third state and not 「closed with a memory」:
 *
 *   closed     nothing but the edge tab. Reopening starts at the category list.
 *   minimized  a small pill that names the category still loaded. Restoring returns to exactly
 *              that screen, mid-scroll position aside.
 *
 * That difference is the reason both exist. Testing 家具 + NPC + 動畫 at once means putting the
 * panel away and picking it up repeatedly, and a 「close」 that silently kept its place would make
 * the X unable to mean 「I'm done with this」.
 */
export type AdminConsoleMode = 'closed' | 'open' | 'minimized';

export interface AdminTestState {
  mode: AdminConsoleMode;
  /** Id of the open category, or `null` for the category list itself. */
  section: string | null;
  /** Whether the Admin-only camera zoom dial is drawn in the HUD's right rail. */
  showZoomDial: boolean;

  open: () => void;
  close: () => void;
  minimize: () => void;
  restore: () => void;
  openSection: (id: string | null) => void;
  setShowZoomDial: (next: boolean) => void;
}

const AdminTestCtx = createContext<AdminTestState | null>(null);

export function AdminTestProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const isAdminMode = useAdminMode();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<AdminConsoleMode>('closed');
  const [section, setSection] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // ON by default so nothing a tester had yesterday is missing today: with 管理員測試模式 on and
  // the console untouched, the dial is exactly where it has always been.
  const [showZoomDial, setShowZoomDial] = useState(true);

  // 管理員測試模式 off is a hard reset, not a hidden panel — see the file comment.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAdminMode) return;
    setMode('closed');
    setSection(null);
  }, [isAdminMode]);

  const open = useCallback(() => setMode('open'), []);
  const minimize = useCallback(() => setMode('minimized'), []);
  const restore = useCallback(() => setMode('open'), []);
  const close = useCallback(() => {
    setMode('closed');
    setSection(null);
  }, []);
  const openSection = useCallback((id: string | null) => setSection(id), []);

  const value = useMemo<AdminTestState>(
    () => ({ mode, section, showZoomDial, open, close, minimize, restore, openSection, setShowZoomDial }),
    [mode, section, showZoomDial, open, close, minimize, restore, openSection],
  );

  return <AdminTestCtx.Provider value={value}>{children}</AdminTestCtx.Provider>;
}

/**
 * Never throws when the provider is missing — the console is optional chrome, and a consumer that
 * white-screens the game because a QA-only wrapper was left out is a worse bug than the missing
 * panel. The fallback reads as 「console closed, dial visible」, i.e. the pre-console behaviour.
 */
export function useAdminTest(): AdminTestState {
  return (
    useContext(AdminTestCtx) ?? {
      mode: 'closed',
      section: null,
      showZoomDial: true,
      open: () => {},
      close: () => {},
      minimize: () => {},
      restore: () => {},
      openSection: () => {},
      setShowZoomDial: () => {},
    }
  );
}
```
