## src/components/UI/minimap/miniMapCore.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { getActiveViewerPos, playerBus } from '../../../lib/playerBus';

/**
 * Shared MiniMap system — the scene-independent half.
 *
 * WHY THIS EXISTS: the minimap used to be one component that did everything
 * (read the player, lay out the house, draw the plan, style the card) and
 * therefore only ever worked for one scene, at one zoom, in one orientation.
 * The pieces are now split so a second scene (the island, another floor, a
 * dungeon) is a *drawing*, not a second minimap:
 *
 *   miniMapCore.ts        — the pose (position, character facing, camera
 *                           heading) and the world→px scale.
 *   MiniMapViewport.tsx   — the round window: follows the player and turns the
 *                           map to the camera.
 *   MiniMapMarker.tsx     — the indicator system: the player's own arrow, plus
 *                           the world-anchored marker any NPC/quest target
 *                           reuses.
 *   MiniMapFrame.tsx      — the ship's-wheel bezel and its nameplate.
 *   <scene>.tsx           — world-space SVG for one place
 *                           (InteriorMiniMapScene is the first).
 *
 * A new scene supplies world-unit bounds and SVG children drawn through
 * {@link mmPx}. It inherits tracking, rotation, smoothing, the frame and the
 * responsive sizing for free, and it cannot drift from the interior map
 * because there is only one implementation of each of those.
 *
 * ── THE TWO ROTATIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * They are separate inputs with separate sources, and neither is derived from
 * the other:
 *
 *   MAP     turns with the CAMERA ({@link MiniMapPose.viewDeg}), so the map is
 *           heading-up: what is in front of you is at the top of the window.
 *   ARROW   turns with the CHARACTER MODEL ({@link MiniMapPose.facingDeg}), so
 *           orbiting the camera around a standing character swings the map
 *           while the arrow keeps pointing at whatever the character is
 *           actually facing.
 *
 * Every angle in this system is authored in ONE frame: screen-clockwise
 * degrees from up on a north-up map — the bearing of the thing in the world.
 * The viewport is the only place that frame is converted to screen, and it
 * does it once (see MiniMapViewport). That is what keeps the two rotations
 * from contaminating each other and what lets a future NPC/quest indicator
 * state a plain world bearing and land correctly on a turning map.
 */

/**
 * Rendered pixels per world unit — the map's zoom, and the reason the map is
 * legible now.
 *
 * The old map *fitted the whole house* into a ~136px box, so its zoom fell as
 * the player expanded: a room was ~68px across with the three starter rooms
 * and ~34px in a 4x4 house, i.e. the more there was to read, the smaller it
 * was drawn. A fixed scale plus a player-following viewport (below) instead
 * gives every room the same 72px on screen forever, and expansion scrolls
 * rather than shrinks.
 */
export const MINIMAP_PX_PER_WORLD = 6;

/** World units → the px space every minimap scene draws in. */
export const mmPx = (world: number) => world * MINIMAP_PX_PER_WORLD;

/**
 * How far past a scene's own bounds its paper is drawn, in world units.
 *
 * The viewport is a follow-camera, so when the player stands at the very edge
 * of the scene half the window looks at nothing. This has to exceed the
 * largest possible viewport *radius* (--minimap-w caps the window at ~200px,
 * so ~17 world units) with room to spare for the corners a rotated square
 * would otherwise expose.
 */
export const MINIMAP_WORLD_PAD = 32;

export interface MiniMapPose {
  /** World XZ of whatever the player is currently looking through. */
  x: number;
  z: number;
  /**
   * Bearing of the CHARACTER MODEL — screen-clockwise degrees from up on a
   * north-up map. See {@link worldYawToFacingDeg}.
   */
  facingDeg: number;
  /**
   * Bearing the CAMERA is looking along, in the same frame. The map is turned
   * by exactly `-viewDeg`, which is what puts this direction at the top of the
   * window. See {@link cameraYawToViewDeg}.
   */
  viewDeg: number;
}

const RAD2DEG = 180 / Math.PI;

/**
 * A three.js Y-rotation (the yaw an avatar/NPC/prop is turned by) → that
 * subject's bearing on the map.
 *
 * The one conversion, so every indicator agrees. In the map's north-up frame
 * world +X is screen right and world +Z is screen down. A yaw of `r` points
 * the model along (sin r, cos r) — Avatar.tsx steers with
 * `atan2(move.x, move.z)`, which is that same convention — and the
 * clockwise-from-up angle of that direction is `180° - r`.
 */
export function worldYawToFacingDeg(yaw: number): number {
  return 180 - yaw * RAD2DEG;
}

/**
 * A camera's Y-rotation → the bearing it is looking along, in the same frame
 * as {@link worldYawToFacingDeg}.
 *
 * A camera looks down its own -Z where a model faces +Z, so its forward is the
 * model direction turned half a circle: `(180° - r) - 180° = -r`. Stated as
 * its own function because the half-turn is exactly the kind of thing that
 * gets "fixed" with a hardcoded 180 at a call site once the two conventions
 * are ever confused.
 */
export function cameraYawToViewDeg(yaw: number): number {
  return -yaw * RAD2DEG;
}

/**
 * Where the player is, which way their model faces, and which way the camera
 * looks — read straight off `playerBus`, so no React state, no subscription,
 * safe to call every frame.
 *
 * FACING AND VIEW ARE DIFFERENT QUESTIONS, which is why both are here.
 * `playerBus.playerRotation` is the avatar's own steering yaw and Avatar.tsx
 * applies exactly that value to the model (`bodyYawRef` is snapped to it every
 * moving frame), so the arrow and the character on screen cannot point
 * different ways. `playerBus.cameraYaw` is written from the live camera
 * quaternion by CameraController — every frame, in every one of its branches
 * (orbit, first person, dressing room, the interior's free-edit camera), so
 * this needs no per-mode or per-scene special case. They coincide in first
 * person, where Avatar.tsx already steers the character by the camera; nothing
 * here has to know that.
 *
 * The exception is the interior's free-edit ("佈置模式") camera: the avatar is
 * frozen there and the map follows the free camera instead (see
 * getActiveViewerPos), so the subject of the centre marker really *is* the
 * camera — its facing has to come from the same subject as its position, or
 * the arrow in the middle of the window would describe a character standing
 * somewhere else entirely.
 */
export function readMiniMapPose(): MiniMapPose | null {
  // getActiveViewerPos() already answers "where is the user, really" for both
  // the walking avatar and the frozen-avatar build camera — see playerBus.
  const pos = getActiveViewerPos();
  if (!pos) return null;

  const viewDeg = cameraYawToViewDeg(playerBus.cameraYaw ?? 0);
  const facingDeg = playerBus.isBuildMode
    ? viewDeg
    : worldYawToFacingDeg(playerBus.playerRotation ?? 0);

  return { x: pos.x, z: pos.z, facingDeg, viewDeg };
}

/**
 * Largest frame delta the smoothing below will honour, in seconds.
 *
 * Browsers throttle rAF in a hidden tab, so the first frame back can report a
 * multi-second delta. Feeding that to an exponential ease is harmless (it just
 * saturates), but clamping keeps the map's catch-up identical to any other
 * resumed frame instead of "instant" — same reasoning as clampFrameDelta() in
 * playerBus.ts, which the 3D layer routes its own deltas through.
 */
export const MINIMAP_MAX_DT = 0.1;

/**
 * How fast the arrow turns to meet the character's facing, per second.
 *
 * Deliberately fast (~55ms time constant). The source is *already* eased —
 * Avatar.tsx turns the character toward its movement direction at rate 22 — so
 * this pass is not there to make the turn look smooth; the character's own turn
 * is the thing the arrow must match. What it is there for is the discontinuous
 * cases the source can't smooth: a teleport writing `rotation.current` outright
 * (leaving build mode hands the avatar the camera's facing), and the ±180°
 * wrap. A slower ease here would just show up as the arrow lagging behind the
 * model, which is the one error this whole indicator exists to avoid.
 */
const FACING_RATE = 18;

/**
 * How fast the map turns to meet the camera, per second.
 *
 * A touch softer than the arrow (~70ms) and for the same kind of reason: the
 * camera yaw arriving here is already damped by OrbitControls, so this only has
 * to absorb the steps the source can't — a mode switch that re-seats the camera
 * behind the character, and the wrap. Any slower and the whole plan visibly
 * trails a flick of the look stick, which on a heading-up map reads as input
 * lag rather than weight.
 */
const VIEW_RATE = 14;

/**
 * Ease `current` toward `target` the short way round the circle.
 *
 * An exponential ease, NOT a fixed step per frame: `1 - e^(-rate·dt)` is
 * frame-rate independent, so a turn feels the same at 30, 60 and 144Hz, and it
 * never overshoots or ratchets.
 *
 * The wrap is the other half of the point: 359° → 1° is a 2° turn, and any
 * smoothing that misses that spins the map (or the marker) 358° backwards every
 * time it crosses north — the classic 0/360 jump. Differences are unwrapped
 * into (-180, 180] before easing for exactly that reason.
 */
export function smoothAngleDeg(current: number, target: number, dt: number, rate: number): number {
  const diff = wrapDeg(target - current);
  return current + diff * (1 - Math.exp(-rate * Math.min(dt, MINIMAP_MAX_DT)));
}

/** {@link smoothAngleDeg} at the arrow's rate. */
export const smoothFacingDeg = (current: number, target: number, dt: number) =>
  smoothAngleDeg(current, target, dt, FACING_RATE);

/** {@link smoothAngleDeg} at the map's rate. */
export const smoothViewDeg = (current: number, target: number, dt: number) =>
  smoothAngleDeg(current, target, dt, VIEW_RATE);

/** Fold an angle into (-180, 180]. */
export function wrapDeg(deg: number): number {
  return ((((deg + 180) % 360) + 360) % 360) - 180;
}
```

```tsx
/**
```

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { getBalance } from '../../../constants/currency';
import { LogOut, Check, Edit2, Copy, ShieldAlert, X, Coins, TrendingUp , Gem } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../../context/AppContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../../auth/useAuth';
import { providerLabel } from '../../../auth/errors';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../../lib/soundUtils';
import { AVATAR_IDS, AvatarIcon, resolveAvatarId } from '../AvatarIcon';
import { Button, PortholeFrame } from '../DesignKit';
import { ProviderButton } from '../ProviderButton';
import { SettingsSection } from './SettingsSection';

// Everything here reads the same hooks/handlers AccountPanel.tsx already
// uses (useAuth's linkableProviders/linkProvider/signOut/error, useApp's
// profile) — no new identity/auth logic, just a full-page layout instead of
// a popover, so Settings can be the "manage everything" destination
// AccountPanel's own "偏好系統設定" button already promises to jump to.
export function AccountCategory() {
  const { user, profile, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const { linkableProviders, linkProvider, signOut, pendingProviderId, error, clearError } = useAuth();

  const [isEditingName, setIsEditingName] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState(profile?.displayName || '');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!profile) return null;

  const isGuest = !!user?.isGuest;
  // True only when the session never reached Firebase at all — the save is on
  // this device and nowhere else. Distinct from an ordinary anonymous guest,
  // whose progress *is* in the cloud and already syncs.
  const isLocalOnly = !!user?.isLocalOnly;
  const userEmail = user?.email || 'guest-session@island.local';
  const providerNames = (user?.linkedProviders ?? []).map(providerLabel).join('、');
  const selectedAvatarId = resolveAvatarId(profile.avatar);

  const handleUpdateName = async () => {
    if (!newName.trim()) return;
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    await updateProfile({ displayName: newName });
    setIsEditingName(false);
  };

  const handleAvatarSelect = async (avatarId: string) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    await updateProfile({ avatar: avatarId });
  };

  const handleCopyId = () => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(profile.userId);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleLink = (providerId: Parameters<typeof linkProvider>[0]) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    void linkProvider(providerId);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-6">
      <SettingsSection title="個人資料">
        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft uppercase tracking-widest pl-4">我的暱稱</label>
            {isEditingName ? (
              <div className="flex-1 flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newName}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-white border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 font-bold text-sm outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-island-teal-light"
                  autoFocus
                />
                <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleUpdateName} className="p-3">
                  <Check size={20} />
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-between bg-white border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 group">
                <span className="font-bold">{profile.displayName}</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsEditingName(true)}
                  className="text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-teal transition-all p-1 hover:bg-island-teal/10 rounded-lg active:scale-95"
                >
                  <Edit2 size={16} />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft uppercase tracking-widest pl-4">通訊頭像</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 justify-items-center">
              {AVATAR_IDS.map((avatarId) => {
                const isSelected = selectedAvatarId === avatarId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={avatarId}
                    onClick={() => handleAvatarSelect(avatarId)}
                    className={`transition-all active:scale-95 ${isSelected ? 'scale-105' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <PortholeFrame size={52}>
                      <div className={`w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
                        isSelected ? 'bg-island-teal/12' : 'bg-white hover:bg-island-line/30'
                      }`}>
                        <AvatarIcon id={avatarId} size={30} />
                      </div>
                    </PortholeFrame>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SettingsSection>

      <SettingsSection title="帳號資訊">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft font-black uppercase tracking-wider">登入狀態</span>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-island-navy truncate">{isGuest ? '訪客存檔' : userEmail}</span>
            {/* Sync badge. Three states, not two: an anonymous guest with a real
                Firebase account already syncs, and conflating that with a
                device-only session is what let players believe their progress
                was safe when it was sitting in one browser's localStorage. */}
            <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black tracking-wide uppercase flex-shrink-0 ${
              isLocalOnly
                ? 'bg-island-coral/10 text-island-coral border border-island-coral/30'
                : isGuest
                  ? 'bg-island-sand text-island-navy-soft border border-island-line'
                  : 'bg-island-teal/10 text-island-teal-dark border border-island-teal/30'
            }`}>
              <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                isLocalOnly ? 'bg-island-coral' : isGuest ? 'bg-island-navy-soft' : 'bg-island-teal'
              } animate-pulse`} />
              {isLocalOnly ? '僅存於此裝置' : isGuest ? '訪客雲端存檔' : `${providerNames || '雲端'} 同步中`}
            </span>
          </div>
          {isLocalOnly && (
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-island-coral/90 bg-island-coral/8 border border-island-coral/20 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2.5">
              你的島嶼目前只儲存在這台裝置上，換裝置或清除瀏覽器資料就會消失。綁定帳號即可備份並跨裝置同步。
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft font-black uppercase tracking-wider">用戶獨立代碼 (UID)</span>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-island-line">
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-island-navy truncate max-w-[220px]">{profile.userId}</span>
            <button
              onClick={handleCopyId}
              className="text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-navy transition-colors p-3 -m-2"
              title="複製 UID"
            >
              {copied ? <Check size={14} className="text-island-teal" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Same three tiles as AccountPanel's, and for the same reason — see the note there. The
            two screens show the same wallet and must not disagree about what is in it. */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Coins className="text-island-gold" size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft font-black tracking-widest uppercase">持有金幣・健身取得</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-island-navy">{getBalance(profile, 'coins').toLocaleString()}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Gem className="text-island-teal-dark" size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft font-black tracking-widest uppercase">持有碎片・非健身取得</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-island-navy">{getBalance(profile, 'fragments').toLocaleString()}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-island-line flex items-center gap-2.5 col-span-2">
            <TrendingUp className="text-island-teal" size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="text-[9px] text-island-navy-soft font-black tracking-widest uppercase">當前經驗</div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-island-navy">{profile.currentXp} XP</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SettingsSection>

      {/* Account binding — 「將 Guest 存檔綁定至正式帳號」. Rendered from
          `linkableProviders`, so this list grows on its own as providers are
          promoted to `ready` in the registry. Same list/handlers as
          AccountPanel.tsx. */}
      {linkableProviders.length > 0 && (
        <SettingsSection title={isGuest ? '綁定帳號以保存進度' : '綁定其他登入方式'}>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft/80 leading-relaxed -mt-2">
            {isGuest
              ? '綁定後即可在其他裝置登入並繼續你的島嶼。'
              : '多綁一種登入方式，換裝置時更方便。'}
          </p>

          {error && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-island-coral/30 bg-island-coral/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-island-coral leading-relaxed"
            >
              <ShieldAlert size={13} className="mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span className="flex-1">{error.message}</span>
              <button onClick={clearError} className="opacity-60 hover:opacity-100" aria-label="關閉提示">
                <X size={12} />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {linkableProviders.map((descriptor) => (
              <ProviderButton
                key={descriptor.id}
                descriptor={descriptor}
                busy={pendingProviderId === descriptor.id}
                disabled={pendingProviderId !== null && pendingProviderId !== descriptor.id}
                onSelect={() => handleLink(descriptor.id)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </SettingsSection>
      )}

      <Button
        variant="danger"
        onClick={() => { playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK); void signOut(); }}
        className="w-full py-3 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest"
      >
        <LogOut size={16} />
        安全登出
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/settings/AdminOwnAllItemsRow.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 擁有全部商品 — the 管理員測試模式 switch that hands over the entire shop catalog, and hands
 * it back.
 *
 * Why a 開關 and not the button that already exists in 帳號中心
 * (UI/AdminValueControls.tsx's GrantAllItemsButton): a button is a one-way door. Pressing it puts
 * the save into the everything-owned state and there is no way out but 清空裝備, which also
 * destroys everything the account actually earned. A switch has to answer 「what does OFF mean」,
 * and answering it honestly is the feature:
 *
 *   ON   grant one copy of every catalog id the save is missing, and REMEMBER exactly which ids
 *        those were (settings.adminGrantedItemIds).
 *   OFF  take back exactly those ids — nothing the player bought with their own gold, and
 *        nothing currently worn, placed, painted or lived in.
 *
 * So the switch is reversible without being destructive, which is what lets it sit in 設定 next
 * to 管理員測試模式 with no confirm() in front of it. The ids it grants and the ids it revokes are
 * decided in ONE place, context/useShopActions.ts — this component owns the receipt and the copy,
 * not the rules.
 *
 * It REPORTS, like every other 管理員 control: how many items moved, that there was nothing to
 * do, how many were kept back because they are in use, or — via `describeRecentFailure` — why the
 * save refused. A switch that flipped but wrote nothing is the failure mode this whole family of
 * controls was rewritten to avoid.
 *
 * One thing it deliberately does NOT do: react to 管理員測試模式 being switched off above it. The
 * row disappears with the rest of the Admin UI while the grant and its receipt stay exactly as
 * they were, so turning Admin Test Mode back on finds the switch still ON and still able to take
 * its items back. Auto-revoking on the way out would mean a save silently losing ~300 items
 * because a different switch was flipped — that is precisely the surprise the OFF side is
 * written to avoid.
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Gift } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../../context/AppContext';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../../lib/soundUtils';
import { describeRecentFailure } from '../../../lib/saveStatus';
import { Toggle } from '../DesignKit';
import { SettingRow } from './SettingRow';

export function AdminOwnAllItemsRow() {
  const {
    settings, updateSettings, grantAllItems, revokeGrantedItems, showIslandAlert,
  } = useApp();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const isOn = !!settings?.adminOwnAllItems;

  const toggle = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (!isOn) await turnOn();
      else await turnOff();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const turnOn = async () => {
    const result = await grantAllItems();
    if (!result.ok) {
      showIslandAlert(describeRecentFailure());
      return;
    }

    // The switch goes on even when nothing was granted: 「everything is already owned」 IS the
    // state the switch describes. What the receipt records is what THIS flip added, because that
    // is all the OFF side is entitled to take back — an item the save already held was not given
    // by the switch and must survive it.
    await updateSettings({ adminOwnAllItems: true, adminGrantedItemIds: result.grantedIds });

    if (result.granted === 0) {
      showIslandAlert('商店裡的商品你本來就全部擁有了 — 開關已打開，關掉時不會收回任何東西。');
      return;
    }
    playSound(SoundEffect.REWARD, 0.4);
    showIslandAlert(`已解鎖 ${result.granted} 件商品 — 商店裡的東西現在全都是你的了。`);
  };

  const turnOff = async () => {
    const granted = settings?.adminGrantedItemIds || [];

    // No receipt means nothing to take back — a switch turned on before this row existed, or one
    // whose grant added nothing. Flipping it off is then purely a state change.
    if (granted.length === 0) {
      await updateSettings({ adminOwnAllItems: false, adminGrantedItemIds: [] });
      showIslandAlert('已關閉。這次沒有東西需要收回。');
      return;
    }

    const result = await revokeGrantedItems(granted);
    if (!result.ok) {
      showIslandAlert(describeRecentFailure());
      return;
    }

    await updateSettings({ adminOwnAllItems: false, adminGrantedItemIds: [] });

    const keptNote = result.kept > 0
      ? `，另有 ${result.kept} 件因為正在穿戴／擺放／使用中而保留`
      : '';
    showIslandAlert(
      result.revoked > 0
        ? `已收回 ${result.revoked} 件由這個開關發出的商品${keptNote}。你自己買的東西沒有動到。`
        : `已關閉。沒有東西可以收回${keptNote}。`,
    );
  };

  return (
    <SettingRow
      icon={<Gift className="text-island-teal" size={18} />}
      label="擁有全部商品"
      description={
        busy
          ? '寫入存檔中…'
          : '開啟後立刻免費擁有商店裡的每一件商品(不扣金幣)。關閉時只收回這個開關發出的東西,你自己買的、正在穿戴或已擺放的都不會動'
      }
      onClick={() => void toggle()}
      control={<Toggle checked={isOn} disabled={busy} onChange={() => void toggle()} />}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Volume2, VolumeX, Waves, Play, Check, Youtube, X, ExternalLink, History,
  AlertCircle, Search, Loader2, Music,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../../context/AppContext';
import { BGM_TRACKS } from '../../../constants/bgmTracks';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../../lib/soundUtils';
import { Slider } from '../DesignKit';
import { useYtm, YouTubeMusicPanel } from '../YouTubeMusicHost';
import {
  parseYouTubeMusicInput, looksLikeYouTubeRef,
  searchYouTubeMusic, YouTubeSearchResult,
} from '../../../lib/youtubeMusic';
// Playback control goes through the manager, never straight at the player: it is
// what guarantees the built-in BGM stops as YouTube starts (and comes back when
// YouTube stops). See lib/backgroundMusic.ts.
import { playYouTubeMusic, stopYouTubeMusic } from '../../../lib/backgroundMusic';
import { SettingsSection } from './SettingsSection';

/**
 * YouTube's Data API returns titles HTML-escaped ("Rock &amp; Roll", "It&#39;s").
 * React escapes on render, so pasting them straight in shows the entities
 * literally; this turns them back into characters WITHOUT going through
 * innerHTML, so a title can never inject markup.
 */
function decodeHtmlEntities(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_, code) => String.fromCharCode(Number(code)));
}

export function AudioCategory() {
  const { settings, updateSettings } = useApp();
  const [youtubeInput, setYoutubeInput] = useState('');
  const [youtubeError, setYoutubeError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ytSearching, setYtSearching] = useState(false);
  const [ytResults, setYtResults] = useState<YouTubeSearchResult[] | null>(null);
  const ytm = useYtm();
  const isMuted = settings?.isMuted ?? false;

  const toggleSetting = async (key: 'isMuted', currentValue: boolean) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    await updateSettings({ [key]: !currentValue });
  };

  /**
   * Play a pasted YouTube / YouTube Music link.
   *
   * This replaced a `setTimeout` that pretended to run an OAuth flow and then
   * only flipped a boolean - nothing ever reached YouTube. There is no OAuth
   * here now because there is nothing to authorise: the IFrame player streams
   * public videos and playlists without an account, and YouTube Music exposes
   * no API to sign into. Turning the feature "on" simply means a real player is
   * mounted and pointed at a real link.
   */
  const handlePlayYoutubeLink = (raw: string) => {
    const ref = parseYouTubeMusicInput(raw);
    if (!ref) {
      setYoutubeError('看不懂這個連結。請貼上 YouTube 或 YouTube Music 的影片/播放清單網址。');
      return;
    }
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setYoutubeError(null);
    setYtResults(null);

    const link = raw.trim();
    const recent = [link, ...(settings?.youtubeRecentLinks ?? []).filter((l) => l !== link)].slice(0, 6);

    // Switch the source and start playing INSIDE this click - browsers only let
    // sound begin from a real gesture, and awaiting the settings write first
    // would put the load outside it. The write below then persists the same
    // decision; the manager is already there.
    playYouTubeMusic(ref);
    // Selecting the local synth tracks turns this off again, so turn it on here.
    updateSettings({ youtubeMusicEnabled: true, youtubePlaylistId: link, youtubeRecentLinks: recent });
    setYoutubeInput('');
  };

  /**
   * One box, two jobs: paste a link and it plays, type a song name and it
   * searches. Which one you meant is decided by looksLikeYouTubeRef rather than
   * by a mode switch the user has to set first - having to know in advance
   * whether you are in "link mode" is exactly the friction this replaces.
   */
  const handleYoutubeSubmit = async (raw: string) => {
    const input = raw.trim();
    if (!input) return;

    if (looksLikeYouTubeRef(input)) {
      handlePlayYoutubeLink(input);
      return;
    }

    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    setYoutubeError(null);
    setYtSearching(true);
    try {
      const results = await searchYouTubeMusic(input);
      setYtResults(results);
      if (results.length === 0) setYoutubeError(`找不到「${input}」的可播放結果,換個關鍵字試試。`);
    } catch (err) {
      setYtResults(null);
      setYoutubeError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'YouTube 搜尋失敗。');
    } finally {
      setYtSearching(false);
    }
  };

  /** Play one of the search hits. Stored as a full watch URL so it round-trips
   *  through the same recent-links list and restore path as a pasted link. */
  const handlePlaySearchResult = (result: YouTubeSearchResult) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    const link = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${result.videoId}`;
    const recent = [link, ...(settings?.youtubeRecentLinks ?? []).filter((l) => l !== link)].slice(0, 6);
    playYouTubeMusic({ videoId: result.videoId });
    updateSettings({ youtubeMusicEnabled: true, youtubePlaylistId: link, youtubeRecentLinks: recent });
    setYoutubeError(null);
    setYoutubeInput('');
    setYtResults(null);
  };

  // Drives whether the button says 播放 or 搜尋, so the box tells you what it is
  // about to do before you press it rather than after.
  const isYoutubeLinkInput = looksLikeYouTubeRef(youtubeInput);

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-6">
      <SettingsSection title="音效控制">
        {/* THE MASTER MUTE, said out loud.
            
            This was a bare speaker icon whose only tell was its background colour — and the
            icon never changed, so "on" and "off" were the same picture in two shades. Worse,
            it did not actually reach the sea: the surf and the swim wash ignored it, so the
            button could read as off while the island kept rolling underneath it. It now
            silences everything and says which everything that is.

            The last thing it did not reach was the sound EFFECTS — footsteps, doors, the pet,
            the garden props, every UI blip — which is what players meant by "按了靜音還是有聲
            音". They go through the same flag now (lib/soundUtils.ts, sfxContext), so the copy
            below can finally say 全部 and mean it. */}
        <button
          onClick={() => toggleSetting('isMuted', isMuted)}
          className={`w-full flex items-center gap-4 p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all active:scale-[0.99] text-left ${
            isMuted
              ? 'bg-white border-island-line'
              : 'bg-island-teal/10 border-island-teal/25'
          }`}
        >
          <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 ${
            isMuted ? 'bg-white border border-island-line text-island-navy-soft' : 'bg-island-teal text-white'
          }`}>
            {isMuted ? <VolumeX size={18} /> : <Volume2 size={18} />}
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy">{isMuted ? '全部靜音中' : '聲音已開啟'}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft leading-snug">
              {isMuted ? '背景音樂、海浪聲與所有音效都已完全停止' : '點一下可靜音背景音樂、海浪聲與所有音效'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>

        {/* Both sliders go dim while muted, so nobody drags one and wonders why nothing
            happens. They stay usable on purpose - setting the level you want BEFORE
            unmuting is a reasonable thing to do. */}
        <div className={`flex flex-col gap-6 transition-opacity ${isMuted ? 'opacity-40' : ''}`}>
          {/* Labelled, because an unlabelled range next to a labelled one reads as the same
              control's second half rather than as the music's own volume. Zero really is off:
              the generative engine stops rather than playing to a muted bus. */}
          <Slider
            icon={<Music size={18} />}
            label="背景音樂"
            value={settings?.bgmVolume ?? 0.5}
            onChange={(v) => updateSettings({ bgmVolume: v })}
          />

          {/* Ambience — its own control, not a sub-setting of the music. The surf is the
              one sound that runs continuously rather than answering an action, so it is
              the one a player may want less of on its own. Takes effect while you drag, even
              standing still on the beach, and at zero the sea is torn down rather than turned
              down — including the swim wash and the splashes (see setAmbienceVolume). */}
          <Slider
            icon={<Waves size={18} />}
            label="海浪環境音"
            value={settings?.ambienceVolume ?? 1}
            onChange={(v) => updateSettings({ ambienceVolume: v })}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft uppercase tracking-widest">挑選音樂</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1">
            {BGM_TRACKS.map((track, idx) => (
              <button
                key={track.id}
                onClick={() => { stopYouTubeMusic(); updateSettings({ currentTrackIndex: idx, youtubeMusicEnabled: false }); }}
                className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl transition-all text-left ${settings?.currentTrackIndex === idx && !settings?.youtubeMusicEnabled ? 'bg-island-teal/10 border border-island-teal/25 translate-x-1' : 'hover:bg-island-line/30 border border-transparent'}`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg ${settings?.currentTrackIndex === idx ? 'bg-island-teal text-white' : 'bg-white border border-island-line text-island-navy-soft'}`}>
                    <Play size={10} />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold">{track.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">{track.artist}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {settings?.currentTrackIndex === idx && !settings?.youtubeMusicEnabled && <Check size={12} className="text-island-teal" />}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </SettingsSection>

      {/* Search-or-paste box. This is the whole "connection" - see
          handlePlayYoutubeLink for why there is no OAuth button here. */}
      <SettingsSection
        icon={<Youtube size={20} />}
        title="YouTube Music"
        description="直接搜尋歌名找 MV,或貼上 YouTube / YouTube Music 連結,在島上播放"
      >
        {settings?.youtubeMusicEnabled && (
          <div className="flex justify-end -mt-1 -mb-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => { playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK); stopYouTubeMusic(); updateSettings({ youtubeMusicEnabled: false }); }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-white text-island-navy-soft hover:text-red-600 hover:border-red-200 rounded-2xl border border-island-line transition-all text-[10px] font-black uppercase active:scale-95"
            >
              <X size={12} />
              停止並關閉
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 border border-island-line space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={youtubeInput}
              onChange={(e) => { setYoutubeInput(e.target.value); setYoutubeError(null); }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleYoutubeSubmit(youtubeInput); }}
              placeholder="輸入歌名或歌手,例如「告白氣球」"
              className="flex-1 min-w-0 bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line rounded-xl px-4 py-3 font-bold text-xs outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-island-teal-light"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => handleYoutubeSubmit(youtubeInput)}
              disabled={!youtubeInput.trim() || ytSearching}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-red-700 transition-all font-black text-xs disabled:opacity-40 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(220,38,38,0.25)] active:scale-95"
            >
              {ytSearching
                ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
                : (isYoutubeLinkInput ? <Play size={14} /> : <Search size={14} />)}
              {ytSearching ? '搜尋中' : (isYoutubeLinkInput ? '播放' : '搜尋')}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Search hits. Thumbnails matter here: picking the right MV out of
              a dozen covers and lyric videos is a visual judgement, and a
              list of titles alone makes you guess. */}
          {ytResults && ytResults.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto -mx-1 px-1">
              {ytResults.map((result) => (
                <button
                  key={result.videoId}
                  onClick={() => handlePlaySearchResult(result)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-xl border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2/40 hover:border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50/40 transition-colors text-left"
                >
                  {result.thumbnail && (
                    <img
                      src={result.thumbnail}
                      alt=""
                      loading="lazy"
                      className="w-16 h-9 object-cover rounded-lg shrink-0 bg-island-line"
                    />
                  )}
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    {/* Titles arrive HTML-escaped from the Data API (&amp;,
                        &#39;), so they are rendered as text, not markup. */}
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy line-clamp-2 leading-snug">
                      {decodeHtmlEntities(result.title)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft truncate">
                      {decodeHtmlEntities(result.channel)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Play size={12} className="shrink-0 text-red-600" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {youtubeError && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-red-600 leading-snug">
              <AlertCircle size={12} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{youtubeError}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Only failures are reported here - the player panel below shows the
              current title itself, so repeating it would just be noise. */}
          {settings?.youtubeMusicEnabled && ytm.error && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-red-600 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 leading-snug">
              <AlertCircle size={12} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{ytm.error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <a
            href="https://music.youtube.com"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft hover:text-red-600 transition-colors"
          >
            <ExternalLink size={11} />
            想放整張專輯或播放清單?去 YouTube Music 複製連結貼回來
          </a>

          <p className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft/80 leading-relaxed">
            使用 YouTube 官方嵌入播放器,免登入。搜尋結果已濾掉不允許嵌入的影片;Premium 專屬曲目、個人上傳,以及部分「自動混音」清單仍然無法播放。
            關閉設定後音樂會繼續播放,切換到內建音樂時會自動停止。
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* The player's on-screen window. The player itself lives outside
            React (lib/youtubeMusic.ts) and only moves here while this panel
            is mounted — closing Settings hides the video, not the music. */}
        <YouTubeMusicPanel />

        <AnimatePresence>
          {(settings?.youtubeRecentLinks?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
              className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 border border-island-line"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy-soft uppercase tracking-widest mb-3">
                <History size={11} />
                最近播放
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1.5">
                {settings!.youtubeRecentLinks!.map((link) => {
                  const isCurrent = settings?.youtubePlaylistId === link && settings?.youtubeMusicEnabled;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={link}
                      onClick={() => handlePlayYoutubeLink(link)}
                      className={`flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl border transition-colors text-left ${
                        isCurrent ? 'bg-island-teal/10 border-island-teal/25' : 'bg-white border-island-line hover:border-red-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Music size={12} className="text-red-500 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy truncate flex-1 min-w-0">{link}</span>
                      {isCurrent && <Check size={12} className="text-island-teal shrink-0" />}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </SettingsSection>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/settings/GeneralCategory.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { Mic, FlaskConical, CloudSun, RefreshCw, Clock, Sun, CloudRain, CloudLightning, Snowflake, Sunset, Moon } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../../context/AppContext';
import { AppSettings, WeatherType } from '../../../types';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../../lib/soundUtils';
import {
  FRAGMENTS_PER_TICKET,
  FRAGMENTS_TO_UNLOCK,
  isOverflowConversionEnabled,
} from '../../../constants/fragments';
import { FragmentShard } from '../FragmentProgress';
import { Toggle } from '../DesignKit';
import { SettingsSection } from './SettingsSection';
import { SettingRow } from './SettingRow';

const WEATHER_OPTIONS: { type: WeatherType; label: string; icon: typeof Sun }[] = [
  { type: WeatherType.SUNNY, label: '晴空', icon: Sun },
  { type: WeatherType.RAINY, label: '細雨', icon: CloudRain },
  { type: WeatherType.STORM, label: '暴雨', icon: CloudLightning },
  { type: WeatherType.SNOW, label: '瑞雪', icon: Snowflake },
  { type: WeatherType.TWILIGHT, label: '暮色', icon: Sunset },
  // 深夜 is last on purpose: it reads as the end of the day the four states
  // before it run through, and it is the one entry that is a time rather than a
  // kind of weather — hence the block's 島嶼狀態 title.
  { type: WeatherType.MIDNIGHT, label: '深夜', icon: Moon },
];

export function GeneralCategory() {
  const {
    settings, updateSettings,
    weather, setWeather, isWeatherAuto, setWeatherAutoMode,
    isWeatherSyncActive, setWeatherSyncMode, weatherSyncLoading, weatherSyncData,
  } = useApp();

  const toggleSetting = async (key: keyof AppSettings, currentValue: boolean) => {
    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
    await updateSettings({ [key]: !currentValue });
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-6">
      {/* Weather — moved off the main screen so it no longer sits as a
          permanent control on top of the game view; only a brief corner
          toast marks a change there now. */}
      <SettingsSection
        icon={<CloudSun size={20} />}
        title="島嶼狀態"
        description="手動選擇氣候與時段,或交給自動輪替 / 真實世界同步"
      >
        <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-2">
          {WEATHER_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
            const isActive = weather === opt.type;
            const Icon = opt.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={opt.type}
                onClick={() => {
                  playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                  setWeather(opt.type);
                }}
                className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all active:scale-95 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-island-teal text-white border-island-teal shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(42,157,143,0.3)]'
                    : 'bg-white text-island-navy-soft border-island-line hover:border-island-teal/40 hover:text-island-navy'
                }`}
              >
                <Icon size={18} />
                <span className="text-[9px] font-black tracking-tight leading-none">{opt.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div
          onClick={() => { playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK); setWeatherAutoMode(!isWeatherAuto); }}
          className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <RefreshCw size={14} className="text-island-navy-soft shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy">自動輪替天氣</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">每分鐘依序切換氣候情境</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <Toggle checked={isWeatherAuto} onChange={setWeatherAutoMode} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 bg-white border border-island-line rounded-2xl px-4 py-3">
          <div
            onClick={() => { playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK); setWeatherSyncMode(!isWeatherSyncActive); }}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Clock size={14} className="text-island-navy-soft shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy">同步真實世界天氣</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">依所在地目前氣象自動更新</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <Toggle checked={isWeatherSyncActive} disabled={weatherSyncLoading} onChange={setWeatherSyncMode} />
            </div>
          </div>

          {weatherSyncLoading && (
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-[26px]">
              <span className="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border border-island-teal/40 border-t-island-teal animate-spin" />
              獲取當前氣象中...
            </div>
          )}

          {!weatherSyncLoading && weatherSyncData && (
            <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-island-teal-dark bg-island-teal/8 border border-island-teal/20 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between ml-[26px]">
              <span>📍 {weatherSyncData.city} · {weatherSyncData.wmoDescription}</span>
              <span className="font-mono">{weatherSyncData.temp}°C</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </SettingsSection>

      <SettingRow
        icon={<Mic className="text-island-teal" size={18} />}
        label="AI 語音引導"
        description="開啟以獲得智慧健身教練的實時建議"
        onClick={() => toggleSetting('voiceGuideEnabled', settings?.voiceGuideEnabled || false)}
        control={
          <Toggle
            checked={!!settings?.voiceGuideEnabled}
            onChange={() => toggleSetting('voiceGuideEnabled', settings?.voiceGuideEnabled || false)}
          />
        }
      />

      {/* 多餘碎片轉換成抽獎券 (constants/fragments.ts).

          A real game rule with a switch on it, not a display preference — which is why the
          description says what turning it OFF costs rather than describing a taste. A fragment stack
          stops at 200 and there are two ways to end up holding fragments past that line: being given
          more once the stack is full, and buying the item with gold, which strands every fragment
          collected toward it. Both are settled the same way, and this is the switch that decides
          whether they are settled into something or simply not kept. */}
      <SettingRow
        icon={<FragmentShard size={18} />}
        label="多餘碎片轉換成抽獎券"
        description={`碎片集滿 ${FRAGMENTS_TO_UNLOCK} 後再獲得的碎片,或用金幣直接購買後用不到的碎片,每 ${FRAGMENTS_PER_TICKET} 個換 1 張抽獎券。關閉後這些碎片不會保留`}
        onClick={() => toggleSetting('fragmentOverflowToTickets', isOverflowConversionEnabled(settings))}
        control={
          <Toggle
            checked={isOverflowConversionEnabled(settings)}
            onChange={() => toggleSetting('fragmentOverflowToTickets', isOverflowConversionEnabled(settings))}
          />
        }
      />

      {/* 管理員測試模式 — the single switch behind every Admin Only feature
          (constants/adminFeatures.ts lists them). It changes nothing about
          how the island plays, it changes what a developer is allowed to
          see — kept as its own row rather than mixed into an audio/graphics
          category.

          What it now adds to the screen is ONE thing: the 【管理員測試】 tab on the right edge
          (components/UI/admin/). Every test control lives behind that tab, so this row no longer
          needs a block of extra switches under it — see below. */}
      <SettingRow
        icon={<FlaskConical className="text-island-navy-soft" size={18} />}
        label="管理員測試模式"
        description="開啟後,畫面右緣會出現【管理員測試】標籤,所有開發測試功能都在裡面。新手教學每次登入都會重新出現,但不影響你的存檔與教學完成狀態"
        onClick={() => toggleSetting('adminTestMode', settings?.adminTestMode || false)}
        control={
          <Toggle
            checked={!!settings?.adminTestMode}
            onChange={() => toggleSetting('adminTestMode', settings?.adminTestMode || false)}
          />
        }
      />

      {/* 擁有全部商品 used to be mounted here, directly under the switch that revealed it. That
          was the right answer while it was the ONLY extra row; it is the wrong one now that every
          other test control has a single home, because it would be the one switch a tester has to
          leave the console to find. It moved to 管理員測試 → 商店與經濟 (the component itself is
          unchanged — settings/AdminOwnAllItemsRow.tsx). */}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React from 'react';

// The single-row setting pattern hand-rolled for the AI-voice-guide and
// admin-test-mode toggles: icon + label + description on the left, one
// control on the right. `onClick` on the row itself (with the control
// wrapped so its own click doesn't double-fire) mirrors the old behaviour
// where clicking anywhere on the row — not just the switch — toggled it.
export function SettingRow({
  icon,
  label,
  description,
  control,
  onClick,
  className = '',
}: {
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  label: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  control: React.ReactNode;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-4 p-5 bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl border border-island-line transition-colors text-left ${
        onClick ? 'hover:bg-island-line/30 cursor-pointer' : ''
      } ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
        {icon}
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <span className="font-bold text-sm block">{label}</span>
          {description && <span className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">{description}</span>}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div onClick={onClick ? (e) => e.stopPropagation() : undefined} className="flex-shrink-0">
        {control}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/UI/settings/SettingsNav.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { VISIBLE_SETTINGS_CATEGORIES, type SettingsCategoryId } from './settingsCategories';

/**
 * Two renderings of the same `activeId`/`onSelect` pair, switched purely by
 * Tailwind breakpoint (this project's sanctioned way to branch mobile vs.
 * desktop layout — see useViewportWidth.ts, which explicitly reserves JS
 * width checks for scaling an already-desktop layout, not for this kind of
 * branch). Below `lg` there usually isn't room for a sidebar, so the same
 * categories become wrapping chips instead.
 *
 * It renders `VISIBLE_SETTINGS_CATEGORIES`, not the whole table: 畫面 / 操作 /
 * 關於 have no settings in them yet, and a nav where half the entries lead to
 * 「敬請期待」 is a nav that has stopped telling the player where anything is.
 * The categories themselves are untouched — see settingsCategories.ts.
 *
 * `DesignKit.tsx`'s `Toolbar` was tried here first (it's the existing
 * array-driven tab switcher) but doesn't fit: its tab pill is one
 * non-wrapping flex row sized for 2-4 mode tabs, so six categories on a
 * phone-width viewport overflowed the card and cut off 帳號/關於 entirely
 * instead of wrapping — confirmed by screenshot, not a hunch. Plain
 * `flex-wrap` chips (same active/inactive token pairing as the weather
 * picker in GeneralCategory) wrap to a second row instead of clipping.
 */
export function SettingsNav({
  activeId,
  onSelect,
}: {
  activeId: SettingsCategoryId;
  onSelect: (id: SettingsCategoryId) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Desktop / laptop / landscape tablet — vertical rail. */}
      <nav className="hidden lg:flex flex-col gap-1.5 w-56 flex-shrink-0">
        {VISIBLE_SETTINGS_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
          const Icon = cat.icon;
          const isActive = cat.id === activeId;
          return (
            <button
              key={cat.id}
              onClick={() => onSelect(cat.id)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all text-left active:scale-[0.98] ${
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-island-teal/8 border-island-teal text-island-navy'
                  : 'bg-transparent border-transparent text-island-navy-soft hover:bg-island-cream-2 hover:text-island-navy'
              }`}
            >
              <Icon size={18} className={isActive ? 'text-island-teal' : ''} />
              <span className="font-bold text-sm">{cat.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {/* Tablet portrait / mobile — wrapping chip row. */}
      <div className="lg:hidden w-full flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {VISIBLE_SETTINGS_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
          const Icon = cat.icon;
          const isActive = cat.id === activeId;
          return (
            <button
              key={cat.id}
              onClick={() => onSelect(cat.id)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full border transition-all active:scale-95 ${
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-island-teal text-white border-island-teal shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(42,157,143,0.3)]'
                  : 'bg-white text-island-navy-soft border-island-line hover:border-island-teal/40 hover:text-island-navy'
              }`}
            >
              <Icon size={14} />
              <span className="text-xs font-black">{cat.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';

// The card shell hand-rolled three times in the old SettingsView.tsx
// (Music, YouTube Music, Weather blocks): icon tile + title + description
// header, then a bg-island-cream-2 + dock-notch card holding the actual
// controls. Centralized so a new setting group is one call site, not
// another copy of the same Tailwind string.
export function SettingsSection({
  icon,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  className = '',
}: {
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`w-full space-y-3 ${className}`}>
      {(icon || title) && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-1">
          {icon && (
            <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-island-teal/12 text-island-teal-dark border border-island-teal/25 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
              {icon}
            </div>
          )}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy">{title}</h3>
            {description && <p className="text-[10px] text-island-navy-soft">{description}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line dock-notch rounded-[1.75rem] p-5 space-y-4">
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

// The one list SettingsNav and SettingsView both read to know which
// categories exist, in what order, and how to label/icon them. Adding a
// future category (e.g. once Graphics/Controls have real settings) is one
// entry here plus one Category component — SettingsNav and SettingsView
// need no changes.

import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { SlidersHorizontal, Volume2, Monitor, Gamepad2, User, Info } from 'lucide-react';

export type SettingsCategoryId = 'general' | 'audio' | 'graphics' | 'controls' | 'account' | 'about';

export interface SettingsCategoryDef {
  id: SettingsCategoryId;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /**
   * 這個分類今天有沒有東西。`false` 的分類**還在**（型別、元件、SettingsView 的掛載全部保留），
   * 只是不畫進導覽列。
   *
   * 為什麼需要這個欄位：畫面／操作／關於三個分類各自只有一張「敬請期待」的 EmptyState，於是設定
   * 的導覽列有一半指向沒有內容的地方 —— 那是把「還沒做」做成了常駐導覽的一部分。這跟
   * `MAIN_SECTIONS` 裡 NPC 不給 iconName 是同一條規則（見 utils/categoryUtils.ts）：占位符不該
   * 長得像一個已經決定好的東西。
   *
   * 補上第一個設定的那一天，改的是這裡的一個 `true`，不是重新排一次六個分類。
   */
  available?: boolean;
}

export const SETTINGS_CATEGORIES: SettingsCategoryDef[] = [
  { id: 'general', label: '一般', icon: SlidersHorizontal, available: true },
  { id: 'audio', label: '音效', icon: Volume2, available: true },
  // 三個空分類 —— 元件仍在（GraphicsCategory / ControlsCategory / AboutCategory），只是不進導覽列。
  { id: 'graphics', label: '畫面', icon: Monitor, available: false },
  { id: 'controls', label: '操作', icon: Gamepad2, available: false },
  { id: 'account', label: '帳號', icon: User, available: true },
  { id: 'about', label: '關於', icon: Info, available: false },
];

/** 導覽列該畫哪幾格。SettingsNav 與 SettingsView 都問這個，不會有一邊多一格的情況。 */
export const VISIBLE_SETTINGS_CATEGORIES: SettingsCategoryDef[] =
  SETTINGS_CATEGORIES.filter((c) => c.available !== false);
```

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import type { SettingsCategoryId } from './settingsCategories';

/**
 * 「打開設定，而且直接停在這一頁。」
 *
 * ## 為什麼需要它
 *
 * 帳號中心（UI/AccountPanel.tsx）底下有兩張看起來完全不同的卡：
 *
 *   編輯個人資料 · 更變暱稱 & 挑選您的專屬頭像
 *   偏好系統設定 · 調整背景音樂與 AI 語音輔助
 *
 * 兩個 `onClick` 以前是**同一個** `handleNavigateToSettings`，而設定永遠從「一般」開場。於是
 * 承諾了暱稱與頭像的那一張，把玩家丟在一個沒有暱稱也沒有頭像的分頁上，剩下的路要自己找 ——
 * 兩個不同的入口通往同一個地方，而且是錯的那一個地方。
 *
 * ## 為什麼是一個模組變數而不是 context
 *
 * 這是一個**一次性的意圖**，不是狀態：它在切換 view 的前一刻寫下、在 SettingsView 掛載的那一刻
 * 讀走，之後就不存在了。放進 AppContext 會讓每一位訂閱者為了一個活不過一次 mount 的值重繪，而
 * 且還得再想「用完要不要清掉、誰負責清」—— 那正是 `consume` 這個名字在這裡代替的東西。
 *
 * SettingsView 每次進入都是全新掛載（App.tsx 的 AnimatePresence 以 currentView 為 key），所以
 * 「寫下 → 切 view → 掛載時讀走」這個順序是成立的，不需要訂閱。
 *
 * 讀走就清掉，這一點是刻意的：沒有清的話，玩家下一次自己從 NavBar 點開設定，會被送到上一次別人
 * 幫他選的那一頁。
 */
let requestedCategory: SettingsCategoryId | null = null;

/** 在 `setCurrentView(View.SETTINGS)` **之前**呼叫。 */
export function requestSettingsCategory(id: SettingsCategoryId): void {
  requestedCategory = id;
}

/** SettingsView 掛載時呼叫一次。沒有人指定過就回 `null`，設定照常從預設分頁開場。 */
export function consumeRequestedSettingsCategory(): SettingsCategoryId | null {
  const requested = requestedCategory;
  requestedCategory = null;
  return requested;
}
```

## src/components/health/ActivityHistoryPanel.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { CalendarCheck, Dumbbell, Flame, TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { Button, EmptyState } from '../UI/DesignKit';
import { SectionHeading, StateNotice } from './HealthChrome';
import {
  activityCivilDate,
  activityTimeLabel,
  dayHeading,
  durationLabel,
  formatNumber,
} from './healthFormat';
import { addCivilDays, civilDateAt, type CivilDate } from '../../constants/civilTime';
import { distinctTypes } from './healthSections';
import type { HealthActivity } from '../../lib/healthData';

/**
 * 「活動紀錄」分頁 —— 過去的運動，依日期整理。
 *
 * 規格要求「依日期或類型整理」並且「避免與目前任務資訊全部混在一起」。改版前那個畫面把三個統計
 * 數字、一張圖表跟全部紀錄疊在同一張卡上，而那張圖畫的是「最近 10 次」—— 一個沒有日期概念的
 * 數列。這裡分成三塊：一張趨勢圖、一排類型篩選、一份依日分組的清單。
 *
 * 分組是在**遊戲時區**做的（healthFormat 的 `activityCivilDate`），不是 `toLocaleDateString()`：
 * 一筆晚上 11 點的紀錄會不會被分到隔天，不該取決於玩家的筆電設在哪一個時區。
 */
export function ActivityHistoryPanel() {
  const { weeklyTaskView, setCurrentView } = useApp();
  const { activities, loading, error } = weeklyTaskView;

  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const types = useMemo(() => distinctTypes(activities), [activities]);

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => (typeFilter ? activities.filter((activity) => activity.type === typeFilter) : activities),
    [activities, typeFilter],
  );

  const today = civilDateAt(new Date());
  const yesterday = addCivilDays(today, -1);

  /** 依日分組，由新到舊。`activities` 已經排序過，所以這裡只需要一次走訪。 */
  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const byDay = new Map<CivilDate, HealthActivity[]>();
    for (const activity of filtered) {
      const day = activityCivilDate(activity);
      const bucket = byDay.get(day);
      if (bucket) bucket.push(activity);
      else byDay.set(day, [activity]);
    }
    return [...byDay.entries()];
  }, [filtered]);

  /** 每日總動作次數，最近 14 天。圖表的 x 軸是日期而不是「第幾次」。 */
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    const totals = new Map<CivilDate, { reps: number; calories: number }>();
    for (const activity of filtered) {
      const day = activityCivilDate(activity);
      const current = totals.get(day) ?? { reps: 0, calories: 0 };
      totals.set(day, {
        reps: current.reps + activity.reps,
        calories: current.calories + activity.calories,
      });
    }
    const days: Array<{ day: string; label: string; reps: number; calories: number }> = [];
    for (let offset = 13; offset >= 0; offset -= 1) {
      const day = addCivilDays(today, -offset);
      const value = totals.get(day) ?? { reps: 0, calories: 0 };
      days.push({
        day,
        label: day.slice(5).replace('-', '/'),
        reps: value.reps,
        calories: Math.round(value.calories),
      });
    }
    return days;
  }, [filtered, today]);

  const totals = useMemo(
    () =>
      filtered.reduce(
        (acc, activity) => ({
          workouts: acc.workouts + 1,
          reps: acc.reps + activity.reps,
          calories: acc.calories + activity.calories,
        }),
        { workouts: 0, reps: 0, calories: 0 },
      ),
    [filtered],
  );

  if (error) {
    return (
      <StateNotice
        kind="error"
        title="讀不到運動紀錄"
        description="請檢查網路連線後再試一次。你已經完成的運動不會因此消失。"
      />
    );
  }

  if (loading) return <StateNotice kind="loading" title="正在讀取運動紀錄…" />;

  if (activities.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        bordered
        icon={<Dumbbell size={30} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
        title="還沒有運動紀錄"
        description="完成第一次健身之後，這裡會依日期列出你做過的每一次運動。"
        action={
          <Button variant="primary" className="h-12 px-6" onClick={() => setCurrentView(View.FITNESS)}>
            <Dumbbell size={16} strokeWidth={3} />
            前往健身
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <SectionHeading
        icon={<TrendingUp size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
        title="最近 14 天"
        subtitle={`${totals.workouts} 次運動．${formatNumber(totals.reps)} 下．${formatNumber(totals.calories)} 大卡`}
      />

      {/* 圖表。高度用 `aspect` 而不是固定的 px：一支手機橫著拿的時候，一個寫死 300px 的圖會吃
          掉整個可視高度。`min-h` 保底，避免在極矮的視窗裡塌成一條線。 */}
      <div className="bg-island-cream-2 rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-line p-4 sm:p-5">
        <h4 className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-widest text-island-navy-soft/70 uppercase mb-4">
          每日動作次數
        </h4>
        <div className="w-full aspect-[16/7] min-h-[160px]">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 4, right: 4, bottom: 0, left: -24 }}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="healthHistoryFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#2A9D8F" stopOpacity={0.3} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#2A9D8F" stopOpacity={0} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="#E1DED4" />
              <XAxis
                dataKey="label"
                tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: '#4A6169' }}
                axisLine={false}
                tickLine={false}
                interval="preserveStartEnd"
                minTickGap={16}
              />
              <YAxis
                tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: '#4A6169' }}
                axisLine={false}
                tickLine={false}
                width={44}
                allowDecimals={false}
              />
              <Tooltip
                contentStyle={{
                  backgroundColor: '#264653',
                  border: 'none',
                  borderRadius: '16px',
                  color: '#fff',
                  padding: '10px 12px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                }}
                itemStyle={{ color: '#fff' }}
                labelStyle={{ color: '#fff', fontWeight: 900 }}
                formatter={(value) => [`${Number(value ?? 0)} 下`, '動作次數']}
              />
              <Area
                type="monotone"
                dataKey="reps"
                stroke="#2A9D8F"
                strokeWidth={3}
                fillOpacity={1}
                fill="url(#healthHistoryFill)"
              />
            </AreaChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 類型篩選。只有真的有兩種以上才出現 —— 一顆永遠只有一個選項的篩選器是雜訊。 */}
      {types.length > 1 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <FilterChip active={typeFilter === null} onClick={() => setTypeFilter(null)}>
            全部
          </FilterChip>
          {types.map((type) => (
            <FilterChip key={type} active={typeFilter === type} onClick={() => setTypeFilter(type)}>
              {type}
            </FilterChip>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <section className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <SectionHeading icon={<CalendarCheck size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />} title="依日期" />
        {groups.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            bordered
            icon={<Dumbbell size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
            title={`沒有「${typeFilter}」的紀錄`}
            description="換一個項目，或先去完成一次這種運動。"
          />
        ) : (
          groups.map(([day, entries]) => (
            <div key={day} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                <h5 className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy">{dayHeading(day, today, yesterday)}</h5>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60 font-mono">
                  {entries.length} 次
                </span>
              </div>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {entries.map((activity) => (
                  <li
                    key={activity.activityId}
                    className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-island-line px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3"
                  >
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-black font-mono text-island-navy-soft/60 w-11 flex-shrink-0">
                      {activityTimeLabel(activity)}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">{activity.type}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 truncate">
                        {durationLabel(activity.durationSeconds)} · {activity.reps} 下
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-black font-mono text-island-gold flex-shrink-0">
                      <Flame size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                      {Math.round(activity.calories)}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterChip({
  active,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`h-10 px-4 rounded-xl border text-xs font-black transition-all active:scale-95 ${
        active
          ? 'bg-island-teal text-white border-island-teal-dark/40'
          : 'bg-white text-island-navy-soft border-island-line hover:border-island-teal-light'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { IconTile } from '../UI/DesignKit';

/**
 * 健康頁四個分頁共用的兩塊小零件。
 *
 * 分頁各自 hand-roll 一個標題列與一個載入狀態，是四個分頁看起來像四個不同畫面的最快路徑。這兩
 * 個元件小到看起來不值得抽出來，而那正是它們最容易長出四份的原因。
 */

/** 一個區塊的標題列：圖示、標題、副標，右邊可選一顆動作按鈕。 */
export function SectionHeading({
  icon,
  title,
  subtitle,
  action,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    // `flex-wrap` 加上 `min-w-0`：手機上按鈕換到下一行，而不是把標題擠成一個字。
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
        <IconTile size={40} active className="text-island-teal">
          {icon}
        </IconTile>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h3 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight truncate">{title}</h3>
          {subtitle && (
            <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 truncate mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 載入中／讀取失敗。
 *
 * 兩者分開而不是共用一個「沒有資料」的畫面，因為它們對玩家的意思完全不同：一個是「等一下」，另
 * 一個是「你的資料還在，只是現在拿不到」。把讀取失敗畫成空狀態，等於告訴玩家他的紀錄不見了。
 */
export function StateNotice({
  kind,
  title,
  description,
}: {
  kind: 'loading' | 'error';
  title: string;
  description?: string;
}) {
  const isError = kind === 'error';
  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-[1.75rem] border p-6 flex items-center gap-3 ${
        isError ? 'bg-island-coral/8 border-island-coral/25' : 'bg-island-cream-2 border-island-line'
      }`}
    >
      <div className={`flex-shrink-0 ${isError ? 'text-island-coral' : 'text-island-teal'}`}>
        {isError ? <AlertCircle size={22} strokeWidth={2.5} /> : <Loader2 size={22} className="animate-spin" />}
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className={`text-sm font-black ${isError ? 'text-island-coral' : 'text-island-navy'}`}>{title}</p>
        {description && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{description}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
