## src/components/health/HealthOverviewPanel.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Activity, ArrowRight, CalendarCheck, Dumbbell, Flame, Plus, Target, Timer, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { Button, EmptyState, StatTile } from '../UI/DesignKit';
import type { HealthSection } from './healthSections';
import { SectionHeading, StateNotice } from './HealthChrome';
import {
  activityTimeLabel,
  cycleRangeLabel,
  dayHeading,
  durationLabel,
  formatNumber,
  remainingLabel,
} from './healthFormat';
import { addCivilDays, civilDateAt } from '../../constants/civilTime';
import { activityCivilDate } from './healthFormat';

/**
 * 「健康總覽」分頁 —— 一眼看完現在的狀態。
 *
 * ## 這裡放什麼、不放什麼
 *
 * 規格把總覽定義成「今日或目前的主要健康數據、近期活動摘要、每週任務完成進度、重要提醒、簡潔的
 * 整體狀態」。關鍵字是**摘要**：每一區都只放最上面的兩三筆，然後給一條通往完整分頁的路。一個總
 * 覽如果把每週任務的全部八張卡片都畫出來，它就不是總覽，是「每週任務」分頁的第二份拷貝 —— 這正
 * 是改版前那個把所有東西堆在同一頁的畫面的問題。
 *
 * 所以：任務只顯示前兩個，紀錄只顯示前三筆，其餘交給分頁。
 */
export function HealthOverviewPanel({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate: (section: HealthSection) => void }) {
  const { weeklyTaskView, setCurrentView } = useApp();
  const { summary, progress, activities, cycle, loading, error } = weeklyTaskView;

  const today = civilDateAt(new Date());
  const yesterday = addCivilDays(today, -1);
  const recent = activities.slice(0, 3);
  const topTasks = progress.slice(0, 2);
  // 「重要提醒」= 還沒完成、而且本週快結束了的任務。這是總覽唯一主動說話的地方，所以它必須是真
  // 的有事才出現 —— 一個每次進來都在提醒的橫幅，玩家三天後就看不見它了。
  const urgent = progress.filter((entry) => !entry.completed && entry.status === 'active' && entry.daysRemaining <= 2);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {/* 重要提醒。只在真的緊急時出現。 */}
      {urgent.length > 0 && (
        <motion.button
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          onClick={() => onNavigate('tasks')}
          className="text-left rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-gold/35 bg-island-gold/10 p-4 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-[0.98]"
        >
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-island-gold/20 border border-island-gold/30 text-island-gold flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <Zap size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">
              {urgent.length === 1 ? `「${urgent[0].task.name}」還沒完成` : `有 ${urgent.length} 個任務還沒完成`}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 truncate mt-0.5">
              {remainingLabel(urgent[0].remaining)}
            </p>
          </div>
          <ArrowRight size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} className="text-island-navy-soft/50 flex-shrink-0" />
        </motion.button>
      )}

      {/* 本週數據。四格，手機兩欄、桌機四欄 —— 沒有固定寬度。 */}
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <SectionHeading
          icon={<Activity size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
          title="本週健康數據"
          subtitle={`${cycleRangeLabel(cycle.weekStart, cycle.weekEnd)}．週一到週日`}
        />
        {error ? (
          <StateNotice
            kind="error"
            title="讀不到運動紀錄"
            description="數據需要你的運動紀錄才能計算。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。"
          />
        ) : loading ? (
          <StateNotice kind="loading" title="正在讀取運動紀錄…" />
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <StatTile accent="teal" icon={<Dumbbell size={18} />} label="運動次數" value={summary.workouts} />
            <StatTile accent="navy" icon={<Timer size={18} />} label="運動時間 (分)" value={summary.minutes} />
            <StatTile accent="teal" icon={<Zap size={18} />} label="動作次數" value={formatNumber(summary.reps)} />
            <StatTile accent="gold" icon={<Flame size={18} />} label="卡路里" value={formatNumber(summary.calories)} />
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 每週任務摘要。 */}
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <SectionHeading
          icon={<Target size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
          title="每週任務進度"
          subtitle={
            summary.tasksActive > 0
              ? `本週已完成 ${summary.tasksCompleted} / ${summary.tasksActive} 個任務`
              : '還沒有任務'
          }
          action={
            progress.length > 0 ? (
              <Button variant="secondary" className="h-10 px-4 text-xs" onClick={() => onNavigate('tasks')}>
                查看全部
                <ArrowRight size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
              </Button>
            ) : undefined
          }
        />
        {progress.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            bordered
            icon={<Target size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
            title="還沒有每週任務"
            description="設一個目標，這裡就會出現你這一週的進度。"
            action={
              <Button variant="primary" className="h-11 px-5" onClick={() => onNavigate('tasks')}>
                <Plus size={15} strokeWidth={3} />
                建立每週任務
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {topTasks.map((entry) => (
              <button
                key={entry.task.taskId}
                onClick={() => onNavigate('tasks')}
                className="text-left bg-white rounded-[1.75rem] border border-island-line p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 transition-all hover:border-island-teal-light hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-[0.98]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">{entry.task.name}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-black font-mono text-island-navy-soft/70 flex-shrink-0">
                    {entry.current} / {entry.target}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2.5 rounded-full bg-island-sand border border-island-line overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    style={{ width: `${entry.ratio * 100}%` }}
                    className={`h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500 ${
                      entry.completed ? 'bg-island-teal' : 'bg-island-teal-light'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 truncate">
                  {entry.completed ? '本週目標已達成' : remainingLabel(entry.remaining)}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* 近期活動摘要。 */}
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <SectionHeading
          icon={<CalendarCheck size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
          title="最近的活動"
          subtitle={activities.length > 0 ? `共 ${activities.length} 筆紀錄` : undefined}
          action={
            activities.length > 0 ? (
              <Button variant="secondary" className="h-10 px-4 text-xs" onClick={() => onNavigate('history')}>
                查看紀錄
                <ArrowRight size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
              </Button>
            ) : undefined
          }
        />
        {loading ? null : activities.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            bordered
            icon={<Dumbbell size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
            title="還沒有運動紀錄"
            description="去健身完成第一次運動，這裡就會開始記錄。"
            action={
              <Button variant="primary" className="h-11 px-5" onClick={() => setCurrentView(View.FITNESS)}>
                <Dumbbell size={15} strokeWidth={3} />
                前往健身
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {recent.map((activity) => (
              <li
                key={activity.activityId}
                className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-island-line px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3"
              >
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-island-teal/10 border border-island-teal/25 text-island-teal-dark flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                  <Dumbbell size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">{activity.type}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 truncate">
                    {dayHeading(activityCivilDate(activity), today, yesterday)} {activityTimeLabel(activity)}
                    {' · '}
                    {durationLabel(activity.durationSeconds)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-black font-mono text-island-navy-soft/70 flex-shrink-0">
                  {activity.reps} 下
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/health/HealthView.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Heart, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import { View } from '../../types';
import { IconTile, SignpostTag } from '../UI/DesignKit';
import { playSound, SoundEffect } from '../../lib/soundUtils';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { HEALTH_SECTIONS, type HealthSection } from './healthSections';
import { HealthOverviewPanel } from './HealthOverviewPanel';
import { WeeklyTaskPanel } from './WeeklyTaskPanel';
import { ActivityHistoryPanel } from './ActivityHistoryPanel';

/**
 * 健康 —— 運動數據、每週任務與活動紀錄。
 *
 * ## 這個畫面以前叫「追蹤」
 *
 * 舊版是 components/TrackerView.tsx：一張 `h-[85vh]` 的卡片，裡面是三個統計數字加一張「最近 10
 * 次」的折線圖。它有三個具體問題，而這一版是針對它們改的：
 *
 *  - **名字**。「追蹤」沒有說出追蹤什麼，而且跟「健身」放在同一排路牌上時，玩家分不出哪一個是
 *    「動起來的地方」、哪一個是「看數字的地方」。現在三個分頁的名字都是「健康」。
 *  - **一頁到底**。加進每週任務之後，所有東西擠在同一個捲動容器裡。現在分成三區
 *    （constants 在 healthSections.ts）。
 *  - **固定高度**。`h-[85vh]` 在矮視窗（1366×768 的筆電、橫著拿的手機）會把圖表壓成一條線，而
 *    在高視窗留下一片空白。現在整頁是自然流動的捲動頁，高度由內容決定。
 *
 * ## 版面
 *
 * 一個全螢幕捲動頁，跟商店（ShopView）與設定同一個形狀 —— `page-shell-x/y` 負責留出瀏海與圓角
 * 的安全區，`max-w-4xl` 負責在寬螢幕上不要把一行字拉成 1800px。分頁列是一排 `SignpostTag`，跟
 * 商店的主分區列同一個元件；固定三欄，所以三個分頁在 320px 的螢幕上仍然是三個讀得完的木牌，而
 * 不是一排被擠爛的字。
 */
export function HealthView() {
  const { setCurrentView } = useApp();
  const [section, setSection] = useState<HealthSection>('overview');

  const close = () => setCurrentView(View.HOME);
  useEscapeToClose(close);

  const meta = HEALTH_SECTIONS.find((entry) => entry.id === section) ?? HEALTH_SECTIONS[0];

  return (
    // z-40: local sub-scale — 這個畫面永遠掛在 App.tsx 的 z-game-view 容器裡，所以它只需要贏過
    // 自己的兄弟（下面那顆 z-50 的關閉鍵）。見 DESIGN_SYSTEM.md 的 z-index「local sub-scale
    // exception」。
    <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-y-auto z-40 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-3xl page-shell-y page-shell-x">
      <button
        onClick={close}
        aria-label="關閉健康頁"
        className="fixed corner-safe-tr w-14 h-14 bg-white border border-island-line hover:bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-navy transition-all z-50 shadow-[0_10px_24px_rgba(38,70,83,0.15)] active:scale-95 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
      >
        <X size={28} strokeWidth={3} />
      </button>

      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.22 }}
        // 沒有 `h-[85vh]`：高度由內容決定，頁面自己捲。這是這一版唯一真正結構性的版面改動。
        className="max-w-4xl w-full mx-auto bg-white border border-island-line rounded-[2rem] shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(38,70,83,0.15)] text-island-navy overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* 標題。`pr-20` 在窄螢幕上讓出右上角那顆固定的關閉鍵，否則標題會被壓在它下面。 */}
        <header className="px-5 sm:px-8 pt-6 sm:pt-8 pr-20 sm:pr-24 flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          <IconTile size={48} active className="text-island-teal">
            <Heart size={26} />
          </IconTile>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">健康</h2>
            <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold truncate">{meta.blurb}</p>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* 分頁列。跟商店主分區同一個做法：`grid` 的欄是 `minmax(0, 1fr)`，所以一個長標籤不可能
            把這一列撐爆 —— 一個 `flex` 加 `min-w-[…]` 的版本才會。 */}
        <nav className="px-5 sm:px-8 pt-5 sm:pt-6">
          {/* 三欄，每個寬度都相同，在每一個螢幕尺寸上都是。不是 `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3`：
              三個 2-4 字的標籤在 320px 上分成三欄仍然各有 ~100px，讀得完；而兩欄會把第三個分頁
              推到自己一行、獨佔半個版面，看起來像它比另外兩個重要。 */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:gap-3">
            {HEALTH_SECTIONS.map((entry) => {
              const active = entry.id === section;
              return (
                <SignpostTag
                  key={entry.id}
                  shape="hang"
                  active={active}
                  onClick={() => {
                    playSound(SoundEffect.CLICK);
                    setSection(entry.id);
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 px-2 pt-4 pb-3"
                >
                  <span className="font-black tracking-tight text-xs sm:text-sm truncate max-w-full">
                    {entry.label}
                  </span>
                </SignpostTag>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </nav>

        <div className="p-5 sm:p-8">
          {section === 'overview' && <HealthOverviewPanel onNavigate={setSection} />}
          {section === 'tasks' && <WeeklyTaskPanel />}
          {section === 'history' && <ActivityHistoryPanel />}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/health/WeeklyTaskCard.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { Check, Pencil, Trash2, CalendarRange } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import type { WeeklyTaskProgress } from '../../constants/weeklyTasks';
import { accentClass } from '../UI/DesignKit';
import { cycleRangeLabel, remainingLabel, statusAccent, statusLabel } from './healthFormat';

/**
 * 一張每週任務卡。
 *
 * ## 資訊層級
 *
 * 規格要求「使用者不需要閱讀所有文字才能理解畫面」，所以這張卡有三層，而且只有三層：
 *
 *   1. **名字 ＋ 狀態徽章** —— 掃一眼就知道這是哪一個任務、做完了沒有。
 *   2. **大數字 ＋ 進度條** —— 「1 / 3 次」跟那條條。這是玩家真正回來看的東西，所以它是卡上最
 *      大的字，而不是被夾在說明文字中間。
 *   3. **週期與剩餘天數** —— 次要，所以小、灰、在最底下。
 *
 * 編輯／刪除是圖示按鈕，放在右上角，而不是卡片底部的兩顆文字按鈕：它們是偶爾才用一次的動作，不
 * 該跟進度爭同一層視覺重量。
 *
 * ## RWD
 *
 * 沒有任何固定寬度或固定高度。卡片是 grid 的一格，內容自己疊。名字用 `truncate` 搭配
 * `min-w-0`，因為在 flex 裡少了 `min-w-0` 的 `truncate` 不會生效 —— 一個長名字會把右邊的按鈕擠
 * 出容器，這正是規格裡「小螢幕避免水平溢出」講的那種溢出。
 *
 * 進度條上方那一行是 `flex-wrap`：在 320px 寬的手機上，「1 / 3 次」跟「33%」會換行而不是重疊，
 * 這也是規格點名的「進度條與文字不要因容器縮小而重疊」。
 */
export function WeeklyTaskCard({
  entry,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}: {
  entry: WeeklyTaskProgress;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const { task, spec, current, target, ratio, percent, rawPercent, completed, status, cycle } = entry;
  const unit = spec?.unit ?? '';
  const accent = statusAccent(status);

  return (
    <div
      className={`bg-white rounded-[1.75rem] border p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 transition-colors ${
        completed ? 'border-island-teal/45' : 'border-island-line'
      }`}
    >
      {/* 第一層：名字與狀態。`min-w-0` 讓 truncate 真的會截斷，而不是把按鈕推出去。 */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h4 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight truncate">{task.name}</h4>
          {/* 狀態徽章跟目標類型同一行，而不是擠進右邊的按鈕列：在 320px 寬的螢幕上，兩顆 44px
              的按鈕加一顆徽章會把標題壓成兩三個字。這裡它有一整行可以待。 */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 min-w-0">
            <span
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-6 px-2 rounded-lg border text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest flex-shrink-0 ${accentClass[accent]}`}
            >
              {completed && <Check size={11} strokeWidth={3} />}
              {statusLabel(status)}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 truncate">
              {spec?.label ?? '未知的目標類型'}
              {task.activityType ? ` · ${task.activityType}` : ''}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
          {/* 44px 的觸控目標，符合規格「按鈕與互動區域需要有足夠大小」。圖示本身是 16px，其餘
              是留白 —— 縮小的是圖示，不是可以點的範圍。 */}
          <button
            onClick={onEdit}
            title="編輯任務"
            aria-label={`編輯 ${task.name}`}
            className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-teal hover:border-island-teal flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-90"
          >
            <Pencil size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onDelete}
            title="刪除任務"
            aria-label={`刪除 ${task.name}`}
            className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-island-cream-2 border border-island-line text-island-navy-soft hover:text-island-coral hover:border-island-coral flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-90"
          >
            <Trash2 size={16} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 第二層：進度。卡上最大的字。 */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1 min-w-0">
            <span className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black font-mono text-island-navy leading-none">
              {current}
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy-soft/60 font-mono leading-none">
              / {target}
            </span>
            {unit && <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60 leading-none">{unit}</span>}
          </div>
          {/* 超額時顯示真實百分比（例如 140%），因為超額是真的，只有條被夾住。 */}
          <span
            className={`text-sm font-black font-mono leading-none ${
              completed ? 'text-island-teal-dark' : 'text-island-navy-soft/70'
            }`}
          >
            {rawPercent > 100 ? rawPercent : percent}%
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="h-3 rounded-full bg-island-sand border border-island-line overflow-hidden">
          <motion.div
            initial={false}
            // `ratio` 已經夾在 0..1（constants/weeklyTasks.ts），所以視覺上不可能超過 100% ——
            // 這一行不需要自己再 clamp 一次，也就不會有兩個地方各夾各的。
            animate={{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 220, damping: 30 }}
            className={`h-full rounded-full ${completed ? 'bg-island-teal' : 'bg-island-teal-light'}`}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 第三層：週期。小、灰、在最下面。 */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <CalendarRange size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="truncate">{cycleRangeLabel(cycle.weekStart, cycle.weekEnd)}</span>
        </span>
        <span className={completed ? 'text-island-teal-dark' : ''}>
          {completed ? '本週目標已達成' : remainingLabel(entry.remaining)}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

## src/components/health/WeeklyTaskForm.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  METRIC_SPECS,
  getMetricSpec,
  hasErrors,
  TASK_NAME_MAX,
  validateWeeklyTaskDraft,
  type WeeklyTaskDefinition,
  type WeeklyTaskDraft,
  type WeeklyTaskErrors,
} from '../../constants/weeklyTasks';
import { selectableActivityTypes, type HealthActivity } from '../../lib/healthData';
import { Button, ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader } from '../UI/DesignKit';
import { useEscapeToClose } from '../../hooks/useEscapeToClose';
import { FloatingPanelPortal } from '../UI/FloatingPanelPortal';

/**
 * 建立／編輯一個每週任務。
 *
 * 一個 modal，而且只放這一件短暫的操作 —— 規格明確寫了「Modal 僅適合短暫操作，不要把完整功能
 * 全部塞進 Modal」。任務的檢視、進度與管理都在健康頁本身，這裡只有一張四個欄位的表單。
 *
 * ## 驗證
 *
 * 規則全部在 constants/weeklyTasks.ts 的 `validateWeeklyTaskDraft`，這裡一條都沒有。理由是它同時
 * 是**寫入前**的最後一道關（context/useWeeklyTasks.ts 也呼叫同一個函式）：如果表單有自己的一
 * 套，兩套遲早會分岔，而分岔的那一刻表單會放行一個服務會拒絕的任務，玩家看到的是一顆沒反應的按
 * 鈕。
 *
 * 錯誤訊息是逐欄位的，而且只在**送出過一次之後**才顯示 —— 一個還沒打完字就開始罵人的表單，玩家
 * 的第一個反應是它壞了。
 */
export function WeeklyTaskForm({
  open,
  editing,
  existingTasks,
  activities,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  /** 編輯模式時的既有任務；建立模式是 null。 */
  editing: WeeklyTaskDefinition | null;
  existingTasks: readonly WeeklyTaskDefinition[];
  activities: readonly HealthActivity[];
  onClose: () => void;
  /** 回傳欄位錯誤代表服務端也拒絕了；回傳 null 代表成功。 */
  onSubmit: (draft: WeeklyTaskDraft) => Promise<WeeklyTaskErrors | null>;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [metric, setMetric] = useState<string>('workout_count');
  const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
  const [activityType, setActivityType] = useState('');
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [serverErrors, setServerErrors] = useState<WeeklyTaskErrors>({});

  const typeOptions = useMemo(() => selectableActivityTypes(activities), [activities]);

  // 每次打開都從頭來：一個還記得上次輸入的表單，在「刪掉又想重建」的流程裡會拿錯的預設值歡迎
  // 玩家。編輯模式則把既有的值填進去。
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setSubmitted(false);
    setSaving(false);
    setServerErrors({});
    if (editing) {
      setName(editing.name);
      setMetric(editing.metric);
      setTarget(String(editing.target));
      setActivityType(editing.activityType ?? typeOptions[0] ?? '');
    } else {
      const spec = getMetricSpec('workout_count');
      setName('');
      setMetric('workout_count');
      setTarget(String(spec?.defaultTarget ?? 3));
      setActivityType(typeOptions[0] ?? '');
    }
    // `typeOptions` 刻意不在依賴裡：訂閱送來一批新紀錄時重設整張表單，會把玩家打到一半的字清
    // 掉。開啟的那一刻取一次就夠了。
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, editing]);

  useEscapeToClose(onClose, open && !saving);

  const draft: WeeklyTaskDraft = { name, metric, target, activityType };
  const spec = getMetricSpec(metric);
  const localErrors = validateWeeklyTaskDraft(draft, existingTasks, editing?.taskId);
  const errors: WeeklyTaskErrors = submitted ? { ...localErrors, ...serverErrors } : serverErrors;

  const changeMetric = (next: string) => {
    setMetric(next);
    setServerErrors({});
    // 換目標類型就換一個合理的預設值。留著上一個類型的數字，會做出「每週運動 300 次」這種任務，
    // 而玩家多半不會注意到單位已經變了。
    const nextSpec = getMetricSpec(next);
    if (nextSpec) setTarget(String(nextSpec.defaultTarget));
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    setSubmitted(true);
    setServerErrors({});
    if (hasErrors(localErrors)) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const result = await onSubmit(draft);
    setSaving(false);
    if (result) {
      setServerErrors(result);
      return;
    }
    onClose();
  };

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    // Portal 出去，而不是留在 HealthView 的卡片裡。
    //
    // HealthView 的卡片是一個有 transform 的 `motion.div`，而一個有 transform 的元素會成為它底下
    // 每一個 `absolute`／`fixed` 子元素的定位基準 —— 加上那張卡片本身 `overflow-hidden`，留在原
    // 地的 modal 會被定位到卡片的框、然後被裁掉一半。寫多高的 z-index 都救不了：它被困在那個
    // stacking context 裡。這跟 BuildingInteriorView 的浮動面板、AccountPanel 是同一個問題與同一
    // 個解法，見 FloatingPanelPortal.tsx。
    <FloatingPanelPortal>
      {/* z-modal — 共用的 modal 層級，見 DESIGN_SYSTEM.md 的 Z-index。 */}
      <ModalOverlay onClick={saving ? undefined : onClose}>
      <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-lg" className="max-h-full">
        <PanelHeader
          icon={<Target size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
          title={editing ? '編輯每週任務' : '建立每週任務'}
          subtitle={editing ? '目標可以隨時調整，已累積的進度會重新計算' : '設定一個這一週想達成的目標'}
          onClose={saving ? undefined : onClose}
        />

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar-teal p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col gap-5">
          <Field label="任務名稱" error={errors.name} hint={`最多 ${TASK_NAME_MAX} 個字`}>
            <input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setName(e.target.value);
                setServerErrors({});
              }}
              maxLength={40}
              placeholder="例如：每週運動 3 次"
              className={inputClass(!!errors.name)}
            />
          </Field>

          <Field label="目標類型" error={errors.metric}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {METRIC_SPECS.map((option) => {
                const isActive = option.id === metric;
                const disabled = !option.available;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={option.id}
                    type="button"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onClick={() => changeMetric(option.id)}
                    // 尚未支援的類型仍然「在」清單上，只是不能選，而且下面就寫著為什麼。把它藏
                    // 起來只會讓玩家一直問遊戲能不能算步數。
                    className={`text-left rounded-2xl border p-3 transition-all ${
                      disabled
                        ? 'bg-island-cream-2 border-island-line opacity-55 cursor-not-allowed'
                        : isActive
                          ? 'bg-island-teal/8 border-island-teal'
                          : 'bg-white border-island-line hover:border-island-teal-light'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy truncate">{option.label}</span>
                      {disabled && (
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-black tracking-widest text-island-navy-soft/60 border border-island-line rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 flex-shrink-0">
                          尚未支援
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                      {disabled ? option.unavailableReason : option.hint}
                    </p>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </Field>

          {spec?.needsActivityType && (
            <Field label="計算哪一種運動" error={errors.activityType}>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {typeOptions.map((type) => (
                  <button
                    key={type}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActivityType(type);
                      setServerErrors({});
                    }}
                    className={`h-11 px-4 rounded-xl border text-sm font-black transition-all active:scale-95 ${
                      activityType === type
                        ? 'bg-island-teal text-white border-island-teal-dark/40'
                        : 'bg-white text-island-navy-soft border-island-line hover:border-island-teal-light'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {type}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Field>
          )}

          <Field
            label="目標數值"
            error={errors.target}
            hint={spec ? `${spec.minTarget} – ${spec.maxTarget} ${spec.unit}` : undefined}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                value={target}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setTarget(e.target.value);
                  setServerErrors({});
                }}
                // `inputMode="numeric"` 而不是 `type="number"`：數字型 input 在手機上會吃掉自
                // 己的值（空字串／`e`／小數點的行為各家瀏覽器不同），而驗證本來就在
                // constants/weeklyTasks.ts 做，這裡只需要叫出數字鍵盤。
                inputMode="numeric"
                placeholder={String(spec?.defaultTarget ?? '')}
                className={`${inputClass(!!errors.target)} font-mono`}
              />
              {spec && (
                <span className="text-sm font-black text-island-navy-soft/70 flex-shrink-0">{spec.unit}</span>
              )}
            </div>
            {/* 快速填入。手機上打數字是這張表單最煩的一步。 */}
            {spec && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                {quickTargets(spec.defaultTarget, spec.minTarget, spec.maxTarget).map((value) => (
                  <button
                    key={value}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setTarget(String(value))}
                    className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 text-xs font-black font-mono text-island-navy-soft hover:border-island-teal hover:text-island-teal transition-all active:scale-95"
                  >
                    {value}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </Field>

          {errors.form && (
            <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-island-coral bg-island-coral/10 border border-island-coral/25 rounded-xl p-3">
              <AlertCircle size={15} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-px" />
              <span>{errors.form}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 border-t border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end flex-shrink-0">
          <Button variant="secondary" className="h-12 px-6" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving}>
            取消
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" className="h-12 px-6" onClick={submit} disabled={saving}>
            {saving && <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />}
            {saving ? '儲存中…' : editing ? '儲存變更' : '建立任務'}
          </Button>
        </div>
        </ModalShell>
      </ModalOverlay>
    </FloatingPanelPortal>
  );
}

/** 三個好按的整數建議值，圍著這個類型的預設值。上下限外的不出現。 */
function quickTargets(base: number, min: number, max: number): number[] {
  const candidates = [Math.round(base / 2), base, base * 2, base * 3];
  const unique: number[] = [];
  for (const value of candidates) {
    if (value < min || value > max) continue;
    if (!unique.includes(value)) unique.push(value);
  }
  return unique.slice(0, 4);
}

function inputClass(invalid: boolean): string {
  return `w-full h-12 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white border text-sm font-bold text-island-navy placeholder:text-island-navy-soft/40 outline-none transition-colors ${
    invalid
      ? 'border-island-coral focus:border-island-coral'
      : 'border-island-line focus:border-island-teal'
  }`;
}

/** 一個欄位：標籤、內容、提示或錯誤。錯誤取代提示，不是疊在它下面 —— 兩行小字讀起來像一段話。 */
function Field({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <label className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-widest text-island-navy-soft/70 uppercase">{label}</label>
      {children}
      {error ? (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-island-coral">
          <AlertCircle size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-px" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </p>
      ) : hint ? (
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60">{hint}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/health/WeeklyTaskPanel.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, CalendarRange, Loader2, Plus, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';
import {
  MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS,
  type WeeklyTaskDefinition,
  type WeeklyTaskDraft,
  type WeeklyTaskErrors,
} from '../../constants/weeklyTasks';
import { Button, EmptyState, ModalOverlay, ModalShell, PanelHeader } from '../UI/DesignKit';
import { WeeklyTaskCard } from './WeeklyTaskCard';
import { WeeklyTaskForm } from './WeeklyTaskForm';
import { cycleRangeLabel } from './healthFormat';
import { SectionHeading, StateNotice } from './HealthChrome';
import { FloatingPanelPortal } from '../UI/FloatingPanelPortal';

/**
 * 「每週任務」分頁 —— 任務清單、建立／編輯／刪除的入口。
 *
 * 這裡沒有任何進度計算：每一張卡片拿到的都是 `weeklyTaskView.progress` 裡算好的一筆
 * （context/useWeeklyTasks.ts → constants/weeklyTasks.ts）。這個元件唯一的工作是排版跟決定哪一
 * 個 modal 開著。
 */
export function WeeklyTaskPanel() {
  const { weeklyTaskView, createWeeklyTask, updateWeeklyTask, deleteWeeklyTask } = useApp();
  const { cycle, progress, tasks, loading, error, canCreate } = weeklyTaskView;

  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<WeeklyTaskDefinition | null>(null);
  const [pendingDelete, setPendingDelete] = useState<WeeklyTaskDefinition | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteFailed, setDeleteFailed] = useState(false);

  const openCreate = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setFormOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (task: WeeklyTaskDefinition) => {
    setEditing(task);
    setFormOpen(true);
  };

  /** 表單只認得「有沒有錯誤」。把服務的 outcome 翻成那個形狀的地方只有這裡一處。 */
  const submit = async (draft: WeeklyTaskDraft): Promise<WeeklyTaskErrors | null> => {
    const outcome = editing
      ? await updateWeeklyTask(editing.taskId, draft)
      : await createWeeklyTask(draft);
    if (outcome.ok) return null;
    if (outcome.reason === 'invalid' && outcome.errors) return outcome.errors;
    return { form: refusalMessage(outcome.reason) };
  };

  const confirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!pendingDelete) return;
    setDeleting(true);
    setDeleteFailed(false);
    const outcome = await deleteWeeklyTask(pendingDelete.taskId);
    setDeleting(false);
    if (!outcome.ok) {
      setDeleteFailed(true);
      return;
    }
    setPendingDelete(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <SectionHeading
        icon={<Target size={18} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
        title="每週任務"
        subtitle={`本週 ${cycleRangeLabel(cycle.weekStart, cycle.weekEnd)}．週一開始、週日結束`}
        action={
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            className="h-11 px-4 text-sm flex-shrink-0"
            onClick={openCreate}
            disabled={!canCreate}
            title={canCreate ? '建立每週任務' : `最多 ${MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS} 個任務`}
          >
            <Plus size={16} strokeWidth={3} />
            建立任務
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {loading ? (
        <StateNotice kind="loading" title="正在讀取運動紀錄…" />
      ) : error ? (
        <StateNotice
          kind="error"
          title="讀不到運動紀錄"
          description="任務進度需要你的運動紀錄才能計算。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。"
        />
      ) : progress.length === 0 ? (
        // 規格：「如果目前尚未有任何任務，應顯示友善的空狀態與『建立每週任務』入口，而不是顯示
        // 空白頁面。」
        <EmptyState
          bordered
          icon={<Target size={30} strokeWidth={1.5} />}
          title="還沒有每週任務"
          description="設一個這一週想達成的目標吧 —— 例如「每週運動 3 次」。進度會在你每次健身完自動更新。"
          action={
            <Button variant="primary" className="h-12 px-6" onClick={openCreate}>
              <Plus size={16} strokeWidth={3} />
              建立每週任務
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* 兩欄以上才進 grid。單欄時卡片自然是全寬，不需要任何固定寬度 —— 這是規格裡「不要為
              了 RWD 使用大量固定寬度與固定高度」的做法。 */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
            {progress.map((entry) => (
              <WeeklyTaskCard
                key={entry.task.taskId}
                entry={entry}
                onEdit={() => openEdit(entry.task)}
                onDelete={() => {
                  setDeleteFailed(false);
                  setPendingDelete(entry.task);
                }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-island-navy-soft/60 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <CalendarRange size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} className="flex-shrink-0" />
            任務每週一重新開始，進度來自你實際完成的健身紀錄（{tasks.length} / {MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS} 個任務）
          </p>
        </>
      )}

      <WeeklyTaskForm
        open={formOpen}
        editing={editing}
        existingTasks={tasks}
        activities={weeklyTaskView.activities}
        onClose={() => setFormOpen(false)}
        onSubmit={submit}
      />

      {/* 刪除確認。規格要求「必要的確認提示」—— 刪一個任務會連同它的達標紀錄一起消失，而那是
          一個沒有復原鍵的動作。 */}
      {/* Portal 出去，理由同 WeeklyTaskForm：HealthView 的卡片有 transform 又 overflow-hidden，
          留在原地的 modal 會被裁掉。見 FloatingPanelPortal.tsx。 */}
      {pendingDelete && (
        <FloatingPanelPortal>
        <ModalOverlay onClick={deleting ? undefined : () => setPendingDelete(null)}>
          <ModalShell maxWidthClassName="max-w-md" className="max-h-full">
            <PanelHeader
              icon={<AlertTriangle size={20} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              title="刪除這個任務？"
              onClose={deleting ? undefined : () => setPendingDelete(null)}
            />
            <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col gap-3">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-island-navy leading-relaxed">
                「{pendingDelete.name}」會被移除，連同它過去幾週的達標紀錄。
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70 leading-relaxed">
                你的運動紀錄不會受影響 —— 被刪掉的只有這個目標本身。
              </p>
              {deleteFailed && (
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-island-coral bg-island-coral/10 border border-island-coral/25 rounded-xl p-3">
                  刪除沒有存檔成功，任務還在。請稍後再試一次。
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 border-t border-island-line bg-island-cream-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                className="h-12 px-6"
                onClick={() => setPendingDelete(null)}
                disabled={deleting}
              >
                取消
              </Button>
              <Button variant="danger" className="h-12 px-6" onClick={confirmDelete} disabled={deleting}>
                {deleting && <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />}
                {deleting ? '刪除中…' : '刪除任務'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </ModalShell>
        </ModalOverlay>
        </FloatingPanelPortal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** 服務拒絕的理由，翻成玩家看得懂的一句話。這是這些字串唯一的出處。 */
function refusalMessage(reason: 'no-profile' | 'not-found' | 'limit-reached' | 'save-failed' | 'invalid'): string {
  switch (reason) {
    case 'no-profile':
      return '還沒讀到你的存檔，請稍後再試。';
    case 'not-found':
      return '這個任務已經不在了，可能在別的裝置上被刪掉。';
    case 'limit-reached':
      return `每週任務最多 ${MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS} 個，請先刪除一個。`;
    case 'save-failed':
      return '沒有存檔成功，請檢查網路連線後再試一次。';
    case 'invalid':
      return '有欄位還沒填對。';
  }
}

```

## src/components/health/healthFormat.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 健康頁的顯示字串 —— 一個數字要怎麼變成一句話。
 *
 * 跟 constants/weeklyTasks.ts 分開，因為那邊是規則、這邊是措辭：改「剩一天要怎麼講」不該碰到進度
 * 怎麼算。跟元件分開，因為同一句話會出現在總覽的摘要、任務卡跟歷史清單上，而同一件事在三個地方
 * 有三種講法，是玩家覺得介面「怪怪的」但說不出哪裡怪的來源。
 */

import { civilDateAt, formatCivilDateShort, type CivilDate } from '../../constants/civilTime';
import type { HealthActivity } from '../../lib/healthData';
import type { WeeklyRemaining, WeeklyTaskStatus } from '../../constants/weeklyTasks';

/**
 * 剩餘時間怎麼講。
 *
 * 規格明確點名這件事：「尚未到期顯示剩餘天數、當天到期顯示適當的當日提示、已過期顯示已過期、已
 * 完成顯示完成狀態」。四種狀態四句話，而且「剩 1 天」這句永遠不會出現 —— 因為當只剩今天的時候，
 * 「剩 1 天」聽起來像還有一整天緩衝，而「今天最後一天」才是實話。
 */
export function remainingLabel(remaining: WeeklyRemaining): string {
  switch (remaining.kind) {
    case 'days':
      return `本週還剩 ${remaining.days} 天`;
    case 'due_today':
      return '今天是本週最後一天';
    case 'expired':
      return remaining.daysAgo === 1 ? '已於昨天結束' : `已結束 ${remaining.daysAgo} 天`;
  }
}

/** 任務狀態的短標籤，給卡片右上角那顆徽章。 */
export function statusLabel(status: WeeklyTaskStatus): string {
  switch (status) {
    case 'completed':
      return '已完成';
    case 'expired':
      return '已過期';
    case 'upcoming':
      return '下週開始';
    case 'active':
      return '進行中';
  }
}

/** 徽章的顏色。完成是 teal，過期是 coral，其餘中性 —— 顏色只標示狀態，不當裝飾。 */
export function statusAccent(status: WeeklyTaskStatus): 'teal' | 'coral' | 'navy' {
  if (status === 'completed') return 'teal';
  if (status === 'expired') return 'coral';
  return 'navy';
}

/** `2026-09-21` → `9/21`。純轉呼叫，讓元件不用認識 constants/civilTime。 */
export function shortDate(date: CivilDate): string {
  return formatCivilDateShort(date);
}

/** `9/15 – 9/21`，任務卡上的週期起訖。 */
export function cycleRangeLabel(weekStart: CivilDate, weekEnd: CivilDate): string {
  return `${shortDate(weekStart)} – ${shortDate(weekEnd)}`;
}

/** 一筆活動發生在哪一天，用遊戲時區算 —— 不是裝置時區。 */
export function activityCivilDate(activity: HealthActivity): CivilDate {
  return civilDateAt(new Date(activity.completedAt));
}

/** `14:32`，遊戲時區。日期已經由分組的標題講過了，這裡只需要時間。 */
export function activityTimeLabel(activity: HealthActivity): string {
  const at = new Date(activity.completedAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(at.getTime())) return '--:--';
  // 用固定位移而不是 toLocaleTimeString：跟日期分組必須用同一個時區，否則一筆晚上 11 點的紀錄
  // 會被分到今天、卻顯示成明天早上的時間。
  const shifted = new Date(at.getTime() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${pad(shifted.getUTCHours())}:${pad(shifted.getUTCMinutes())}`;
}

/** `12 分 30 秒` / `45 秒`。秒數在短運動上是唯一有意義的單位，所以不無條件進位成分鐘。 */
export function durationLabel(seconds: number): string {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.round(seconds));
  if (total < 60) return `${total} 秒`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(total / 60);
  const rest = total % 60;
  return rest === 0 ? `${minutes} 分` : `${minutes} 分 ${rest} 秒`;
}

/** 日期分組的標題：今天、昨天，再往前就寫日期。 */
export function dayHeading(date: CivilDate, today: CivilDate, yesterday: CivilDate): string {
  if (date === today) return '今天';
  if (date === yesterday) return '昨天';
  return date.replace(/^\d{4}-/, '').replace('-', '/');
}

/** 大數字加千分位，讓 12000 大卡不用一位一位數。 */
export function formatNumber(value: number): string {
  return Math.round(value).toLocaleString('en-US');
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import type { HealthActivity } from '../../lib/healthData';

/**
 * 健康頁分成哪幾個區。
 *
 * ## 為什麼是三個分頁，而不是一頁到底
 *
 * 改版前的「追蹤」是一張卡片：三個統計數字、一張「最近 10 次」的折線圖，結束。它沒有分頁的問題
 * ——它是連東西都還沒有多到需要分的程度。每週任務進來之後就不是了：任務清單、建立表單與活動紀
 * 錄放在同一個捲動頁裡，玩家要找「我這週還差幾次」得先捲過一張圖表。
 *
 * 三個分頁：總覽、每週任務、活動紀錄。原本還有第四個「資料與說明」（資料來源、目標類型支援狀
 * 況、週期定義），已經拿掉 —— 它是一頁只有靜態說明、沒有任何操作的分頁，卻在導覽列上佔掉四分之
 * 一的寬度，讓三個真的有東西可看的分頁都變窄。它唯一真正必要的內容 ——「哪些目標類型還沒有資料
 * 來源」—— 本來就在建立任務的表單裡講了一次（灰掉的選項下面就寫著原因），而那是玩家真的會問這
 * 個問題的時刻。
 *
 * 分頁（而不是側邊導航或可收合區塊）的理由是這個遊戲的 UI 已經有分頁這個東西了 —— 商店的主分區列就是一排
 * `SignpostTag`（components/UI/CategoryTabs.tsx）。多發明一種導航元件，只會讓健康頁看起來不像
 * 這個遊戲的一部分。
 */
export type HealthSection = 'overview' | 'tasks' | 'history';

export interface HealthSectionMeta {
  id: HealthSection;
  label: string;
  /** 分頁標題列的副標。 */
  blurb: string;
}

export const HEALTH_SECTIONS: readonly HealthSectionMeta[] = [
  { id: 'overview', label: '總覽', blurb: '本週狀態一覽' },
  { id: 'tasks', label: '每週任務', blurb: '自訂目標與進度' },
  { id: 'history', label: '活動紀錄', blurb: '過去的運動' },
] as const;

/** 活動紀錄裡出現過的運動項目，依出現順序（也就是由新到舊第一次出現的順序）。 */
export function distinctTypes(activities: readonly HealthActivity[]): string[] {
  const seen: string[] = [];
  for (const activity of activities) {
    if (!seen.includes(activity.type)) seen.push(activity.type);
  }
  return seen;
}
```

```ts
/**

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * Central catalog of every feature that is (or should become) gated behind
 * 管理員測試模式 (hooks/useAdminMode.ts, components/UI/AdminOnly.tsx).
 *
 * This is documentation with a compiler-checked shape, not a runtime
 * dispatcher — nothing reads this array to decide what to render. Its job is
 * to be the ONE list a developer checks before adding a new test-only
 * feature (to see how similar ones were classified) and before a release
 * (to see what still needs a look). When a `candidate` entry is actually
 * wired up to `<AdminOnly>` / `useAdminMode()`, flip its status to `active`
 * and update `location` to point at the gate.
 *
 * - `active`    — already behind Admin Test Mode; OFF (hidden) for every
 *                 normal player today.
 * - `candidate` — identified as test/dev/debug-only, but still visible to
 *                 every player. Not touched by this pass on purpose (see the
 *                 Admin Test Mode project notes) — flagged here so it can be
 *                 migrated deliberately, one at a time.
 *
 * ## 2026-09-06 — every `active` feature now has ONE address
 *
 * Switching 管理員測試模式 on used to alter seven screens at once, each in its own way, with no
 * screen anywhere saying what had appeared. Every `active` entry below now lives inside the
 * 管理員測試 console (components/UI/admin/), reached from a single tab on the right edge of the
 * screen, and the `location` field says which CATEGORY it landed in
 * (components/UI/admin/adminTestSections.tsx) as well as which files implement it.
 *
 * The control components themselves did not change — AdminIslandControls, AdminValueControls,
 * AdminWorkoutRewardControls and AdminOwnAllItemsRow are the same components with the same write
 * paths. What changed is where they are mounted, so 「掃描 → 分類 → 移入」 rather than a rewrite.
 */

export type AdminFeatureStatus = 'active' | 'candidate';

export type AdminFeatureCategory =
  | 'debug-ui'       // dev-facing panels, overlays, consoles
  | 'test-panel'      // QA conveniences (replay a flow, force a state)
  | 'experimental'    // half-built or trial features
  | 'dev-tool';       // build-time/console-only tooling

export interface AdminFeatureEntry {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  category: AdminFeatureCategory;
  status: AdminFeatureStatus;
  /** Where it lives in the codebase today. */
  location: string;
  note: string;
}
```

## src/constants/angelAvoid.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * The one marker the 小天使 (AngelGuide.tsx) steps around.
 *
 * She narrates the panels along the bottom of the screen from the sky above
 * them, so she is always racing the thing she is talking about for the same
 * viewport. The static half of that — the interior header card and the MiniMap
 * — is solved by `PLACEMENT_KEEP_OUT` in AngelGuide.tsx, because those two are
 * always the same size in the same corner. This marker is for the half that is
 * NOT: the build-mode panel is as tall as whichever tab is open, the furniture
 * drawer only exists while it is open (and jumps to the top-right the moment a
 * piece is picked up), and every dock's height follows its own live contents. A
 * padding figure tuned to any one of those is wrong for the rest, which is how
 * the guide ended up sitting on top of the panel it was narrating on a short
 * window.
 *
 * WHY AN ATTRIBUTE AND NOT A REF — same reasoning as `data-tour`
 * (tourTargets.ts): the obstacles live in different components, in different
 * portals, and mount and unmount as the player works. The guide queries for
 * whatever is on screen this frame and reserves the room it actually occupies;
 * an obstacle that isn't mounted simply isn't found. Nothing here names a
 * specific panel, and no panel needs to know the guide exists beyond spreading
 * this one attribute — which is what lets a dock added later be stepped around
 * for free.
 *
 * The marker goes on the element whose *painted* box must stay clear — the
 * card itself, not a full-bleed backdrop wrapper around it, since
 * `getBoundingClientRect()` on it is literally the area the guide gives up.
 */
export const ANGEL_AVOID = { 'data-angel-avoid': '' } as const;

/** The matching query the guide measures with. */
export const ANGEL_AVOID_SELECTOR = '[data-angel-avoid]';

```

## src/constants/artwork.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { ItemCategory } from '../types';
import type { ItemDefinition } from './items';
import type { Rarity } from './rarity';
import type { PlacementSpec } from './placement';

/**
 * 藝術品 — the catalog, and the one record each piece is made of.
 *
 * ## Why a catalog rather than 40 more rows in items.ts
 *
 * An artwork is not one thing, it is a *form* filled in with a palette: a framed picture and a
 * poster differ by their edge, two landscape paintings differ by four colours and a motif. Written
 * out longhand that is 40 near-identical entries in constants/items.ts plus 40 hand-built models in
 * FurnitureItem.tsx plus 40 hand-drawn SVGs in QVersionIcon.tsx — three lists that must be kept in
 * step by memory, which is exactly how a catalog rots.
 *
 * So a piece is declared once, here, as {@link ArtworkSpec}: what shape it is, what colours, what
 * it depicts, what it costs, and what surface it hangs or stands on. Everything downstream reads
 * that one record:
 *
 *   - `ARTWORK_ITEMS` becomes ordinary catalog rows, spread into ALL_ITEMS, so artworks are bought,
 *     stocked, placed, moved, stored and saved by the systems that already exist. There is no
 *     parallel "artwork system"; an artwork is a piece of furniture that declares its own mount.
 *   - Three/ArtworkModels.tsx draws the 3D piece from `form` + `palette` + `motif`.
 *   - ArtworkIcon.tsx draws the shop/inventory icon from the same three fields, so the icon and
 *     the object in the room cannot drift apart.
 *   - constants/placement.ts turns `form` into the surfaces the piece may attach to.
 *
 * Adding a piece is one entry below. Adding a *kind* of piece is one entry in {@link ArtForm},
 * one model branch and one icon branch — and `npm run audit:furniture` fails until both exist.
 *
 * ## Sizes are here, colliders are not
 *
 * `size` is the picture plane a wall form is drawn at — art direction, not physics. Nothing reads
 * it to decide where the piece may go or how far off the wall it stands: those come from measuring
 * the model that was actually drawn (lib/furniturePlacement.ts), which is what keeps a frame's
 * collision box the size of the frame instead of the size of somebody's guess about the frame.
 */

/**
 * The shape family a piece belongs to. Also the only thing that decides what it mounts to — see
 * {@link ART_FORM_PLACEMENT} — so "can this hang on a wall" is answered by the piece's own data
 * rather than by anything checking whether an item is an artwork.
 */
export type ArtForm =
  // --- wall ---
  /** A picture in a frame: matted canvas behind a moulding. */
  | 'framed'
  /** Gallery-wrap canvas, no frame — the painting's edge is the piece's edge. */
  | 'canvas'
  /** Oil on canvas in a deep, ornate frame, with visible impasto. */
  | 'oil'
  /** An unframed printed sheet, held up at the corners. */
  | 'poster'
  /** Woven cloth hung from a rod, with a fringed hem. */
  | 'tapestry'
  /** Knotted cotton cord hanging from a dowel. */
  | 'macrame'
  /** A carved wooden panel — relief, not picture. */
  | 'relief'
  /** Several small frames hung as one composition. */
  | 'gallery'
  /** A small hanging ornament — light, narrow, hung low. */
  | 'charm'
  // --- tabletop / floor ---
  /** A small figure on a base. */
  | 'figurine'
  /** A thrown ceramic vessel — belly, neck, handles. */
  | 'vessel'
  /** A vase, usually with something in it. */
  | 'vase'
  /** A small abstract sculpture: stacked or pierced solids. */
  | 'objet'
  /** A decorative plate on a stand. */
  | 'plate'
  /** A mineral cluster or point. */
  | 'crystal'
  /** A handmade craft object. */
  | 'craft'
  // --- floor only ---
  /** A large statue on its own pedestal. */
  | 'statue'
  /** Large-format pottery that stands on the ground. */
  | 'urn'
  /** A tall floor vase. */
  | 'floorvase'
  /** A sculpture presented on a display plinth. */
  | 'plinth'
  /** A large art installation — arcs, rings, things you walk around. */
  | 'installation';

/**
 * What a painted surface depicts. Drawn as a handful of flat shapes over the ground colour, in the
 * game's low-poly register — enough that two 風景畫 read as different pictures rather than as the
 * same rectangle in two colours.
 */
export type ArtMotif =
  | 'island'
  | 'ocean'
  | 'plant'
  | 'abstract'
  | 'animal'
  | 'portrait'
  | 'landscape'
  | 'illustration'
  | 'still'
  | 'sunset';

/**
 * The colours a form fills itself in with.
 *
 * `a`/`b`/`c` are ROLES, not a ranking, and every motif uses them the same way — otherwise a
 * palette is a bag of three hex codes whose effect you can only discover by rendering it, which is
 * how 島嶼晨光 shipped its first draft with a navy sun over a yellow sea:
 *
 *   - `a` — the SUBJECT: the mountain, the whale, the leaves, the sun, the big block.
 *   - `b` — the FIELD it sits in: the sea band, the sky, the shoulders, the ground.
 *   - `c` — the ACCENT: the small bright thing. A sun over a landscape, a highlight on a wave,
 *           the red cross on a map.
 *
 * Which keys a *form* uses is still that form's own business (a macramé has no motif at all), but
 * within a painted motif these three mean the same thing everywhere.
 */
export interface ArtPalette {
  /** Frame, rod, base, plinth — the piece's structural colour. */
  frame?: string;
  /** The ground the motif is painted on, or the body colour of a solid piece. */
  ground?: string;
  /** The subject. */
  a?: string;
  /** The field the subject sits in. */
  b?: string;
  /** The accent. */
  c?: string;
}

/** The shelf a piece sits on inside 藝術品. Presentation only — see `subGroup` in items.ts. */
export type ArtGroup = '畫作' | '壁飾' | '雕塑' | '陶藝' | '擺件' | '大型裝置';

export interface ArtworkSpec {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  /**
   * 稀有度 (constants/rarity.ts). Required, like it is on every catalog entry in the game.
   *
   * Declared here rather than derived from `price`, `group` or `form`, and the shelf is laid out so
   * that rule can be READ off it: 部落 or hand-made pieces at 220–300 sit at 普通 while a 520g
   * 鯨落 is 稀有, because what a tier grades is how much of an EVENT the piece is on a wall — not
   * what it cost. `form` decides the model; `rarity` decides the frame it is presented in.
   */
  rarity: Rarity;
  group: ArtGroup;
  form: ArtForm;
  motif?: ArtMotif;
  /**
   * Which silhouette within the form — `'cat'` or `'bird'` for a 雕塑, `'cluster'` or `'point'`
   * for a 水晶.
   *
   * A form is a *family* (a small creature on a base, a mineral on a stand); a variant is the
   * particular shape. Splitting them keeps the number of forms — and therefore the number of
   * model and icon branches — proportional to how many genuinely different constructions exist,
   * while still letting two pieces in one family look like different objects rather than the same
   * object in two colours. It is declared here in the catalog, so nothing anywhere infers a shape
   * from an item id.
   */
  variant?: string;
  /** Picture-plane width and height in local units, for the wall forms. Art direction only. */
  size?: [number, number];
  palette: ArtPalette;
  description: string;
  /** Overrides the form's default hang height (constants/placement.ts explains the units). */
  hangHeight?: number;
  /** Sold in 室外 and placed on the island rather than in the house. */
  outdoor?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Which surfaces each form attaches to.
 *
 * Stated per form rather than per piece because it is a property of the shape: a tapestry hangs,
 * a vase stands. A piece that genuinely differs from its family overrides `placement` on its own
 * catalog row below, which is why this is a default and not a law.
 *
 * The tabletop forms take `['surface', 'floor']`, surface first: a vase belongs on a table, but
 * refusing to let a player stand one on the floor would be a rule with no reason behind it. The
 * order is the preference the placement resolver uses when both are in reach.
 */
export const ART_FORM_PLACEMENT: Record<ArtForm, PlacementSpec> = {
  framed: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.0 },
  canvas: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.0 },
  oil: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.05 },
  poster: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.0 },
  tapestry: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.45 },
  macrame: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.5 },
  relief: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.15 },
  gallery: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.1 },
  charm: { mounts: ['wall'], hangHeight: 2.25 },

  figurine: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },
  vessel: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },
  vase: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },
  objet: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },
  plate: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },
  crystal: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },
  craft: { mounts: ['surface', 'floor'] },

  statue: { mounts: ['floor'] },
  urn: { mounts: ['floor'] },
  floorvase: { mounts: ['floor'] },
  plinth: { mounts: ['floor'] },
  installation: { mounts: ['floor'] },
};

const SPECS_BY_ID = new Map(ARTWORK_SPECS.map((spec) => [spec.id, spec]));

/**
 * The artwork record for an item id, or `undefined` for anything that is not an artwork.
 *
 * This is what the model registry and the icon registry branch on, so an artwork never needs an
 * entry in either of their name-keyed tables.
 */
export function getArtworkSpec(itemId: string): ArtworkSpec | undefined {
  return SPECS_BY_ID.get(itemId);
}

/** Is this piece one that hangs on a wall? Answered from its form, for audits and copy. */
export function isWallArtwork(itemId: string): boolean {
  const spec = SPECS_BY_ID.get(itemId);
  return !!spec && WALL_ART_FORMS.has(spec.form);
}

/**
 * The artwork catalog as ordinary catalog rows, spread into ALL_ITEMS by constants/items.ts.
 *
 * Indoor pieces are FURNITURE in 藝術品; outdoor ones are BUILDING in 室外藝術, matching what the
 * island's build rail already sells — the category is what decides which of the two placement
 * scopes a piece belongs to (utils/categoryUtils.ts), so nothing else has to be told.
 */
export const ARTWORK_ITEMS: ItemDefinition[] = ARTWORK_SPECS.map((spec) => ({
  id: spec.id,
  name: spec.name,
  category: spec.outdoor ? ItemCategory.BUILDING : ItemCategory.FURNITURE,
  price: spec.price,
  rarity: spec.rarity,
  shopCategory: spec.outdoor ? 'ArtOutdoor' : 'Art',
  subGroup: spec.group,
  placement: spec.hangHeight
    ? { ...ART_FORM_PLACEMENT[spec.form], hangHeight: spec.hangHeight }
    : ART_FORM_PLACEMENT[spec.form],
  description: spec.description,
}));
```

## src/constants/cameraFocus.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * WHERE THE ORBIT LOOKS — one rule, so the character holds the same place in the frame whatever
 * the body is doing.
 *
 * 「玩家模型永遠在畫面中間，因此下海/回島鏡頭不會有延遲」. The camera does not aim at the
 * character's logical position (`playerBus.playerPos`, which never leaves the walking plane) but
 * at the middle of the body as it is actually RENDERED, plus a fixed lift. Both terms move, and
 * the whole point of stating them here rather than inside CameraController is that they move for
 * reasons only Avatar.tsx can see:
 *
 *   the root sinks   entering the sea drops the body to {@link SWIM_BODY_Y}, ~0.6 below the
 *                    plane the walker stands on. The bus position does not follow it down.
 *   the body lies    and then it lies down (Three/swimPose.ts pitches it ~71deg about its own
 *                    root), which brings its middle from {@link STANDING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y} to
 *                    {@link FLOATING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y}.
 *
 * 1.25 world units in total, at a default zoom whose half-frame is 2.21 — i.e. a swimmer framed
 * as if they were walking sits 57% of the way from the middle of the screen to its bottom edge
 * lower than a walker, which is well past the top of the bottom navigation bar. That was the
 * reported 「角色在島上走動時會固定在中間，進入海裡就不會，會被下方功能鍵擋住」.
 *
 * WHY THERE IS NO EASING HERE, WHICH IS THE WHOLE POINT. The camera used to answer that with a
 * blend of its own — 1.8 eased toward the swim focus at a fixed rate whenever `isSwimming` went
 * true. Two independently-timed curves for one movement: the body crossed the 1.25 on
 * SWIM_TRANSITION_DURATION's eased ramp (Avatar.tsx applies its swim heights with no smoothing
 * at all, precisely so height and tilt stay in lockstep), while the camera crossed it on an
 * exponential lag that was still a third of the way behind when the body arrived. The character
 * therefore SANK in the frame on the way in and rose on the way out — 「下海/回島鏡頭會有延遲」.
 * Nothing here has a rate, a timer or a blend state: it is a function of the body's rendered
 * height and pose weight this frame, so the framing cannot lag the body by construction, and a
 * future change to how fast the water pose develops needs no matching change here.
 */
import { SWIM_BODY_Y } from './world';

/**
 * How high the body's middle sits above its own root (the character's feet), standing.
 *
 * With the root on the walking plane this plus {@link FOCUS_ABOVE_BODY_MIDDLE} is the 1.8 the
 * outdoor orbit has always aimed at, which is where it comes from.
 */
export const STANDING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y = 0.9;

/**
 * The same measurement for the floating body: lying flat, its middle is barely a quarter of a
 * unit above the root, against the standing 0.9. See Three/swimPose.ts for the pitch.
 */
export const FLOATING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y = 0.25;

/**
 * How far above the body's middle the orbit actually aims — i.e. how high the character sits in
 * the frame. The one piece of taste in this file; everything else is a measurement of the body.
 */
export const FOCUS_ABOVE_BODY_MIDDLE = 0.9;

/** The land framing, as an offset above the walking plane. Unchanged at 1.8 - see the module doc. */
export const STANDING_FOCUS_Y = STANDING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y + FOCUS_ABOVE_BODY_MIDDLE;

/** The same, for a body floating in deep water. Reached continuously, never blended toward. */
export const SWIM_FOCUS_Y = SWIM_BODY_Y + FLOATING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y + FOCUS_ABOVE_BODY_MIDDLE;

const clamp01 = (v: number) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v);
const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;

/**
 * Where the orbit looks, as a height above the character's walking plane (`playerPos.y`).
 *
 * @param planeY     the walking plane — the height `playerBus.playerPos` reports.
 * @param bodyRootY  world Y of the body's root as it is being RENDERED this frame
 *                   (`playerBus.bodyRootY`); `undefined` before the avatar has published one,
 *                   which falls back to the swim depth the pose weight implies.
 * @param swimPose   the water-pose weight the avatar is rendering, 0..1
 *                   (`playerBus.swimPose`).
 *
 * ONLY THE PART OF THE ROOT BELOW THE PLANE COUNTS. The body's height on land is the terrain's,
 * which runs from 0.4 on the mound to 0.02 at the water line - and the island framing measured
 * from the plane is the one that is already right (and the one the bottom navigation bar was
 * fitted around). Following the terrain up would move that framing for no reported reason;
 * following the body DOWN is the defect this file exists for, and the sea is the only place the
 * body ever goes below the plane. So the drop is clamped at zero: on land this returns exactly
 * the 1.8 it always did, and it starts tracking the moment the body starts sinking - including
 * the shallows, where a wader whose feet are on a seabed 0.2 under the plane is 0.2 lower in the
 * world and should be no lower in the frame.
 */
export function orbitFocusOffsetY(
  planeY: number,
  bodyRootY: number | undefined,
  swimPose: number,
): number {
  const pose = clamp01(swimPose);
  const rootY = bodyRootY ?? planeY + SWIM_BODY_Y * pose;
  const drop = Math.min(0, rootY - planeY);
  return drop + lerp(STANDING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y, FLOATING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y, pose) + FOCUS_ABOVE_BODY_MIDDLE;
}

/**
 * The world height of the body's middle - i.e. the point {@link orbitFocusOffsetY} is derived
 * from, and therefore the point that has to hold still in the frame. Exported for
 * scripts/audit-swim-pose.ts's FRAME check, which measures exactly that.
 */
export function bodyMiddleY(bodyRootY: number, swimPose: number): number {
  return bodyRootY + lerp(STANDING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y, FLOATING_BODY_MIDDLE_Y, clamp01(swimPose));
}

```

## src/constants/cameraZoom.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * Single source of truth for camera-zoom (`uiScale`) limits and per-input step
 * sizes. Every input method that can change zoom - mouse wheel
 * (CameraController), the on-screen +/- buttons (ZoomControl), and touch
 * pinch (MobileControls) - imports these instead of hard-coding their own
 * copies, so all three always agree on range and can't silently drift out of
 * sync with each other.
 */
export const ZOOM_MIN = 0.5;
export const ZOOM_MAX = 2.0;

/**
 * The zoom at which the outdoor camera stops trailing the character and goes inside their head.
 *
 * Zoom is not just a distance: pushed to the last sliver of its range it becomes a MODE, and the
 * rig, the character controller and the companion all branch on it (CameraRig, Avatar,
 * Three/IslandPet). It lived as a bare `1.95` in four of those branches, which is one number that
 * had to be edited in four places and, worse, gave anything that needed to ASK "is this player in
 * first person?" nothing to ask.
 *
 * That question is the reason this is named: `uiScale` is persisted to localStorage, so a player
 * who left the camera zoomed all the way in is still in first person the next time they open the
 * game — including on the run where they are handed their first house.
 */
export const FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM = 1.95;

/**
 * Where the zoom is put when something needs to *guarantee* a third-person view.
 *
 * The bottom of the range rather than a step back from {@link FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM}: this is used
 * when the game has decided the player should be looking at their character (see AppContext's
 * first-home camera reset), and a camera parked one notch below the first-person cutoff is still
 * pressed against the back of their head.
 */
export const THIRD_PERSON_ZOOM = ZOOM_MIN;

/**
 * Where the camera starts handing over from the third-person orbit to first person.
 *
 * The handover is a RAMP, not a switch: over this band the orbit arm shortens to nothing, the
 * FOV opens out to the first-person lens, the focus point climbs from the chest to the eye and
 * the player's own body fades away. Every one of those used to spell its own `(uiScale - 1.5) /
 * 0.5` — a ramp that finishes at 2.0 while the MODE changes at {@link FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM} = 1.95.
 * See {@link firstPersonRamp} for what that five hundredths of a mismatch actually looked like.
 *
 * WHY IT IS 1.8 AND NOT 1.5 (「放大到 150 以上會有透視的感覺」). The third-person zoom spends
 * itself on BOTH distance (`7 / uiScale`) and lens (`35 / uiScale`), so zooming in makes the
 * lens progressively LONGER — 25° at 140%, 23° at 150% — and a long lens flattens perspective.
 * Crossing this constant reversed that: the FOV turned around and opened toward the 68°
 * first-person lens while the arm collapsed from 4.7 units to nothing, which is a dolly zoom —
 * the shot that holds a subject the same size on screen while its perspective visibly stretches.
 * At 1.5 that reversal reached 42° at 2.6 units by uiScale 1.7, with the body still 56% opaque,
 * so the player watched their own character stretch for the last third of the zoom range and
 * read it (correctly) as the picture going wrong rather than as a mode change.
 *
 * At 1.8 the whole span the player actually looks at their character from is one flat,
 * monotonically-lengthening lens, and the perspective only opens up over the last three wheel
 * notches — by which point the body is fading out and the shot is openly becoming first person.
 * The band stays wide enough to ramp through (0.15 = 3 wheel notches) rather than being a
 * switch, which is what {@link firstPersonRamp} exists to smooth. Nothing else needs editing to
 * follow it: the arm, the focus climb, the body fade and the FOV all read the ramp, and the
 * arm's own start distance is spelled `7.0 / FIRST_PERSON_RAMP_START` in CameraController.
 */
export const FIRST_PERSON_RAMP_START = 1.8;

/**
 * How far through the third-person → first-person handover a given zoom is: 0 while the camera
 * is still behind the character, 1 from the moment it is inside their head.
 *
 * IT ENDS ON {@link FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM}, and that is the whole reason it exists as a function
 * rather than as the four hand-written copies it replaces. Those ran to ZOOM_MAX (2.0) while the
 * first-person branch takes over at 1.95, so in that band the camera was already sitting inside
 * the skull with the head still being drawn at 10% opacity. From inside a head, the skull's own
 * faces point away and are culled, but the eyes, the mouth and the blush do not — which is
 * exactly the reported 「放大成第一人稱只剩五官浮在空中」. A ramp and a mode change that describe
 * the same transition have to end on the same number, so they now read it from the same place.
 */
export function firstPersonRamp(uiScale: number): number {
  if (uiScale <= FIRST_PERSON_RAMP_START) return 0;
  if (uiScale >= FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM) return 1;
  return (uiScale - FIRST_PERSON_RAMP_START) / (FIRST_PERSON_ZOOM - FIRST_PERSON_RAMP_START);
}

/**
 * How visible the player's own body is at a given zoom: fully solid in third person, and
 * completely gone by the time the camera reaches the eye. The inverse of the ramp above, named
 * because that is what the one caller (Three/Avatar.tsx) is actually asking for.
 */
export function avatarZoomOpacity(uiScale: number): number {
  return 1 - firstPersonRamp(uiScale);
}

/** uiScale change per wheel-event tick. */
export const WHEEL_ZOOM_STEP = 0.05;

/** uiScale change per +/- button click. */
export const BUTTON_ZOOM_STEP = 0.1;

/** uiScale change per pixel of pinch-distance delta (two-finger touch). */
export const PINCH_ZOOM_SENSITIVITY = 0.0035;

export function clampZoom(value: number): number {
  return Math.max(ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(value, ZOOM_MAX));
}
```

## src/constants/characterAssets.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * WHERE THE HAND-MADE CHARACTER MODEL LIVES — one place, so no component ever spells an
 * asset path itself.
 *
 * The rule this file exists to enforce: a model path appears HERE and nowhere else. The
 * moment two components each know a URL, renaming a file or re-cutting the model into
 * different parts becomes a search-and-replace across the codebase instead of an edit to one
 * table — and the second component is always the one that gets missed.
 *
 * Same convention as constants/environmentMaps.ts: files sit in `public/`, so they are
 * served verbatim in dev and copied into `dist/` by `npm run build`, and the paths are
 * absolute for both. They are NOT `import`ed, deliberately — a bundled model becomes part of
 * the main JS payload and is re-downloaded on every deploy, where a `public/` file is a
 * plain cacheable asset the browser can keep across releases.
 *
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * FORMAT: glTF-Binary (.glb)
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *
 * `.glb` is the format to export, and the reason is not preference — it is the only one of
 * the usual candidates that is loadable here without adding anything:
 *
 *   .glb / .gltf   Native. `useGLTF` (@react-three/drei) is already a dependency and is
 *                  already used by this loader. `.glb` over `.gltf` because it is ONE file
 *                  with the textures and buffers packed in, so a part cannot arrive with its
 *                  texture missing — a loose `.gltf` references siblings by relative path and
 *                  breaks quietly the first time someone moves a folder.
 *   .fbx           NOT supported here. three ships an FBXLoader, but it is not wired up, and
 *                  FBX carries units and axis conventions that vary by exporter — which is
 *                  exactly the class of bug the LOCAL-units rule in characterRig.ts exists to
 *                  avoid. Export FBX from the modelling tool only if the tool needs it as an
 *                  intermediate; convert to .glb before it reaches this directory.
 *   .obj           No skeleton, no animation, no scene graph. Fine for a static prop, not for
 *                  a body part that may later need bones.
 *
 * Draco/meshopt compression is deliberately NOT set up. It needs a decoder wired into the
 * loader, and it is not worth doing before there is a real asset whose size can be measured —
 * see the performance note in docs/character-import-checklist.md.
 */

/**
 * The directory every character part is served from: `public/models/character/`.
 *
 * The six files in it are GENERATED — `npm run split:character` cuts them out of
 * `blender-reference/authored-character-source.glb`, which is the one file a modeller edits.
 * Do not hand-edit a part file: the next re-cut overwrites it, and a part whose geometry no
 * longer matches the numbers in characterRig.ts is the "looks fine standing, detaches when it
 * walks" bug. The whole pipeline is docs/character-authored-model.md.
 */
export const CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR = '/models/character';

/**
 * The parts the character can be assembled from, and the file each one is expected at.
 *
 * Both shapes the brief asks to keep open are expressible here, and neither is baked in:
 *
 *   ONE WHOLE MODEL      export the finished body as `whole` and register that single slot.
 *   SEPARATE PARTS       export head/torso/arms/legs and register them as they are finished.
 *
 * Naming a file here does NOT load it. Loading happens only when a slot is registered in
 * character/slots.tsx, so this table can be filled in ahead of the assets with no effect on
 * the running game — it is a statement of where things go, not a manifest of what exists.
 */
export const CHARACTER_MODEL_FILES = {
  /**
   * The whole character as a single export, for the case where the model is finished in one
   * piece rather than part by part. Mounted under the ROOT, so it is authored in LOCAL units
   * with its origin on the ground contact point — not at a joint, unlike every entry below.
   */
  whole: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/character.glb`,
  head: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/head.glb`,
  torso: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/torso.glb`,
  leftArm: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/arm-left.glb`,
  rightArm: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/arm-right.glb`,
  leftLeg: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/leg-left.glb`,
  rightLeg: `${CHARACTER_MODEL_DIR}/leg-right.glb`,
} as const;

export type CharacterModelFileKey = keyof typeof CHARACTER_MODEL_FILES;

/**
 * BUDGETS for one whole character, checked and reported by the loader in dev builds.
 *
 * These are not limits the loader enforces — it warns, it never refuses to draw a part,
 * because a model that is over budget is still far more useful on screen than absent. They
 * exist so "is this model too heavy?" has an answer that was decided in advance rather than
 * argued about after the frame rate drops.
 *
 * The numbers are set against what the procedural character already costs, which is the only
 * honest reference point available before a real asset exists: the shipped chibi is roughly
 * 40 meshes of low-poly primitives, and it runs. A single imported character that stays near
 * these figures cannot be the cause of a new stutter.
 *
 * The one that matters most on this project is `meshes`, not `triangles`. This game's past
 * frame-time problems have been draw-call and main-thread bound rather than fill bound, and
 * every separate mesh with a distinct material is another draw call — so a model split into
 * fifty small objects is worse here than one merged mesh with five times the triangles.
 */
export const CHARACTER_MODEL_BUDGET = {
  /** Triangles for the whole character, all parts summed. */
  triangles: 30000,
  /** Separate meshes. Merge in the modelling tool rather than shipping many small objects. */
  meshes: 40,
  /** Distinct materials. Each one is a state change; an atlas beats a material per part. */
  materials: 8,
  /** Largest texture edge, px. A character this size on screen gains nothing above this. */
  textureSize: 1024,
} as const;

```
