```ts
  list.forEach((roomStr) => {
    if (!roomStr) return;

    if (roomStr.startsWith('ext_')) {
      // Format: ext_[roomType]_[gridX]_[gridZ]_[id]
      const parts = roomStr.split('_');
      if (parts.length >= 5) {
        const type = parts[1] as RoomKey;
        const gridX = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
        const gridZ = parseInt(parts[3], 10);
        const id = parts[4];
        const def = ROOM_DEFS[type];
        if (def) {
          rooms.push({
            id,
            type,
            cx: gridX * ROOM_GRID_SIZE,
            cz: gridZ * ROOM_GRID_SIZE,
            name: def.name
          });
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Legacy predefined room strings (e.g. 'living', 'kitchen', etc.)
      const key = roomStr as RoomKey;
      const def = ROOM_DEFS[key];
      if (def && !processedKeys.has(key)) {
        processedKeys.add(key);
        rooms.push({
          id: key,
          type: key,
          cx: def.pos[0],
          cz: def.pos[1],
          name: def.name
        });
      }
    }
  });

  // Ensure 'living' is always established as a base
  if (!rooms.some(r => r.type === 'living' || r.id === 'living')) {
    rooms.unshift({
      id: 'living',
      type: 'living',
      cx: ROOM_DEFS.living.pos[0],
      cz: ROOM_DEFS.living.pos[1],
      name: ROOM_DEFS.living.name
    });
  }

  // Ensure 'bathroom' is always established as a base
  if (!rooms.some(r => r.type === 'bathroom' || r.id === 'bathroom')) {
    rooms.push({
      id: 'bathroom',
      type: 'bathroom',
      cx: ROOM_DEFS.bathroom.pos[0],
      cz: ROOM_DEFS.bathroom.pos[1],
      name: ROOM_DEFS.bathroom.name
    });
  }

  // Ensure 'study' is always established as a base
  if (!rooms.some(r => r.type === 'study' || r.id === 'study')) {
    rooms.push({
      id: 'study',
      type: 'study',
      cx: ROOM_DEFS.study.pos[0],
      cz: ROOM_DEFS.study.pos[1],
      name: ROOM_DEFS.study.name
    });
  }

  return rooms;
}

/**
 * The room containing a world position, or null if the position is outside every room.
 *
 * The tolerance widens each room by a little past its wall line so that standing exactly in a
 * doorway - which is ON the boundary between two rooms - still resolves to one of them rather
 * than to nothing.
 */
export function findRoomAtPosition(
  x: number,
  z: number,
  rooms: RoomInstance[],
  tolerance = 0.5
): RoomInstance | null {
  const reach = ROOM_HALF_SIZE + tolerance;
  return rooms.find(r => Math.abs(x - r.cx) <= reach && Math.abs(z - r.cz) <= reach) ?? null;
}

/** The room whose centre is closest to a world position. Null only when there are no rooms. */
export function findNearestRoom(x: number, z: number, rooms: RoomInstance[]): RoomInstance | null {
  let best: RoomInstance | null = null;
  let bestDistSq = Infinity;
  for (const r of rooms) {
    const dx = x - r.cx;
    const dz = z - r.cz;
    const distSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    if (distSq < bestDistSq) {
      bestDistSq = distSq;
      best = r;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

/**
 * Which room an interior edit (painting a wall, laying a floor) should apply to, given where
 * the player or the build-mode camera currently is.
 *
 * Falls back to the NEAREST room when the position is not inside any: build mode flies a free
 * camera that can easily sit out beyond the walls, and silently doing nothing there would look
 * like the paint button is broken. Picking the nearest room always gives the click an effect,
 * and it is the room the camera is looking at from just outside anyway.
 */
export function resolveEditTargetRoom(
  x: number,
  z: number,
  rooms: RoomInstance[]
): RoomInstance | null {
  return findRoomAtPosition(x, z, rooms) ?? findNearestRoom(x, z, rooms);
}

export interface FurnitureSpawnPoint {
  itemId: string;
  relativePos: [number, number]; // [x_offset, z_offset] relative to room center
  rotation: number;
  /**
   * Height above the floor, for a piece authored to stand ON another piece
   * rather than beside it (the bedroom's 復古提燈 on its 床頭小櫃). Without
   * it both sit at y=0 and the small piece is drawn *inside* the large one —
   * two solids in the same space, which is precisely the intersection the
   * depth buffer cannot order and which shows up as flickering.
   *
   * Author it as the supporting piece's measured height; `npm run
   * audit:placements` re-measures every preset and fails on any pair that
   * still interpenetrates.
   *
   * Preset-authoring only. Placing by hand always lands on the floor, so
   * picking a stacked piece up drops it to y=0 like anything else.
   */
  elevation?: number;
}

export interface RoomTypeConfig {
  roomType: RoomKey;
  wallMaterial: string;          // wall style ID from WALL_STYLES (e.g. 'wall-blue')
  floorMaterial: string;         // floor style ID from FLOOR_STYLES (e.g. 'floor-white-tile')
  defaultFurnitureList: string[]; // List of default item IDs
  furnitureSpawnPoints: FurnitureSpawnPoint[];
  roomFunction: string;          // Character description / label
}
```

## src/constants/seed.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 種子亂數 — the two-and-a-half functions every 「隨機但不能重擲」 decision in this game is built on.
 *
 * They were written three times before this file existed: `seedFrom` in constants/rewardPools.ts,
 * `hashSeed` in constants/fragments.ts, and a third copy was about to go into constants/dailyLogin.ts
 * for the seven-day prize roll. All three are the same FNV-1a, and three copies of a hash is three
 * chances for one of them to be "improved" into a different sequence — at which point a board
 * PREVIEWING a prize and a claim PAYING one disagree, silently, for one item in seven.
 *
 * So the hash lives here, and it is deliberately the only thing here: this module imports nothing,
 * which is what lets it be read by the browser, by `tsx` scripts and by the Express server
 * (src/server/dailyLoginApi.ts) without dragging a catalog behind it.
 *
 * ## Why seeded at all, rather than `Math.random()`
 *
 * Because every draw in this game is a draw the player can SEE BEFORE it is taken, or has to be
 * able to retry. A daily-login board shows what day 5 is worth on day 1; a wheel spin that is
 * re-rendered must not land somewhere else; a grant whose confirmation was lost must be recognised
 * as the same grant when it is retried. `Math.random()` is correct exactly once and wrong on every
 * second look, and all three of those are second looks.
 */

/**
 * FNV-1a over a string, as a non-negative 32-bit integer.
 *
 * Not cryptographic and does not need to be. What it needs to be is STABLE — the same string gives
 * the same number in this process, in the next one, and on the server — which ad-hoc character sums
 * are not once a seed grows past a few characters.
 */
export function seedFrom(text: string): number {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  }
  return hash >>> 0;
}

/**
 * The fraction of the way through a range this seed lands, 0…1 (never 1).
 *
 * The whole 32 bits rather than `seed % n`, so a table whose size shares a factor with the hash's
 * range does not bunch on a few entries.
 */
export function seedUnit(seed: number): number {
  return ((seed >>> 0) % 0x100000000) / 0x100000000;
}

/**
 * A final mixing step — the 「雪崩」 that {@link seedFrom} on its own does not provide.
 *
 * ## The bug this exists to fix, because it is not obvious and it was live
 *
 * FNV-1a mixes from the LOW end: each character is xored into the bottom byte and then multiplied
 * up. {@link seedUnit} reads the TOP bits. So the last thing multiplied — `h * 0x01000193` — puts
 * the pre-multiply low byte almost unchanged into the top byte, and two seeds that differ only in
 * their final character produce two fractions a couple of 256ths apart.
 *
 * For the daily-login round that was not a theoretical wobble. The four coin-flip days seed on
 * `daily-prize:cycle-YYYY-MM-DD:1` … `:6`, which differ ONLY in that last character, so all four
 * landed on the same side of 0.5 in four rounds out of five: a week of 「碎片 or 金幣」 that was in
 * practice 「all 金幣」 or 「all 碎片」. The per-day odds were 50/50 when measured ACROSS rounds,
 * which is why the distribution test passed while the feature was visibly broken.
 *
 * This is the standard 32-bit finalizer (two xor-shift/multiply rounds), which spreads a one-bit
 * input difference across all 32 output bits.
 *
 * ## Why it is applied HERE and not inside seedFrom
 *
 * Because `seedFrom`'s output is already load-bearing elsewhere. The 限時商店's rotation and the
 * wheel's item draws are seeded through it, and those reach the number they want by `seed % n`,
 * which reads the LOW bits and mixes perfectly well. Changing the hash itself would silently
 * reshuffle every shop rotation in the game to fix a bug none of them have.
 */
function avalanche(seed: number): number {
  let h = seed >>> 0;
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  h = Math.imul(h, 0x7feb352d) >>> 0;
  h ^= h >>> 15;
  h = Math.imul(h, 0x846ca68b) >>> 0;
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  return h >>> 0;
}

/**
 * One entry of a list, uniformly — the 「每個選項機率相同」 draw.
 *
 * Its own function because that is what the daily-login round actually asks for: 50／50 on the
 * 碎片／金幣 days and 33／33／33 on 第 2 天 and 第 5 天. Expressing equal odds as a weight table
 * ({@link pickWeighted} in constants/rewardPools.ts) would be three rows all saying `weight: 1`,
 * which reads as a balance decision somebody made rather than as the absence of one.
 *
 * Reads the seed through {@link avalanche} rather than raw, because this is the one selector in the
 * game that picks by FRACTION from seeds which routinely differ by a single trailing character —
 * see the note there for what that cost.
 */
export function seedPick<T>(items: readonly T[], seed: number): T | null {
  if (items.length === 0) return null;
  return items[Math.min(items.length - 1, Math.floor(seedUnit(avalanche(seed)) * items.length))];
}
```

## src/constants/terrain.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * The island's vertical contract, and the shared rules for drawing anything
 * that lies flat ON a surface.
 *
 * ## Why this file exists
 *
 * `characterMovement.ts` already documents the land contract ("grass plateau
 * top is y 0.3 out to r 5.7") and says it is "matched to Island.tsx's meshes"
 * so the two cannot drift. They had drifted anyway: Island.tsx stacked two more
 * terrain cylinders on top of the body, one of them with its top face just
 * 0.02 above the plateau, and every decoration then hard-coded its own guess at
 * where the ground was (`yBase = 0.3` in two places, a bare `0.31` in a third).
 *
 * That produced the two failure modes this module exists to prevent:
 *
 *   1. **Z-fighting.** Two opaque surfaces 0.02 apart across a disc of radius
 *      4.5 is far below the depth resolution available at the distances the
 *      island camera pulls back to, so the whole plateau flickered between two
 *      greens as the camera moved.
 *   2. **Buried decals.** A stepping stone at a hard-coded y=0.31 is *above*
 *      one terrain layer and *below* another, so the same path had stones that
 *      z-fought near the shore and stones that vanished entirely inland.
 *
 * Both are the same root cause: no single answer to "how high is the ground
 * here?". This file is that answer. Terrain meshes are generated from
 * {@link ISLAND_TERRAIN}, and anything drawn on the ground asks
 * {@link getIslandSurfaceY} rather than guessing.
 */

/**
 * World Y of the flat grass plateau - the surface the character actually walks
 * on, and the height `characterMovement.getTerrainInfo` returns for 'grass'.
 *
 * This is the one number the island's art and its collision agree on. Changing
 * it means changing `characterMovement.ts` in the same commit.
 */
export const ISLAND_SURFACE_Y = 0.3;

/**
 * Minimum vertical clearance between two *opaque* surfaces that overlap in
 * plan view and both write depth.
 *
 * Below this, the pair is a z-fighting defect and must be fixed structurally -
 * by merging the surfaces or deleting the hidden one - not by nudging one of
 * them apart. `scripts/audit-zfighting.mjs` flags anything closer.
 *
 * The value is not arbitrary: the island camera sits ~25-40 units out with
 * near=0.3/far=200, where a 24-bit depth buffer resolves roughly 1e-4 units.
 * 0.05 clears that by three orders of magnitude, which also covers the much
 * coarser precision the mobile 16-bit depth path can fall back to.
 */
export const MIN_SURFACE_SEPARATION = 0.05;

/**
 * How far a decal is lifted off the surface it lies on.
 *
 * A decal is a flat thing drawn *on* another flat thing - a stepping stone, a
 * footstep ring, a selection ring, a rug. It is coplanar by design, so unlike
 * the case above it cannot be fixed by restructuring the geometry: the two
 * surfaces are *supposed* to be in the same place. Decals are therefore the one
 * legitimate use of {@link DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS}, and this lift handles the
 * lighting/shadow half of the same problem (a decal at exactly the surface Y
 * picks up z-fighting in the shadow map too, which no polygon offset on the
 * colour pass can help with).
 *
 * Kept well under the ~0.1 at which a decal starts to read as *hovering* at
 * this camera distance, and well over the depth-buffer resolution.
 */
export const SURFACE_DECAL_LIFT = 0.02;

/**
 * Rasterizer depth bias for decals, spread onto a material.
 *
 * `polygonOffset` biases a surface's depth values toward the camera at
 * rasterization time, so a decal wins against whatever it lies on no matter how
 * coarse the depth buffer is out there. This is the correct tool for
 * coplanar-by-design geometry and nothing else - it must never be used to paper
 * over two surfaces that are accidentally in the same place, because it only
 * fixes the pair it is applied to and hides the modelling error from review.
 *
 * Usage: `<meshStandardMaterial color="..." {...DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS} />`
 *
 * For a decal stacked on another decal (a rug's inner panel over its border),
 * override `polygonOffsetUnits` with a *more negative* value so the upper layer
 * still wins - see FurnitureItem's WovenRugModel.
 */
export const DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS = {
  polygonOffset: true,
  polygonOffsetFactor: -2,
  polygonOffsetUnits: -4,
} as const;

/**
 * A raised terrain feature sitting on the plateau, in the island's *unscaled*
 * local frame (the frame inside Island.tsx's `scale={[islandScale, 1, islandScale]}`
 * group). Y is never scaled, only XZ.
 */
export type TerrainMound = {
  /** Centre in unscaled local XZ. */
  cx: number;
  cz: number;
  /** Radius of the flat top. */
  radiusTop: number;
  /** Radius where the skirt meets the plateau. */
  radiusBottom: number;
  /** World Y of the mound's flat top. */
  topY: number;
};

/**
 * How far a mound's frustum is sunk below the plateau, so it reads as ground rising out of the
 * island rather than as a disc set down on it.
 *
 * Here rather than in Three/Island.tsx (which is where it used to be, as a bare `- 0.2`) because
 * it is half of the mound's SLOPE, and the slope is what the walk height has to agree with: the
 * skirt falls from `topY` to this depth across `radiusBottom - radiusTop`, and a height function
 * that assumes any other drop puts the feet somewhere the mound is not. See getIslandSurfaceY.
 */
export const MOUND_BASE_SINK = 0.2;

/**
 * The island's terrain, as data rather than as meshes buried in JSX.
 *
 * `Island.tsx` builds its geometry from this and `getIslandSurfaceY` reads the
 * same numbers, so a mound cannot be drawn in one place and missed by the
 * things that stand on it.
 *
 * Note what is *not* here: the old "Terrain Layer" cylinder whose top sat at
 * y=0.32. It was a second full disc of radius 4.5 lying 0.02 above the plateau
 * - a duplicate surface that contributed nothing but a colour and a depth
 * conflict. Its colour is now a vertex-coloured band on the single plateau
 * surface (see `PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR`), which is how the sand edge has always
 * handled its own colour transition.
 */
export const ISLAND_TERRAIN = {
  /** Radius of the flat walkable plateau. Mirrors characterMovement's GRASS_RADIUS. */
  plateauRadius: 5.7,
  /** Radius of the body's base, where it meets the sand cone. */
  baseRadius: 6.84,
  /** World Y of the body's underside. */
  baseY: -0.7,
  /**
   * Radius out to which the plateau is tinted with the inner (lighter) green,
   * and the radius the tint has fully faded to the outer green by. These
   * reproduce the deleted layer's r=4.5 top and r=4.8 base exactly.
   */
  innerTintRadius: 4.5,
  innerTintFadeRadius: 4.8,
  /**
   * Raised mounds standing proud of the plateau. The single entry here clears
   * MIN_SURFACE_SEPARATION against the plateau by 0.1, so it is a genuine
   * elevation rather than a coplanar duplicate, and it stays.
   */
  mounds: [
    { cx: -2, cz: -1.5, radiusTop: 2.5, radiusBottom: 2.7, topY: 0.4 },
  ] as TerrainMound[],
} as const;

/** Plateau green outside the tinted centre - the island body's own colour. */
export const PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR = '#3f6212';
/** Plateau green in the tinted centre - inherited from the deleted terrain layer. */
export const PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR = '#4d7c0f';
/**
 * Mound green.
 *
 * Pulled in from `#65a30d` toward the plateau's own greens during the 地表質感 pass. At the old
 * value the mound was a markedly lighter green than everything around it, and once the plateau
 * gained its procedural variation that became the most conspicuous thing on the island: a clean,
 * uniform, brighter disc sitting on a mottled lawn reads as a decal stuck to the ground rather
 * than as ground that is 10 cm higher.
 *
 * It is still lighter, because a rise genuinely does catch more light and dry out faster — but
 * the difference is now small enough that Three/groundMaterial.ts's grading (which runs a little
 * drier on the mound for the same reason) carries it, instead of a flat colour step doing all
 * the work.
 */
export const MOUND_COLOR = '#5a8f14';

/**
 * World Y of the topmost *rendered* island surface at a world XZ.
 *
 * This is what anything lying on the ground must use to find its own height -
 * stepping stones, garden paths, footstep rings, placement indicators. It is
 * deliberately the height of the surface that is actually *drawn*, which past
 * the plateau edge is not the same as the height the character is placed at
 * ({@link getTerrainInfo}): the sand cone the renderer draws and
 * the walk height are different curves out there by design.
 *
 * @param x world X (already multiplied by islandScale)
 * @param z world Z
 * @param islandScale the territory-level scale applied to the island's XZ
 */
export function getIslandSurfaceY(x: number, z: number, islandScale: number): number {
  // Mounds are authored in the unscaled local frame, so compare in that frame.
  const lx = x / islandScale;
  const lz = z / islandScale;

  let y = ISLAND_SURFACE_Y;
  for (const m of ISLAND_TERRAIN.mounds) {
    const d = Math.hypot(lx - m.cx, lz - m.cz);
    if (d <= m.radiusTop) {
      y = Math.max(y, m.topY);
    }
    // Between radiusTop and radiusBottom the mound is a skirt, not a flat top.
    // Anything landing on the slope is placed at the slope's height so it does
    // not float over the low side or sink through the high one.
    //
    // The skirt is the DRAWN frustum's, which falls to MOUND_BASE_SINK below the
    // plateau rather than to the plateau itself - the lower part of the cone is
    // buried, and what a walker sees out here is the plateau that buries it,
    // which the Math.max already selects. Ramping to ISLAND_SURFACE_Y instead
    // (the previous form) described a slope a third as steep as the one on
    // screen, so the walkable ramp reached ~13cm further out than the visible
    // one and the feet rode up to 7cm above the ground over that ring.
    else if (d < m.radiusBottom) {
      const t = (d - m.radiusTop) / (m.radiusBottom - m.radiusTop);
      y = Math.max(y, m.topY + (ISLAND_SURFACE_Y - MOUND_BASE_SINK - m.topY) * t);
    }
  }
  return y;
}

/**
 * World Y at which to draw a decal lying on the island's surface at a world XZ.
 *
 * Pair with {@link DECAL_DEPTH_BIAS} on the decal's material - this handles the
 * shadow/lighting half, that handles the depth half.
 */
export function getIslandDecalY(x: number, z: number, islandScale: number): number {
  return getIslandSurfaceY(x, z, islandScale) + SURFACE_DECAL_LIFT;
}

// --- Terrain zones ---------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * The island's concentric zones, as radii in world units BEFORE islandScale is applied.
 * Every terrain/water decision in the game derives from these three numbers, so the
 * boundaries the renderer draws and the boundaries the character is judged against cannot
 * drift apart the way three separately hard-coded copies of `6.8` would.
 *
 * They live here, alongside {@link ISLAND_TERRAIN} and {@link getIslandSurfaceY}, rather than
 * in the character controller that used to own them: the height of the ground and the extent
 * of the ground are one contract, and the placement system needs both without having to reach
 * into movement code. `characterMovement.ts` re-exports them, so the character keeps reading
 * exactly the numbers the island is drawn from.
 *
 * Matched to Island.tsx's meshes:
 *   - Grass plateau a single flat disc at y = ISLAND_SURFACE_Y (0.3) out to
 *                   r = ISLAND_TERRAIN.plateauRadius (5.7).
 *   - Sand edge     cylinder(rTop 5.93, rBottom 7.07, h 0.8) at y -0.25.
 *   - Ocean plane   y = WATER_SURFACE_Y (-0.5), which cuts that sand cone at r ~= 6.86.
 *
 * SHORELINE_RADIUS is therefore the real, visible waterline: inland of it the sand is dry
 * and above water, outside it the sand is submerged. It is THE land/water boundary, and
 * nothing may put the character in a water state while it stands inside it.
 */
export const GRASS_RADIUS = ISLAND_TERRAIN.plateauRadius;
export const SHORELINE_RADIUS = 6.8;

/**
 * How far out to sea the player may swim, as a radius from the world origin. It is both the
 * water/deepWater line in getTerrainInfo and the hard leash resolveCollisions clamps swimmers
 * to, so the seabed the character is told it is over always matches the area it can reach.
 *
 * Sized so the island stays comfortably in frame at the far edge rather than by how much sea
 * exists: the third-person camera trails the player by 7 units (CameraController) through a
 * 25deg vertical FOV, so from the leash the island's 6.8 radius still subtends about two thirds
 * of the half-view. Ocean.tsx covers this easily - its fine near-sea mesh runs to COAST_RADIUS
 * + 45 and the far sea plane is 2000 across - so raising this only widens where the *player*
 * may go, with no new geometry needed to swim over.
 */
export const SWIMMABLE_RADIUS = 18.0;

export interface TerrainInfo {
  terrain: 'grass' | 'sand' | 'water' | 'deepWater';
  targetY: number;
}

export function getTerrainInfo(x: number, z: number, islandScale: number): TerrainInfo {
  const dist = Math.sqrt(x * x + z * z);
  const grassRadius = GRASS_RADIUS * islandScale;
  const sandRadius = SHORELINE_RADIUS * islandScale;
  const swimmableWaterRadius = SWIMMABLE_RADIUS * islandScale;

  if (dist <= grassRadius) {
    // The plateau is not flat everywhere: ISLAND_TERRAIN.mounds raises the *drawn* ground
    // around (-2, -1.5), and this used to return a flat 0.3 regardless, so the character
    // waded through the mound while decorations correctly stood on top of it. Reading the
    // same function the renderer builds from is what removes that whole class of mismatch -
    // and it is the reason a wooden deck can be ground too (see lib/placementSurfaces.ts):
    // "how high is the surface here" has one answer for the art, the props and the player.
    return { terrain: 'grass', targetY: getIslandSurfaceY(x, z, islandScale) };
  } else if (dist <= sandRadius) {
    // Graceful slope interpolation from grass (0.3) to beach water line edge (0.02)
    const t = (dist - grassRadius) / (sandRadius - grassRadius);
    const targetY = ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + (0.02 - ISLAND_SURFACE_Y) * t;
    return { terrain: 'sand', targetY };
  } else if (dist <= swimmableWaterRadius) {
    // Seabed continues the beach slope down from the waterline instead of jumping
    // straight to swim depth. This matters for the swim-state hysteresis band just
    // past sandRadius, where the character is standing in the shallows but still
    // classified 'walking': with a flat -0.6 here, resolveCollisions handed that
    // walking character the SWIM depth as its ground height, sinking the avatar
    // bodily into the shore the moment it touched the waterline. A doubled beach
    // gradient (clamped at swim depth) keeps the shallows ankle-to-knee deep
    // through the band; actual swimmers never read this value (their height comes
    // from the swim branch), and the enter/exit transitions now blend from a
    // wading height instead of from an already-sunken one.
    const beachSlope = (ISLAND_SURFACE_Y - 0.02) / (sandRadius - grassRadius);
    const targetY = Math.max(-0.6, 0.02 - (dist - sandRadius) * beachSlope * 2);
    return { terrain: 'water', targetY };
  } else {
    return { terrain: 'deepWater', targetY: -1.0 };
  }
}

/** Is this terrain zone dry land an object can be stood on? */
export function isLandTerrain(terrain: TerrainInfo['terrain']): boolean {
  return terrain === 'grass' || terrain === 'sand';
}

/**
 * The island's stepping-stone path, in unscaled island units.
 *
 * Layout data rather than art: the stones are drawn by Three/IslandDecorations.tsx, but where the
 * path RUNS is also the answer to 「哪裡是走道」, which the offline-overgrowth siting rules need in
 * order to keep weeds off it (lib/islandOvergrowth.ts). It lives here, beside the terrain the path
 * is laid on, so neither side owns the other and neither can drift.
 *
 * Multiply X/Z by islandScale at the point of use, exactly as the renderer does.
 */
export const PATHWAY_BASE_POINTS: readonly (readonly [number, number, number])[] = [
  [0, 0, 0], [0.5, 0, 1], [1.2, 0, 2], [2, 0, 3], [3, 0, 3.5], [4, 0, 3.8],
  [-0.8, 0, -1], [-1.5, 0, -2], [-2.5, 0, -2.8], [-4, 0, -3.2],
];

```

## src/constants/tourTargets.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * The HUD landmarks the 新手引導 (NewbieTour.tsx) shines its spotlight on, and
 * the one attribute every one of them is found by.
 *
 * WHY AN ATTRIBUTE AND NOT A REF: the landmarks live in six different
 * components spread across four HudFrame regions (HudFrame.tsx), and two of them
 * render *different DOM trees* depending on the device (TopBar has separate
 * mobile/desktop layouts; ControlsHint renders nothing at all on touch). Hoisting
 * six refs up through HudFrame into App just so a tutorial can measure them
 * would couple the whole HUD to a feature that is on screen for twenty seconds
 * once. A `data-tour` marker is a flat contract instead: each component tags its
 * own outermost card, the tour queries for it, and a component that isn't
 * mounted right now simply isn't found (the tour holds its last known rect, or
 * falls back to a screen region — see NewbieTour's `useSpotlightRect`).
 *
 * The marker goes on the element whose *painted* box should be lit — the card
 * wrapper, not an inner button — since `getBoundingClientRect()` on it is
 * literally the shape of the hole cut into the dark.
 */
/**
 * THE ORDER OF THIS OBJECT IS THE ORDER OF THE TOUR, and the tour walks the
 * screen ANTICLOCKWISE: top-left, down the left rail, along the bottom, then up
 * the right edge. Every station is the next landmark you reach going that way
 * round, which is what makes six separate cards read as one lap of one screen
 * rather than six unrelated popups. Insert a new landmark where it physically
 * sits on the ring, not at the end. (NewbieTour.tsx's STEPS is the script; this
 * is the map it walks.)
 */
export const TOUR_TARGET = {
  /** TopBar's profile card, top-left. Station 1. */
  account: 'account',
  /** SideButtons' four-tag signpost column, left rail. Station 2. */
  toolbar: 'toolbar',
  /** NavBar's four-tab board, bottom-centre. Station 3. */
  nav: 'nav',
  /** LuckyWheel's corner launcher, bottom-right. Station 4. */
  wheel: 'wheel',
  /** ControlsHint's WASD card, right edge above the wheel (desktop only). Station 5. */
  move: 'move',
  /** ZoomControl's camera dial, right edge. Station 6, Admin Only. */
  camera: 'camera',
} as const;

export type TourTargetId = (typeof TOUR_TARGET)[keyof typeof TOUR_TARGET];

/** Spread onto the element that should be lit: `{...tourTag(TOUR_TARGET.account)}`. */
export const tourTag = (id: TourTargetId) => ({ 'data-tour': id });

/** The matching query the tour measures with. */
export const tourSelector = (id: TourTargetId) => `[data-tour="${id}"]`;
```

## src/constants/utilityCards.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 功能卡 — what a card IS, what it does when it is used, and how many of them a player holds.
 *
 * A 功能卡 is not a 家具, a 衣服, a 配件 or a 特殊飾品. Those are all things the player OWNS and
 * puts on or puts down; a card is something the player SPENDS, and what it buys is a change to how
 * the rest of the game pays out for a while. That difference is why it does not live in
 * constants/items.ts: an item has a `shopCategory`, a placement scope and a stock rule, and a card
 * has none of the three — it has an effect, a duration and a count.
 *
 * This file is data and pure rules only. No React, no Firestore, and no 雙倍金幣 anywhere except as
 * one row of {@link UTILITY_CARDS}. The write half is context/useUtilityCards.ts; the calculation
 * half — 「這張卡怎麼改變獎勵」 — is constants/rewardEffects.ts, deliberately a separate file
 * because it is the layer EVERY reward source passes through, and no reward source should have to
 * import a card catalog in order to be paid.
 *
 * ## Adding the second card is a row here
 *
 *   1. a member of {@link UtilityCardId}
 *   2. a row of {@link UTILITY_CARDS} — name, effect, duration, rarity, icon, stacking, cap
 *   3. wherever it may be obtained: a product in constants/limitedShop.ts, a slot in
 *      constants/wheelRewards.ts, or both
 *
 * That is the whole list. Nothing switches on a card id: not the inventory, not the use flow, not
 * the reward calculation, not the shop, not the UI. If a change ever seems to need
 * `if (cardId === …)`, the thing it wants is a FIELD on the definition instead.
 *
 * ## Effects are declared, never coded per card
 *
 * {@link UtilityEffect} is a small union of effect SHAPES — multiply a currency, multiply 經驗值 —
 * and a card names one of them with its own numbers. So 「碎片 ×1.5」 and 「經驗值 ×2」 are already
 * expressible without touching a line of the resolver, and a genuinely new SHAPE (an extra draw, a
 * flat bonus) is one member here plus one branch in constants/rewardEffects.ts. What must never
 * happen is a card reaching into a system of its own: the double-coin card does not know that 健身
 * exists, and 健身 does not know the card exists.
 *
 * ## The clock is the player's, and that is a prototype decision
 *
 * A timed effect expires against `Date.now()` on the device. There is no server that can arbitrate
 * that today, and pretending otherwise (§18 of the brief) would be worse than saying so: a player
 * who moves their clock can extend an effect. When there is a service to ask, the one thing that
 * changes is where `nowMs` comes from — every function here already takes it as an argument rather
 * than reading the clock itself, which is also what makes them testable.
 */

import type { CurrencyId } from './currency';
import type { Rarity } from './rarity';

// --- What a card can do ------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * The effect SHAPES the game knows how to apply. Both are implemented in
 * constants/rewardEffects.ts — this union deliberately contains no member that nothing can honour.
 *
 * `currency-multiplier` covers 雙倍金幣 and 碎片加成 with the same three lines, because 「哪一種
 * 貨幣」 is a field rather than a second effect kind.
 */
export type UtilityEffect =
  /** Multiplies one currency on every reward paid while it is live. */
  | { kind: 'currency-multiplier'; currency: CurrencyId; multiplier: number }
  /** Multiplies 經驗值. Not a currency (it is never spent), so it is its own shape. */
  | { kind: 'xp-multiplier'; multiplier: number };

export type UtilityEffectKind = UtilityEffect['kind'];

/** What the effect is called on screen. Never derived from the kind id. */
export const UTILITY_EFFECT_LABELS: Record<UtilityEffectKind, string> = {
  'currency-multiplier': '獎勵加成',
  'xp-multiplier': '經驗加成',
};

/**
 * How long one activation lasts.
 *
 * Two shapes rather than one, because the brief explicitly refuses to assume: a card can be 「接下
 * 來 N 分鐘」 or 「接下來 N 次獎勵」, and which one a card is belongs to the card, not to the code
 * that applies it. Both are honoured by the same resolver — a `uses` effect is consumed inside the
 * SAME write as the reward it boosted (see constants/rewardEffects.ts), which is what stops a
 * failed save from spending a use and paying nothing for it.
 */
export type UtilityCardDuration =
  | { kind: 'timed'; seconds: number }
  | { kind: 'uses'; count: number };

/**
 * What happens when a card is used while one of its own activations is already running.
 *
 * `reject` keeps the card in the bag and tells the player, which is the honest default for a timed
 * buff — a second activation whose effect is invisible is a card silently thrown away. `extend`
 * adds the new duration onto the running one. Neither of them is 「stack the multipliers」: how two
 * DIFFERENT effects combine is a property of the calculation layer and is capped there, not a
 * per-card setting that would let one card quietly re-decide the ceiling.
 */
export type UtilityCardStacking = 'reject' | 'extend';

/**
 * Where a card can legitimately come from.
 *
 * Declared on the card so the UI can answer 「這張卡要去哪裡拿」 without crawling every shop table,
 * and cross-checked against those tables by `npm run test:utility-cards` — so it cannot drift into
 * a promise the game does not keep.
 */
export type UtilityCardChannel = 'limited-shop' | 'wheel' | 'daily-login';

export const UTILITY_CARD_CHANNEL_LABELS: Record<UtilityCardChannel, string> = {
  'limited-shop': '限時商店',
  wheel: '輪盤',
  'daily-login': '每日登入',
};

/** The glyph a card is drawn with. A lucide name, resolved by components/UI/UtilityCard.tsx. */
export type UtilityCardIconName = 'Coins' | 'Sparkles' | 'Zap';

/**
 * Every card in the game. One member per card, and the id is also the key it is stored under.
 *
 * Deliberately a hand-written union rather than `string`: a card id that does not exist should be a
 * compile error at the shop table or the wheel table that names it, not a mystery empty tile.
 */
export type UtilityCardId = 'double-coin';

export interface UtilityCardDefinition {
  id: UtilityCardId;
  name: string;
  /** The full line, for the card back and the confirmation dialog. */
  description: string;
  /**
   * The effect in one short phrase — 「金幣獲得 ×2」. Written rather than generated: a sentence
   * built from `${multiplier}×${currency}` reads like a spreadsheet, and this is the line the
   * player actually reads on a small tile.
   */
  effectSummary: string;
  effect: UtilityEffect;
  duration: UtilityCardDuration;
  /**
   * 稀有度 — the same ladder every item is graded on (constants/rarity.ts), and required for the
   * same reason it is required there: a card without a tier is one that ships looking deliberate
   * and meaning nothing. It drives the tile's frame and any reward pool's filters.
   */
  rarity: Rarity;
  iconName: UtilityCardIconName;
  stacking: UtilityCardStacking;
  /**
   * The most copies one account may hold.
   *
   * A cap rather than an infinity, because every grant path (a purchase, a wheel drop) tops out
   * here rather than each one inventing its own limit — and because an unbounded count is how a
   * bug in a future drop table turns into a permanent economy.
   */
  maxOwned: number;
  channels: readonly UtilityCardChannel[];
}

/**
 * 雙倍金幣券 — the first 功能卡.
 *
 * ## The two numbers that are a design decision, not an implementation detail
 *
 * **`duration.seconds` (30 分鐘).** The brief refuses to assume a duration, so this is a stated
 * default and not a discovered constant: 金幣 comes only from 健身, and 30 minutes is about one
 * training session with room around it — long enough that a player who activates the card and then
 * warms up is not robbed, short enough that it cannot be left running across a whole day of
 * workouts. Changing it to 「接下來一次健身」 is `{ kind: 'uses', count: 1 }` on this one line, and
 * nothing else in the game changes.
 *
 * **The price is NOT here.** What a card costs belongs to whatever is selling it — see
 * constants/limitedShop.ts, where this same card is listed at a 碎片 price (the ordinary way to get
 * one) and at a deliberately steep 金幣 price (the conversion §11 asks for). A price on the card
 * definition would be a price every future shelf had to obey.
 *
 * `stacking: 'reject'` because the effect is invisible: with a timed multiplier already running, a
 * second activation would consume a card for nothing the player could see. They keep it instead.
 */
export const UTILITY_CARDS: Record<UtilityCardId, UtilityCardDefinition> = {
  'double-coin': {
    id: 'double-coin',
    name: '雙倍金幣券',
    description:
      '使用後的一段時間內，健身結算獲得的金幣加倍。金幣只能靠運動賺取，所以這張券真正加倍的是你流的汗。',
    effectSummary: '金幣獲得 ×2',
    effect: { kind: 'currency-multiplier', currency: 'coins', multiplier: 2 },
    duration: { kind: 'timed', seconds: 30 * 60 },
    rarity: 'rare',
    iconName: 'Coins',
    stacking: 'reject',
    maxOwned: 99,
    channels: ['limited-shop', 'wheel', 'daily-login'],
  },
};

export const ALL_UTILITY_CARDS: readonly UtilityCardDefinition[] = Object.values(UTILITY_CARDS);

export const UTILITY_CARD_IDS: readonly UtilityCardId[] = ALL_UTILITY_CARDS.map((card) => card.id);

export function isUtilityCardId(id: string | null | undefined): id is UtilityCardId {
  return !!id && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(UTILITY_CARDS, id);
}

/** The definition, or null for an id that no longer exists. Never throws — see {@link isEffectLive}. */
export function getUtilityCard(id: string | null | undefined): UtilityCardDefinition | null {
  return isUtilityCardId(id) ? UTILITY_CARDS[id] : null;
}

/** 「持續 30 分鐘」/「接下來 3 次獎勵」 — the duration in the player's words. */
export function describeDuration(duration: UtilityCardDuration): string {
  if (duration.kind === 'uses') return `接下來 ${duration.count} 次獎勵`;
  const minutes = Math.round(duration.seconds / 60);
  if (minutes >= 60 && minutes % 60 === 0) return `持續 ${minutes / 60} 小時`;
  return `持續 ${minutes} 分鐘`;
}

// --- What the save holds -----------------------------------------------------

/**
 * One running effect.
 *
 * It stores WHICH CARD produced it and never a copy of the effect itself, so re-balancing a card
 * changes what a live activation does rather than leaving old activations paying the old numbers —
 * and so a card removed from the catalog leaves an activation that resolves to nothing instead of
 * one that keeps paying from a definition nobody can find.
 */
export interface ActiveUtilityEffect {
  /** Unique per activation, so two copies of one card in flight are distinguishable. */
  activationId: string;
  cardId: UtilityCardId;
  /** ISO instant it was used. */
  activatedAt: string;
  /** ISO expiry — present for a `timed` card, absent for a `uses` one. */
  expiresAt?: string;
  /** Remaining applications — present for a `uses` card, absent for a `timed` one. */
  usesLeft?: number;
}

/**
 * 功能卡 state on the player's profile.
 *
 * ONE nested map, for exactly the reason `workoutRewards` and `islandState` are one (see types.ts):
 * it is one clause in firestore.rules and one entry in each update whitelist, so the second card —
 * and the first card whose effect needs a new field — is a change here and not a rules deploy.
 *
 * Absent on every save written before the feature, which is correctly indistinguishable from a
 * player who has never been given a card: neither holds one.
 */
export interface UtilityCardState {
  /** How many of each card is in the bag. A count of 0 is pruned rather than stored. */
  owned?: Partial<Record<UtilityCardId, number>>;
  /** Effects currently running. Expired entries are swept on the next write, not on read. */
  active?: ActiveUtilityEffect[];
  /** Lifetime uses per card. Not a rule — the readout behind 「已使用」 and the admin panel. */
  usedTotal?: Partial<Record<UtilityCardId, number>>;
}

export const EMPTY_UTILITY_STATE: UtilityCardState = {};

/** A whole, non-negative count. Anything else — NaN, negative, fractional — reads as none. */
function sane(value: unknown): number {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
}

export function getOwnedCardCount(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
  cardId: UtilityCardId,
): number {
  return sane(state?.owned?.[cardId]);
}

export function getUsedTotal(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
  cardId: UtilityCardId,
): number {
  return sane(state?.usedTotal?.[cardId]);
}

/** Every card the player holds at least one of, in catalog order. For the 功能卡 bag. */
export function getOwnedCards(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
): { card: UtilityCardDefinition; count: number }[] {
  return ALL_UTILITY_CARDS
    .map((card) => ({ card, count: getOwnedCardCount(state, card.id) }))
    .filter((entry) => entry.count > 0);
}

// --- Live effects ------------------------------------------------------------

/** Whether one activation is still paying out at `nowMs`. */
export function isEffectLive(effect: ActiveUtilityEffect, nowMs: number): boolean {
  if (!getUtilityCard(effect.cardId)) return false;
  if (typeof effect.usesLeft === 'number') return effect.usesLeft > 0;
  if (effect.expiresAt) return Date.parse(effect.expiresAt) > nowMs;
  // Neither bound present: an activation that can never end is refused rather than honoured, which
  // is the safe direction — a corrupt record cannot become a permanent multiplier.
  return false;
}

/** Milliseconds left on a timed effect, or null for a uses-based one (and for a dead one). */
export function remainingMs(effect: ActiveUtilityEffect, nowMs: number): number | null {
  if (!effect.expiresAt) return null;
  const left = Date.parse(effect.expiresAt) - nowMs;
  return left > 0 ? left : null;
}

/** The effects running right now. Dead ones are filtered out but not written back — see below. */
export function activeEffects(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
  nowMs: number,
): ActiveUtilityEffect[] {
  return (state?.active ?? []).filter((effect) => isEffectLive(effect, nowMs));
}

/**
 * The state with dead activations swept out, or null when there is nothing to sweep.
 *
 * Null-when-clean on purpose, the same shape as `reconcileInventoryStock` and `stripRetiredItems`:
 * a healthy save costs one filter and NO write. Sweeping is housekeeping — nothing reads
 * `state.active` without going through {@link activeEffects} first, so an unswept save is merely
 * untidy and never wrong.
 */
export function pruneUtilityState(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
  nowMs: number,
): UtilityCardState | null {
  const active = state?.active ?? [];
  const live = active.filter((effect) => isEffectLive(effect, nowMs));
  if (live.length === active.length) return null;
  return { ...(state ?? {}), active: live };
}

// --- Grant and use -----------------------------------------------------------

/** What a grant did. `dropped` is what the {@link UtilityCardDefinition.maxOwned} cap refused. */
export interface CardGrantResult {
  state: UtilityCardState;
  granted: number;
  dropped: number;
}

/**
 * Adds copies of a card to the bag, respecting the cap. Pure — the caller persists the result.
 *
 * Every source (a limited-shop purchase, a wheel drop, an admin button) goes through this one
 * function, so the cap is applied once rather than per source, and a drop table that hands out a
 * hundred cards cannot write a hundred into the save.
 */
export function grantCards(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
  cardId: UtilityCardId,
  quantity: number,
): CardGrantResult {
  const card = getUtilityCard(cardId);
  const base: UtilityCardState = state ?? {};
  const wanted = Number.isFinite(quantity) ? Math.floor(quantity) : 0;
  if (!card || wanted <= 0) return { state: base, granted: 0, dropped: Math.max(0, wanted) };

  const held = getOwnedCardCount(base, cardId);
  const granted = Math.max(0, Math.min(wanted, card.maxOwned - held));
  if (granted === 0) return { state: base, granted: 0, dropped: wanted };

  return {
    state: { ...base, owned: { ...(base.owned ?? {}), [cardId]: held + granted } },
    granted,
    dropped: wanted - granted,
  };
}

/** Why a card could not be used. Every one of these is a state the UI shows, not an error. */
export type CardUseError =
  | 'unknown-card'
  | 'none-owned'
  /** Its own effect is already running and the card's stacking rule is `reject`. */
  | 'already-active';

export type CardUseResult =
  | { ok: true; state: UtilityCardState; effect: ActiveUtilityEffect }
  | { ok: false; error: CardUseError };

/**
 * Uses one card: spend a copy, start (or extend) its effect. Pure — the caller writes the result.
 *
 * `activationId` and `nowMs` are arguments rather than generated here so the whole flow is
 * reproducible in a test and, more importantly, so a retry of the same write cannot mint a second
 * activation id for what the player experienced as one tap.
 */
export function useCard(
  state: UtilityCardState | null | undefined,
  cardId: UtilityCardId,
  { nowMs, activationId }: { nowMs: number; activationId: string },
): CardUseResult {
  const card = getUtilityCard(cardId);
  if (!card) return { ok: false, error: 'unknown-card' };

  const base: UtilityCardState = state ?? {};
  const held = getOwnedCardCount(base, cardId);
  if (held <= 0) return { ok: false, error: 'none-owned' };

  const live = activeEffects(base, nowMs);
  const running = live.find((effect) => effect.cardId === cardId);
  if (running && card.stacking === 'reject') return { ok: false, error: 'already-active' };

  const owned = { ...(base.owned ?? {}) };
  if (held - 1 > 0) owned[cardId] = held - 1;
  else delete owned[cardId];

  const usedTotal = { ...(base.usedTotal ?? {}), [cardId]: getUsedTotal(base, cardId) + 1 };

  // `extend` lengthens the running activation rather than appending a second record: two records
  // for one card would both be found by the resolver and multiply twice, which is exactly the
  // 「重複計算」 the brief names. Extending keeps 「一次只有一份效果」 structurally true.
  if (running && card.stacking === 'extend') {
    const extended = extendEffect(running, card, nowMs);
    return {
      ok: true,
      state: {
        ...base,
        owned,
        usedTotal,
        active: live.map((effect) =>
          effect.activationId === running.activationId ? extended : effect,
        ),
      },
      effect: extended,
    };
  }

  const effect: ActiveUtilityEffect = {
    activationId,
    cardId,
    activatedAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
    ...(card.duration.kind === 'timed'
      ? { expiresAt: new Date(nowMs + card.duration.seconds * 1000).toISOString() }
      : { usesLeft: card.duration.count }),
  };

  return { ok: true, state: { ...base, owned, usedTotal, active: [...live, effect] }, effect };
}

/** One activation's length added onto a running one. See {@link UtilityCardStacking}. */
function extendEffect(
  running: ActiveUtilityEffect,
  card: UtilityCardDefinition,
  nowMs: number,
): ActiveUtilityEffect {
  if (card.duration.kind === 'uses') {
    return { ...running, usesLeft: (running.usesLeft ?? 0) + card.duration.count };
  }
  const from = Math.max(nowMs, running.expiresAt ? Date.parse(running.expiresAt) : nowMs);
  return { ...running, expiresAt: new Date(from + card.duration.seconds * 1000).toISOString() };
}

```

## src/constants/weeklyTasks.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 每週任務 — 週期、目標類型、進度計算與驗證。這裡沒有 React，也沒有 Firestore。
 *
 * 這是功能的「規則」那一半；`lib/healthData.ts` 負責資料從哪裡來，`context/useWeeklyTasks.ts`
 * 負責存檔，`components/health/` 負責畫面。四者分開的理由跟 constants/dailyLogin.ts 當初分開的
 * 理由一樣：一個要調整「一週從星期幾開始」或「幾次算完成」的人，不該需要打開任何一個元件；而
 * 一個元件也不該是遊戲規則被發現的地方。
 *
 * 這個檔案的 API 由 scripts/test-weekly-tasks.ts（`npm run test:weekly-tasks`）釘住。
 *
 * ## 進度是「算出來的」，不是「存起來的」
 *
 * 任務只存**定義**（名字、目標類型、目標數值）。目前進度永遠是從實際的運動紀錄重新算出來的
 * （{@link computeWeeklyTaskProgress}）。這是刻意的，而且是規格裡「不要用假的固定數值冒充實際
 * 運動紀錄」那一條唯一站得住的做法：
 *
 *  - 一個存起來的 `progress` 數字，跟它聲稱代表的運動紀錄之間沒有任何約束。兩者一旦不同步（漏寫
 *    一次、寫了兩次、跨週沒有重設），畫面上那條進度條就開始說謊，而且沒有任何辦法發現。
 *  - 從紀錄算出來的進度，重新整理後必然還在 —— 因為紀錄本來就在存檔裡。規格裡「任務完成狀態不
 *    應因單純重新整理頁面而遺失」因此是個結構性的保證，不是一個要小心維護的行為。
 *  - 跨週不需要任何寫入。週期是從時鐘推導出來的（{@link weeklyCycleAt}），所以星期一凌晨零點一
 *    到，本週的分母自己就換了一批運動紀錄，沒有任何「建立新週期」的排程需要在對的時間跑起來。
 *
 * 唯一存起來的進度相關資料是 {@link WeeklyTaskDefinition.completedWeeks} —— 已經達標過的那幾週。
 * 它不是進度來源（進度還是重算的），它是給「這一週的達標畫面只慶祝一次」與歷史紀錄用的。
 */

import {
  addCivilDays,
  civilDateAt,
  civilDaysBetween,
  civilEnd,
  civilStart,
  civilWeekday,
  type CivilDate,
} from './civilTime';

export type { CivilDate };

// --- 週期 --------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * 一週從星期幾開始。1 = 星期一。
 *
 * 明確寫出來而不是靠 `Date` 的預設，因為 JavaScript 的 `getDay()` 以星期日為 0，而中文語境裡
 * 「這禮拜」幾乎都是從星期一算起。規格要求「明確定義每週起始日與結束日」，這一行就是那個定義，
 * 而且它是唯一的一份 —— UI 顯示的起訖日期跟進度用的時間範圍都從 {@link weeklyCycleAt} 出來。
 */
export const WEEK_START_WEEKDAY = 1;

/** 一週七天。具名而不是散落的 `7`，因為剩餘天數、週期長度與進度條都各讀一次。 */
export const DAYS_PER_WEEK = 7;

/** 一段任務週期：起訖的日曆日，以及對應的絕對時間區間（半開區間 `[startMs, endMs)`）。 */
export interface WeeklyCycle {
  /** 這一週的星期一，`YYYY-MM-DD`（遊戲時區）。同時是這個週期的 id。 */
  weekStart: CivilDate;
  /** 這一週的星期日，`YYYY-MM-DD`。 */
  weekEnd: CivilDate;
  /** `weekStart` 的午夜，UTC 毫秒。用來篩選運動紀錄。 */
  startMs: number;
  /** `weekEnd` 結束的那一刻（＝下週一的午夜），**不包含**。 */
  endMs: number;
}

/** 某個日曆日所屬那一週的星期一。 */
export function weekStartFor(date: CivilDate): CivilDate {
  const weekday = civilWeekday(date);
  // `+ 7` 讓結果在 JS 的 `%` 對負數回傳負值時仍然是 0..6。
  const offset = (weekday - WEEK_START_WEEKDAY + DAYS_PER_WEEK) % DAYS_PER_WEEK;
  return addCivilDays(date, -offset);
}

/** 某一刻落在哪個週期裡。所有「本週」的判斷都從這裡出發。 */
export function weeklyCycleAt(now: Date = new Date()): WeeklyCycle {
  return cycleFromWeekStart(weekStartFor(civilDateAt(now)));
}

/** 由週一日期組出整個週期。導出的是同一組數字，所以 UI 與計算不可能各算各的。 */
export function cycleFromWeekStart(weekStart: CivilDate): WeeklyCycle {
  const weekEnd = addCivilDays(weekStart, DAYS_PER_WEEK - 1);
  return {
    weekStart,
    weekEnd,
    startMs: civilStart(weekStart),
    endMs: civilEnd(weekEnd),
  };
}

// --- 目標類型 ----------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * 一個每週任務可以追蹤什麼。
 *
 * 每一個都必須對應到**目前真的拿得到的數字**，否則它會是一條永遠停在 0 的進度條。目前系統實際
 * 產生的運動資料只有四種（見 lib/healthData.ts 與 context/useWorkoutRewards.ts 寫進
 * `workout_logs` 的欄位）：次數、時間、動作次數、卡路里。
 *
 * {@link WeeklyTaskMetric} 裡仍然列出 `steps`，而且它被明確標成「尚未支援」。把它留在型別裡而不
 * 是假裝它不存在，是因為規格直接問到步數：一個列在這裡、在 UI 上被標為灰色並寫明原因的目標類
 * 型，會讓「這個遊戲量不到步數」變成一件玩家看得到的事；把它刪掉只會讓下一個人重新問一次。接上
 * 計步資料的那一天，改動是 {@link METRIC_SPECS} 裡的一個 `available: true` 加上
 * lib/healthData.ts 裡的一個轉接器，不是一次資料結構重做。
 */
export type WeeklyTaskMetric =
  | 'workout_count'
  | 'workout_minutes'
  | 'workout_reps'
  | 'calories'
  | 'activity_type_count'
  | 'steps';

/** 一種目標類型長什麼樣子：怎麼稱呼、用什麼單位、目前有沒有資料。 */
export interface WeeklyTaskMetricSpec {
  id: WeeklyTaskMetric;
  /** 表單與卡片上的名字。 */
  label: string;
  /** 數值後面那個字：次、分鐘、大卡。 */
  unit: string;
  /** 表單上的一行說明，講清楚這個數字實際上從哪裡來。 */
  hint: string;
  /** 建立任務時預填的目標值 —— 一個合理的一週份量，不是 1。 */
  defaultTarget: number;
  /** 目標值的下限與上限，表單驗證用。 */
  minTarget: number;
  maxTarget: number;
  /** 目標值要不要允許小數。時間與卡路里也用整數，因為玩家不會設 2.5 分鐘的週目標。 */
  step: number;
  /** 目前有沒有資料來源。false 代表 UI 要把它標示為尚未支援並擋下建立。 */
  available: boolean;
  /** `available === false` 時，為什麼。直接顯示給玩家看。 */
  unavailableReason?: string;
  /** 需不需要再指定一個運動項目（只有 `activity_type_count`）。 */
  needsActivityType?: boolean;
}

/**
 * 目標類型的表。新增一種目標就是這裡加一列 ＋ {@link measureActivity} 裡加一個 case。
 *
 * 排序就是表單上的顯示順序：先放最好懂的「幾次」，最後放尚未支援的那一個。
 */
export const METRIC_SPECS: readonly WeeklyTaskMetricSpec[] = [
  {
    id: 'workout_count',
    label: '每週運動次數',
    unit: '次',
    hint: '完成一次健身就 +1，不論做了多久。',
    defaultTarget: 3,
    minTarget: 1,
    maxTarget: 50,
    step: 1,
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'workout_minutes',
    label: '每週運動時間',
    unit: '分鐘',
    hint: '把這一週每次健身的時間加起來。',
    defaultTarget: 60,
    minTarget: 5,
    maxTarget: 2000,
    step: 5,
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'workout_reps',
    label: '每週累積動作次數',
    unit: '下',
    hint: '開合跳與深蹲偵測到的動作次數總和。',
    defaultTarget: 200,
    minTarget: 10,
    maxTarget: 20000,
    step: 10,
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'calories',
    label: '每週消耗卡路里',
    unit: '大卡',
    hint: '由運動時間與動作次數推估，不是實測值。',
    defaultTarget: 300,
    minTarget: 10,
    maxTarget: 20000,
    step: 10,
    available: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'activity_type_count',
    label: '每週完成指定運動',
    unit: '次',
    hint: '只計算你指定的那一種運動。',
    defaultTarget: 3,
    minTarget: 1,
    maxTarget: 50,
    step: 1,
    available: true,
    needsActivityType: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'steps',
    label: '每週累積步數',
    unit: '步',
    hint: '需要計步資料來源。',
    defaultTarget: 30000,
    minTarget: 1000,
    maxTarget: 500000,
    step: 1000,
    available: false,
    unavailableReason: '遊戲目前沒有計步資料來源，接上穿戴裝置或健康 API 後才會開放。',
  },
] as const;

/** 目標類型的規格。未知的 id 回 null —— 舊存檔裡被移除的類型走的就是這條路。 */
export function getMetricSpec(metric: string): WeeklyTaskMetricSpec | null {
  return METRIC_SPECS.find((spec) => spec.id === metric) ?? null;
}

/** 現在真的可以建立的目標類型。表單只列這些。 */
export function availableMetrics(): WeeklyTaskMetricSpec[] {
  return METRIC_SPECS.filter((spec) => spec.available);
}

/** 列出來但還沒有資料來源的目標類型。健康頁的「資料來源」區塊照這份清單說明。 */
export function unsupportedMetrics(): WeeklyTaskMetricSpec[] {
  return METRIC_SPECS.filter((spec) => !spec.available);
}

// --- 任務定義 ----------------------------------------------------------------

/** 一個玩家自訂的每週任務。存在 `profile.weeklyTasks.tasks` 裡。 */
export interface WeeklyTaskDefinition {
  taskId: string;
  /** 玩家自己取的名字。 */
  name: string;
  metric: WeeklyTaskMetric;
  /** 目標數值，單位由 {@link WeeklyTaskMetricSpec.unit} 決定。 */
  target: number;
  /** `metric === 'activity_type_count'` 時，要計算哪一種運動（例如「深蹲」）。 */
  activityType?: string;
  /** 建立時間，ISO 字串。列表排序用。 */
  createdAt: string;
  /** 最後一次編輯時間。沒編輯過就沒有這個欄位。 */
  updatedAt?: string;
  /**
   * 這個任務從哪一週開始生效（該週的星期一）。
   *
   * 存起來是為了兩件事：任務卡上的「開始日期」在跨週後仍然說得出實話，以及在任務建立之前的那幾
   * 週不會被算成「當時就已經過期」。它不是進度來源。
   */
  startWeek: CivilDate;
  /**
   * 已經達標過的那幾週（每個元素是該週的星期一）。
   *
   * 進度**不是**從這裡來的（見檔頭）。它的用途是：跨週之後仍然知道上週有沒有完成，以及讓達標的
   * 慶祝回饋一週只出現一次。有上限（{@link COMPLETED_WEEKS_LIMIT}），因為這是一份存在玩家文件裡
   * 的清單，而不是一份無限成長的日誌。
   */
  completedWeeks?: CivilDate[];
}

/** 存在 `profile.weeklyTasks` 的那一整包。一個巢狀 map，理由同 `workoutRewards`：它只佔一個欄位。 */
export interface WeeklyTaskState {
  tasks?: WeeklyTaskDefinition[];
}

/** 一個帳號最多能有幾個每週任務。 */
export const MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS = 8;

/** 任務名稱長度上限。跟 firestore.rules 的檢查同一個數字。 */
export const TASK_NAME_MAX = 24;

/** `completedWeeks` 最多保留幾週，約半年。 */
export const COMPLETED_WEEKS_LIMIT = 26;

// --- 健康資料 ----------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * 一次活動，正規化之後的樣子 —— 每週任務唯一認得的輸入。
 *
 * 刻意不是 `WorkoutLog`。`WorkoutLog` 是目前這個原型寫進 Firestore 的那張表，欄位名（`counts`、
 * `goldEarned`）帶著它自己的歷史；而每週任務要能在資料來源換掉之後照樣運作。兩者之間的翻譯只在
 * lib/healthData.ts 的轉接器裡做一次，所以換一個資料來源是改一個檔案，不是改每一個計算。
 */
export interface HealthActivity {
  activityId: string;
  /** ISO 字串。 */
  completedAt: string;
  /** 運動項目名稱，例如「開合跳」。 */
  type: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  /** 偵測到的動作次數。沒有動作概念的活動（例如跑步）是 0。 */
  reps: number;
  /** 大卡。目前是推估值 —— 見 {@link METRIC_SPECS} 裡 `calories` 的 hint。 */
  calories: number;
}

// --- 進度 --------------------------------------------------------------------

/** 一個任務在某一週的狀態。 */
export type WeeklyTaskStatus = 'upcoming' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'expired';

/** 剩餘時間怎麼講。分開成一個 union，讓「還剩 0 天」不會被寫成一句誤導人的話。 */
export type WeeklyRemaining =
  | { kind: 'days'; days: number }
  | { kind: 'due_today' }
  | { kind: 'expired'; daysAgo: number };

/** 一個任務算完之後的全貌 —— 卡片需要的每一個數字都在這裡，元件不再自己算任何一個。 */
export interface WeeklyTaskProgress {
  task: WeeklyTaskDefinition;
  cycle: WeeklyCycle;
  spec: WeeklyTaskMetricSpec | null;
  /** 這一週實際累積到多少。**不設上限** —— 超額完成是真的超額。 */
  current: number;
  target: number;
  /** 進度條用，0..1，已經夾在上限內。 */
  ratio: number;
  /** 顯示用的百分比，0..100 的整數，同樣已經夾住。 */
  percent: number;
  /** 沒有夾住的百分比。超額時 UI 才有辦法說「140%」而不必自己重算。 */
  rawPercent: number;
  completed: boolean;
  status: WeeklyTaskStatus;
  remaining: WeeklyRemaining;
  /**
   * 本週還剩幾天，**含今天**。已過期是 0。
   *
   * 含今天，因為「還剩 1 天」在星期六被讀成「今天加明天」會是錯的 —— 星期六還有兩天可以動。
   * {@link WeeklyTaskProgress.remaining} 是同一個數字的顯示版本：`daysRemaining === 1` 時它會
   * 變成「今天最後一天」而不是「剩 1 天」，因為這兩句話給人的急迫感差很多。
   */
  daysRemaining: number;
  /** 這一週是不是已經被記進 `completedWeeks`。用來決定要不要放慶祝動畫。 */
  celebrated: boolean;
}

/** 一次活動對某個任務貢獻多少。未知的目標類型貢獻 0，而不是拋錯 —— 見 {@link computeWeeklyTaskProgress}。 */
export function measureActivity(activity: HealthActivity, task: WeeklyTaskDefinition): number {
  switch (task.metric) {
    case 'workout_count':
      return 1;
    case 'workout_minutes':
      return Math.max(0, activity.durationSeconds) / 60;
    case 'workout_reps':
      return Math.max(0, activity.reps);
    case 'calories':
      return Math.max(0, activity.calories);
    case 'activity_type_count':
      return task.activityType && activity.type === task.activityType ? 1 : 0;
    case 'steps':
      // 沒有資料來源，所以是 0 —— 不是「先給個數字之後再說」。見 METRIC_SPECS。
      return 0;
    default:
      return 0;
  }
}

/** 這一週的數字要怎麼顯示。時間取整數分鐘，其餘本來就是整數。 */
export function roundMetricValue(metric: WeeklyTaskMetric, value: number): number {
  if (metric === 'workout_minutes') return Math.round(value);
  return Math.round(value);
}

/**
 * 算出一個任務在某一週的完整狀態。
 *
 * `activities` 可以是任何範圍的紀錄 —— 這個函式自己會濾出落在週期內的那些。呼叫端不需要先篩，
 * 也就不可能篩錯。
 */
export function computeWeeklyTaskProgress(
  task: WeeklyTaskDefinition,
  activities: readonly HealthActivity[],
  now: Date = new Date(),
  cycle: WeeklyCycle = weeklyCycleAt(now),
): WeeklyTaskProgress {
  const spec = getMetricSpec(task.metric);
  const today = civilDateAt(now);

  let current = 0;
  for (const activity of activities) {
    const at = Date.parse(activity.completedAt);
    // 無法解析的時間戳不算數。一筆壞掉的紀錄不該讓整條進度條變成 NaN。
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) continue;
    if (at < cycle.startMs || at >= cycle.endMs) continue;
    current += measureActivity(activity, task);
  }
  current = roundMetricValue(task.metric, current);

  const target = Math.max(1, task.target);
  const rawRatio = current / target;
  const ratio = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, rawRatio));
  const completed = current >= target;

  // 「剩幾天」永遠從今天算到這一週的星期日，而不是任何寫死的數字。
  const daysToEnd = civilDaysBetween(today, cycle.weekEnd);
  const daysRemaining = daysToEnd >= 0 ? daysToEnd + 1 : 0;
  const remaining: WeeklyRemaining =
    daysToEnd > 0
      ? { kind: 'days', days: daysRemaining }
      : daysToEnd === 0
        ? { kind: 'due_today' }
        : { kind: 'expired', daysAgo: -daysToEnd };

  const startsLater = civilDaysBetween(task.startWeek, cycle.weekStart) < 0;
  const status: WeeklyTaskStatus = startsLater
    ? 'upcoming'
    : completed
      ? 'completed'
      : daysToEnd < 0
        ? 'expired'
        : 'active';

  return {
    task,
    cycle,
    spec,
    current,
    target,
    ratio,
    percent: Math.round(ratio * 100),
    rawPercent: Math.round(rawRatio * 100),
    completed,
    status,
    remaining,
    daysRemaining,
    celebrated: (task.completedWeeks ?? []).includes(cycle.weekStart),
  };
}

/** 這一週的總覽數字。健康總覽那一區直接讀這個，不再自己 reduce 一次。 */
export interface WeeklyHealthSummary {
  cycle: WeeklyCycle;
  workouts: number;
  minutes: number;
  reps: number;
  calories: number;
  /** 完成的任務數 / 任務總數（只算這一週生效的任務）。 */
  tasksCompleted: number;
  tasksActive: number;
}

/** 把一週的活動與任務收斂成總覽那幾個數字。 */
export function summariseWeek(
  activities: readonly HealthActivity[],
  progress: readonly WeeklyTaskProgress[],
  now: Date = new Date(),
  cycle: WeeklyCycle = weeklyCycleAt(now),
): WeeklyHealthSummary {
  let workouts = 0;
  let seconds = 0;
  let reps = 0;
  let calories = 0;
  for (const activity of activities) {
    const at = Date.parse(activity.completedAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) continue;
    if (at < cycle.startMs || at >= cycle.endMs) continue;
    workouts += 1;
    seconds += Math.max(0, activity.durationSeconds);
    reps += Math.max(0, activity.reps);
    calories += Math.max(0, activity.calories);
  }
  const live = progress.filter((entry) => entry.status !== 'upcoming');
  return {
    cycle,
    workouts,
    minutes: Math.round(seconds / 60),
    reps,
    calories: Math.round(calories),
    tasksCompleted: live.filter((entry) => entry.completed).length,
    tasksActive: live.length,
  };
}

// --- 驗證 --------------------------------------------------------------------

/** 表單送出來的東西 —— 還沒有 id，數值還是字串，因為那是 `<input>` 給的。 */
export interface WeeklyTaskDraft {
  name: string;
  metric: string;
  target: string | number;
  activityType?: string;
}

/** 欄位 → 錯誤訊息。空物件代表通過。逐欄回報，因為表單要把訊息放在對應的欄位底下。 */
export type WeeklyTaskErrors = Partial<Record<'name' | 'metric' | 'target' | 'activityType' | 'form', string>>;

/**
 * 驗證一份草稿。建立與編輯共用同一份規則 —— 兩套規則遲早會分岔。
 *
 * `existing` 是目前已有的任務（編輯時要排除自己），用來擋重複名稱與數量上限。
 */
export function validateWeeklyTaskDraft(
  draft: WeeklyTaskDraft,
  existing: readonly WeeklyTaskDefinition[] = [],
  editingTaskId?: string,
): WeeklyTaskErrors {
  const errors: WeeklyTaskErrors = {};
  const others = existing.filter((task) => task.taskId !== editingTaskId);

  if (!editingTaskId && others.length >= MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS) {
    errors.form = `每週任務最多 ${MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS} 個，請先刪除一個再建立。`;
  }

  const name = draft.name.trim();
  if (!name) {
    errors.name = '請輸入任務名稱。';
  } else if (name.length > TASK_NAME_MAX) {
    errors.name = `名稱請控制在 ${TASK_NAME_MAX} 個字以內。`;
  } else if (others.some((task) => task.name.trim() === name)) {
    errors.name = '已經有同名的任務了。';
  }

  const spec = getMetricSpec(draft.metric);
  if (!spec) {
    errors.metric = '請選擇目標類型。';
  } else if (!spec.available) {
    errors.metric = spec.unavailableReason ?? '這個目標類型目前還沒有資料來源。';
  }

  const target = typeof draft.target === 'number' ? draft.target : Number(String(draft.target).trim());
  if (!String(draft.target).trim()) {
    errors.target = '請輸入目標數值。';
  } else if (!Number.isFinite(target)) {
    errors.target = '目標數值必須是數字。';
  } else if (!Number.isInteger(target)) {
    errors.target = '目標數值請填整數。';
  } else if (spec && target < spec.minTarget) {
    errors.target = `至少要 ${spec.minTarget} ${spec.unit}。`;
  } else if (spec && target > spec.maxTarget) {
    errors.target = `最多 ${spec.maxTarget} ${spec.unit}。`;
  }

  if (spec?.needsActivityType && !draft.activityType?.trim()) {
    errors.activityType = '請選擇要計算哪一種運動。';
  }

  return errors;
}

/** 驗證結果有沒有問題。`Object.keys(...).length === 0` 散在四處會被寫錯一次。 */
export function hasErrors(errors: WeeklyTaskErrors): boolean {
  return Object.keys(errors).length > 0;
}

/** 把通過驗證的草稿變成一個任務定義。id 與日期在這裡生成，呼叫端忘不掉。 */
export function makeWeeklyTask(draft: WeeklyTaskDraft, now: Date = new Date()): WeeklyTaskDefinition {
  const spec = getMetricSpec(draft.metric);
  const target = typeof draft.target === 'number' ? draft.target : Number(String(draft.target).trim());
  return {
    taskId: newTaskId(),
    name: draft.name.trim(),
    metric: (spec?.id ?? 'workout_count') as WeeklyTaskMetric,
    target: Math.round(target),
    ...(spec?.needsActivityType && draft.activityType?.trim()
      ? { activityType: draft.activityType.trim() }
      : {}),
    createdAt: now.toISOString(),
    startWeek: weekStartFor(civilDateAt(now)),
    completedWeeks: [],
  };
}

function newTaskId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && 'randomUUID' in crypto) return `wt-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  return `wt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

/** 把編輯過的欄位套回一個既有任務。`taskId`、`createdAt`、`startWeek` 與達標紀錄永遠保留。 */
export function applyWeeklyTaskEdit(
  task: WeeklyTaskDefinition,
  draft: WeeklyTaskDraft,
  now: Date = new Date(),
): WeeklyTaskDefinition {
  const spec = getMetricSpec(draft.metric);
  const target = typeof draft.target === 'number' ? draft.target : Number(String(draft.target).trim());
  const next: WeeklyTaskDefinition = {
    ...task,
    name: draft.name.trim(),
    metric: (spec?.id ?? task.metric) as WeeklyTaskMetric,
    target: Math.round(target),
    updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
  };
  if (spec?.needsActivityType && draft.activityType?.trim()) {
    next.activityType = draft.activityType.trim();
  } else {
    delete next.activityType;
  }
  return next;
}

/** 記下「這一週達標了」。已經記過就原樣回傳，所以呼叫端可以無腦呼叫。 */
export function markWeekCompleted(task: WeeklyTaskDefinition, weekStart: CivilDate): WeeklyTaskDefinition {
  const weeks = task.completedWeeks ?? [];
  if (weeks.includes(weekStart)) return task;
  // 由舊到新排序後只留最後 N 筆，所以砍掉的一定是最舊的那幾週。
  const next = [...weeks, weekStart].sort().slice(-COMPLETED_WEEKS_LIMIT);
  return { ...task, completedWeeks: next };
}

/**
 * 讀存檔時的防線：把任何形狀不對的東西丟掉，而不是讓它一路長到畫面上。
 *
 * 存檔是使用者裝置上的 JSON，可能來自舊版本、被手動改過、或是寫到一半斷掉。一個 `target` 是字串
 * 的任務會讓進度條變成 NaN，而 NaN 不會拋錯 —— 它會安靜地畫出一條空白的條。
 */
export function normalizeWeeklyTaskState(raw: unknown): WeeklyTaskState {
  if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) return { tasks: [] };
  const tasks = (raw as { tasks?: unknown }).tasks;
  if (!Array.isArray(tasks)) return { tasks: [] };

  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const cleaned: WeeklyTaskDefinition[] = [];
  for (const entry of tasks) {
    if (typeof entry !== 'object' || entry === null) continue;
    const task = entry as Partial<WeeklyTaskDefinition>;
    if (typeof task.taskId !== 'string' || !task.taskId) continue;
    if (seen.has(task.taskId)) continue;
    if (typeof task.name !== 'string' || !task.name.trim()) continue;
    if (typeof task.target !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(task.target) || task.target <= 0) continue;
    if (typeof task.metric !== 'string' || !getMetricSpec(task.metric)) continue;

    seen.add(task.taskId);
    cleaned.push({
      taskId: task.taskId,
      name: task.name,
      metric: task.metric as WeeklyTaskMetric,
      target: Math.round(task.target),
      ...(typeof task.activityType === 'string' && task.activityType
        ? { activityType: task.activityType }
        : {}),
      createdAt: typeof task.createdAt === 'string' ? task.createdAt : new Date(0).toISOString(),
      ...(typeof task.updatedAt === 'string' ? { updatedAt: task.updatedAt } : {}),
      startWeek:
        typeof task.startWeek === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(task.startWeek)
          ? task.startWeek
          : weekStartFor(civilDateAt(new Date())),
      completedWeeks: Array.isArray(task.completedWeeks)
        ? task.completedWeeks.filter((week): week is string => typeof week === 'string').slice(-COMPLETED_WEEKS_LIMIT)
        : [],
    });
    if (cleaned.length >= MAX_WEEKLY_TASKS) break;
  }
  return { tasks: cleaned };
}

/** 任務列表的顯示順序：還沒完成的排前面，其次是建立時間。 */
export function sortProgress(entries: readonly WeeklyTaskProgress[]): WeeklyTaskProgress[] {
  const rank: Record<WeeklyTaskStatus, number> = { active: 0, upcoming: 1, completed: 2, expired: 3 };
  return [...entries].sort((a, b) => {
    const byStatus = rank[a.status] - rank[b.status];
    if (byStatus !== 0) return byStatus;
    return a.task.createdAt.localeCompare(b.task.createdAt);
  });
}
```

## src/constants/wheelRewards.ts

```ts
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * 輪盤獎勵池 — what a spin can produce, and how likely each outcome is.
 *
 * A weighted TABLE, which is the whole of §5 of the brief: every outcome is a row with a `weight`,
 * and 「功能卡比較難抽到」 is the number 10 sitting next to 380 rather than an `if` somewhere. There
 * is no branch in this file that mentions 雙倍金幣券, and nothing that spins the wheel is allowed to
 * grow one — a second card is another row, and a third kind of prize is another member of
 * {@link WheelPrize}.
 *
 * ## What exists today, and what does not
 *
 * There is no 轉盤 SCREEN in the game. That was true before this feature and is still true: the
 * brief asks for the probability system and for 功能卡 to be reachable through it, not for a wheel
 * to be designed. So this file is the reward half — the table, the draw and the odds — and
 * context/useWheelActions.ts is the grant half. When a wheel is built, it calls `spinWheel()` and
 * draws the result; it does not decide what it won.
 *
 * What a spin COSTS is deliberately not decided here either. 抽獎券 exist and have no sink yet
 * (constants/fragments.ts), and choosing 「一次一張券」 would be this file quietly designing an
 * economy that nobody has asked it to. The draw is free of that question: a caller charges whatever
 * the wheel ends up costing, in the same write, and this table stays about prizes.
 *
 * ## The draw is seeded, and that is the fix for §19's 「不會因 UI 重渲染重新抽獎」
 *
 * {@link drawWheelSlot} takes a spin id and is a pure function of it. A component that re-renders
 * mid-animation re-derives the SAME prize, because the prize is a property of the spin and not of
 * the render. `Math.random()` inside a component is the exact failure that requirement names.
 */

import { getItemById, type ItemDefinition } from './items';
import { FRAGMENT_ITEMS, rollWorkoutFragmentItem } from './fragments';
import { pickWeighted, seedFrom, totalWeight, weightedChance, type Weighted } from './rewardPools';
import { getUtilityCard, type UtilityCardId } from './utilityCards';
import type { UserProfile } from '../types';

/**
 * What one slot pays.
 *
 * Three shapes, and each one is granted through the system that already owns it — 碎片 through the
 * economy service, 商品碎片 through the fragment service, 功能卡 through the card service. The
 * wheel therefore has no write of its own and cannot drift from how the same prize is paid
 * elsewhere. See context/useWheelActions.ts.
 */
export type WheelPrize =
  /** 碎片 — the wallet currency. Never 金幣: SOURCE_CURRENCY_POLICY refuses that (constants/rewards.ts). */
  | { kind: 'currency'; currency: 'fragments'; amount: number }
  /** 商品碎片 toward one item, chosen by the same rule a workout's drop uses. */
  | { kind: 'item-fragments'; amount: number }
  /** 功能卡 (constants/utilityCards.ts). */
  | { kind: 'utility-card'; cardId: UtilityCardId; quantity: number };

export interface WheelSlot {
  id: string;
  /** What the wedge says. Player-facing. */
  label: string;
  /**
   * Relative likelihood against every other row. Not a percentage — a percentage would have to be
   * re-typed on every row each time a slot is added, and the first one anybody forgets makes the
   * table lie about itself. See {@link wheelOdds} for the derived percentages.
   */
  weight: number;
  prize: WheelPrize;
}

/**
 * The table.
 *
 * Weights add up to 1,000, which is a convenience for reading them as tenths of a percent and
 * nothing more — {@link pickWeighted} normalises, so a row can be added without re-balancing the
 * rest to hit a round number.
 *
 * The shape of the ladder: 碎片 is the everyday outcome, 商品碎片 is the one that moves a collection
 * forward, and 功能卡 is the rare one. 1% is deliberately an order of magnitude below the least
 * likely ordinary prize (6%) — a card is a thing that happens to you a few times a month, not a
 * thing you spin for. `npm run test:utility-cards` fails if that stops being true.
 */
export const WHEEL_SLOTS: readonly WheelSlot[] = [
  {
    id: 'fragments-small',
    label: '碎片 ×10',
    weight: 380,
    prize: { kind: 'currency', currency: 'fragments', amount: 10 },
  },
  {
    id: 'item-fragments-small',
    label: '商品碎片 ×15',
    weight: 250,
    prize: { kind: 'item-fragments', amount: 15 },
  },
  {
    id: 'fragments-medium',
    label: '碎片 ×25',
    weight: 200,
    prize: { kind: 'currency', currency: 'fragments', amount: 25 },
  },
  {
    id: 'item-fragments-large',
    label: '商品碎片 ×40',
    weight: 100,
    prize: { kind: 'item-fragments', amount: 40 },
  },
  {
    id: 'fragments-large',
    label: '碎片 ×60',
    weight: 60,
    prize: { kind: 'currency', currency: 'fragments', amount: 60 },
  },
  {
    id: 'card-double-coin',
    label: '雙倍金幣券',
    weight: 10,
    prize: { kind: 'utility-card', cardId: 'double-coin', quantity: 1 },
  },
];

/** The table as the shared weighted-choice system reads it. */
export const WHEEL_ENTRIES: readonly Weighted<WheelSlot>[] = WHEEL_SLOTS.map((slot) => ({
  value: slot,
  weight: slot.weight,
}));

export function getWheelSlot(slotId: string): WheelSlot | null {
  return WHEEL_SLOTS.find((slot) => slot.id === slotId) ?? null;
}

/**
 * The prize for one spin. A pure function of the spin id — see the file doc on why that matters.
 *
 * The id is the EVENT: whatever the wheel screen calls one spin (a uuid, a timestamp, a server's
 * id), the same id always lands on the same wedge, so a re-render, a retry or a reconnect cannot
 * change what was won.
 */
export function drawWheelSlot(spinId: string): WheelSlot | null {
  return pickWeighted(WHEEL_ENTRIES, seedFrom(`wheel:${spinId}`));
}

/** Every slot with its real probability. For an odds sheet, the admin readout and the tests. */
export function wheelOdds(): { slot: WheelSlot; chance: number }[] {
  return WHEEL_SLOTS.map((slot) => ({ slot, chance: weightedChance(WHEEL_ENTRIES, slot) }));
}

/** The combined chance of drawing any 功能卡. What §5's 「機率較低」 is measured against. */
export function utilityCardChance(): number {
  const total = totalWeight(WHEEL_ENTRIES);
  if (total <= 0) return 0;
  const cardWeight = WHEEL_SLOTS
    .filter((slot) => slot.prize.kind === 'utility-card')
    .reduce((sum, slot) => sum + slot.weight, 0);
  return cardWeight / total;
}

/**
 * A deterministic 0…1 generator from one seed. Mulberry32 — small, fast, and good enough for a
 * prize wheel.
 *
 * It exists so the 商品碎片 slot can reuse {@link rollWorkoutFragmentItem}'s selection rule (which
 * takes an injected `random`) instead of this file inventing a second answer to 「碎片要給哪一件
 * 商品」. One rule, two callers.
 */
export function seededRandom(seed: number): () => number {
  let state = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = state;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/** A slot's prize with everything resolved — the item behind a 商品碎片 win, the card behind a card. */
export type ResolvedWheelPrize =
  | { kind: 'currency'; currency: 'fragments'; amount: number; label: string }
  | { kind: 'item-fragments'; item: ItemDefinition; amount: number; label: string }
  | { kind: 'utility-card'; cardId: UtilityCardId; quantity: number; label: string };

/**
 * Turns a drawn slot into the exact thing to grant.
 *
 * Separate from the draw because only this half needs the player: which item's fragments a spin pays
 * depends on what they already own, while WHICH WEDGE it landed on does not. Keeping the wedge pure
 * is what lets a wheel animation be driven from the spin id alone.
 *
 * Returns null when a slot cannot be honoured — a card that has been retired, or a catalog with no
 * fragment items at all. A prize that cannot be paid is dropped rather than substituted, because
 * quietly paying something else is how a drop table's mistakes become invisible.
 */
export function resolveWheelPrize(
  slot: WheelSlot,
  profile: UserProfile | null | undefined,
  isOwned: (itemId: string) => boolean,
  spinId: string,
): ResolvedWheelPrize | null {
  const prize = slot.prize;

  if (prize.kind === 'currency') {
    return { kind: 'currency', currency: prize.currency, amount: prize.amount, label: slot.label };
  }

  if (prize.kind === 'item-fragments') {
    if (FRAGMENT_ITEMS.length === 0) return null;
    const item = rollWorkoutFragmentItem(profile, isOwned, seededRandom(seedFrom(`wheel-item:${spinId}`)));
    const resolved = item ?? getItemById(FRAGMENT_ITEMS[0].id);
    if (!resolved) return null;
    return { kind: 'item-fragments', item: resolved, amount: prize.amount, label: slot.label };
  }

  const card = getUtilityCard(prize.cardId);
  if (!card) return null;
  return { kind: 'utility-card', cardId: card.id, quantity: prize.quantity, label: card.name };
}
```
