```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway: every hairstyle against every hat, on one canvas — the contact sheet for
 * 「短髮戴帽子看不到頭髮」 and 「長髮和帽子的接縫像被切斷」.
 *
 * One WebGL context for the whole grid, same as tmp-hair.tsx: swiftshader (the software
 * renderer a headless screenshot has to use) will not hand out one context per cell.
 *
 * http://localhost:3000/tmp-hathair.html?angle=3/4&style=hair-buzz
 * Delete once the hat/hair join is signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { HAIR_SPECS, AVATAR_SKIN_COLOR, HairSpec } from './src/constants/hair';
import { HairPiece, LegacyHat } from './src/components/Three/character/legacy/wardrobe';
import { LEGACY_SKELETON } from './src/constants/characterRig';
import type { HatKind } from './src/components/Three/character/types';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const only = params.get('style');
const STYLES = only ? only.split(',').map(id => HAIR_SPECS[id]) : Object.values(HAIR_SPECS);

const ALL_HATS: Array<[string, HatKind | null]> = [
  ['bare', null],
  ['草帽', 'straw'],
  ['漁夫帽', 'bucket'],
  ['貝雷帽', 'beret'],
  ['毛帽', 'beanie'],
  ['平板帽', 'snapback'],
];
const wantedHats = params.get('hat');
const HATS = wantedHats
  ? wantedHats.split(',').map(n => ALL_HATS.find(h => h[1] === n || h[0] === n)!)
  : ALL_HATS;

/** front, three-quarter, side, back. `?angle=side` when one view is the one in question. */
const ALL_ANGLES: Record<string, number> = {
  front: 0,
  '3/4': Math.PI * 0.28,
  side: Math.PI * 0.5,
  back: Math.PI,
};
const ANGLE = ALL_ANGLES[params.get('angle') ?? '3/4'] ?? ALL_ANGLES['3/4'];

const CELL_W = 1.12;
const CELL_H = 1.25;
const ZOOM = Number(params.get('zoom') ?? 150);

/** The legacy head the hair is fitted to, copied from HairSpinPreview's PreviewHead. */
function Head({
  spec,
  hat,
  position,
}: {
  spec: HairSpec;
  hat: HatKind | null;
  position: [number, number, number];
}) {
  const swayRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null!);
  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={[0, ANGLE, 0]}>
      <mesh>
        <sphereGeometry args={[LEGACY_SKELETON.head.halfWidth, 32, 32]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={AVATAR_SKIN_COLOR} roughness={0.7} />
      </mesh>
      <group position={[0, 0.035, 0.225]}>
        <mesh position={[-0.104, 0, 0]}>
          <sphereGeometry args={[0.036, 16, 16]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#0d1117" roughness={0.1} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.104, 0, 0]}>
          <sphereGeometry args={[0.036, 16, 16]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#0d1117" roughness={0.1} />
        </mesh>
      </group>
      <HairPiece spec={spec} hat={hat} swayRef={swayRef} />
      {hat && <LegacyHat kind={hat} />}
    </group>
  );
}

function Sheet() {
  const rows = STYLES.length;
  return (
    <>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.85} />
      <directionalLight position={[2, 4, 3]} intensity={1.15} />
      <directionalLight position={[-3, 1, -2]} intensity={0.45} />
      {STYLES.map((spec, r) =>
        HATS.map(([, hat], c) => (
          <Head
            key={`${spec.id}-${c}`}
            spec={spec}
            hat={hat}
            position={[
              (c - (HATS.length - 1) / 2) * CELL_W,
              ((rows - 1) / 2 - r) * CELL_H,
              0,
            ]}
          />
        )),
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const width = HATS.length * CELL_W * ZOOM;
const height = STYLES.length * CELL_H * ZOOM;

function App() {
  return (
    <div style={{ font: '13px sans-serif', background: '#f2f2f4' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', marginLeft: 120 }}>
        {HATS.map(([label]) => (
          <div key={label} style={{ width: CELL_W * ZOOM, textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 700, color: '#333' }}>
            {label}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex' }}>
        <div style={{ width: 120 }}>
          {STYLES.map(s => (
            <div
              key={s.id}
              style={{ height: CELL_H * ZOOM, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', fontWeight: 700, color: '#333' }}
            >
              {s.label}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{ width, height, background: '#e9e9ee' }}>
          <Canvas orthographic camera={{ zoom: ZOOM, position: [0, 0, 6] }} gl={{ antialias: true }}>
            <Sheet />
          </Canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />);
```

## tmp-homecam-check.ts

```ts
/** Throwaway: solveBoxContainmentLimit against the cases the house-corner bug is made of.
 *  Delete when signed off. Usage: npx tsx tmp-homecam-check.ts */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { solveBoxContainmentLimit, CameraContainmentBox } from './src/lib/cameraCollision';

// A Home at the origin, ~3.6 x 3.6 on plan and 3 tall, unrotated.
const box: CameraContainmentBox = {
  x: 0, z: 0, rotation: 0,
  halfWidth: 1.8, halfDepth: 1.8,
  baseY: 0.3, topY: 3.3,
};
const R = 0.5;
const ARM = 14;

let failures = 0;
function check(name: string, got: number, want: number | 'unchanged', tol = 0.06) {
  const target = want === 'unchanged' ? ARM : want;
  const ok = Math.abs(got - target) <= tol;
  if (!ok) failures++;
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${name}: got ${got.toFixed(3)}, want ${want === 'unchanged' ? 'unchanged (' + ARM + ')' : target.toFixed(3)}`);
}

const dir = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z).normalize();
const at = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

// 1. THE BUG. Player walking past the corner, camera on a long arm well outside the house.
//    The arm's line passes over/through the house, but the camera itself sits far beyond it.
//    Old behaviour: raycast hit the roof and cut the arm. Wanted: no change at all.
check(
  'arm crosses the house, camera far beyond it',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(3, 1.4, 0), dir(1, 0.35, 0).negate(), ARM, box, R),
  'unchanged',
);

// 2. Same, at 45 degrees across the corner - the exact geometry of "穿過房子的角".
check(
  'arm grazes the corner diagonally',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(3, 1.4, 3), dir(-1, 0.3, -1), ARM, box, R),
  'unchanged',
);

// 3. Camera high above the roof looking down at a player standing beside the house. The arm never
//    enters the box at all.
check(
  'high arm passes over the roof',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(2.6, 1.4, 0), dir(1, 1.2, 0), ARM, box, R),
  'unchanged',
);

// 4. THE GUARANTEE. Short arm, player hugging a wall: the camera would sit inside the shell, so it
//    must be stood outside it. Player 2.6 from centre, wall+radius at 2.3, arm 1.6 pointing at the
//    house => camera would be at 1.0 from centre, inside. Limit must be the entry at 0.3.
check(
  'short arm would put the camera inside the shell',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(2.6, 1.4, 0), dir(-1, 0, 0), 1.6, box, R),
  0.3,
);

// 5. Camera dead level with the roof peak but above it - clearance is on the roof too.
check(
  'arm just above the inflated roof',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(2.6, 3.85, 0), dir(-1, 0, 0), 1.6, box, R),
  1.6, 0.0001,
);
check(
  'arm just below the inflated roof',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(2.6, 3.7, 0), dir(-1, 0, 0), 1.6, box, R),
  0.3,
);

// 6. Rotated house: the same "inside the shell" case, with the box turned 45 degrees. Approaching
//    a corner along +x, the inflated corner is at (1.8+... ) - just assert it shortens at all, and
//    that the shortened camera really is outside.
{
  const rotated: CameraContainmentBox = { ...box, rotation: Math.PI / 4 };
  const origin = at(3.4, 1.4, 0);
  const d = dir(-1, 0, 0);
  const limit = solveBoxContainmentLimit(origin, d, 2.6, rotated, R);
  const cam = origin.clone().addScaledVector(d, limit);
  // Back into the box frame to confirm the resulting point is outside the inflated footprint.
  const cos = Math.cos(-rotated.rotation), sin = Math.sin(-rotated.rotation);
  const lx = Math.abs(cam.x * cos - cam.z * sin);
  const lz = Math.abs(cam.x * sin + cam.z * cos);
  const outside = lx >= rotated.halfWidth + R - 1e-6 || lz >= rotated.halfDepth + R - 1e-6;
  console.log(`${limit < 2.6 && outside ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  rotated house: shortened to ${limit.toFixed(3)}, camera outside = ${outside}`);
  if (!(limit < 2.6 && outside)) failures++;
}

// 7. Pivot somehow inside the box (teleport / re-siting around a standing player): must NOT
//    collapse the arm onto the player's head.
check(
  'pivot inside the box leaves the arm alone',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(0, 1.4, 0), dir(1, 0.2, 0), ARM, box, R),
  'unchanged',
);

// 8. House nowhere near the ray.
check(
  'house behind the camera',
  solveBoxContainmentLimit(at(9, 1.4, 9), dir(1, 0.2, 1), ARM, box, R),
  'unchanged',
);

console.log(failures === 0 ? '\nALL PASS' : `\n${failures} FAILED`);
process.exit(failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);
```

## tmp-house-camera.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway verification page for the "camera sees through the house" fix.
 *
 * Renders the SAME house twice, from the camera position each rule produces for a player standing
 * near the front wall with the camera arm swinging back over the building:
 *
 *   LEFT  - house tagged as a prop only (the old rule). The occlusion probe finds nothing in the
 *           CAMERA_BLOCKER layer, so the arm keeps its full length and the camera ends up inside
 *           the shell, where the 0.5 near plane eats the wall - you see straight through the house.
 *   RIGHT - house tagged as a structure (the fix). Same pipeline, same numbers, but the probe now
 *           sees the house: the avoidance lift swings the arm up over the roof and what is left is
 *           capped short of the wall.
 *
 * Runs the REAL exported pipeline (CameraOcclusionProbe -> solveAvoidanceLift -> observation
 * floor), not a re-implementation, so the only difference between the two panels is the layer tag.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Canvas, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { HouseModel } from './src/components/Three/HouseModel';
import { getHouseStyle } from './src/constants/houseStyles';
import { useCameraBlocker, useSightlineOccluder } from './src/constants/layers';
import {
  CameraOcclusionProbe,
  CAMERA_COLLIDER_RADIUS,
  applyCameraLift,
  applyObservationFloor,
  surfaceOverrunAllowance,
  solveAvoidanceLift,
} from './src/lib/cameraCollision';

const style = getHouseStyle('starter');

// Player standing 1.3 clear of the front wall (halfDepth 1.7), pivot at head height, facing away
// from the house so the arm swings back into it. DESIRED 3.5 is a partly zoomed-in view
// (uiScale ~1.6) - the band where the arm is short enough to land inside the shell rather than
// sailing past behind it.
const PIVOT = new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.1, 3.0);
const DIR = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.30, -1).normalize();
const DESIRED = 3.5;
// CameraController's own outdoor values.
const ORBIT_MIN_POLAR = 0.12;
const LIFT_POLAR_SAFETY = 0.03;
const MIN_THIRD_PERSON_DISTANCE = 2.2;

function House({ blocker }: { blocker: boolean }) {
  const blockerRef = useCameraBlocker<THREE.Group>();
  const propRef = useSightlineOccluder<THREE.Group>();
  return (
    <group ref={blocker ? blockerRef : propRef}>
      <HouseModel style={style} />
    </group>
  );
}

/** Runs the real collision pipeline against the real scene, then parks the camera where it lands. */
function Rig({ onSolved }: { onSolved: (s: { dist: number; lift: number }) => void }) {
  const { scene, camera } = useThree();
  // Solve exactly once. `onSolved` sets state with a fresh object, so re-running this on every
  // render would be an infinite render loop (and was, first time round).
  const doneRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (doneRef.current) return;
    doneRef.current = true;
    const probe = new CameraOcclusionProbe();
    const measure = (d: THREE.Vector3) => probe.probe(scene, PIVOT, d, DESIRED, CAMERA_COLLIDER_RADIUS);

    const dir = DIR.clone();
    const polar = Math.acos(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dir.y, -1, 1));
    const headroom = Math.max(0, polar - ORBIT_MIN_POLAR - LIFT_POLAR_SAFETY);
    const lift = solveAvoidanceLift(
      dir, Math.min(DESIRED, MIN_THIRD_PERSON_DISTANCE), headroom, measure, new THREE.Vector3()
    );

    const viewDir = applyCameraLift(dir.clone(), lift);
    const collision = measure(viewDir);
    const dist = applyObservationFloor(Math.min(DESIRED, collision), collision, DESIRED, surfaceOverrunAllowance(camera.near));

    onSolved({ dist, lift });
    camera.position.copy(PIVOT).addScaledVector(viewDir, dist);
    camera.lookAt(PIVOT.x, PIVOT.y - 0.3, PIVOT.z);
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  });

  return null;
}

/** Stand-in for the avatar, so "the camera can see the player through the wall" is visible. */
function PlayerMarker() {
  return (
    <mesh position={[PIVOT.x, 1.0, PIVOT.z]} castShadow>
      <capsuleGeometry args={[0.35, 1.3, 8, 16]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#e11d48" />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Panel({ blocker, label }: { blocker: boolean; label: string }) {
  const [solved, setSolved] = useState<{ dist: number; lift: number } | null>(null);
  return (
    <div style={{ flex: 1, position: 'relative', background: '#87ceeb' }}>
      <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 2, 9], fov: 35, near: 0.5, far: 2000 }}>
        <ambientLight intensity={0.7} />
        <directionalLight position={[20, 20, 10]} intensity={1.2} />
        <House blocker={blocker} />
        <PlayerMarker />
        <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <circleGeometry args={[14, 32]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#6aa84f" />
        </mesh>
        <Rig onSolved={setSolved} />
      </Canvas>
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, padding: '10px 14px',
          font: '600 19px system-ui', color: '#fff', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)',
        }}
      >
        {label} — arm {solved ? solved.dist.toFixed(2) : '...'} / {DESIRED},
        {' '}lift {solved ? `${((solved.lift * 180) / Math.PI).toFixed(0)}°` : '...'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <div style={{ display: 'flex', width: '100vw', height: '100vh' }}>
    <Panel blocker={false} label="BEFORE (prop only)" />
    <Panel blocker label="AFTER (camera blocker)" />
  </div>
);

```

## tmp-interior-footstep-check.ts

```ts
import { nextSwimState, SwimState } from './src/components/Three/characterMovement';
import { ROOM_DEFS, ROOM_GRID_SIZE, ROOM_HALF_SIZE } from './src/constants/rooms';

const scale = 1;
const DT = 1 / 60;

/**
 * Runs the swim state machine over a point inside the house for a couple of seconds,
 * exactly the way Avatar.tsx's useFrame does, with the isInterior guard either applied
 * (fixed) or not (the bug). Reports the settled state and whether footsteps would fire.
 *
 * Footstep gate in Avatar.tsx: `if (isMoving.current && !isWet)`, isWet = state !== 'walking'.
 */
function probe(x: number, z: number, guarded: boolean) {
  let state: SwimState = 'walking';
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {          // 2 s at 60 fps
    if (guarded) {
      state = 'walking';                    // the new isInterior pin
    } else {
      state = nextSwimState(state, x, z, scale);
      // transitions settle to their terminal state within 0.45 s; short-circuit them
      if (state === 'enteringWater') state = 'swimming';
      if (state === 'exitingWater') state = 'walking';
    }
  }
  const isWet = guarded ? false : state !== 'walking';
  return { state, footsteps: !isWet };
}

console.log(`ROOM_GRID_SIZE=${ROOM_GRID_SIZE}  water threshold = 6.8 + 0.35 = 7.15\n`);
console.log('room        centre        dist   before fix        after fix');
console.log('----------------------------------------------------------------');

let anyBroken = false;
let allFixed = true;

for (const [key, def] of Object.entries(ROOM_DEFS)) {
  const [x, z] = def.pos;
  const dist = Math.hypot(x, z);
  const before = probe(x, z, false);
  const after = probe(x, z, true);
  if (!before.footsteps) anyBroken = true;
  if (!after.footsteps) allFixed = false;
  console.log(
    `${key.padEnd(11)} (${String(x).padStart(3)},${String(z).padStart(4)})  ${dist.toFixed(2).padStart(5)}   ` +
    `${(before.footsteps ? 'footsteps ok' : 'SILENT').padEnd(17)} ${after.footsteps ? 'footsteps ok' : 'SILENT'}`
  );
}

// The living room is centred on the origin, but it is 12x12 - its far corners are
// further from the origin than the water threshold, so even it was not fully safe.
const corner = ROOM_HALF_SIZE - 0.35; // walkable inset by playerRadius
const cd = Math.hypot(corner, corner);
const cBefore = probe(corner, corner, false);
const cAfter = probe(corner, corner, true);
if (!cBefore.footsteps) anyBroken = true;
if (!cAfter.footsteps) allFixed = false;
console.log(
  `${'living(cnr)'.padEnd(11)} (${corner.toFixed(1).padStart(3)},${corner.toFixed(1).padStart(4)})  ${cd.toFixed(2).padStart(5)}   ` +
  `${(cBefore.footsteps ? 'footsteps ok' : 'SILENT').padEnd(17)} ${cAfter.footsteps ? 'footsteps ok' : 'SILENT'}`
);

console.log(`\nbug reproduced before fix: ${anyBroken}`);
console.log(`all rooms audible after fix: ${allFixed}`);
process.exit(anyBroken && allFixed ? 0 : 1);
```

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for the 2026-09 「人物與草地質感」 pass. Delete with tmp-lawn.html.
 *
 * Reproduces the GAME's conditions rather than a studio's, because both halves of this pass are
 * things that only go wrong in context:
 *   - Scene.tsx's SUNNY lighting rig, verbatim (ambient .5 / hemi .6 #fff over #4a4a4a /
 *     dir [20,20,10] 1.4 #fffbeb, PCF shadows, 2048 map over ±20)
 *   - the real plateau / mound / sand meshes with the real terrain materials
 *   - the real GroundCoverField
 *   - the real character model, posed exactly as the controller leaves it at rest
 *
 *   ?dist=12     camera arm
 *   ?elev=22     camera elevation, degrees
 *   ?az=35       camera azimuth, degrees
 *   ?target=0,0  where the camera looks, island XZ
 *   ?fov=25      matches the island camera
 *   ?char=1      draw the character
 *   ?grass=1     draw the ground cover
 *   ?outfit=default|bare|dressed
 */
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';

import { CharacterModel } from './src/components/Three/character';
import type { CharacterModelId, CharacterOutfit, CharacterRig } from './src/components/Three/character';
import { CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE } from './src/constants/characterRig';
import { getHairSpec, AVATAR_SKIN_COLOR } from './src/constants/hair';
import { GroundCoverField } from './src/components/Three/GroundCover';
import { getTerrainMaterial, setTerrainIslandScale } from './src/components/Three/groundMaterial';
import {
  ISLAND_SURFACE_Y,
  ISLAND_TERRAIN,
  MOUND_BASE_SINK,
  MOUND_COLOR,
  PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR,
  PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR,
} from './src/constants/terrain';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const num = (k: string, d: number) => Number(params.get(k) ?? d);
const flag = (k: string, d: boolean) => (params.has(k) ? params.get(k) !== '0' : d);

const BARE: CharacterOutfit = {
  hair: null, hat: null, outfit: null, pants: null, shoes: null,
  necklaceId: null, earring: null,
  hasGlasses: false, hasMask: false, hasShellNecklace: false, hasSkirt: false,
  hasSwimsuit: false, hasShirt: false, hasFallbackShirt: false, hasSleeves: false,
  specials: [],
  skinColor: AVATAR_SKIN_COLOR,
  bodyColor: '#718096',
};

/** What a fresh guest actually wears — the combination every screenshot of the game shows. */
const GAME_DEFAULT: CharacterOutfit = { ...BARE, hasFallbackShirt: true, hasSleeves: true };

const DRESSED: CharacterOutfit = {
  ...BARE,
  hair: getHairSpec('hair-long') ?? null,
  hat: 'straw',
  outfit: 'jacket',
  pants: 'wide',
  shoes: 'sport',
  hasSleeves: true,
  bodyColor: '#4a5568',
};

const OUTFITS: Record<string, CharacterOutfit> = { bare: BARE, default: GAME_DEFAULT, dressed: DRESSED };

function Rigged({ modelId, outfit }: { modelId: CharacterModelId; outfit: CharacterOutfit }) {
  const rig: CharacterRig = {
    head: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), torso: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    leftArm: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), rightArm: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    leftLeg: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), rightLeg: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    eyeL: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), eyeR: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    mouth: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), hairSway: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
  };

  // The idle the controller writes: a gentle breathing bob on the torso and head.
  useFrame((state) => {
    const t = state.clock.elapsedTime;
    const bob = Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.006;
    if (rig.torso.current) rig.torso.current.position.y += 0;
    if (rig.head.current) rig.head.current.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.25;
    if (rig.leftArm.current) rig.leftArm.current.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.08 - 0.05;
    if (rig.rightArm.current) rig.rightArm.current.rotation.x = -Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.08 - 0.05;
    void bob;
  });

  return (
    <group scale={[CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE, CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE, CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE]} position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0]}>
      <CharacterModel modelId={modelId} rig={rig} outfit={outfit} />
    </group>
  );
}

/** Scene.tsx's SUNNY rig, verbatim. */
function Lighting() {
  return (
    <>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.5} />
      <hemisphereLight intensity={0.6} color="#ffffff" groundColor="#4a4a4a" />
      <directionalLight
        position={[20, 20, 10]}
        intensity={1.4}
        color="#fffbeb"
        castShadow
        shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
        shadow-camera-left={-20}
        shadow-camera-right={20}
        shadow-camera-top={20}
        shadow-camera-bottom={-20}
        shadow-camera-near={5}
        shadow-camera-far={70}
        shadow-bias={-0.0004}
        shadow-normalBias={0.028}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function Terrain() {
  const geo = (() => {
    const { plateauRadius, innerTintRadius, innerTintFadeRadius } = ISLAND_TERRAIN;
    const g = new THREE.RingGeometry(0, plateauRadius, 32, 32);
    const pos = g.attributes.position;
    const colors = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
    const inner = new THREE.Color(PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR);
    const outer = new THREE.Color(PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR);
    const c = new THREE.Color();
    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
      const r = Math.hypot(pos.getX(i), pos.getY(i));
      c.copy(inner).lerp(outer, THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(r, innerTintRadius, innerTintFadeRadius));
      colors[i * 3] = c.r; colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
    }
    g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    return g;
  })();

  const sand = (() => {
    const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(5.93, 7.07, 0.8, 32, 24);
    const pos = g.attributes.position;
    const colors = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
    const dry = new THREE.Color('#fef08a');
    const wet = new THREE.Color('#b8823a');
    const sub = wet.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color('#2dd4bf'), 0.45);
    const c = new THREE.Color();
    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
      const y = pos.getY(i);
      c.copy(dry).lerp(wet, 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, -0.05, 0.3));
      c.lerp(sub, 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y, -0.35, -0.1));
      colors[i * 3] = c.r; colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
    }
    g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    return g;
  })();

  const m = ISLAND_TERRAIN.mounds[0];
  const bottomY = ISLAND_SURFACE_Y - MOUND_BASE_SINK;

  return (
    <group>
      <mesh
        position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0]}
        rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}
        geometry={geo}
        receiveShadow
        material={getTerrainMaterial('plateau', '#ffffff', true)}
      />
      <mesh
        position={[m.cx, (m.topY + bottomY) / 2, m.cz]}
        receiveShadow
        material={getTerrainMaterial('mound', MOUND_COLOR)}
      >
        <cylinderGeometry args={[m.radiusTop, m.radiusBottom, m.topY - bottomY, 32]} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh
        position={[0, (ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseY) / 2, 0]}
        receiveShadow
        material={getTerrainMaterial('shore', PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR)}
      >
        <cylinderGeometry
          args={[ISLAND_TERRAIN.plateauRadius, ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseRadius, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y - ISLAND_TERRAIN.baseY, 32, 1, true]}
        />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, -0.25, 0]} geometry={sand} material={getTerrainMaterial('shore', '#ffffff', true)} />
    </group>
  );
}

function App() {
  setTerrainIslandScale(1);

  const dist = num('dist', 12);
  const elev = (num('elev', 22) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const az = (num('az', 35) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const [tx, tz] = (params.get('target') ?? '0,0').split(',').map(Number);
  const target = new THREE.Vector3(tx || 0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + num('ty', 0.6), tz || 0);
  const pos: [number, number, number] = [
    target.x + dist * Math.cos(elev) * Math.sin(az),
    target.y + dist * Math.sin(elev),
    target.z + dist * Math.cos(elev) * Math.cos(az),
  ];

  const outfit = OUTFITS[params.get('outfit') ?? 'default'] ?? GAME_DEFAULT;

  return (
    <Canvas
      shadows={{ type: THREE.PCFShadowMap }}
      camera={{ position: pos, fov: num('fov', 25), near: 0.5, far: 2000 }}
      onCreated={({ camera }) => camera.lookAt(target)}
    >
      <color attach="background" args={['#8fd4e8']} />
      <Lighting />
      <Terrain />
      {flag('grass', true) && <GroundCoverField islandScale={1} home={null} />}
      {flag('char', true) && <Rigged modelId="legacy" outfit={outfit} />}
    </Canvas>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />);
```

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for eyeballing the 經驗值 lock treatment on shop cards
 * (柴犬 / xpUnlock, see src/utils/unlock.ts). Mirrors ShopView's card markup with the
 * real QVersionIcon / RarityAura / index.css, at three profile states.
 * Delete with tmp-lock-preview.html once signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Coins, Check, Lock, Zap, ShoppingBag, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import './src/index.css';
import { getItemById } from './src/constants/items';
import { rarityStyleVars } from './src/constants/rarity';
import { QVersionIcon } from './src/components/QVersionIcon';
import { RarityAura } from './src/components/UI/RarityAura';
import { Button } from './src/components/UI/DesignKit';

const shiba = getItemById('pet-dog-shiba')!;
const poodle = getItemById('pet-dog-poodle')!;

function Card({ item, xp, label }: { item: typeof shiba; xp: number; label: string }) {
  const xpRequired = item.xpUnlock ?? 0;
  const locked = xpRequired > 0 && xp < xpRequired;

  return (
    <div>
      <p style={{ font: '600 12px system-ui', color: '#33475b', margin: '0 0 6px' }}>
        {label}（目前 {xp} XP）
      </p>
      <div
        className={`store-card p-4 rounded-[1.75rem] border flex flex-col group relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 text-left ${
          locked ? 'bg-island-cream-2' : 'bg-white'
        } ${item.rarity ? 'rarity-card' : 'border-island-line hover:border-island-teal-light'}`}
        style={item.rarity ? rarityStyleVars(item.rarity) : undefined}
      >
        <div
          className={`w-full aspect-[4/3] bg-island-cream-2 rounded-2xl mb-3 flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden border ${
            item.rarity ? 'rarity-well' : 'border-island-line'
          }`}
        >
          {item.rarity && (
            <div className={locked ? 'opacity-30' : undefined}>
              <RarityAura rarity={item.rarity} />
            </div>
          )}
          <div
            className={`text-island-navy flex items-center justify-center scale-[0.96] transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-[1.02] relative ${
              locked ? 'opacity-40 grayscale' : ''
            }`}
          >
            <QVersionIcon itemId={item.id} size={110} />
          </div>
          {locked && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-none">
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-white/90 border border-island-line flex items-center justify-center text-island-navy-soft shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(38,70,83,0.12)]">
                <Lock size={20} strokeWidth={2.75} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-island-navy bg-white/90 border border-island-line px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
                {xpRequired} 經驗值解鎖
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {locked && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-[15] bg-island-navy/[0.07] pointer-events-none rounded-[1.75rem]" />
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-col flex-1">
          <h4 className="text-base font-black text-island-navy tracking-tight leading-tight mb-1 truncate group-hover:text-island-teal-dark transition-colors duration-200">
            {item.name}
          </h4>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-island-cream-2 text-island-navy-soft text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg border border-island-line">
              狗
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-island-navy-soft/70 text-xs font-bold leading-relaxed mb-3 line-clamp-2 min-h-[2rem]">
            {item.description}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-between mb-3 border-t border-island-line pt-2.5 z-10 w-full ${
            locked ? 'bg-transparent' : 'bg-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="text-xs text-island-navy-soft/70 font-bold">
            {xpRequired > 0 ? '解鎖條件' : '商品售價'}
          </span>
          {xpRequired > 0 ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-black text-base text-island-navy">
              <Zap size={14} className="text-island-teal" strokeWidth={2.75} />
              <span>{locked ? `${xp} / ${xpRequired}` : xpRequired}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-island-navy-soft/70">經驗值</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-black text-base text-island-navy">
              <Coins size={14} className="text-island-gold" />
              <span>{item.price}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* BuyButton's three states, reproduced (it needs AppContext, which this harness has none of) */}
        <Button
          variant={locked ? 'ghost' : 'primary'}
          disabled={locked}
          className="w-full py-2.5 text-sm gap-1.5"
        >
          {locked ? (
            <>
              <Lock size={14} strokeWidth={3} />
              <span>需 {xpRequired} 經驗值</span>
            </>
          ) : xpRequired > 0 ? (
            <>
              <Sparkles size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} />
              <span>免費解鎖</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ShoppingBag size={14} strokeWidth={2.75} />
              <span>購買</span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 opacity-90">
                <Coins size={12} className="text-island-gold" />
                {item.price}
              </span>
            </>
          )}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 320px)', gap: 20, padding: 8 }}>
      <Card item={poodle} xp={40} label="一般商品（對照組）" />
      <Card item={shiba} xp={40} label="柴犬・未解鎖（上鎖 + 變暗）" />
      <Card item={shiba} xp={120} label="柴犬・已達 100 XP" />
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />);
```

```tsx
/**
 * Temporary harness: the real <Moon /> from NightSky.tsx, drawn across a full 陰晴圓缺 cycle.
 * Not part of the app. Delete once the moon has been signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { Moon } from './src/components/Three/NightSky';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const PHASES = (params.get('phases') ?? '0,0.125,0.25,0.375,0.5,0.625,0.75,0.875')
  .split(',')
  .map(Number);
const ZOOM = Number(params.get('zoom') ?? 5.2);
const SPACING = Number(params.get('spacing') ?? 30);

function Row() {
  // Fully night: the ramp the real NightSky lerps toward when weather is MIDNIGHT.
  const nightRef = useRef(1);
  return (
    <>
      {PHASES.map((p, i) => (
        <group key={p} position={[(i - (PHASES.length - 1) / 2) * SPACING, 0, 0]}>
          {/* Moon positions itself at MOON_POSITION, so cancel that out and re-place it here. */}
          <group position={[140, -150, 145]}>
            <Moon nightRef={nightRef} phase={p} />
          </group>
        </group>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <Canvas
    orthographic
    camera={{ position: [0, 0, 200], zoom: ZOOM, near: 0.1, far: 1000 }}
    gl={{ antialias: true }}
    style={{ width: '100vw', height: '100vh', background: '#060d24' }}
  >
    <Row />
  </Canvas>,
);
```

```ts
/**
 * Replays IslandNpcs' territory and NpcWalker's frame loop headlessly, with the walker's
 * edge handling switchable between BEFORE (grind against the edge until the 1.6s stuck timer
 * happens to fire) and AFTER (turn away 0.15s after the step stops going anywhere).
 *
 * Not a component: the useFrame body is transcribed here so it can be driven at 60fps for
 * several simulated minutes against the real terrain, home and furniture resolvers.
 */
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { SHORELINE_RADIUS } from './src/constants/terrain';
import { NPC_WALK } from './src/constants/npcs';
import { getSurfaceAt } from './src/lib/placementSurfaces';
import { resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture } from './src/lib/furniturePlacement';
import { resolveHomeCollision } from './src/components/Three/characterMovement';
import { getPlayerHome, ResolvedHome } from './src/hooks/usePlayerHome';
import type { PlacedItem } from './src/types';

const NPC_RADIUS = 0.3;
const ROAM_FRACTION = 0.82;
const MIN_TRIP = 2.2;
const PICK_ATTEMPTS = 14;
const DT = 1 / 60;

// The new constants, mirrored from NpcWalker.tsx.
const BOUNCE_PROGRESS = 0.45;
const BOUNCE_SECONDS = 0.15;
const SHOVE_EPSILON = 0.001;
const BOUNCE_PAUSE = 0.4;
const BOUNCE_MEMORY = 5;
const BOUNCE_CONE = Math.cos(Math.PI / 3);
const REROUTE_ATTEMPTS = 4;

/** A rock-sized solid on the rim: what a decorated island puts between her and the sea. */
interface Blob { x: number; z: number; r: number }

/** Deterministic RNG so BEFORE and AFTER see the same island and the same dice. */
function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
    return s / 4294967296;
  };
}

function makeTerritory(items: PlacedItem[], islandScale: number, home: ResolvedHome | null, blobs: Blob[], rand: () => number) {
  const roam = SHORELINE_RADIUS * islandScale * ROAM_FRACTION;
  const probe = new THREE.Vector3();
  const pushBlobs = (p: { x: number; z: number }, radius: number) => {
    for (const b of blobs) {
      const dx = p.x - b.x;
      const dz = p.z - b.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      const reach = b.r + radius;
      if (d < reach && d > 1e-6) {
        p.x = b.x + (dx / d) * reach;
        p.z = b.z + (dz / d) * reach;
      }
    }
  };
  const isFree = (x: number, z: number) => {
    if (!getSurfaceAt(x, z, items, islandScale).isSolid) return false;
    probe.set(x, 0, z);
    if (home) resolveHomeCollision(probe, home, NPC_RADIUS + 0.2);
    if (probe.x !== x || probe.z !== z) return false;
    pushBlobs(probe, NPC_RADIUS + 0.2);
    if (probe.x !== x || probe.z !== z) return false;
    const pushed = resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture(x, z, NPC_RADIUS + 0.2, items);
    return pushed.x === x && pushed.z === z;
  };
  return {
    pickRoute(from: THREE.Vector3) {
      for (let i = 0; i < PICK_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
        const angle = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
        const radius = Math.sqrt(rand()) * roam;
        const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
        const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
        if (Math.hypot(x - from.x, z - from.z) < MIN_TRIP) continue;
        if (!isFree(x, z)) continue;
        return [{ x, z }];
      }
      return [] as { x: number; z: number }[];
    },
    contain(p: THREE.Vector3) {
      if (home) resolveHomeCollision(p, home, NPC_RADIUS);
      const pushed = resolvePlayerAgainstFurniture(p.x, p.z, NPC_RADIUS, items);
      p.x = pushed.x;
      p.z = pushed.z;
      pushBlobs(p, NPC_RADIUS);
      if (!getSurfaceAt(p.x, p.z, items, islandScale).isSolid) {
        const shore = SHORELINE_RADIUS * islandScale * 0.94;
        const dist = Math.hypot(p.x, p.z);
        if (dist > shore && dist > 1e-6) {
          p.x *= shore / dist;
          p.z *= shore / dist;
        }
      }
    },
    groundY(x: number, z: number) {
      return getSurfaceAt(x, z, items, islandScale).y;
    },
  };
}

function turnToward(current: number, target: number, alpha: number) {
  const d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(target - current), Math.cos(target - current));
  return current + d * alpha;
}

interface Scenario {
  label: string;
  items?: PlacedItem[];
  home?: ResolvedHome | null;
  blobs?: Blob[];
  player?: THREE.Vector3 | null;
  islandScale?: number;
  /** Where she starts, when the point of the scenario is where she already is. */
  start?: [number, number];
  seconds: number;
}

function run(scn: Scenario, fixed: boolean) {
  const islandScale = scn.islandScale ?? 1;
  const rand = rng(20260906);
  const terr = makeTerritory(scn.items ?? [], islandScale, scn.home ?? null, scn.blobs ?? [], rand);
  const pos = scn.start
    ? new THREE.Vector3(scn.start[0], 0, scn.start[1])
    : new THREE.Vector3(1.35 * islandScale, 0, 1.3 * islandScale);
  pos.y = terr.groundY(pos.x, pos.z);
  let yaw = -0.35;
  let route: { x: number; z: number }[] = [];
  let pause = 0.8;
  let lastDist = Infinity;
  let stuckFor = 0;
  let blockedFor = 0;
  let blockedUntil = 0;
  const blockedDir = new THREE.Vector2();
  const stepFrom = new THREE.Vector3();

  // What the player would actually see: frames where she is walking but the edge is eating the
  // step, and frames where she is standing but something keeps shoving her.
  let grindFrames = 0;
  let worstGrind = 0;
  let grindRun = 0;
  let episodes = 0;
  let travelledTotal = 0;
  let lastGrind = 0;

  const frames = Math.round(scn.seconds / DT);
  for (let f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
    const t = f * DT;
    let travelled = 0;
    let walking = false;
    stepFrom.copy(pos);
    let stepX = 0;
    let stepZ = 0;

    if (route.length === 0) {
      pause -= DT;
      if (pause <= 0) {
        if (fixed) {
          const avoid = t < blockedUntil ? blockedDir : null;
          let picked: { x: number; z: number }[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < REROUTE_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
            picked = terr.pickRoute(pos);
            if (picked.length === 0) break;
            if (!avoid) break;
            const dx = picked[0].x - pos.x;
            const dz = picked[0].z - pos.z;
            const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
            if (d < 1e-4 || (dx / d) * avoid.x + (dz / d) * avoid.y <= BOUNCE_CONE) break;
          }
          route = picked;
        } else {
          route = terr.pickRoute(pos);
        }
        pause = route.length > 0 ? 0 : 0.5;
        lastDist = Infinity;
        stuckFor = 0;
        blockedFor = 0;
      }
    } else {
      const target = route[0];
      const dx = target.x - pos.x;
      const dz = target.z - pos.z;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (dist <= NPC_WALK.arrive) {
        route.shift();
        if (route.length === 0) pause = NPC_WALK.pauseMin + rand() * (NPC_WALK.pauseMax - NPC_WALK.pauseMin);
        lastDist = Infinity;
        stuckFor = 0;
      } else {
        walking = true;
        travelled = Math.min(dist, NPC_WALK.speed * DT);
        stepX = dx / dist;
        stepZ = dz / dist;
        pos.x += stepX * travelled;
        pos.z += stepZ * travelled;
        yaw = turnToward(yaw, Math.atan2(dx, dz), 1 - Math.exp(-NPC_WALK.turnRate * DT));
        stuckFor = dist < lastDist - 0.01 ? 0 : stuckFor + DT;
        lastDist = dist;
        if (stuckFor > NPC_WALK.stuckSeconds) {
          route.length = 0;
          pause = 0.6;
          stuckFor = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    terr.contain(pos);

    if (scn.player) {
      const px = pos.x - scn.player.x;
      const pz = pos.z - scn.player.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(px, pz);
      if (d < 0.75) {
        const nx = d > 1e-4 ? px / d : Math.sin(yaw);
        const nz = d > 1e-4 ? pz / d : Math.cos(yaw);
        pos.x = scn.player.x + nx * 0.75;
        pos.z = scn.player.z + nz * 0.75;
      }
    }

    const gained = walking ? (pos.x - stepFrom.x) * stepX + (pos.z - stepFrom.z) * stepZ : 0;
    const blocked = walking
      ? gained < travelled * BOUNCE_PROGRESS
      : Math.hypot(pos.x - stepFrom.x, pos.z - stepFrom.z) > SHOVE_EPSILON;

    // Measurement, identical for both variants.
    if (blocked) {
      grindFrames++;
      grindRun++;
      lastGrind = t;
      if (grindRun === 1) episodes++;
      worstGrind = Math.max(worstGrind, grindRun);
    } else {
      grindRun = 0;
    }
    travelledTotal += Math.hypot(pos.x - stepFrom.x, pos.z - stepFrom.z);

    if (fixed) {
      blockedFor = blocked ? blockedFor + DT : 0;
      if (blockedFor >= BOUNCE_SECONDS) {
        route.length = 0;
        blockedFor = 0;
        stuckFor = 0;
        lastDist = Infinity;
        if (walking) {
          pause = BOUNCE_PAUSE;
          blockedDir.set(stepX, stepZ);
          blockedUntil = t + BOUNCE_MEMORY;
        } else {
          pause = 0;
          blockedUntil = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    pos.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(pos.y, terr.groundY(pos.x, pos.z), 1 - Math.exp(-14 * DT));
  }

  return {
    grind: grindFrames * DT,
    worst: worstGrind * DT,
    episodes,
    distance: travelledTotal,
    lastGrind,
  };
}

const home = getPlayerHome({
  home: { position: [4.4, 0.3, 3.2], rotation: 0.6, currentStyle: 'cottage' },
} as any);

/** Decorations along the rim, where players actually put them. */
const rimBlobs: Blob[] = [
  { x: 5.1, z: 0.4, r: 0.8 },
  { x: -4.2, z: 3.1, r: 0.9 },
  { x: 0.6, z: -5.0, r: 0.7 },
  { x: -5.2, z: -1.4, r: 0.8 },
];

const scenarios: Scenario[] = [
  { label: 'A  empty island, no home', seconds: 600 },
  { label: 'B  home near the rim', home, seconds: 600 },
  { label: 'C  decorations along the rim', blobs: rimBlobs, seconds: 600 },
  { label: 'D  home + rim decorations', home, blobs: rimBlobs, seconds: 600 },
  { label: 'E  player parked on the sand', player: new THREE.Vector3(5.2, 0, 0), blobs: rimBlobs, seconds: 600 },
  { label: 'F  bigger island (territory 3)', islandScale: 1.8, home, blobs: rimBlobs.map((b) => ({ ...b, x: b.x * 1.8, z: b.z * 1.8 })), seconds: 600 },
  // G is the reported bug in its pure form: two rules that disagree. A solid straddling the
  // waterline pushes her out through its seaward face, the waterline pulls her straight back
  // inside it, and neither ever wins - so she ping-pongs on the spot for as long as she is left
  // there. The stuck timer cannot see it: the distance to her target goes down and up again with
  // each bounce, which is exactly what resets it.
  { label: 'G  solid straddling the waterline', blobs: [{ x: 6.5, z: 0, r: 1.3 }], start: [6.45, 0], seconds: 120 },
  { label: 'H  the same, on a level-3 island', islandScale: 1.8, blobs: [{ x: 11.6, z: 0, r: 1.6 }], start: [11.5, 0], seconds: 120 },
];

console.log('               scenario                  |  grinding-at-an-edge  | longest single grind | episodes | last grind at | distance walked');
for (const scn of scenarios) {
  const before = run(scn, false);
  const after = run(scn, true);
  const row = (tag: string, r: ReturnType<typeof run>) =>
    `  ${tag} ${scn.label.padEnd(33)} |  ${r.grind.toFixed(1).padStart(6)}s / ${String(scn.seconds).padStart(3)}s  |  ${r.worst.toFixed(2).padStart(7)}s           |  ${String(r.episodes).padStart(4)}    |  ${r.lastGrind.toFixed(1).padStart(6)}s      |  ${r.distance.toFixed(0)}`;
  console.log(row('BEFORE', before));
  console.log(row('AFTER ', after));
}
```

## tmp-npcedge.tsx

```tsx
/** Throwaway: the real 餅乾兔園丁 walking a real island rim with a hedge on it, seen from above,
 *  so「撞到邊緣就掉頭」can be watched (and measured) instead of argued about. Delete when signed off.
 *
 *  The territory is the island's own: real getSurfaceAt for what is land, the real waterline
 *  clamp from IslandNpcs, plus an arc of solids sitting on the rim — the decorations players
 *  actually line their beaches with, and the thing she used to grind against.
 *
 *  `window.__npcTrace` collects {t, x, z} at 10Hz for the driver script; the white trail is the
 *  same data drawn in the scene so a single screenshot shows where she has been. */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { NpcTerritory, NpcWalker, NpcWaypoint } from './src/components/Three/NpcWalker';
import { getSurfaceAt } from './src/lib/placementSurfaces';
import { SHORELINE_RADIUS } from './src/constants/terrain';

const NPC_RADIUS = 0.3;
const ROAM_FRACTION = 0.82;
const MIN_TRIP = 2.2;
const PICK_ATTEMPTS = 14;

/**
 * A decorated island: an arc of solids walling off the beach on the +x side, plus scattered
 * pieces inland — i.e. what a played-in island looks like, where most straight lines between two
 * free spots cross something. `?bare=1` clears them for a control run.
 */
const HEDGE = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('bare') ? [] : [
  ...Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => {
    const a = (-60 + i * 15) * (Math.PI / 180);
    return { x: Math.cos(a) * 4.9, z: Math.sin(a) * 4.9, r: 0.6 };
  }),
  { x: -1.2, z: 3.6, r: 0.7 }, { x: -3.8, z: 1.4, r: 0.8 }, { x: -2.6, z: -2.4, r: 0.7 },
  { x: 0.4, z: -4.2, r: 0.8 }, { x: 2.6, z: -3.0, r: 0.6 }, { x: -4.6, z: -3.2, r: 0.7 },
  { x: 1.8, z: 2.2, r: 0.6 }, { x: -0.6, z: -1.0, r: 0.6 }, { x: 3.4, z: 3.6, r: 0.7 },
];

(window as any).__npcTrace = [] as { t: number; x: number; z: number }[];
(window as any).__hedge = HEDGE;

function pushOutOfHedge(p: { x: number; z: number }, radius: number) {
  for (const b of HEDGE) {
    const dx = p.x - b.x;
    const dz = p.z - b.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    const reach = b.r + radius;
    if (d < reach && d > 1e-6) {
      p.x = b.x + (dx / d) * reach;
      p.z = b.z + (dz / d) * reach;
    }
  }
}

function useIslandTerritory(): NpcTerritory {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const roam = SHORELINE_RADIUS * ROAM_FRACTION;
    const probe = { x: 0, z: 0 };
    const isFree = (x: number, z: number) => {
      if (!getSurfaceAt(x, z, [], 1).isSolid) return false;
      probe.x = x;
      probe.z = z;
      pushOutOfHedge(probe, NPC_RADIUS + 0.2);
      return probe.x === x && probe.z === z;
    };
    return {
      pickRoute(from): NpcWaypoint[] {
        for (let i = 0; i < PICK_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
          const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const radius = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * roam;
          const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
          const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
          if (Math.hypot(x - from.x, z - from.z) < MIN_TRIP) continue;
          if (!isFree(x, z)) continue;
          return [{ x, z }];
        }
        return [];
      },
      routeTo(_from, to) {
        return isFree(to.x, to.z) ? [{ x: to.x, z: to.z }] : null;
      },
      contain(p) {
        pushOutOfHedge(p, NPC_RADIUS);
        if (!getSurfaceAt(p.x, p.z, [], 1).isSolid) {
          const shore = SHORELINE_RADIUS * 0.94;
          const dist = Math.hypot(p.x, p.z);
          if (dist > shore && dist > 1e-6) {
            p.x *= shore / dist;
            p.z *= shore / dist;
          }
        }
      },
      groundY(x, z) {
        return getSurfaceAt(x, z, [], 1).y;
      },
    };
  }, []);
}

/** Reads the walker's own group each frame — the trace is where she actually is, not a re-sim. */
function Tracker({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const group = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const trail = useRef<THREE.BufferGeometry>(null);
  const next = useRef(0);
  const points = useRef<number[]>([]);

  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    const walker = group.current?.children[0];
    if (!walker) return;
    const t = clock.getElapsedTime();
    // Every frame: telling「grinding against a hedge」apart from「standing and looking around」
    // needs per-frame motion — both are nearly still at 10Hz, but the first one is stepping
    // forward and being pushed back 60 times a second and the second one is not moving at all.
    (window as any).__npcTrace.push({ t, x: walker.position.x, z: walker.position.z });
    if (t < next.current) return;
    next.current = t + 0.1;
    points.current.push(walker.position.x, 0.45, walker.position.z);
    if (trail.current) {
      trail.current.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(points.current, 3));
      trail.current.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
  });

  return (
    <>
      <group ref={group}>{children}</group>
      <points>
        <bufferGeometry ref={trail} />
        <pointsMaterial color="#ffffff" size={0.09} />
      </points>
    </>
  );
}

function Harness() {
  const territory = useIslandTerritory();
  return (
    <Canvas
      orthographic
      camera={{ position: [0, 30, 0.001], zoom: 46, near: 0.1, far: 100 }}
      gl={{ preserveDrawingBuffer: true }}
      style={{ width: '100vw', height: '100vh' }}
    >
      <color attach="background" args={['#123a4d']} />
      <ambientLight intensity={1.5} />
      <directionalLight position={[4, 8, 3]} intensity={1.4} />
      {/* The island, drawn as the two rings the terrain actually is: grass, then beach. */}
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.01, 0]}>
        <circleGeometry args={[SHORELINE_RADIUS, 64]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#d8c79a" />
      </mesh>
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.02, 0]}>
        <circleGeometry args={[5.7, 64]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#6f9b58" />
      </mesh>
      {/* Where she is allowed to aim: the roam disc. Anything outside it she only reaches by
          being pushed there. */}
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.03, 0]}>
        <ringGeometry args={[SHORELINE_RADIUS * ROAM_FRACTION - 0.02, SHORELINE_RADIUS * ROAM_FRACTION, 64]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#ffffff" transparent opacity={0.35} />
      </mesh>
      {HEDGE.map((b, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} position={[b.x, 0.35, b.z]}>
          <cylinderGeometry args={[b.r, b.r, 0.7, 16]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#2f5d3a" />
        </mesh>
      ))}
      <Tracker>
        <NpcWalker
          npcId="npc-cookie-rabbit"
          name="餅乾兔園丁"
          scope="island"
          kind="cookieRabbit"
          height={1.85}
          spawnX={1.35}
          spawnZ={1.3}
          spawnRotation={-0.35}
          territory={territory}
        />
      </Tracker>
    </Canvas>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<Harness />);
```

## tmp-npcsocial.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness: a resident's social layer (notice, stop, face, talk, farewell) driven through
 * the REAL NpcWalker on a flat disc. Delete when signed off.
 *
 *   ?kind=cookieRabbit | hippoButler      (the butler lives indoors, so this sets isInsideHouse)
 *
 * window.__player(x, z)   move the stand-in player
 * window.__talk()          press 「聊天」 exactly as the E key / badge do
 * window.__bus             the live player bus (npcTarget, npcSpeech)
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { NpcWalker, type NpcTerritory } from './src/components/Three/NpcWalker';
import { ISLAND_NPCS, INTERIOR_NPCS, type NpcKind } from './src/constants/npcs';
import { playerBus } from './src/lib/playerBus';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const KIND = (params.get('kind') ?? 'cookieRabbit') as NpcKind;
const SPEC = [...ISLAND_NPCS, ...INTERIOR_NPCS].find((n) => n.kind === KIND)!;
const SCOPE = KIND === 'hippoButler' ? 'interior' : 'island';

playerBus.playerPos = new THREE.Vector3(9, 0, 0);
playerBus.playerRotation = -Math.PI / 2;
playerBus.isInsideHouse = SCOPE === 'interior';
(window as any).__bus = playerBus;
(window as any).__player = (x: number, z: number) => {
  const p = playerBus.playerPos!;
  playerBus.playerRotation = Math.atan2(-x, -z);
  p.set(x, 0, z);
};
(window as any).__talk = () => {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('npc-interact', { detail: { npcId: SPEC.id } }));
};

// A still resident by default (?roam=1 lets her walk), so screenshots are of the social layer, not
// of wherever her route happened to take her.
const ROAM = params.has('roam');
const territory: NpcTerritory = {
  pickRoute: () => {
    if (!ROAM) return [];
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const r = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
    return [{ x: Math.cos(a) * r, z: Math.sin(a) * r }];
  },
  routeTo: (from, to) => [to],
  contain: (p) => {
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x, p.z);
    if (d > 8) { p.x *= 8 / d; p.z *= 8 / d; }
  },
  groundY: () => 0,
};

function Player() {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  useFrame(() => {
    const p = playerBus.playerPos!;
    ref.current?.position.set(p.x, 0, p.z);
  });
  return (
    <group ref={ref}>
      <mesh position={[0, 1.05, 0]}>
        <capsuleGeometry args={[0.3, 1.5, 8, 12]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#8fa6b5" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function Hud() {
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const tick = () => {
      const t = playerBus.npcTarget;
      const s = playerBus.npcSpeech;
      setText(`target: ${t ? `${t.label}${t.talking ? ' (talking)' : ''}` : '—'}   |   speech: ${s ? `${s.name}：${s.text}` : '—'}`);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, []);
  return <div className="hud" id="hud">{text}</div>;
}

const CAM = (params.get('cam')?.split(',').map(Number) as [number, number, number]) ?? [3.2, 2.4, 5.2];

function App() {
  return (
    <>
      <Hud />
      <Canvas shadows camera={{ position: CAM, fov: 38 }} onCreated={({ camera }) => camera.lookAt(0.6, 1.0, 0)}>
        <color attach="background" args={['#eef2f5']} />
        <ambientLight intensity={0.85} />
        <directionalLight position={[4, 7, 5]} intensity={1.4} castShadow />
        <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} receiveShadow>
          <circleGeometry args={[10, 48]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#cfe3c8" roughness={1} />
        </mesh>
        <Player />
        <NpcWalker
          npcId={SPEC.id}
          name={SPEC.name}
          scope={SCOPE}
          kind={KIND}
          height={SPEC.height}
          spawnX={0}
          spawnZ={0}
          spawnRotation={0}
          territory={territory}
        />
      </Canvas>
    </>
  );
}

const host = document.getElementById('root')! as HTMLElement & { __root?: ReturnType<typeof createRoot> };
host.__root ??= createRoot(host);
host.__root.render(<App />);

```

## tmp-objectanim.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for signing off the Object Interaction Animation System.
 *
 * Every reacting piece drawn by the SHIPPING `FurnitureModel` with a real instance id, plus the
 * two buttons that fire the exact events Three/Avatar.tsx fires. So a screenshot here is what the
 * player gets when they press E, without having to buy the furniture first.
 *
 *   ?set=doors    wardrobe, fridge, oven, microwave, picnic basket, vanity
 *   ?set=state    stove, radio, washbasin, toilet, fountain
 *   ?set=seats    sofas, beds, bath, loungers   (use 佔用 rather than 互動)
 *   ?set=throw    frisbee, beach ball, bookshelf, desks, viewing deck
 *
 * Delete with tmp-objectanim.html once this is signed off.
 */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls } from '@react-three/drei';

import { FurnitureModel } from './src/components/Three/FurnitureItem';
import { getItemById } from './src/constants/items';
import * as objectState from './src/lib/objectRuntimeState';

(window as any).__objState = objectState;

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const SET = params.get('set') ?? 'doors';

const SETS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  doors: ['item-wardrobe', 'item-fridge', 'furn-oven', 'furn-microwave', 'deco-picnic-basket', 'furn-vanity'],
  state: ['item-stove', 'deco-radio', 'item-washbasin', 'item-toilet', 'item-17'],
  seats: ['item-21', 'item-bed', 'item-bathtub', 'furn-beanbag', 'deco-lounger-beach', 'furn-rocking-chair'],
  throw: ['deco-frisbee', 'deco-beach-ball', 'item-24', 'item-desk', 'deco-viewing-deck', 'deco-tent'],
  outdoor: ['deco-campfire', 'deco-telescope', 'deco-birdhouse', 'deco-wishing-well'],
};

const ONLY = params.get('id');
const IDS = ONLY ? [ONLY] : (SETS[SET] ?? SETS.doors);
const SPACING = 3.4;
const CAM: [number, number, number] = (params.get('cam')?.split(',').map(Number) as [number, number, number])
  ?? (ONLY ? [0, 1.6, 4.4] : [0, 4.2, 17]);
const FOV = Number(params.get('fov')) || (ONLY ? 40 : 46);
const TARGET_Y = Number(params.get('ty')) || (ONLY ? 1.1 : 1);
/** ?fire=interact|occupy fires on load, so a screenshot needs no click. */
const AUTO = params.get('fire');
/**
 * ?from=<degrees> — WHICH SIDE THE PLAYER IS ON when they press E.
 *
 * The whole of the dynamic-direction test. 0 is standing on the piece's own +Z side, 90 on its
 * +X side, and so on; the synthetic player stands one unit out on that bearing and faces the
 * piece, which is exactly what the interaction system does with a real one (an acting posture
 * resolves a stand spot on the side the player approached from and squares them up to it —
 * lib/furnitureInteraction.ts's `resolveStandSpot`).
 *
 * Fire the same piece from 0, 90, 180 and 270 and the disc must go four different ways. Before
 * `launch` existed it went the same way four times, because the flight was welded to the model's
 * own +Z.
 */
const FROM = Number(params.get('from') ?? 180);
/** How far out the synthetic player stands. Only its DIRECTION matters to the heading. */
const STAND_OFF = 1.2;

function Piece({ id }: { id: string; index: number }) {
  const item = getItemById(id);
  const x = pieceXFor(id);
  if (!item) return null;
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, 0]}>
      <FurnitureModel name={item.name} item={item} scale={1.0} instanceId={`probe-${id}`} />
    </group>
  );
}

function fire(type: string) {
  (window as any).__fired = performance.now();
  const bearing = (FROM * Math.PI) / 180;
  for (const id of IDS) {
    // Each piece stands at its own x on the row, so the synthetic player has to be placed
    // relative to THAT piece — a single world position would be a different bearing for every
    // piece in the set, which is the one thing this parameter must not be.
    const pieceX = pieceXFor(id);
    const px = pieceX + Math.sin(bearing) * STAND_OFF;
    const pz = Math.cos(bearing) * STAND_OFF;
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, {
      detail: {
        instanceId: `probe-${id}`,
        itemId: id,
        at: performance.now(),
        // The same shape Avatar.tsx sends: where the body is and which way it points, with the
        // body squared up to the piece.
        player: { x: px, z: pz, yaw: Math.atan2(pieceX - px, -pz) },
      },
    }));
  }
}

function pieceXFor(id: string): number {
  return (IDS.indexOf(id) - (IDS.length - 1) / 2) * SPACING;
}

function App() {
  const [note, setNote] = useState('idle');
  // Deterministic firing for the screenshot script: it waits for the scene, calls this, then
  // waits an exact number of milliseconds. A timer inside the page cannot be timed from outside.
  useEffect(() => {
    (window as any).__fire = (kind: string) => {
      fire(kind === 'occupy' ? 'furniture-occupy' : kind === 'release' ? 'furniture-release' : 'furniture-interact');
      setNote(kind);
    };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!AUTO) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      fire(AUTO === 'occupy' ? 'furniture-occupy' : 'furniture-interact');
      setNote(AUTO);
    }, 600);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="bar">
        <strong>{SET}</strong>
        <button onClick={() => { fire('furniture-interact'); setNote('interact'); }}>按 E（互動）</button>
        <button onClick={() => { fire('furniture-occupy'); setNote('occupied'); }}>坐上去（佔用）</button>
        <button onClick={() => { fire('furniture-release'); setNote('released'); }}>起身（釋放）</button>
        <span>{note}</span>
        {Object.keys(SETS).map((s) => (
          <a key={s} href={`?set=${s}`}>{s}</a>
        ))}
      </div>
      <Canvas shadows camera={{ position: CAM, fov: FOV }} onCreated={({ scene }) => { (window as any).__scene = scene; }}>
        <color attach="background" args={['#1b2430']} />
        <hemisphereLight args={['#dff0ff', '#6b5a45', 1.0]} />
        <directionalLight position={[5, 9, 6]} intensity={1.5} castShadow />
        <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} receiveShadow>
          <planeGeometry args={[80, 80]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#8a9a7b" />
        </mesh>
        {IDS.map((id, i) => <Piece key={id} id={id} index={i} />)}
        <OrbitControls target={[0, TARGET_Y, 0]} />
      </Canvas>
    </>
  );
}

// Vite invalidates this module on every edit (the `SETS` export is not Fast-Refresh compatible),
// which re-executes it and would call createRoot on the same container again — stacking roots,
// each with its own Canvas and its own event listeners. Reuse the root instead.
const host = document.getElementById('root')! as HTMLElement & { __root?: ReturnType<typeof createRoot> };
host.__root ??= createRoot(host);
host.__root.render(<App />);

```

## tmp-oceanring.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Temporary harness: the REAL <Ocean /> and <SkyDome /> from the app, viewed from
 * above so the near/far crossfade ring (uFadeStart..uFadeEnd) is in frame.
 * Not part of the app.
 *
 *   ?cam=top      looking down at the sea around the island
 *   ?cam=horizon  the game's own lens, aimed at the horizon
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { AppProvider } from './src/context/AppContext';
import { Ocean } from './src/components/Three/Ocean';
import { SkyDome } from './src/components/Three/SkyDome';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const CAM = params.get('cam') ?? 'top';
/** ?only=sky | ocean | both - which layer to draw, so the two can be told apart. */
const ONLY = params.get('only') ?? 'both';

function Aim() {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera);
  if (CAM === 'horizon') {
    camera.position.set(30, 12, 40);
    camera.lookAt(-300, 30, -400);
  } else {
    camera.position.set(0, 95, 60);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
  }
  camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  return null;
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <AppProvider>
    <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 95, 60], fov: 45, near: 0.5, far: 2000 }}>
      <Aim />
      {ONLY !== 'ocean' && <SkyDome />}
      {ONLY === 'ocean' && (
        /* Opaque backdrop so the ocean's own shading is all that is on screen. */
        <mesh>
          <sphereGeometry args={[600, 32, 32]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#404040" side={2} />
        </mesh>
      )}
      {ONLY !== 'sky' && <Ocean />}
      <ambientLight intensity={1} />
    </Canvas>
  </AppProvider>
);
```

## tmp-outdoor-preview.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for signing off the 2026-09 outdoor quality pass.
 *
 * Every outdoor placeable is drawn by the SHIPPING `FurnitureModel` at the SHIPPING island scale
 * (0.85, which FurnitureModel then multiplies by 1.55 for a BUILDING item), on grass, lit the way
 * the island lights it — so a screenshot here is what the player gets after they buy the thing.
 * The seven House Styles are drawn by the shipping `HouseModel` at its own scale of 1.
 *
 *   ?set=rebuilt   the five original catalog pieces that were 2–4 primitives
 *   ?set=interactive  swing / campfire / telescope / birdhouse / wishing well
 *   ?set=art       the five outdoor art installations
 *   ?set=pets      the ten pet homes
 *   ?set=houses    all seven House Styles side by side
 *   ?id=<item id>  one piece, alone, filling the view
 *   ?house=<style id>  one house, alone
 *
 * Delete with tmp-outdoor-preview.html once this is signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls } from '@react-three/drei';

import { FurnitureModel } from './src/components/Three/FurnitureItem';
import { HouseModel } from './src/components/Three/HouseModel';
import { getItemById } from './src/constants/items';
import { HOUSE_STYLES, getHouseStyle } from './src/constants/houseStyles';
import { QVersionIcon } from './src/components/QVersionIcon';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const ONLY = params.get('id');
const ONE_HOUSE = params.get('house');
const SET = params.get('set') ?? 'rebuilt';
/** ?cam=x,y,z&look=x,y,z — frame one detail close up. OrbitControls still works from there. */
const triple = (key: string): [number, number, number] | null => {
  const raw = params.get(key);
  if (!raw) return null;
  const n = raw.split(',').map(Number);
  return n.length === 3 && n.every((v) => Number.isFinite(v)) ? [n[0], n[1], n[2]] : null;
};
const CAM = triple('cam');
const LOOK = triple('look');

/** The island draws a placed piece at 0.85 (Three/PlacementGhost's IslandPlacements). */
const ISLAND_SCALE = 0.85;

const SETS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  rebuilt: ['item-18', 'item-17', 'item-16', 'item-19', 'item-20', 'deco-fence-picket'],
  interactive: ['deco-swing', 'deco-campfire', 'deco-telescope', 'deco-birdhouse', 'deco-wishing-well'],
  art: ['art-out-totem', 'art-out-arch', 'art-out-urn', 'art-out-mobile', 'art-out-plinth'],
  // The 2026-09 outdoor animation pass: everything that was fixed or set moving.
  motion: ['item-18', 'item-17', 'item-19', 'deco-swing', 'deco-telescope', 'art-out-totem', 'art-out-mobile'],
  // Four copies of the same tree, to check they do not sway as one object.
  grove: ['item-18', 'item-18', 'item-18', 'item-18'],
  pets: [
    'petbed-outdoor-basic', 'pethome-dog-cabin', 'pethome-dog-tent', 'pethome-dog-basket',
    'pethome-cat-donut', 'pethome-cat-yarn', 'pethome-cat-tower',
    'pethome-bird-cage', 'pethome-bird-perch', 'pethome-bird-nest',
  ],
};

const IS_HOUSES = SET === 'houses' || !!ONE_HOUSE;
const IDS = ONLY ? [ONLY] : (SETS[SET] ?? SETS.rebuilt);
const HOUSE_IDS = ONE_HOUSE ? [ONE_HOUSE] : HOUSE_STYLES.map((s) => s.id);

const COUNT = IS_HOUSES ? HOUSE_IDS.length : IDS.length;
const COLS = COUNT === 1 ? 1 : Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(COUNT));
const PITCH = COUNT === 1 ? 0 : IS_HOUSES ? 9 : 4.2;

function Piece({ id, x, z, tag }: { id: string; x: number; z: number; tag?: string }) {
  const item = getItemById(id);
  if (!item) return null;
  // instanceId is what the outdoor animation system seeds each copy's phase/rate/gain from, so a
  // grove of palms here desyncs exactly the way it will on the island.
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, z]}>
      <FurnitureModel name={item.name} item={item} scale={ISLAND_SCALE} instanceId={tag ?? id} />
    </group>
  );
}

function House({ id, x, z }: { id: string; x: number; z: number }) {
  return (
    <group position={[x, 0, z]}>
      <HouseModel style={getHouseStyle(id)} />
    </group>
  );
}

function App() {
  const rows = Math.ceil(COUNT / COLS);
  const span = Math.max(Math.max(COLS, rows) * PITCH, IS_HOUSES ? 13 : 8);
  return (
    <Canvas
      shadows
      camera={{ position: CAM ?? [span * 0.6, span * 0.42 + 2.4, span * 0.8], fov: 42 }}
      gl={{ antialias: true }}
    >
      {/* Island daylight: a warm key from high and to the side, a cool sky fill, and a low bounce
          off the grass. Close enough to Scene.tsx that a silhouette reads the same here. */}
      <color attach="background" args={['#bfe0ea']} />
      <ambientLight intensity={0.75} />
      <hemisphereLight args={['#dff0f7', '#6d7a4a', 0.8]} />
      <directionalLight position={[-10, 7, -6]} intensity={0.45} />
      <directionalLight position={[9, 15, 8]} intensity={1.6} castShadow shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]} />
      <mesh position={[0, -0.02, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} receiveShadow>
        <planeGeometry args={[400, 400]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#7fa54a" roughness={1} />
      </mesh>
      {(IS_HOUSES ? HOUSE_IDS : IDS).map((id, i) => {
        const x = (i % COLS) * PITCH - ((COLS - 1) * PITCH) / 2;
        const z = Math.floor(i / COLS) * PITCH - ((rows - 1) * PITCH) / 2;
        const tag = id + '#' + i;
        return IS_HOUSES
          ? <House key={tag} id={id} x={x} z={z} />
          : <Piece key={tag} id={id} x={x} z={z} tag={tag} />;
      })}
      <OrbitControls target={LOOK ?? [0, IS_HOUSES ? 2.2 : 1.4, 0]} />
    </Canvas>
  );
}

/**
 * ?icons=1 — the SHOP pictures for the same seven houses, so the preview and the model can be
 * compared rather than remembered. This is the half of the brief that says a shop picture must not
 * promise something the model does not deliver.
 */
function Icons() {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 24, padding: 24, background: '#eef2f4' }}>
      {HOUSE_STYLES.map((s) => (
        <div key={s.id} style={{ textAlign: 'center', font: '13px system-ui', color: '#334' }}>
          <div style={{ background: '#fff', borderRadius: 12, padding: 8 }}>
            <QVersionIcon itemId={s.itemId} size={128} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>{s.name}</div>
          <div style={{ opacity: 0.6 }}>{s.roof} / {s.wall}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(params.get('icons') ? <Icons /> : <App />);

```

## tmp-outfit-audit.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness: renders a GRID of avatars, each wearing one combination of
 * equipped items, so cross-slot clashes (hat vs wreath, necklace vs collar, skirt vs
 * coat hem...) can be looked at instead of reasoned about.
 *
 *   ?sheet=<name>&yaw=<rad>
 *
 * Delete with tmp-outfit-audit.html once the audit is signed off.
 */
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { AppProvider } from './src/context/AppContext';
import { CosmeticEffectField } from './src/components/Three/effects';
import { LegacyCharacterModel } from './src/components/Three/character/legacy';
import { CharacterModel } from './src/components/Three/character';
import { resolveCharacterOutfit } from './src/components/Three/character/outfit';
import { CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE, LEGACY_ATTACHMENTS, LEGACY_SKELETON } from './src/constants/characterRig';
import { ALL_ITEMS } from './src/constants/items';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const SHEET = params.get('sheet') ?? 'tops';
const YAW = Number(params.get('yaw') ?? '0');
const PITCH = Number(params.get('pitch') ?? '0');
const MODEL = params.get('model') ?? 'authored';

const TOPS = ['', 'item-1', 'item-2', 'item-3', 'item-4', 'item-26', 'item-27', 'item-32', 'item-33', 'top-jacket'];
const BOTTOMS = ['', 'item-0', 'pants-straight', 'pants-tapered', 'pants-wide', 'pants-skinny', 'pants-cargo', 'pants-denim'];
const HATS = ['', 'item-5', 'hat-bucket', 'hat-beret', 'hat-beanie', 'hat-snapback'];
const ACCS = ['', 'neck-choker', 'neck-princess', 'neck-matinee', 'neck-opera', 'acc-glasses', 'acc-mask'];
const SHOES = ['', 'shoes-sport', 'shoes-leather', 'shoes-heels', 'shoes-boots', 'shoes-sandals', 'shoes-flats'];
const HAIRS = ['', 'hair-short-set', 'hair-mid-set', 'hair-long-set', 'hair-long', 'hair-bob-inward', 'hair-spike-front', 'hair-perm-messy', 'hair-buzz', 'hair-mohawk'];
const FX = ['', 'fx-star-hairpin', 'fx-forest-crown', 'fx-bubble-hairpin', 'fx-flame-charm', 'fx-butterfly-clip'];

const nameOf = (id: string) => (id ? ALL_ITEMS.find(i => i.id === id)?.name ?? id : '—');

interface Cell { items: string[]; label: string }
interface Sheet { cols: number; cells: Cell[]; cellW?: number; cellH?: number }

/** Cross product of two slots, row = a, col = b. */
function matrix(a: string[], b: string[], base: string[] = []): Sheet {
  const cells: Cell[] = [];
  for (const x of a) for (const y of b) {
    cells.push({ items: [...base, x, y].filter(Boolean), label: `${nameOf(x)} + ${nameOf(y)}` });
  }
  return { cols: b.length, cells };
}

function list(ids: string[], base: string[] = []): Sheet {
  return {
    cols: Math.min(ids.length, 6),
    cells: ids.map(id => ({ items: [...base, id].filter(Boolean), label: nameOf(id) })),
  };
}

const SHEETS: Record<string, () => Sheet> = {
  // Each top on its own, then each top over each bottom.
  tops: () => list(TOPS),
  topsbottoms: () => matrix(TOPS, BOTTOMS),
  // Hats against the moving ornaments and against hair.
  hatfx: () => matrix(HATS, FX),
  hathair: () => matrix(HATS, HAIRS.slice(0, 6)),
  hathair2: () => matrix(HATS, ['', ...HAIRS.slice(6)]),
  hairfx: () => matrix(HAIRS, FX),
  hatacc: () => matrix(HATS, ACCS),
  maskhat: () => matrix(HATS, ['acc-mask', 'acc-glasses']),
  skirtshoes: () => list(SHOES, ['item-0']),
  surfshoes: () => list(SHOES, ['item-2']),
  swimneck: () => list(ACCS, ['item-3']),
  // Necklaces / glasses / mask against every top.
  accstops: () => matrix(ACCS, TOPS),
  // Shoes against every bottom.
  shoesbottoms: () => matrix(SHOES, BOTTOMS),
  // Grass skirt against everything that could fight it.
  skirt: () => list(TOPS, ['item-0']),
  bottoms: () => list(BOTTOMS),
  skirt2: () => ({ cols: 5, cells: [
    { items: ['item-0'], label: '草裙' },
    { items: ['item-0', 'item-3'], label: '草裙+泳衣' },
    { items: ['item-0', 'item-26'], label: '草裙+船長' },
    { items: ['item-0', 'item-33', 'neck-opera'], label: '草裙+披肩+歌劇鍊' },
    { items: ['item-0', 'top-jacket', 'shoes-sandals'], label: '草裙+夾克+涼鞋' },
  ] }),
  shoes: () => list(SHOES),
  hats: () => list(HATS),
  accs: () => list(ACCS),
  hairs: () => list(HAIRS),
  fx: () => list(FX),
  // A few full looks.
  full: () => ({
    cols: 5,
    cells: [
      { items: ['item-26', 'pants-straight', 'hat-snapback', 'neck-opera', 'shoes-leather', 'hair-long-set'], label: '船長全套' },
      { items: ['item-4', 'pants-cargo', 'hat-bucket', 'neck-choker', 'shoes-boots', 'hair-spike-front'], label: '探險全套' },
      { items: ['item-3', 'item-0', 'acc-glasses', 'shoes-flats', 'hair-long', 'fx-forest-crown'], label: '海灘全套' },
      { items: ['item-33', 'pants-wide', 'hat-beret', 'neck-princess', 'shoes-heels', 'hair-bob-inward'], label: '披肩全套' },
      { items: ['top-jacket', 'pants-denim', 'hat-beanie', 'acc-mask', 'shoes-sport', 'hair-perm-messy'], label: '夾克全套' },
    ],
  }),
};

const sheet = (SHEETS[SHEET] ?? SHEETS.tops)();

// --- layout: pixels drive the world grid, so the HTML captions land under the avatars ---
const PPU = Number(params.get('ppu') ?? '118');
const FOCUS = params.get('focus') ?? 'body';
const CELL_W = sheet.cellW ?? (FOCUS === 'head' ? 1.55 : FOCUS === 'torso' ? 1.3 : 1.62);
const CELL_H = sheet.cellH ?? (FOCUS === 'head' ? 1.75 : FOCUS === 'torso' ? 1.45 : 2.72);
const COLS = Number(params.get('cols') ?? String(sheet.cols));
const ROWS = Math.ceil(sheet.cells.length / COLS);

function Stand({ items }: { items: string[] }) {
  const rig = {
    head: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), torso: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    leftArm: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), rightArm: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    leftLeg: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), rightLeg: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    eyeL: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), eyeR: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
    mouth: useRef<THREE.Group>(null), hairSway: useRef<THREE.Group>(null),
  };
  const equipped = ALL_ITEMS.filter(i => items.includes(i.id));
  const outfit = resolveCharacterOutfit(equipped);
  return (
    <group scale={CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE} rotation={[PITCH, YAW, 0]} rotation-order="YXZ">
      {MODEL === 'legacy'
        ? <LegacyCharacterModel rig={rig} skeleton={LEGACY_SKELETON} attachments={LEGACY_ATTACHMENTS} outfit={outfit} />
        : <CharacterModel modelId={MODEL as 'authored'} rig={rig} outfit={outfit} />}
    </group>
  );
}

function Grid() {
  return (
    <>
      {sheet.cells.map((cell, i) => {
        const col = i % COLS;
        const row = Math.floor(i / COLS);
        return (
          <group
            key={i}
            position={[
              (col - (COLS - 1) / 2) * CELL_W,
              -(row - (ROWS - 1) / 2) * CELL_H - CELL_H / 2 + (FOCUS === 'head' ? CELL_H / 2 - 1.5676 + 0.06 : FOCUS === 'torso' ? CELL_H / 2 - 0.8475 : 0.28),
              0,
            ]}
          >
            <Stand items={cell.items} />
          </group>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

// HTML caption grid, sized in the same pixels the ortho camera maps world units to.
const grid = document.getElementById('grid')!;
grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${COLS}, ${CELL_W * PPU}px)`;
grid.style.gridAutoRows = `${CELL_H * PPU}px`;
sheet.cells.forEach(cell => {
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.className = 'cell';
  d.innerHTML = `<div class="cap">${cell.label}</div>`;
  grid.appendChild(d);
});

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <AppProvider>
    <Canvas
      orthographic
      camera={{ position: [0, 0, 12], zoom: PPU, near: 0.1, far: 100 }}
      gl={{ preserveDrawingBuffer: true }}
    >
      <color attach="background" args={['#eef2ee']} />
      <ambientLight intensity={1.15} />
      <directionalLight position={[3, 5, 6]} intensity={1.3} />
      <directionalLight position={[-4, 2, -3]} intensity={0.5} />
      <CosmeticEffectField>
        <Grid />
      </CosmeticEffectField>
    </Canvas>
  </AppProvider>,
);

```
