## tmp-overgrowth-preview.tsx

```tsx
/** Throwaway: 離線回歸's overgrowth, sited by the REAL grower and drawn by the REAL field, against
 *  a stand-in Home and a patch of the island's own ground colour. Delete when signed off.
 *
 *  What it is for: every piece of this feature's geometry is hand-authored placement maths — a leaf
 *  laid flat, a twig rolled onto its side, a vine hung off a wall anchor, a bowl on a mat — and
 *  none of it can be checked in the game itself until the Firestore rules carrying `islandState`
 *  are deployed AND a real absence has elapsed. So the field is mounted here instead, with the
 *  sprouts produced by growOvergrowth for a given number of days.
 *
 *  `?days=N` sets the absence (default 40, which is the ceiling and therefore the busiest island).
 *  `?nest=0` hides the pet's resting spot.
 *
 *  Publishes `window.__overgrowth` so a headless run can assert over the sited list rather than
 *  only look at a picture. */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls } from '@react-three/drei';
import { OvergrowthField } from './src/components/Three/IslandOvergrowth';
import { HouseModel } from './src/components/Three/HouseModel';
import { growOvergrowth } from './src/lib/islandOvergrowth';
import { getHouseStyle, HOUSE_FOOTPRINT } from './src/constants/houseStyles';
import { getOvergrowthKind } from './src/constants/islandReturn';
import { ISLAND_SURFACE_Y } from './src/constants/terrain';
import { WeatherType } from './src/types';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const DAYS = Number(params.get('days') ?? 40);
const SHOW_NEST = params.get('nest') !== '0';

/** The stand-in Home: rotated, so nothing below can look right by axis-aligned accident. */
const HOME = {
  position: [1.4, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, -1.1] as [number, number, number],
  rotation: 0.7,
  style: getHouseStyle('starter'),
  footprint: HOUSE_FOOTPRINT,
};

const sprouts = growOvergrowth({
  existing: [],
  hours: DAYS * 24,
  home: HOME,
  islandScale: 1,
  placements: [],
});

(window as unknown as { __overgrowth: unknown }).__overgrowth = {
  days: DAYS,
  total: sprouts.length,
  byKind: sprouts.reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, s) => {
    acc[s.kind] = (acc[s.kind] ?? 0) + 1;
    return acc;
  }, {}),
  wallSlots: sprouts.filter((s) => s.slot >= 0).map((s) => s.slot),
  // Every ground sprout's distance from the origin, so a headless run can assert the spawn-point
  // and grass-edge keep-outs without eyeballing a screenshot.
  groundRadii: sprouts
    .filter((s) => getOvergrowthKind(s.kind).surface === 'ground')
    .map((s) => Math.round(Math.hypot(s.x, s.z) * 100) / 100),
};

function Ground() {
  return (
    <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0]} receiveShadow>
      <circleGeometry args={[5.7, 48]} />
      {/* The plateau's own green (constants/terrain.ts PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR), so the litter is
          judged against the colour it will actually be sitting on. */}
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#4d7c0f" roughness={1} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <div style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0 }}>
    <Canvas shadows camera={{ position: [7, 5.5, 8], fov: 32 }}>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.55} />
      <hemisphereLight intensity={0.5} color="#ffffff" groundColor="#4a4a4a" />
      <directionalLight position={[8, 12, 6]} intensity={1.3} castShadow shadow-mapSize={[1024, 1024]} />
      <Ground />
      <group position={HOME.position} rotation={[0, HOME.rotation, 0]}>
        <HouseModel style={HOME.style} />
      </group>
      <OvergrowthField
        sprouts={sprouts}
        home={HOME}
        islandScale={1}
        weather={WeatherType.SUNNY}
        showNest={SHOW_NEST}
      />
      <OrbitControls target={[0.6, 0.8, 0]} />
    </Canvas>
  </div>,
);
```

```tsx
/** Throwaway: the island companion's follow slot and world scale, checked against a stand-in
 *  owner (a capsule the avatar's real height, facing +z). Delete when signed off.
 *
 *  `?walk=1` drives the stand-in owner in a circle so the trailing/turning can be watched live in
 *  a real browser — headless only ever renders a handful of frames, where the useful check is the
 *  settled pose the pet spawns into. */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { WalkingPet, FlyingPet } from './src/components/Three/IslandPet';
import { PetModel } from './src/components/Three/Pets';
import { AVATAR_BASE_SCALE } from './src/components/Three/Avatar';
import { PET_SPECS, getPetSpecies } from './src/constants/pets';
import { playerBus } from './src/lib/playerBus';
import { ISLAND_SURFACE_Y } from './src/constants/terrain';

// The avatar measures 0.945 local from soles to crown (see Avatar.tsx), i.e. ~2.13 world units.
const OWNER_HEIGHT = 0.945 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE;
const WALK = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('walk');

playerBus.playerPos = new THREE.Vector3(0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0);
playerBus.playerRotation = 0;
playerBus.playerIsMoving = false;

/** Stand-in for the character: a capsule its exact height, with a nose so +z is unambiguous. */
function Owner() {
  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    if (!WALK) return;
    const t = clock.getElapsedTime() * 0.6;
    const r = 2.2;
    playerBus.playerPos!.set(Math.sin(t) * r, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, Math.cos(t) * r);
    // Facing along the circle's tangent, in the same atan2(dirX, dirZ) convention as the avatar.
    playerBus.playerRotation = Math.atan2(Math.cos(t), -Math.sin(t));
    playerBus.playerIsMoving = true;
  });

  const p = playerBus.playerPos!;
  return (
    <group position={[p.x, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, p.z]}>
      {/* Body: the avatar's torso is ~0.14 local wide, i.e. ~0.32 world. */}
      <mesh position={[0, 0.55, 0]}>
        <capsuleGeometry args={[0.17, 1.1, 8, 12]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#8fa6b5" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
      {/* Head, at BASE_HEAD_Y (0.68 local) with the real 0.26-local radius — 大頭小身, and the
          thing a bird flying at head height actually has to clear. */}
      <mesh position={[0, 0.68 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE, 0]}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[0.26 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE, 20, 16]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#8fa6b5" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
      {/* Nose: the direction the owner faces (+z at rotation 0). */}
      <mesh position={[0, 0.68 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE, 0.26 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE + 0.1]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <coneGeometry args={[0.12, 0.3, 8]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#e8836a" />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

function Tile({ id, cam, label }: { id: string; cam: [number, number, number]; label: string }) {
  const size = PET_SPECS[id.replace(/^pet-(dog|cat|bird)-/, '')].height * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE;
  const world = { islandScale: 1, placements: [], home: null };
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ font: '12px sans-serif' }}>{id} · {label} · size {size.toFixed(3)}</div>
      <div style={{ width: 340, height: 300, background: '#eef2f5', border: '1px solid #ccd' }}>
        <Canvas
          shadows
          camera={{ position: cam, fov: 35 }}
          onCreated={({ camera }) => camera.lookAt(0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + 0.6, 0)}
        >
          <ambientLight intensity={0.8} />
          <directionalLight position={[4, 7, 5]} intensity={1.4} castShadow />
          <directionalLight position={[-4, 3, -3]} intensity={0.45} />
          <gridHelper args={[14, 28, '#9bb', '#cdd']} position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + 0.001, 0]} />
          <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0]} receiveShadow>
            <circleGeometry args={[7, 48]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#cfe3c8" roughness={1} />
          </mesh>
          <Owner />
          {getPetSpecies(id) === 'bird'
            ? <FlyingPet itemId={id} size={size} {...world} />
            : <WalkingPet itemId={id} size={size} {...world} />}
        </Canvas>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** `?gait=<id>`: the same model held at four fixed points of the step cycle, to check the legs
 *  actually swing about their hips (and that nothing detaches when they do). */
function GaitStrip({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const size = PET_SPECS[id.replace(/^pet-(dog|cat|bird)-/, '')].height * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE;
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 260px)', gap: 6, padding: 6 }}>
      {[0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, (3 * Math.PI) / 2].map(phase => {
        const gait = { current: { intensity: 1, phase } };
        return (
          <div key={phase}>
            <div style={{ font: '12px sans-serif' }}>{id} · phase {(phase / Math.PI).toFixed(1)}π</div>
            <div style={{ width: 260, height: 260, background: '#eef2f5', border: '1px solid #ccd' }}>
              <Canvas camera={{ position: [1.9, 0.75, 1.5], fov: 32 }} onCreated={({ camera }) => camera.lookAt(0, 0.45, 0)}>
                <ambientLight intensity={0.85} />
                <directionalLight position={[3, 5, 4]} intensity={1.4} />
                <gridHelper args={[3, 12, '#9bb', '#cdd']} />
                <PetModel itemId={id} gait={gait} />
              </Canvas>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

const GAIT = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('gait');
const ONLY = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('only');
const IDS = ['pet-dog-shiba', 'pet-dog-dachshund', 'pet-cat-orange', 'pet-bird-budgie', 'pet-bird-phoenix']
  .filter(id => !ONLY || id.includes(ONLY));
const VIEWS: Array<[string, [number, number, number]]> = [
  ['front', [0, 1.6, 6.2]],
  ['3/4 high', [4.4, 3.6, 4.6]],
  ['side', [6.0, 1.4, 0.4]],
];

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  GAIT ? (
    <GaitStrip id={GAIT} />
  ) : (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 344px)', gap: 6, padding: 6 }}>
      {IDS.flatMap(id => VIEWS.map(([label, cam]) => (
        <Tile key={id + label} id={id} cam={cam} label={label} />
      )))}
    </div>
  ),
);

```

```tsx
/** Throwaway: the island companion seen FROM the first-person camera — the only view that can
 *  answer "is the pet actually on screen". Camera is at the owner's eye (1.65 above their feet) at
 *  FIRST_PERSON_FOV, looking along playerBus.cameraYaw, exactly as CameraController puts it.
 *  Top row is the fix on, bottom row is it off, so the difference is the check. Delete when signed off. */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { WalkingPet, FlyingPet } from './src/components/Three/IslandPet';
import { AVATAR_BASE_SCALE } from './src/components/Three/Avatar';
import { PET_SPECS, getPetSpecies } from './src/constants/pets';
import { playerBus } from './src/lib/playerBus';
import { ISLAND_SURFACE_Y } from './src/constants/terrain';

/** CameraController's FIRST_PERSON_FOV and its eye height above the player's feet. */
const FOV = 68;
const EYE = 1.65;

playerBus.playerPos = new THREE.Vector3(0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0);
playerBus.playerIsMoving = false;

/** Drives the bus every frame the way the real app does, then parks the camera at the eye. */
function Eye({ camYaw }: { camYaw: number }) {
  useFrame(({ camera }) => {
    playerBus.cameraYaw = camYaw;
    // In first person Avatar.tsx steers the body by the camera; a camera looks down -Z where a
    // model faces +Z, hence the half turn — the same conversion IslandPet's slotHeading makes.
    playerBus.playerRotation = camYaw + Math.PI;
    const p = playerBus.playerPos!;
    camera.position.set(p.x, p.y + EYE, p.z);
    camera.lookAt(p.x - Math.sin(camYaw), p.y + EYE, p.z - Math.cos(camYaw));
  });
  return null;
}

/** `?top=1`: same scene, camera lifted and pulled back, to locate a pet that is not in the eye view. */
const TOP = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('top');

function TopEye({ camYaw }: { camYaw: number }) {
  useFrame(({ camera }) => {
    playerBus.cameraYaw = camYaw;
    playerBus.playerRotation = camYaw + Math.PI;
    const p = playerBus.playerPos!;
    camera.position.set(p.x + 4.5, p.y + 5, p.z + 4.5);
    camera.lookAt(p.x, p.y + 0.5, p.z);
  });
  return null;
}

function Tile({ id, camYaw, firstPerson, label }: {
  id: string; camYaw: number; firstPerson: boolean; label: string;
}) {
  const size = PET_SPECS[id.replace(/^pet-(dog|cat|bird)-/, '')].height * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE;
  const world = { islandScale: 1, placements: [], home: null };
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ font: '12px sans-serif' }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{ width: 340, height: 260, background: '#dfeaf2', border: '1px solid #ccd' }}>
        <Canvas shadows camera={{ fov: FOV }}>
          <ambientLight intensity={0.8} />
          <directionalLight position={[4, 7, 5]} intensity={1.4} castShadow />
          <directionalLight position={[-4, 3, -3]} intensity={0.45} />
          <gridHelper args={[24, 48, '#9bb', '#c3d2c0']} position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + 0.001, 0]} />
          <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y, 0]} receiveShadow>
            <circleGeometry args={[14, 48]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#cfe3c8" roughness={1} />
          </mesh>
          {/* A marker at the owner's feet, so the top view has the player to measure against. */}
          {TOP && (
            <mesh position={[0, ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + 1, 0]}>
              <capsuleGeometry args={[0.17, 1.4, 8, 12]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#8fa6b5" roughness={0.9} />
            </mesh>
          )}
          {TOP ? <TopEye camYaw={camYaw} /> : <Eye camYaw={camYaw} />}
          {/* Magenta ball at the walker's first-person slot, straight off the constants: if this is
              on screen and the pet is not, the pet is not at its slot. */}
          <mesh position={[
            -Math.cos(camYaw + Math.PI) * 1.1 + Math.sin(camYaw + Math.PI) * 3.4,
            ISLAND_SURFACE_Y + 0.25,
            Math.sin(camYaw + Math.PI) * 1.1 + Math.cos(camYaw + Math.PI) * 3.4,
          ]}>
            <sphereGeometry args={[0.25, 16, 12]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color="#ff00aa" />
          </mesh>
          {getPetSpecies(id) === 'bird'
            ? <FlyingPet itemId={id} size={size} firstPerson={firstPerson} {...world} />
            : <WalkingPet itemId={id} size={size} firstPerson={firstPerson} {...world} />}
        </Canvas>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * ONE yaw for the whole page (`?yaw=`), which is not a simplification — it is required.
 *
 * `playerBus` is a module-level singleton and every tile on this page mounts its own Canvas into
 * it, so tiles with different yaws simply overwrite each other's `cameraYaw` and every pet ends up
 * placed along whichever tile rendered last while each camera still looks along its own. That is
 * what made the walkers vanish from a view they were, in the app, correctly standing in.
 */
const YAW = Number(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('yaw') ?? 0);
const IDS = ['pet-dog-shiba', 'pet-cat-orange', 'pet-bird-budgie', 'pet-bird-phoenix'];

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 344px)', gap: 6, padding: 6 }}>
    {IDS.map(id => (
      <Tile key={`on${id}`} id={id} camYaw={YAW} firstPerson label={`${id} · yaw ${YAW} · FIXED`} />
    ))}
    {IDS.map(id => (
      <Tile key={`off${id}`} id={id} camYaw={YAW} firstPerson={false} label={`${id} · yaw ${YAW} · before`} />
    ))}
  </div>,
);

```

## tmp-petinteract.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness: the island companion's interactions (petting, feeding, play, notice, rest)
 * driven through the REAL movers, bowl and toy against a bare island. Delete when signed off.
 *
 *   ?id=pet-dog-shiba | pet-cat-orange | pet-bird-budgie
 *
 * window.__do('pet' | 'feed' | 'play')   start an activity exactly as the UI does
 * window.__owner(x, z, yaw)              move the stand-in owner
 * window.__pa / __bus                     the live activity store and player bus
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { FlyingPet, PetBowl, PetToy, WalkingPet } from './src/components/Three/IslandPet';
import { AVATAR_BASE_SCALE } from './src/components/Three/Avatar';
import { PET_SPECS, getPetSpecies } from './src/constants/pets';
import { PET_PLAY_STYLE } from './src/constants/petInteractions';
import { playerBus } from './src/lib/playerBus';
import * as pa from './src/lib/petActivity';
import { getSurfaceAt } from './src/lib/placementSurfaces';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const ID = params.get('id') ?? 'pet-dog-shiba';
const species = getPetSpecies(ID)!;
const size = PET_SPECS[ID.replace(/^pet-(dog|cat|bird)-/, '')].height * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE;
const groundY = getSurfaceAt(0, 0, [], 1).y;

playerBus.playerPos = new THREE.Vector3(0, groundY, 0);
playerBus.playerRotation = 0;
playerBus.playerIsMoving = false;

(window as any).__pa = pa;
(window as any).__bus = playerBus;
(window as any).__owner = (x: number, z: number, yaw = 0) => {
  playerBus.playerPos!.set(x, getSurfaceAt(x, z, [], 1).y, z);
  playerBus.playerRotation = yaw;
};
(window as any).__do = (kind: string) => {
  if (kind === 'pet') {
    pa.startPetting(ID);
    let n = 0;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      pa.patPet(ID);
      if (++n >= 8) {
        window.clearInterval(timer);
        pa.finishPetActivity(ID);
        pa.playPetReaction(ID, 'happy');
      }
    }, 320);
  } else if (kind === 'feed') {
    pa.startEating(ID);
  } else if (kind === 'play') {
    pa.startPlay(ID, PET_PLAY_STYLE[species]);
  }
};

function Owner() {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  useFrame(() => {
    const p = playerBus.playerPos!;
    ref.current?.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
    if (ref.current) ref.current.rotation.y = playerBus.playerRotation ?? 0;
  });
  return (
    <group ref={ref}>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.55, 0]}>
        <capsuleGeometry args={[0.17, 1.1, 8, 12]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#8fa6b5" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.68 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE, 0]}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[0.26 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE, 20, 16]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#8fa6b5" roughness={0.9} />
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.68 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE, 0.26 * AVATAR_BASE_SCALE + 0.1]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <coneGeometry args={[0.12, 0.3, 8]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#e8836a" />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
}

const CAM = (params.get('cam')?.split(',').map(Number) as [number, number, number]) ?? [4.5, 3.4, 6.5];

function App() {
  const world = { islandScale: 1, placements: [], home: null };
  return (
    <>
      <div className="bar">
        <strong>{ID}</strong>
        <button onClick={() => (window as any).__do('pet')}>摸摸</button>
        <button onClick={() => (window as any).__do('feed')}>餵食</button>
        <button onClick={() => (window as any).__do('play')}>陪牠玩</button>
      </div>
      <Canvas shadows camera={{ position: CAM, fov: 40 }} onCreated={({ camera }) => camera.lookAt(0, groundY + 0.4, 1.4)}>
        <color attach="background" args={['#eef2f5']} />
        <ambientLight intensity={0.8} />
        <directionalLight position={[4, 7, 5]} intensity={1.4} castShadow />
        <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, groundY, 0]} receiveShadow>
          <circleGeometry args={[9, 48]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#cfe3c8" roughness={1} />
        </mesh>
        <gridHelper args={[18, 36, '#9bb', '#cdd']} position={[0, groundY + 0.002, 0]} />
        <Owner />
        {species === 'bird'
          ? <FlyingPet itemId={ID} size={size} {...world} />
          : <WalkingPet itemId={ID} size={size} {...world} />}
        <PetBowl itemId={ID} small={species === 'bird'} />
        <PetToy itemId={ID} />
      </Canvas>
    </>
  );
}

const host = document.getElementById('root')! as HTMLElement & { __root?: ReturnType<typeof createRoot> };
host.__root ??= createRoot(host);
host.__root.render(<App />);

```

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for signing off the furniture INTERACTION POSTURE rework.
 *
 * The house interior is not reachable on the guest path, so the bathtub — the piece this whole
 * change is about — cannot be looked at in the game. Everything here is the SHIPPING code:
 *
 *   the furniture   `FurnitureModel` at the interior scale, same as BuildingInteriorView
 *   the character   `CharacterModel` (legacy) driven through the real `CharacterRig` refs
 *   the placement   `resolveInteractionSpot` — the same world-space anchor the game resolves
 *   the pose        `resolveOccupancyFrame` / `resolveActionFrame` + `solveLegSwing`
 *
 * So a screenshot here is what the player gets, and if the body clips the tub, the game clips
 * the tub.
 *
 *   ?item=<item id>    which piece (default the bathtub)
 *   ?t=<0..1>          freeze the mount at this progress instead of animating
 *
 * Delete with tmp-posture-preview.html once this is signed off.
 */
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls } from '@react-three/drei';
import * as THREE from 'three';

import { FurnitureModel } from './src/components/Three/FurnitureItem';
import { CharacterModel } from './src/components/Three/character';
import type { CharacterRig } from './src/components/Three/character/types';
import { resolveCharacterOutfit } from './src/components/Three/character/outfit';
import { CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE, LEGACY_SKELETON, toWorld } from './src/constants/characterRig';
import { getItemById } from './src/constants/items';
import { getPrimaryInteraction, interactionPosture, liePitch } from './src/constants/furnitureInteractions';
import { getPosture } from './src/constants/interactionPostures';
import {
  resolveActionFrame, resolveOccupancyFrame, settleFrom, solveLegSwing,
} from './src/lib/interactionPosture';
import { resolveInteractionSpot } from './src/lib/furnitureInteraction';
import { registerFootprint } from './src/lib/furniturePlacement';
import { ItemCategory, type PlacedItem } from './src/types';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const ITEM = params.get('item') ?? 'item-bathtub';
const FROZEN = params.has('t') ? Number(params.get('t')) : null;
const INTERIOR_SCALE = 1.15;
/** Island decor is drawn at 0.85 and FurnitureModel multiplies BUILDING pieces by a further 1.55. */
const ISLAND_SCALE = 0.85;

const item = getItemById(ITEM)!;
const PIECE_SCALE = item.category === ItemCategory.BUILDING ? ISLAND_SCALE : INTERIOR_SCALE;
const interaction = getPrimaryInteraction(ITEM)!;
const postureId = interactionPosture(interaction);
const posture = getPosture(postureId);

/**
 * The piece stands at the origin, unrotated. `resolveInteractionSpot` needs a measured footprint
 * for `reachAhead`, and nothing has mounted a model yet — the shipping registry fills itself when
 * FurnitureItem mounts, which this harness does not use. Seeding it with the piece's own drawn
 * extent is what the audit does too.
 */
const placement: PlacedItem = { instanceId: 'probe', itemId: ITEM, position: [0, 0, 0], rotation: 0 };

function Scene() {
  const headRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const bodyRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const leftArmRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const rightArmRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const leftLegRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const rightLegRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const eyeLRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const eyeRRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const mouthRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const hairRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const rootRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);

  const rig: CharacterRig = useMemo(() => ({
    head: headRef, torso: bodyRef,
    leftArm: leftArmRef, rightArm: rightArmRef,
    leftLeg: leftLegRef, rightLeg: rightLegRef,
    eyeL: eyeLRef, eyeR: eyeRRef, mouth: mouthRef, hairSway: hairRef,
  }), []);

  const outfit = useMemo(() => resolveCharacterOutfit([]), []);
  const pieceRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const measuredRef = useRef(false);
  const spotRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof resolveInteractionSpot>>(null);

  useFrame((state) => {
    const t = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    // MEASURE THE PIECE FIRST. `reachAhead` (how far the sofa reaches past the seat) is what
    // decides whether the legs hang or plant, and the shipping registry is filled by
    // FurnitureItem, which this harness bypasses — so without this every seat would take the
    // "reach the floor" branch and bury its shins in the cushion. Once, on the first frame the
    // model exists.
    if (!measuredRef.current && pieceRef.current) {
      const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(pieceRef.current);
      if (box.min.x < box.max.x) {
        measuredRef.current = true;
        const extent = {
          cx: (box.min.x + box.max.x) / 2, cz: (box.min.z + box.max.z) / 2,
          halfW: (box.max.x - box.min.x) / 2, halfD: (box.max.z - box.min.z) / 2,
        };
        // `walk` is the FULL box here rather than the game's height-sliced walk band, which only
        // makes the stand spot conservative: the body stands a little further out than it will in
        // the game, never closer. A telescope is the visible case — its tube overhangs the tripod.
        registerFootprint(ITEM, { ...extent, minY: box.min.y, maxY: box.max.y, walk: extent });
        spotRef.current = resolveInteractionSpot(placement, interaction, LEGACY_SKELETON, { x: 0, z: 3 });
        (window as unknown as { __posture: unknown }).__posture = {
          item: item.name, kind: interaction.kind, posture: postureId,
          occupies: posture.occupies, lean: posture.lean ?? 0, legs: posture.legs ?? null,
          box: { min: box.min.toArray(), max: box.max.toArray() },
          spot: spotRef.current,
        };
      }
    }
    const spot = spotRef.current;
    if (!rootRef.current || !spot) return;
    const joints: Record<string, { current: THREE.Group | null }> = {
      head: headRef, torso: bodyRef,
      leftArm: leftArmRef, rightArm: rightArmRef,
      leftLeg: leftLegRef, rightLeg: rightLegRef,
    };

    if (posture.occupies) {
      // Ease the mount in over the first second, then hold — or freeze wherever ?t asked.
      const p = FROZEN ?? Math.min(1, t / 1.2);
      const settle = settleFrom(p);
      const legSwing = solveLegSwing(posture.legs, {
        legLength: toWorld(LEGACY_SKELETON.hip.y - LEGACY_SKELETON.soleY),
        // The floor the player walked in from, which for an indoor piece is 0.
        hipDrop: spot.y + toWorld(LEGACY_SKELETON.hip.y),
        reachAhead: spot.reachAhead,
        lean: posture.lean ?? 0,
      });
      const frame = resolveOccupancyFrame(postureId, { progress: p, settle, time: t, legSwing });
      rootRef.current.position.set(spot.x, THREE.MathUtils.lerp(0, spot.y, settle) + frame.rootRise, spot.z);
      // THE RECLINE, which this harness used to leave out — and leaving it out is not a small
      // inaccuracy, it is the entire lie pose. `lie` declares no `lean` on purpose: how far a
      // body is tipped off flat is derived from the rig (`liePitch`, the angle that keeps an
      // oversized chibi skull out of the mattress), and Avatar.tsx adds it on top of the frame's
      // own pitch. Without it every bed and hammock in here showed a character STANDING on the
      // mattress, which is a picture of the harness rather than of the game.
      const reclinePitch = posture.anchoring === 'side' ? liePitch(LEGACY_SKELETON) * settle : 0;
      rootRef.current.quaternion.setFromEuler(
        new THREE.Euler(reclinePitch + frame.rootPitch, spot.yaw, 0, 'YXZ'),
      );
      write(joints, frame.joints);
    } else {
      const duration = posture.duration ?? 1;
      // Loop the action with a beat of rest between takes — or hold it at ?t of the way through,
      // which is the only way to screenshot a specific moment of a 2.6 s posture.
      const elapsed = FROZEN !== null ? FROZEN * duration : t % (duration + 0.8);
      const frame = resolveActionFrame(postureId, Math.min(elapsed, duration), {
        hipY: toWorld(LEGACY_SKELETON.hip.y),
        legLength: toWorld(LEGACY_SKELETON.hip.y - LEGACY_SKELETON.soleY),
      });
      rootRef.current.position.set(spot.x, frame.rootRise, spot.z);
      rootRef.current.quaternion.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(frame.rootPitch, spot.yaw, 0, 'YXZ'));
      // Neutral first, so a joint the posture does not name goes back to rest rather than
      // holding the previous frame — the game has an idle animation underneath doing this.
      for (const ref of Object.values(joints)) ref.current?.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
      write(joints, frame.joints, frame.weight);
    }
  });

  return (
    <>
      <group ref={pieceRef}>
        <FurnitureModel name={item.name} item={item} scale={PIECE_SCALE} instanceId="probe" />
      </group>
      <group ref={rootRef} scale={CHARACTER_ROOT_SCALE}>
        <CharacterModel modelId="legacy" rig={rig} outfit={outfit} />
      </group>
    </>
  );
}

function write(
  joints: Record<string, { current: THREE.Group | null }>,
  pose: Record<string, { x?: number; y?: number; z?: number } | undefined>,
  weight = 1,
) {
  for (const [name, target] of Object.entries(pose)) {
    const g = joints[name]?.current;
    if (!g || !target) continue;
    if (target.x !== undefined) g.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(g.rotation.x, target.x, weight);
    if (target.y !== undefined) g.rotation.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(g.rotation.y, target.y, weight);
    if (target.z !== undefined) g.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(g.rotation.z, target.z, weight);
  }
}

const label = `${item.name}  ·  ${interaction.kind} → ${postureId}`;
document.getElementById('label')!.textContent = label;

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <Canvas camera={{ position: [3.6, 2.4, 3.8], fov: 42 }} shadows>
    <color attach="background" args={['#e8eef2']} />
    <ambientLight intensity={0.85} />
    <directionalLight position={[4, 7, 4]} intensity={1.5} castShadow />
    <directionalLight position={[-4, 3, -3]} intensity={0.5} />
    <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.002, 0]} receiveShadow>
      <planeGeometry args={[24, 24]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#cfd8dd" />
    </mesh>
    <gridHelper args={[24, 24, '#9fb0b8', '#bcc8ce']} position={[0, 0, 0]} />
    <Scene />
    <OrbitControls target={[0, 0.7, 0]} />
  </Canvas>,
);

// window.__posture is published by Scene once the model has been measured — see the useFrame
// above. Asserting on it is how a run proves the anchor rather than only screenshotting it.

```

```tsx
/** Throwaway: the cookie rabbit alone, ten angles, to sign off the gardener outfit. Delete when done. */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { NpcModel } from './src/components/Three/Npcs';

type View = [label: string, cam: [number, number, number], fov: number, look: [number, number, number], rot?: number];

// The last two reproduce the island's own framing: Scene.tsx puts the camera at [30,12,40] with
// fov 25, the rabbit stands at (1.35, 1.3) scaled to height 1.85, and it is turned by -0.35. That
// works out to 26.8 units away for a unit-height model - i.e. the rabbit is ~8% of the viewport.
const VIEWS: View[] = [
  ['front', [0, 0.55, 2.0], 32, [0, 0.5, 0]],
  ['front-3/4', [1.2, 0.9, 1.7], 32, [0, 0.5, 0]],
  ['side', [2.0, 0.55, 0.05], 32, [0, 0.5, 0]],
  ['back-3/4', [-1.2, 0.9, -1.6], 32, [0, 0.5, 0]],
  ['head', [0, 0.86, 1.6], 14, [0, 0.8, 0]],
  ['head-3/4', [0.9, 0.95, 1.3], 14, [0, 0.78, 0]],
  ['low (hem + boots)', [0, 0.14, 1.7], 30, [0, 0.32, 0]],
  ['above (ear holes)', [0.6, 2.0, 1.0], 26, [0, 0.78, 0]],
  ['ISLAND default cam', [15.48, 6.48, 20.91], 25, [0, 0.5, 0], -0.35],
  ['ISLAND zoomed ~3x', [5.2, 3.01, 7.02], 25, [0, 0.5, 0], -0.35],
];

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <div style={{ font: '12px sans-serif', background: '#f4f1ea' }}>
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 380px)', gap: 6, padding: 6 }}>
      {VIEWS.map(([label, cam, fov, look, rot]) => (
        <div key={label}>
          <div style={{ padding: '2px 0' }}>{label}</div>
          <div style={{ width: 380, height: 440, background: '#8fa9bd' }}>
            <Canvas camera={{ position: cam, fov }} onCreated={({ camera }) => camera.lookAt(...look)}>
              <ambientLight intensity={0.85} />
              <directionalLight position={[3, 5, 4]} intensity={1.5} />
              <directionalLight position={[-3, 2, -2]} intensity={0.5} />
              <group rotation={[0, rot ?? 0, 0]}>
                <NpcModel kind="cookieRabbit" />
              </group>
            </Canvas>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </div>,
);
```

## tmp-rarity-verify.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway verification harness for the four-tier 稀有度 ladder.
 *
 * Renders the REAL RarityAura through react-dom/server and pairs it with the REAL `.rarity-*`
 * rules lifted verbatim out of src/index.css, so what gets screenshotted is the shipping code
 * and not a mock-up of it. Four checks, matching the acceptance list:
 *   A  four tiers side by side — is the intensity a visible slope, or just four colours?
 *   B  稀有 beside a selected card — can it be misread as "the one I tapped"?
 *   C  神話 beside the 餘額不足 warning — can it be misread as danger?
 *   D  thumbnail size — does `.rarity-chip` stay clean where the aura would moiré?
 *
 * Run: npx tsx tmp-rarity-verify.tsx out.html
 * Delete once the ladder is signed off.
 */
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { QVersionIcon } from './src/components/QVersionIcon';
import { RarityAura } from './src/components/UI/RarityAura';
import { Rarity, RARITY_SPECS, rarityStyleVars } from './src/constants/rarity';

const OUT = process.argv[2];

// The rarity block out of the real stylesheet: everything from the 稀有度 banner up to the next
// unrelated rule. Plain CSS in there (no @apply), so it can be dropped straight into a <style>.
const css = readFileSync('./src/index.css', 'utf8');
const banner = css.indexOf('稀有度 (RARITY)');
const start = banner < 0 ? -1 : css.lastIndexOf('/*', banner);
const end = css.indexOf('.confirm-buy-btn');
if (start < 0 || end < 0) throw new Error('could not locate the rarity block in index.css');
const rarityCss = css.slice(start, end);

/**
 * Pass `freeze` as the second argument to pin every animation at a chosen phase.
 *
 * A headless screenshot lands at an arbitrary moment, and these animations are dark for most of
 * their cycle by design — the sparkles are lit for ~1s in every 7 — so an unfrozen capture mostly
 * proves nothing. Negative delays park each layer at its peak instead: all sparks alight (so they
 * can be counted), the sweep mid-pass, the hue at maximum drift.
 */
const FREEZE = process.argv[3] === 'freeze' ? `
  .rarity-spark { animation-delay:-0.476s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .rarity-shine { animation-delay:-6.3s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .rarity-metal { animation-delay:-17.8s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .rarity-mythic .rarity-bezel { animation-delay:-6s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  /* The reveal, parked just after the item has settled: dim fully arrived, flash on its way out,
     rays at their brightest, item at rest. */
  .rarity-reveal-dim { animation-delay:-0.3s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  /* Late in the flash, not at its peak: parked at 12% the white sheet covers everything and the
     frame proves nothing about what is underneath it. */
  .rarity-reveal-flash { animation-delay:-0.45s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .rarity-reveal-rays { animation-delay:-0.48s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .rarity-reveal-item { animation-delay:-0.66s !important; animation-play-state:paused !important; }
` : '';

/** The reveal's DOM, exactly as RarityReveal.tsx builds it, inside a stand-in for ModalOverlay. */
function reveal(rarity: Rarity) {
  const [id, name] = PET[rarity];
  return `<div class="reveal-stage">
    <div class="rarity-reveal-dim"></div>
    <div class="rarity-reveal-flash"></div>
    <div class="rarity-reveal-rays"></div>
    <div class="rarity-reveal-item" style="${styleAttr(rarity)}">
      <div class="rarity-reveal-plinth plinth">
        ${renderToStaticMarkup(<RarityAura rarity={rarity} />)}
        <div class="art">${renderToStaticMarkup(<QVersionIcon itemId={id} size={132} />)}</div>
      </div>
      <span class="rev-name">${name}</span>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

const LADDER: Rarity[] = ['common', 'rare', 'epic', 'mythic'];
// One pet per rung, each actually tagged that tier in constants/items.ts.
const PET: Record<Rarity, [string, string, string]> = {
  common: ['pet-bird-budgie', '虎皮鸚鵡', '600'],
  rare: ['pet-bird-canary', '金絲雀', '850'],
  epic: ['pet-dog-shiba', '柴犬', 'XP 100'],
  mythic: ['pet-bird-phoenix', '鳳凰', '4800'],
};

const styleAttr = (rarity: Rarity) =>
  Object.entries(rarityStyleVars(rarity) as Record<string, string>)
    .map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`)
    .join(';');

function card(rarity: Rarity) {
  const [id, name, price] = PET[rarity];
  return `
  <div class="store-card rarity-card" style="${styleAttr(rarity)}">
    <div class="well rarity-well">
      ${renderToStaticMarkup(<RarityAura rarity={rarity} />)}
      <div class="art">${renderToStaticMarkup(<QVersionIcon itemId={id} size={110} />)}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="name">${name}</div>
    <div class="price">◆ ${price}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function readout(rarity: Rarity) {
  const spec = RARITY_SPECS[rarity];
  const l = spec.layers;
  const drawn = [
    '邊環', '琺瑯板',
    l.rays ? (l.rays < 1 ? '放射紋½' : '放射紋') : null,
    l.sparks ? `閃光×${l.sparks}` : null,
    l.metal ? '金屬流光' : null,
    l.shine ? '掃光' : null,
    l.iris ? '虹彩' : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return `<div class="ro"><b><i style="background:${spec.edge}"></i>${spec.label}</b><br>
    edge ${spec.edge}<br>core ${spec.fieldCore}<br><b>${drawn.length} 層</b><br>${drawn.join(' / ')}</div>`;
}

function chip(rarity: Rarity) {
  const [id, name] = PET[rarity];
  return `<div class="chip rarity-chip" style="${styleAttr(rarity)}">
    <div class="chip-tile">${renderToStaticMarkup(<QVersionIcon itemId={id} size={56} />)}</div>
    <div><div class="chip-name">${name}</div><div class="chip-sub">${RARITY_SPECS[rarity].label}</div></div>
  </div>`;
}

/** `reveal-only` trims the page to section E, so a headless capture (which cannot scroll) gets it. */
const REVEAL_ONLY = process.argv[4] === 'reveal-only';

const body = REVEAL_ONLY ? `
  <h2>E — 揭曉轉場（史詩／神話，凍結在商品現身的瞬間）</h2>
  <div class="row">${reveal('epic')}${reveal('mythic')}</div>
` : null;

writeFileSync(OUT, `<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  :root {
    --color-island-teal:#2A9D8F; --color-island-teal-light:#5FBDAF; --color-island-teal-dark:#1F7A70;
    --color-island-navy:#264653; --color-island-navy-soft:#4A6169;
    --color-island-cream:#FFFFFF; --color-island-cream-2:#F8F6F1; --color-island-line:#E1DED4;
    --color-island-gold:#E8AA3E; --color-island-coral:#E8836A;
  }
  body { margin:0; padding:28px 24px 40px; background:var(--color-island-cream-2);
         font-family:system-ui,"Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif; color:var(--color-island-navy); }
  h2 { font-size:15px; margin:30px 0 12px; letter-spacing:.02em; }
  h2:first-of-type { margin-top:0; }
  .row { display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start; }

  /* .store-card's shape, minus the @apply Tailwind can't give us here. */
  .store-card { width:206px; background:#fff; border-radius:1.75rem; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--color-island-line);
                display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; text-align:left; }
  .well { width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; background:var(--color-island-cream-2); border-radius:16px;
          border:1px solid var(--color-island-line); position:relative; overflow:hidden;
          display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .art { position:relative; z-index:3; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transform:scale(.96); }
  .name { font-weight:900; font-size:14px; }
  .price { font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:var(--color-island-gold); }

  .ro { width:206px; font:11px/1.7 ui-monospace,monospace; color:var(--color-island-navy-soft); padding:0 4px; }
  .ro i { display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:3px; margin-right:6px; vertical-align:-1px; }

  /* The two states a tier must never be mistaken for. */
  .selected { border:2px solid var(--color-island-teal);
              box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(42,157,143,.22), 0 10px 24px rgba(38,70,83,.10); }
  .danger { width:300px; background:rgba(232,131,106,.10); border:1px solid rgba(232,131,106,.25);
            border-radius:12px; padding:10px; color:var(--color-island-coral);
            font-size:12px; font-weight:800; text-align:center; }

  .chip { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; width:280px; padding:12px;
          background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--color-island-line); border-radius:16px; }
  .chip-tile { width:56px; height:56px; flex:0 0 auto; background:var(--color-island-cream-2);
               border-radius:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; }
  .chip-name { font-weight:900; font-size:14px; }
  .chip-sub { font-size:10px; font-weight:800; color:var(--color-island-navy-soft); }

  /* Stand-in for ModalOverlay: same scrim colour, same centring, boxed so both tiers fit on one
     screenshot instead of being full-viewport. */
  .reveal-stage { position:relative; width:660px; height:420px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:20px;
                  background:rgba(38,70,83,.45); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .plinth { width:248px; aspect-ratio:4/3; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .rev-name { color:#fff; font-weight:900; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:.02em;
              text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }

${rarityCss}
${FREEZE}
</style></head><body>${body ?? `
  <h2>A — 四階並排（強度階梯）</h2>
  <div class="row">${LADDER.map(card).join('')}</div>
  <div class="row">${LADDER.map(readout).join('')}</div>

  <h2>B — 稀有 vs 已選取</h2>
  <div class="row">${card('rare')}
    <div class="store-card selected"><div class="well"><div class="art">${renderToStaticMarkup(<QVersionIcon itemId="pet-bird-javasparrow" size={110} />)}</div></div>
```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>reveal frozen</title></head>
<body style="margin:0"><div id="root"></div>
<script type="module" src="/src/index.css"></script>
<script type="module" src="/tmp-reveal.tsx"></script>
<script type="module">
  // Throwaway: freeze the REAL reveal at one instant so the settle-anchored beats (burst, rings,
  // ground light, gradient, copy, hint) can be screenshotted. The strip in tmp-spinstrip.tsx
  // overrides every animation-delay and so can only ever show the arrival; this keeps the delays
  // and seeks the whole document's animations instead. Time in ms comes from the hash.
  const t = Number(location.hash.slice(1) || 5500);
  setTimeout(() => {
    for (const a of document.getAnimations()) {
      try { a.pause(); a.currentTime = t; } catch (e) { /* not seekable - ignore */ }
    }
    document.title = 'frozen@' + t;
  }, 400);
</script>
</body></html>

```

## tmp-roomstyle-check.ts

```ts
import {
  ROOM_TYPE_CONFIGS, parseUnlockedRooms, resolveEditTargetRoom, findRoomAtPosition,
  ROOM_GRID_SIZE, ROOM_HALF_SIZE, RoomInstance,
} from './src/constants/rooms';
import { FLOOR_STYLES, WALL_STYLES } from './src/constants/materialSwatches';
import type { RoomStyle } from './src/types';

const rooms = parseUnlockedRooms(['living', 'kitchen', 'bathroom', 'study']);
const byId = (id: string) => rooms.find(r => r.id === id)!;

/** Mirrors the resolution chain in BuildingInteriorView's room component. */
function resolve(room: RoomInstance, roomStyles: Record<string, RoomStyle>, legacyFloor?: string, legacyWall?: string) {
  const norm = (v?: string) => (v && v !== 'default' ? v : null);
  const rs = roomStyles[room.id];
  const cfg = ROOM_TYPE_CONFIGS[room.type];
  const floorId = rs?.floor ?? norm(legacyFloor) ?? cfg?.floorMaterial ?? 'default';
  const wallId = rs?.wall ?? norm(legacyWall) ?? cfg?.wallMaterial ?? 'default';
  return { floorId, wallId, floor: FLOOR_STYLES[floorId], wall: WALL_STYLES[wallId] };
}

/** Mirrors handleCreateNewPlacement's style branch. */
function applyStyle(roomStyles: Record<string, RoomStyle>, target: RoomInstance, itemId: string) {
  const isWall = itemId.startsWith('wall-');
  return {
    ...roomStyles,
    [target.id]: { ...(roomStyles[target.id] || {}), [isWall ? 'wall' : 'floor']: itemId },
  };
}

let ok = true;
const check = (label: string, cond: boolean) => {
  if (!cond) ok = false;
  console.log(`  ${cond ? 'ok  ' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`);
};

console.log('--- 1. Target room resolution ---');
const centre = resolveEditTargetRoom(0, 0, rooms);
const inKitchen = resolveEditTargetRoom(ROOM_GRID_SIZE, 0, rooms);
const inDoorway = resolveEditTargetRoom(ROOM_HALF_SIZE, 0, rooms);          // exactly on the boundary
const wayOutside = resolveEditTargetRoom(90, 90, rooms);                     // build cam far away
const noRoomHit = findRoomAtPosition(90, 90, rooms);
check(`origin -> living (${centre?.name})`, centre?.id === 'living');
check(`x=+12 -> kitchen (${inKitchen?.name})`, inKitchen?.id === 'kitchen');
check(`doorway on boundary still resolves (${inDoorway?.name})`, inDoorway !== null);
check(`far outside is in NO room`, noRoomHit === null);
check(`far outside still falls back to a room (${wayOutside?.name})`, wayOutside !== null);

console.log('\n--- 2. Painting one room does not touch the others ---');
let styles: Record<string, RoomStyle> = {};
styles = applyStyle(styles, byId('kitchen'), 'wall-pink');
styles = applyStyle(styles, byId('kitchen'), 'floor-luxury-marble');

for (const id of ['living', 'kitchen', 'bathroom', 'study']) {
  const r = resolve(byId(id), styles);
  console.log(`    ${id.padEnd(9)} floor=${r.floorId.padEnd(24)} wall=${r.wallId}`);
}
check('kitchen took the pink wall', resolve(byId('kitchen'), styles).wallId === 'wall-pink');
check('kitchen took the marble floor', resolve(byId('kitchen'), styles).floorId === 'floor-luxury-marble');
check('living kept its own default', resolve(byId('living'), styles).wallId === 'wall-white');
check('bathroom kept its own default', resolve(byId('bathroom'), styles).wallId === 'wall-blue');
check('study kept its own default', resolve(byId('study'), styles).wallId === 'wall-green');

console.log('\n--- 3. A second room can differ from the first ---');
styles = applyStyle(styles, byId('study'), 'wall-red');
check('study now red', resolve(byId('study'), styles).wallId === 'wall-red');
check('kitchen still pink', resolve(byId('kitchen'), styles).wallId === 'wall-pink');

console.log('\n--- 4. Legacy house-wide value still honoured where no per-room style exists ---');
const legacy = resolve(byId('bathroom'), styles, 'floor-oak', 'wall-purple');
const legacyOverridden = resolve(byId('kitchen'), styles, 'floor-oak', 'wall-purple');
check('un-painted room uses the legacy house-wide style', legacy.wallId === 'wall-purple' && legacy.floorId === 'floor-oak');
check('per-room style outranks the legacy value', legacyOverridden.wallId === 'wall-pink');

console.log('\n--- 5. Partial styles fall through per field ---');
const wallOnly = applyStyle({}, byId('living'), 'wall-red');
const r5 = resolve(byId('living'), wallOnly);
check('wall applied, floor still the room-type default', r5.wallId === 'wall-red' && r5.floorId === 'floor-oak');

console.log(`\n${ok ? 'ALL PASS' : 'FAILURES'}`);
process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);

```

```ts
console.log('HOUSE_FOOTPRINT      ', HOUSE_FOOTPRINT);

// clear them is the thinnest half-extent plus the clearance.
const thin = Math.min(solid.halfWidth, solid.halfDepth);
const wide = Math.max(solid.halfWidth, solid.halfDepth);
console.log(`\nplayer at island centre -> nearest accepted seed ~${(thin + clearance).toFixed(2)} away`);
console.log(`(worst axis ${(wide + clearance).toFixed(2)}); house edge sits ${clearance.toFixed(2)} from the character`);
```

## tmp-shoes-preview.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for eyeballing the new 3D wardrobe:
 *   - src/components/Three/Shoes.tsx   (under a stub of the avatar's leg capsule)
 *   - src/components/Three/Outfits.tsx (inside a stub of the avatar's torso capsule)
 * Both stubs copy Avatar.tsx's real dimensions, so anything poking through here pokes
 * through in game too. Delete with tmp-shoes-preview.html once this is signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { ShoeModel, ShoeType, soleAnchorY } from './src/components/Three/Shoes';
import { OutfitModel, OutfitType, OUTFIT_SHELL_COLOR, OUTFIT_HAS_SLEEVES } from './src/components/Three/Outfits';

const LEG_LENGTHEN = 0.0167;
const SKIN = '#f8d3b5';
const STRAIGHT = 0.14 + LEG_LENGTHEN;
const LEG_CENTER_Y = STRAIGHT / 2 + 0.055;

const SHOES: [ShoeType, string][] = [
  ['sport', '運動/休閒鞋'],
  ['leather', '皮鞋/紳士鞋'],
  ['heels', '優雅高跟鞋'],
  ['boots', '時尚靴子'],
  ['sandals', '涼鞋'],
  ['flipflops', '夾腳拖'],
];

const OUTFITS: [OutfitType, string][] = [
  ['surf', '衝浪運動裝'],
  ['diving', '潛水服'],
  ['explorer', '探險套裝'],
  ['captain', '船長制服'],
  ['vest', '探險背心'],
  ['shawl', '島嶼披肩'],
  ['jacket', '夾克'],
];

function Lights() {
  return (
    <>
      <ambientLight intensity={1.15} />
      <directionalLight position={[2, 4, 3]} intensity={2.1} />
      <directionalLight position={[-2, 1.5, -1]} intensity={0.6} />
    </>
  );
}

function ShoeRow({ pants }: { pants: boolean }) {
  return (
    <Canvas camera={{ position: [0.52, 0.36, 0.72], fov: 32 }}>
      <color attach="background" args={['#eaf2f8']} />
      <Lights />
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.001, 0]}>
        <planeGeometry args={[6, 6]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#dfe9f0" roughness={1} />
      </mesh>
      {SHOES.map(([type], i) => (
        <group key={type} position={[(i - (SHOES.length - 1) / 2) * 0.3, 0, 0]}>
          <mesh position={[0, LEG_CENTER_Y, 0]}>
            <capsuleGeometry args={[0.055, STRAIGHT, 4, 16]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={pants ? '#2f4c7c' : SKIN} roughness={0.7} />
          </mesh>
          {/* soleAnchorY is leg-local (origin = hip pivot); this stub is drawn from the sole,
              so add the pivot height back to land the shoe on y=0. */}
          <group position={[0, soleAnchorY(LEG_LENGTHEN) + (0.225 + LEG_LENGTHEN), 0]}>
            <ShoeModel type={type} skinColor={SKIN} />
          </group>
        </group>
      ))}
    </Canvas>
  );
}

/** Torso stub: same capsule Avatar.tsx uses, with the garment nested inside it exactly as
 *  the real component does, plus the two arm capsules so sleeves can be checked. */
function OutfitRow({ back }: { back: boolean }) {
  return (
    <Canvas camera={{ position: back ? [0, 0.1, -0.85] : [0.28, 0.16, 0.78], fov: 34 }}>
      <color attach="background" args={['#eef1f5']} />
      <Lights />
      {OUTFITS.map(([type], i) => (
        <group key={type} position={[(i - (OUTFITS.length - 1) / 2) * 0.42, 0, 0]}>
          <mesh>
            <capsuleGeometry args={[0.135, 0.08, 4, 16]} />
            <meshStandardMaterial color={OUTFIT_SHELL_COLOR[type]} roughness={0.7} />
            <OutfitModel type={type} />
          </mesh>
          {OUTFIT_HAS_SLEEVES[type] &&
            [-1, 1].map((s) => (
              <group key={s} position={[s * 0.138, 0.06, 0]}>
                <mesh position={[0, -0.07, 0]}>
                  <capsuleGeometry args={[0.04, 0.1, 4, 16]} />
                  <meshStandardMaterial color={SKIN} roughness={0.7} />
                </mesh>
                <mesh position={[0, -0.03, 0]}>
                  <capsuleGeometry args={[0.048, 0.04, 4, 16]} />
                  <meshStandardMaterial color={OUTFIT_SHELL_COLOR[type]} roughness={0.6} />
                </mesh>
              </group>
            ))}
        </group>
      ))}
    </Canvas>
  );
}

function Labels({ items }: { items: [string, string][] }) {
  return (
    <div className="labels">
      {items.map(([id, label]) => (
        <span key={id}>
          {label}
          <br />
          <code>{id}</code>
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <div>
    <h2>上衣（左：正面 / 右：背面）</h2>
    <div className="strip tall">
      <OutfitRow back={false} />
    </div>
    <Labels items={OUTFITS} />
    <div className="strip tall">
      <OutfitRow back />
    </div>
    <h2>鞋子（上：光腳 / 下：牛仔褲）</h2>
    <div className="strip">
      <ShoeRow pants={false} />
    </div>
    <div className="strip">
      <ShoeRow pants />
    </div>
    <Labels items={SHOES} />
  </div>,
);

```

## tmp-shopmatch-spans.ts

```ts
/**
 * Measures every outdoor placeable at island scale and writes tmp-shopmatch-spans.json, which
 * tmp-shopmatch.tsx reads to frame each row. Re-run it after changing any outdoor model:
 *
 *   npx tsx tmp-shopmatch-spans.ts > tmp-shopmatch-spans.json
 *
 * Delete with tmp-shopmatch.html / .tsx once the 「商店縮圖 vs 實際模型」 pass is signed off.
 */
import { ALL_ITEMS } from './src/constants/items';
import { DISPLAY_CATEGORIES } from './src/utils/categoryUtils';
import { footprintOf, ISLAND_SCALE } from './scripts/lib/measureFurnitureModel';

const outdoorCats = new Set(
  DISPLAY_CATEGORIES
    .filter((c) => (c.placementScope ?? c.mainSection) === 'OUTDOOR' && c.kind === 'placeable')
    .map((c) => c.id),
);

const out: Record<string, [number, number]> = {};
for (const item of ALL_ITEMS.filter((i) => outdoorCats.has(i.shopCategory))) {
  const box = footprintOf(item.id, ISLAND_SCALE);
  out[item.id] = box
    ? [Number(Math.max(box.maxX - box.minX, box.maxZ - box.minZ).toFixed(2)), Number(box.maxY.toFixed(2))]
    : [2, 2];
}
console.log(JSON.stringify(out));

```

## tmp-shopmatch.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for the 2026-09 「商店縮圖 vs 實際模型」 pass.
 *
 * The shop icon and the shipping model, side by side, for every outdoor placeable.
 *
 * ONE canvas for the whole page: a canvas per row runs the tab out of WebGL contexts after three
 * or four of them, so the rows live in a single orthographic scene instead — laid out along −Z so
 * that the camera's elevation stacks them up the screen, four yaws (正面/右側/背面/左側) across.
 * Every piece is normalised into the same cell, which is also what the icon does, so the two
 * columns are answering the same question.
 *
 *   ?page=0..N   which slice of the catalog (page_size items per page)
 *   ?ids=a,b,c   an explicit list instead of the catalog slice
 *   ?elev=18     camera elevation in degrees (default 18 ≈ the player's normal view)
 *   ?page_size=6
 *
 * Delete with tmp-shopmatch.html once the pass is signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';

import { FurnitureModel } from './src/components/Three/FurnitureItem';
import { ALL_ITEMS, getItemById } from './src/constants/items';
import { DISPLAY_CATEGORIES } from './src/utils/categoryUtils';
import { QVersionIcon } from './src/components/QVersionIcon';
import SPAN_JSON from './tmp-shopmatch-spans.json';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const ELEV = Number(params.get('elev') ?? 18);
const NIGHT = params.get('night') === '1';
const PAGE_SIZE = Number(params.get('page_size') ?? 6);
const PAGE = Number(params.get('page') ?? 0);
const ISLAND_SCALE = 0.85;

const SPAN = SPAN_JSON as unknown as Record<string, [number, number]>;

const outdoorCats = new Set(
  DISPLAY_CATEGORIES.filter(c => (c.placementScope ?? c.mainSection) === 'OUTDOOR' && c.kind === 'placeable').map(c => c.id),
);
const ALL_OUTDOOR = ALL_ITEMS.filter(i => outdoorCats.has(i.shopCategory));

const explicit = params.get('ids');
const LIST = explicit
  ? (explicit.split(',').map(s => getItemById(s.trim())).filter(Boolean) as typeof ALL_OUTDOOR)
  : ALL_OUTDOOR.slice(PAGE * PAGE_SIZE, PAGE * PAGE_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE);

const YAWS = [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, -Math.PI / 2];

/** World size of one cell after each piece is normalised into it. */
const S = 2;
const COL_PITCH = S * 1.25;
const ROW_SCREEN = S * 1.3;
const ROW_PX = Number(params.get('row_px') ?? 190);
const CANVAS_W = 4 * ROW_PX;

function Scene() {
  const el = (ELEV * Math.PI) / 180;
  const rowPitch = ROW_SCREEN / Math.sin(el);
  const rows = LIST.length;
  const H = (4 * COL_PITCH) / 2;
  const V = (rows * ROW_SCREEN) / 2;
  const centreZ = -((rows - 1) * rowPitch) / 2;
  const D = rows * rowPitch + 60;
  const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, S / 2, centreZ);
  const camPos: [number, number, number] = [
    target.x, target.y + Math.sin(el) * D, target.z + Math.cos(el) * D,
  ];
  return (
    <Canvas
      orthographic
      style={{ width: CANVAS_W, height: rows * ROW_PX, background: NIGHT ? '#101c2b' : '#cfe6ee', borderRadius: 8 }}
      camera={{ left: -H, right: H, top: V, bottom: -V, near: 0.1, far: D * 3, position: camPos }}
      gl={{ antialias: true }}
      onCreated={({ camera }) => { camera.lookAt(target); camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); }}
    >
      <ambientLight intensity={NIGHT ? 0.12 : 0.72} />
      <hemisphereLight args={['#dff0f7', '#6d7a4a', NIGHT ? 0.12 : 0.8]} />
      <directionalLight position={[-10, 7, -6]} intensity={NIGHT ? 0.08 : 0.45} />
      <directionalLight position={[9, 15, 8]} intensity={NIGHT ? 0.18 : 1.5} />
      <mesh position={[0, -0.015, centreZ]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <planeGeometry args={[400, 400]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={NIGHT ? "#2b3a24" : "#7fa54a"} roughness={1} />
      </mesh>
      {LIST.map((item, i) => {
        const [span, height] = SPAN[item.id] ?? [2, 2];
        const k = (S / Math.max(span, height, 0.2)) * 0.92;
        const z = -(rows - 1 - i) * rowPitch;
        return YAWS.map((y, j) => (
          <group key={item.id + j} position={[(j - 1.5) * COL_PITCH, 0, z]} scale={k}>
            <group rotation={[0, y, 0]}>
              <FurnitureModel name={item.name} item={item} scale={ISLAND_SCALE} instanceId={item.id + '#' + j} />
            </group>
          </group>
        ));
      })}
    </Canvas>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 11, opacity: 0.6 }}>
        page {PAGE} · elev {ELEV}° · 正面 / 右側 / 背面 / 左側 · {LIST.length} of {ALL_OUTDOOR.length}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 10, padding: '0 10px' }}>
        <div style={{ width: 168 }}>
          {LIST.map(item => (
            <div key={item.id} style={{ height: ROW_PX, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ background: '#fff', borderRadius: 10, padding: 4, width: 150, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                <QVersionIcon itemId={item.id} size={128} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 2, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12 }}>{item.name}</div>
              <div style={{ opacity: 0.55, fontSize: 10 }}>{item.id}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Scene />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />);

```

## tmp-shrubfield.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway harness for the 2026-09 「圓形灌木擺放後不明顯」 pass.
 *
 * tmp-shopmatch answers "does the model look like the icon" and puts every piece on a #7fa54a
 * studio floor. That floor is LIGHTER than the island's own grass (PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR #4d7c0f),
 * so a mid-green shrub reads as a dark ball there and vanishes in the game — the harness was
 * flattering the exact failure being investigated.
 *
 * This one reproduces the placed conditions instead:
 *   - the real plateau greens, inner and outer
 *   - Scene.tsx's lighting, verbatim (ambient .4 / hemi .5 #fff over #4a4a4a / dir [20,20,10] 1.2)
 *   - the third-person camera: fov 35, 7 units of arm (CameraController's `7.0 / uiScale`)
 *   - a chibi-height post beside each piece, so "is it big enough" is a comparison, not a guess
 *
 *   ?ids=a,b,c   pieces to line up (default: the three 灌木 plus their neighbours)
 *   ?elev=26     camera elevation in degrees
 *   ?dist=7      camera arm
 *   ?scale=1     scale reference posts on/off
 *   ?outer=1     stand them on PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR instead
 *
 * Delete with tmp-shrubfield.html once the pass is signed off.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';

import { FurnitureModel } from './src/components/Three/FurnitureItem';
import { getItemById } from './src/constants/items';
import { PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR, PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR } from './src/constants/terrain';
import { LEGACY_SKELETON, worldHeight } from './src/constants/characterRig';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const ELEV = Number(params.get('elev') ?? 26);
const DIST_OVERRIDE = params.get('dist');
const ISLAND_SCALE = 0.85;
const SHOW_SCALE = params.get('scale') !== '0';
const GROUND = params.get('outer') === '1' ? PLATEAU_OUTER_COLOR : PLATEAU_INNER_COLOR;
const IDS = (params.get('ids') ?? 'deco-shrub-round,deco-shrub-flowering,deco-shrub-natural,deco-shrub-tropical')
  .split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

const PLAYER_H = worldHeight(LEGACY_SKELETON);
const PITCH = Number(params.get('pitch') ?? 1.5);
/** Auto-frame: arm long enough to fit the whole row at fov 35, unless ?dist= overrides it. */
const AUTO_DIST = DIST_OVERRIDE ? Number(DIST_OVERRIDE)
  : Math.max(6, ((IDS.length - 1) * PITCH + 2.6) / (2 * Math.tan((35 * Math.PI / 180) / 2)) * 0.60);

function Scene() {
  const el = (ELEV * Math.PI) / 180;
  const spanX = (IDS.length - 1) * PITCH;
  const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.35, 0);
  const camPos: [number, number, number] = [0, target.y + Math.sin(el) * AUTO_DIST, target.z + Math.cos(el) * AUTO_DIST];
  return (
    <Canvas
      shadows
      style={{ width: '100%', height: '78vh', background: '#bfe3ef' }}
      camera={{ position: camPos, fov: 35, near: 0.1, far: 200 }}
      onCreated={({ camera }) => { camera.lookAt(target); camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); }}
    >
      {/* Scene.tsx's lighting, verbatim. */}
      <ambientLight intensity={0.4} />
      <hemisphereLight intensity={0.5} color="#ffffff" groundColor="#4a4a4a" />
      <directionalLight
        position={[20, 20, 10]}
        intensity={1.2}
        castShadow
        shadow-mapSize={[2048, 2048]}
        shadow-camera-left={-20}
        shadow-camera-right={20}
        shadow-camera-top={20}
        shadow-camera-bottom={-20}
      />
      <mesh position={[0, 0, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} receiveShadow>
        <planeGeometry args={[200, 200]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color={GROUND} roughness={1} />
      </mesh>
      {IDS.map((id, i) => {
        const item = getItemById(id);
        if (!item) return null;
        const x = i * PITCH - spanX / 2;
        return (
          <group key={id} position={[x, 0, 0]}>
            <FurnitureModel name={item.name} item={item} scale={ISLAND_SCALE} instanceId={id} />
            {SHOW_SCALE && (
              <mesh position={[0.62, PLAYER_H / 2, 0.1]} castShadow>
                <boxGeometry args={[0.055, PLAYER_H, 0.055]} />
                <meshStandardMaterial color="#e8836a" roughness={0.9} />
              </mesh>
            )}
          </group>
        );
      })}
    </Canvas>
  );
}

function App() {
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12 }}>
        ground {GROUND} · elev {ELEV}° · dist {AUTO_DIST.toFixed(1)} · fov 35 · 玩家身高 {PLAYER_H.toFixed(2)}（珊瑚色柱）
      </div>
      <Scene />
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', padding: '4px 10px', fontSize: 12, gap: 8 }}>
        {IDS.map(id => (
          <div key={id} style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'center' }}>{getItemById(id)?.name ?? id}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />);

```

## tmp-skyfacet.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Temporary harness: does SkyDome's gradient crease along the sphere's triangle
 * edges? Same shader, same colours, camera aimed at the zenith where the pole fan
 * is. ?seg=32x32 (old) vs ?seg=64x40 (new). Not part of the app.
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Canvas, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import * as THREE from 'three';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const [W, H] = (params.get('seg') ?? '32x32').split('x').map(Number);
const PITCH = Number(params.get('pitch') ?? 55); // degrees above the horizon

function Sky() {
  const material = useMemo(
    () =>
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        uniforms: {
          uTopColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#4fc3f7') },
          uBottomColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#e0f2fe') },
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;
          void main() {
            vWorldPosition = (modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
          }`,
        fragmentShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;
          uniform vec3 uTopColor;
          uniform vec3 uBottomColor;
          void main() {
            float h = normalize(vWorldPosition).y;
            gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uBottomColor, uTopColor, smoothstep(0.0, 0.42, h)), 1.0);
          }`,
        side: THREE.BackSide,
      }),
    []
  );
  return (
    <mesh>
      <sphereGeometry args={[500, W, H]} />
      <primitive object={material} attach="material" />
    </mesh>
  );
}

function Aim() {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera);
  const r = (PITCH * Math.PI) / 180;
  camera.position.set(0, 12, 0);
  camera.lookAt(Math.cos(r) * 400, 12 + Math.sin(r) * 400, 0);
  camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  return null;
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 12, 0], fov: 70, near: 0.5, far: 2000 }}>
    <Aim />
    <Sky />
  </Canvas>
);

```

## tmp-skystars.tsx

```tsx
/**
 * Temporary harness: is drei's <Stars> from Scene.tsx visible in a DAYTIME sky,
 * and does it show through the transparent ocean plane?
 * Reproduces Scene.tsx's camera, SkyDome's gradient shader (SUNNY endpoints, no
 * lerp) and Ocean.tsx's transparent/depthWrite:false surface. Not part of the app.
 *
 *   ?stars=1  drei <Stars> mounted (current Scene.tsx)
 *   ?stars=0  removed (proposed)
 */
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Canvas, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { Stars } from '@react-three/drei';
import * as THREE from 'three';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const WITH_STARS = params.get('stars') !== '0';

function Sky() {
  const material = useMemo(
    () =>
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        uniforms: {
          uTopColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#4fc3f7') },
          uBottomColor: { value: new THREE.Color('#e0f2fe') },
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;
          void main() {
            vWorldPosition = (modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
          }`,
        fragmentShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;
          uniform vec3 uTopColor;
          uniform vec3 uBottomColor;
          void main() {
            float h = normalize(vWorldPosition).y;
            gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uBottomColor, uTopColor, smoothstep(0.0, 0.42, h)), 1.0);
          }`,
        side: THREE.BackSide,
      }),
    []
  );
  return (
    <mesh>
      <sphereGeometry args={[500, 32, 32]} />
      <primitive object={material} attach="material" />
    </mesh>
  );
}

/** Stand-in for Ocean.tsx's surface: the properties that matter here are
 *  `transparent` + `depthWrite: false`, which are exactly what lets anything
 *  underneath it keep drawing straight through. */
function Sea() {
  return (
    <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.5, 0]}>
      <planeGeometry args={[2000, 2000, 1, 1]} />
      <meshBasicMaterial color="#116985" transparent opacity={0.85} depthWrite={false} />
    </mesh>
  );
}

/** Aim the lens at the horizon so both the sky and the open sea are in frame -
 *  the default lookAt(0,0,0) from this position fills the frame with water. */
function Aim() {
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera);
  camera.lookAt(-300, 40, -400);
  camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  return null;
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(
  <Canvas camera={{ position: [30, 12, 40], fov: 25, near: 0.5, far: 2000 }}>
    <Aim />
    <Sky />
    <Sea />
    {WITH_STARS && (
      <Stars radius={100} depth={50} count={2000} factor={4} saturation={0} fade speed={1} />
    )}
  </Canvas>
);

```

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway: renders the 轉動音 offline and prints its envelope, so「是不是持續的」can be answered
 * with numbers instead of by asking someone to listen.
 *
 * The reveal's whoosh is the one sound whose failure mode is being INAUDIBLE — masked by the
 * fanfare, or gated to silence between passes — and neither of those shows up in a screenshot or
 * in a headless run (no audio device). So: run the real `playRevealSpin` into an
 * OfflineAudioContext, render it, and measure the RMS of every 100ms window. A continuous sound
 * has no window near zero.
 *
 * Open http://localhost:3000/tmp-spinsound.html, or read `window.__spinEnvelope` over CDP.
 * Delete once the sound is signed off.
 */
import { playRevealSpin } from './src/lib/soundUtils';
import { REVEAL_COLOUR_RISE_MS, REVEAL_SETTLE_MS } from './src/constants/rarityFx';

const DURATION_MS = REVEAL_SETTLE_MS;
/** The sound is supposed to be GONE from here on. Measured below, not assumed. */
const END_MS = REVEAL_COLOUR_RISE_MS;
const RENDER_MS = 8200;
const RATE = 44100;
const WINDOW_MS = 100;

const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.floor((RENDER_MS / 1000) * RATE), RATE);
playRevealSpin(0.55, DURATION_MS, END_MS, ctx);

ctx.startRendering().then(buffer => {
  const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
  const rows: Array<{ ms: number; rms: number; peak: number }> = [];
  for (let ms = 0; ms < RENDER_MS; ms += WINDOW_MS) {
    const from = Math.floor((ms / 1000) * RATE);
    const to = Math.min(data.length, Math.floor(((ms + WINDOW_MS) / 1000) * RATE));
    let sum = 0;
    let peak = 0;
    for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
      sum += data[i] * data[i];
      if (Math.abs(data[i]) > peak) peak = Math.abs(data[i]);
    }
    rows.push({ ms, rms: Math.sqrt(sum / (to - from)), peak });
  }

  const body = rows.filter(r => r.ms >= 400 && r.ms <= END_MS - 500);
  const tail = rows.filter(r => r.ms >= END_MS + 100);
  const loudestTail = tail.reduce((a, b) => (a.rms > b.rms ? a : b));
  const quietest = body.reduce((a, b) => (a.rms < b.rms ? a : b));
  const loudest = body.reduce((a, b) => (a.rms > b.rms ? a : b));

  (window as unknown as { __spinEnvelope?: unknown }).__spinEnvelope = {
    rows,
    quietest,
    loudest,
    loudestTail,
    // The number the complaint was about: how deep the holes between passes go.
    ratio: quietest.rms / loudest.rms,
  };

  document.body.style.font = '12px ui-monospace, monospace';
  document.body.style.whiteSpace = 'pre';
  document.body.textContent = [
    `duration ${DURATION_MS}ms, rendered ${RENDER_MS}ms`,
    `sound ends at ${END_MS}ms (colour rise); spin runs to ${DURATION_MS}ms`,
    `quietest window in the body: ${quietest.ms}ms rms=${quietest.rms.toFixed(4)}`,
    `loudest  window in the body: ${loudest.ms}ms rms=${loudest.rms.toFixed(4)}`,
    `loudest window AFTER the end: ${loudestTail.ms}ms rms=${loudestTail.rms.toFixed(4)}`,
    `floor/peak ratio: ${(quietest.rms / loudest.rms).toFixed(3)}`,
    '',
    ...rows.map(r => `${String(r.ms).padStart(5)}ms  rms=${r.rms.toFixed(4)}  peak=${r.peak.toFixed(4)}  ${'#'.repeat(Math.round(r.rms * 300))}`),
  ].join('\n');
});
```

```tsx
/**
 * Throwaway: the 5.5s arrival, sampled as a strip — does the item actually turn AND grow, and is the
 * silhouette still black for most of it?
 *
 * Renders the real `.rarity-reveal-*` DOM with the real rules lifted out of src/index.css, once per
 * sample, each frozen at a different point of the track with a negative animation-delay. Every
 * layer on a tile gets the SAME negative delay, so a tile is one honest instant of the reveal.
 *
 * Run: npx tsx tmp-spinstrip.tsx out.html
 * Delete once the arrival is signed off.
 */
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { QVersionIcon } from './src/components/QVersionIcon';
import { RarityAura } from './src/components/UI/RarityAura';
import { Rarity, rarityStyleVars } from './src/constants/rarity';
import { RARITY_FX, REVEAL_SETTLE_MS } from './src/constants/rarityFx';

const OUT = process.argv[2];
const ITEM = 'pet-bird-phoenix';
const TIER: Rarity = 'mythic';

const css = readFileSync('./src/index.css', 'utf8');
const banner = css.indexOf('稀有度 (RARITY)');
const start = banner < 0 ? -1 : css.lastIndexOf('/*', banner);
const end = css.indexOf('.confirm-buy-btn');
if (start < 0 || end < 0) throw new Error('could not locate the rarity block in index.css');
const rarityCss = css.slice(start, end);

const styleAttr = (r: Rarity) =>
  Object.entries(rarityStyleVars(r) as Record<string, string>).map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`).join(';');

/** Every animated layer in the reveal, so one delay can be pushed onto all of them at once. */
const LAYERS = [
  'rarity-reveal-layer', 'rarity-reveal-dim', 'rarity-reveal-backdrop', 'rarity-reveal-flash',
  'rarity-reveal-rays', 'rarity-reveal-burst', 'rarity-reveal-ring', 'rarity-reveal-stage',
  'rarity-reveal-spin', 'rarity-reveal-grow', 'rarity-reveal-plinth', 'rarity-reveal-plate',
  'rarity-reveal-silhouette',
  'rarity-reveal-pool', 'rarity-reveal-halo', 'rarity-reveal-line', 'rarity-reveal-hint',
];

const freeze = (ms: number) => LAYERS.map(c =>
  `#t${ms} .${c} { animation-delay: -${ms}ms !important; animation-play-state: paused !important; }`,
).join('\n');

const turns = RARITY_FX[TIER].revealTurns ?? 3;

const tile = (ms: number) => `
<figure>
  <figcaption>${ms}ms${ms === REVEAL_SETTLE_MS ? ' — SETTLE' : ''}</figcaption>
  <div class="viewport" id="t${ms}">
    <div class="rarity-reveal-layer">
      <div class="rarity-reveal-dim"></div>
      <div class="rarity-reveal-backdrop" style="${styleAttr(TIER)}"></div>
      <div class="rarity-reveal-flash"></div>
      <div class="rarity-reveal-rays"></div>
      <div class="rarity-reveal-burst" style="${styleAttr(TIER)}"></div>
      <div class="rarity-reveal-ring" style="${styleAttr(TIER)}"></div>
      <div class="rarity-reveal-stage" style="${styleAttr(TIER)}">
        <div class="rarity-reveal-pivot">
          <div class="rarity-reveal-ground">
            <div class="rarity-reveal-pool"></div>
            <div class="rarity-reveal-halo"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="rarity-reveal-spin" style="--reveal-turns:${turns}">
            <div class="rarity-reveal-grow">
              <div class="rarity-reveal-plinth plinth">
                <div class="rarity-reveal-plate">${renderToStaticMarkup(<RarityAura rarity={TIER} />)}</div>
                <div class="rarity-reveal-silhouette">${renderToStaticMarkup(<QVersionIcon itemId={ITEM} size={132} />)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</figure>`;

// Sampled tightly through the arrival: the question is whether the TURN is legible frame to frame,
// which a coarse strip cannot answer — two samples a full revolution apart look identical.
const SAMPLES = [200, 600, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, 3400, 3800, 4200, 4700, 5100, REVEAL_SETTLE_MS];

writeFileSync(OUT, `<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  :root {
    --color-island-teal:#2A9D8F; --color-island-navy:#264653;
    --color-island-cream:#FFFFFF; --color-island-cream-2:#F8F6F1; --color-island-line:#E1DED4;
    --color-island-gold:#E8AA3E; --color-island-coral:#E8836A;
  }
  body { margin:0; padding:14px; background:#f4f4f6; font:12px sans-serif; }
  .row { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  figure { margin:0; }
  figcaption { padding-bottom:4px; font-weight:700; color:#333; }
  .viewport { position:relative; width:250px; height:250px; overflow:hidden; background:#111; }
  .viewport .rarity-reveal-layer { position:absolute; inset:0; }
  .rarity-reveal-stage { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .plinth { width:150px; aspect-ratio:4/3; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .plinth svg { width:80px; height:80px; }
${rarityCss}
${SAMPLES.map(freeze).join('\n')}
</style></head><body>
<div class="row">${SAMPLES.map(tile).join('')}</div>
</body></html>`);
```
